title: 稀釋製冷機
summary: 以無液氦的乾式稀釋製冷機為對象：從 ³He 在 ⁴He 中的有限溶解度與相分離出發，理解混合腔如何連續製冷到 10 mK 以下；再把脈衝管冷卻器、靜止段、逆流熱交換器、氣體處理系統與熱負載預算整合成可驗收、可交接的毫克耳文實驗平台。
summaryEn: Built around a cryogen-free dry dilution refrigerator: start from the finite solubility of ³He in ⁴He and phase separation to see how the mixing chamber cools continuously below 10 mK, then integrate the pulse-tube cooler, still, counterflow heat exchangers, gas-handling system and heat-load budget into a millikelvin platform that can be accepted and handed over.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冷卻力與基礎溫度練習：假設 ³He 循環率 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = 84·ṅ₃·T² = 0.042·T² W；考慮熱交換器效率 70%，有效係數為 0.0294 W/K²。混合腔寄生負載預算：50 條同軸線傳導 0.12 µW、衰減器耗散 0.01 µW、脈衝管振動加熱 1.0 µW、殘餘氣體 0.5 µW、屏蔽開孔輻射 0.07 µW，合計 1.7 µW。無實驗負載時基礎溫度 T = √(1.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(5.8×10⁻⁵) ≈ 7.6 mK。加上一個耗散 10 µW 的實驗，總負載 11.7 µW，T = √(11.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(3.98×10⁻⁴) ≈ 20 mK；若實驗只能容忍 15 mK，可用的有效冷卻力為 0.0294×(0.015)² = 6.6 µW，必須把實驗耗散壓到 5 µW 以下或提高循環率。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cooling-power and base-temperature exercise: assume a ³He circulation rate ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s, ideal cooling power Q̇ = 84·ṅ₃·T² = 0.042·T² W, and a 70% heat-exchanger efficiency giving an effective coefficient of 0.0294 W/K². Parasitic-load budget at the mixing chamber: conduction through 50 coaxial lines 0.12 µW, attenuator dissipation 0.01 µW, pulse-tube vibration heating 1.0 µW, residual gas 0.5 µW, radiation through shield openings 0.07 µW, total 1.7 µW. With no experiment the base temperature is T = √(1.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(5.8×10⁻⁵) ≈ 7.6 mK. Adding an experiment that dissipates 10 µW makes the total 11.7 µW and T = √(11.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(3.98×10⁻⁴) ≈ 20 mK; if the experiment can only tolerate 15 mK, the available effective cooling is 0.0294×(0.015)² = 6.6 µW, so the experiment's dissipation must be cut below 5 µW or the circulation rate raised. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」與「靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling" and "Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: ³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「混合腔相界面」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mixing-chamber phase boundary” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ³He/⁴He 混合液在約 0.87 K 以下會相分離：富 ³He 的濃相浮在富 ⁴He 的稀相之上；即使溫度趨近 0 K，稀相仍溶有 6.6% 的 ³He，因為 ³He 原子與 ⁴He 之間的結合比 ³He 彼此之間更強。³He 原子從濃相穿過相界面進入稀相時要吸收焓差，和蒸發一樣；稀相中的 ³He 行為像費米氣體，其焓隨 T² 變化。由於溶解度不會歸零，這種「蒸發」在毫克耳文仍能持續，不像純 ³He 抽氣在 0.3 K 附近就因蒸氣壓指數下降而失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「混合腔相界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Below about 0.87 K a ³He/⁴He mixture separates into a ³He-rich concentrated phase floating on a ⁴He-rich dilute phase, and even as T → 0 the dilute phase still dissolves 6.6% ³He because a ³He atom binds more strongly to ⁴He than to other ³He atoms. A ³He atom crossing the phase boundary from the concentrated into the dilute phase absorbs an enthalpy difference, exactly like evaporation; in the dilute phase ³He behaves as a Fermi gas whose enthalpy scales as T². Because the solubility never vanishes, this evaporation keeps working at millikelvin temperatures, unlike pumping on pure ³He, which stops near 0.3 K as the vapour pressure collapses exponentially. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mixing-chamber phase boundary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：濃相與稀相的莫耳焓近似為 H_c ≈ 11·T² 與 H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²)，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The molar enthalpies of the concentrated and dilute phases are approximately H_c ≈ 11·T² and H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²), so the ideal cooling power is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「混合腔相界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mixing-chamber phase boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling
knowledge.text: ³He/⁴He 混合液在約 0.87 K 以下會相分離：富 ³He 的濃相浮在富 ⁴He 的稀相之上；即使溫度趨近 0 K，稀相仍溶有 6.6% 的 ³He，因為 ³He 原子與 ⁴He 之間的結合比 ³He 彼此之間更強。³He 原子從濃相穿過相界面進入稀相時要吸收焓差，和蒸發一樣；稀相中的 ³He 行為像費米氣體，其焓隨 T² 變化。
knowledge.textEn: Below about 0.87 K a ³He/⁴He mixture separates into a ³He-rich concentrated phase floating on a ⁴He-rich dilute phase, and even as T → 0 the dilute phase still dissolves 6.6% ³He because a ³He atom binds more strongly to ⁴He than to other ³He atoms. A ³He atom crossing the phase boundary from the concentrated into the dilute phase absorbs an enthalpy difference, exactly like evaporation; in the dilute phase ³He behaves as a Fermi gas whose enthalpy scales as T².

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling" is correct?
options: 低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。
³He/⁴He 混合液在約 0.87 K 以下會相分離：富 ³He 的濃相浮在富 ⁴He 的稀相之上。
靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
optionsEn: Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot.

Below about 0.87 K a ³He/⁴He mixture separates into a ³He-rich concentrated phase floating on a ⁴He-rich dilute phase, and even as T → 0 the dilute phase still dissolves 6.6% ³He because a ³He atom binds more strongly to ⁴He than to other ³He atoms.
The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
quiz.explanation: ³He/⁴He 混合液在約 0.87 K 以下會相分離：富 ³He 的濃相浮在富 ⁴He 的稀相之上；即使溫度趨近 0 K，稀相仍溶有 6.6% 的 ³He，因為 ³He 原子與 ⁴He 之間的結合比 ³He 彼此之間更強。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Below about 0.87 K a ³He/⁴He mixture separates into a ³He-rich concentrated phase floating on a ⁴He-rich dilute phase, and even as T → 0 the dilute phase still dissolves 6.6% ³He because a ³He atom binds more strongly to ⁴He than to other ³He atoms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: ³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混合腔相界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mixing-chamber phase boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：濃相與稀相的莫耳焓近似為 H_c ≈ 11·T² 與 H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²)，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T²。取 ³He 循環率 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s = 5×10⁻⁴ mol/s：在 100 mK，Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×0.01 = 4.2×10⁻⁴ W = 420 µW；在 20 mK，Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×4×10⁻⁴ = 16.8 µW，與商用大型乾式系統在 100 mK 標示的 350–450 µW 屬同一量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The molar enthalpies of the concentrated and dilute phases are approximately H_c ≈ 11·T² and H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²), so the ideal cooling power is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T². With a ³He circulation rate ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s = 5×10⁻⁴ mol/s: at 100 mK, Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×0.01 = 4.2×10⁻⁴ W = 420 µW; at 20 mK, Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×4×10⁻⁴ = 16.8 µW, the same order as the 350–450 µW at 100 mK quoted for large commercial dry systems. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在穩態下對混合腔施加已知加熱功率，逐點記錄混合腔溫度，把 Q̇ 對 T² 作圖：斜率就是有效的 84·ṅ₃，拿來和氣體處理系統流量計讀到的循環率比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At steady state apply a known heater power to the mixing chamber, record its temperature point by point and plot Q̇ against T²: the slope is the effective 84·ṅ₃, to be compared with the circulation rate read on the gas-handling-system flow meter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 濃相與稀相的莫耳焓近似為 H_c ≈ 11·T² 與 H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²)，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T²。取 ³He 循環率 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s = 5×10⁻⁴ mol/s：在 100 mK，Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×0.01 = 4.2×10⁻⁴ W = 420 µW；在 20 mK，Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×4×10⁻⁴ = 16.8 µW，與商用大型乾式系統在 100 mK 標示的 350–450 µW 屬同一量級。
knowledge.textEn: The molar enthalpies of the concentrated and dilute phases are approximately H_c ≈ 11·T² and H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²), so the ideal cooling power is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T². With a ³He circulation rate ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s = 5×10⁻⁴ mol/s: at 100 mK, Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×0.01 = 4.2×10⁻⁴ W = 420 µW; at 20 mK, Q̇ = 84×5×10⁻⁴×4×10⁻⁴ = 16.8 µW, the same order as the 350–450 µW at 100 mK quoted for large commercial dry systems.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling", which statement holds?
options: 熱交換面積越大一定越好，與流阻無關。
只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。
濃相與稀相的莫耳焓近似為 H_c ≈ 11·T² 與 H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²)，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T²。
optionsEn: More exchanger area is always better, regardless of flow impedance.
Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature.
The molar enthalpies of the concentrated and dilute phases are approximately H_c ≈ 11·T² and H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²), so the ideal cooling power is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T².
quiz.explanation: 濃相與稀相的莫耳焓近似為 H_c ≈ 11·T² 與 H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²)，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The molar enthalpies of the concentrated and dilute phases are approximately H_c ≈ 11·T² and H_d ≈ 95·T² J/(mol·K²), so the ideal cooling power is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95 − 11)·T² = 84·ṅ₃·T². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: ³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「混合腔相界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mixing-chamber phase boundary” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在穩態下對混合腔施加已知加熱功率，逐點記錄混合腔溫度，把 Q̇ 對 T² 作圖：斜率就是有效的 84·ṅ₃，拿來和氣體處理系統流量計讀到的循環率比較。若斜率明顯低於 84·ṅ₃，表示回流 ³He 的入口溫度高於混合腔，熱交換器效率不足；完整關係是 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At steady state apply a known heater power to the mixing chamber, record its temperature point by point and plot Q̇ against T²: the slope is the effective 84·ṅ₃, to be compared with the circulation rate read on the gas-handling-system flow meter. A slope clearly below 84·ṅ₃ means the returning ³He enters warmer than the mixing chamber, i.e. the heat exchangers are inefficient; the full relation is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：混合物比例錯誤或 ³He 流失時，相界面不會落在混合腔內，而是跑到靜止段或混合腔下方的管路；症狀是靜止段與循環率看起來都正常，混合腔卻停在數百 mK 的平台，無論怎麼調整都到不了基礎溫度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With a wrong mixture ratio or lost ³He the phase boundary does not sit inside the mixing chamber but ends up in the still or in the line below the chamber; the symptom is a still and a circulation rate that look normal while the mixing chamber plateaus at a few hundred millikelvin and no tuning reaches base temperature.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在穩態下對混合腔施加已知加熱功率，逐點記錄混合腔溫度，把 Q̇ 對 T² 作圖：斜率就是有效的 84·ṅ₃，拿來和氣體處理系統流量計讀到的循環率比較。若斜率明顯低於 84·ṅ₃，表示回流 ³He 的入口溫度高於混合腔，熱交換器效率不足；完整關係是 Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)。
knowledge.textEn: At steady state apply a known heater power to the mixing chamber, record its temperature point by point and plot Q̇ against T²: the slope is the effective 84·ṅ₃, to be compared with the circulation rate read on the gas-handling-system flow meter. A slope clearly below 84·ṅ₃ means the returning ³He enters warmer than the mixing chamber, i.e. the heat exchangers are inefficient; the full relation is Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²).

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling"?
options: 在穩態下對混合腔施加已知加熱功率，逐點記錄混合腔溫度，把 Q̇ 對 T² 作圖：斜率就是有效的 84·ṅ₃，拿來和氣體處理系統流量計讀到的循環率比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。
optionsEn: At steady state apply a known heater power to the mixing chamber, record its temperature point by point and plot Q̇ against T²: the slope is the effective 84·ṅ₃, to be compared with the circulation rate read on the gas-handling-system flow meter.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional.
quiz.explanation: 在穩態下對混合腔施加已知加熱功率，逐點記錄混合腔溫度，把 Q̇ 對 T² 作圖：斜率就是有效的 84·ṅ₃，拿來和氣體處理系統流量計讀到的循環率比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At steady state apply a known heater power to the mixing chamber, record its temperature point by point and plot Q̇ against T²: the slope is the effective 84·ṅ₃, to be compared with the circulation rate read on the gas-handling-system flow meter. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: ³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混合腔相界面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Mixing-chamber phase boundary” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 混合物比例錯誤或 ³He 流失時，相界面不會落在混合腔內，而是跑到靜止段或混合腔下方的管路；症狀是靜止段與循環率看起來都正常，混合腔卻停在數百 mK 的平台，無論怎麼調整都到不了基礎溫度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With a wrong mixture ratio or lost ³He the phase boundary does not sit inside the mixing chamber but ends up in the still or in the line below the chamber; the symptom is a still and a circulation rate that look normal while the mixing chamber plateaus at a few hundred millikelvin and no tuning reaches base temperature. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於溶解度不會歸零，這種「蒸發」在毫克耳文仍能持續，不像純 ³He 抽氣在 0.3 K 附近就因蒸氣壓指數下降而失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the solubility never vanishes, this evaporation keeps working at millikelvin temperatures, unlike pumping on pure ³He, which stops near 0.3 K as the vapour pressure collapses exponentially.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混合物比例錯誤或 ³He 流失時，相界面不會落在混合腔內，而是跑到靜止段或混合腔下方的管路；症狀是靜止段與循環率看起來都正常，混合腔卻停在數百 mK 的平台，無論怎麼調整都到不了基礎溫度。
knowledge.textEn: With a wrong mixture ratio or lost ³He the phase boundary does not sit inside the mixing chamber but ends up in the still or in the line below the chamber; the symptom is a still and a circulation rate that look normal while the mixing chamber plateaus at a few hundred millikelvin and no tuning reaches base temperature.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Finite ³He solubility and dilution cooling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
混合物比例錯誤或 ³He 流失時，相界面不會落在混合腔內，而是跑到靜止段或混合腔下方的管路。
靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
With a wrong mixture ratio or lost ³He the phase boundary does not sit inside the mixing chamber but ends up in the still or in the line below the chamber.
The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
quiz.explanation: 混合物比例錯誤或 ³He 流失時，相界面不會落在混合腔內，而是跑到靜止段或混合腔下方的管路；症狀是靜止段與循環率看起來都正常，混合腔卻停在數百 mK 的平台，無論怎麼調整都到不了基礎溫度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With a wrong mixture ratio or lost ³He the phase boundary does not sit inside the mixing chamber but ends up in the still or in the line below the chamber; the symptom is a still and a circulation rate that look normal while the mixing chamber plateaus at a few hundred millikelvin and no tuning reaches base temperature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「靜止段與循環迴路」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Still and circulation loop” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 稀相從混合腔向上延伸到溫度約 0.7 K 的靜止段；靜止段加熱器以數毫瓦到數十毫瓦的功率讓 ³He 優先蒸發，因為在 0.7 K 時 ⁴He 的蒸氣壓比 ³He 低兩到三個數量級，蒸氣中 ³He 佔 90% 以上。室溫的渦輪泵與壓縮機把蒸氣抽出、經冷阱除去空氣與水氣，再由冷凝線送回；乾式系統沒有 1 K 鍋，而是在 4 K 級與靜止段用焦耳–湯姆森阻抗把回流的 ³He 冷凝。循環率 ṅ₃ 由靜止段功率決定，靜止段太熱會讓 ⁴He 一起循環，白白消耗冷凝能力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靜止段與循環迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The dilute phase extends upward from the mixing chamber to the still at about 0.7 K, where a heater of a few to a few tens of milliwatts evaporates ³He preferentially: at 0.7 K the vapour pressure of ⁴He is two to three orders of magnitude below that of ³He, so the vapour is more than 90% ³He. A room-temperature turbopump and compressor extract the vapour, cold traps strip air and water, and the condensing line returns it; a dry system has no 1 K pot, so a Joule–Thomson impedance at the 4 K stage and still condenses the returning ³He. The circulation rate ṅ₃ is set by the still power, and an overheated still circulates ⁴He as well, wasting condensing capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Still and circulation loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：蒸發一莫耳 ³He 離開稀相所需的有效熱量取 L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol（教學假設，含潛熱與混合熱），則 P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff：要維持 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，需要 P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take an effective heat of L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol to evaporate one mole of ³He out of the dilute phase (teaching assumption covering latent heat and heat of mixing), so P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff: sustaining ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s needs P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「靜止段與循環迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Still and circulation loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力
knowledge.titleEn: Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power
knowledge.text: 稀相從混合腔向上延伸到溫度約 0.7 K 的靜止段；靜止段加熱器以數毫瓦到數十毫瓦的功率讓 ³He 優先蒸發，因為在 0.7 K 時 ⁴He 的蒸氣壓比 ³He 低兩到三個數量級，蒸氣中 ³He 佔 90% 以上。室溫的渦輪泵與壓縮機把蒸氣抽出、經冷阱除去空氣與水氣，再由冷凝線送回；乾式系統沒有 1 K 鍋，而是在 4 K 級與靜止段用焦耳–湯姆森阻抗把回流的 ³He 冷凝。
knowledge.textEn: The dilute phase extends upward from the mixing chamber to the still at about 0.7 K, where a heater of a few to a few tens of milliwatts evaporates ³He preferentially: at 0.7 K the vapour pressure of ⁴He is two to three orders of magnitude below that of ³He, so the vapour is more than 90% ³He. A room-temperature turbopump and compressor extract the vapour, cold traps strip air and water, and the condensing line returns it; a dry system has no 1 K pot, so a Joule–Thomson impedance at the 4 K stage and still condenses the returning ³He.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power" is correct?
options: 靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。
稀相從混合腔向上延伸到溫度約 0.7 K 的靜止段。
optionsEn: The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management.

The dilute phase extends upward from the mixing chamber to the still at about 0.7 K, where a heater of a few to a few tens of milliwatts evaporates ³He preferentially: at 0.7 K the vapour pressure of ⁴He is two to three orders of magnitude below that of ³He, so the vapour is more than 90% ³He.
quiz.explanation: 稀相從混合腔向上延伸到溫度約 0.7 K 的靜止段；靜止段加熱器以數毫瓦到數十毫瓦的功率讓 ³He 優先蒸發，因為在 0.7 K 時 ⁴He 的蒸氣壓比 ³He 低兩到三個數量級，蒸氣中 ³He 佔 90% 以上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The dilute phase extends upward from the mixing chamber to the still at about 0.7 K, where a heater of a few to a few tens of milliwatts evaporates ³He preferentially: at 0.7 K the vapour pressure of ⁴He is two to three orders of magnitude below that of ³He, so the vapour is more than 90% ³He. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「靜止段與循環迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Still and circulation loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：蒸發一莫耳 ³He 離開稀相所需的有效熱量取 L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol（教學假設，含潛熱與混合熱），則 P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff：要維持 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，需要 P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW。若靜止段壓力約 0.1 mbar = 10 Pa，室溫端所需抽速 S = ṅ₃·R·T/p = 5×10⁻⁴×8.314×293/10 ≈ 0.12 m³/s ≈ 120 L/s，所以靜止段抽氣管的分子流傳導率必須遠大於 120 L/s，否則循環率受管路限制而非受加熱器限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take an effective heat of L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol to evaporate one mole of ³He out of the dilute phase (teaching assumption covering latent heat and heat of mixing), so P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff: sustaining ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s needs P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW. If the still pressure is about 0.1 mbar = 10 Pa, the pumping speed needed at room temperature is S = ṅ₃·R·T/p = 5×10⁻⁴×8.314×293/10 ≈ 0.12 m³/s ≈ 120 L/s, so the molecular-flow conductance of the still pumping line must be well above 120 L/s or the circulation becomes line-limited rather than heater-limited. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐步改變靜止段加熱功率，同時記錄氣體處理系統的流量計與靜止段壓力，確認 ṅ₃ 與 P_still 近似線性且斜率約為 1/L_eff；再用殘氣分析儀或冷阱稱重檢查循環氣體中的 ⁴He 比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Step the still heater power while logging the gas-handling flow meter and the still pressure, confirming that ṅ₃ is roughly linear in P_still with a slope of about 1/L_eff; then check the ⁴He fraction in the circulating gas with a residual-gas analyser or by weighing a cold trap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 蒸發一莫耳 ³He 離開稀相所需的有效熱量取 L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol（教學假設，含潛熱與混合熱），則 P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff：要維持 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，需要 P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW。若靜止段壓力約 0.1 mbar = 10 Pa，室溫端所需抽速 S = ṅ₃·R·T/p = 5×10⁻⁴×8.314×293/10 ≈ 0.12 m³/s ≈ 120 L/s，所以靜止段抽氣管的分子流傳導率必須遠大於 120 L/s，否則循環率受管路限制而非受加熱器限制。
knowledge.textEn: Take an effective heat of L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol to evaporate one mole of ³He out of the dilute phase (teaching assumption covering latent heat and heat of mixing), so P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff: sustaining ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s needs P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW. If the still pressure is about 0.1 mbar = 10 Pa, the pumping speed needed at room temperature is S = ṅ₃·R·T/p = 5×10⁻⁴×8.314×293/10 ≈ 0.12 m³/s ≈ 120 L/s, so the molecular-flow conductance of the still pumping line must be well above 120 L/s or the circulation becomes line-limited rather than heater-limited.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power", which statement holds?
options: 蒸發一莫耳 ³He 離開稀相所需的有效熱量取 L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol（教學假設，含潛熱與混合熱），則 P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff：要維持 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，需要 P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW。
RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。

optionsEn: Take an effective heat of L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol to evaporate one mole of ³He out of the dilute phase (teaching assumption covering latent heat and heat of mixing), so P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff: sustaining ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s needs P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW.
A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited.

quiz.explanation: 蒸發一莫耳 ³He 離開稀相所需的有效熱量取 L_eff ≈ 40 J/mol（教學假設，含潛熱與混合熱），則 P_still ≈ ṅ₃·L_eff：要維持 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，需要 P_still ≈ 5×10⁻⁴×40 = 0.02 W = 20 mW。 重算時請保留單位。

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「靜止段與循環迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Still and circulation loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐步改變靜止段加熱功率，同時記錄氣體處理系統的流量計與靜止段壓力，確認 ṅ₃ 與 P_still 近似線性且斜率約為 1/L_eff；再用殘氣分析儀或冷阱稱重檢查循環氣體中的 ⁴He 比例。若靜止段超過 0.8 K 後 ⁴He 比例快速上升，表示靜止段過熱或超流膜爬行過多，需要降低功率或檢查膜燃燒器。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Step the still heater power while logging the gas-handling flow meter and the still pressure, confirming that ṅ₃ is roughly linear in P_still with a slope of about 1/L_eff; then check the ⁴He fraction in the circulating gas with a residual-gas analyser or by weighing a cold trap. A ⁴He fraction that climbs steeply once the still exceeds 0.8 K indicates an overheated still or excessive superfluid film creep, calling for lower power or a check of the film burner. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：混合物中殘留的空氣或水氣在冷阱或焦耳–湯姆森阻抗處結冰、阻塞回流：症狀是冷凝線壓力在數小時內持續上升而流量下降，混合腔緩慢回暖；後果是整機回溫、清理混合物並更換冷阱，損失數天實驗時間。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Air or water left in the mixture freezes in a cold trap or in the Joule–Thomson impedance and blocks the return flow: the symptom is a condensing-line pressure that keeps rising over hours while the flow drops and the mixing chamber warms slowly; the consequence is a full warm-up, cleaning of the mixture and trap replacement, costing days of experiment time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐步改變靜止段加熱功率，同時記錄氣體處理系統的流量計與靜止段壓力，確認 ṅ₃ 與 P_still 近似線性且斜率約為 1/L_eff；再用殘氣分析儀或冷阱稱重檢查循環氣體中的 ⁴He 比例。若靜止段超過 0.8 K 後 ⁴He 比例快速上升，表示靜止段過熱或超流膜爬行過多，需要降低功率或檢查膜燃燒器。
knowledge.textEn: Step the still heater power while logging the gas-handling flow meter and the still pressure, confirming that ṅ₃ is roughly linear in P_still with a slope of about 1/L_eff; then check the ⁴He fraction in the circulating gas with a residual-gas analyser or by weighing a cold trap. A ⁴He fraction that climbs steeply once the still exceeds 0.8 K indicates an overheated still or excessive superfluid film creep, calling for lower power or a check of the film burner.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Step the still heater power while logging the gas-handling flow meter and the still pressure, confirming that ṅ₃ is roughly linear in P_still with a slope of about 1/L_eff.

quiz.explanationEn: Step the still heater power while logging the gas-handling flow meter and the still pressure, confirming that ṅ₃ is roughly linear in P_still with a slope of about 1/L_eff; then check the ⁴He fraction in the circulating gas with a residual-gas analyser or by weighing a cold trap. steps.title: 靜止段蒸餾、循環率與冷卻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Still distillation, circulation rate and cooling power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「靜止段與循環迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Still and circulation loop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 混合物中殘留的空氣或水氣在冷阱或焦耳–湯姆森阻抗處結冰、阻塞回流：症狀是冷凝線壓力在數小時內持續上升而流量下降，混合腔緩慢回暖；後果是整機回溫、清理混合物並更換冷阱，損失數天實驗時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨」與「逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks" and "Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾式稀釋製冷機用兩級脈衝管冷卻器取代液氦：第一級約 45–50 K，擋住室溫輻射並錨定配線；第二級約 3–4 K，撐住 4 K 法蘭並冷凝 ³He/⁴He 混合物。再往下依序是約 0.7–0.9 K 的靜止段、約 100 mK 的冷板與約 10 mK 的混合腔，每一級有自己的輻射屏蔽，級與級之間用低熱導的不鏽鋼或玻纖支撐。脈衝管以約 1.4 Hz 運轉，會注入振動與磁性雜訊，所以用軟銅編織帶做熱連接並做機械去耦；各級可用的冷卻力要和輻射、傳導與配線熱負載逐級對帳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dry dilution refrigerator replaces liquid helium with a two-stage pulse-tube cryocooler: the first stage at about 45–50 K blocks room-temperature radiation and anchors wiring, and the second stage at about 3–4 K carries the 4 K flange and condenses the ³He/⁴He mixture. Below it sit the still at about 0.7–0.9 K, the cold plate near 100 mK and the mixing chamber near 10 mK, each with its own radiation shield and joined by low-conductivity stainless-steel or fibreglass supports. The pulse tube runs at about 1.4 Hz and injects vibration and magnetic noise, so it is thermally linked by soft copper braids and mechanically decoupled; the cooling power available at each stage must be reconciled stage by stage against radiation, conduction and wiring loads. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：4 K 屏蔽從 50 K 屏蔽接收的輻射為 P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Radiation received by the 4 K shield from the 50 K shield is P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨
knowledge.titleEn: Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks

Below it sit the still at about 0.7–0.9 K, the cold plate near 100 mK and the mixing chamber near 10 mK, each with its own radiation shield and joined by low-conductivity stainless-steel or fibreglass supports.

quiz.question: 關於「乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks" is correct?

steps.title: 乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4 K 屏蔽從 50 K 屏蔽接收的輻射為 P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴)。取 A = 0.5 m²、有效發射率 ε_eff = 0.05（拋光鍍金面，教學假設）、T_h = 50 K、T_c = 4 K：50⁴ = 6.25×10⁶，4⁴ 可忽略，P = 0.05×5.67×10⁻⁸×0.5×6.25×10⁶ ≈ 8.9 mW，相對脈衝管第二級在 4.2 K 約 1.5 W 的冷卻力可以接受。若少了 50 K 屏蔽而直接面對 300 K，300⁴ = 8.1×10⁹，P ≈ 11.5 W，第二級永遠到不了 4 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Radiation received by the 4 K shield from the 50 K shield is P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴). With A = 0.5 m², an effective emissivity ε_eff = 0.05 (polished gold-plated surfaces, teaching assumption), T_h = 50 K and T_c = 4 K: 50⁴ = 6.25×10⁶, 4⁴ is negligible, so P = 0.05×5.67×10⁻⁸×0.5×6.25×10⁶ ≈ 8.9 mW, acceptable against the roughly 1.5 W that a pulse-tube second stage delivers at 4.2 K. Without the 50 K shield, facing 300 K directly, 300⁴ = 8.1×10⁹ and P ≈ 11.5 W, so the second stage would never reach 4 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：穩態時用校正過的感測器記錄各級溫度，再對 4 K 法蘭施加已知加熱功率，量 ΔT 對功率的負載線，與製造商的脈衝管冷卻力曲線（例如 4.2 K 約 1.5 W）比較以得知餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At steady state log every stage temperature with calibrated sensors, then apply a known heater power to the 4 K flange and measure the load line of ΔT versus power, comparing it with the manufacturer's pulse-tube capacity curve (about 1.5 W at 4.2 K) to establish the margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Radiation received by the 4 K shield from the 50 K shield is P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴). With A = 0.5 m², an effective emissivity ε_eff = 0.05 (polished gold-plated surfaces, teaching assumption), T_h = 50 K and T_c = 4 K: 50⁴ = 6.25×10⁶, 4⁴ is negligible, so P = 0.05×5.67×10⁻⁸×0.5×6.25×10⁶ ≈ 8.9 mW, acceptable against the roughly 1.5 W that a pulse-tube second stage delivers at 4.2 K. Without the 50 K shield, facing 300 K directly, 300⁴ = 8.1×10⁹ and P ≈ 11.5 W, so the second stage would never reach 4 K.

Radiation received by the 4 K shield from the 50 K shield is P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴).
Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration.
quiz.explanation: 4 K 屏蔽從 50 K 屏蔽接收的輻射為 P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Radiation received by the 4 K shield from the 50 K shield is P = ε_eff·σ·A·(T_h⁴ − T_c⁴). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 穩態時用校正過的感測器記錄各級溫度，再對 4 K 法蘭施加已知加熱功率，量 ΔT 對功率的負載線，與製造商的脈衝管冷卻力曲線（例如 4.2 K 約 1.5 W）比較以得知餘裕。若無外加負載時 4 K 法蘭仍高於約 4.2 K，就要找輻射漏洞：屏蔽縫隙、缺少多層絕熱或某處機械接觸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At steady state log every stage temperature with calibrated sensors, then apply a known heater power to the 4 K flange and measure the load line of ΔT versus power, comparing it with the manufacturer's pulse-tube capacity curve (about 1.5 W at 4.2 K) to establish the margin. If the 4 K flange sits above roughly 4.2 K with no added load, hunt for a radiation leak: a shield gap, missing multilayer insulation or a mechanical touch somewhere. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：50 K 屏蔽與 4 K 屏蔽之間若有鬆脫的多層絕熱毯或下垂的電纜造成熱短路，會多出數瓦的熱負載：降溫紀錄裡兩級溫度逐漸靠攏，4 K 法蘭停在 6–8 K，混合物無法在焦耳–湯姆森阻抗處冷凝，系統永遠到不了基礎溫度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A loose multilayer-insulation blanket or a sagging cable that thermally shorts the 50 K and 4 K shields adds watts of load: in the cooldown log the two stage temperatures converge, the 4 K flange stalls at 6–8 K, the mixture cannot condense at the Joule–Thomson impedance and the system never reaches base.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 乾式預冷鏈與各級熱錨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cryogen-free precooling chain and stage heat sinks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脈衝管冷卻器與 4 K 法蘭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pulse-tube cooler and 4 K flange” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 50 K 屏蔽與 4 K 屏蔽之間若有鬆脫的多層絕熱毯或下垂的電纜造成熱短路，會多出數瓦的熱負載：降溫紀錄裡兩級溫度逐漸靠攏，4 K 法蘭停在 6–8 K，混合物無法在焦耳–湯姆森阻抗處冷凝，系統永遠到不了基礎溫度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A loose multilayer-insulation blanket or a sagging cable that thermally shorts the 50 K and 4 K shields adds watts of load: in the cooldown log the two stage temperatures converge, the 4 K flange stalls at 6–8 K, the mixture cannot condense at the Joule–Thomson impedance and the system never reaches base. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：脈衝管以約 1.4 Hz 運轉，會注入振動與磁性雜訊，所以用軟銅編織帶做熱連接並做機械去耦；各級可用的冷卻力要和輻射、傳導與配線熱負載逐級對帳。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The pulse tube runs at about 1.4 Hz and injects vibration and magnetic noise, so it is thermally linked by soft copper braids and mechanically decoupled; the cooling power available at each stage must be reconciled stage by stage against radiation, conduction and wiring loads.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「燒結銀熱交換器」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sintered-silver heat exchangers” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回流的濃相 ³He 在進入混合腔之前，必須被流出的冷稀相預冷，否則它帶進來的焓 11·T_in² 會吃掉冷卻力。50 mK 以上用套管式連續逆流熱交換器就夠；更低溫時液氦與金屬之間的卡皮查（聲學失配）熱邊界阻隨 T⁻³ 急升，所以改用階梯式熱交換器，在銅鎳本體內燒結銀粉，比表面積每克約 1–2 m²，提供數十平方公尺的接觸面。設計同時受流阻限制：³He 黏度在低溫上升，黏滯加熱正比於 ṅ₃² 且隨溫度降低而惡化，流道截面、燒結厚度與級數必須折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「燒結銀熱交換器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Returning concentrated ³He must be precooled by the outgoing cold dilute stream before it reaches the mixing chamber, otherwise the enthalpy it carries in, 11·T_in², consumes the cooling power. Above about 50 mK a continuous tube-in-tube counterflow exchanger suffices; lower down the Kapitza (acoustic-mismatch) thermal boundary resistance between helium and metal rises as T⁻³, so step exchangers are used, with silver powder sintered inside copper–nickel bodies at roughly 1–2 m² per gram to provide tens of square metres of contact area. The design is also bounded by flow impedance: ³He viscosity rises at low temperature and viscous heating scales as ṅ₃² and worsens as temperature falls, so channel cross-section, sinter thickness and the number of steps must be traded off. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sintered-silver heat exchangers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取卡皮查熱阻 R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W（教學假設）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a Kapitza resistance R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W (teaching assumption).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱交換面積越大一定越好，與流阻無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More exchanger area is always better, regardless of flow impedance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「燒結銀熱交換器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sintered-silver heat exchangers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance" is correct?

回流的濃相 ³He 在進入混合腔之前，必須被流出的冷稀相預冷，否則它帶進來的焓 11·T_in² 會吃掉冷卻力。

steps.title: 逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「燒結銀熱交換器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sintered-silver heat exchangers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取卡皮查熱阻 R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W（教學假設）。在 T = 20 mK：R_K·A = 0.05/(0.02)³ = 6250 K·m²/W。若要在 ΔT = 5 mK 的溫差下傳遞 Q̇ = 20 µW，需要面積 A = Q̇·(R_K·A)/ΔT = 2×10⁻⁵×6250/0.005 = 25 m²；以每克 1.5 m² 的燒結銀估算約需 17 g。同樣的傳熱在 100 mK 只需 1/125 的面積，因為 (100/20)³ = 125。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a Kapitza resistance R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W (teaching assumption). At T = 20 mK, R_K·A = 0.05/(0.02)³ = 6250 K·m²/W. To transfer Q̇ = 20 µW across ΔT = 5 mK the required area is A = Q̇·(R_K·A)/ΔT = 2×10⁻⁵×6250/0.005 = 25 m², about 17 g of sintered silver at 1.5 m² per gram. The same transfer at 100 mK needs only 1/125 of that area because (100/20)³ = 125. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測得的冷卻力反推回流入口溫度：Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)，所以 T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Back out the return inlet temperature from the measured cooling power: Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²), hence T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11].
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance", which statement holds?
options: 混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。
低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。
取卡皮查熱阻 R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W（教學假設）。
optionsEn: Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional.
Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot.
Take a Kapitza resistance R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W (teaching assumption).
quiz.explanation: 取卡皮查熱阻 R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W（教學假設）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a Kapitza resistance R_K·A ≈ 0.05/T³ K·m²/W (teaching assumption). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「燒結銀熱交換器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sintered-silver heat exchangers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用測得的冷卻力反推回流入口溫度：Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)，所以 T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]。例如 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s、T_mc = 20 mK 時理想值為 16.8 µW；若實測只有 10 µW，則 T_in = √[(0.038 − 0.02)/11] ≈ 40 mK，表示熱交換器讓回流 ³He 比混合腔熱了一倍，要檢查燒結銀是否脫落或流道是否部分阻塞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Back out the return inlet temperature from the measured cooling power: Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²), hence T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]. For ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s at T_mc = 20 mK the ideal value is 16.8 µW; if only 10 µW is measured, T_in = √[(0.038 − 0.02)/11] ≈ 40 mK, meaning the exchangers deliver ³He twice as warm as the mixing chamber, so check for detached sinter or a partly blocked channel. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：燒結層堵塞或流道太窄使流阻過高，³He 在管內的黏滯加熱隨 ṅ₃² 增加：症狀是提高循環率時冷卻力不升反降、冷卻力曲線在高流量端彎折，最佳循環率往低處移，基礎溫度比規格差一截。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A clogged sinter or an undersized channel makes the flow impedance too high and viscous heating of the ³He grows as ṅ₃²: the symptom is cooling power that falls instead of rising when the circulation rate is increased, a cooling-power curve that bends over at high flow, an optimum circulation rate shifted lower and a base temperature short of specification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用測得的冷卻力反推回流入口溫度：Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)，所以 T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]。例如 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s、T_mc = 20 mK 時理想值為 16.8 µW；若實測只有 10 µW，則 T_in = √[(0.038 − 0.02)/11] ≈ 40 mK，表示熱交換器讓回流 ³He 比混合腔熱了一倍，要檢查燒結銀是否脫落或流道是否部分阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Back out the return inlet temperature from the measured cooling power: Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²), hence T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]. For ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s at T_mc = 20 mK the ideal value is 16.8 µW; if only 10 µW is measured, T_in = √[(0.038 − 0.02)/11] ≈ 40 mK, meaning the exchangers deliver ³He twice as warm as the mixing chamber, so check for detached sinter or a partly blocked channel.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance"?
options: 用測得的冷卻力反推回流入口溫度：Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)，所以 T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
optionsEn: Back out the return inlet temperature from the measured cooling power: Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²), hence T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11].
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
quiz.explanation: 用測得的冷卻力反推回流入口溫度：Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²)，所以 T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Back out the return inlet temperature from the measured cooling power: Q̇ = ṅ₃·(95·T_mc² − 11·T_in²), hence T_in = √[(95·T_mc² − Q̇/ṅ₃)/11]. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「燒結銀熱交換器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sintered-silver heat exchangers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 燒結層堵塞或流道太窄使流阻過高，³He 在管內的黏滯加熱隨 ṅ₃² 增加：症狀是提高循環率時冷卻力不升反降、冷卻力曲線在高流量端彎折，最佳循環率往低處移，基礎溫度比規格差一截。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A clogged sinter or an undersized channel makes the flow impedance too high and viscous heating of the ³He grows as ṅ₃²: the symptom is cooling power that falls instead of rising when the circulation rate is increased, a cooling-power curve that bends over at high flow, an optimum circulation rate shifted lower and a base temperature short of specification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計同時受流阻限制：³He 黏度在低溫上升，黏滯加熱正比於 ṅ₃² 且隨溫度降低而惡化，流道截面、燒結厚度與級數必須折衷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design is also bounded by flow impedance: ³He viscosity rises at low temperature and viscous heating scales as ṅ₃² and worsens as temperature falls, so channel cross-section, sinter thickness and the number of steps must be traded off.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱交換面積越大一定越好，與流阻無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More exchanger area is always better, regardless of flow impedance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「逆流熱交換器與卡皮查熱阻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Counterflow heat exchangers and Kapitza resistance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
燒結層堵塞或流道太窄使流阻過高，³He 在管內的黏滯加熱隨 ṅ₃² 增加：症狀是提高循環率時冷卻力不升反降、冷卻力曲線在高流量端彎折，最佳循環率往低處移，基礎溫度比規格差一截。
RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A clogged sinter or an undersized channel makes the flow impedance too high and viscous heating of the ³He grows as ṅ₃²: the symptom is cooling power that falls instead of rising when the circulation rate is increased, a cooling-power curve that bends over at high flow, an optimum circulation rate shifted lower and a base temperature short of specification.
A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited.
quiz.explanation: 燒結層堵塞或流道太窄使流阻過高，³He 在管內的黏滯加熱隨 ṅ₃² 增加：症狀是提高循環率時冷卻力不升反降、冷卻力曲線在高流量端彎折，最佳循環率往低處移，基礎溫度比規格差一截。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A clogged sinter or an undersized channel makes the flow impedance too high and viscous heating of the ³He grows as ṅ₃²: the symptom is cooling power that falls instead of rising when the circulation rate is increased, a cooling-power curve that bends over at high flow, an optimum circulation rate shifted lower and a base temperature short of specification. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」與「配線、同軸線與熱負載預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain" and "Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混合腔與樣品溫度通常用氧化釕厚膜或 Cernox 電阻溫度計讀取，由低激發的交流電阻電橋量測；激發功率 V²/R 必須遠小於感測器與法蘭之間熱連結能帶走的熱，否則感測器自熱。20 mK 以下，電子與聲子脫耦、引線熱漏與射頻拾取都會讓電阻溫度計讀高。絕對參考來自初級溫度計：微分電導谷寬正比於 T 的庫侖阻塞溫度計、以 SQUID 讀出的雜訊溫度計，或超導定點裝置；ITS-90 只到 0.65 K，0.9 mK 到 1 K 由 PLTS-2000 以 ³He 熔化壓力定義，校正鏈就是從這些初級標準逐級傳遞到樣品溫度計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing-chamber and sample temperatures are usually read with ruthenium-oxide thick-film or Cernox resistance thermometers on a low-excitation AC resistance bridge; the excitation power V²/R must stay far below what the thermal link between sensor and flange can carry, otherwise the sensor self-heats. Below 20 mK electron–phonon decoupling, lead heat leaks and radio-frequency pickup all make resistance thermometers read high. Absolute references come from primary thermometers: the Coulomb-blockade thermometer whose differential-conductance dip width is proportional to T, SQUID-read noise thermometers, or superconducting fixed-point devices. ITS-90 ends at 0.65 K and PLTS-2000 defines 0.9 mK to 1 K through the ³He melting pressure, and the calibration chain passes from these primary standards step by step down to the sample thermometer. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：自熱估算：RuO₂ 感測器在 20 mK 時 R = 10 kΩ，激發 V = 10 µV（有效值），P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W；若感測器到法蘭的熱阻 R_th = 10⁸ K/W（教學假設），ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK，可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Self-heating estimate: a RuO₂ sensor with R = 10 kΩ at 20 mK excited at V = 10 µV rms dissipates P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W; with a sensor-to-flange thermal resistance R_th = 10⁸ K/W (teaching assumption) ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK, negligible.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain
knowledge.text: 混合腔與樣品溫度通常用氧化釕厚膜或 Cernox 電阻溫度計讀取，由低激發的交流電阻電橋量測；激發功率 V²/R 必須遠小於感測器與法蘭之間熱連結能帶走的熱，否則感測器自熱。20 mK 以下，電子與聲子脫耦、引線熱漏與射頻拾取都會讓電阻溫度計讀高。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing-chamber and sample temperatures are usually read with ruthenium-oxide thick-film or Cernox resistance thermometers on a low-excitation AC resistance bridge; the excitation power V²/R must stay far below what the thermal link between sensor and flange can carry, otherwise the sensor self-heats. Below 20 mK electron–phonon decoupling, lead heat leaks and radio-frequency pickup all make resistance thermometers read high.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain" is correct?
options: RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。
只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。
混合腔與樣品溫度通常用氧化釕厚膜或 Cernox 電阻溫度計讀取，由低激發的交流電阻電橋量測。
optionsEn: A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited.
Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature.
Mixing-chamber and sample temperatures are usually read with ruthenium-oxide thick-film or Cernox resistance thermometers on a low-excitation AC resistance bridge.

quiz.explanationEn: Mixing-chamber and sample temperatures are usually read with ruthenium-oxide thick-film or Cernox resistance thermometers on a low-excitation AC resistance bridge; the excitation power V²/R must stay far below what the thermal link between sensor and flange can carry, otherwise the sensor self-heats. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自熱估算：RuO₂ 感測器在 20 mK 時 R = 10 kΩ，激發 V = 10 µV（有效值），P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W；若感測器到法蘭的熱阻 R_th = 10⁸ K/W（教學假設），ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK，可忽略。若激發改為 1 mV，P = 10⁻¹⁰ W，ΔT = 10 mK，讀值變成 30 mK 而非 20 mK，誤差 50%。庫侖阻塞溫度計的半深寬度 ΔV ≈ 5.44·N·k_B·T/e：N = 32 個串聯接面在 20 mK 時 ΔV ≈ 5.44×32×1.38×10⁻²³×0.02/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 300 µV，容易量測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Self-heating estimate: a RuO₂ sensor with R = 10 kΩ at 20 mK excited at V = 10 µV rms dissipates P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W; with a sensor-to-flange thermal resistance R_th = 10⁸ K/W (teaching assumption) ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK, negligible. At 1 mV excitation P = 10⁻¹⁰ W and ΔT = 10 mK, so the sensor reads 30 mK instead of 20 mK, a 50% error. For a Coulomb-blockade thermometer the full width at half depth is ΔV ≈ 5.44·N·k_B·T/e: with N = 32 junctions in series at 20 mK, ΔV ≈ 5.44×32×1.38×10⁻²³×0.02/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 300 µV, an easily measured width. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把待校的 RuO₂ 與初級溫度計（庫侖阻塞或雜訊溫度計）裝在同一個混合腔法蘭上，在 10 mK 到 100 mK 之間取四到五個設定點比較；每一點把激發電壓改變三倍，讀值不應改變，否則就是自熱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount the RuO₂ under test and a primary thermometer (Coulomb-blockade or noise) on the same mixing-chamber flange and compare at four or five setpoints between 10 mK and 100 mK; at each point change the excitation by a factor of three and confirm the reading does not move, otherwise self-heating is present.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 自熱估算：RuO₂ 感測器在 20 mK 時 R = 10 kΩ，激發 V = 10 µV（有效值），P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W；若感測器到法蘭的熱阻 R_th = 10⁸ K/W（教學假設），ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK，可忽略。若激發改為 1 mV，P = 10⁻¹⁰ W，ΔT = 10 mK，讀值變成 30 mK 而非 20 mK，誤差 50%。庫侖阻塞溫度計的半深寬度 ΔV ≈ 5.44·N·k_B·T/e：N = 32 個串聯接面在 20 mK 時 ΔV ≈ 5.44×32×1.38×10⁻²³×0.02/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 300 µV，容易量測。
knowledge.textEn: Self-heating estimate: a RuO₂ sensor with R = 10 kΩ at 20 mK excited at V = 10 µV rms dissipates P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W; with a sensor-to-flange thermal resistance R_th = 10⁸ K/W (teaching assumption) ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK, negligible. At 1 mV excitation P = 10⁻¹⁰ W and ΔT = 10 mK, so the sensor reads 30 mK instead of 20 mK, a 50% error. For a Coulomb-blockade thermometer the full width at half depth is ΔV ≈ 5.44·N·k_B·T/e: with N = 32 junctions in series at 20 mK, ΔV ≈ 5.44×32×1.38×10⁻²³×0.02/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 300 µV, an easily measured width.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain", which statement holds?
options: 自熱估算：RuO₂ 感測器在 20 mK 時 R = 10 kΩ，激發 V = 10 µV（有效值），P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W。
驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。
靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
optionsEn: Self-heating estimate: a RuO₂ sensor with R = 10 kΩ at 20 mK excited at V = 10 µV rms dissipates P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W.
Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration.
The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
quiz.explanation: 自熱估算：RuO₂ 感測器在 20 mK 時 R = 10 kΩ，激發 V = 10 µV（有效值），P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W；若感測器到法蘭的熱阻 R_th = 10⁸ K/W（教學假設），ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK，可忽略。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Self-heating estimate: a RuO₂ sensor with R = 10 kΩ at 20 mK excited at V = 10 µV rms dissipates P = V²/R = (10⁻⁵)²/10⁴ = 10⁻¹⁴ W; with a sensor-to-flange thermal resistance R_th = 10⁸ K/W (teaching assumption) ΔT = P·R_th = 10⁻⁶ K = 1 µK, negligible. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把待校的 RuO₂ 與初級溫度計（庫侖阻塞或雜訊溫度計）裝在同一個混合腔法蘭上，在 10 mK 到 100 mK 之間取四到五個設定點比較；每一點把激發電壓改變三倍，讀值不應改變，否則就是自熱。把各點偏差記入校正不確定度預算，並留意 RuO₂ 曲線在 15 mK 以下「變平」，那是感測器與法蘭脫耦的徵兆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount the RuO₂ under test and a primary thermometer (Coulomb-blockade or noise) on the same mixing-chamber flange and compare at four or five setpoints between 10 mK and 100 mK; at each point change the excitation by a factor of three and confirm the reading does not move, otherwise self-heating is present. Enter the deviations into the calibration-uncertainty budget and watch for the RuO₂ curve flattening below 15 mK, the signature of the sensor decoupling from the flange. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：激發過大或引線沒有在每一級熱錨，溫度計自熱而讀到 30 mK，混合腔實際只有 12 mK；操作者依照假的最低點去調靜止段功率，實驗在比紀錄更暖的溫度下進行，量子位元的熱布居或熱學數據被錯誤詮釋。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Excessive excitation or leads that are not heat-sunk at every stage make the thermometer self-heat and read 30 mK while the mixing chamber is really at 12 mK; the operator tunes the still power to a false minimum, experiments run warmer than logged, and qubit thermal populations or thermal data are misinterpreted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把待校的 RuO₂ 與初級溫度計（庫侖阻塞或雜訊溫度計）裝在同一個混合腔法蘭上，在 10 mK 到 100 mK 之間取四到五個設定點比較；每一點把激發電壓改變三倍，讀值不應改變，否則就是自熱。把各點偏差記入校正不確定度預算，並留意 RuO₂ 曲線在 15 mK 以下「變平」，那是感測器與法蘭脫耦的徵兆。
knowledge.textEn: Mount the RuO₂ under test and a primary thermometer (Coulomb-blockade or noise) on the same mixing-chamber flange and compare at four or five setpoints between 10 mK and 100 mK; at each point change the excitation by a factor of three and confirm the reading does not move, otherwise self-heating is present. Enter the deviations into the calibration-uncertainty budget and watch for the RuO₂ curve flattening below 15 mK, the signature of the sensor decoupling from the flange.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
把待校的 RuO₂ 與初級溫度計（庫侖阻塞或雜訊溫度計）裝在同一個混合腔法蘭上，在 10 mK 到 100 mK 之間取四到五個設定點比較。
脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Mount the RuO₂ under test and a primary thermometer (Coulomb-blockade or noise) on the same mixing-chamber flange and compare at four or five setpoints between 10 mK and 100 mK.
With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management.
quiz.explanation: 把待校的 RuO₂ 與初級溫度計（庫侖阻塞或雜訊溫度計）裝在同一個混合腔法蘭上，在 10 mK 到 100 mK 之間取四到五個設定點比較；每一點把激發電壓改變三倍，讀值不應改變，否則就是自熱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount the RuO₂ under test and a primary thermometer (Coulomb-blockade or noise) on the same mixing-chamber flange and compare at four or five setpoints between 10 mK and 100 mK; at each point change the excitation by a factor of three and confirm the reading does not move, otherwise self-heating is present. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「RuO₂ 與庫侖阻塞溫度計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “RuO₂ and Coulomb-blockade thermometers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 激發過大或引線沒有在每一級熱錨，溫度計自熱而讀到 30 mK，混合腔實際只有 12 mK；操作者依照假的最低點去調靜止段功率，實驗在比紀錄更暖的溫度下進行，量子位元的熱布居或熱學數據被錯誤詮釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Excessive excitation or leads that are not heat-sunk at every stage make the thermometer self-heat and read 30 mK while the mixing chamber is really at 12 mK; the operator tunes the still power to a false minimum, experiments run warmer than logged, and qubit thermal populations or thermal data are misinterpreted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：絕對參考來自初級溫度計：微分電導谷寬正比於 T 的庫侖阻塞溫度計、以 SQUID 讀出的雜訊溫度計，或超導定點裝置；ITS-90 只到 0.65 K，0.9 mK 到 1 K 由 PLTS-2000 以 ³He 熔化壓力定義，校正鏈就是從這些初級標準逐級傳遞到樣品溫度計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ITS-90 ends at 0.65 K and PLTS-2000 defines 0.9 mK to 1 K through the ³He melting pressure, and the calibration chain passes from these primary standards step by step down to the sample thermometer.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 激發過大或引線沒有在每一級熱錨，溫度計自熱而讀到 30 mK，混合腔實際只有 12 mK；操作者依照假的最低點去調靜止段功率，實驗在比紀錄更暖的溫度下進行，量子位元的熱布居或熱學數據被錯誤詮釋。
knowledge.textEn: Excessive excitation or leads that are not heat-sunk at every stage make the thermometer self-heat and read 30 mK while the mixing chamber is really at 12 mK; the operator tunes the still power to a false minimum, experiments run warmer than logged, and qubit thermal populations or thermal data are misinterpreted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Millikelvin thermometry and the calibration chain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。
激發過大或引線沒有在每一級熱錨，溫度計自熱而讀到 30 mK，混合腔實際只有 12 mK。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature.
Excessive excitation or leads that are not heat-sunk at every stage make the thermometer self-heat and read 30 mK while the mixing chamber is really at 12 mK.
quiz.explanation: 激發過大或引線沒有在每一級熱錨，溫度計自熱而讀到 30 mK，混合腔實際只有 12 mK；操作者依照假的最低點去調靜止段功率，實驗在比紀錄更暖的溫度下進行，量子位元的熱布居或熱學數據被錯誤詮釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excessive excitation or leads that are not heat-sunk at every stage make the thermometer self-heat and read 30 mK while the mixing chamber is really at 12 mK; the operator tunes the still power to a false minimum, experiments run warmer than logged, and qubit thermal populations or thermal data are misinterpreted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 配線、同軸線與熱負載預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱負載預算表」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heat-load budget table” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一條訊號線都是從高溫級流向混合腔的熱通道：直流線束與微波同軸線的傳導熱為 Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT，所以外導體與內導體採用不鏽鋼或銅鎳而非純銅；微波輸入線在各級裝衰減器（例如 4 K 處 20 dB、冷板 20 dB、混合腔 20 dB），既把室溫熱雜訊逐級壓低，也把內導體熱錨到該級。其他負載包括脈衝管振動引起的摩擦與渦電流加熱、真空罐內殘餘氣體的傳熱、屏蔽孔洞漏進的輻射與量測本身的耗散；混合腔在 20 mK 約十幾微瓦的冷卻力必須大於所有負載的總和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱負載預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every signal line is a heat path from a warmer stage to the mixing chamber: DC looms and microwave coaxial lines conduct Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT, which is why outer and inner conductors are stainless steel or copper–nickel rather than pure copper. Microwave input lines carry attenuators at successive stages (for example 20 dB at 4 K, 20 dB at the cold plate and 20 dB at the mixing chamber), which both suppress room-temperature thermal noise stage by stage and heat-sink the inner conductor at each stage. Other loads include friction and eddy-current heating driven by pulse-tube vibration, heat carried by residual gas in the vacuum can, radiation leaking through shield openings and the dissipation of the measurement itself; the ten-odd microwatts available at 20 mK must exceed the sum of all of them. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Heat-load budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一條不鏽鋼同軸線（外導體外徑 2.2 mm、壁厚 0.3 mm，內導體直徑 0.5 mm）的金屬截面約 A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²；不鏽鋼在 1 K 以下取 k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K)（教學假設）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A stainless coaxial line (outer conductor 2.2 mm diameter with 0.3 mm wall, inner conductor 0.5 mm) has a metal cross-section of about A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²; take stainless steel below 1 K as k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K) (teaching assumption).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱負載預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Heat-load budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 配線、同軸線與熱負載預算
knowledge.titleEn: Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget
knowledge.text: 每一條訊號線都是從高溫級流向混合腔的熱通道：直流線束與微波同軸線的傳導熱為 Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT，所以外導體與內導體採用不鏽鋼或銅鎳而非純銅；微波輸入線在各級裝衰減器（例如 4 K 處 20 dB、冷板 20 dB、混合腔 20 dB），既把室溫熱雜訊逐級壓低，也把內導體熱錨到該級。其他負載包括脈衝管振動引起的摩擦與渦電流加熱、真空罐內殘餘氣體的傳熱、屏蔽孔洞漏進的輻射與量測本身的耗散；混合腔在 20 mK 約十幾微瓦的冷卻力必須大於所有負載的總和。
