Microwave input lines carry attenuators at successive stages (for example 20 dB at 4 K, 20 dB at the cold plate and 20 dB at the mixing chamber), which both suppress room-temperature thermal noise stage by stage and heat-sink the inner conductor at each stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「配線、同軸線與熱負載預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget" is correct?
options: 每一條訊號線都是從高溫級流向混合腔的熱通道：直流線束與微波同軸線的傳導熱為 Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT，所以外導體與內導體採用不鏽鋼或銅鎳而非純銅。
只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。
混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。
optionsEn: Every signal line is a heat path from a warmer stage to the mixing chamber: DC looms and microwave coaxial lines conduct Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT, which is why outer and inner conductors are stainless steel or copper–nickel rather than pure copper.
Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature.
Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional.
quiz.explanation: 每一條訊號線都是從高溫級流向混合腔的熱通道：直流線束與微波同軸線的傳導熱為 Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT，所以外導體與內導體採用不鏽鋼或銅鎳而非純銅；微波輸入線在各級裝衰減器（例如 4 K 處 20 dB、冷板 20 dB、混合腔 20 dB），既把室溫熱雜訊逐級壓低，也把內導體熱錨到該級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every signal line is a heat path from a warmer stage to the mixing chamber: DC looms and microwave coaxial lines conduct Q̇ = (A/L)·∫k dT, which is why outer and inner conductors are stainless steel or copper–nickel rather than pure copper. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 配線、同軸線與熱負載預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱負載預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heat-load budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一條不鏽鋼同軸線（外導體外徑 2.2 mm、壁厚 0.3 mm，內導體直徑 0.5 mm）的金屬截面約 A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²；不鏽鋼在 1 K 以下取 k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K)（教學假設）。從 100 mK 冷板到 20 mK 混合腔、長度 L = 0.3 m：∫k dT = 0.075×(0.1² − 0.02²)/2 = 3.6×10⁻⁴ W/m，Q̇ = (2×10⁻⁶/0.3)×3.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 2.4 nW；50 條只有 0.12 µW，不到 20 mK 冷卻力 16.8 µW 的 1%。同樣的線從 4 K 到 0.8 K 的靜止段，∫k dT = 0.075×(16 − 0.64)/2 = 0.576 W/m，每條 3.8 µW，50 條 0.19 mW，由靜止段毫瓦級的冷卻力吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A stainless coaxial line (outer conductor 2.2 mm diameter with 0.3 mm wall, inner conductor 0.5 mm) has a metal cross-section of about A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²; take stainless steel below 1 K as k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K) (teaching assumption). From the 100 mK cold plate to the 20 mK mixing chamber over L = 0.3 m: ∫k dT = 0.075×(0.1² − 0.02²)/2 = 3.6×10⁻⁴ W/m and Q̇ = (2×10⁻⁶/0.3)×3.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 2.4 nW; 50 lines give only 0.12 µW, under 1% of the 16.8 µW available at 20 mK. The same line from 4 K to the 0.8 K still has ∫k dT = 0.075×(16 − 0.64)/2 = 0.576 W/m, 3.8 µW per line and 0.19 mW for 50 lines, absorbed by the still's milliwatt-level cooling power. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先按級別建立預算表：傳導、輻射、射頻耗散、振動與量測各列一行；再用「加熱器替代法」驗證：量得基礎溫度後對混合腔施加已知功率，擬合 Q̇(T) 曲線並外推到測得的基礎溫度，截距就是寄生負載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First build the budget table stage by stage with a row each for conduction, radiation, RF dissipation, vibration and measurement; then verify it by heater substitution: after measuring the base temperature, apply known powers to the mixing chamber, fit the Q̇(T) curve and extrapolate to the measured base, where the intercept is the parasitic load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「配線、同軸線與熱負載預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget", which statement holds?
options: 低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。
一條不鏽鋼同軸線（外導體外徑 2.2 mm、壁厚 0.3 mm，內導體直徑 0.5 mm）的金屬截面約 A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²。
脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。
optionsEn: Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot.
A stainless coaxial line (outer conductor 2.2 mm diameter with 0.3 mm wall, inner conductor 0.5 mm) has a metal cross-section of about A = 2×10⁻⁶ m².
With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management.
quiz.explanation: 一條不鏽鋼同軸線（外導體外徑 2.2 mm、壁厚 0.3 mm，內導體直徑 0.5 mm）的金屬截面約 A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²；不鏽鋼在 1 K 以下取 k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K)（教學假設）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A stainless coaxial line (outer conductor 2.2 mm diameter with 0.3 mm wall, inner conductor 0.5 mm) has a metal cross-section of about A = 2×10⁻⁶ m²; take stainless steel below 1 K as k ≈ 0.075·T W/(m·K) (teaching assumption). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 配線、同軸線與熱負載預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱負載預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Heat-load budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先按級別建立預算表：傳導、輻射、射頻耗散、振動與量測各列一行；再用「加熱器替代法」驗證：量得基礎溫度後對混合腔施加已知功率，擬合 Q̇(T) 曲線並外推到測得的基礎溫度，截距就是寄生負載。例如外推得到 2 µW 的寄生負載，就能解釋為何基礎溫度是 14 mK 而非規格的 10 mK，再回頭對照預算表找出超支的項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First build the budget table stage by stage with a row each for conduction, radiation, RF dissipation, vibration and measurement; then verify it by heater substitution: after measuring the base temperature, apply known powers to the mixing chamber, fit the Q̇(T) curve and extrapolate to the measured base, where the intercept is the parasitic load. An extrapolated parasitic load of 2 µW, for instance, explains a 14 mK base instead of the specified 10 mK, and the budget table then points to the item that overran. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一條同軸線的內導體沒有衰減器或只裝了未熱錨的直流阻斷器，4 K 的黑體光子與傳導熱直接抵達樣品：混合腔溫度計一切正常，但量子位元的有效溫度卻是 60–80 mK，出現任何製冷機調整都消不掉的熱布居。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A coaxial inner conductor with no attenuator, or only an unanchored DC block, lets 4 K black-body photons and conducted heat reach the sample directly: the mixing-chamber thermometer looks normal while the qubit's effective temperature is 60–80 mK, with an excess thermal population that no refrigerator adjustment removes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先按級別建立預算表：傳導、輻射、射頻耗散、振動與量測各列一行；再用「加熱器替代法」驗證：量得基礎溫度後對混合腔施加已知功率，擬合 Q̇(T) 曲線並外推到測得的基礎溫度，截距就是寄生負載。例如外推得到 2 µW 的寄生負載，就能解釋為何基礎溫度是 14 mK 而非規格的 10 mK，再回頭對照預算表找出超支的項目。
knowledge.textEn: First build the budget table stage by stage with a row each for conduction, radiation, RF dissipation, vibration and measurement; then verify it by heater substitution: after measuring the base temperature, apply known powers to the mixing chamber, fit the Q̇(T) curve and extrapolate to the measured base, where the intercept is the parasitic load. An extrapolated parasitic load of 2 µW, for instance, explains a 14 mK base instead of the specified 10 mK, and the budget table then points to the item that overran.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「配線、同軸線與熱負載預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
熱交換面積越大一定越好，與流阻無關。
先按級別建立預算表：傳導、輻射、射頻耗散、振動與量測各列一行。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
More exchanger area is always better, regardless of flow impedance.
First build the budget table stage by stage with a row each for conduction, radiation, RF dissipation, vibration and measurement.
quiz.explanation: 先按級別建立預算表：傳導、輻射、射頻耗散、振動與量測各列一行；再用「加熱器替代法」驗證：量得基礎溫度後對混合腔施加已知功率，擬合 Q̇(T) 曲線並外推到測得的基礎溫度，截距就是寄生負載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: First build the budget table stage by stage with a row each for conduction, radiation, RF dissipation, vibration and measurement; then verify it by heater substitution: after measuring the base temperature, apply known powers to the mixing chamber, fit the Q̇(T) curve and extrapolate to the measured base, where the intercept is the parasitic load. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 配線、同軸線與熱負載預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱負載預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Heat-load budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一條同軸線的內導體沒有衰減器或只裝了未熱錨的直流阻斷器，4 K 的黑體光子與傳導熱直接抵達樣品：混合腔溫度計一切正常，但量子位元的有效溫度卻是 60–80 mK，出現任何製冷機調整都消不掉的熱布居。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A coaxial inner conductor with no attenuator, or only an unanchored DC block, lets 4 K black-body photons and conducted heat reach the sample directly: the mixing-chamber thermometer looks normal while the qubit's effective temperature is 60–80 mK, with an excess thermal population that no refrigerator adjustment removes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：其他負載包括脈衝管振動引起的摩擦與渦電流加熱、真空罐內殘餘氣體的傳熱、屏蔽孔洞漏進的輻射與量測本身的耗散；混合腔在 20 mK 約十幾微瓦的冷卻力必須大於所有負載的總和。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Other loads include friction and eddy-current heating driven by pulse-tube vibration, heat carried by residual gas in the vacuum can, radiation leaking through shield openings and the dissipation of the measurement itself; the ten-odd microwatts available at 20 mK must exceed the sum of all of them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一條同軸線的內導體沒有衰減器或只裝了未熱錨的直流阻斷器，4 K 的黑體光子與傳導熱直接抵達樣品：混合腔溫度計一切正常，但量子位元的有效溫度卻是 60–80 mK，出現任何製冷機調整都消不掉的熱布居。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「配線、同軸線與熱負載預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wiring, coaxial lines and the heat-load budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一條同軸線的內導體沒有衰減器或只裝了未熱錨的直流阻斷器，4 K 的黑體光子與傳導熱直接抵達樣品：混合腔溫度計一切正常，但量子位元的有效溫度卻是 60–80 mK，出現任何製冷機調整都消不掉的熱布居。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。
optionsEn: A coaxial inner conductor with no attenuator, or only an unanchored DC block, lets 4 K black-body photons and conducted heat reach the sample directly: the mixing-chamber thermometer looks normal while the qubit's effective temperature is 60–80 mK, with an excess thermal population that no refrigerator adjustment removes.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional.

quiz.explanationEn: A coaxial inner conductor with no attenuator, or only an unanchored DC block, lets 4 K black-body photons and conducted heat reach the sample directly: the mixing-chamber thermometer looks normal while the qubit's effective temperature is 60–80 mK, with an excess thermal population that no refrigerator adjustment removes. stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉」與「基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation" and "Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gas-handling system and condensing line” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾式系統的降溫是一套固定程序：先把真空罐抽到高真空並啟動脈衝管；內部各級從 300 K 預冷到約 4 K 時不用交換氣，而是讓混合氣體經預冷迴路循環、在各級之間搬運熱量，接近 4 K 時再把迴路切斷。接著壓縮機把混合物經冷凝線壓入，氣體在 4 K 級被冷卻、經焦耳–湯姆森阻抗膨脹而液化，依序填滿靜止段與混合腔；氣體處理系統監看各段壓力並控制閥門，之後啟動循環，混合腔在數小時內從約 0.8 K 降到基礎溫度。安全邏輯包括混合物回收桶、洩壓閥與停電時的自動回收，整個流程約 24 小時。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling a dry system down follows a fixed sequence: pump the vacuum can to high vacuum and start the pulse tube; precool the internal stages from 300 K to about 4 K not with exchange gas but by circulating the mixture gas through a precooling loop that carries heat between stages, then isolate the loop near 4 K. The compressor then pushes the mixture through the condensing line, where it is cooled at the 4 K stage and liquefied by expansion across the Joule–Thomson impedance, filling the still and then the mixing chamber; the gas-handling system monitors pressures and sequences the valves, after which circulation starts and the mixing chamber falls from about 0.8 K to base within hours. Safety logic includes the mixture dump tank, relief valves and automatic recovery on power loss, and the whole process takes about 24 hours. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas-handling system and condensing line”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預冷時間估算：內部銅質構件 60 kg，銅從 300 K 到 4 K 的焓約 80 kJ/kg（教學假設），需移除 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Precool-time estimate: the internal copper parts weigh 60 kg and copper's enthalpy from 300 K to 4 K is about 80 kJ/kg (teaching assumption), so 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ must be removed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gas-handling system and condensing line”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Cooling a dry system down follows a fixed sequence: pump the vacuum can to high vacuum and start the pulse tube; precool the internal stages from 300 K to about 4 K not with exchange gas but by circulating the mixture gas through a precooling loop that carries heat between stages, then isolate the loop near 4 K. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation" is correct?
options: 混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。
乾式系統的降溫是一套固定程序：先把真空罐抽到高真空並啟動脈衝管。
驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。
optionsEn: Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional.
Cooling a dry system down follows a fixed sequence: pump the vacuum can to high vacuum and start the pulse tube.
Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration.
quiz.explanation: 乾式系統的降溫是一套固定程序：先把真空罐抽到高真空並啟動脈衝管；內部各級從 300 K 預冷到約 4 K 時不用交換氣，而是讓混合氣體經預冷迴路循環、在各級之間搬運熱量，接近 4 K 時再把迴路切斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling a dry system down follows a fixed sequence: pump the vacuum can to high vacuum and start the pulse tube; precool the internal stages from 300 K to about 4 K not with exchange gas but by circulating the mixture gas through a precooling loop that carries heat between stages, then isolate the loop near 4 K. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gas-handling system and condensing line” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預冷時間估算：內部銅質構件 60 kg，銅從 300 K 到 4 K 的焓約 80 kJ/kg（教學假設），需移除 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ。若兩級脈衝管透過預冷迴路有效提供平均 70 W，時間 = 4.8×10⁶/70 ≈ 6.9×10⁴ s ≈ 19 h；再加約 4 h 冷凝與混合腔降溫，總計約 23 h，與商用系統「24 h 到基礎溫度」的規格一致。若只靠第二級的 1.5 W 做預冷，需要 4.8×10⁶/1.5 ≈ 3.2×10⁶ s ≈ 37 天，所以預冷迴路不可或缺。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Precool-time estimate: the internal copper parts weigh 60 kg and copper's enthalpy from 300 K to 4 K is about 80 kJ/kg (teaching assumption), so 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ must be removed. If the two pulse-tube stages deliver an effective average of 70 W through the precooling loop, the time is 4.8×10⁶/70 ≈ 6.9×10⁴ s ≈ 19 h; adding about 4 h for condensation and mixing-chamber cooling gives roughly 23 h, consistent with the 24 h to base specified for commercial systems. Relying on the 1.5 W second stage alone would take 4.8×10⁶/1.5 ≈ 3.2×10⁶ s ≈ 37 days, which is why the precooling loop is indispensable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：整個降溫過程記錄各級溫度與氣體處理系統各段壓力，和初次驗收時的參考曲線疊圖比較：到達 4 K 的時間、冷凝壓力隨時間下降的形狀、循環開始後混合腔的降溫斜率都應落在參考帶內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log every stage temperature and every gas-handling pressure through the cooldown and overlay them on the reference curves from commissioning: the time to reach 4 K, the shape of the falling condensing pressure and the mixing-chamber cooling slope after circulation starts should all fall inside the reference band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預冷時間估算：內部銅質構件 60 kg，銅從 300 K 到 4 K 的焓約 80 kJ/kg（教學假設），需移除 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ。若兩級脈衝管透過預冷迴路有效提供平均 70 W，時間 = 4.8×10⁶/70 ≈ 6.9×10⁴ s ≈ 19 h；再加約 4 h 冷凝與混合腔降溫，總計約 23 h，與商用系統「24 h 到基礎溫度」的規格一致。若只靠第二級的 1.5 W 做預冷，需要 4.8×10⁶/1.5 ≈ 3.2×10⁶ s ≈ 37 天，所以預冷迴路不可或缺。
knowledge.textEn: Precool-time estimate: the internal copper parts weigh 60 kg and copper's enthalpy from 300 K to 4 K is about 80 kJ/kg (teaching assumption), so 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ must be removed. If the two pulse-tube stages deliver an effective average of 70 W through the precooling loop, the time is 4.8×10⁶/70 ≈ 6.9×10⁴ s ≈ 19 h; adding about 4 h for condensation and mixing-chamber cooling gives roughly 23 h, consistent with the 24 h to base specified for commercial systems. Relying on the 1.5 W second stage alone would take 4.8×10⁶/1.5 ≈ 3.2×10⁶ s ≈ 37 days, which is why the precooling loop is indispensable.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation", which statement holds?
options: 靜止段加熱器只是額外的熱負載，把它關掉混合腔會更冷。
熱交換面積越大一定越好，與流阻無關。
預冷時間估算：內部銅質構件 60 kg，銅從 300 K 到 4 K 的焓約 80 kJ/kg（教學假設），需移除 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ。
optionsEn: The still heater is just an extra heat load, so switching it off makes the mixing chamber colder.
More exchanger area is always better, regardless of flow impedance.
Precool-time estimate: the internal copper parts weigh 60 kg and copper's enthalpy from 300 K to 4 K is about 80 kJ/kg (teaching assumption), so 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ must be removed.
quiz.explanation: 預冷時間估算：內部銅質構件 60 kg，銅從 300 K 到 4 K 的焓約 80 kJ/kg（教學假設），需移除 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Precool-time estimate: the internal copper parts weigh 60 kg and copper's enthalpy from 300 K to 4 K is about 80 kJ/kg (teaching assumption), so 60×80 = 4800 kJ = 4.8 MJ must be removed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gas-handling system and condensing line” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 整個降溫過程記錄各級溫度與氣體處理系統各段壓力，和初次驗收時的參考曲線疊圖比較：到達 4 K 的時間、冷凝壓力隨時間下降的形狀、循環開始後混合腔的降溫斜率都應落在參考帶內。4 K 法蘭已達 4 K 而冷凝壓力居高不下，指向阻抗阻塞或冷凝線某處偏暖；最後確認 24 h 內到達基礎溫度並重測 100 mK 的冷卻力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log every stage temperature and every gas-handling pressure through the cooldown and overlay them on the reference curves from commissioning: the time to reach 4 K, the shape of the falling condensing pressure and the mixing-chamber cooling slope after circulation starts should all fall inside the reference band. A condensing pressure that stays high while the 4 K flange is already at 4 K points to a blocked impedance or a warm spot on the condensing line; finally confirm base temperature within 24 h and re-measure the cooling power at 100 mK. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：氣體處理系統有微小漏氣或混合物被污染，阻抗與冷阱結冰、循環率下降；若壓力失控觸發洩壓閥，昂貴且難以補充的 ³He 會被排到大氣。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A small leak in the gas-handling system or a contaminated mixture ices up the impedance and cold traps and the circulation rate drops; if the pressure runs away and lifts a relief valve, expensive and hard-to-replace ³He is vented to the atmosphere.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 整個降溫過程記錄各級溫度與氣體處理系統各段壓力，和初次驗收時的參考曲線疊圖比較：到達 4 K 的時間、冷凝壓力隨時間下降的形狀、循環開始後混合腔的降溫斜率都應落在參考帶內。4 K 法蘭已達 4 K 而冷凝壓力居高不下，指向阻抗阻塞或冷凝線某處偏暖；最後確認 24 h 內到達基礎溫度並重測 100 mK 的冷卻力。
knowledge.textEn: Log every stage temperature and every gas-handling pressure through the cooldown and overlay them on the reference curves from commissioning: the time to reach 4 K, the shape of the falling condensing pressure and the mixing-chamber cooling slope after circulation starts should all fall inside the reference band. A condensing pressure that stays high while the 4 K flange is already at 4 K points to a blocked impedance or a warm spot on the condensing line; finally confirm base temperature within 24 h and re-measure the cooling power at 100 mK.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation"?
options: 整個降溫過程記錄各級溫度與氣體處理系統各段壓力，和初次驗收時的參考曲線疊圖比較：到達 4 K 的時間、冷凝壓力隨時間下降的形狀、循環開始後混合腔的降溫斜率都應落在參考帶內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。
optionsEn: Log every stage temperature and every gas-handling pressure through the cooldown and overlay them on the reference curves from commissioning: the time to reach 4 K, the shape of the falling condensing pressure and the mixing-chamber cooling slope after circulation starts should all fall inside the reference band.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited.
quiz.explanation: 整個降溫過程記錄各級溫度與氣體處理系統各段壓力，和初次驗收時的參考曲線疊圖比較：到達 4 K 的時間、冷凝壓力隨時間下降的形狀、循環開始後混合腔的降溫斜率都應落在參考帶內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log every stage temperature and every gas-handling pressure through the cooldown and overlay them on the reference curves from commissioning: the time to reach 4 K, the shape of the falling condensing pressure and the mixing-chamber cooling slope after circulation starts should all fall inside the reference band. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣體處理系統與冷凝線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gas-handling system and condensing line” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 氣體處理系統有微小漏氣或混合物被污染，阻抗與冷阱結冰、循環率下降；若壓力失控觸發洩壓閥，昂貴且難以補充的 ³He 會被排到大氣。症狀是冷凝壓力上升、流量下降；後果是回溫清理，而且混合物庫存永久減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A small leak in the gas-handling system or a contaminated mixture ices up the impedance and cold traps and the circulation rate drops; if the pressure runs away and lifts a relief valve, expensive and hard-to-replace ³He is vented to the atmosphere. The symptom is rising condensing pressure with falling flow; the consequence is a warm-up for cleaning and a permanent loss of mixture inventory. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安全邏輯包括混合物回收桶、洩壓閥與停電時的自動回收，整個流程約 24 小時。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Safety logic includes the mixture dump tank, relief valves and automatic recovery on power loss, and the whole process takes about 24 hours.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混合物抽過一次真空就乾淨了，冷阱可有可無。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the mixture has been pumped on once it is clean and cold traps are optional." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 氣體處理系統有微小漏氣或混合物被污染，阻抗與冷阱結冰、循環率下降；若壓力失控觸發洩壓閥，昂貴且難以補充的 ³He 會被排到大氣。症狀是冷凝壓力上升、流量下降；後果是回溫清理，而且混合物庫存永久減少。
knowledge.textEn: A small leak in the gas-handling system or a contaminated mixture ices up the impedance and cold traps and the circulation rate drops; if the pressure runs away and lifts a relief valve, expensive and hard-to-replace ³He is vented to the atmosphere. The symptom is rising condensing pressure with falling flow; the consequence is a warm-up for cleaning and a permanent loss of mixture inventory.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「降溫程序、冷凝與自動化運轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cooldown sequence, condensation and automated operation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
氣體處理系統有微小漏氣或混合物被污染，阻抗與冷阱結冰、循環率下降；若壓力失控觸發洩壓閥，昂貴且難以補充的 ³He 會被排到大氣。
驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A small leak in the gas-handling system or a contaminated mixture ices up the impedance and cold traps and the circulation rate drops.
Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration.
quiz.explanation: 氣體處理系統有微小漏氣或混合物被污染，阻抗與冷阱結冰、循環率下降；若壓力失控觸發洩壓閥，昂貴且難以補充的 ³He 會被排到大氣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small leak in the gas-handling system or a contaminated mixture ices up the impedance and cold traps and the circulation rate drops; if the pressure runs away and lifts a relief valve, expensive and hard-to-replace ³He is vented to the atmosphere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收測試與交接文件」如何決定稀釋製冷機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance test and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Dilution refrigerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收不是只看一次基礎溫度，而是一組可重複的量測：以校正過的溫度計確認混合腔 ≤ 10 mK、在規定循環率下量 20 mK 與 100 mK 的冷卻力、記錄降溫時間、混合腔的振動位準、24 小時溫度漂移、無人值守運轉與警報，以及每條線路的衰減與熱錨狀態。交接文件要包含實際配線圖、各溫度計校正表、氣體處理系統閥門圖、混合物庫存量、冷卻力曲線、安全設定與保養週期（壓縮機吸附器、冷阱更換）。沒有這份文件，往後任何配置變更都無法回溯是哪一項吃掉了冷卻力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試與交接文件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is not a single glimpse of base temperature but a repeatable set of measurements: confirm the mixing chamber at ≤ 10 mK with a calibrated thermometer, measure the cooling power at 20 mK and 100 mK at the specified circulation rate, record the cooldown time, the vibration level at the mixing chamber, the 24-hour temperature drift, unattended operation and alarms, and the attenuation and heat-sinking state of every line. The handoff record must contain the as-built wiring diagram, every thermometer calibration table, the gas-handling valve map, the mixture inventory, the cooling-power curve, the safety settings and the maintenance intervals for the compressor adsorber and cold traps. Without this record no later configuration change can be traced back to the item that consumed the cooling power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance test and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：驗收線以 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s 的理想曲線 Q̇ = 0.042·T² W 為基準：100 mK 實測 400 µW 對理想 420 µW 為 95%，通過；20 mK 實測 12 µW 對理想 16.8 µW 為 71%，反映 T_in > T_mc，仍在常見的 ≥ 65% 允收門檻內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The acceptance line is the ideal curve Q̇ = 0.042·T² W for ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s: at 100 mK a measured 400 µW against the ideal 420 µW is 95%, a pass; at 20 mK a measured 12 µW against 16.8 µW is 71%, reflecting T_in > T_mc but still inside a common ≥ 65% acceptance threshold.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收測試與交接文件」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance test and handoff record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接
knowledge.titleEn: Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff
knowledge.text: 驗收不是只看一次基礎溫度，而是一組可重複的量測：以校正過的溫度計確認混合腔 ≤ 10 mK、在規定循環率下量 20 mK 與 100 mK 的冷卻力、記錄降溫時間、混合腔的振動位準、24 小時溫度漂移、無人值守運轉與警報，以及每條線路的衰減與熱錨狀態。交接文件要包含實際配線圖、各溫度計校正表、氣體處理系統閥門圖、混合物庫存量、冷卻力曲線、安全設定與保養週期（壓縮機吸附器、冷阱更換）。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance is not a single glimpse of base temperature but a repeatable set of measurements: confirm the mixing chamber at ≤ 10 mK with a calibrated thermometer, measure the cooling power at 20 mK and 100 mK at the specified circulation rate, record the cooldown time, the vibration level at the mixing chamber, the 24-hour temperature drift, unattended operation and alarms, and the attenuation and heat-sinking state of every line. The handoff record must contain the as-built wiring diagram, every thermometer calibration table, the gas-handling valve map, the mixture inventory, the cooling-power curve, the safety settings and the maintenance intervals for the compressor adsorber and cold traps.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff" is correct?
options: 驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。
低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。
驗收不是只看一次基礎溫度，而是一組可重複的量測：以校正過的溫度計確認混合腔 ≤ 10 mK、在規定循環率下量 20 mK 與 100 mK 的冷卻力、記錄降溫時間、混合腔的振動位準、24 小時溫度漂移、無人值守運轉與警報，以及每條線路的衰減與熱錨狀態。
optionsEn: Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration.
Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot.

Acceptance is not a single glimpse of base temperature but a repeatable set of measurements: confirm the mixing chamber at ≤ 10 mK with a calibrated thermometer, measure the cooling power at 20 mK and 100 mK at the specified circulation rate, record the cooldown time, the vibration level at the mixing chamber, the 24-hour temperature drift, unattended operation and alarms, and the attenuation and heat-sinking state of every line.
quiz.explanation: 驗收不是只看一次基礎溫度，而是一組可重複的量測：以校正過的溫度計確認混合腔 ≤ 10 mK、在規定循環率下量 20 mK 與 100 mK 的冷卻力、記錄降溫時間、混合腔的振動位準、24 小時溫度漂移、無人值守運轉與警報，以及每條線路的衰減與熱錨狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance is not a single glimpse of base temperature but a repeatable set of measurements: confirm the mixing chamber at ≤ 10 mK with a calibrated thermometer, measure the cooling power at 20 mK and 100 mK at the specified circulation rate, record the cooldown time, the vibration level at the mixing chamber, the 24-hour temperature drift, unattended operation and alarms, and the attenuation and heat-sinking state of every line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收測試與交接文件」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance test and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：驗收線以 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s 的理想曲線 Q̇ = 0.042·T² W 為基準：100 mK 實測 400 µW 對理想 420 µW 為 95%，通過；20 mK 實測 12 µW 對理想 16.8 µW 為 71%，反映 T_in > T_mc，仍在常見的 ≥ 65% 允收門檻內。把寄生負載 3 µW 代入 3×10⁻⁶ = 0.042·T²，得理想極限 T_base = √(7.14×10⁻⁵) ≈ 8.5 mK；再計入熱交換器效率，實際約 10 mK，與規格相符。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The acceptance line is the ideal curve Q̇ = 0.042·T² W for ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s: at 100 mK a measured 400 µW against the ideal 420 µW is 95%, a pass; at 20 mK a measured 12 µW against 16.8 µW is 71%, reflecting T_in > T_mc but still inside a common ≥ 65% acceptance threshold. Substituting a parasitic load of 3 µW into 3×10⁻⁶ = 0.042·T² gives an ideal limit T_base = √(7.14×10⁻⁵) ≈ 8.5 mK; allowing for exchanger efficiency the real value is about 10 mK, matching the specification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在所有線路接妥的狀態下做 24 小時無人值守穩定性測試，記錄混合腔溫度漂移；以加熱器階躍法在 20、50、100 mK 量冷卻力；用加速規或樣品位置的感測器量振動，標出 1.4 Hz 脈衝管基頻及其諧波；模擬停電確認混合物自動回收到儲桶；每一項結果都與驗收紀錄中的規格表逐欄比對並簽署。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With every line connected, run a 24-hour unattended stability test and log the mixing-chamber drift; measure cooling power by heater steps at 20, 50 and 100 mK; measure vibration with an accelerometer or a sample-position sensor and identify the 1.4 Hz pulse-tube fundamental and its harmonics; simulate a power loss to confirm the mixture is recovered automatically to the dump tank; compare every result column by column with the specification table in the acceptance record and sign it off.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 驗收線以 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s 的理想曲線 Q̇ = 0.042·T² W 為基準：100 mK 實測 400 µW 對理想 420 µW 為 95%，通過；20 mK 實測 12 µW 對理想 16.8 µW 為 71%，反映 T_in > T_mc，仍在常見的 ≥ 65% 允收門檻內。把寄生負載 3 µW 代入 3×10⁻⁶ = 0.042·T²，得理想極限 T_base = √(7.14×10⁻⁵) ≈ 8.5 mK；再計入熱交換器效率，實際約 10 mK，與規格相符。
knowledge.textEn: The acceptance line is the ideal curve Q̇ = 0.042·T² W for ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s: at 100 mK a measured 400 µW against the ideal 420 µW is 95%, a pass; at 20 mK a measured 12 µW against 16.8 µW is 71%, reflecting T_in > T_mc but still inside a common ≥ 65% acceptance threshold. Substituting a parasitic load of 3 µW into 3×10⁻⁶ = 0.042·T² gives an ideal limit T_base = √(7.14×10⁻⁵) ≈ 8.5 mK; allowing for exchanger efficiency the real value is about 10 mK, matching the specification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff", which statement holds?
options: 驗收線以 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s 的理想曲線 Q̇ = 0.042·T² W 為基準：100 mK 實測 400 µW 對理想 420 µW 為 95%，通過。
脈衝管在 4 K 有 1.5 W，所以 4 K 級的熱負載不必特別管理。
RuO₂ 溫度計的出廠校正曲線不論安裝與激發方式都有效。
optionsEn: The acceptance line is the ideal curve Q̇ = 0.042·T² W for ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s: at 100 mK a measured 400 µW against the ideal 420 µW is 95%, a pass.
With 1.5 W available at 4 K, the loads on the 4 K stage need no management.
A RuO₂ sensor's factory calibration curve holds regardless of how it is mounted and excited.
quiz.explanation: 驗收線以 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s 的理想曲線 Q̇ = 0.042·T² W 為基準：100 mK 實測 400 µW 對理想 420 µW 為 95%，通過；20 mK 實測 12 µW 對理想 16.8 µW 為 71%，反映 T_in > T_mc，仍在常見的 ≥ 65% 允收門檻內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The acceptance line is the ideal curve Q̇ = 0.042·T² W for ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s: at 100 mK a measured 400 µW against the ideal 420 µW is 95%, a pass; at 20 mK a measured 12 µW against 16.8 µW is 71%, reflecting T_in > T_mc but still inside a common ≥ 65% acceptance threshold. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收測試與交接文件」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance test and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在所有線路接妥的狀態下做 24 小時無人值守穩定性測試，記錄混合腔溫度漂移；以加熱器階躍法在 20、50、100 mK 量冷卻力；用加速規或樣品位置的感測器量振動，標出 1.4 Hz 脈衝管基頻及其諧波；模擬停電確認混合物自動回收到儲桶；每一項結果都與驗收紀錄中的規格表逐欄比對並簽署。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With every line connected, run a 24-hour unattended stability test and log the mixing-chamber drift; measure cooling power by heater steps at 20, 50 and 100 mK; measure vibration with an accelerometer or a sample-position sensor and identify the 1.4 Hz pulse-tube fundamental and its harmonics; simulate a power loss to confirm the mixture is recovered automatically to the dump tank; compare every result column by column with the specification table in the acceptance record and sign it off. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收時混合腔是空的、沒有任何配線，之後才裝上一百條同軸線：冷卻力被吃掉，基礎溫度升到 20 mK；因為沒有實際配置的熱負載表，沒有人知道是哪些線造成的，後果是數個月的拆裝與重新驗證。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance was done with an empty mixing chamber and no wiring, and a hundred coaxial lines were installed afterwards: the cooling power is consumed and base rises to 20 mK; with no as-built heat-load table nobody knows which lines are responsible, and the consequence is months of disassembly and re-verification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在所有線路接妥的狀態下做 24 小時無人值守穩定性測試，記錄混合腔溫度漂移；以加熱器階躍法在 20、50、100 mK 量冷卻力；用加速規或樣品位置的感測器量振動，標出 1.4 Hz 脈衝管基頻及其諧波；模擬停電確認混合物自動回收到儲桶；每一項結果都與驗收紀錄中的規格表逐欄比對並簽署。
knowledge.textEn: With every line connected, run a 24-hour unattended stability test and log the mixing-chamber drift; measure cooling power by heater steps at 20, 50 and 100 mK; measure vibration with an accelerometer or a sample-position sensor and identify the 1.4 Hz pulse-tube fundamental and its harmonics; simulate a power loss to confirm the mixture is recovered automatically to the dump tank; compare every result column by column with the specification table in the acceptance record and sign it off.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在所有線路接妥的狀態下做 24 小時無人值守穩定性測試，記錄混合腔溫度漂移。
只要混合腔法蘭到達基礎溫度，法蘭上的樣品就自動同溫。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
With every line connected, run a 24-hour unattended stability test and log the mixing-chamber drift.
Once the mixing-chamber flange reaches base, a sample on it is automatically at the same temperature.
quiz.explanation: 在所有線路接妥的狀態下做 24 小時無人值守穩定性測試，記錄混合腔溫度漂移；以加熱器階躍法在 20、50、100 mK 量冷卻力；用加速規或樣品位置的感測器量振動，標出 1.4 Hz 脈衝管基頻及其諧波；模擬停電確認混合物自動回收到儲桶；每一項結果都與驗收紀錄中的規格表逐欄比對並簽署。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: With every line connected, run a 24-hour unattended stability test and log the mixing-chamber drift; measure cooling power by heater steps at 20, 50 and 100 mK; measure vibration with an accelerometer or a sample-position sensor and identify the 1.4 Hz pulse-tube fundamental and its harmonics; simulate a power loss to confirm the mixture is recovered automatically to the dump tank; compare every result column by column with the specification table in the acceptance record and sign it off. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收測試與交接文件」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance test and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 驗收時混合腔是空的、沒有任何配線，之後才裝上一百條同軸線：冷卻力被吃掉，基礎溫度升到 20 mK；因為沒有實際配置的熱負載表，沒有人知道是哪些線造成的，後果是數個月的拆裝與重新驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance was done with an empty mixing chamber and no wiring, and a hundred coaxial lines were installed afterwards: the cooling power is consumed and base rises to 20 mK; with no as-built heat-load table nobody knows which lines are responsible, and the consequence is months of disassembly and re-verification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有這份文件，往後任何配置變更都無法回溯是哪一項吃掉了冷卻力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without this record no later configuration change can be traced back to the item that consumed the cooling power.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「驗收時到達過一次基礎溫度，就證明系統在任何後續配置下都能到達。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching base once at acceptance proves the system will reach it in every later configuration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 驗收時混合腔是空的、沒有任何配線，之後才裝上一百條同軸線：冷卻力被吃掉，基礎溫度升到 20 mK；因為沒有實際配置的熱負載表，沒有人知道是哪些線造成的，後果是數個月的拆裝與重新驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance was done with an empty mixing chamber and no wiring, and a hundred coaxial lines were installed afterwards: the cooling power is consumed and base rises to 20 mK; with no as-built heat-load table nobody knows which lines are responsible, and the consequence is months of disassembly and re-verification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基礎溫度、冷卻力曲線與驗收交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base temperature, cooling-power curve and acceptance handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
低於 0.3 K 之後 ³He 會直接從混合物中蒸發掉，所以稀釋製冷和 ³He 抽氣一樣有指數截止。
驗收時混合腔是空的、沒有任何配線，之後才裝上一百條同軸線：冷卻力被吃掉，基礎溫度升到 20 mK。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Below 0.3 K the ³He simply evaporates out of the mixture, so dilution cooling has the same exponential cutoff as a pumped ³He pot.
Acceptance was done with an empty mixing chamber and no wiring, and a hundred coaxial lines were installed afterwards: the cooling power is consumed and base rises to 20 mK.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時混合腔是空的、沒有任何配線，之後才裝上一百條同軸線：冷卻力被吃掉，基礎溫度升到 20 mK；因為沒有實際配置的熱負載表，沒有人知道是哪些線造成的，後果是數個月的拆裝與重新驗證。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance was done with an empty mixing chamber and no wiring, and a hundred coaxial lines were installed afterwards: the cooling power is consumed and base rises to 20 mK; with no as-built heat-load table nobody knows which lines are responsible, and the consequence is months of disassembly and re-verification. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 超高真空腔體建置
summary: 以一個 100 L、內表面 1 m² 的不鏽鋼實驗腔為對象：從極限壓力 p = Q/S 出發，理解出氣率與分子流傳導率為何比泵的標稱抽速更重要；再把材料選擇、內側焊接、CF 金屬密封、烘烤程序、泵組合與離子真空計／殘氣分析的誤差預算整合成可驗收、可交接的超高真空腔體。
summaryEn: Built around a 100 L stainless experimental chamber with 1 m² of internal surface: start from the ultimate-pressure relation p = Q/S to see why outgassing and molecular-flow conductance matter more than the pump's nameplate speed, then integrate material choice, inside welding, CF metal seals, bakeout, pump combinations and the error budget of ion gauges and residual-gas analysis into an ultrahigh-vacuum chamber that can be accepted and handed over.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 低溫、真空與精密實驗平台

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 極限壓力鏈練習：腔體 V = 100 L、內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²，渦輪泵 300 L/s 經 DN100、30 cm 管子接入，C ≈ 12.1×1000/30 ≈ 403 L/s，S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s。漏氣：20 個 CF 法蘭各 ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s，合計 2×10⁻¹⁰，壓力貢獻 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar。未烘烤抽 10 小時：q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²)，Q = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s，p = 1×10⁻⁵/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸ mbar。150 °C 烘烤 48 小時後：q_H₂ = 2×10⁻¹³，Q = 2×10⁻⁹，p = 2×10⁻⁹/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar。再並聯離子泵（對氫 250 L/s）與 NEG 匣 400 L/s：S_total = 172 + 250 + 400 = 822 L/s，p = 2×10⁻⁹/822 ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹² mbar。真空計讀值：氫的相對靈敏度 0.46，BA 計顯示約 0.46×2.4×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.1×10⁻¹² mbar 的氮當量，已低於其 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar 的 X 光極限，顯示會停在 10⁻¹¹ 附近，必須改用引出式真空計才能證明達標。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Ultimate-pressure chain exercise: chamber V = 100 L with internal surface A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm², a 300 L/s turbopump connected through a DN100 tube 30 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/30 ≈ 403 L/s and S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s. Leaks: 20 CF flanges at ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s each, 2×10⁻¹⁰ in total, contributing 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar. Unbaked after 10 hours: q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²), Q = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s and p = 1×10⁻⁵/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸ mbar. After a 48-hour bake at 150 °C: q_H₂ = 2×10⁻¹³, Q = 2×10⁻⁹ and p = 2×10⁻⁹/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar. Adding an ion pump (250 L/s for hydrogen) and a 400 L/s NEG cartridge in parallel: S_total = 172 + 250 + 400 = 822 L/s and p = 2×10⁻⁹/822 ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹² mbar. Gauge reading: with a relative sensitivity of 0.46 for hydrogen the BA gauge displays about 0.46×2.4×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.1×10⁻¹² mbar nitrogen equivalent, below its 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar X-ray limit, so the display sticks near 10⁻¹¹ and an extractor gauge is needed to prove the target. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」與「分子流傳導率與有效抽速」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" and "Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「腔壁的氣體來源」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gas sources at the chamber wall” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，腔內的氣體負載不是殘留的空氣，而是從壁面脫附的分子：未烘烤系統以水氣為主，烘烤後則是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫。此時平均自由徑長達數公里，氣體以分子流運動，分子只與壁面碰撞而不彼此碰撞，壓力由平衡關係 p = Q/S_eff 決定，Q 是出氣、漏氣與滲透的總氣體流量，S_eff 是泵經過管路後在腔體入口的有效抽速。所以超高真空設計就是兩件事：把單位面積出氣率 q 與內表面積 A 的乘積壓到最低，並讓 S_eff 不被傳導率吃掉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「腔壁的氣體來源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Below 10⁻⁹ mbar the gas load inside the chamber is not residual air but molecules desorbing from the walls: water dominates an unbaked system, and after bakeout the source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel. The mean free path is then kilometres, gas moves in molecular flow where molecules collide only with walls and never with each other, and the pressure settles at p = Q/S_eff, with Q the total throughput from outgassing, leaks and permeation and S_eff the effective pumping speed at the chamber port after the connecting line. Ultrahigh-vacuum design therefore reduces to two tasks: minimise the product of specific outgassing rate q and internal area A, and keep S_eff from being throttled by conductance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas sources at the chamber wall”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腔體內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The internal surface is A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「腔壁的氣體來源」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gas sources at the chamber wall”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S
knowledge.titleEn: Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S
knowledge.text: 在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，腔內的氣體負載不是殘留的空氣，而是從壁面脫附的分子：未烘烤系統以水氣為主，烘烤後則是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫。此時平均自由徑長達數公里，氣體以分子流運動，分子只與壁面碰撞而不彼此碰撞，壓力由平衡關係 p = Q/S_eff 決定，Q 是出氣、漏氣與滲透的總氣體流量，S_eff 是泵經過管路後在腔體入口的有效抽速。
knowledge.textEn: Below 10⁻⁹ mbar the gas load inside the chamber is not residual air but molecules desorbing from the walls: water dominates an unbaked system, and after bakeout the source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel. The mean free path is then kilometres, gas moves in molecular flow where molecules collide only with walls and never with each other, and the pressure settles at p = Q/S_eff, with Q the total throughput from outgassing, leaks and permeation and S_eff the effective pumping speed at the chamber port after the connecting line.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" is correct?
options: 只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。
在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，腔內的氣體負載不是殘留的空氣，而是從壁面脫附的分子：未烘烤系統以水氣為主，烘烤後則是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫。
兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。
optionsEn: A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing.

Below 10⁻⁹ mbar the gas load inside the chamber is not residual air but molecules desorbing from the walls: water dominates an unbaked system, and after bakeout the source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel.
The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two.
quiz.explanation: 在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，腔內的氣體負載不是殘留的空氣，而是從壁面脫附的分子：未烘烤系統以水氣為主，烘烤後則是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Below 10⁻⁹ mbar the gas load inside the chamber is not residual air but molecules desorbing from the walls: water dominates an unbaked system, and after bakeout the source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔壁的氣體來源」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gas sources at the chamber wall” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腔體內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²。未烘烤的不鏽鋼抽氣 10 小時後 q ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設，以水氣為主），Q = q·A = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s；若 S_eff = 200 L/s，p = Q/S_eff = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar，只是高真空。在 150–250 °C 烘烤後 q 降到約 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（以氫為主），Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，p = 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar，進入超高真空。同一個泵，壓力差了三個多數量級，差別全在 q。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The internal surface is A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm². Unbaked stainless steel after 10 hours of pumping has q ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption, water-dominated), so Q = q·A = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s; with S_eff = 200 L/s, p = Q/S_eff = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar, merely high vacuum. After a 150–250 °C bakeout q falls to about 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (hydrogen-dominated), Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and p = 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar, ultrahigh vacuum. Same pump, more than three orders of magnitude in pressure, and the whole difference is in q. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用壓升法量總氣體負載：關閉泵前的閥門，記錄壓力隨時間的上升，Q = V·(dp/dt)；例如 V = 100 L、dp/dt = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar/s 時 Q = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the total gas load by rate of rise: close the valve in front of the pump, log the pressure versus time and take Q = V·(dp/dt); for V = 100 L and dp/dt = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar/s, Q = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 腔體內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²。未烘烤的不鏽鋼抽氣 10 小時後 q ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設，以水氣為主），Q = q·A = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s；若 S_eff = 200 L/s，p = Q/S_eff = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar，只是高真空。在 150–250 °C 烘烤後 q 降到約 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（以氫為主），Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，p = 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar，進入超高真空。同一個泵，壓力差了三個多數量級，差別全在 q。
knowledge.textEn: The internal surface is A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm². Unbaked stainless steel after 10 hours of pumping has q ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption, water-dominated), so Q = q·A = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s; with S_eff = 200 L/s, p = Q/S_eff = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar, merely high vacuum. After a 150–250 °C bakeout q falls to about 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (hydrogen-dominated), Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and p = 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar, ultrahigh vacuum. Same pump, more than three orders of magnitude in pressure, and the whole difference is in q.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S", which statement holds?
options: CF 法蘭漏氣時，把螺栓鎖得更緊就能解決。
離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。
腔體內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²。
optionsEn: A leaking CF flange is fixed by tightening the bolts harder.
The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber.
The internal surface is A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm².
quiz.explanation: 腔體內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The internal surface is A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「腔壁的氣體來源」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gas sources at the chamber wall” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用壓升法量總氣體負載：關閉泵前的閥門，記錄壓力隨時間的上升，Q = V·(dp/dt)；例如 V = 100 L、dp/dt = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar/s 時 Q = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s。壓力線性上升代表漏氣或出氣，再用殘氣分析儀分辨：m/z 28 與 32 比約 4:1 是空氣漏入，m/z 18 為主是水氣出氣，m/z 2 為主是烘烤後的氫。把 Q 除以 S_eff，預測的極限壓力應與重新開閥後的穩態壓力一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the total gas load by rate of rise: close the valve in front of the pump, log the pressure versus time and take Q = V·(dp/dt); for V = 100 L and dp/dt = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar/s, Q = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s. A linear rise means a leak or outgassing, and the residual-gas analyser tells them apart: m/z 28 to 32 near 4:1 is an air leak, dominant m/z 18 is water outgassing, dominant m/z 2 is post-bake hydrogen. Dividing Q by S_eff must reproduce the steady pressure observed after the valve is reopened. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一顆鎖進盲孔的未開槽螺絲把一小團空氣困在螺紋裡，形成虛漏：抽氣曲線停在 10⁻⁸ mbar 不再下降，殘氣譜像空氣，但氦氣檢漏在外部找不到任何漏點；後果是永遠到不了超高真空，直到換成有排氣槽或通孔的螺絲。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An unvented screw in a blind tapped hole traps a pocket of air in the threads and becomes a virtual leak: the pump-down curve stalls at 10⁻⁸ mbar, the residual-gas spectrum looks like air, yet helium leak detection finds nothing outside; the consequence is a chamber that never reaches ultrahigh vacuum until vented or through-drilled screws replace it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腔壁的氣體來源」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gas sources at the chamber wall” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一顆鎖進盲孔的未開槽螺絲把一小團空氣困在螺紋裡，形成虛漏：抽氣曲線停在 10⁻⁸ mbar 不再下降，殘氣譜像空氣，但氦氣檢漏在外部找不到任何漏點；後果是永遠到不了超高真空，直到換成有排氣槽或通孔的螺絲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An unvented screw in a blind tapped hole traps a pocket of air in the threads and becomes a virtual leak: the pump-down curve stalls at 10⁻⁸ mbar, the residual-gas spectrum looks like air, yet helium leak detection finds nothing outside; the consequence is a chamber that never reaches ultrahigh vacuum until vented or through-drilled screws replace it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所以超高真空設計就是兩件事：把單位面積出氣率 q 與內表面積 A 的乘積壓到最低，並讓 S_eff 不被傳導率吃掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ultrahigh-vacuum design therefore reduces to two tasks: minimise the product of specific outgassing rate q and internal area A, and keep S_eff from being throttled by conductance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。

steps.title: 分子流傳導率與有效抽速：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「抽氣口與連接管」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping port and connecting tube” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分子流下，傳導率只由幾何決定而與壓力無關：對 20 °C 的空氣，薄孔的傳導率約 C ≈ 11.6·A L/s（A 以 cm² 計），長圓管約 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）。串聯元件的傳導率以倒數相加，泵的有效抽速為 1/S_eff = 1/S_pump + 1/C。因為 C 正比於 d³/L，管徑是主導因素：一段又長又細的管子會把再大的泵都節流掉。傳導率還隨氣體分子量以 1/√M 變化，氫的傳導率約為空氣的 3.8 倍，所以同一條管路對不同氣體的「有效抽速」並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「抽氣口與連接管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In molecular flow the conductance is fixed by geometry alone and does not depend on pressure: for air at 20 °C a thin aperture has C ≈ 11.6·A L/s (A in cm²) and a long round tube C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s (d and L in cm). Series elements combine by adding reciprocals, and the effective pumping speed is 1/S_eff = 1/S_pump + 1/C. Because C scales as d³/L, the tube diameter dominates: a long narrow tube throttles any pump however large. Conductance also varies with molecular mass as 1/√M, hydrogen flowing about 3.8 times more readily than air, so the same line gives different effective speeds for different gases. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pumping port and connecting tube”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一台 S = 300 L/s 的渦輪泵接在 DN100（d = 10 cm）、L = 30 cm 的管子上：C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s，S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s，只剩標稱抽速的 57%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A turbopump of S = 300 L/s hung on a DN100 tube (d = 10 cm) of length L = 30 cm: C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s and S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s, only 57% of the nameplate speed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「抽氣口與連接管」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pumping port and connecting tube”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Series elements combine by adding reciprocals, and the effective pumping speed is 1/S_eff = 1/S_pump + 1/C.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

steps.title: 分子流傳導率與有效抽速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抽氣口與連接管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumping port and connecting tube” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一台 S = 300 L/s 的渦輪泵接在 DN100（d = 10 cm）、L = 30 cm 的管子上：C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s，S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s，只剩標稱抽速的 57%。若改用 DN40（d = 4 cm）同樣 30 cm：C ≈ 12.1×64/30 ≈ 25.8 L/s，S_eff ≈ 1/(1/300 + 1/25.8) ≈ 23.8 L/s，比標稱抽速低了 12 倍，等於把 300 L/s 的泵用成 24 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A turbopump of S = 300 L/s hung on a DN100 tube (d = 10 cm) of length L = 30 cm: C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s and S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s, only 57% of the nameplate speed. With a DN40 tube (d = 4 cm) of the same 30 cm: C ≈ 12.1×64/30 ≈ 25.8 L/s and S_eff ≈ 1/(1/300 + 1/25.8) ≈ 23.8 L/s, twelve times below nameplate, which turns a 300 L/s pump into a 24 L/s one. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知流量的校正漏孔（例如 Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）接到腔體，記錄壓力上升量 Δp，則 S_eff = Q/Δp，直接與傳導率計算比較；若實測比計算低 30% 以上，先檢查閥門是否全開、管內有無擋板或網，再檢查真空計位置是否離泵口太近而讀到局部較低的壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Attach a calibrated leak of known throughput (for example Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) to the chamber, record the pressure rise Δp and take S_eff = Q/Δp, comparing directly with the conductance calculation; if the measurement falls more than 30% below the calculation, first check that valves are fully open and no baffle or screen sits in the line, then check whether the gauge is so close to the pump port that it reads a locally lower pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

With a DN40 tube (d = 4 cm) of the same 30 cm: C ≈ 12.1×64/30 ≈ 25.8 L/s and S_eff ≈ 1/(1/300 + 1/25.8) ≈ 23.8 L/s, twelve times below nameplate, which turns a 300 L/s pump into a 24 L/s one.

The ion-pump current reading always equals the true pressure.
quiz.explanation: 一台 S = 300 L/s 的渦輪泵接在 DN100（d = 10 cm）、L = 30 cm 的管子上：C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s，S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s，只剩標稱抽速的 57%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A turbopump of S = 300 L/s hung on a DN100 tube (d = 10 cm) of length L = 30 cm: C ≈ 12.1×10³/30 ≈ 403 L/s and S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s, only 57% of the nameplate speed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分子流傳導率與有效抽速：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「抽氣口與連接管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pumping port and connecting tube” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已知流量的校正漏孔（例如 Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）接到腔體，記錄壓力上升量 Δp，則 S_eff = Q/Δp，直接與傳導率計算比較；若實測比計算低 30% 以上，先檢查閥門是否全開、管內有無擋板或網，再檢查真空計位置是否離泵口太近而讀到局部較低的壓力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Attach a calibrated leak of known throughput (for example Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) to the chamber, record the pressure rise Δp and take S_eff = Q/Δp, comparing directly with the conductance calculation; if the measurement falls more than 30% below the calculation, first check that valves are fully open and no baffle or screen sits in the line, then check whether the gauge is so close to the pump port that it reads a locally lower pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了隔離振動，在泵與腔體之間加了一段長波紋管再加一個小通徑閘閥：S_eff 掉到原來的五分之一到十分之一，極限壓力上升一個數量級，而且腔體遠端與真空計之間出現壓力梯度，樣品附近的壓力比顯示值高數倍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A long bellows plus a small-bore gate valve inserted between pump and chamber to isolate vibration cuts S_eff to a fifth or a tenth, raises the ultimate pressure by an order of magnitude, and creates a pressure gradient between the far end of the chamber and the gauge so that the sample sees several times the displayed pressure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已知流量的校正漏孔（例如 Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）接到腔體，記錄壓力上升量 Δp，則 S_eff = Q/Δp，直接與傳導率計算比較；若實測比計算低 30% 以上，先檢查閥門是否全開、管內有無擋板或網，再檢查真空計位置是否離泵口太近而讀到局部較低的壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Attach a calibrated leak of known throughput (for example Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) to the chamber, record the pressure rise Δp and take S_eff = Q/Δp, comparing directly with the conductance calculation; if the measurement falls more than 30% below the calculation, first check that valves are fully open and no baffle or screen sits in the line, then check whether the gauge is so close to the pump port that it reads a locally lower pressure.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分子流傳導率與有效抽速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用已知流量的校正漏孔（例如 Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）接到腔體，記錄壓力上升量 Δp，則 S_eff = Q/Δp，直接與傳導率計算比較。
腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Attach a calibrated leak of known throughput (for example Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) to the chamber, record the pressure rise Δp and take S_eff = Q/Δp, comparing directly with the conductance calculation.
Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting.

quiz.explanationEn: Attach a calibrated leak of known throughput (for example Q = 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) to the chamber, record the pressure rise Δp and take S_eff = Q/Δp, comparing directly with the conductance calculation; if the measurement falls more than 30% below the calculation, first check that valves are fully open and no baffle or screen sits in the line, then check whether the gauge is so close to the pump port that it reads a locally lower pressure. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 分子流傳導率與有效抽速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抽氣口與連接管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pumping port and connecting tube” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了隔離振動，在泵與腔體之間加了一段長波紋管再加一個小通徑閘閥：S_eff 掉到原來的五分之一到十分之一，極限壓力上升一個數量級，而且腔體遠端與真空計之間出現壓力梯度，樣品附近的壓力比顯示值高數倍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A long bellows plus a small-bore gate valve inserted between pump and chamber to isolate vibration cuts S_eff to a fifth or a tenth, raises the ultimate pressure by an order of magnitude, and creates a pressure gradient between the far end of the chamber and the gauge so that the sample sees several times the displayed pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傳導率還隨氣體分子量以 1/√M 變化，氫的傳導率約為空氣的 3.8 倍，所以同一條管路對不同氣體的「有效抽速」並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conductance also varies with molecular mass as 1/√M, hydrogen flowing about 3.8 times more readily than air, so the same line gives different effective speeds for different gases.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 為了隔離振動，在泵與腔體之間加了一段長波紋管再加一個小通徑閘閥：S_eff 掉到原來的五分之一到十分之一，極限壓力上升一個數量級，而且腔體遠端與真空計之間出現壓力梯度，樣品附近的壓力比顯示值高數倍。
