knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分子流傳導率與有效抽速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Molecular-flow conductance and effective pumping speed" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。
為了隔離振動，在泵與腔體之間加了一段長波紋管再加一個小通徑閘閥：S_eff 掉到原來的五分之一到十分之一，極限壓力上升一個數量級，而且腔體遠端與真空計之間出現壓力梯度，樣品附近的壓力比顯示值高數倍。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally.

quiz.explanationEn: A long bellows plus a small-bore gate valve inserted between pump and chamber to isolate vibration cuts S_eff to a fifth or a tenth, raises the ultimate pressure by an order of magnitude, and creates a pressure gradient between the far end of the chamber and the gauge so that the sample sees several times the displayed pressure. stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理」與「ConFlat 金屬密封與可烘烤組件」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing" and "ConFlat metal sealing and bakeable components": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超高真空腔體用低碳的 304L／316L／316LN 不鏽鋼，避免焊接與烘烤時碳化物析出造成晶界腐蝕與漏氣；需要極低氫出氣時可先在 950 °C 真空燒結去氫。焊接採 TIG、從真空側全滲透焊接，絕不留下真空側的縫隙或被兩道焊縫夾住的死體積；只能從外側焊的部位也必須全滲透。內表面以電解拋光降低有效表面積並去除加工污染層，清洗流程為去脂、超音波、去離子水沖洗、無塵烘乾。禁用材料包括鋅、鎘、黃銅、一般塑膠與潤滑油脂，彈性體只容許用於高真空區段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum chambers use low-carbon 304L, 316L or 316LN stainless steel so that welding and bakeout do not precipitate carbides that cause intergranular corrosion and leaks; where hydrogen outgassing must be minimal the parts are vacuum-fired at 950 °C beforehand. Welding is TIG with full penetration from the vacuum side, never leaving a vacuum-side crevice or a dead volume trapped between two seams; joints that can only be welded from outside must still fully penetrate. Internal surfaces are electropolished to reduce effective area and strip the machining-contaminated layer, and cleaning runs degreasing, ultrasonic bath, deionised rinse and dust-free drying. Forbidden materials include zinc, cadmium, brass, ordinary plastics and lubricants, with elastomers tolerated only in high-vacuum sections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：大氣壓對平板蓋的壓力載荷必須算：直徑 300 mm 的簡支圓板承受 Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa，316L 的 E = 193 GPa、ν = 0.3，板剛度 D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The atmospheric load on a flat cover must be computed: a simply supported circular plate of 300 mm diameter carries Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa, 316L has E = 193 GPa and ν = 0.3, and the plate stiffness is D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理
knowledge.titleEn: Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing

Welding is TIG with full penetration from the vacuum side, never leaving a vacuum-side crevice or a dead volume trapped between two seams; joints that can only be welded from outside must still fully penetrate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing" is correct?
options: 超高真空腔體用低碳的 304L／316L／316LN 不鏽鋼，避免焊接與烘烤時碳化物析出造成晶界腐蝕與漏氣；需要極低氫出氣時可先在 950 °C 真空燒結去氫。

CF 法蘭漏氣時，把螺栓鎖得更緊就能解決。
optionsEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum chambers use low-carbon 304L, 316L or 316LN stainless steel so that welding and bakeout do not precipitate carbides that cause intergranular corrosion and leaks.
Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally.
A leaking CF flange is fixed by tightening the bolts harder.

quiz.explanationEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum chambers use low-carbon 304L, 316L or 316LN stainless steel so that welding and bakeout do not precipitate carbides that cause intergranular corrosion and leaks; where hydrogen outgassing must be minimal the parts are vacuum-fired at 950 °C beforehand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：大氣壓對平板蓋的壓力載荷必須算：直徑 300 mm 的簡支圓板承受 Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa，316L 的 E = 193 GPa、ν = 0.3，板剛度 D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)]。t = 10 mm 時 D ≈ 1.77×10⁴ N·m，中央撓度 w ≈ 0.0637·p·r⁴/D = 0.0637×10⁵×(0.15)⁴/1.77×10⁴ ≈ 0.18 mm，最大應力 σ ≈ 1.24·p·(r/t)² ≈ 28 MPa，遠低於降伏。改成 t = 5 mm，撓度隨 1/t³ 增為約 1.5 mm，應力約 112 MPa：仍不會破，但裝在蓋上的光學元件會因抽氣而偏移 1.5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The atmospheric load on a flat cover must be computed: a simply supported circular plate of 300 mm diameter carries Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa, 316L has E = 193 GPa and ν = 0.3, and the plate stiffness is D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)]. For t = 10 mm, D ≈ 1.77×10⁴ N·m, the centre deflection w ≈ 0.0637·p·r⁴/D = 0.0637×10⁵×(0.15)⁴/1.77×10⁴ ≈ 0.18 mm and the peak stress σ ≈ 1.24·p·(r/t)² ≈ 28 MPa, far below yield. At t = 5 mm the deflection grows as 1/t³ to about 1.5 mm and the stress to about 112 MPa: it still will not fail, but optics mounted on that cover shift by 1.5 mm every time the chamber is pumped. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對材料證明（低碳牌號、真空燒結紀錄），每一道焊縫做染色滲透或射線檢查，並以氦氣檢漏逐條確認 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；抽氣時用千分錶量大法蘭與蓋板的撓度並與平板公式比較；用輪廓儀量內表面粗糙度 Ra，確認電解拋光達到規格；最後以壓升法量整腔出氣率，和材料與面積的預估值對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the material certificates (low-carbon grade, vacuum-firing record), inspect every weld by dye penetrant or radiography and helium-leak-check each seam to below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s; during pump-down measure the deflection of large flanges and covers with a dial indicator and compare with the plate formula; measure the internal roughness Ra with a profilometer to confirm the electropolish meets specification; finally measure the whole-chamber outgassing by rate of rise and compare with the estimate from material and area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 大氣壓對平板蓋的壓力載荷必須算：直徑 300 mm 的簡支圓板承受 Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa，316L 的 E = 193 GPa、ν = 0.3，板剛度 D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)]。t = 10 mm 時 D ≈ 1.77×10⁴ N·m，中央撓度 w ≈ 0.0637·p·r⁴/D = 0.0637×10⁵×(0.15)⁴/1.77×10⁴ ≈ 0.18 mm，最大應力 σ ≈ 1.24·p·(r/t)² ≈ 28 MPa，遠低於降伏。改成 t = 5 mm，撓度隨 1/t³ 增為約 1.5 mm，應力約 112 MPa：仍不會破，但裝在蓋上的光學元件會因抽氣而偏移 1.5 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The atmospheric load on a flat cover must be computed: a simply supported circular plate of 300 mm diameter carries Δp = 1 bar = 10⁵ Pa, 316L has E = 193 GPa and ν = 0.3, and the plate stiffness is D = E·t³/[12(1 − ν²)]. For t = 10 mm, D ≈ 1.77×10⁴ N·m, the centre deflection w ≈ 0.0637·p·r⁴/D = 0.0637×10⁵×(0.15)⁴/1.77×10⁴ ≈ 0.18 mm and the peak stress σ ≈ 1.24·p·(r/t)² ≈ 28 MPa, far below yield. At t = 5 mm the deflection grows as 1/t³ to about 1.5 mm and the stress to about 112 MPa: it still will not fail, but optics mounted on that cover shift by 1.5 mm every time the chamber is pumped.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing", which statement holds?

腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。
optionsEn: The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber.

steps.title: 材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material selection, welding and internal surface finishing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 核對材料證明（低碳牌號、真空燒結紀錄），每一道焊縫做染色滲透或射線檢查，並以氦氣檢漏逐條確認 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；抽氣時用千分錶量大法蘭與蓋板的撓度並與平板公式比較；用輪廓儀量內表面粗糙度 Ra，確認電解拋光達到規格；最後以壓升法量整腔出氣率，和材料與面積的預估值對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the material certificates (low-carbon grade, vacuum-firing record), inspect every weld by dye penetrant or radiography and helium-leak-check each seam to below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s; during pump-down measure the deflection of large flanges and covers with a dial indicator and compare with the plate formula; measure the internal roughness Ra with a profilometer to confirm the electropolish meets specification; finally measure the whole-chamber outgassing by rate of rise and compare with the estimate from material and area. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了外觀而從外側焊接、內側留下 0.1 mm 的縫，縫裡困住的空氣與清洗液成為虛漏並發生縫隙腐蝕：腔體停在 10⁻⁹ mbar，烘烤時壓力反而上升；氦檢漏對焊道噴氦有緩慢反應；後果是磨開焊道、重新清洗並從內側重焊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Welding from the outside for cosmetic reasons leaves a 0.1 mm crevice inside, and the air and cleaning fluid trapped in it become a virtual leak with crevice corrosion: the chamber stalls at 10⁻⁹ mbar, the pressure rises during bakeout, and helium sprayed on the seam gives a slow response; the consequence is grinding out the seam, re-cleaning and re-welding from the inside.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「316L 腔壁與內側焊道」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “316L chamber wall and inside weld seams” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了外觀而從外側焊接、內側留下 0.1 mm 的縫，縫裡困住的空氣與清洗液成為虛漏並發生縫隙腐蝕：腔體停在 10⁻⁹ mbar，烘烤時壓力反而上升；氦檢漏對焊道噴氦有緩慢反應；後果是磨開焊道、重新清洗並從內側重焊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Welding from the outside for cosmetic reasons leaves a 0.1 mm crevice inside, and the air and cleaning fluid trapped in it become a virtual leak with crevice corrosion: the chamber stalls at 10⁻⁹ mbar, the pressure rises during bakeout, and helium sprayed on the seam gives a slow response; the consequence is grinding out the seam, re-cleaning and re-welding from the inside. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：禁用材料包括鋅、鎘、黃銅、一般塑膠與潤滑油脂，彈性體只容許用於高真空區段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Forbidden materials include zinc, cadmium, brass, ordinary plastics and lubricants, with elastomers tolerated only in high-vacuum sections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料選擇、焊接與內表面處理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: ConFlat 金屬密封與可烘烤組件：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: ConFlat metal sealing and bakeable components: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CF 刀口與無氧銅墊片」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CF knife edge and OFHC copper gasket” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: CF 法蘭靠兩側不鏽鋼刀口咬入退火無氧銅墊片形成冷流金屬密封，外側的限位環阻止銅被擠出；螺栓以星形順序分段上緊，使刀口均勻壓入。銅與不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數相近（約 17×10⁻⁶/K），所以可以反覆烘烤到 450 °C 而不鬆脫；墊片塑性變形後只能用一次。螺栓鍍銀防止高溫咬死。視窗用玻璃對金屬（Kovar）封接、耐溫受限；饋通、陶瓷絕緣段與全金屬閥都要能同步烘烤。彈性體 O 環會出氣並讓氦滲透，只能用在高真空段，不能進入超高真空的邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CF 刀口與無氧銅墊片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A CF flange seals by two stainless knife edges biting into an annealed OFHC copper gasket to form a cold-flow metal seal, with an outer retaining ring that stops the copper extruding; bolts are tightened in stages in a star pattern so the knife edge sinks in evenly. Copper and stainless steel have similar expansion coefficients (about 17×10⁻⁶/K), so the joint survives repeated bakeouts to 450 °C without loosening, but the plastically deformed gasket is single-use. Bolts are silver-plated against galling at temperature. Viewports use glass-to-metal (Kovar) seals with limited bake temperature, and feedthroughs, ceramic breaks and all-metal valves must all bake together. Elastomer O-rings outgas and let helium permeate, so they belong only in high-vacuum sections and never on the ultrahigh-vacuum boundary. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CF knife edge and OFHC copper gasket”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：漏氣預算：腔體有 20 個 CF 法蘭，每個驗收漏率 ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s，總漏氣 ≤ 2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；以 S_eff = 172 L/s 計，漏氣貢獻的壓力只有 2×10⁻¹⁰/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar，比烘烤後的氫出氣小一個數量級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Leak budget: the chamber has 20 CF flanges each accepted at ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s, so the total leak is ≤ 2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s; with S_eff = 172 L/s the leak contribution to pressure is only 2×10⁻¹⁰/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar, an order of magnitude below post-bake hydrogen outgassing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CF 法蘭漏氣時，把螺栓鎖得更緊就能解決。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leaking CF flange is fixed by tightening the bolts harder." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CF 刀口與無氧銅墊片」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CF knife edge and OFHC copper gasket”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: ConFlat 金屬密封與可烘烤組件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: ConFlat metal sealing and bakeable components: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CF 刀口與無氧銅墊片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CF knife edge and OFHC copper gasket” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：漏氣預算：腔體有 20 個 CF 法蘭，每個驗收漏率 ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s，總漏氣 ≤ 2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；以 S_eff = 172 L/s 計，漏氣貢獻的壓力只有 2×10⁻¹⁰/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar，比烘烤後的氫出氣小一個數量級。若換上一個 Viton O 環密封的 ISO 法蘭，其出氣加滲透約 1×10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s（教學假設），單獨就貢獻 1×10⁻⁷/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，整個腔體的極限壓力被這一個環卡在 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Leak budget: the chamber has 20 CF flanges each accepted at ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s, so the total leak is ≤ 2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s; with S_eff = 172 L/s the leak contribution to pressure is only 2×10⁻¹⁰/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar, an order of magnitude below post-bake hydrogen outgassing. Replace one flange with a Viton O-ring ISO joint whose outgassing plus permeation is about 1×10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s (teaching assumption) and that single ring contributes 1×10⁻⁷/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, pinning the whole chamber's ultimate pressure in the 10⁻⁹ mbar range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個法蘭都以氦氣檢漏儀確認（偵測極限 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/s）；拆墊片時檢查壓痕，兩面都要有連續完整的環；核對螺栓扭力與星形順序紀錄；烘烤降溫後必須重新檢漏，因為熱循環會讓邊緣漏點打開；每個法蘭的漏率寫進腔體檔案，之後任何開啟都要更新。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm every flange with a helium leak detector (detection limit 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/s); when a gasket is removed inspect the imprint, which must be a continuous unbroken ring on both faces; check the recorded bolt torque and star sequence; leak-check again after bakeout and cooldown, because thermal cycling opens marginal leaks; write each flange's leak rate into the chamber logbook and update it whenever that flange is opened.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: ConFlat 金屬密封與可烘烤組件：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: ConFlat metal sealing and bakeable components: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CF 刀口與無氧銅墊片」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CF knife edge and OFHC copper gasket” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每個法蘭都以氦氣檢漏儀確認（偵測極限 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/s）；拆墊片時檢查壓痕，兩面都要有連續完整的環；核對螺栓扭力與星形順序紀錄；烘烤降溫後必須重新檢漏，因為熱循環會讓邊緣漏點打開；每個法蘭的漏率寫進腔體檔案，之後任何開啟都要更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm every flange with a helium leak detector (detection limit 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/s); when a gasket is removed inspect the imprint, which must be a continuous unbroken ring on both faces; check the recorded bolt torque and star sequence; leak-check again after bakeout and cooldown, because thermal cycling opens marginal leaks; write each flange's leak rate into the chamber logbook and update it whenever that flange is opened. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用螺絲起子撬墊片時在刀口上劃出一道徑向刮痕，此後該法蘭漏率 10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s，再怎麼鎖緊也無效：氦檢漏在那一圈有明確反應；後果是整個法蘭更換或重新車削刀口，若法蘭是焊在腔體上的，就得割下重焊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Prying a gasket out with a screwdriver scores a radial scratch across the knife edge, after which that flange leaks 10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s no matter how hard it is tightened: the helium leak detector responds clearly around that ring; the consequence is replacing the flange or re-machining the knife edge, and if the flange is welded to the chamber it must be cut off and re-welded.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」與「超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing" and "Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未烘烤系統的出氣以水氣為主，脫附率大約隨 1/t 緩慢下降；脫附時間常數遵循 τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT)，所以把壁面加熱到 150–250 °C 可以把需要數年的室溫脫附壓縮成一天。烘烤降溫後，剩下的主要氣源是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫，屬擴散控制、隨 1/√t 衰減，只能靠真空燒結或預先形成氧化層來進一步降低。烘烤時所有零件，包括真空計、閥門與視窗，都必須維持相近溫度，否則最冷處會重新吸附水氣；燈絲在烘烤末期除氣，並在持續抽氣下降溫。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Outgassing of an unbaked system is water-dominated and the desorption rate falls only slowly, roughly as 1/t; the desorption time constant follows τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT), so heating the walls to 150–250 °C compresses years of room-temperature desorption into a day. After cooldown the remaining source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel, a diffusion-limited process decaying as 1/√t that can only be reduced further by vacuum firing or a pre-formed oxide barrier. During bakeout every part, including gauges, valves and viewports, must sit at a similar temperature, otherwise the coldest spot re-adsorbs the water; filaments are degassed at the end of the bake and the system cools under continuous pumping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：阿瑞尼斯加速比：脫附率正比於 exp(−E_d/kT)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arrhenius acceleration: the desorption rate scales as exp(−E_d/kT).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「烘烤越熱越好，溫度只受加熱帶功率限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hotter bake is always better and only the heater power limits the temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為
knowledge.titleEn: Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing
knowledge.text: 未烘烤系統的出氣以水氣為主，脫附率大約隨 1/t 緩慢下降；脫附時間常數遵循 τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT)，所以把壁面加熱到 150–250 °C 可以把需要數年的室溫脫附壓縮成一天。烘烤降溫後，剩下的主要氣源是從不鏽鋼本體擴散出來的氫，屬擴散控制、隨 1/√t 衰減，只能靠真空燒結或預先形成氧化層來進一步降低。
knowledge.textEn: Outgassing of an unbaked system is water-dominated and the desorption rate falls only slowly, roughly as 1/t; the desorption time constant follows τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT), so heating the walls to 150–250 °C compresses years of room-temperature desorption into a day. After cooldown the remaining source is hydrogen diffusing out of the bulk stainless steel, a diffusion-limited process decaying as 1/√t that can only be reduced further by vacuum firing or a pre-formed oxide barrier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：烘烤越熱越好，溫度只受加熱帶功率限制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A hotter bake is always better and only the heater power limits the temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing" is correct?
options: 烘烤越熱越好，溫度只受加熱帶功率限制。
離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。
未烘烤系統的出氣以水氣為主，脫附率大約隨 1/t 緩慢下降。
optionsEn: A hotter bake is always better and only the heater power limits the temperature.
The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber.
Outgassing of an unbaked system is water-dominated and the desorption rate falls only slowly, roughly as 1/t.
quiz.explanation: 未烘烤系統的出氣以水氣為主，脫附率大約隨 1/t 緩慢下降；脫附時間常數遵循 τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT)，所以把壁面加熱到 150–250 °C 可以把需要數年的室溫脫附壓縮成一天。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Outgassing of an unbaked system is water-dominated and the desorption rate falls only slowly, roughly as 1/t; the desorption time constant follows τ = τ₀·exp(E_d/kT), so heating the walls to 150–250 °C compresses years of room-temperature desorption into a day. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阿瑞尼斯加速比：脫附率正比於 exp(−E_d/kT)。取水的 E_d = 0.9 eV，E_d/k = 0.9/8.617×10⁻⁵ ≈ 10,445 K；從 293 K 升到 423 K（150 °C），加速比 r = exp[10,445×(1/293 − 1/423)] = exp(10.96) ≈ 5.7×10⁴。在 150 °C 烘烤 24 小時，相當於室溫下抽氣 24×5.7×10⁴ ≈ 1.4×10⁶ 小時，約 160 年。烘烤後氫出氣 q ≈ 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²)，1 m² 腔體以 S_eff = 172 L/s 得 p ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar；若材料先經 950 °C 真空燒結使 q 降到 1×10⁻¹⁴，p ≈ 6×10⁻¹³ mbar。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arrhenius acceleration: the desorption rate scales as exp(−E_d/kT). Take E_d = 0.9 eV for water, so E_d/k = 0.9/8.617×10⁻⁵ ≈ 10,445 K; going from 293 K to 423 K (150 °C) gives r = exp[10,445×(1/293 − 1/423)] = exp(10.96) ≈ 5.7×10⁴. A 24-hour bake at 150 °C is thus equivalent to 24×5.7×10⁴ ≈ 1.4×10⁶ hours, about 160 years, of room-temperature pumping. Post-bake hydrogen outgassing q ≈ 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²) gives p ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar for the 1 m² chamber at S_eff = 172 L/s; if the material was vacuum-fired at 950 °C so that q drops to 1×10⁻¹⁴, p ≈ 6×10⁻¹³ mbar. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在最厚的法蘭、閥體、波紋管與視窗等最冷與最熱處貼熱電偶，要求全部高於設定溫度減 20 K；烘烤期間用殘氣分析儀追蹤 m/z 18 的水峰下降、m/z 2 的氫峰取而代之；降溫後記錄壓力曲線，最終殘氣譜應以氫為主、CO（m/z 28）與 CH₄（m/z 16）為次；把最終壓力與 p = q·A/S_eff 的預測比較，差距超過三倍就要找冷點或漏點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix thermocouples at the coldest and hottest locations, the thickest flanges, valve bodies, bellows and viewports, and require all of them above the setpoint minus 20 K; during the bake track the m/z 18 water peak falling and the m/z 2 hydrogen peak taking over on the residual-gas analyser; after cooldown log the pressure curve, and the final spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with CO (m/z 28) and CH₄ (m/z 16) secondary; compare the final pressure with the prediction p = q·A/S_eff, and a gap beyond a factor of three means a cold spot or a leak.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 阿瑞尼斯加速比：脫附率正比於 exp(−E_d/kT)。取水的 E_d = 0.9 eV，E_d/k = 0.9/8.617×10⁻⁵ ≈ 10,445 K；從 293 K 升到 423 K（150 °C），加速比 r = exp[10,445×(1/293 − 1/423)] = exp(10.96) ≈ 5.7×10⁴。在 150 °C 烘烤 24 小時，相當於室溫下抽氣 24×5.7×10⁴ ≈ 1.4×10⁶ 小時，約 160 年。烘烤後氫出氣 q ≈ 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²)，1 m² 腔體以 S_eff = 172 L/s 得 p ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar；若材料先經 950 °C 真空燒結使 q 降到 1×10⁻¹⁴，p ≈ 6×10⁻¹³ mbar。
knowledge.textEn: Arrhenius acceleration: the desorption rate scales as exp(−E_d/kT). Take E_d = 0.9 eV for water, so E_d/k = 0.9/8.617×10⁻⁵ ≈ 10,445 K; going from 293 K to 423 K (150 °C) gives r = exp[10,445×(1/293 − 1/423)] = exp(10.96) ≈ 5.7×10⁴. A 24-hour bake at 150 °C is thus equivalent to 24×5.7×10⁴ ≈ 1.4×10⁶ hours, about 160 years, of room-temperature pumping. Post-bake hydrogen outgassing q ≈ 2×10⁻¹³ mbar·L/(s·cm²) gives p ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar for the 1 m² chamber at S_eff = 172 L/s; if the material was vacuum-fired at 950 °C so that q drops to 1×10⁻¹⁴, p ≈ 6×10⁻¹³ mbar.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing", which statement holds?
options: 阿瑞尼斯加速比：脫附率正比於 exp(−E_d/kT)。
腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。
兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。
optionsEn: Arrhenius acceleration: the desorption rate scales as exp(−E_d/kT).
Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting.
The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two.
quiz.explanation: 阿瑞尼斯加速比：脫附率正比於 exp(−E_d/kT)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arrhenius acceleration: the desorption rate scales as exp(−E_d/kT). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在最厚的法蘭、閥體、波紋管與視窗等最冷與最熱處貼熱電偶，要求全部高於設定溫度減 20 K；烘烤期間用殘氣分析儀追蹤 m/z 18 的水峰下降、m/z 2 的氫峰取而代之；降溫後記錄壓力曲線，最終殘氣譜應以氫為主、CO（m/z 28）與 CH₄（m/z 16）為次；把最終壓力與 p = q·A/S_eff 的預測比較，差距超過三倍就要找冷點或漏點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix thermocouples at the coldest and hottest locations, the thickest flanges, valve bodies, bellows and viewports, and require all of them above the setpoint minus 20 K; during the bake track the m/z 18 water peak falling and the m/z 2 hydrogen peak taking over on the residual-gas analyser; after cooldown log the pressure curve, and the final spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with CO (m/z 28) and CH₄ (m/z 16) secondary; compare the final pressure with the prediction p = q·A/S_eff, and a gap beyond a factor of three means a cold spot or a leak. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一段沒有包覆加熱帶的波紋管在烘烤時只有 60 °C，成為冷點：整個腔體脫附出來的水在它上面重新凝結，烘烤結束後它再以數週的時間慢慢釋放；症狀是 m/z 18 在烘烤後仍然突出，壓力停在 10⁻⁹ 而非 10⁻¹¹ mbar。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A bellows left unwrapped sits at 60 °C during the bake and becomes a cold spot: water desorbed from the whole chamber recondenses on it and is then released slowly over weeks; the symptom is an m/z 18 peak still prominent after the bake and a pressure stuck at 10⁻⁹ rather than 10⁻¹¹ mbar.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在最厚的法蘭、閥體、波紋管與視窗等最冷與最熱處貼熱電偶，要求全部高於設定溫度減 20 K；烘烤期間用殘氣分析儀追蹤 m/z 18 的水峰下降、m/z 2 的氫峰取而代之；降溫後記錄壓力曲線，最終殘氣譜應以氫為主、CO（m/z 28）與 CH₄（m/z 16）為次；把最終壓力與 p = q·A/S_eff 的預測比較，差距超過三倍就要找冷點或漏點。
knowledge.textEn: Fix thermocouples at the coldest and hottest locations, the thickest flanges, valve bodies, bellows and viewports, and require all of them above the setpoint minus 20 K; during the bake track the m/z 18 water peak falling and the m/z 2 hydrogen peak taking over on the residual-gas analyser; after cooldown log the pressure curve, and the final spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with CO (m/z 28) and CH₄ (m/z 16) secondary; compare the final pressure with the prediction p = q·A/S_eff, and a gap beyond a factor of three means a cold spot or a leak.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在最厚的法蘭、閥體、波紋管與視窗等最冷與最熱處貼熱電偶，要求全部高於設定溫度減 20 K。
外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Fix thermocouples at the coldest and hottest locations, the thickest flanges, valve bodies, bellows and viewports, and require all of them above the setpoint minus 20 K.
Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally.
quiz.explanation: 在最厚的法蘭、閥體、波紋管與視窗等最冷與最熱處貼熱電偶，要求全部高於設定溫度減 20 K；烘烤期間用殘氣分析儀追蹤 m/z 18 的水峰下降、m/z 2 的氫峰取而代之；降溫後記錄壓力曲線，最終殘氣譜應以氫為主、CO（m/z 28）與 CH₄（m/z 16）為次；把最終壓力與 p = q·A/S_eff 的預測比較，差距超過三倍就要找冷點或漏點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix thermocouples at the coldest and hottest locations, the thickest flanges, valve bodies, bellows and viewports, and require all of them above the setpoint minus 20 K; during the bake track the m/z 18 water peak falling and the m/z 2 hydrogen peak taking over on the residual-gas analyser; after cooldown log the pressure curve, and the final spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with CO (m/z 28) and CH₄ (m/z 16) secondary; compare the final pressure with the prediction p = q·A/S_eff, and a gap beyond a factor of three means a cold spot or a leak. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「烘烤加熱帶與熱電偶」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bakeout heater tapes and thermocouples” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一段沒有包覆加熱帶的波紋管在烘烤時只有 60 °C，成為冷點：整個腔體脫附出來的水在它上面重新凝結，烘烤結束後它再以數週的時間慢慢釋放；症狀是 m/z 18 在烘烤後仍然突出，壓力停在 10⁻⁹ 而非 10⁻¹¹ mbar。另一種失效是視窗超過允許溫度，玻璃對金屬封接龜裂，降溫時才出現漏氣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A bellows left unwrapped sits at 60 °C during the bake and becomes a cold spot: water desorbed from the whole chamber recondenses on it and is then released slowly over weeks; the symptom is an m/z 18 peak still prominent after the bake and a pressure stuck at 10⁻⁹ rather than 10⁻¹¹ mbar. A second failure is a viewport driven past its rated temperature, cracking the glass-to-metal seal so that a leak appears only on cooldown. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：烘烤時所有零件，包括真空計、閥門與視窗，都必須維持相近溫度，否則最冷處會重新吸附水氣；燈絲在烘烤末期除氣，並在持續抽氣下降溫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During bakeout every part, including gauges, valves and viewports, must sit at a similar temperature, otherwise the coldest spot re-adsorbs the water; filaments are degassed at the end of the bake and the system cools under continuous pumping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「烘烤越熱越好，溫度只受加熱帶功率限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hotter bake is always better and only the heater power limits the temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一段沒有包覆加熱帶的波紋管在烘烤時只有 60 °C，成為冷點：整個腔體脫附出來的水在它上面重新凝結，烘烤結束後它再以數週的時間慢慢釋放；症狀是 m/z 18 在烘烤後仍然突出，壓力停在 10⁻⁹ 而非 10⁻¹¹ mbar。另一種失效是視窗超過允許溫度，玻璃對金屬封接龜裂，降溫時才出現漏氣。
knowledge.textEn: A bellows left unwrapped sits at 60 °C during the bake and becomes a cold spot: water desorbed from the whole chamber recondenses on it and is then released slowly over weeks; the symptom is an m/z 18 peak still prominent after the bake and a pressure stuck at 10⁻⁹ rather than 10⁻¹¹ mbar. A second failure is a viewport driven past its rated temperature, cracking the glass-to-metal seal so that a leak appears only on cooldown.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。
一段沒有包覆加熱帶的波紋管在烘烤時只有 60 °C，成為冷點：整個腔體脫附出來的水在它上面重新凝結，烘烤結束後它再以數週的時間慢慢釋放。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber.
A bellows left unwrapped sits at 60 °C during the bake and becomes a cold spot: water desorbed from the whole chamber recondenses on it and is then released slowly over weeks.
quiz.explanation: 一段沒有包覆加熱帶的波紋管在烘烤時只有 60 °C，成為冷點：整個腔體脫附出來的水在它上面重新凝結，烘烤結束後它再以數週的時間慢慢釋放；症狀是 m/z 18 在烘烤後仍然突出，壓力停在 10⁻⁹ 而非 10⁻¹¹ mbar。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A bellows left unwrapped sits at 60 °C during the bake and becomes a cold spot: water desorbed from the whole chamber recondenses on it and is then released slowly over weeks; the symptom is an m/z 18 peak still prominent after the bake and a pressure stuck at 10⁻⁹ rather than 10⁻¹¹ mbar. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 熱陰極 Bayard–Alpert 真空計以燈絲發射電子電流 I_e，電子在柵極內游離氣體，離子被細長的收集極捕獲，I⁺ = S·I_e·p，靈敏度 S 對氮約 10–25 mbar⁻¹。下限由 X 光極限決定：電子打在柵極產生軟 X 光，射到收集極釋出光電子，形成與離子電流無法區分的背景，裸式 BA 計約 10⁻¹¹ mbar，引出式（extractor）計可到 10⁻¹²。靈敏度隨氣體種類改變（相對氮：He 0.18、H₂ 0.46、Ar 1.3），顯示值是「氮當量」，必須用殘氣分析儀的成分來修正。真空計本身會出氣、也會以約 0.1 L/s 抽氣，而電子激發脫附的離子會偽裝成壓力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge emits an electron current I_e from the filament, the electrons ionise gas inside the grid and the ions are caught by a thin collector wire, giving I⁺ = S·I_e·p with a sensitivity S of about 10–25 mbar⁻¹ for nitrogen. The lower limit is the X-ray limit: electrons striking the grid produce soft X-rays that release photoelectrons from the collector, a background indistinguishable from ion current, about 10⁻¹¹ mbar for a nude BA gauge and 10⁻¹² for an extractor gauge. Sensitivity depends on the gas (relative to nitrogen: He 0.18, H₂ 0.46, Ar 1.3), so the display is a nitrogen equivalent that must be corrected with the composition from a residual-gas analyser. The gauge itself outgasses, pumps at about 0.1 L/s, and electron-stimulated desorption ions masquerade as pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：BA 計 S = 20 mbar⁻¹、I_e = 1 mA：在 p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA；X 光極限相當於 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar，即 0.2 pA 的固定背景。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A BA gauge with S = 20 mbar⁻¹ and I_e = 1 mA: at p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA; an X-ray limit equivalent to 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar is a fixed 0.2 pA background.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget" is correct?
options: 熱陰極 Bayard–Alpert 真空計以燈絲發射電子電流 I_e，電子在柵極內游離氣體，離子被細長的收集極捕獲，I⁺ = S·I_e·p，靈敏度 S 對氮約 10–25 mbar⁻¹。
離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。
離子泵的電流讀數永遠等於真實壓力。
optionsEn: A hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge emits an electron current I_e from the filament, the electrons ionise gas inside the grid and the ions are caught by a thin collector wire, giving I⁺ = S·I_e·p with a sensitivity S of about 10–25 mbar⁻¹ for nitrogen.
The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber.
The ion-pump current reading always equals the true pressure.
quiz.explanation: 熱陰極 Bayard–Alpert 真空計以燈絲發射電子電流 I_e，電子在柵極內游離氣體，離子被細長的收集極捕獲，I⁺ = S·I_e·p，靈敏度 S 對氮約 10–25 mbar⁻¹。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge emits an electron current I_e from the filament, the electrons ionise gas inside the grid and the ions are caught by a thin collector wire, giving I⁺ = S·I_e·p with a sensitivity S of about 10–25 mbar⁻¹ for nitrogen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：BA 計 S = 20 mbar⁻¹、I_e = 1 mA：在 p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA；X 光極限相當於 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar，即 0.2 pA 的固定背景。在真實壓力 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar 時離子電流與背景相等，顯示 2×10⁻¹¹，誤差 100%。氣體修正：烘烤後殘氣以氫為主，顯示 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar（氮當量）對應真實氫分壓 1×10⁻¹⁰/0.46 ≈ 2.2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar。不確定度預算：靈敏度 ±15%、氣體修正 ±10%、位置與傳導率 ±10%，均方根合成約 ±21%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A BA gauge with S = 20 mbar⁻¹ and I_e = 1 mA: at p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA; an X-ray limit equivalent to 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar is a fixed 0.2 pA background. At a true pressure of 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar the ion current equals that background, the display shows 2×10⁻¹¹ and the error is 100%. Gas correction: with hydrogen-dominated post-bake residual gas, a display of 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar (nitrogen equivalent) corresponds to a true hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻¹⁰/0.46 ≈ 2.2×10⁻¹⁰ mbar. Uncertainty budget: sensitivity ±15%, gas correction ±10%, location and conductance ±10%, root-sum-square about ±21%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子真空計或經校正的參考計核對 BA 計的靈敏度；用殘氣分析儀取得成分後套用氣體修正係數；把 BA 計與引出式真空計並排比較，兩者在 10⁻¹¹ mbar 以下分岔的位置就是 X 光極限；除氣後等待數小時再讀值，並把燈絲關閉再開啟觀察電子激發脫附的瞬態；最後把靈敏度、氣體修正與位置效應寫成不確定度預算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the BA gauge sensitivity against a spinning-rotor gauge or a calibrated reference gauge in their overlapping range; obtain the composition from the residual-gas analyser and apply the gas-correction factors; compare the BA gauge side by side with an extractor gauge, and the point below 10⁻¹¹ mbar where they diverge is the X-ray limit; after degassing wait several hours before reading, and switch the filament off and on to observe the electron-stimulated-desorption transient; finally write sensitivity, gas correction and location effects into an uncertainty budget table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget", which statement holds?
options: 只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。
BA 計 S = 20 mbar⁻¹、I_e = 1 mA：在 p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA。
外側焊接比較乾淨，所以超高真空腔體應該從外面焊。
optionsEn: A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing.
A BA gauge with S = 20 mbar⁻¹ and I_e = 1 mA: at p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA.
Welding from the outside is cleaner, so ultrahigh-vacuum chambers should be welded externally.
quiz.explanation: BA 計 S = 20 mbar⁻¹、I_e = 1 mA：在 p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA；X 光極限相當於 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar，即 0.2 pA 的固定背景。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A BA gauge with S = 20 mbar⁻¹ and I_e = 1 mA: at p = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, I⁺ = 20×10⁻³×10⁻¹⁰ = 2×10⁻¹² A = 2 pA; an X-ray limit equivalent to 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar is a fixed 0.2 pA background. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子真空計或經校正的參考計核對 BA 計的靈敏度；用殘氣分析儀取得成分後套用氣體修正係數；把 BA 計與引出式真空計並排比較，兩者在 10⁻¹¹ mbar 以下分岔的位置就是 X 光極限；除氣後等待數小時再讀值，並把燈絲關閉再開啟觀察電子激發脫附的瞬態；最後把靈敏度、氣體修正與位置效應寫成不確定度預算表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the BA gauge sensitivity against a spinning-rotor gauge or a calibrated reference gauge in their overlapping range; obtain the composition from the residual-gas analyser and apply the gas-correction factors; compare the BA gauge side by side with an extractor gauge, and the point below 10⁻¹¹ mbar where they diverge is the X-ray limit; after degassing wait several hours before reading, and switch the filament off and on to observe the electron-stimulated-desorption transient; finally write sensitivity, gas correction and location effects into an uncertainty budget table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：真空計裝在泵口旁邊一段細長管上，讀到的壓力比樣品區低五倍：紙面上達到 10⁻¹⁰ mbar，樣品卻在 10⁻⁹ mbar；以黏附係數 1 估算，10⁻⁹ mbar 時一層單分子層約 1000 秒就形成，10⁻¹¹ mbar 則要約一天，表面科學數據因此被錯誤詮釋。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A gauge mounted on a narrow stub next to the pump port reads five times lower than the sample region: 10⁻¹⁰ mbar on paper while the sample sits at 10⁻⁹ mbar; with a sticking coefficient of 1 a monolayer forms in about 1000 s at 10⁻⁹ mbar but takes about a day at 10⁻¹¹ mbar, so surface-science data are misinterpreted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子真空計或經校正的參考計核對 BA 計的靈敏度；用殘氣分析儀取得成分後套用氣體修正係數；把 BA 計與引出式真空計並排比較，兩者在 10⁻¹¹ mbar 以下分岔的位置就是 X 光極限；除氣後等待數小時再讀值，並把燈絲關閉再開啟觀察電子激發脫附的瞬態；最後把靈敏度、氣體修正與位置效應寫成不確定度預算表。
knowledge.textEn: Check the BA gauge sensitivity against a spinning-rotor gauge or a calibrated reference gauge in their overlapping range; obtain the composition from the residual-gas analyser and apply the gas-correction factors; compare the BA gauge side by side with an extractor gauge, and the point below 10⁻¹¹ mbar where they diverge is the X-ray limit; after degassing wait several hours before reading, and switch the filament off and on to observe the electron-stimulated-desorption transient; finally write sensitivity, gas correction and location effects into an uncertainty budget table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A leaking CF flange is fixed by tightening the bolts harder.

quiz.explanationEn: Check the BA gauge sensitivity against a spinning-rotor gauge or a calibrated reference gauge in their overlapping range; obtain the composition from the residual-gas analyser and apply the gas-correction factors; compare the BA gauge side by side with an extractor gauge, and the point below 10⁻¹¹ mbar where they diverge is the X-ray limit; after degassing wait several hours before reading, and switch the filament off and on to observe the electron-stimulated-desorption transient; finally write sensitivity, gas correction and location effects into an uncertainty budget table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Bayard–Alpert 離子真空計與 RGA」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bayard–Alpert ion gauge and RGA” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 真空計裝在泵口旁邊一段細長管上，讀到的壓力比樣品區低五倍：紙面上達到 10⁻¹⁰ mbar，樣品卻在 10⁻⁹ mbar；以黏附係數 1 估算，10⁻⁹ mbar 時一層單分子層約 1000 秒就形成，10⁻¹¹ mbar 則要約一天，表面科學數據因此被錯誤詮釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A gauge mounted on a narrow stub next to the pump port reads five times lower than the sample region: 10⁻¹⁰ mbar on paper while the sample sits at 10⁻⁹ mbar; with a sticking coefficient of 1 a monolayer forms in about 1000 s at 10⁻⁹ mbar but takes about a day at 10⁻¹¹ mbar, so surface-science data are misinterpreted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：真空計本身會出氣、也會以約 0.1 L/s 抽氣，而電子激發脫附的離子會偽裝成壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gauge itself outgasses, pumps at about 0.1 L/s, and electron-stimulated desorption ions masquerade as pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子真空計顯示的數字就是腔內的絕對總壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The number on the ion gauge is the absolute total pressure in the chamber." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 真空計裝在泵口旁邊一段細長管上，讀到的壓力比樣品區低五倍：紙面上達到 10⁻¹⁰ mbar，樣品卻在 10⁻⁹ mbar；以黏附係數 1 估算，10⁻⁹ mbar 時一層單分子層約 1000 秒就形成，10⁻¹¹ mbar 則要約一天，表面科學數據因此被錯誤詮釋。
knowledge.textEn: A gauge mounted on a narrow stub next to the pump port reads five times lower than the sample region: 10⁻¹⁰ mbar on paper while the sample sits at 10⁻⁹ mbar; with a sticking coefficient of 1 a monolayer forms in about 1000 s at 10⁻⁹ mbar but takes about a day at 10⁻¹¹ mbar, so surface-science data are misinterpreted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超高真空泵組合與長期維持」與「從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance" and "From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超高真空泵組合與長期維持：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ion pump, TSP and NEG” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超高真空靠泵的組合而非單一泵：渦輪泵加乾式前級泵負責粗抽與烘烤期間的大氣體負載；濺射離子泵沒有活動件，靠游離與掩埋抽所有氣體，包括惰性氣體，對氫的抽速高；鈦昇華泵對活性氣體有極大抽速，但對甲烷與惰性氣體無效；非蒸發吸氣劑（NEG）是鋯釩鈦合金，在 180–450 °C 活化後把氫與活性氣體吸入本體，CERN 發展的 NEG 薄膜鍍層更把腔壁本身變成一個低出氣的泵。烘烤完成後通常把渦輪泵用全金屬閥隔離，消除振動與油氣回流風險；此後殘氣以氫與甲烷為主，而甲烷只有離子泵能抽。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ultrahigh vacuum rests on a combination of pumps rather than one: a turbopump with a dry backing pump handles roughing and the heavy gas load during bakeout; a sputter-ion pump has no moving parts, pumps every gas including noble gases by ionisation and burial, and pumps hydrogen fast; a titanium sublimation pump offers enormous speed for active gases but none for methane or noble gases; a non-evaporable getter (NEG) of zirconium–vanadium–titanium alloy, activated at 180–450 °C, absorbs hydrogen and active gases into its bulk, and the NEG thin-film coating developed at CERN turns the chamber wall itself into a low-outgassing pump. After the bake the turbopump is usually isolated behind an all-metal valve to remove vibration and backstreaming risk; the residual gas is then hydrogen and methane, and only the ion pump removes methane. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion pump, TSP and NEG”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：並聯泵的抽速相加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Parallel pumps add their speeds.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子泵的電流讀數永遠等於真實壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ion-pump current reading always equals the true pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ion pump, TSP and NEG”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：離子泵的電流讀數永遠等於真實壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「超高真空泵組合與長期維持」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance" is correct?
