The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超高真空泵組合與長期維持：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ion pump, TSP and NEG” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：並聯泵的抽速相加。烘烤後的氫負載 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s（1 m² 腔體）。只用離子泵，對氫抽速約為氮標稱 150 L/s 的 1.7 倍 ≈ 250 L/s：p = 2×10⁻⁹/250 = 8×10⁻¹² mbar。加上經埠口傳導率限制後有效 500 L/s 的鈦昇華泵與 400 L/s 的 NEG 匣：S_total ≈ 250 + 500 + 400 = 1150 L/s，p ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹² mbar。NEG 對 CO 的容量取 0.2 mbar·L（教學假設），在 Q_CO = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s 下可用 2×10⁹ s ≈ 63 年，所以實務上只有每次破真空後才需要重新活化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Parallel pumps add their speeds. Post-bake hydrogen load Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s for the 1 m² chamber. With the ion pump alone, whose hydrogen speed is about 1.7 times its nitrogen rating of 150 L/s, roughly 250 L/s: p = 2×10⁻⁹/250 = 8×10⁻¹² mbar. Adding a titanium sublimation pump with 500 L/s effective after port conductance and a 400 L/s NEG cartridge: S_total ≈ 250 + 500 + 400 = 1150 L/s and p ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹² mbar. Taking a NEG capacity for CO of 0.2 mbar·L (teaching assumption), at Q_CO = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s it lasts 2×10⁹ s ≈ 63 years, so in practice reactivation is needed only after each venting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：隔離渦輪泵後記錄 48 小時壓力，應持平或下降；殘氣譜以氫為主、甲烷與 CO 為次；把離子泵電流（正比於壓力）與真空計讀值對照；逐一短暫關閉某個泵，壓力階躍 Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total 就是該泵在總抽速中的份額，與預算表比對；NEG 活化後確認氫分壓下降的幅度與匣的標稱抽速一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After isolating the turbopump log the pressure for 48 hours, which should hold or fall; the residual spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with methane and CO secondary; compare the ion-pump current, proportional to pressure, with the gauge reading; switch each pump off briefly in turn, and the pressure step Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total is that pump's share of the total speed, to be compared with the budget; after NEG activation confirm that the drop in hydrogen partial pressure matches the cartridge's rated speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 並聯泵的抽速相加。烘烤後的氫負載 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s（1 m² 腔體）。只用離子泵，對氫抽速約為氮標稱 150 L/s 的 1.7 倍 ≈ 250 L/s：p = 2×10⁻⁹/250 = 8×10⁻¹² mbar。加上經埠口傳導率限制後有效 500 L/s 的鈦昇華泵與 400 L/s 的 NEG 匣：S_total ≈ 250 + 500 + 400 = 1150 L/s，p ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹² mbar。NEG 對 CO 的容量取 0.2 mbar·L（教學假設），在 Q_CO = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s 下可用 2×10⁹ s ≈ 63 年，所以實務上只有每次破真空後才需要重新活化。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel pumps add their speeds. Post-bake hydrogen load Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s for the 1 m² chamber. With the ion pump alone, whose hydrogen speed is about 1.7 times its nitrogen rating of 150 L/s, roughly 250 L/s: p = 2×10⁻⁹/250 = 8×10⁻¹² mbar. Adding a titanium sublimation pump with 500 L/s effective after port conductance and a 400 L/s NEG cartridge: S_total ≈ 250 + 500 + 400 = 1150 L/s and p ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹² mbar. Taking a NEG capacity for CO of 0.2 mbar·L (teaching assumption), at Q_CO = 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s it lasts 2×10⁹ s ≈ 63 years, so in practice reactivation is needed only after each venting.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超高真空泵組合與長期維持」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 兩段管子串聯的傳導率等於兩者相加。
CF 法蘭漏氣時，把螺栓鎖得更緊就能解決。
並聯泵的抽速相加。
optionsEn: The conductance of two tubes in series is the sum of the two.
A leaking CF flange is fixed by tightening the bolts harder.
Parallel pumps add their speeds.
quiz.explanation: 並聯泵的抽速相加。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel pumps add their speeds. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超高真空泵組合與長期維持：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ion pump, TSP and NEG” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 隔離渦輪泵後記錄 48 小時壓力，應持平或下降；殘氣譜以氫為主、甲烷與 CO 為次；把離子泵電流（正比於壓力）與真空計讀值對照；逐一短暫關閉某個泵，壓力階躍 Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total 就是該泵在總抽速中的份額，與預算表比對；NEG 活化後確認氫分壓下降的幅度與匣的標稱抽速一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After isolating the turbopump log the pressure for 48 hours, which should hold or fall; the residual spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with methane and CO secondary; compare the ion-pump current, proportional to pressure, with the gauge reading; switch each pump off briefly in turn, and the pressure step Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total is that pump's share of the total speed, to be compared with the budget; after NEG activation confirm that the drop in hydrogen partial pressure matches the cartridge's rated speed. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：二極式離子泵在用含氬氣體破真空後出現氬不穩定：被掩埋的氬週期性釋出，壓力每隔數分鐘突波一次；另一種是鈦昇華泵剝落的鈦片造成高壓短路，或 NEG 在破真空後飽和未再活化，腔體卡在 10⁻⁹ mbar 而殘氣以氫為主。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A diode ion pump vented with an argon-rich gas develops argon instability: buried argon is released periodically and the pressure bursts every few minutes; other cases are a flake of titanium from the sublimation pump shorting the high voltage, or a NEG saturated by a vent and never reactivated, leaving the chamber stuck at 10⁻⁹ mbar with hydrogen as the main residual gas.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 隔離渦輪泵後記錄 48 小時壓力，應持平或下降；殘氣譜以氫為主、甲烷與 CO 為次；把離子泵電流（正比於壓力）與真空計讀值對照；逐一短暫關閉某個泵，壓力階躍 Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total 就是該泵在總抽速中的份額，與預算表比對；NEG 活化後確認氫分壓下降的幅度與匣的標稱抽速一致。
knowledge.textEn: After isolating the turbopump log the pressure for 48 hours, which should hold or fall; the residual spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with methane and CO secondary; compare the ion-pump current, proportional to pressure, with the gauge reading; switch each pump off briefly in turn, and the pressure step Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total is that pump's share of the total speed, to be compared with the budget; after NEG activation confirm that the drop in hydrogen partial pressure matches the cartridge's rated speed.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高真空泵組合與長期維持」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance"?
options: 隔離渦輪泵後記錄 48 小時壓力，應持平或下降。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
烘烤越熱越好，溫度只受加熱帶功率限制。
optionsEn: After isolating the turbopump log the pressure for 48 hours, which should hold or fall.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A hotter bake is always better and only the heater power limits the temperature.
quiz.explanation: 隔離渦輪泵後記錄 48 小時壓力，應持平或下降；殘氣譜以氫為主、甲烷與 CO 為次；把離子泵電流（正比於壓力）與真空計讀值對照；逐一短暫關閉某個泵，壓力階躍 Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total 就是該泵在總抽速中的份額，與預算表比對；NEG 活化後確認氫分壓下降的幅度與匣的標稱抽速一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After isolating the turbopump log the pressure for 48 hours, which should hold or fall; the residual spectrum should be hydrogen-dominated with methane and CO secondary; compare the ion-pump current, proportional to pressure, with the gauge reading; switch each pump off briefly in turn, and the pressure step Δp/p ≈ S_i/S_total is that pump's share of the total speed, to be compared with the budget; after NEG activation confirm that the drop in hydrogen partial pressure matches the cartridge's rated speed. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超高真空泵組合與長期維持：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離子泵、TSP 與 NEG」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ion pump, TSP and NEG” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 二極式離子泵在用含氬氣體破真空後出現氬不穩定：被掩埋的氬週期性釋出，壓力每隔數分鐘突波一次；另一種是鈦昇華泵剝落的鈦片造成高壓短路，或 NEG 在破真空後飽和未再活化，腔體卡在 10⁻⁹ mbar 而殘氣以氫為主。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A diode ion pump vented with an argon-rich gas develops argon instability: buried argon is released periodically and the pressure bursts every few minutes; other cases are a flake of titanium from the sublimation pump shorting the high voltage, or a NEG saturated by a vent and never reactivated, leaving the chamber stuck at 10⁻⁹ mbar with hydrogen as the main residual gas. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：烘烤完成後通常把渦輪泵用全金屬閥隔離，消除振動與油氣回流風險；此後殘氣以氫與甲烷為主，而甲烷只有離子泵能抽。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After the bake the turbopump is usually isolated behind an all-metal valve to remove vibration and backstreaming risk; the residual gas is then hydrogen and methane, and only the ion pump removes methane.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子泵的電流讀數永遠等於真實壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The ion-pump current reading always equals the true pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 二極式離子泵在用含氬氣體破真空後出現氬不穩定：被掩埋的氬週期性釋出，壓力每隔數分鐘突波一次；另一種是鈦昇華泵剝落的鈦片造成高壓短路，或 NEG 在破真空後飽和未再活化，腔體卡在 10⁻⁹ mbar 而殘氣以氫為主。
knowledge.textEn: A diode ion pump vented with an argon-rich gas develops argon instability: buried argon is released periodically and the pressure bursts every few minutes; other cases are a flake of titanium from the sublimation pump shorting the high voltage, or a NEG saturated by a vent and never reactivated, leaving the chamber stuck at 10⁻⁹ mbar with hydrogen as the main residual gas.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超高真空泵組合與長期維持」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultrahigh-vacuum pump combinations and long-term maintenance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
二極式離子泵在用含氬氣體破真空後出現氬不穩定：被掩埋的氬週期性釋出，壓力每隔數分鐘突波一次。
腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A diode ion pump vented with an argon-rich gas develops argon instability: buried argon is released periodically and the pressure bursts every few minutes.
Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting.
quiz.explanation: 二極式離子泵在用含氬氣體破真空後出現氬不穩定：被掩埋的氬週期性釋出，壓力每隔數分鐘突波一次；另一種是鈦昇華泵剝落的鈦片造成高壓短路，或 NEG 在破真空後飽和未再活化，腔體卡在 10⁻⁹ mbar 而殘氣以氫為主。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A diode ion pump vented with an argon-rich gas develops argon instability: buried argon is released periodically and the pressure bursts every few minutes; other cases are a flake of titanium from the sublimation pump shorting the high voltage, or a NEG saturated by a vent and never reactivated, leaving the chamber stuck at 10⁻⁹ mbar with hydrogen as the main residual gas. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」如何決定超高真空腔體建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance record and chamber logbook” determines the key performance of “Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收是一組可重複的量測而非一次讀數：整腔氦漏率在烘烤與熱循環後 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；在規定烘烤條件下（例如 150 °C、48 小時，再抽氣降溫 24 小時）用校正真空計加成分修正量得極限壓力 ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar；壓升法出氣率低於目標；埠口軸線在抽氣狀態下的位置與角度公差（例如 ±0.1 mm、±0.1°），因為大氣撓度會移動它們。交接文件包含材料證明、焊道圖、檢漏紀錄、烘烤紀錄、殘氣譜、真空計校正證書與埠口配置圖；破真空必須用乾燥氮氣、時間最短、並維持正壓，之後依排程重新烘烤；使用者要受訓：手套、專用工具、不留指紋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is a repeatable set of measurements, not one reading: whole-chamber helium leak rate below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s after bake and thermal cycle; ultimate pressure ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar under a specified bake (for example 150 °C for 48 hours, then 24 hours of pumped cooldown) measured with a calibrated gauge and composition correction; rate-of-rise outgassing below target; and port-axis position and angle tolerances under vacuum (for example ±0.1 mm and ±0.1°), because atmospheric deflection moves them. The handoff package contains material certificates, weld map, leak-check log, bake log, residual-gas spectra, gauge calibration certificates and the port map; venting must use dry nitrogen, as briefly as possible and under positive pressure, followed by a scheduled re-bake; users are trained in gloves, dedicated tools and no fingerprints. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance record and chamber logbook”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：抽氣時間模型：粗抽段為黏滯流，V = 100 L 以 S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s 的乾式泵從 1000 mbar 抽到 0.1 mbar，t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pump-down time model: roughing is viscous flow, and a dry pump of S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s takes V = 100 L from 1000 mbar to 0.1 mbar in t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance record and chamber logbook”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接
knowledge.titleEn: From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff
knowledge.text: 驗收是一組可重複的量測而非一次讀數：整腔氦漏率在烘烤與熱循環後 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；在規定烘烤條件下（例如 150 °C、48 小時，再抽氣降溫 24 小時）用校正真空計加成分修正量得極限壓力 ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar；壓升法出氣率低於目標；埠口軸線在抽氣狀態下的位置與角度公差（例如 ±0.1 mm、±0.1°），因為大氣撓度會移動它們。交接文件包含材料證明、焊道圖、檢漏紀錄、烘烤紀錄、殘氣譜、真空計校正證書與埠口配置圖；破真空必須用乾燥氮氣、時間最短、並維持正壓，之後依排程重新烘烤；使用者要受訓：手套、專用工具、不留指紋。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance is a repeatable set of measurements, not one reading: whole-chamber helium leak rate below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s after bake and thermal cycle; ultimate pressure ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar under a specified bake (for example 150 °C for 48 hours, then 24 hours of pumped cooldown) measured with a calibrated gauge and composition correction; rate-of-rise outgassing below target; and port-axis position and angle tolerances under vacuum (for example ±0.1 mm and ±0.1°), because atmospheric deflection moves them. The handoff package contains material certificates, weld map, leak-check log, bake log, residual-gas spectra, gauge calibration certificates and the port map; venting must use dry nitrogen, as briefly as possible and under positive pressure, followed by a scheduled re-bake; users are trained in gloves, dedicated tools and no fingerprints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff" is correct?
options: 腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。
只要泵夠大，任何腔體都能抽到超高真空，不必管出氣。
驗收是一組可重複的量測而非一次讀數：整腔氦漏率在烘烤與熱循環後 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s。
optionsEn: Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting.
A big enough pump reaches ultrahigh vacuum in any chamber, whatever its outgassing.
Acceptance is a repeatable set of measurements, not one reading: whole-chamber helium leak rate below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s after bake and thermal cycle.
quiz.explanation: 驗收是一組可重複的量測而非一次讀數：整腔氦漏率在烘烤與熱循環後 < 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s；在規定烘烤條件下（例如 150 °C、48 小時，再抽氣降溫 24 小時）用校正真空計加成分修正量得極限壓力 ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar；壓升法出氣率低於目標；埠口軸線在抽氣狀態下的位置與角度公差（例如 ±0.1 mm、±0.1°），因為大氣撓度會移動它們。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance is a repeatable set of measurements, not one reading: whole-chamber helium leak rate below 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s after bake and thermal cycle; ultimate pressure ≤ 5×10⁻¹¹ mbar under a specified bake (for example 150 °C for 48 hours, then 24 hours of pumped cooldown) measured with a calibrated gauge and composition correction; rate-of-rise outgassing below target; and port-axis position and angle tolerances under vacuum (for example ±0.1 mm and ±0.1°), because atmospheric deflection moves them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance record and chamber logbook” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：抽氣時間模型：粗抽段為黏滯流，V = 100 L 以 S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s 的乾式泵從 1000 mbar 抽到 0.1 mbar，t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min。高真空段由水氣出氣主導，q(t) ≈ q₁ₕ/t（t 以小時計），取 q₁ₕ = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/(s·cm²)、A = 10⁴ cm²、S_eff = 172 L/s：p(1 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁷、p(10 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸、p(100 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁹ mbar，抽四天也進不了超高真空；只有烘烤能把它推到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，這就是驗收必須規定烘烤條件的原因。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pump-down time model: roughing is viscous flow, and a dry pump of S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s takes V = 100 L from 1000 mbar to 0.1 mbar in t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min. The high-vacuum phase is governed by water outgassing q(t) ≈ q₁ₕ/t (t in hours); with q₁ₕ = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/(s·cm²), A = 10⁴ cm² and S_eff = 172 L/s: p(1 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁷, p(10 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸, p(100 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁹ mbar, so four days of pumping never reaches ultrahigh vacuum; only a bake pushes it to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, which is why acceptance must specify the bake conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依序執行驗收程序：氦檢漏、抽氣曲線與模型比對、依規定烘烤、極限壓力與殘氣成分、壓升法、熱循環、最終檢漏；每一項與驗收紀錄的限值逐欄比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the acceptance sequence in order: helium leak check, pump-down curve against the model, bake to specification, ultimate pressure with residual-gas composition, rate of rise, thermal cycle and final leak check, comparing each with the limits in the acceptance record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 抽氣時間模型：粗抽段為黏滯流，V = 100 L 以 S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s 的乾式泵從 1000 mbar 抽到 0.1 mbar，t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min。高真空段由水氣出氣主導，q(t) ≈ q₁ₕ/t（t 以小時計），取 q₁ₕ = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/(s·cm²)、A = 10⁴ cm²、S_eff = 172 L/s：p(1 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁷、p(10 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸、p(100 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁹ mbar，抽四天也進不了超高真空；只有烘烤能把它推到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，這就是驗收必須規定烘烤條件的原因。

The high-vacuum phase is governed by water outgassing q(t) ≈ q₁ₕ/t (t in hours); with q₁ₕ = 1×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/(s·cm²), A = 10⁴ cm² and S_eff = 172 L/s: p(1 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁷, p(10 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸, p(100 h) ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁹ mbar, so four days of pumping never reaches ultrahigh vacuum; only a bake pushes it to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, which is why acceptance must specify the bake conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 抽氣時間模型：粗抽段為黏滯流，V = 100 L 以 S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s 的乾式泵從 1000 mbar 抽到 0.1 mbar，t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min。

quiz.explanationEn: Pump-down time model: roughing is viscous flow, and a dry pump of S = 5 m³/h ≈ 1.39 L/s takes V = 100 L from 1000 mbar to 0.1 mbar in t = (V/S)·ln(p₀/p₁) = 72×ln(10⁴) ≈ 72×9.21 ≈ 663 s ≈ 11 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance record and chamber logbook” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依序執行驗收程序：氦檢漏、抽氣曲線與模型比對、依規定烘烤、極限壓力與殘氣成分、壓升法、熱循環、最終檢漏；每一項與驗收紀錄的限值逐欄比對。埠口位置用抽氣狀態下的光學準直或座標量測確認；交付腔體檔案並由接手的工程師簽署，之後每次開腔、換墊片、烘烤都要追加紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the acceptance sequence in order: helium leak check, pump-down curve against the model, bake to specification, ultimate pressure with residual-gas composition, rate of rise, thermal cycle and final leak check, comparing each with the limits in the acceptance record. Confirm port positions under vacuum by optical alignment or coordinate measurement; deliver the chamber logbook with the receiving engineer's signature, and append a record for every later opening, gasket change and bake. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收時沒烘烤、在 5×10⁻⁹ mbar 就簽收，半年後實驗需要 10⁻¹¹ mbar，才發現腔上有一個 Viton 密封閥與一個不可烘烤的饋通，不重建就做不到；另一種是驗收後用室內空氣破真空，壁面重新吸附水氣，重新烘烤多花數天。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Signing off unbaked at 5×10⁻⁹ mbar, then six months later needing 10⁻¹¹ mbar, reveals a Viton-sealed valve and a non-bakeable feedthrough on the chamber that make the target unreachable without rebuilding; another case is venting with room air after acceptance, so the walls re-adsorb water and the re-bake costs days.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收紀錄與腔體檔案」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance record and chamber logbook” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 驗收時沒烘烤、在 5×10⁻⁹ mbar 就簽收，半年後實驗需要 10⁻¹¹ mbar，才發現腔上有一個 Viton 密封閥與一個不可烘烤的饋通，不重建就做不到；另一種是驗收後用室內空氣破真空，壁面重新吸附水氣，重新烘烤多花數天。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件包含材料證明、焊道圖、檢漏紀錄、烘烤紀錄、殘氣譜、真空計校正證書與埠口配置圖；破真空必須用乾燥氮氣、時間最短、並維持正壓，之後依排程重新烘烤；使用者要受訓：手套、專用工具、不留指紋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package contains material certificates, weld map, leak-check log, bake log, residual-gas spectra, gauge calibration certificates and the port map; venting must use dry nitrogen, as briefly as possible and under positive pressure, followed by a scheduled re-bake; users are trained in gloves, dedicated tools and no fingerprints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體到過一次超高真空之後，任何破真空後都能很快回到同樣壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a chamber has reached ultrahigh vacuum it returns to the same pressure quickly after any venting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
summary: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。
summaryEn: Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 泵站選型練習：一台 50 L 的分析腔（例如飛行時間質譜儀）有樣品進氣負載 Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s，另加出氣 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s，目標工作壓力 1×10⁻⁶ mbar。所需有效抽速 S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s。泵接在 DN100、20 cm 的管上，C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s，所需泵抽速 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835，S_pump ≈ 120 L/s；選一台 260 L/s 的 DN100 泵留餘裕：S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s，工作壓力 p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar，達標且有近兩倍餘裕。前級：流量 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s 在 1×10⁻² mbar 的前級壓力下只需 0.01 L/s 的前級抽速，小型隔膜泵綽綽有餘；氫回流 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 可忽略。真空計：Pirani 在 10⁻³ mbar 切換到 BA 計，BA 計靈敏度 20 mbar⁻¹、發射 1 mA，在 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar 的離子電流為 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA，遠高於 X 光極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Pump-station sizing exercise: a 50 L analytical chamber (for example a time-of-flight mass spectrometer) has a sample-inlet load Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s plus 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s of outgassing and a target working pressure of 1×10⁻⁶ mbar. The required effective speed is S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s. With the pump on a DN100 tube 20 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s, the required pump speed follows from 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835, S_pump ≈ 120 L/s; choosing a 260 L/s DN100 pump for margin gives S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s and a working pressure p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar, meeting the target with nearly a factor of two in hand. Backing: a throughput of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s at a foreline pressure of 1×10⁻² mbar needs only 0.01 L/s of backing speed, so a small diaphragm pump is ample, and the hydrogen backflow 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar is negligible. Gauges: the Pirani hands over to the BA gauge at 10⁻³ mbar, and with a sensitivity of 20 mbar⁻¹ and 1 mA emission the ion current at 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar is 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA, far above the X-ray limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」與「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" and "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor blades and gas molecules” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。因為 c̄ 隨 1/√M 增加，氫分子比氮快 3.7 倍，同一組葉片對氫的「追得上」程度差很多，壓縮比隨 √M 呈指數變化。入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. Because c̄ grows as 1/√M, hydrogen moves 3.7 times faster than nitrogen, the blades keep up with it far less well, and the compression ratio therefore varies exponentially with √M. The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotor blades and gas molecules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Rotor blades and gas molecules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" is correct?
options: 渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。
在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度。
前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
optionsEn: A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.
In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added.
As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
quiz.explanation: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor blades and gas molecules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。氮在 293 K 的 c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s，兩者相當；氫的 c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s，v/c̄ 只有 0.27。壓縮比寫成 K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M)：若純渦輪級對氮 K₀ = 10⁸，則 a·√28 = 18.4，a ≈ 3.48，對氫 K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140（教學估算；實際混合泵靠 Holweck 段把氫壓縮比拉到 10³–10⁵）。入口抽速上限 S ≈ 11.6·A·α，DN100 入口 A ≈ 78.5 cm²，捕獲機率 α ≈ 0.3，S ≈ 273 L/s，與 DN100 泵約 260 L/s 的標稱值相符。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Nitrogen at 293 K has c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s, a match; hydrogen has c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s, so v/c̄ is only 0.27. Writing K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M): if pure turbo stages give K₀ = 10⁸ for nitrogen then a·√28 = 18.4, a ≈ 3.48 and K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140 for hydrogen (teaching estimate; real hybrid pumps use Holweck stages to lift hydrogen compression to 10³–10⁵). The inlet speed limit S ≈ 11.6·A·α with A ≈ 78.5 cm² for DN100 and capture probability α ≈ 0.3 gives S ≈ 273 L/s, consistent with the roughly 260 L/s nameplate of a DN100 pump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「轉子葉片與氣體分子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Rotor blades and gas molecules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。把量到的 K₀(N₂)、K₀(He)、K₀(H₂) 對 √M 作半對數圖，應近似一條直線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前級管路與 Holweck 段」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foreline and Holweck stage” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。零流量壓縮比 K₀ 決定每種氣體從前級回流到入口的分壓，入口極限壓力是各氣體 p_fore,i/K₀,i 的總和再加上出氣量除以抽速；重氣體的 K₀ 高達 10¹¹，前級成分只對氫與氦重要。高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing. The zero-flow compression ratio K₀ sets the partial pressure of each gas that leaks back from foreline to inlet, and the inlet ultimate pressure is the sum of p_fore,i/K₀,i over the gases plus outgassing divided by pumping speed; for heavy gases K₀ reaches 10¹¹, so the foreline composition matters only for hydrogen and helium. At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Foreline and Holweck stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Foreline and Holweck stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力
knowledge.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure
knowledge.text: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。
knowledge.textEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure" is correct?
options: 前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。
渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。
optionsEn: As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.
Turbo stages work only in molecular flow.
quiz.explanation: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foreline and Holweck stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Foreline total 5×10⁻² mbar from a scroll pump, with a hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar (teaching assumption). Nitrogen: 5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar, negligible. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。
knowledge.textEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Foreline total 5×10⁻² mbar from a scroll pump, with a hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar (teaching assumption). Nitrogen: 5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar, negligible. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure", which statement holds?
options: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。
新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。
渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。
optionsEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S.
A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute.
Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure.
quiz.explanation: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前級管路與 Holweck 段」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Foreline and Holweck stage” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。
knowledge.textEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次。
磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen.
A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.
quiz.explanation: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Foreline and Holweck stage” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉子材料、動平衡與軸承」與「三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotor materials, balancing and bearings" and "Three gauge physics and range coverage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Rotor materials, balancing and bearings: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鋁合金轉子與軸承」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉子由單塊高強度鋁合金整體切削，葉尖速度 300–500 m/s 使離心應力逼近材料極限，所以轉子溫度上限（約 90–120 °C）是為了控制鋁合金的潛變而設。轉子必須做到極高等級的動平衡，否則不平衡力隨 ω² 放大成振動與軸承負載。軸承有兩種：混合軸承在前級側用陶瓷球加鋼製滾道、終身潤滑油脂，在高真空側用永磁軸承；五軸主動磁浮則完全沒有潤滑劑與微粒、振動更低，但需要備用的機械落地軸承承受斷電或撞機。葉片的製造公差、表面處理與入口防護網都屬於轉子工程的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The rotor is machined from a single block of high-strength aluminium alloy, and tip speeds of 300–500 m/s push the centrifugal stress toward the material limit, which is why the rotor temperature ceiling of about 90–120 °C exists: it bounds the creep of the alloy. The rotor must be balanced to an extremely fine grade, because any residual unbalance is amplified by ω² into vibration and bearing load. Two bearing systems are used: hybrid bearings with ceramic balls on steel races and lifetime grease on the foreline side plus a permanent-magnet bearing on the high-vacuum side, or five-axis active magnetic levitation with no lubricant and no particles and lower vibration, which needs backup touchdown bearings for power loss or a crash. Blade machining tolerances, surface treatment and the inlet protection screen are all part of rotor engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：實心圓盤的最大離心應力 σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip²（ν = 0.3）：鋁合金 ρ = 2700 kg/m³、v_tip = 471 m/s，σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa，對降伏強度約 500 MPa 的 7000 系鋁合金安全係數約 2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The peak centrifugal stress of a solid disc is σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip² (ν = 0.3): for aluminium alloy ρ = 2700 kg/m³ and v_tip = 471 m/s, σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa, a safety factor of about 2 against the roughly 500 MPa yield of a 7000-series alloy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotor materials, balancing and bearings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：實心圓盤的最大離心應力 σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip²（ν = 0.3）：鋁合金 ρ = 2700 kg/m³、v_tip = 471 m/s，σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa，對降伏強度約 500 MPa 的 7000 系鋁合金安全係數約 2。平衡等級 G 0.4 代表 e·ω = 0.4 mm/s：ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s，重心偏心 e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm。轉子動能 E = ½·I·ω²，取 I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m²，E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ，撞機時這些能量在毫秒內釋放成法蘭上的扭矩，所以安裝螺栓數與法蘭等級必須依廠商規定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The peak centrifugal stress of a solid disc is σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip² (ν = 0.3): for aluminium alloy ρ = 2700 kg/m³ and v_tip = 471 m/s, σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa, a safety factor of about 2 against the roughly 500 MPa yield of a 7000-series alloy. Balance grade G 0.4 means e·ω = 0.4 mm/s: with ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s the centre-of-mass eccentricity is e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm. The rotor's kinetic energy E = ½·I·ω² with I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m² is E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ, released within milliseconds as torque on the flange in a crash, which is why bolt count and flange rating must follow the vendor's mounting rules. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在泵的法蘭上用加速規量振動頻譜：基頻在轉速頻率（90,000 rpm 即 1500 Hz）及其諧波，軸承缺陷頻率另有特徵線；每季記錄振幅趨勢，上升代表軸承磨耗或不平衡變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the vibration spectrum on the pump flange with an accelerometer: the fundamental sits at the rotation frequency (90,000 rpm is 1500 Hz) with its harmonics, and bearing-defect frequencies show up as separate lines; log the amplitude trend quarterly, and a rise indicates bearing wear or a change in balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 實心圓盤的最大離心應力 σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip²（ν = 0.3）：鋁合金 ρ = 2700 kg/m³、v_tip = 471 m/s，σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa，對降伏強度約 500 MPa 的 7000 系鋁合金安全係數約 2。平衡等級 G 0.4 代表 e·ω = 0.4 mm/s：ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s，重心偏心 e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm。轉子動能 E = ½·I·ω²，取 I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m²，E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ，撞機時這些能量在毫秒內釋放成法蘭上的扭矩，所以安裝螺栓數與法蘭等級必須依廠商規定。

steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor materials, balancing and bearings: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鋁合金轉子與軸承」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在泵的法蘭上用加速規量振動頻譜：基頻在轉速頻率（90,000 rpm 即 1500 Hz）及其諧波，軸承缺陷頻率另有特徵線；每季記錄振幅趨勢，上升代表軸承磨耗或不平衡變化。記錄升速與自然減速時間、軸承溫度；磁浮泵則監看位置感測器的軌跡振幅。把這些數值和廠商驗收值比較，超過即安排軸承保養。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the vibration spectrum on the pump flange with an accelerometer: the fundamental sits at the rotation frequency (90,000 rpm is 1500 Hz) with its harmonics, and bearing-defect frequencies show up as separate lines; log the amplitude trend quarterly, and a rise indicates bearing wear or a change in balance. Record run-up and free run-down times and bearing temperature; on a magnetically levitated pump watch the orbit amplitude from the position sensors. Compare these with the vendor's acceptance values and schedule bearing service when exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一顆螺絲掉進入口，或空氣在全速時從入口灌入：轉子撞機，葉片剪斷、71 kJ 動能在毫秒內變成扭矩；若泵只用了幾顆螺栓固定、沒有依規定安裝，泵會從法蘭上扭脫並損壞腔體；後果是泵報廢、腔體檢修，所以入口網與受控通氣閥不是選配。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A screw dropped into the inlet, or air rushing in through the inlet at full speed, crashes the rotor: blades shear and 71 kJ of kinetic energy becomes torque within milliseconds; if the pump was held by only a few bolts outside the vendor's mounting rules it twists off the flange and damages the chamber; the consequence is a scrapped pump and a chamber overhaul, which is why the inlet screen and the controlled vent valve are not optional.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在泵的法蘭上用加速規量振動頻譜：基頻在轉速頻率（90,000 rpm 即 1500 Hz）及其諧波，軸承缺陷頻率另有特徵線；每季記錄振幅趨勢，上升代表軸承磨耗或不平衡變化。記錄升速與自然減速時間、軸承溫度；磁浮泵則監看位置感測器的軌跡振幅。把這些數值和廠商驗收值比較，超過即安排軸承保養。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the vibration spectrum on the pump flange with an accelerometer: the fundamental sits at the rotation frequency (90,000 rpm is 1500 Hz) with its harmonics, and bearing-defect frequencies show up as separate lines; log the amplitude trend quarterly, and a rise indicates bearing wear or a change in balance. Record run-up and free run-down times and bearing temperature; on a magnetically levitated pump watch the orbit amplitude from the position sensors. Compare these with the vendor's acceptance values and schedule bearing service when exceeded.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotor materials, balancing and bearings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一顆螺絲掉進入口，或空氣在全速時從入口灌入：轉子撞機，葉片剪斷、71 kJ 動能在毫秒內變成扭矩；若泵只用了幾顆螺栓固定、沒有依規定安裝，泵會從法蘭上扭脫並損壞腔體；後果是泵報廢、腔體檢修，所以入口網與受控通氣閥不是選配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一顆螺絲掉進入口，或空氣在全速時從入口灌入：轉子撞機，葉片剪斷、71 kJ 動能在毫秒內變成扭矩；若泵只用了幾顆螺栓固定、沒有依規定安裝，泵會從法蘭上扭脫並損壞腔體；後果是泵報廢、腔體檢修，所以入口網與受控通氣閥不是選配。
knowledge.textEn: A screw dropped into the inlet, or air rushing in through the inlet at full speed, crashes the rotor: blades shear and 71 kJ of kinetic energy becomes torque within milliseconds; if the pump was held by only a few bolts outside the vendor's mounting rules it twists off the flange and damages the chamber; the consequence is a scrapped pump and a chamber overhaul, which is why the inlet screen and the controlled vent valve are not optional.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沒有任何一種真空計能從 1000 mbar 量到 10⁻¹² mbar，所以泵站要用三種物理機制接力：電容薄膜計直接量氣體對薄膜的力，與氣體種類無關，每個感測頭涵蓋約四個數量級，精度可達 0.2%；Pirani 計量加熱絲的熱損失，在 10⁻⁴ 到 10 mbar 之間熱損失與壓力有關，但隨氣體的熱傳導係數不同而讀值不同，接近大氣時熱傳導不再隨壓力變化而飽和；游離計分成冷陰極的 Penning／反磁控管（放電電流約隨 p^n 變化，n 約 1.1–1.4，耐用但點火有延遲）與熱陰極的 Bayard–Alpert（10⁻² 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，引出式到 10⁻¹²）。組合計把 Pirani 與游離計做在一起自動切換。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: No single gauge spans 1000 mbar to 10⁻¹² mbar, so a pumping station relays between three physical mechanisms: the capacitance-diaphragm gauge measures the gas force on a membrane directly, independent of gas species, each head covering about four decades with accuracy down to 0.2%; the Pirani gauge measures the heat loss of a heated wire, which depends on pressure between 10⁻⁴ and 10 mbar but reads differently for gases of different thermal conductivity and saturates toward atmosphere where conduction stops depending on pressure; ionisation gauges split into cold-cathode Penning or inverted-magnetron types (discharge current roughly ∝ p^n with n about 1.1–1.4, robust but slow to strike) and the hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge (10⁻² to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, 10⁻¹² for the extractor type). Combination gauges package a Pirani with an ionisation element and switch automatically. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：電容薄膜計：C = ε₀·A/d，薄膜面積 A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²、間隙 d = 100 µm，C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF；滿量程 1 mbar = 100 Pa 讓中心撓度 10 µm（設計值），ΔC/C ≈ 10%；要分辨滿量程的 10⁻⁴（即 10⁻⁴ mbar），電容分辨率需達 10⁻⁵ 相對值，約 0.1 fF，這就是薄膜計必須恆溫並做零點校正的原因。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capacitance-diaphragm gauge: C = ε₀·A/d with membrane area A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m² and gap d = 100 µm gives C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF; a full-scale 1 mbar = 100 Pa deflects the centre by 10 µm (design value), so ΔC/C ≈ 10%; resolving 10⁻⁴ of full scale (10⁻⁴ mbar) demands a relative capacitance resolution of 10⁻⁵, about 0.1 fF, which is why the head is thermostated and zeroed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：電容薄膜計：C = ε₀·A/d，薄膜面積 A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²、間隙 d = 100 µm，C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF；滿量程 1 mbar = 100 Pa 讓中心撓度 10 µm（設計值），ΔC/C ≈ 10%；要分辨滿量程的 10⁻⁴（即 10⁻⁴ mbar），電容分辨率需達 10⁻⁵ 相對值，約 0.1 fF，這就是薄膜計必須恆溫並做零點校正的原因。Penning 計 I = k·p^n：若實際 n = 1.2 而控制器假設 n = 1，跨三個數量級的誤差達 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capacitance-diaphragm gauge: C = ε₀·A/d with membrane area A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m² and gap d = 100 µm gives C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF; a full-scale 1 mbar = 100 Pa deflects the centre by 10 µm (design value), so ΔC/C ≈ 10%; resolving 10⁻⁴ of full scale (10⁻⁴ mbar) demands a relative capacitance resolution of 10⁻⁵, about 0.1 fF, which is why the head is thermostated and zeroed. Penning gauge I = k·p^n: if the true n = 1.2 while the controller assumes n = 1, the error across three decades reaches 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 Pirani 判斷何時啟動渦輪泵，但腔內是富氦氣體：Pirani 顯示 10⁻² mbar、實際是 10⁻¹ mbar，渦輪泵在過高壓力下升速、轉子過熱跳機；另一種是薄膜計感測頭在溫度變化後零點漂移，所有低端讀值帶著固定偏移，製程壓力因而設錯。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A Pirani used to decide when to start the turbopump while the chamber holds helium-rich gas: the Pirani shows 10⁻² mbar but the real pressure is 10⁻¹ mbar, the turbopump runs up at too high a pressure and trips on rotor temperature; another case is a diaphragm head whose zero drifts after a temperature change, so every low-range reading carries a fixed offset and the process pressure is set wrongly.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。
knowledge.textEn: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

optionsEn: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar.
