steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用 Pirani 判斷何時啟動渦輪泵，但腔內是富氦氣體：Pirani 顯示 10⁻² mbar、實際是 10⁻¹ mbar，渦輪泵在過高壓力下升速、轉子過熱跳機；另一種是薄膜計感測頭在溫度變化後零點漂移，所有低端讀值帶著固定偏移，製程壓力因而設錯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A Pirani used to decide when to start the turbopump while the chamber holds helium-rich gas: the Pirani shows 10⁻² mbar but the real pressure is 10⁻¹ mbar, the turbopump runs up at too high a pressure and trips on rotor temperature; another case is a diaphragm head whose zero drifts after a temperature change, so every low-range reading carries a fixed offset and the process pressure is set wrongly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：組合計把 Pirani 與游離計做在一起自動切換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combination gauges package a Pirani with an ionisation element and switch automatically.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「真空計校正與不確定度鏈」與「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain" and "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真空量值的溯源鏈從國家計量機構的初級標準開始：靜態膨脹法涵蓋約 10⁻⁴ 到 1000 mbar，孔口流動（動態膨脹）法涵蓋約 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻² mbar；轉移標準是旋轉轉子真空計（量鋼球在氣體中的減速率，約 10⁻⁶ 到 1 mbar，不確定度約 1%）與電容薄膜計；工作真空計則在校正腔內以比較法校正。主要不確定度來源包括參考計本身、氣體種類、熱蒸騰（真空計與腔體溫度不同時，分子流下 p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂)）、真空計安裝位置的傳導率效應，以及熱陰極計靈敏度在兩次校正之間 10–20% 的漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The traceability chain for vacuum starts at the primary standards of national metrology institutes: static expansion covers about 10⁻⁴ to 1000 mbar and orifice-flow (dynamic expansion) about 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻² mbar; transfer standards are the spinning-rotor gauge (measuring the deceleration of a levitated steel ball in gas, about 10⁻⁶ to 1 mbar with roughly 1% uncertainty) and the capacitance-diaphragm gauge; working gauges are then calibrated by comparison in a calibration chamber. The main uncertainty sources are the reference gauge itself, gas species, thermal transpiration (with gauge and chamber at different temperatures, p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂) in molecular flow), conductance effects at the gauge's mounting position, and the 10–20% drift of hot-cathode sensitivity between calibrations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱蒸騰：恆溫在 45 °C（318 K）的薄膜計接到 293 K 的腔體，分子流下 p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042，讀值高 4.2%，在 10⁻³ mbar 以下必須修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal transpiration: a diaphragm gauge thermostated at 45 °C (318 K) on a chamber at 293 K reads p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042 in molecular flow, 4.2% high, which must be corrected below 10⁻³ mbar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱蒸騰：恆溫在 45 °C（318 K）的薄膜計接到 293 K 的腔體，分子流下 p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042，讀值高 4.2%，在 10⁻³ mbar 以下必須修正。BA 計的不確定度預算：靈敏度漂移 ±15%、參考計 ±2%、氣體修正 ±5%、位置與傳導率 ±5%，均方根 √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%；若把控制器裡的靈敏度常數留在出廠值 25 mbar⁻¹ 而老化後實際是 18 mbar⁻¹，讀值系統性偏低 28%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal transpiration: a diaphragm gauge thermostated at 45 °C (318 K) on a chamber at 293 K reads p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042 in molecular flow, 4.2% high, which must be corrected below 10⁻³ mbar. Uncertainty budget of a BA gauge: sensitivity drift ±15%, reference gauge ±2%, gas correction ±5%, position and conductance ±5%, root-sum-square √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%; leaving the controller's sensitivity constant at the factory 25 mbar⁻¹ when the aged gauge really has 18 mbar⁻¹ makes every reading 28% low. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子計校正：Pirani 與薄膜計在 10⁻³ 到 1 mbar，游離計在 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻³ mbar，每個數量級至少取三點檢查線性；把 BA 計量得的靈敏度寫回控制器；記錄溫度與氣體種類；建立不確定度預算表，並規定重新校正週期（例如一年或更換燈絲後）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate against the spinning-rotor gauge in the overlapping ranges: Pirani and diaphragm gauges between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar, ionisation gauges between 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻³ mbar, with at least three points per decade to check linearity; write the measured BA sensitivity back into the controller; record temperature and gas species; build the uncertainty budget table and fix the recalibration interval (for example one year or after a filament change).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.

quiz.explanation: 熱蒸騰：恆溫在 45 °C（318 K）的薄膜計接到 293 K 的腔體，分子流下 p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042，讀值高 4.2%，在 10⁻³ mbar 以下必須修正。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal transpiration: a diaphragm gauge thermostated at 45 °C (318 K) on a chamber at 293 K reads p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042 in molecular flow, 4.2% high, which must be corrected below 10⁻³ mbar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子計校正：Pirani 與薄膜計在 10⁻³ 到 1 mbar，游離計在 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻³ mbar，每個數量級至少取三點檢查線性；把 BA 計量得的靈敏度寫回控制器；記錄溫度與氣體種類；建立不確定度預算表，並規定重新校正週期（例如一年或更換燈絲後）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate against the spinning-rotor gauge in the overlapping ranges: Pirani and diaphragm gauges between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar, ionisation gauges between 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻³ mbar, with at least three points per decade to check linearity; write the measured BA sensitivity back into the controller; record temperature and gas species; build the uncertainty budget table and fix the recalibration interval (for example one year or after a filament change). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：控制器換新後靈敏度常數回到出廠值，老化的 BA 計讀值偏低三成：團隊相信腔體在 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar，實際是 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，驗收報告與後續實驗的壓力紀錄全都系統性錯誤，直到與參考計比對才發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a controller swap the sensitivity constant reverts to the factory value and the aged BA gauge reads thirty percent low: the team believes the chamber is at 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar when it is really at 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, and the acceptance report and every later pressure log are systematically wrong until a comparison with a reference gauge exposes it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「真空計校正與不確定度鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain"?

steps.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 控制器換新後靈敏度常數回到出廠值，老化的 BA 計讀值偏低三成：團隊相信腔體在 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar，實際是 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，驗收報告與後續實驗的壓力紀錄全都系統性錯誤，直到與參考計比對才發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After a controller swap the sensitivity constant reverts to the factory value and the aged BA gauge reads thirty percent low: the team believes the chamber is at 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar when it is really at 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, and the acceptance report and every later pressure log are systematically wrong until a comparison with a reference gauge exposes it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：主要不確定度來源包括參考計本身、氣體種類、熱蒸騰（真空計與腔體溫度不同時，分子流下 p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂)）、真空計安裝位置的傳導率效應，以及熱陰極計靈敏度在兩次校正之間 10–20% 的漂移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The main uncertainty sources are the reference gauge itself, gas species, thermal transpiration (with gauge and chamber at different temperatures, p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂) in molecular flow), conductance effects at the gauge's mounting position, and the 10–20% drift of hot-cathode sensitivity between calibrations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「流量計與測試罩」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flow meter and test dome” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 廠商的抽速是在標準測試罩中量的：氣體經校正流量計注入、真空計裝在規定位置，S = Q/(p − p₀)。腔體得到的有效抽速一定比銘牌低，因為要串聯管路與閥門的傳導率。泵還有流量上限：高流量時黏滯摩擦加熱轉子，馬達電流與轉子溫度達到上限後泵會降速，所以製程氣體負載必須查泵的 S(p) 曲線與最大流量規格。氣體負載由製程進氣、出氣與漏氣構成，三者相加後除以有效抽速才是工作壓力，而真空計的擺放若直視泵口會因分子束流效應讀得偏低。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「流量計與測試罩」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vendor's pumping speed is measured in a standard test dome: gas is admitted through a calibrated flow meter, the gauge sits at a prescribed position, and S = Q/(p − p₀). The effective speed at the chamber is always below nameplate because line and valve conductances are in series. The pump also has a throughput limit: at high flow viscous friction heats the rotor, and once motor current and rotor temperature reach their limits the pump slows, so process gas loads must be checked against the pump's S(p) curve and its maximum-throughput rating. The gas load is the sum of process gas, outgassing and leaks, and that sum divided by the effective speed is the working pressure; a gauge that looks straight into the pump inlet reads low because of molecular beaming. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Flow meter and test dome”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵銘牌上的抽速就是腔體得到的抽速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「流量計與測試罩」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Flow meter and test dome”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A vendor's pumping speed is measured in a standard test dome: gas is admitted through a calibrated flow meter, the gauge sits at a prescribed position, and S = Q/(p − p₀). quiz.question: 關於「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads" is correct?

steps.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流量計與測試罩」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flow meter and test dome” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。經 DN100、30 cm 的管子（C ≈ 403 L/s）接到腔體：S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s。若泵的最大流量為 2 mbar·L/s（教學假設），對應的入口壓力為 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar，製程壓力若高於此值，泵會降速或過熱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen. Through a DN100 tube 30 cm long (C ≈ 403 L/s) to the chamber: S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s. If the pump's maximum throughput is 2 mbar·L/s (teaching assumption), the corresponding inlet pressure is 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar, and a process pressure above that slows or overheats the pump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

If the pump's maximum throughput is 2 mbar·L/s (teaching assumption), the corresponding inlet pressure is 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar, and a process pressure above that slows or overheats the pump.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads", which statement holds?
options: 渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。
流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。
渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。
optionsEn: A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.
Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen.
A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.
quiz.explanation: 流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「流量計與測試罩」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Flow meter and test dome” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%；再把氬氣流量計量到的值當成氮的抽速，兩個錯誤疊在一起，製程壓力設計整整差一倍；泵長期在超過最大流量下運轉，轉子溫度逼近上限，幾個月後軸承油脂劣化而失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%; treating a value measured with an argon flow meter as the nitrogen speed stacks a second error, and the process pressure design is off by a factor of two; the pump then runs above its maximum throughput for months, the rotor near its temperature limit, until the bearing grease degrades and fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。
knowledge.textEn: Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。
在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species.

Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed.
quiz.explanation: 在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流量計與測試罩」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Flow meter and test dome” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%；再把氬氣流量計量到的值當成氮的抽速，兩個錯誤疊在一起，製程壓力設計整整差一倍；泵長期在超過最大流量下運轉，轉子溫度逼近上限，幾個月後軸承油脂劣化而失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%; treating a value measured with an argon flow meter as the nitrogen speed stacks a second error, and the process pressure design is off by a factor of two; the pump then runs above its maximum throughput for months, the rotor near its temperature limit, until the bearing grease degrades and fails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣體負載由製程進氣、出氣與漏氣構成，三者相加後除以有效抽速才是工作壓力，而真空計的擺放若直視泵口會因分子束流效應讀得偏低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gas load is the sum of process gas, outgassing and leaks, and that sum divided by the effective speed is the working pressure; a gauge that looks straight into the pump inlet reads low because of molecular beaming.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵銘牌上的抽速就是腔體得到的抽速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%；再把氬氣流量計量到的值當成氮的抽速，兩個錯誤疊在一起，製程壓力設計整整差一倍；泵長期在超過最大流量下運轉，轉子溫度逼近上限，幾個月後軸承油脂劣化而失效。
knowledge.textEn: A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%; treating a value measured with an argon flow meter as the nitrogen speed stacks a second error, and the process pressure design is off by a factor of two; the pump then runs above its maximum throughput for months, the rotor near its temperature limit, until the bearing grease degrades and fails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。
optionsEn: A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure.
quiz.explanation: 真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%；再把氬氣流量計量到的值當成氮的抽速，兩個錯誤疊在一起，製程壓力設計整整差一倍；泵長期在超過最大流量下運轉，轉子溫度逼近上限，幾個月後軸承油脂劣化而失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%; treating a value measured with an argon flow meter as the nitrogen speed stacks a second error, and the process pressure design is off by a factor of two; the pump then runs above its maximum throughput for months, the rotor near its temperature limit, until the bearing grease degrades and fails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護」與「驗收、維護週期與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection" and "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站的整合是一連串有條件的動作：先啟動前級泵，前級壓力低於渦輪泵允許的啟動壓力後才升速；升速需數分鐘，控制器監看轉速、電流與溫度；真空計在 10⁻³ mbar 附近由 Pirani 切換到游離計；渦輪泵轉速超過 90% 且腔體已經由旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar 以下，閘閥才允許開啟。停電時通氣閥在延遲後以乾燥氮氣通氣，讓轉子受控減速並阻止前級的油氣或微粒回流；通氣速率要受限，避免黏滯氣流對葉片造成衝擊。冷卻（風冷或水冷）、入口法蘭的烘烤溫度上限（約 120 °C）、外部磁場（渦電流加熱轉子）與振動去耦都要在整合時一併設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating a pumping station is a chain of conditional actions: start the backing pump first and run the turbopump up only once the foreline is below its permitted start pressure; run-up takes minutes while the controller watches speed, current and temperature; gauges switch from Pirani to ionisation near 10⁻³ mbar; the gate valve may open only when the turbopump exceeds 90% speed and the chamber has been rough-pumped through a bypass below 10⁻² mbar. On a power failure the vent valve admits dry nitrogen after a delay so the rotor decelerates under control and no oil vapour or particles backstream from the foreline; the venting rate is throttled so that viscous inflow does not shock the blades. Cooling (air or water), the inlet-flange bake limit (about 120 °C), external magnetic fields (eddy-current heating of the rotor) and vibration decoupling are all settled during integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Controller, vent valve and interlocks”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護

On a power failure the vent valve admits dry nitrogen after a delay so the rotor decelerates under control and no oil vapour or particles backstream from the foreline; the venting rate is throttled so that viscous inflow does not shock the blades.

quiz.question: 關於「泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection" is correct?

磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。在基礎壓力下不通氣自然減速，只靠約 5 W 的軸承摩擦耗能，需要 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 小時；受控通氣可在約一分鐘內停機。閘閥風險：100 L 腔體在 1 mbar 時含 100 mbar·L 氣體，若最大流量 2 mbar·L/s，開閥瞬間相當於 50 秒的滿載衝擊，所以必須先旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar（只剩 1 mbar·L）再開閘閥。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes. Free run-down at base pressure without venting dissipates only about 5 W in bearing friction, taking 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 hours, whereas controlled venting stops the rotor in about a minute. Gate-valve risk: a 100 L chamber at 1 mbar holds 100 mbar·L of gas, and with a maximum throughput of 2 mbar·L/s opening the valve is a 50-second full-load shock, so the chamber must first be rough-pumped through the bypass to 10⁻² mbar (only 1 mbar·L) before the gate valve opens. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。在基礎壓力下不通氣自然減速，只靠約 5 W 的軸承摩擦耗能，需要 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 小時；受控通氣可在約一分鐘內停機。閘閥風險：100 L 腔體在 1 mbar 時含 100 mbar·L 氣體，若最大流量 2 mbar·L/s，開閥瞬間相當於 50 秒的滿載衝擊，所以必須先旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar（只剩 1 mbar·L）再開閘閥。
knowledge.textEn: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes. Free run-down at base pressure without venting dissipates only about 5 W in bearing friction, taking 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 hours, whereas controlled venting stops the rotor in about a minute. Gate-valve risk: a 100 L chamber at 1 mbar holds 100 mbar·L of gas, and with a maximum throughput of 2 mbar·L/s opening the valve is a 50-second full-load shock, so the chamber must first be rough-pumped through the bypass to 10⁻² mbar (only 1 mbar·L) before the gate valve opens.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection", which statement holds?
options: 前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。
升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。
optionsEn: As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species.
Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes.
quiz.explanation: 升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。
knowledge.textEn: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection"?
options: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。
optionsEn: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute.
quiz.explanation: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冷卻（風冷或水冷）、入口法蘭的烘烤溫度上限（約 120 °C）、外部磁場（渦電流加熱轉子）與振動去耦都要在整合時一併設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cooling (air or water), the inlet-flange bake limit (about 120 °C), external magnetic fields (eddy-current heating of the rotor) and vibration decoupling are all settled during integration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。
knowledge.textEn: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承。
磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection.
A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.
quiz.explanation: 對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。維護週期依軸承型式而定：油脂潤滑的混合軸承依運轉時數定期更換，磁浮泵沒有軸承保養但要監看落地軸承次數；前級渦卷泵的尖端密封與隔膜泵的膜片有各自的壽命；BA 計燈絲與 Penning 計的放電污染也要排程處理。交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. Maintenance intervals depend on the bearing type: grease-lubricated hybrid bearings are replaced on running hours, magnetically levitated pumps need no bearing service but their touchdown count is monitored; scroll-pump tip seals and diaphragm-pump membranes have their own lives; BA filaments and Penning discharge contamination are scheduled as well. The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pump-station acceptance report and run log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接
knowledge.text: 泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。維護週期依軸承型式而定：油脂潤滑的混合軸承依運轉時數定期更換，磁浮泵沒有軸承保養但要監看落地軸承次數；前級渦卷泵的尖端密封與隔膜泵的膜片有各自的壽命；BA 計燈絲與 Penning 計的放電污染也要排程處理。
knowledge.textEn: Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. Maintenance intervals depend on the bearing type: grease-lubricated hybrid bearings are replaced on running hours, magnetically levitated pumps need no bearing service but their touchdown count is monitored; scroll-pump tip seals and diaphragm-pump membranes have their own lives; BA filaments and Penning discharge contamination are scheduled as well.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「驗收、維護週期與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff" is correct?
options: 磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。
渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。
泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。
optionsEn: A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.
A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.

Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records.
quiz.explanation: 泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。真空計重校正週期：BA 計靈敏度每年漂移約 −5%（教學假設），允許誤差 ±10%，兩年後達 −10%，因此校正週期訂為最長兩年。維護排程：混合軸承每 3 年或依廠商時數更換，渦卷泵尖端密封每年檢查。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable. Gauge recalibration interval: BA sensitivity drifts about −5% per year (teaching assumption) against a ±10% allowance, reaching −10% after two years, so the interval is set at two years maximum. Maintenance schedule: hybrid bearings every 3 years or per the vendor's hour count, scroll-pump tip seals inspected yearly. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。真空計重校正週期：BA 計靈敏度每年漂移約 −5%（教學假設），允許誤差 ±10%，兩年後達 −10%，因此校正週期訂為最長兩年。維護排程：混合軸承每 3 年或依廠商時數更換，渦卷泵尖端密封每年檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable. Gauge recalibration interval: BA sensitivity drifts about −5% per year (teaching assumption) against a ±10% allowance, reaching −10% after two years, so the interval is set at two years maximum. Maintenance schedule: hybrid bearings every 3 years or per the vendor's hour count, scroll-pump tip seals inspected yearly.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗收、維護週期與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。
渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。
新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。
optionsEn: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable.
A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.
A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute.
quiz.explanation: 盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收、維護週期與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試。
泵銘牌上的抽速就是腔體得到的抽速。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests.
The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives.
quiz.explanation: 依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。
knowledge.textEn: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收、維護週期與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。
沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.
With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes.
quiz.explanation: 沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 無振動精密實驗平台
summary: 以一張 1000 kg 蜂巢光學桌與四支 1.5 Hz 氣墊隔振腳為主線，說明樓板 VC 等級如何經傳遞率變成桌面奈米級運動，再把桌面模態、主動隔振的傾斜極限、熱與聲學漂移和管線振動短路整合成可量測、可交接的平台驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 干涉儀穩定度練習：一台 Michelson 干涉儀放在 1000 kg 蜂巢桌上，兩臂長度差 0.5 m，要求 10 分鐘內相對光程漂移小於 20 nm；樓板為 VC-C，隔振器 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1。振動項：8 Hz 頻帶桌面絕對運動 13.2 nm，加速度 a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s²，經 270 Hz 第一彎曲模態轉成的差模 δ ≈ a/ω₁² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m，可忽略。未加罩時 10 分鐘溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 600 nm、空氣 47 nm、70 dB 聲壓激起鏡架共振 19 nm，RSS ≈ 602 nm，超出 30 倍。改善：加隔熱隔音罩使 ΔT 降到 0.01 K、聲壓降 20 dB，並把臂長差縮到 0.05 m：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm、空氣 0.47 nm、聲學 1.9 nm，RSS ≈ 6.3 nm，達標。結論：隔振之後，預算由熱與聲學主導。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Interferometer stability exercise: a Michelson interferometer sits on a 1000 kg honeycomb table with an arm-length difference of 0.5 m and must hold relative path drift below 20 nm over 10 minutes; the floor is VC-C and the isolators have f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1. Vibration term: the 8 Hz band moves the top 13.2 nm absolutely, an acceleration a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s², which the 270 Hz first bending mode converts to a differential δ ≈ a/ω1² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m, negligible. Without an enclosure a 0.1 K change in 10 minutes gives steel 600 nm, air 47 nm and a 70 dB tone exciting a mount resonance 19 nm, an RSS of about 602 nm, thirty times over. Fix: a thermal and acoustic enclosure cuts ΔT to 0.01 K and sound by 20 dB, and the arm difference is reduced to 0.05 m, giving steel 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm, air 0.47 nm and acoustics 1.9 nm, an RSS of about 6.3 nm, within budget. Conclusion: once isolated, the budget is dominated by thermal and acoustic terms. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」與「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" and "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單自由度隔振器」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。地面運動以傳遞率 T(f) 傳到桌面：f 遠低於 f₀ 時桌面跟著地面走（T ≈ 1），f = f₀ 時共振放大，只有在 f > √2·f₀ 之後才開始隔振，無阻尼時隨 (f/f₀)⁻² 下降。阻尼壓低共振峰，卻在高頻把衰減斜率從 40 dB/decade 拉回到約 20 dB/decade，因此精密平台必須在共振放大與高頻隔振之間取捨。要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單自由度隔振器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). Ground motion reaches the top through the transmissibility T(f): well below f0 the top follows the ground (T ≈ 1), at f0 it is amplified, and isolation starts only above √2·f0, falling as (f/f0)⁻² when undamped. Damping lowers the resonant peak but at high frequency pulls the roll-off from 40 dB/decade back toward 20 dB/decade, so a precision platform trades resonant amplification against high-frequency isolation. Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單自由度隔振器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
