quiz.question: 關於「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" is correct?
options: 隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。
無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency.
A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m).
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單自由度隔振器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：無阻尼 T = 1/|1 − (f/f₀)²|：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 r = 6.67，T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023（−32.8 dB）。加阻尼比 ζ = 0.1 後 T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038，共振峰 T(f₀) ≈ 5.1。若用鋼彈簧做 1.5 Hz，需靜變形 δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m；10 Hz 的橡膠墊只需 2.5 mm，但在 10 Hz 完全不隔振。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). With a damping ratio ζ = 0.1, T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038 and the resonant peak T(f0) ≈ 5.1. A 1.5 Hz steel spring would need a static deflection δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m, whereas a 10 Hz rubber pad needs only 2.5 mm but gives no isolation at 10 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). With a damping ratio ζ = 0.1, T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038 and the resonant peak T(f0) ≈ 5.1. A 1.5 Hz steel spring would need a static deflection δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m, whereas a 10 Hz rubber pad needs only 2.5 mm but gives no isolation at 10 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off", which statement holds?
options: 桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。
只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。
optionsEn: A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.
Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
quiz.explanationEn: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單自由度隔振器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。
knowledge.textEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off"?
options: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
optionsEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
quiz.explanation: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單自由度隔振器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
knowledge.textEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common.
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。以速度定義代表在固定速度下位移 x = v/(2πf) 隨頻率下降，所以低頻的位移最大，也最難隔離。振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz. A velocity criterion means displacement x = v/(2πf) falls with frequency at constant velocity, so low frequencies carry the largest displacement and are the hardest to isolate. Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源
knowledge.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources
knowledge.text: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。
knowledge.textEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources" is correct?
options: 樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
平台設計從場址的輸入開始。
optionsEn: A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
Platform design starts from the site input.
quiz.explanation: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。16 Hz 頻帶：124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm；31.5 Hz：63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm。但若 2 Hz 頻帶達到 VC-C 上限，995 nm 經 T ≈ 1.26 反被放大到約 1.25 µm，顯示 VC 等級本身無法描述隔振器共振附近的風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. In the 16 Hz band 124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm, and at 31.5 Hz 63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm. A 2 Hz band at the VC-C limit, 995 nm, is instead amplified by T ≈ 1.26 to about 1.25 µm, showing that a VC class alone cannot describe the risk near the isolator resonance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。16 Hz 頻帶：124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm；31.5 Hz：63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm。但若 2 Hz 頻帶達到 VC-C 上限，995 nm 經 T ≈ 1.26 反被放大到約 1.25 µm，顯示 VC 等級本身無法描述隔振器共振附近的風險。
knowledge.textEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. In the 16 Hz band 124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm, and at 31.5 Hz 63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm. A 2 Hz band at the VC-C limit, 995 nm, is instead amplified by T ≈ 1.26 to about 1.25 µm, showing that a VC class alone cannot describe the risk near the isolator resonance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources", which statement holds?
options: 任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。
主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
optionsEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm.
Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
quiz.explanation: VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。
knowledge.textEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖。
纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves.
Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.
quiz.explanation: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。
knowledge.textEn: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平」與「蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling" and "Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。兩個氣室之間以層流阻尼孔相連，氣體來回流動消耗能量提供阻尼；水平方向則以內部擺桿或膜片側向柔性形成約 1.5 Hz 的擺。機械式水平閥偵測桌面高度，自動補氣或排氣，使不同負載下高度回到原位，但閥的死區與反應時間會影響沉降與漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm; the piston area A carries the weight W = p_g·A, and stiffness comes from gas compression, k = n·p_abs·A²/V, so the natural frequency depends only on the pressure ratio and the effective height V/A, not on the load. Two chambers joined by a laminar damping orifice dissipate energy as gas flows back and forth, and horizontally an internal pendulum or the diaphragm's lateral compliance forms a pendulum near 1.5 Hz. A mechanical leveling valve senses table height and adds or vents air so the height returns under changing loads, but its dead band and response time affect settling and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平

knowledge.text: 誤解：負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling" is correct?
options: 氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。
optionsEn: A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.
quiz.explanation: 氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm; the piston area A carries the weight W = p_g·A, and stiffness comes from gas compression, k = n·p_abs·A²/V, so the natural frequency depends only on the pressure ratio and the effective height V/A, not on the load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。取 n = 1.4、p_g = 4 bar、p_abs ≈ 5 bar、h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m：f₀ ≈ 1.32 Hz；氣室縮小到 h_eff = 0.1 m 時 f₀ ≈ 2.09 Hz。1000 kg 桌面由四腳分擔，每腳 2452 N，需 A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m²（直徑約 88 mm）。水平擺長 L = 0.1 m 時 f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)). With n = 1.4, p_g = 4 bar, p_abs ≈ 5 bar and h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m, f0 ≈ 1.32 Hz; shrinking the chamber to h_eff = 0.1 m raises f0 to about 2.09 Hz. A 1000 kg top shared by four legs puts 2452 N on each, requiring A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m², about 88 mm in diameter. A horizontal pendulum of length L = 0.1 m gives f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對；水平閥則以加載後回到原高度的時間與殘餘偏差評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement); evaluate the leveling valves by the time to return to height after loading and the residual offset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。取 n = 1.4、p_g = 4 bar、p_abs ≈ 5 bar、h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m：f₀ ≈ 1.32 Hz；氣室縮小到 h_eff = 0.1 m 時 f₀ ≈ 2.09 Hz。1000 kg 桌面由四腳分擔，每腳 2452 N，需 A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m²（直徑約 88 mm）。水平擺長 L = 0.1 m 時 f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)). With n = 1.4, p_g = 4 bar, p_abs ≈ 5 bar and h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m, f0 ≈ 1.32 Hz; shrinking the chamber to h_eff = 0.1 m raises f0 to about 2.09 Hz. A 1000 kg top shared by four legs puts 2452 N on each, requiring A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m², about 88 mm in diameter. A horizontal pendulum of length L = 0.1 m gives f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling", which statement holds?
options: 只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。
將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。
纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。
optionsEn: Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)).
Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.
quiz.explanation: 將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對；水平閥則以加載後回到原高度的時間與殘餘偏差評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement); evaluate the leveling valves by the time to return to height after loading and the residual offset. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：供氣含水氣或油霧時阻尼孔與水平閥被污染，阻尼下降、閥卡住，桌面會緩慢傾斜或持續上下微振；膜片老化漏氣則使某一腳壓力不足，負載轉移到其他腳，四腳 f₀ 不一致並激起搖擺模態。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Supply air carrying moisture or oil mist fouls the damping orifices and leveling valves, reducing damping and sticking valves, so the table slowly tilts or keeps hunting up and down; an aged, leaking diaphragm leaves one leg under-pressured, shifts load to the others, mismatches the four f0 values and excites rocking modes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對；水平閥則以加載後回到原高度的時間與殘餘偏差評估。
knowledge.textEn: Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement); evaluate the leveling valves by the time to return to height after loading and the residual offset.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。
在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency.

Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement).
quiz.explanation: 在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對；水平閥則以加載後回到原高度的時間與殘餘偏差評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement); evaluate the leveling valves by the time to return to height after loading and the residual offset. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 供氣含水氣或油霧時阻尼孔與水平閥被污染，阻尼下降、閥卡住，桌面會緩慢傾斜或持續上下微振；膜片老化漏氣則使某一腳壓力不足，負載轉移到其他腳，四腳 f₀ 不一致並激起搖擺模態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Supply air carrying moisture or oil mist fouls the damping orifices and leveling valves, reducing damping and sticking valves, so the table slowly tilts or keeps hunting up and down; an aged, leaking diaphragm leaves one leg under-pressured, shifts load to the others, mismatches the four f0 values and excites rocking modes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.title: 蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鋼製蜂巢桌面」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel honeycomb tabletop” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隔振腳決定桌面整體跟地面的關係，桌面本身的彎曲與扭轉模態則決定桌上兩個元件之間的相對運動。蜂巢桌面以上下鋼板夾著薄鋼蜂巢芯，像工字梁一樣把材料放在離中性面最遠處，以低質量換取高彎曲剛度；但金屬結構的內阻尼很小，模態品質因數 Q 可達 100，任何落在共振頻率的力都會被放大。因此桌面內部要加寬頻阻尼器或調諧質量阻尼器，並以動態柔度曲線（位移／力對頻率）描述，而不只看靜態剛度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The legs set how the whole top follows the ground, but the top's own bending and torsion modes set the relative motion between two components on it. A honeycomb top sandwiches a thin steel honeycomb core between steel skins, placing material far from the neutral plane like an I-beam to buy bending stiffness with little mass; yet metal structures have little internal damping, so modal quality factors reach 100 and any force at a resonance is amplified. Tops therefore include broadband or tuned-mass dampers and are characterized by a dynamic compliance curve, displacement per unit force versus frequency, rather than static stiffness alone. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Steel honeycomb tabletop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m、上下鋼板各 5 mm、質量 680 kg 的桌面：I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴，EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m²，μ = 283 kg/m；自由—自由梁第一彎曲模態 f₁ = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz（芯材剪切會再拉低）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m top with 5 mm steel skins and 680 kg mass: I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴, EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m², μ = 283 kg/m, and the first free–free bending mode is f1 = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz, lowered further by core shear.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Steel honeycomb tabletop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel honeycomb tabletop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m、上下鋼板各 5 mm、質量 680 kg 的桌面：I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴，EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m²，μ = 283 kg/m；自由—自由梁第一彎曲模態 f₁ = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz（芯材剪切會再拉低）。取模態質量 m/4 = 170 kg，k_modal = m_eff·ω₁² ≈ 4.9×10⁸ N/m；共振處柔度 ≈ Q/k：Q = 100 時 2.0×10⁻⁷ m/N，0.1 N 的風扇力造成約 20 nm，阻尼到 Q = 10 時降為約 2 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m top with 5 mm steel skins and 680 kg mass: I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴, EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m², μ = 283 kg/m, and the first free–free bending mode is f1 = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz, lowered further by core shear. Taking a modal mass m/4 = 170 kg gives k_modal = m_eff·ω1² ≈ 4.9×10⁸ N/m; the compliance at resonance ≈ Q/k is 2.0×10⁻⁷ m/N for Q = 100, so a 0.1 N fan force produces about 20 nm, falling to about 2 nm when damping brings Q to 10. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes; repeat at several points to map mode shapes and compare with the supplier's published compliance curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Taking a modal mass m/4 = 170 kg gives k_modal = m_eff·ω1² ≈ 4.9×10⁸ N/m; the compliance at resonance ≈ Q/k is 2.0×10⁻⁷ m/N for Q = 100, so a 0.1 N fan force produces about 20 nm, falling to about 2 nm when damping brings Q to 10.

steps.title: 蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鋼製蜂巢桌面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Steel honeycomb tabletop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes; repeat at several points to map mode shapes and compare with the supplier's published compliance curve. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍；症狀是干涉條紋只在特定設備開機時出現固定頻率的抖動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Bolting a fast vacuum pump or cooling fan directly to the top, with a rotation harmonic near a table mode, amplifies the relative vibration between two optical components tens of times; the symptom is fringe jitter at a fixed frequency only when that equipment runs.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。
knowledge.textEn: Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes; repeat at several points to map mode shapes and compare with the supplier's published compliance curve.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance"?
options: 以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes; repeat at several points to map mode shapes and compare with the supplier's published compliance curve. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Steel honeycomb tabletop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍；症狀是干涉條紋只在特定設備開機時出現固定頻率的抖動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Bolting a fast vacuum pump or cooling fan directly to the top, with a rotation harmonic near a table mode, amplifies the relative vibration between two optical components tens of times; the symptom is fringe jitter at a fixed frequency only when that equipment runs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此桌面內部要加寬頻阻尼器或調諧質量阻尼器，並以動態柔度曲線（位移／力對頻率）描述，而不只看靜態剛度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tops therefore include broadband or tuned-mass dampers and are characterized by a dynamic compliance curve, displacement per unit force versus frequency, rather than static stiffness alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍；症狀是干涉條紋只在特定設備開機時出現固定頻率的抖動。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍。
任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Bolting a fast vacuum pump or cooling fan directly to the top, with a rotation harmonic near a table mode, amplifies the relative vibration between two optical components tens of times.
Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.
quiz.explanation: 把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍；症狀是干涉條紋只在特定設備開機時出現固定頻率的抖動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolting a fast vacuum pump or cooling fan directly to the top, with a rotation harmonic near a table mode, amplifies the relative vibration between two optical components tens of times; the symptom is fringe jitter at a fixed frequency only when that equipment runs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」與「相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring transmissibility and compliance" and "Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring transmissibility and compliance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。低頻量測的難點在感測器雜訊：固定位移下加速度 a = (2πf)²x 隨頻率平方下降，1 Hz 時奈米級位移只對應奈克（ng）級加速度，低於一般壓電加速度計的雜訊底線，必須改用地震級加速度計或速度型地震儀。頻率響應以互功率譜估計 H₁ = S_xy/S_xx，並檢查相干函數；相干性低的頻段代表輸出被其他來源主導，結果不可信。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The difficulty at low frequency is sensor noise: at fixed displacement the acceleration a = (2πf)²x falls with frequency squared, so nanometre motion at 1 Hz means only nano-g acceleration, below the noise floor of ordinary piezoelectric accelerometers, and seismic-grade accelerometers or velocity seismometers are needed. The frequency response is estimated from cross-spectra as H1 = S_xy/S_xx and checked with the coherence function; bands of low coherence mean the output is dominated by other sources and the result is not trustworthy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法
knowledge.text: 驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。低頻量測的難點在感測器雜訊：固定位移下加速度 a = (2πf)²x 隨頻率平方下降，1 Hz 時奈米級位移只對應奈克（ng）級加速度，低於一般壓電加速度計的雜訊底線，必須改用地震級加速度計或速度型地震儀。
knowledge.textEn: Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The difficulty at low frequency is sensor noise: at fixed displacement the acceleration a = (2πf)²x falls with frequency squared, so nanometre motion at 1 Hz means only nano-g acceleration, below the noise floor of ordinary piezoelectric accelerometers, and seismic-grade accelerometers or velocity seismometers are needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring transmissibility and compliance" is correct?
options: 任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。
只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。
驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。
optionsEn: Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.
Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation.
quiz.explanation: 驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring transmissibility and compliance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。要解析 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的共振，半功率頻寬 2ζf₀ = 0.3 Hz，頻率解析度至少取其 1/6 即 0.05 Hz，每段紀錄長 T = 1/Δf = 20 s；平均 30 段把頻譜隨機誤差壓到約 1/√30 ≈ 18%，共需 10 分鐘。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng. Resolving an f0 = 1.5 Hz, ζ = 0.1 resonance with half-power bandwidth 2ζf0 = 0.3 Hz needs a frequency resolution of at least one sixth of it, 0.05 Hz, so each record is T = 1/Δf = 20 s long; averaging 30 records to cut the spectral random error to about 1/√30 ≈ 18% takes 10 minutes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差；之後再分置地面與桌面，並在報告中同時附上相干函數與感測器雜訊底線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error; then separate them to floor and top, and report the coherence function and sensor noise floor together with the result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。要解析 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的共振，半功率頻寬 2ζf₀ = 0.3 Hz，頻率解析度至少取其 1/6 即 0.05 Hz，每段紀錄長 T = 1/Δf = 20 s；平均 30 段把頻譜隨機誤差壓到約 1/√30 ≈ 18%，共需 10 分鐘。
knowledge.textEn: At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng. Resolving an f0 = 1.5 Hz, ζ = 0.1 resonance with half-power bandwidth 2ζf0 = 0.3 Hz needs a frequency resolution of at least one sixth of it, 0.05 Hz, so each record is T = 1/Δf = 20 s long; averaging 30 records to cut the spectral random error to about 1/√30 ≈ 18% takes 10 minutes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring transmissibility and compliance", which statement holds?
options: 1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。
纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng.
Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring transmissibility and compliance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差；之後再分置地面與桌面，並在報告中同時附上相干函數與感測器雜訊底線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error; then separate them to floor and top, and report the coherence function and sensor noise floor together with the result. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用雜訊太高的加速度計量傳遞率，桌面訊號其實是感測器雜訊，算出的傳遞率在 20 Hz 以上變成一條平坦的假底線，讓人誤以為隔振器只有 −20 dB，進而更換本來合格的系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring transmissibility with an accelerometer whose noise is too high makes the tabletop signal pure sensor noise, so the computed transmissibility flattens into a false floor above 20 Hz, suggesting the isolators give only −20 dB and prompting replacement of a system that was actually compliant.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差；之後再分置地面與桌面，並在報告中同時附上相干函數與感測器雜訊底線。
knowledge.textEn: Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error; then separate them to floor and top, and report the coherence function and sensor noise floor together with the result.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring transmissibility and compliance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
quiz.explanation: 量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差；之後再分置地面與桌面，並在報告中同時附上相干函數與感測器雜訊底線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error; then separate them to floor and top, and report the coherence function and sensor noise floor together with the result. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring transmissibility and compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用雜訊太高的加速度計量傳遞率，桌面訊號其實是感測器雜訊，算出的傳遞率在 20 Hz 以上變成一條平坦的假底線，讓人誤以為隔振器只有 −20 dB，進而更換本來合格的系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring transmissibility with an accelerometer whose noise is too high makes the tabletop signal pure sensor noise, so the computed transmissibility flattens into a false floor above 20 Hz, suggesting the isolators give only −20 dB and prompting replacement of a system that was actually compliant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：頻率響應以互功率譜估計 H₁ = S_xy/S_xx，並檢查相干函數；相干性低的頻段代表輸出被其他來源主導，結果不可信。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The frequency response is estimated from cross-spectra as H1 = S_xy/S_xx and checked with the coherence function; bands of low coherence mean the output is dominated by other sources and the result is not trustworthy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「相對運動誤差預算表」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative-motion error budget” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平台上的實驗在意的是兩個元件之間的相對位移，而非桌面對地的絕對運動。隔振後，樓板傳入的剛體運動大多是共模，經桌面彎曲轉成的差模極小；真正主導長時間穩定度的是溫度：鋼的熱膨脹係數約 12 ppm/K，空氣折射率隨溫度變化約 −9.3×10⁻⁷/K，氣流與空調週期會讓光程在分鐘尺度漂移。聲壓則透過鏡架與立柱的機械共振直接激振元件，因此預算表要把熱、折射、聲學與殘餘振動分項列出後以 RSS 合成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相對運動誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground. After isolation, most rigid-body motion from the floor is common-mode and the differential part converted by table bending is tiny; what dominates long-term stability is temperature, since steel expands about 12 ppm/K and the refractive index of air changes about −9.3×10⁻⁷/K, so airflow and HVAC cycles drift optical paths over minutes. Sound pressure drives components directly through mount and post resonances, so the budget lists thermal, refractive, acoustic and residual-vibration terms separately and combines them by RSS. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Relative-motion error budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「相對運動誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Relative-motion error budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

After isolation, most rigid-body motion from the floor is common-mode and the differential part converted by table bending is tiny; what dominates long-term stability is temperature, since steel expands about 12 ppm/K and the refractive index of air changes about −9.3×10⁻⁷/K, so airflow and HVAC cycles drift optical paths over minutes.

quiz.question: 關於「相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics" is correct?
options: 平台上的實驗在意的是兩個元件之間的相對位移，而非桌面對地的絕對運動。
只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。

optionsEn: Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground.
Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.

quiz.explanationEn: Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相對運動誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative-motion error budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩元件相距 0.5 m、溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm；殷鋼 1.2×10⁻⁶ 時 60 nm；空氣光程 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm。70 dB 聲壓為 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa，作用在 0.01 m² 的鏡架面上約 0.63 mN；鏡架剛度 10⁶ N/m 時靜態 0.63 nm，若聲頻落在 Q = 30 的鏡架共振則約 19 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm. A 70 dB sound pressure is 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa, about 0.63 mN on a 0.01 m² mount face; with a mount stiffness of 10⁶ N/m that is 0.63 nm statically, but about 19 nm if the tone hits a Q = 30 mount resonance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源；再分別開關空調、加罩、播放測試音，逐項核對預算表的預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration; use coherence analysis to assign the relative-displacement spectrum to each source, then switch HVAC, add an enclosure or play test tones to check each budget line.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩元件相距 0.5 m、溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm；殷鋼 1.2×10⁻⁶ 時 60 nm；空氣光程 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm。70 dB 聲壓為 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa，作用在 0.01 m² 的鏡架面上約 0.63 mN；鏡架剛度 10⁶ N/m 時靜態 0.63 nm，若聲頻落在 Q = 30 的鏡架共振則約 19 nm。
knowledge.textEn: Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm. A 70 dB sound pressure is 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa, about 0.63 mN on a 0.01 m² mount face; with a mount stiffness of 10⁶ N/m that is 0.63 nm statically, but about 19 nm if the tone hits a Q = 30 mount resonance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics", which statement holds?
options: 隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
optionsEn: An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency.
Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
quiz.explanationEn: Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「相對運動誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Relative-motion error budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源；再分別開關空調、加罩、播放測試音，逐項核對預算表的預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration; use coherence analysis to assign the relative-displacement spectrum to each source, then switch HVAC, add an enclosure or play test tones to check each budget line. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把所有心力放在升級隔振腳，卻忽略空調出風口正對光路，干涉訊號仍在數分鐘週期內漂移數百奈米；這類漂移與振動頻譜無關，換再好的隔振器也不會改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Investing everything in better legs while an HVAC outlet blows across the beam path still leaves the interference signal drifting hundreds of nanometres with a period of minutes; such drift is unrelated to the vibration spectrum and no isolator upgrade will fix it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源；再分別開關空調、加罩、播放測試音，逐項核對預算表的預測。
knowledge.textEn: Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration; use coherence analysis to assign the relative-displacement spectrum to each source, then switch HVAC, add an enclosure or play test tones to check each budget line.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。
在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.
Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration.
quiz.explanation: 在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源；再分別開關空調、加罩、播放測試音，逐項核對預算表的預測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration; use coherence analysis to assign the relative-displacement spectrum to each source, then switch HVAC, add an enclosure or play test tones to check each budget line. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.
