steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有心力放在升級隔振腳，卻忽略空調出風口正對光路，干涉訊號仍在數分鐘週期內漂移數百奈米；這類漂移與振動頻譜無關，換再好的隔振器也不會改善。
knowledge.textEn: Investing everything in better legs while an HVAC outlet blows across the beam path still leaves the interference signal drifting hundreds of nanometres with a period of minutes; such drift is unrelated to the vibration spectrum and no isolator upgrade will fix it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把所有心力放在升級隔振腳，卻忽略空調出風口正對光路，干涉訊號仍在數分鐘週期內漂移數百奈米；這類漂移與振動頻譜無關，換再好的隔振器也不會改善。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
optionsEn: Investing everything in better legs while an HVAC outlet blows across the beam path still leaves the interference signal drifting hundreds of nanometres with a period of minutes.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
quiz.explanation: 把所有心力放在升級隔振腳，卻忽略空調出風口正對光路，干涉訊號仍在數分鐘週期內漂移數百奈米；這類漂移與振動頻譜無關，換再好的隔振器也不會改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Investing everything in better legs while an HVAC outlet blows across the beam path still leaves the interference signal drifting hundreds of nanometres with a period of minutes; such drift is unrelated to the vibration spectrum and no isolator upgrade will fix it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合」與「現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration" and "Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主動隔振控制迴路」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active isolation control loop” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。主動系統的極限來自感測器：水平慣性感測器無法區分水平加速度與地面傾斜造成的重力分量 g·θ，低頻時傾斜雜訊會被當成運動注入桌面。此外，酬載的重心高度、本身的結構共振與桌面耦合，會限制控制頻寬並可能造成不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. Its limit is the sensor: a horizontal inertial sensor cannot distinguish horizontal acceleration from the gravity component g·θ due to ground tilt, so at low frequency tilt noise is read as motion and injected into the top. In addition, payload center-of-gravity height, the payload's own structural resonances and their coupling to the top limit control bandwidth and can cause instability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation control loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主動隔振控制迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active isolation control loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合
knowledge.titleEn: Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration
knowledge.text: 被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。主動系統的極限來自感測器：水平慣性感測器無法區分水平加速度與地面傾斜造成的重力分量 g·θ，低頻時傾斜雜訊會被當成運動注入桌面。
knowledge.textEn: Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. Its limit is the sensor: a horizontal inertial sensor cannot distinguish horizontal acceleration from the gravity component g·θ due to ground tilt, so at low frequency tilt noise is read as motion and injected into the top.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration" is correct?
options: 主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效。
纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。
optionsEn: Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it.
Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.
quiz.explanation: 被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動隔振控制迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active isolation control loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。在 3 Hz 迴路增益 G = 30 時，殘餘運動降為被動值的 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032（約 −30 dB）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz. With a loop gain G = 30 at 3 Hz, residual motion falls to 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032 of the passive value, about −30 dB. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°；在桌面上加入或移動酬載後重測，確認沒有新的振盪；同時記錄低頻水平感測器輸出與傾斜計，檢查兩者在 0.1 Hz 以下是否高度相干。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°; re-measure after adding or moving payload to confirm no new oscillation; log the low-frequency horizontal sensor output together with a tiltmeter and check whether they are highly coherent below 0.1 Hz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。在 3 Hz 迴路增益 G = 30 時，殘餘運動降為被動值的 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032（約 −30 dB）。
knowledge.textEn: A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz. With a loop gain G = 30 at 3 Hz, residual motion falls to 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032 of the passive value, about −30 dB.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration", which statement holds?
options: 樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。
傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。
optionsEn: A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.

A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz.
quiz.explanation: 傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主動隔振控制迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active isolation control loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°；在桌面上加入或移動酬載後重測，確認沒有新的振盪；同時記錄低頻水平感測器輸出與傾斜計，檢查兩者在 0.1 Hz 以下是否高度相干。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°; re-measure after adding or moving payload to confirm no new oscillation; log the low-frequency horizontal sensor output together with a tiltmeter and check whether they are highly coherent below 0.1 Hz. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在主動平台上加裝高而柔的酬載（例如長立柱上的真空腔），其擺動模態落在控制頻寬內，迴路相位被吃掉，平台在數 Hz 自激振盪，振幅比關閉主動控制時還大。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Adding a tall, compliant payload such as a vacuum chamber on a long column puts its rocking mode inside the control bandwidth, eats the loop's phase, and makes the platform self-oscillate at a few hertz with more amplitude than with active control switched off.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°；在桌面上加入或移動酬載後重測，確認沒有新的振盪；同時記錄低頻水平感測器輸出與傾斜計，檢查兩者在 0.1 Hz 以下是否高度相干。
knowledge.textEn: Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°; re-measure after adding or moving payload to confirm no new oscillation; log the low-frequency horizontal sensor output together with a tiltmeter and check whether they are highly coherent below 0.1 Hz.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration"?
options: 量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。
optionsEn: Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.
quiz.explanation: 量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°；在桌面上加入或移動酬載後重測，確認沒有新的振盪；同時記錄低頻水平感測器輸出與傾斜計，檢查兩者在 0.1 Hz 以下是否高度相干。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°; re-measure after adding or moving payload to confirm no new oscillation; log the low-frequency horizontal sensor output together with a tiltmeter and check whether they are highly coherent below 0.1 Hz. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動隔振控制迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Active isolation control loop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在主動平台上加裝高而柔的酬載（例如長立柱上的真空腔），其擺動模態落在控制頻寬內，迴路相位被吃掉，平台在數 Hz 自激振盪，振幅比關閉主動控制時還大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Adding a tall, compliant payload such as a vacuum chamber on a long column puts its rocking mode inside the control bandwidth, eats the loop's phase, and makes the platform self-oscillate at a few hertz with more amplitude than with active control switched off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此外，酬載的重心高度、本身的結構共振與桌面耦合，會限制控制頻寬並可能造成不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In addition, payload center-of-gravity height, the payload's own structural resonances and their coupling to the top limit control bandwidth and can cause instability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoses, cables and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 實驗室中的平台很少只靠隔振腳支撐：真空管、冷卻水管、電纜與光纖都把桌面和地面或振動源直接相連，形成繞過隔振器的振動短路。這些路徑的剛度與隔振器並聯，提高等效 f₀，更嚴重的是把泵或冷卻機的振動直接送上桌面。安裝時要讓管線以柔性迴圈先錨定在地面或獨立支架上，再接到桌面；驗收則在實際運轉狀態（泵、冷卻機、空調全開）量測桌面頻譜、傳遞率、柔度、沉降時間與溫度漂移，並把基準資料交接給使用者以便日後比對。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a real laboratory a platform rarely rests on its legs alone: vacuum hoses, cooling-water lines, cables and fibres tie the top directly to the floor or to vibration sources, forming short circuits that bypass the isolators. Their stiffness acts in parallel with the isolators and raises the effective f0, and worse, they carry pump or chiller vibration straight onto the top. Installation should route lines in compliant loops anchored first to the floor or an independent stand before reaching the top; acceptance then measures the tabletop spectrum, transmissibility, compliance, settling time and thermal drift under real operating conditions with pumps, chillers and HVAC running, and hands the baseline data to users for later comparison. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hoses, cables and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1000 kg 桌面、f₀ = 1.5 Hz 時隔振器總剛度 k = m(2πf₀)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m；並聯一條 2×10⁴ N/m 的真空波紋管後 f₀ 升到 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 1000 kg top with f0 = 1.5 Hz, the total isolator stiffness is k = m(2πf0)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m; adding a 2×10⁴ N/m vacuum bellows in parallel raises f0 to 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hoses, cables and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoses, cables and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1000 kg 桌面、f₀ = 1.5 Hz 時隔振器總剛度 k = m(2πf₀)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m；並聯一條 2×10⁴ N/m 的真空波紋管後 f₀ 升到 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz。更關鍵的是直接路徑：泵端 25 Hz、1 µm 的振動經波紋管傳到桌面約 k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm，與 VC-C 樓板經隔振器傳入的約 1.0 nm 同一量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 1000 kg top with f0 = 1.5 Hz, the total isolator stiffness is k = m(2πf0)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m; adding a 2×10⁴ N/m vacuum bellows in parallel raises f0 to 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz. The direct path matters more: 1 µm of 25 Hz motion at the pump end reaches the top as about k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm, the same order as the roughly 1.0 nm arriving from a VC-C floor through the isolators. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻；另以 50 kg 負載偏心加載量沉降時間與水平恢復，24 小時溫度與相對位移紀錄一併歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running; the spectral difference is the short-circuit contribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1000 kg 桌面、f₀ = 1.5 Hz 時隔振器總剛度 k = m(2πf₀)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m；並聯一條 2×10⁴ N/m 的真空波紋管後 f₀ 升到 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz。更關鍵的是直接路徑：泵端 25 Hz、1 µm 的振動經波紋管傳到桌面約 k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm，與 VC-C 樓板經隔振器傳入的約 1.0 nm 同一量級。
knowledge.textEn: For a 1000 kg top with f0 = 1.5 Hz, the total isolator stiffness is k = m(2πf0)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m; adding a 2×10⁴ N/m vacuum bellows in parallel raises f0 to 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz. The direct path matters more: 1 µm of 25 Hz motion at the pump end reaches the top as about k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm, the same order as the roughly 1.0 nm arriving from a VC-C floor through the isolators.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff", which statement holds?

The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.

steps.title: 現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hoses, cables and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻；另以 50 kg 負載偏心加載量沉降時間與水平恢復，24 小時溫度與相對位移紀錄一併歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running; the spectral difference is the short-circuit contribution. Also apply an off-center 50 kg load to measure settling time and level recovery, and archive a 24-hour record of temperature and relative displacement with the results. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接後使用者為了整齊，把纜線用束帶緊緊固定在桌腳與桌面之間，10 到 50 Hz 的隔振效果損失一個數量級，卻沒有人拿半年前的驗收頻譜比對，問題被誤判為樓板惡化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After handoff, users tidy cables by strapping them tightly between the legs and the top, losing an order of magnitude of isolation from 10 to 50 Hz, yet nobody compares against the acceptance spectrum from six months earlier and the problem is misdiagnosed as a deteriorating floor.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻；另以 50 kg 負載偏心加載量沉降時間與水平恢復，24 小時溫度與相對位移紀錄一併歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running; the spectral difference is the short-circuit contribution. Also apply an off-center 50 kg load to measure settling time and level recovery, and archive a 24-hour record of temperature and relative displacement with the results.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻。
只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running.
Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
quiz.explanation: 驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻；另以 50 kg 負載偏心加載量沉降時間與水平恢復，24 小時溫度與相對位移紀錄一併歸檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running; the spectral difference is the short-circuit contribution. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hoses, cables and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接後使用者為了整齊，把纜線用束帶緊緊固定在桌腳與桌面之間，10 到 50 Hz 的隔振效果損失一個數量級，卻沒有人拿半年前的驗收頻譜比對，問題被誤判為樓板惡化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After handoff, users tidy cables by strapping them tightly between the legs and the top, losing an order of magnitude of isolation from 10 to 50 Hz, yet nobody compares against the acceptance spectrum from six months earlier and the problem is misdiagnosed as a deteriorating floor. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝時要讓管線以柔性迴圈先錨定在地面或獨立支架上，再接到桌面；驗收則在實際運轉狀態（泵、冷卻機、空調全開）量測桌面頻譜、傳遞率、柔度、沉降時間與溫度漂移，並把基準資料交接給使用者以便日後比對。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Installation should route lines in compliant loops anchored first to the floor or an independent stand before reaching the top; acceptance then measures the tabletop spectrum, transmissibility, compliance, settling time and thermal drift under real operating conditions with pumps, chillers and HVAC running, and hands the baseline data to users for later comparison.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 同步輻射儲存環
summary: 以一座 3 GeV、528 m 的教學用多彎消色散儲存環為主線，從同步輻射造成的每圈 430 keV 能量損失出發，說明發射度為何隨彎轉角三次方下降，再把小孔徑磁鐵、射頻補能、束流尺寸量測、Touschek 壽命、插件磁鐵擾動與頂注驗收整合成可交接的光源工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Follow a 3 GeV, 528 m teaching multi-bend-achromat storage ring from the 430 keV per-turn energy loss caused by synchrotron radiation, see why emittance falls with the cube of the bending angle, then integrate small-bore magnets, RF energy replacement, beam-size measurement, Touschek lifetime, insertion-device perturbations and top-up acceptance into a transferable light-source engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 晶格升級練習：同一條 528 m、3 GeV 的隧道，比較 24 晶胞 DBA（48 片彎轉磁鐵，每片 1.4 m）與 20 晶胞 7BA（140 片，總彎轉長度 104.8 m）。DBA：ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m、B ≈ 0.94 T、U₀ = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV、εc ≈ 5.6 keV、τ_x = 2E·T₀/U₀ ≈ 15.8 ms，TME 極限 637 pm。7BA：ρ = 16.7 m、B = 0.6 T、U₀ ≈ 430 keV、εc ≈ 3.59 keV、τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms，TME 極限 25.7 pm。500 mA 下彎轉磁鐵輻射功率從 335 kW 降到 215 kW，射頻負擔減輕，但阻尼變慢、εc 變低，硬 X 光改由插件磁鐵提供。若兩者實際發射度都約為 TME 的 4 倍（2.55 nm 對 103 pm），垂直發射度相同，則加上 1 Å 光子的 8 pm 後，水平有效光源發射度從 2.56 nm 降到 111 pm，波盪器亮度約提高 23 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Lattice upgrade exercise: in the same 528 m, 3 GeV tunnel compare a 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles of 1.4 m) with a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, 104.8 m of total bending length). DBA: ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m, B ≈ 0.94 T, U0 = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV, εc ≈ 5.6 keV, τ_x = 2E·T0/U0 ≈ 15.8 ms and a TME limit of 637 pm. 7BA: ρ = 16.7 m, B = 0.6 T, U0 ≈ 430 keV, εc ≈ 3.59 keV, τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms and a TME limit of 25.7 pm. At 500 mA the dipole radiation power falls from 335 kW to 215 kW, easing the RF load, but damping slows and εc drops, so hard X-rays must come from insertion devices. If both lattices reach about 4 times their TME limit (2.55 nm versus 103 pm) with equal vertical emittance, adding the 8 pm photon term at 1 Å gives a horizontal effective source emittance falling from 2.56 nm to 111 pm, raising undulator brightness about 23-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量」與「發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy" and "Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bending magnet and radiation cone” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存環讓數 GeV 的電子在磁場中持續偏轉，相對論電子偏轉時沿切線方向放出張角約 1/γ 的同步輻射光錐，每一圈損失的能量 U₀ 必須由射頻腔補回。U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，這是電子而非質子適合當光源的原因；輻射頻譜以臨界能量 εc 描述，一半功率在 εc 以上、一半在以下。輻射同時是阻尼機制：能量沿動量方向損失、射頻只在縱向補回，使振盪逐漸衰減，並與量子激發的隨機擾動達成平衡，決定環的平衡發射度與能量散佈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A storage ring keeps electrons of several GeV bending in magnetic fields, and relativistic electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially in a cone of opening about 1/γ; the energy U0 lost each turn must be restored by RF cavities. U0 scales as E⁴/ρ, which is why electrons rather than protons make light sources, and the spectrum is described by the critical energy εc, with half the power above it and half below. Radiation is also a damping mechanism: energy is lost along the momentum direction but replaced by RF only longitudinally, so oscillations decay until balanced by the random kicks of quantum excitation, which sets the ring's equilibrium emittance and energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending magnet and radiation cone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW; εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bending magnet and radiation cone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy" is correct?
options: 儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
儲存環讓數 GeV 的電子在磁場中持續偏轉，相對論電子偏轉時沿切線方向放出張角約 1/γ 的同步輻射光錐，每一圈損失的能量 U₀ 必須由射頻腔補回。
只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。
optionsEn: Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.
A storage ring keeps electrons of several GeV bending in magnetic fields, and relativistic electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially in a cone of opening about 1/γ.
Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance.
quiz.explanation: 儲存環讓數 GeV 的電子在磁場中持續偏轉，相對論電子偏轉時沿切線方向放出張角約 1/γ 的同步輻射光錐，每一圈損失的能量 U₀ 必須由射頻腔補回。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A storage ring keeps electrons of several GeV bending in magnetic fields, and relativistic electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially in a cone of opening about 1/γ; the energy U0 lost each turn must be restored by RF cavities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bending magnet and radiation cone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = 3 GeV、彎轉場 B = 0.6 T：ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m，U₀ = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV，500 mA 時輻射功率 U₀·I ≈ 215 kW；εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV。周長 528 m、迴轉週期 T₀ = 1.76 µs，阻尼時間 τ = 2E·T₀/(J·U₀)：縱向（J ≈ 2）約 12.3 ms、水平（J ≈ 1）約 24.6 ms；自然能量散佈 σδ = γ√(C_q/(2ρ)) ≈ 6.3×10⁻⁴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW; εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV. With a 528 m circumference the revolution period is T0 = 1.76 µs and the damping time τ = 2E·T0/(J·U0) is about 12.3 ms longitudinally (J ≈ 2) and 24.6 ms horizontally (J ≈ 1); the natural energy spread is σδ = γ√(C_q/(2ρ)) ≈ 6.3×10⁻⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以射頻順向功率與腔壓讀數量測不同儲存電流下的束流功率，斜率即為每圈損失 U₀（扣除插件磁鐵貢獻後）；以光束線的光通量對能量曲線擬合臨界能量，並以條紋相機或束流頻譜量同步振盪頻率，與由 U₀ 推算的同步相位比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam power from RF forward-power and cavity-voltage readings at several stored currents; the slope gives the energy loss per turn U0 once insertion-device contributions are removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW; εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV. With a 528 m circumference the revolution period is T0 = 1.76 µs and the damping time τ = 2E·T0/(J·U0) is about 12.3 ms longitudinally (J ≈ 2) and 24.6 ms horizontally (J ≈ 1); the natural energy spread is σδ = γ√(C_q/(2ρ)) ≈ 6.3×10⁻⁴.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy", which statement holds?
options: 腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。
發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。
optionsEn: A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam.
Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.
For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW.
quiz.explanationEn: For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW; εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bending magnet and radiation cone” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以射頻順向功率與腔壓讀數量測不同儲存電流下的束流功率，斜率即為每圈損失 U₀（扣除插件磁鐵貢獻後）；以光束線的光通量對能量曲線擬合臨界能量，並以條紋相機或束流頻譜量同步振盪頻率，與由 U₀ 推算的同步相位比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam power from RF forward-power and cavity-voltage readings at several stored currents; the slope gives the energy loss per turn U0 once insertion-device contributions are removed. Fit the critical energy to a beamline's flux-versus-energy curve, and measure the synchrotron oscillation frequency with a streak camera or the beam spectrum to compare with the synchronous phase predicted from U0. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只用彎轉磁鐵估 U₀ 而漏算插件磁鐵，射頻電壓與功率留得太緊；所有插件磁鐵關閉間隙後同步相位上移、能量接受度下降，Touschek 壽命突然縮短，甚至在注入時掉束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Estimating U0 from the dipoles alone and forgetting insertion devices leaves too little RF voltage and power; when all insertion devices close their gaps the synchronous phase rises, energy acceptance shrinks, and Touschek lifetime suddenly drops or beam is lost at injection.

knowledge.textEn: Measure beam power from RF forward-power and cavity-voltage readings at several stored currents; the slope gives the energy loss per turn U0 once insertion-device contributions are removed. Fit the critical energy to a beamline's flux-versus-energy curve, and measure the synchrotron oscillation frequency with a streak camera or the beam spectrum to compare with the synchronous phase predicted from U0.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bending magnet and radiation cone” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只用彎轉磁鐵估 U₀ 而漏算插件磁鐵，射頻電壓與功率留得太緊；所有插件磁鐵關閉間隙後同步相位上移、能量接受度下降，Touschek 壽命突然縮短，甚至在注入時掉束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating U0 from the dipoles alone and forgetting insertion devices leaves too little RF voltage and power; when all insertion devices close their gaps the synchronous phase rises, energy acceptance shrinks, and Touschek lifetime suddenly drops or beam is lost at injection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輻射同時是阻尼機制：能量沿動量方向損失、射頻只在縱向補回，使振盪逐漸衰減，並與量子激發的隨機擾動達成平衡，決定環的平衡發射度與能量散佈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Radiation is also a damping mechanism: energy is lost along the momentum direction but replaced by RF only longitudinally, so oscillations decay until balanced by the random kicks of quantum excitation, which sets the ring's equilibrium emittance and energy spread.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「多彎消色散晶胞」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multi-bend achromat cell” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。量子激發發生在色散不為零的彎轉磁鐵內，因此每片磁鐵的彎轉角 θ 越小、色散函數越小，發射度越低；理論最小值（TME）與 γ²θ³ 成正比。第三代光源每個晶胞只用兩片彎轉磁鐵（DBA），第四代改用五到七片（MBA），在同一周長中把磁鐵數提高到約 3 倍，發射度因 θ³ 降低一個數量級以上，代價是更強的四極與六極磁鐵、更小的動態孔徑與更困難的注入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多彎消色散晶胞」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence. Quantum excitation occurs in dipoles where dispersion is non-zero, so a smaller bending angle θ per magnet and smaller dispersion give lower emittance; the theoretical minimum (TME) scales as γ²θ³. Third-generation rings use two dipoles per cell (DBA), while fourth-generation rings use five to seven (MBA), roughly tripling the dipole count in the same circumference and cutting emittance by more than an order of magnitude through θ³, at the price of stronger quadrupoles and sextupoles, a smaller dynamic aperture and harder injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-bend achromat cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：TME 極限 ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x)，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m、γ = 5871。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The TME limit is ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x) with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m and γ = 5871.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「多彎消色散晶胞」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Multi-bend achromat cell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格
knowledge.titleEn: Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices
knowledge.text: 水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。量子激發發生在色散不為零的彎轉磁鐵內，因此每片磁鐵的彎轉角 θ 越小、色散函數越小，發射度越低；理論最小值（TME）與 γ²θ³ 成正比。
knowledge.textEn: The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence. Quantum excitation occurs in dipoles where dispersion is non-zero, so a smaller bending angle θ per magnet and smaller dispersion give lower emittance; the theoretical minimum (TME) scales as γ²θ³.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices" is correct?
options: 只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。
磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。
水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。
optionsEn: Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance.
A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam.
The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence.
quiz.explanation: 水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多彎消色散晶胞」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multi-bend achromat cell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：TME 極限 ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x)，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m、γ = 5871。24 晶胞 DBA（48 片，θ = 0.131 rad）：ε_min ≈ 637 pm；20 晶胞 7BA（140 片，θ = 0.0449 rad）：ε_min ≈ 25.7 pm，比值 (140/48)³ ≈ 24.8。實際晶格受動態孔徑限制，通常落在理論值的數倍，取 4 倍約 100 pm；1 Å X 光的繞射極限 λ/4π ≈ 8 pm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The TME limit is ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x) with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m and γ = 5871. A 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles, θ = 0.131 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 637 pm; a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, θ = 0.0449 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 25.7 pm, a ratio (140/48)³ ≈ 24.8. Real lattices are limited by dynamic aperture and usually sit several times above the limit; taking a factor of 4 gives about 100 pm, compared with the diffraction limit λ/4π ≈ 8 pm for 1 Å X-rays. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以晶格程式（如 MAD-X、Elegant、AT）計算線性光學與發射度，再追蹤粒子求動態孔徑與動量接受度；試運轉時以響應矩陣分析（LOCO 類方法）反推實際四極強度與色散，並用光源點尺寸量測反推發射度，三者必須互相一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute linear optics and emittance with a lattice code such as MAD-X, Elegant or AT, then track particles to obtain dynamic aperture and momentum acceptance; during commissioning infer actual quadrupole strengths and dispersion with response-matrix analysis (LOCO-type methods) and emittance from source-size measurements, and require all three to agree.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles, θ = 0.131 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 637 pm; a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, θ = 0.0449 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 25.7 pm, a ratio (140/48)³ ≈ 24.8. steps.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「多彎消色散晶胞」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Multi-bend achromat cell” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以晶格程式（如 MAD-X、Elegant、AT）計算線性光學與發射度，再追蹤粒子求動態孔徑與動量接受度；試運轉時以響應矩陣分析（LOCO 類方法）反推實際四極強度與色散，並用光源點尺寸量測反推發射度，三者必須互相一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute linear optics and emittance with a lattice code such as MAD-X, Elegant or AT, then track particles to obtain dynamic aperture and momentum acceptance; during commissioning infer actual quadrupole strengths and dispersion with response-matrix analysis (LOCO-type methods) and emittance from source-size measurements, and require all three to agree. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求最低發射度把晶格推到極限，六極磁鐵強度過大，動態孔徑只剩數毫米，注入效率長期偏低且對磁鐵誤差極敏感；機器可以達到設計發射度，卻無法穩定做頂注運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pushing the lattice to its limit for the lowest emittance needs sextupoles so strong that dynamic aperture shrinks to a few millimetres, leaving injection efficiency chronically low and very sensitive to magnet errors; the machine reaches design emittance but cannot sustain top-up operation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以晶格程式（如 MAD-X、Elegant、AT）計算線性光學與發射度，再追蹤粒子求動態孔徑與動量接受度；試運轉時以響應矩陣分析（LOCO 類方法）反推實際四極強度與色散，並用光源點尺寸量測反推發射度，三者必須互相一致。
knowledge.textEn: Compute linear optics and emittance with a lattice code such as MAD-X, Elegant or AT, then track particles to obtain dynamic aperture and momentum acceptance; during commissioning infer actual quadrupole strengths and dispersion with response-matrix analysis (LOCO-type methods) and emittance from source-size measurements, and require all three to agree.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

steps.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多彎消色散晶胞」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Multi-bend achromat cell” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求最低發射度把晶格推到極限，六極磁鐵強度過大，動態孔徑只剩數毫米，注入效率長期偏低且對磁鐵誤差極敏感；機器可以達到設計發射度，卻無法穩定做頂注運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing the lattice to its limit for the lowest emittance needs sextupoles so strong that dynamic aperture shrinks to a few millimetres, leaving injection efficiency chronically low and very sensitive to magnet errors; the machine reaches design emittance but cannot sustain top-up operation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：第三代光源每個晶胞只用兩片彎轉磁鐵（DBA），第四代改用五到七片（MBA），在同一周長中把磁鐵數提高到約 3 倍，發射度因 θ³ 降低一個數量級以上，代價是更強的四極與六極磁鐵、更小的動態孔徑與更困難的注入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Third-generation rings use two dipoles per cell (DBA), while fourth-generation rings use five to seven (MBA), roughly tripling the dipole count in the same circumference and cutting emittance by more than an order of magnitude through θ³, at the price of stronger quadrupoles and sextupoles, a smaller dynamic aperture and harder injection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差」與「射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances" and "RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: MBA 晶格要求 50 T/m 以上的四極梯度與很強的六極，鐵芯磁極尖端磁場 B_tip = G·r 必須低於鐵的飽和（設計上約 1 T 以下較安全），因此只能縮小孔徑；孔徑縮小又讓所需安匝數按 r² 下降，磁鐵更小、更省電，但真空管只剩約 20 mm 內徑。磁鐵以數十微米精度預先對準在共同的磁鐵座上，再整座安裝；四極磁鐵偏離束流中心 Δx 時會給電子一個偏轉 θ = K₁L·Δx，經閉合軌道放大後，整圈軌道都會偏移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: MBA lattices need quadrupole gradients above 50 T/m and very strong sextupoles, and the iron pole-tip field B_tip = G·r must stay below saturation, safely under about 1 T, so the bore must shrink; a smaller bore also cuts the required ampere-turns as r², making magnets smaller and cheaper to power, but leaves only about 20 mm inner diameter for the vacuum chamber. Magnets are pre-aligned to tens of micrometres on common girders that are installed as units; a quadrupole offset Δx from the beam axis gives the electrons a kick θ = K1L·Δx that the closed orbit amplifies around the whole ring. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每極安匝 NI = G·r²/(2μ₀)：G = 50 T/m、r = 12.5 mm 時 NI ≈ 3110 A·turn、B_tip = 0.625 T；若 r = 35 mm，NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn（7.8 倍，功耗約 61 倍），且 B_tip = 1.75 T 已超過鐵的飽和。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ampere-turns per pole are NI = G·r²/(2μ0): with G = 50 T/m and r = 12.5 mm, NI ≈ 3110 A·turn and B_tip = 0.625 T; at r = 35 mm, NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn (7.8 times, about 61 times the power) and B_tip = 1.75 T is beyond iron saturation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances

Magnets are pre-aligned to tens of micrometres on common girders that are installed as units; a quadrupole offset Δx from the beam axis gives the electrons a kick θ = K1L·Δx that the closed orbit amplifies around the whole ring.

steps.title: 磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每極安匝 NI = G·r²/(2μ₀)：G = 50 T/m、r = 12.5 mm 時 NI ≈ 3110 A·turn、B_tip = 0.625 T；若 r = 35 mm，NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn（7.8 倍，功耗約 61 倍），且 B_tip = 1.75 T 已超過鐵的飽和。偏移：Bρ = 10.0 T·m、L = 0.25 m，K₁L ≈ 1.25 m⁻¹，Δx = 30 µm 產生 37.5 µrad；兩處 β = 5 m、工作點 ν = 42.2 時閉合軌道最大偏移 ≈ β/(2|sin πν|)×θ ≈ 4.25 m×37.5 µrad ≈ 159 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ampere-turns per pole are NI = G·r²/(2μ0): with G = 50 T/m and r = 12.5 mm, NI ≈ 3110 A·turn and B_tip = 0.625 T; at r = 35 mm, NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn (7.8 times, about 61 times the power) and B_tip = 1.75 T is beyond iron saturation. Offset: with Bρ = 10.0 T·m and L = 0.25 m, K1L ≈ 1.25 m⁻¹, so Δx = 30 µm gives 37.5 µrad; with β = 5 m at both locations and tune ν = 42.2, the peak closed-orbit shift ≈ β/(2|sin πν|)×θ ≈ 4.25 m×37.5 µrad ≈ 159 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差；上座後以雷射追蹤儀量磁鐵座相對位置；運轉時以束流基準對準（調變單一四極強度、找出軌道不變的位置）反推每個四極相對 BPM 的偏移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials; after mounting, survey girder positions with a laser tracker; in operation, use beam-based alignment, modulating one quadrupole and finding where the orbit stops changing, to infer each quadrupole's offset from its BPM.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
