steps.title: 磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差；上座後以雷射追蹤儀量磁鐵座相對位置；運轉時以束流基準對準（調變單一四極強度、找出軌道不變的位置）反推每個四極相對 BPM 的偏移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials; after mounting, survey girder positions with a laser tracker; in operation, use beam-based alignment, modulating one quadrupole and finding where the orbit stops changing, to infer each quadrupole's offset from its BPM. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差；軌道回授雖能補正，但修正子強度逐月爬升，最終耗盡修正範圍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight; tens of micrometres of movement accumulate into hundreds of micrometres of orbit error, and although orbit feedback compensates, corrector strengths creep upward month by month until their range is exhausted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差；上座後以雷射追蹤儀量磁鐵座相對位置；運轉時以束流基準對準（調變單一四極強度、找出軌道不變的位置）反推每個四極相對 BPM 的偏移。
knowledge.textEn: At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials; after mounting, survey girder positions with a laser tracker; in operation, use beam-based alignment, modulating one quadrupole and finding where the orbit stops changing, to infer each quadrupole's offset from its BPM.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.
At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差；上座後以雷射追蹤儀量磁鐵座相對位置；運轉時以束流基準對準（調變單一四極強度、找出軌道不變的位置）反推每個四極相對 BPM 的偏移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials; after mounting, survey girder positions with a laser tracker; in operation, use beam-based alignment, modulating one quadrupole and finding where the orbit stops changing, to infer each quadrupole's offset from its BPM. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差；軌道回授雖能補正，但修正子強度逐月爬升，最終耗盡修正範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight; tens of micrometres of movement accumulate into hundreds of micrometres of orbit error, and although orbit feedback compensates, corrector strengths creep upward month by month until their range is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：磁鐵以數十微米精度預先對準在共同的磁鐵座上，再整座安裝；四極磁鐵偏離束流中心 Δx 時會給電子一個偏轉 θ = K₁L·Δx，經閉合軌道放大後，整圈軌道都會偏移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Magnets are pre-aligned to tens of micrometres on common girders that are installed as units; a quadrupole offset Δx from the beam axis gives the electrons a kick θ = K1L·Δx that the closed orbit amplifies around the whole ring.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差；軌道回授雖能補正，但修正子強度逐月爬升，最終耗盡修正範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight; tens of micrometres of movement accumulate into hundreds of micrometres of orbit error, and although orbit feedback compensates, corrector strengths creep upward month by month until their range is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。
optionsEn: Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam.
quiz.explanation: 磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差；軌道回授雖能補正，但修正子強度逐月爬升，最終耗盡修正範圍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight; tens of micrometres of movement accumulate into hundreds of micrometres of orbit error, and although orbit feedback compensates, corrector strengths creep upward month by month until their range is exhausted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「射頻腔與高功率放大器」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。早到與晚到的電子拿到不同能量，在色散造成的路徑差下繞同步點做縱向同步振盪，形成束團；腔壓相對 U₀ 的過電壓比 q 決定 RF 桶的高度，也就是可容許的能量偏差。射頻功率除了供給束流損失，還要支付腔壁的歐姆損耗，並隨插件磁鐵間隙改變而變動，因此低階射頻控制（LLRF）必須穩住振幅與相位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻腔與高功率放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0. Early and late electrons gain different energies and, through the path-length difference caused by dispersion, perform longitudinal synchrotron oscillations about the synchronous point, forming bunches; the overvoltage ratio q of cavity voltage to U0 sets the height of the RF bucket, the tolerable energy deviation. RF power must cover the beam loss plus cavity wall losses and changes as insertion-device gaps move, so the low-level RF control must hold amplitude and phase steady. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「射頻腔與高功率放大器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度
knowledge.titleEn: RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance
knowledge.text: 射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。早到與晚到的電子拿到不同能量，在色散造成的路徑差下繞同步點做縱向同步振盪，形成束團；腔壓相對 U₀ 的過電壓比 q 決定 RF 桶的高度，也就是可容許的能量偏差。
knowledge.textEn: RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0. Early and late electrons gain different energies and, through the path-length difference caused by dispersion, perform longitudinal synchrotron oscillations about the synchronous point, forming bunches; the overvoltage ratio q of cavity voltage to U0 sets the height of the RF bucket, the tolerable energy deviation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance" is correct?
options: 腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。
射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。
拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。
optionsEn: A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam.
RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0.
The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response.
quiz.explanation: 射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「射頻腔與高功率放大器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：528 m、100 MHz：h = 176。U₀ = 430 keV（彎轉）+ 200 keV（插件）= 0.63 MeV，腔壓 V = 1.6 MV：q = 2.54，φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°。動量壓縮 α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ 時 RF 接受度 δ = √[(2U₀/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%，同步頻率 f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz。功率：束流 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW，六個腔各 R_s = 3 MΩ 的壁損 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW，共約 386 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176. With U0 = 430 keV from dipoles plus 200 keV from insertion devices, 0.63 MeV, and V = 1.6 MV, q = 2.54 and φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°. With momentum compaction α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ the RF acceptance δ = √[(2U0/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%, and the synchrotron frequency f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz. Power: beam 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW plus wall losses of six cavities with R_s = 3 MΩ, 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW, about 386 kW in total. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對；逐步降低腔壓直到壽命開始下降，判斷實際接受度由射頻還是由晶格動量接受度限制；高功率端記錄順向與反射功率、腔體溫度與調諧器位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings; lower the voltage step by step until lifetime begins to fall to find whether acceptance is limited by the RF or by the lattice momentum acceptance; on the high-power side log forward and reflected power, cavity temperatures and tuner positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 528 m、100 MHz：h = 176。U₀ = 430 keV（彎轉）+ 200 keV（插件）= 0.63 MeV，腔壓 V = 1.6 MV：q = 2.54，φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°。動量壓縮 α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ 時 RF 接受度 δ = √[(2U₀/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%，同步頻率 f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz。功率：束流 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW，六個腔各 R_s = 3 MΩ 的壁損 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW，共約 386 kW。
knowledge.textEn: For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176. With U0 = 430 keV from dipoles plus 200 keV from insertion devices, 0.63 MeV, and V = 1.6 MV, q = 2.54 and φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°. With momentum compaction α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ the RF acceptance δ = √[(2U0/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%, and the synchrotron frequency f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz. Power: beam 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW plus wall losses of six cavities with R_s = 3 MΩ, 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW, about 386 kW in total.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 插件磁鐵只影響自己的光束線，不影響其他使用者。
儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
optionsEn: An insertion device affects only its own beamline, not other users.
Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.
For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176.
quiz.explanation: 528 m、100 MHz：h = 176。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「射頻腔與高功率放大器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對；逐步降低腔壓直到壽命開始下降，判斷實際接受度由射頻還是由晶格動量接受度限制；高功率端記錄順向與反射功率、腔體溫度與調諧器位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings; lower the voltage step by step until lifetime begins to fall to find whether acceptance is limited by the RF or by the lattice momentum acceptance; on the high-power side log forward and reflected power, cavity temperatures and tuner positions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase; with insufficient tuning and LLRF feedforward, coupled-bunch instabilities develop, bunch length and energy spread oscillate, and beamlines see intensity and spot-position jitter in the kilohertz band.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對；逐步降低腔壓直到壽命開始下降，判斷實際接受度由射頻還是由晶格動量接受度限制；高功率端記錄順向與反射功率、腔體溫度與調諧器位置。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings; lower the voltage step by step until lifetime begins to fall to find whether acceptance is limited by the RF or by the lattice momentum acceptance; on the high-power side log forward and reflected power, cavity temperatures and tuner positions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance"?
options: 以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。
optionsEn: Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance.
quiz.explanation: 以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對；逐步降低腔壓直到壽命開始下降，判斷實際接受度由射頻還是由晶格動量接受度限制；高功率端記錄順向與反射功率、腔體溫度與調諧器位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings; lower the voltage step by step until lifetime begins to fall to find whether acceptance is limited by the RF or by the lattice momentum acceptance; on the high-power side log forward and reflected power, cavity temperatures and tuner positions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「射頻腔與高功率放大器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase; with insufficient tuning and LLRF feedforward, coupled-bunch instabilities develop, bunch length and energy spread oscillate, and beamlines see intensity and spot-position jitter in the kilohertz band. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：射頻功率除了供給束流損失，還要支付腔壁的歐姆損耗，並隨插件磁鐵間隙改變而變動，因此低階射頻控制（LLRF）必須穩住振幅與相位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: RF power must cover the beam loss plus cavity wall losses and changes as insertion-device gaps move, so the low-level RF control must hold amplitude and phase steady.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。
knowledge.textEn: At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase; with insufficient tuning and LLRF feedforward, coupled-bunch instabilities develop, bunch length and energy spread oscillate, and beamlines see intensity and spot-position jitter in the kilohertz band.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。
拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase.
The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response.
quiz.explanation: 高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase; with insufficient tuning and LLRF feedforward, coupled-bunch instabilities develop, bunch length and energy spread oscillate, and beamlines see intensity and spot-position jitter in the kilohertz band. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束流尺寸量測與發射度反推」與「束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion" and "Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「X 光針孔相機與光源點」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “X-ray pinhole camera and source point” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。MBA 環的垂直尺寸只有數微米，可見光成像受繞射限制而失效，必須用 X 光針孔相機、繞射式成像或同步光干涉儀。量到的是束流尺寸與儀器點擴散函數（PSF）的捲積，因此 PSF 的校正誤差會直接放大成發射度誤差，尤其當束流尺寸與 PSF 相當時。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光針孔相機與光源點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Emittance cannot be measured directly; it is inferred from a beam size somewhere through σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²), with β and dispersion η from lattice measurements and σδ from energy-spread measurement. Vertical sizes in an MBA ring are only a few micrometres, beyond diffraction-limited visible-light imaging, so X-ray pinhole cameras, diffractive imaging or synchrotron-light interferometers are used. The measured value is the beam size convolved with the instrument point-spread function (PSF), so PSF calibration error is amplified directly into emittance error, especially when beam size and PSF are comparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray pinhole camera and source point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光源點 β_x = 1 m、η = 5 mm、ε_x = 100 pm、σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴：σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm；若忽略色散項，反推 ε ≈ 110 pm，高估 10%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm; ignoring the dispersion term would infer ε ≈ 110 pm, 10% high.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「X 光針孔相機與光源點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “X-ray pinhole camera and source point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推
knowledge.text: 發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。MBA 環的垂直尺寸只有數微米，可見光成像受繞射限制而失效，必須用 X 光針孔相機、繞射式成像或同步光干涉儀。
knowledge.textEn: Emittance cannot be measured directly; it is inferred from a beam size somewhere through σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²), with β and dispersion η from lattice measurements and σδ from energy-spread measurement. Vertical sizes in an MBA ring are only a few micrometres, beyond diffraction-limited visible-light imaging, so X-ray pinhole cameras, diffractive imaging or synchrotron-light interferometers are used.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束流尺寸量測與發射度反推」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion" is correct?
options: 拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。
發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。
發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。
optionsEn: The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response.
Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.
Emittance cannot be measured directly.
quiz.explanation: 發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Emittance cannot be measured directly; it is inferred from a beam size somewhere through σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²), with β and dispersion η from lattice measurements and σδ from energy-spread measurement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「X 光針孔相機與光源點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “X-ray pinhole camera and source point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光源點 β_x = 1 m、η = 5 mm、ε_x = 100 pm、σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴：σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm；若忽略色散項，反推 ε ≈ 110 pm，高估 10%。垂直 β_y = 3 m、ε_y = 5 pm：σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm；PSF 3.0 µm 時量得 √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm，PSF 不確定 ±0.5 µm 造成 σ_y 誤差 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm（10%），ε_y 誤差約 20%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm; ignoring the dispersion term would infer ε ≈ 110 pm, 10% high. Vertically, β_y = 3 m and ε_y = 5 pm give σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm; with a 3.0 µm PSF the measured size is √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm, and a ±0.5 µm PSF uncertainty produces a σ_y error of 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm (10%), about 20% in ε_y. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ；PSF 以改變針孔尺寸或用已知的小尺寸光源校正；再以斜四極調整耦合改變 ε_y，確認量到的尺寸變化與模型一致，並與 Touschek 壽命隨 ε_y 的變化交叉驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ; calibrate the PSF by changing pinhole size or using a known small source; then change ε_y with skew quadrupoles and confirm that the measured size change follows the model, cross-checking against the variation of Touschek lifetime with ε_y.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光源點 β_x = 1 m、η = 5 mm、ε_x = 100 pm、σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴：σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm；若忽略色散項，反推 ε ≈ 110 pm，高估 10%。垂直 β_y = 3 m、ε_y = 5 pm：σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm；PSF 3.0 µm 時量得 √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm，PSF 不確定 ±0.5 µm 造成 σ_y 誤差 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm（10%），ε_y 誤差約 20%。
knowledge.textEn: At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm; ignoring the dispersion term would infer ε ≈ 110 pm, 10% high. Vertically, β_y = 3 m and ε_y = 5 pm give σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm; with a 3.0 µm PSF the measured size is √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm, and a ±0.5 µm PSF uncertainty produces a σ_y error of 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm (10%), about 20% in ε_y.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「束流尺寸量測與發射度反推」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion", which statement holds?
options: 頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。
只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。
optionsEn: At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm.
Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users.
Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance.
quiz.explanation: 光源點 β_x = 1 m、η = 5 mm、ε_x = 100 pm、σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴：σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm；若忽略色散項，反推 ε ≈ 110 pm，高估 10%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm; ignoring the dispersion term would infer ε ≈ 110 pm, 10% high. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「X 光針孔相機與光源點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “X-ray pinhole camera and source point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ；PSF 以改變針孔尺寸或用已知的小尺寸光源校正；再以斜四極調整耦合改變 ε_y，確認量到的尺寸變化與模型一致，並與 Touschek 壽命隨 ε_y 的變化交叉驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ; calibrate the PSF by changing pinhole size or using a known small source; then change ε_y with skew quadrupoles and confirm that the measured size change follows the model, cross-checking against the variation of Touschek lifetime with ε_y. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ；PSF 以改變針孔尺寸或用已知的小尺寸光源校正；再以斜四極調整耦合改變 ε_y，確認量到的尺寸變化與模型一致，並與 Touschek 壽命隨 ε_y 的變化交叉驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ; calibrate the PSF by changing pinhole size or using a known small source; then change ε_y with skew quadrupoles and confirm that the measured size change follows the model, cross-checking against the variation of Touschek lifetime with ε_y.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流尺寸量測與發射度反推」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ。
磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ.
A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam.
quiz.explanation: 在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ；PSF 以改變針孔尺寸或用已知的小尺寸光源校正；再以斜四極調整耦合改變 ε_y，確認量到的尺寸變化與模型一致，並與 Touschek 壽命隨 ε_y 的變化交叉驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ; calibrate the PSF by changing pinhole size or using a known small source; then change ε_y with skew quadrupoles and confirm that the measured size change follows the model, cross-checking against the variation of Touschek lifetime with ε_y. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「X 光針孔相機與光源點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “X-ray pinhole camera and source point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到的是束流尺寸與儀器點擴散函數（PSF）的捲積，因此 PSF 的校正誤差會直接放大成發射度誤差，尤其當束流尺寸與 PSF 相當時。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measured value is the beam size convolved with the instrument point-spread function (PSF), so PSF calibration error is amplified directly into emittance error, especially when beam size and PSF are comparable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。
knowledge.textEn: If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流尺寸量測與發射度反推」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。
針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.
If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value.
quiz.explanation: 針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「壽命監測與諧波腔」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。Touschek 散射是同一束團內兩顆電子碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向，使能量偏差超過動量接受度而損失；束團越密（發射度越小、束團越短）損失越快，因此低發射度環的壽命往往由 Touschek 主導。殘氣散射與真空壓力成正比，新安裝的真空腔要經過數百安培小時的束流清洗，讓光子誘發脫附下降。第三諧波腔把束團拉長數倍以降低電子密度，是 MBA 環延長壽命的標準手段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「壽命監測與諧波腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms. Touschek scattering is a collision between two electrons in the same bunch that converts transverse momentum into longitudinal, pushing the energy deviation beyond the momentum acceptance; the denser the bunch, with smaller emittance and shorter length, the faster the loss, so low-emittance rings are usually Touschek-dominated. Residual-gas scattering scales with vacuum pressure, and new chambers need hundreds of ampere-hours of beam conditioning to reduce photon-stimulated desorption. A third-harmonic cavity lengthens the bunch several times to lower electron density and is the standard way to extend lifetime in MBA rings. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「壽命監測與諧波腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算
knowledge.titleEn: Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget
knowledge.text: 儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。Touschek 散射是同一束團內兩顆電子碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向，使能量偏差超過動量接受度而損失；束團越密（發射度越小、束團越短）損失越快，因此低發射度環的壽命往往由 Touschek 主導。
knowledge.textEn: Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms. Touschek scattering is a collision between two electrons in the same bunch that converts transverse momentum into longitudinal, pushing the energy deviation beyond the momentum acceptance; the denser the bunch, with smaller emittance and shorter length, the faster the loss, so low-emittance rings are usually Touschek-dominated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget" is correct?
options: 儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。
發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。
插件磁鐵只影響自己的光束線，不影響其他使用者。
optionsEn: Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms.
Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.
An insertion device affects only its own beamline, not other users.
quiz.explanation: 儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壽命監測與諧波腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。束長 10 ps 時 τ_T = 6 h（教學假設），殘氣 τ_gas = 40 h：τ ≈ 5.2 h；諧波腔拉長到 40 ps 使 τ_T（∝ σ_s）變為 24 h：τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h。若晶格動量接受度從 3% 降到 2.5%，τ_T 約按接受度三次方縮為 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h，總壽命降到約 10.3 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas. With a 10 ps bunch, τ_T = 6 h (teaching assumption) and τ_gas = 40 h give τ ≈ 5.2 h; a harmonic cavity stretching bunches to 40 ps raises τ_T (∝ σ_s) to 24 h and τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h. If lattice momentum acceptance falls from 3% to 2.5%, τ_T shrinks roughly as the cube of acceptance to 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h and total lifetime to about 10.3 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 DCCT 量電流衰減率求壽命，並在總電流不變下改變束團填充模式（每束團電荷不同）以分離 Touschek 與殘氣項：Touschek 項隨每束團電荷變化，殘氣項只隨壓力變化；再以腔壓掃描與垂直耦合掃描確認壽命對接受度與 ε_y 的依存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive lifetime from the DCCT current-decay rate, and separate Touschek and gas terms by changing the fill pattern at constant total current: the Touschek term varies with charge per bunch, the gas term only with pressure; then scan RF voltage and vertical coupling to confirm the dependence of lifetime on acceptance and ε_y.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。束長 10 ps 時 τ_T = 6 h（教學假設），殘氣 τ_gas = 40 h：τ ≈ 5.2 h；諧波腔拉長到 40 ps 使 τ_T（∝ σ_s）變為 24 h：τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h。若晶格動量接受度從 3% 降到 2.5%，τ_T 約按接受度三次方縮為 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h，總壽命降到約 10.3 h。
knowledge.textEn: Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas. With a 10 ps bunch, τ_T = 6 h (teaching assumption) and τ_gas = 40 h give τ ≈ 5.2 h; a harmonic cavity stretching bunches to 40 ps raises τ_T (∝ σ_s) to 24 h and τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h. If lattice momentum acceptance falls from 3% to 2.5%, τ_T shrinks roughly as the cube of acceptance to 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h and total lifetime to about 10.3 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget", which statement holds?
options: 儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。
磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。
optionsEn: Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.
Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas.
A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam.
quiz.explanation: 總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 插件磁鐵或真空元件更換後未經充分束流清洗，局部壓力升高一個數量級，殘氣壽命從 40 h 掉到 4 h；散射電子同時在下游窄縫處提高輻射劑量，並帶來波盪器磁鐵永久退磁的風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動」與「頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations" and "Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波盪器間隙與前饋表」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undulator gap and feedforward tables” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存環的主要光源是直線段中的插件磁鐵：波盪器以週期 λu 的交錯磁場讓電子小幅蛇行，輻射在特定波長干涉增強，光子能量以間隙調整 K 值；扭擺器則以強場產生寬頻、高功率的輻射。每支插件磁鐵都是環的一部分：它增加每圈能量損失與射頻負擔，產生垂直聚焦而改變工作點，磁場積分誤差在間隙變動時擾動軌道，因此每支插件磁鐵都要附帶以間隙為索引的修正子與四極前饋表。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器間隙與前饋表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A storage ring's main sources are insertion devices in the straights: an undulator's alternating field of period λu makes electrons snake gently so radiation interferes constructively at specific wavelengths, with photon energy tuned by gap through K; a wiggler uses strong fields for broadband, high-power radiation. Each device becomes part of the ring: it adds energy loss per turn and RF load, produces vertical focusing that shifts the tune, and its field-integral errors disturb the orbit as the gap moves, so every insertion device carries gap-indexed corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator gap and feedforward tables”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For λu = 2.0 cm and B0 = 0.8 T, K = 0.934×0.8×2.0 ≈ 1.49 and the fundamental E1 = 0.950×3²/(2.0×(1 + K²/2)) ≈ 2.02 keV, with the fifth harmonic near 10.1 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「插件磁鐵只影響自己的光束線，不影響其他使用者。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An insertion device affects only its own beamline, not other users." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波盪器間隙與前饋表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Undulator gap and feedforward tables”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波盪器間隙與前饋表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undulator gap and feedforward tables” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λu = 2.0 cm、B₀ = 0.8 T：K = 0.934×0.8×2.0 ≈ 1.49，基頻 E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.0×(1 + K²/2)) ≈ 2.02 keV，第 5 諧波約 10.1 keV。3 m 長的能量損失 U_ID = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L ≈ 10.9 keV，500 mA 時 5.5 kW 打到前端；十支共 109 keV，加兩支 2 T、2 m 扭擺器各 45.6 keV，合計約 200 keV。垂直聚焦 k_y = 1/(2ρ₀²)，ρ₀ = 10.0/0.8 ≈ 12.5 m，β_y = 3 m 時 Δν_y = β_y·k_y·L/(4π) ≈ 0.0023。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For λu = 2.0 cm and B0 = 0.8 T, K = 0.934×0.8×2.0 ≈ 1.49 and the fundamental E1 = 0.950×3²/(2.0×(1 + K²/2)) ≈ 2.02 keV, with the fifth harmonic near 10.1 keV. A 3 m device loses U_ID = 0.633·E²·B0²·L ≈ 10.9 keV, sending 5.5 kW onto the front end at 500 mA; ten of them total 109 keV, and two 2 T, 2 m wigglers add 45.6 keV each, about 200 keV in all. Vertical focusing k_y = 1/(2ρ0²) with ρ0 = 10.0/0.8 ≈ 12.5 m gives Δν_y = β_y·k_y·L/(4π) ≈ 0.0023 for β_y = 3 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在儲存束流下逐步掃描間隙，同時記錄全環軌道、工作點與射頻功率，建立修正子與四極前饋表；驗收時要求間隙全程移動下軌道擾動小於束流尺寸的 10%，光束線則以單色器掃描諧波峰位置，確認 K 值與電子能量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the gap step by step with stored beam while logging the ring-wide orbit, tunes and RF power to build corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables; acceptance requires the orbit disturbance over full gap travel to stay below 10% of the beam size, and the beamline scans harmonic peaks with its monochromator to confirm K and electron energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波盪器間隙與前饋表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Undulator gap and feedforward tables” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在儲存束流下逐步掃描間隙，同時記錄全環軌道、工作點與射頻功率，建立修正子與四極前饋表；驗收時要求間隙全程移動下軌道擾動小於束流尺寸的 10%，光束線則以單色器掃描諧波峰位置，確認 K 值與電子能量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the gap step by step with stored beam while logging the ring-wide orbit, tunes and RF power to build corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables; acceptance requires the orbit disturbance over full gap travel to stay below 10% of the beam size, and the beamline scans harmonic peaks with its monochromator to confirm K and electron energy. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：新裝真空內波盪器的前饋表只在低電流下建立，高電流時阻抗與熱負載改變，間隙移動造成數微米的軌道跳動傳到其他光束線，使用者看到光點在別人調能量時跳動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A new in-vacuum undulator whose feedforward table was built only at low current behaves differently at high current, where impedance and heat load change; gap moves then kick the orbit by several micrometres, and users on other beamlines see their spot jump whenever someone else changes energy.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波盪器間隙與前饋表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Undulator gap and feedforward tables” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 新裝真空內波盪器的前饋表只在低電流下建立，高電流時阻抗與熱負載改變，間隙移動造成數微米的軌道跳動傳到其他光束線，使用者看到光點在別人調能量時跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A new in-vacuum undulator whose feedforward table was built only at low current behaves differently at high current, where impedance and heat load change; gap moves then kick the orbit by several micrometres, and users on other beamlines see their spot jump whenever someone else changes energy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每支插件磁鐵都是環的一部分：它增加每圈能量損失與射頻負擔，產生垂直聚焦而改變工作點，磁場積分誤差在間隙變動時擾動軌道，因此每支插件磁鐵都要附帶以間隙為索引的修正子與四極前饋表。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each device becomes part of the ring: it adds energy loss per turn and RF load, produces vertical focusing that shifts the tune, and its field-integral errors disturb the orbit as the gap moves, so every insertion device carries gap-indexed corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「插件磁鐵只影響自己的光束線，不影響其他使用者。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An insertion device affects only its own beamline, not other users." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 新裝真空內波盪器的前饋表只在低電流下建立，高電流時阻抗與熱負載改變，間隙移動造成數微米的軌道跳動傳到其他光束線，使用者看到光點在別人調能量時跳動。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
新裝真空內波盪器的前饋表只在低電流下建立，高電流時阻抗與熱負載改變，間隙移動造成數微米的軌道跳動傳到其他光束線，使用者看到光點在別人調能量時跳動。
頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A new in-vacuum undulator whose feedforward table was built only at low current behaves differently at high current, where impedance and heat load change.
Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users.

quiz.explanationEn: A new in-vacuum undulator whose feedforward table was built only at low current behaves differently at high current, where impedance and heat load change; gap moves then kick the orbit by several micrometres, and users on other beamlines see their spot jump whenever someone else changes energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」如何決定同步輻射儲存環的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-up injection and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron storage rings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 現代光源以頂注運轉讓儲存電流幾乎恆定：增能環每隔幾分鐘把少量電荷注入環中，補回壽命損失，光束線的熱負載因此穩定，光學元件不必隨電流漂移重新對準。MBA 環的動態孔徑小，傳統以四支踢波磁鐵造凸軌的離軸注入很難不擾動儲存束流，因此發展出多極注入踢波器或軸上交換注入。由於注入時光束線光閘保持開啟，注入效率必須夠高，損失電荷要控制在輻射安全允許範圍內，這是頂注能否放行的核心驗收項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts. MBA rings have small dynamic apertures, so classic off-axis injection with a four-kicker bump is hard to do without disturbing the stored beam, leading to multipole injection kickers or on-axis swap-out. Because beamline shutters stay open during injection, efficiency must be high and lost charge must stay within radiation-safety limits, which is the core acceptance item for allowing top-up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Top-up injection and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：I = 500 mA、τ = 15 h：電流每小時下降 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA；要維持 ±0.5%（2.5 mA）需每 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 分鐘注入一次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With I = 500 mA and τ = 15 h, current falls 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA per hour; holding ±0.5% (2.5 mA) requires an injection every 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 minutes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Top-up injection and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance
knowledge.text: 現代光源以頂注運轉讓儲存電流幾乎恆定：增能環每隔幾分鐘把少量電荷注入環中，補回壽命損失，光束線的熱負載因此穩定，光學元件不必隨電流漂移重新對準。MBA 環的動態孔徑小，傳統以四支踢波磁鐵造凸軌的離軸注入很難不擾動儲存束流，因此發展出多極注入踢波器或軸上交換注入。
knowledge.textEn: Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts. MBA rings have small dynamic apertures, so classic off-axis injection with a four-kicker bump is hard to do without disturbing the stored beam, leading to multipole injection kickers or on-axis swap-out.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance" is correct?
options: 頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。
儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
現代光源以頂注運轉讓儲存電流幾乎恆定：增能環每隔幾分鐘把少量電荷注入環中，補回壽命損失，光束線的熱負載因此穩定，光學元件不必隨電流漂移重新對準。
optionsEn: Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users.
Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.

Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts.

quiz.explanationEn: Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-up injection and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：I = 500 mA、τ = 15 h：電流每小時下降 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA；要維持 ±0.5%（2.5 mA）需每 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 分鐘注入一次。環內 500 mA 對應 I·T₀ = 0.5×1.76 µs ≈ 0.88 µC，2.5 mA 對應 4.4 nC；注入效率 90% 時每次需送入 4.9 nC、損失 0.49 nC，每小時累積約 6.5 nC 打在環內，這個數字決定屏蔽與劑量監測的設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With I = 500 mA and τ = 15 h, current falls 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA per hour; holding ±0.5% (2.5 mA) requires an injection every 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 minutes. The stored 500 mA is I·T0 = 0.5×1.76 µs ≈ 0.88 µC, and 2.5 mA corresponds to 4.4 nC; at 90% efficiency each top-up must deliver 4.9 nC and loses 0.49 nC, about 6.5 nC per hour deposited in the ring, a figure that drives shielding and dose-monitoring design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）；再以劑量計確認損失位置與量，最後交接操作參數、前饋表與異常處理紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs; dosimeters then confirm where and how much charge is lost, and operating parameters, feedforward tables and fault records are handed over.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

The stored 500 mA is I·T0 = 0.5×1.76 µs ≈ 0.88 µC, and 2.5 mA corresponds to 4.4 nC; at 90% efficiency each top-up must deliver 4.9 nC and loses 0.49 nC, about 6.5 nC per hour deposited in the ring, a figure that drives shielding and dose-monitoring design.

steps.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Top-up injection and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）；再以劑量計確認損失位置與量，最後交接操作參數、前饋表與異常處理紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs; dosimeters then confirm where and how much charge is lost, and operating parameters, feedforward tables and fault records are handed over. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes; if injection efficiency slowly falls unnoticed, the growing lost charge trips radiation interlocks and stops top-up.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）；再以劑量計確認損失位置與量，最後交接操作參數、前饋表與異常處理紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs; dosimeters then confirm where and how much charge is lost, and operating parameters, feedforward tables and fault records are handed over.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）。
發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs.
Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.
quiz.explanation: 試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）；再以劑量計確認損失位置與量，最後交接操作參數、前饋表與異常處理紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs; dosimeters then confirm where and how much charge is lost, and operating parameters, feedforward tables and fault records are handed over. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Top-up injection and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。若注入效率逐漸下降而未察覺，損失電荷增加會觸發輻射連鎖，使頂注中止。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes; if injection efficiency slowly falls unnoticed, the growing lost charge trips radiation interlocks and stops top-up. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於注入時光束線光閘保持開啟，注入效率必須夠高，損失電荷要控制在輻射安全允許範圍內，這是頂注能否放行的核心驗收項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because beamline shutters stay open during injection, efficiency must be high and lost charge must stay within radiation-safety limits, which is the core acceptance item for allowing top-up.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。若注入效率逐漸下降而未察覺，損失電荷增加會觸發輻射連鎖，使頂注中止。
knowledge.textEn: Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes; if injection efficiency slowly falls unnoticed, the growing lost charge trips radiation interlocks and stops top-up.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。
注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.

Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes.
quiz.explanation: 注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes; if injection efficiency slowly falls unnoticed, the growing lost charge trips radiation interlocks and stops top-up. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 自由電子雷射加速器
summary: 以一座教學用 5.8 GeV、C 波段精簡型硬 X 光 FEL 為主線，從共振條件如何決定加速器長度出發，說明電子槍、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器如何產生 3 kA 的高品質束團，再把飛秒級縱向診斷、射頻抖動預算、波盪器軌道直線度與增益曲線驗收整合成可交接的 FEL 加速器工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Follow a 5.8 GeV, C-band compact hard X-ray FEL used for teaching, starting from how the resonance condition sets linac length, see how the gun, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes produce a high-quality 3 kA bunch, then integrate femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics, the RF jitter budget, undulator trajectory straightness and gain-curve acceptance into a transferable FEL-accelerator engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
