workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 精簡型硬 X 光 FEL 加速器練習：目標 0.1 nm（12.4 keV），λu = 15 mm、K = 1.2，需 E ≈ 5.8 GeV。電子槍：200 pC、Cs₂Te QE 1%，266 nm 雷射約 93 nJ；高斯束團 σ_t = 3 ps，峰值 I₀ = Q/(√(2π)σ_t) ≈ 26.6 A。要達 3 kA 需總壓縮 C ≈ 113，分配為 300 MeV 處第一級 C₁ = 10、約 2 GeV 處第二級 C₂ ≈ 11.3。雷射加熱器加入 15 keV 切片能量散佈，壓縮後放大為 15 keV×113 ≈ 1.7 MeV，在 5.8 GeV 為 2.9×10⁻⁴，仍小於 ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴，但餘量只有 1.7 倍；加熱器若設到 30 keV 就會超過 ρ。主加速：扣掉注入器 300 MeV 並補回 X 波段減速 17.6 MeV，以 28 MV/m 計約需 (5800 − 300 + 17.6)/28 ≈ 197 m 結構。飽和脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ（2.9×10¹¹ 個光子）；若最終能量抖動 2×10⁻⁴，光子能量逐發偏移約 5 eV。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Compact hard X-ray FEL accelerator exercise: target 0.1 nm (12.4 keV) with λu = 15 mm and K = 1.2, requiring E ≈ 5.8 GeV. Gun: 200 pC from Cs2Te at 1% QE needs about 93 nJ of 266 nm laser; a Gaussian bunch with σ_t = 3 ps has peak I0 = Q/(√(2π)σ_t) ≈ 26.6 A. Reaching 3 kA needs total compression C ≈ 113, split as C1 = 10 at 300 MeV and C2 ≈ 11.3 near 2 GeV. A laser heater adding 15 keV of slice energy spread is magnified by compression to 15 keV×113 ≈ 1.7 MeV, which at 5.8 GeV is 2.9×10⁻⁴, still below ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴ but with only 1.7 times margin; a 30 keV heater setting would exceed ρ. Main linac: after the 300 MeV injector and making up 17.6 MeV of X-band deceleration, about (5800 − 300 + 17.6)/28 ≈ 197 m of structure at 28 MV/m. Saturation pulse energy is about 0.57 mJ (2.9×10¹¹ photons); a final energy jitter of 2×10⁻⁴ shifts photon energy by about 5 eV shot to shot. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共振條件決定加速器規模」與「電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale" and "Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共振條件決定加速器規模：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波盪器週期與電子能量」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undulator period and electron energy” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由電子雷射的波長不是由增益介質決定，而是由電子能量與波盪器共同決定：λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²)。要得到 0.1 nm 硬 X 光，γ 必須上萬，所需的直線加速器長度、隧道與建築成本因此由 λu 與 K 的選擇決定。縮短波盪器週期（真空內波盪器、小間隙）並提高加速梯度（C 波段 5.7 GHz 常溫結構），能把同樣波長所需的能量與長度降低數倍，這是 SACLA、SwissFEL 等精簡型設施的設計邏輯；代價是更小的間隙，以及更嚴格的尾場與束流品質要求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器週期與電子能量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free-electron laser's wavelength is set not by a gain medium but jointly by electron energy and the undulator: λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²). Reaching 0.1 nm hard X-rays requires γ above ten thousand, so the linac length, tunnel and building cost follow from the choice of λu and K. Shortening the undulator period with small-gap in-vacuum devices and raising the accelerating gradient with C-band 5.7 GHz normal-conducting structures cuts the energy and length needed for the same wavelength several-fold, which is the design logic of compact facilities such as SACLA and SwissFEL; the price is smaller gaps and tighter wakefield and beam-quality requirements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator period and electron energy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For λ = 0.1 nm with λu = 15 mm and K = 1.2, γ = √(λu(1 + K²/2)/(2λ)) = √(0.015×1.72/(2×10⁻¹⁰)) ≈ 11 360 and E ≈ 5.8 GeV, about 207 m of structure at 28 MV/m; with λu = 30 mm and K = 3.5, γ ≈ 32 690 and E ≈ 16.7 GeV, needing about 597 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波盪器週期與電子能量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Undulator period and electron energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共振條件決定加速器規模
knowledge.titleEn: The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale
knowledge.text: 自由電子雷射的波長不是由增益介質決定，而是由電子能量與波盪器共同決定：λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²)。要得到 0.1 nm 硬 X 光，γ 必須上萬，所需的直線加速器長度、隧道與建築成本因此由 λu 與 K 的選擇決定。
knowledge.textEn: A free-electron laser's wavelength is set not by a gain medium but jointly by electron energy and the undulator: λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²). Reaching 0.1 nm hard X-rays requires γ above ten thousand, so the linac length, tunnel and building cost follow from the choice of λu and K.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共振條件決定加速器規模」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale" is correct?
options: FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
自由電子雷射的波長不是由增益介質決定，而是由電子能量與波盪器共同決定：λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²)。
電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。
optionsEn: An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.
A free-electron laser's wavelength is set not by a gain medium but jointly by electron energy and the undulator: λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²).
The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal.
quiz.explanation: 自由電子雷射的波長不是由增益介質決定，而是由電子能量與波盪器共同決定：λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A free-electron laser's wavelength is set not by a gain medium but jointly by electron energy and the undulator: λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共振條件決定加速器規模：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波盪器週期與電子能量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undulator period and electron energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：目標 λ = 0.1 nm：λu = 15 mm、K = 1.2 時 γ = √(λu(1 + K²/2)/(2λ)) = √(0.015×1.72/(2×10⁻¹⁰)) ≈ 11 360，E ≈ 5.8 GeV，以 28 MV/m 計約需 207 m 加速結構；若用 λu = 30 mm、K = 3.5，γ ≈ 32 690、E ≈ 16.7 GeV，需約 597 m。固定能量下把 K 從 1.2 關到 0.8，波長乘以 (1 + 0.32)/(1 + 0.72) ≈ 0.77，0.1 nm 變成約 0.077 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For λ = 0.1 nm with λu = 15 mm and K = 1.2, γ = √(λu(1 + K²/2)/(2λ)) = √(0.015×1.72/(2×10⁻¹⁰)) ≈ 11 360 and E ≈ 5.8 GeV, about 207 m of structure at 28 MV/m; with λu = 30 mm and K = 3.5, γ ≈ 32 690 and E ≈ 16.7 GeV, needing about 597 m. At fixed energy, closing K from 1.2 to 0.8 multiplies the wavelength by (1 + 0.32)/(1 + 0.72) ≈ 0.77, turning 0.1 nm into about 0.077 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以能譜分析段（偏轉磁鐵加螢光屏）量最終電子能量，並以單色器或光譜儀量自發輻射的諧波峰，兩者代入共振式反解 K，與波盪器磁場量測給出的 K 比較，差異應在 10⁻³ 等級以內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the final electron energy with a spectrometer dipole and screen, measure the spontaneous-emission harmonic peak with a monochromator or spectrometer, invert the resonance relation for K and compare with the K from undulator field measurements, expecting agreement at the 10⁻³ level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 共振條件決定加速器規模：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波盪器週期與電子能量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Undulator period and electron energy” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以能譜分析段（偏轉磁鐵加螢光屏）量最終電子能量，並以單色器或光譜儀量自發輻射的諧波峰，兩者代入共振式反解 K，與波盪器磁場量測給出的 K 比較，差異應在 10⁻³ 等級以內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the final electron energy with a spectrometer dipole and screen, measure the spontaneous-emission harmonic peak with a monochromator or spectrometer, invert the resonance relation for K and compare with the K from undulator field measurements, expecting agreement at the 10⁻³ level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：能譜分析磁鐵未經校正，實際電子能量比標示低 0.3%，光子能量隨之低 0.6%；使用者在吸收邊附近的實驗全部偏移，波盪器間隙表卻被誤認為有誤而遭錯誤修改。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共振條件決定加速器規模」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale"?
options: 以能譜分析段（偏轉磁鐵加螢光屏）量最終電子能量，並以單色器或光譜儀量自發輻射的諧波峰，兩者代入共振式反解 K，與波盪器磁場量測給出的 K 比較，差異應在 10⁻³ 等級以內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Measure the final electron energy with a spectrometer dipole and screen, measure the spontaneous-emission harmonic peak with a monochromator or spectrometer, invert the resonance relation for K and compare with the K from undulator field measurements, expecting agreement at the 10⁻³ level.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the final electron energy with a spectrometer dipole and screen, measure the spontaneous-emission harmonic peak with a monochromator or spectrometer, invert the resonance relation for K and compare with the K from undulator field measurements, expecting agreement at the 10⁻³ level. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 共振條件決定加速器規模：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波盪器週期與電子能量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Undulator period and electron energy” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 能譜分析磁鐵未經校正，實際電子能量比標示低 0.3%，光子能量隨之低 0.6%；使用者在吸收邊附近的實驗全部偏移，波盪器間隙表卻被誤認為有誤而遭錯誤修改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An uncalibrated spectrometer dipole leaves the true electron energy 0.3% below the displayed value, so photon energy is 0.6% low; every user experiment near an absorption edge is shifted, and the undulator gap table is wrongly blamed and wrongly edited. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：縮短波盪器週期（真空內波盪器、小間隙）並提高加速梯度（C 波段 5.7 GHz 常溫結構），能把同樣波長所需的能量與長度降低數倍，這是 SACLA、SwissFEL 等精簡型設施的設計邏輯；代價是更小的間隙，以及更嚴格的尾場與束流品質要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shortening the undulator period with small-gap in-vacuum devices and raising the accelerating gradient with C-band 5.7 GHz normal-conducting structures cuts the energy and length needed for the same wavelength several-fold, which is the design logic of compact facilities such as SACLA and SwissFEL; the price is smaller gaps and tighter wakefield and beam-quality requirements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 能譜分析磁鐵未經校正，實際電子能量比標示低 0.3%，光子能量隨之低 0.6%；使用者在吸收邊附近的實驗全部偏移，波盪器間隙表卻被誤認為有誤而遭錯誤修改。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共振條件決定加速器規模」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The resonance condition sets the accelerator scale" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

能譜分析磁鐵未經校正，實際電子能量比標示低 0.3%，光子能量隨之低 0.6%；使用者在吸收邊附近的實驗全部偏移，波盪器間隙表卻被誤認為有誤而遭錯誤修改。
電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。

An uncalibrated spectrometer dipole leaves the true electron energy 0.3% below the displayed value, so photon energy is 0.6% low.
The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal.

steps.title: 電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流品質規格表」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-quality specification sheet” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 增益要求電子束同時滿足三個條件：橫向上，幾何發射度 ε_n/γ 最好小於 λ/4π，使電子束與輻射模式重疊；縱向上，切片能量散佈要小於 Pierce 參數 ρ，否則電子的共振波長被抹開；峰值電流要達到數 kA，ρ 才夠大、增益長度才夠短。三者互相牽制：壓縮提高電流，同時放大能量散佈，並可能因相干同步輻射劣化發射度；能量散佈過小又會引發微束團不穩定，因此加速器設計是在這些規格之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流品質規格表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SASE gain requires the electron beam to satisfy three conditions at once: transversely, the geometric emittance ε_n/γ should be below λ/4π so the beam overlaps the radiation mode; longitudinally, the slice energy spread must be below the Pierce parameter ρ or the resonant wavelength is smeared; and the peak current must reach several kiloamperes so that ρ is large and the gain length short. The three pull against each other: compression raises current but magnifies energy spread and can degrade emittance through coherent synchrotron radiation, while too small an energy spread triggers the microbunching instability, so the accelerator design is a balance among these specifications. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-quality specification sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：5.8 GeV（γ ≈ 11 360）、λ = 0.1 nm：λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm，相當於 ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm；實際 ε_n = 0.4 µm 對應幾何 35 pm，超出約 4.4 倍，需由三維增益長度修正承擔。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 5.8 GeV (γ ≈ 11 360) and λ = 0.1 nm, λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm, equivalent to ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm; a real ε_n = 0.4 µm gives a geometric 35 pm, about 4.4 times over, which the three-dimensional gain-length correction must absorb.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流品質規格表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-quality specification sheet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流
knowledge.titleEn: Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current
knowledge.text: SASE 增益要求電子束同時滿足三個條件：橫向上，幾何發射度 ε_n/γ 最好小於 λ/4π，使電子束與輻射模式重疊；縱向上，切片能量散佈要小於 Pierce 參數 ρ，否則電子的共振波長被抹開；峰值電流要達到數 kA，ρ 才夠大、增益長度才夠短。三者互相牽制：壓縮提高電流，同時放大能量散佈，並可能因相干同步輻射劣化發射度；能量散佈過小又會引發微束團不穩定，因此加速器設計是在這些規格之間取得平衡。
knowledge.textEn: SASE gain requires the electron beam to satisfy three conditions at once: transversely, the geometric emittance ε_n/γ should be below λ/4π so the beam overlaps the radiation mode; longitudinally, the slice energy spread must be below the Pierce parameter ρ or the resonant wavelength is smeared; and the peak current must reach several kiloamperes so that ρ is large and the gain length short. The three pull against each other: compression raises current but magnifies energy spread and can degrade emittance through coherent synchrotron radiation, while too small an energy spread triggers the microbunching instability, so the accelerator design is a balance among these specifications.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流品質規格表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-quality specification sheet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：5.8 GeV（γ ≈ 11 360）、λ = 0.1 nm：λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm，相當於 ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm；實際 ε_n = 0.4 µm 對應幾何 35 pm，超出約 4.4 倍，需由三維增益長度修正承擔。I = 3 kA、K = 1.2、σ_x = 20 µm 時 ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴，一維增益長度 L_g = λu/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 1.39 m。切片能量散佈 0.5 MeV 對應 8.6×10⁻⁵，約為 ρ 的 1/6，滿足要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 5.8 GeV (γ ≈ 11 360) and λ = 0.1 nm, λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm, equivalent to ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm; a real ε_n = 0.4 µm gives a geometric 35 pm, about 4.4 times over, which the three-dimensional gain-length correction must absorb. With I = 3 kA, K = 1.2 and σ_x = 20 µm, ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴ and the one-dimensional gain length L_g = λu/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 1.39 m. A slice energy spread of 0.5 MeV is 8.6×10⁻⁵, about one sixth of ρ, which satisfies the requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把規格表的每一項對應到一個量測：以四極掃描或多屏法量投影與切片發射度，以橫向偏轉腔加能譜儀量切片能量散佈與電流分佈，再把量得的參數代入 Ming Xie 等三維增益長度擬合式，預測增益長度並與實測增益曲線比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every line of the specification sheet to a measurement: projected and slice emittance by quadrupole scans or multi-screen methods, slice energy spread and current profile with a transverse deflector plus spectrometer, then insert the measured parameters into a three-dimensional gain-length fit such as Ming Xie's to predict the gain length and compare with the measured gain curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 5.8 GeV（γ ≈ 11 360）、λ = 0.1 nm：λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm，相當於 ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm；實際 ε_n = 0.4 µm 對應幾何 35 pm，超出約 4.4 倍，需由三維增益長度修正承擔。I = 3 kA、K = 1.2、σ_x = 20 µm 時 ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴，一維增益長度 L_g = λu/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 1.39 m。切片能量散佈 0.5 MeV 對應 8.6×10⁻⁵，約為 ρ 的 1/6，滿足要求。
knowledge.textEn: At 5.8 GeV (γ ≈ 11 360) and λ = 0.1 nm, λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm, equivalent to ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm; a real ε_n = 0.4 µm gives a geometric 35 pm, about 4.4 times over, which the three-dimensional gain-length correction must absorb. With I = 3 kA, K = 1.2 and σ_x = 20 µm, ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴ and the one-dimensional gain length L_g = λu/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 1.39 m. A slice energy spread of 0.5 MeV is 8.6×10⁻⁵, about one sixth of ρ, which satisfies the requirement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current", which statement holds?
options: 屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。
optionsEn: At 5.8 GeV (γ ≈ 11 360) and λ = 0.1 nm, λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm, equivalent to ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm.
The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.
If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.
quiz.explanation: 5.8 GeV（γ ≈ 11 360）、λ = 0.1 nm：λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm，相當於 ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm；實際 ε_n = 0.4 µm 對應幾何 35 pm，超出約 4.4 倍，需由三維增益長度修正承擔。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 5.8 GeV (γ ≈ 11 360) and λ = 0.1 nm, λ/4π ≈ 7.96 pm, equivalent to ε_n ≤ γλ/4π ≈ 90 nm; a real ε_n = 0.4 µm gives a geometric 35 pm, about 4.4 times over, which the three-dimensional gain-length correction must absorb. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流品質規格表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-quality specification sheet” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把規格表的每一項對應到一個量測：以四極掃描或多屏法量投影與切片發射度，以橫向偏轉腔加能譜儀量切片能量散佈與電流分佈，再把量得的參數代入 Ming Xie 等三維增益長度擬合式，預測增益長度並與實測增益曲線比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every line of the specification sheet to a measurement: projected and slice emittance by quadrupole scans or multi-screen methods, slice energy spread and current profile with a transverse deflector plus spectrometer, then insert the measured parameters into a three-dimensional gain-length fit such as Ming Xie's to predict the gain length and compare with the measured gain curve. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只量投影發射度就宣告合格，卻漏掉束團中心切片因相干同步輻射而歪斜；只有少數切片真正對準波盪器軸，脈衝能量只有預期的幾分之一，而且對軌道微調極度敏感。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Declaring success from projected emittance alone misses slices tilted by coherent synchrotron radiation in the bunch core; only a few slices align with the undulator axis, pulse energy is a fraction of expectation and extremely sensitive to orbit tweaks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把規格表的每一項對應到一個量測：以四極掃描或多屏法量投影與切片發射度，以橫向偏轉腔加能譜儀量切片能量散佈與電流分佈，再把量得的參數代入 Ming Xie 等三維增益長度擬合式，預測增益長度並與實測增益曲線比對。
knowledge.textEn: Map every line of the specification sheet to a measurement: projected and slice emittance by quadrupole scans or multi-screen methods, slice energy spread and current profile with a transverse deflector plus spectrometer, then insert the measured parameters into a three-dimensional gain-length fit such as Ming Xie's to predict the gain length and compare with the measured gain curve.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把規格表的每一項對應到一個量測：以四極掃描或多屏法量投影與切片發射度，以橫向偏轉腔加能譜儀量切片能量散佈與電流分佈，再把量得的參數代入 Ming Xie 等三維增益長度擬合式，預測增益長度並與實測增益曲線比對。
偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Map every line of the specification sheet to a measurement: projected and slice emittance by quadrupole scans or multi-screen methods, slice energy spread and current profile with a transverse deflector plus spectrometer, then insert the measured parameters into a three-dimensional gain-length fit such as Ming Xie's to predict the gain length and compare with the measured gain curve.
Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated.
quiz.explanation: 把規格表的每一項對應到一個量測：以四極掃描或多屏法量投影與切片發射度，以橫向偏轉腔加能譜儀量切片能量散佈與電流分佈，再把量得的參數代入 Ming Xie 等三維增益長度擬合式，預測增益長度並與實測增益曲線比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map every line of the specification sheet to a measurement: projected and slice emittance by quadrupole scans or multi-screen methods, slice energy spread and current profile with a transverse deflector plus spectrometer, then insert the measured parameters into a three-dimensional gain-length fit such as Ming Xie's to predict the gain length and compare with the measured gain curve. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流品質規格表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-quality specification sheet” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只量投影發射度就宣告合格，卻漏掉束團中心切片因相干同步輻射而歪斜；只有少數切片真正對準波盪器軸，脈衝能量只有預期的幾分之一，而且對軌道微調極度敏感。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Declaring success from projected emittance alone misses slices tilted by coherent synchrotron radiation in the bunch core; only a few slices align with the undulator axis, pulse energy is a fraction of expectation and extremely sensitive to orbit tweaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三者互相牽制：壓縮提高電流，同時放大能量散佈，並可能因相干同步輻射劣化發射度；能量散佈過小又會引發微束團不穩定，因此加速器設計是在這些規格之間取得平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The three pull against each other: compression raises current but magnifies energy spread and can degrade emittance through coherent synchrotron radiation, while too small an energy spread triggers the microbunching instability, so the accelerator design is a balance among these specifications.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量投影發射度就宣告合格，卻漏掉束團中心切片因相干同步輻射而歪斜；只有少數切片真正對準波盪器軸，脈衝能量只有預期的幾分之一，而且對軌道微調極度敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Declaring success from projected emittance alone misses slices tilted by coherent synchrotron radiation in the bunch core; only a few slices align with the undulator axis, pulse energy is a fraction of expectation and extremely sensitive to orbit tweaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電子束品質要求：發射度、能量散佈與峰值電流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electron-beam requirements: emittance, energy spread and peak current" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。
只量投影發射度就宣告合格，卻漏掉束團中心切片因相干同步輻射而歪斜；只有少數切片真正對準波盪器軸，脈衝能量只有預期的幾分之一，而且對軌道微調極度敏感。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun.
Declaring success from projected emittance alone misses slices tilted by coherent synchrotron radiation in the bunch core.
quiz.explanation: 只量投影發射度就宣告合格，卻漏掉束團中心切片因相干同步輻射而歪斜；只有少數切片真正對準波盪器軸，脈衝能量只有預期的幾分之一，而且對軌道微調極度敏感。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Declaring success from projected emittance alone misses slices tilted by coherent synchrotron radiation in the bunch core; only a few slices align with the undulator axis, pulse energy is a fraction of expectation and extremely sensitive to orbit tweaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷」與「加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge" and "Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光陰極與驅動雷射」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photocathode and drive laser” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FEL 的電子束品質在電子槍就大致決定，後段加速只能保持而無法改善。驅動雷射以紫外脈衝照射銅或 Cs₂Te 光陰極，量子效率（QE）決定所需雷射能量；電子離開陰極時帶有平均橫向能量（MTE），形成與雷射光斑大小成正比的熱發射度。陰極表面約 100 MV/m 的射頻電場要快速把電子加速到相對論速度，以壓住空間電荷力；陰極面上的電荷面密度不能超過鏡像電荷極限 ε₀E，電子槍後的螺線管再做發射度補償，把各切片的橫向相空間重新對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極與驅動雷射」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An FEL's beam quality is largely fixed at the gun; downstream acceleration can preserve but not improve it. A drive laser illuminates a copper or Cs2Te photocathode with ultraviolet pulses, and the quantum efficiency (QE) sets the laser energy needed; electrons leave the cathode with a mean transverse energy (MTE) that produces a thermal emittance proportional to the laser spot size. An RF field of about 100 MV/m at the cathode must quickly accelerate electrons to relativistic speed to suppress space-charge forces; the surface charge density cannot exceed the image-charge limit ε0E, and a solenoid after the gun performs emittance compensation to realign the transverse phase space of the slices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photocathode and drive laser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：200 pC 等於 1.25×10⁹ 個電子，266 nm 光子能量 4.66 eV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 200 pC is 1.25×10⁹ electrons, and a 266 nm photon carries 4.66 eV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光陰極與驅動雷射」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photocathode and drive laser”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷
knowledge.titleEn: Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge
knowledge.text: FEL 的電子束品質在電子槍就大致決定，後段加速只能保持而無法改善。驅動雷射以紫外脈衝照射銅或 Cs₂Te 光陰極，量子效率（QE）決定所需雷射能量；電子離開陰極時帶有平均橫向能量（MTE），形成與雷射光斑大小成正比的熱發射度。
knowledge.textEn: An FEL's beam quality is largely fixed at the gun; downstream acceleration can preserve but not improve it. A drive laser illuminates a copper or Cs2Te photocathode with ultraviolet pulses, and the quantum efficiency (QE) sets the laser energy needed; electrons leave the cathode with a mean transverse energy (MTE) that produces a thermal emittance proportional to the laser spot size.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge" is correct?
options: FEL 的電子束品質在電子槍就大致決定，後段加速只能保持而無法改善。
電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。
只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。
optionsEn: An FEL's beam quality is largely fixed at the gun; downstream acceleration can preserve but not improve it.
The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun.
Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch.
quiz.explanation: FEL 的電子束品質在電子槍就大致決定，後段加速只能保持而無法改善。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An FEL's beam quality is largely fixed at the gun; downstream acceleration can preserve but not improve it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光陰極與驅動雷射」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photocathode and drive laser” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：200 pC 等於 1.25×10⁹ 個電子，266 nm 光子能量 4.66 eV。Cs₂Te 的 QE = 1% 時雷射能量 1.25×10⁹/0.01×4.66 eV ≈ 93 nJ；銅陰極 QE = 5×10⁻⁵ 時需約 18.6 µJ。熱發射度 ε_th = σ_x·√(MTE/mc²)，取 0.9 µm/mm（MTE ≈ 0.41 eV）、σ_x = 0.2 mm 得 0.18 µm。陰極場 100 MV/m 的面電荷極限 ε₀E ≈ 8.85×10⁻⁴ C/m²，半徑 0.4 mm 的光斑最多約 0.45 nC，200 pC 已用掉 45%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 200 pC is 1.25×10⁹ electrons, and a 266 nm photon carries 4.66 eV. With a Cs2Te QE of 1% the laser energy is 1.25×10⁹/0.01×4.66 eV ≈ 93 nJ; a copper cathode at QE = 5×10⁻⁵ needs about 18.6 µJ. Thermal emittance ε_th = σ_x·√(MTE/mc²); taking 0.9 µm/mm (MTE ≈ 0.41 eV) and σ_x = 0.2 mm gives 0.18 µm. At a 100 MV/m cathode field the surface-charge limit ε0E ≈ 8.85×10⁻⁴ C/m² allows at most about 0.45 nC from a 0.4 mm radius spot, so 200 pC uses 45% of it. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以法拉第杯或積分電流變壓器量電荷對雷射能量的曲線，線性段斜率即 QE，飽和處與鏡像電荷極限對照；以多種光斑尺寸量低電荷發射度，外推到零尺寸得 MTE；並定期以雷射掃描陰極面繪製 QE 分佈，追蹤局部劣化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure charge versus laser energy with a Faraday cup or integrating current transformer: the linear slope is the QE and the saturation point is compared with the image-charge limit; measure low-charge emittance at several spot sizes and extrapolate to zero size to obtain the MTE; map QE across the cathode periodically with the laser to track local degradation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 200 pC 等於 1.25×10⁹ 個電子，266 nm 光子能量 4.66 eV。Cs₂Te 的 QE = 1% 時雷射能量 1.25×10⁹/0.01×4.66 eV ≈ 93 nJ；銅陰極 QE = 5×10⁻⁵ 時需約 18.6 µJ。熱發射度 ε_th = σ_x·√(MTE/mc²)，取 0.9 µm/mm（MTE ≈ 0.41 eV）、σ_x = 0.2 mm 得 0.18 µm。陰極場 100 MV/m 的面電荷極限 ε₀E ≈ 8.85×10⁻⁴ C/m²，半徑 0.4 mm 的光斑最多約 0.45 nC，200 pC 已用掉 45%。
knowledge.textEn: 200 pC is 1.25×10⁹ electrons, and a 266 nm photon carries 4.66 eV. With a Cs2Te QE of 1% the laser energy is 1.25×10⁹/0.01×4.66 eV ≈ 93 nJ; a copper cathode at QE = 5×10⁻⁵ needs about 18.6 µJ. Thermal emittance ε_th = σ_x·√(MTE/mc²); taking 0.9 µm/mm (MTE ≈ 0.41 eV) and σ_x = 0.2 mm gives 0.18 µm. At a 100 MV/m cathode field the surface-charge limit ε0E ≈ 8.85×10⁻⁴ C/m² allows at most about 0.45 nC from a 0.4 mm radius spot, so 200 pC uses 45% of it.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge", which statement holds?
options: 射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。
200 pC 等於 1.25×10⁹ 個電子，266 nm 光子能量 4.66 eV。
偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。
optionsEn: RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time.
200 pC is 1.25×10⁹ electrons, and a 266 nm photon carries 4.66 eV.
Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated.
quiz.explanation: 200 pC 等於 1.25×10⁹ 個電子，266 nm 光子能量 4.66 eV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 200 pC is 1.25×10⁹ electrons, and a 266 nm photon carries 4.66 eV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光陰極與驅動雷射」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photocathode and drive laser” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以法拉第杯或積分電流變壓器量電荷對雷射能量的曲線，線性段斜率即 QE，飽和處與鏡像電荷極限對照；以多種光斑尺寸量低電荷發射度，外推到零尺寸得 MTE；並定期以雷射掃描陰極面繪製 QE 分佈，追蹤局部劣化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure charge versus laser energy with a Faraday cup or integrating current transformer: the linear slope is the QE and the saturation point is compared with the image-charge limit; measure low-charge emittance at several spot sizes and extrapolate to zero size to obtain the MTE; map QE across the cathode periodically with the laser to track local degradation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：陰極在不良真空下被氧化或污染，QE 逐週下降，操作者只好不斷加大雷射能量；雷射熱點使局部 QE 不均，電子束橫向分佈出現熱點，發射度與暗電流同時上升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A cathode oxidized or contaminated by poor vacuum loses QE week by week, so operators keep raising laser energy; laser hot spots make the local QE non-uniform, the electron beam's transverse profile develops hot spots, and emittance and dark current rise together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以法拉第杯或積分電流變壓器量電荷對雷射能量的曲線，線性段斜率即 QE，飽和處與鏡像電荷極限對照；以多種光斑尺寸量低電荷發射度，外推到零尺寸得 MTE；並定期以雷射掃描陰極面繪製 QE 分佈，追蹤局部劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Measure charge versus laser energy with a Faraday cup or integrating current transformer: the linear slope is the QE and the saturation point is compared with the image-charge limit; measure low-charge emittance at several spot sizes and extrapolate to zero size to obtain the MTE; map QE across the cathode periodically with the laser to track local degradation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
以法拉第杯或積分電流變壓器量電荷對雷射能量的曲線，線性段斜率即 QE，飽和處與鏡像電荷極限對照。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.
Measure charge versus laser energy with a Faraday cup or integrating current transformer: the linear slope is the QE and the saturation point is compared with the image-charge limit.
quiz.explanation: 以法拉第杯或積分電流變壓器量電荷對雷射能量的曲線，線性段斜率即 QE，飽和處與鏡像電荷極限對照；以多種光斑尺寸量低電荷發射度，外推到零尺寸得 MTE；並定期以雷射掃描陰極面繪製 QE 分佈，追蹤局部劣化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure charge versus laser energy with a Faraday cup or integrating current transformer: the linear slope is the QE and the saturation point is compared with the image-charge limit; measure low-charge emittance at several spot sizes and extrapolate to zero size to obtain the MTE; map QE across the cathode periodically with the laser to track local degradation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光陰極與驅動雷射」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photocathode and drive laser” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 陰極在不良真空下被氧化或污染，QE 逐週下降，操作者只好不斷加大雷射能量；雷射熱點使局部 QE 不均，電子束橫向分佈出現熱點，發射度與暗電流同時上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A cathode oxidized or contaminated by poor vacuum loses QE week by week, so operators keep raising laser energy; laser hot spots make the local QE non-uniform, the electron beam's transverse profile develops hot spots, and emittance and dark current rise together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：陰極表面約 100 MV/m 的射頻電場要快速把電子加速到相對論速度，以壓住空間電荷力；陰極面上的電荷面密度不能超過鏡像電荷極限 ε₀E，電子槍後的螺線管再做發射度補償，把各切片的橫向相空間重新對齊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An RF field of about 100 MV/m at the cathode must quickly accelerate electrons to relativistic speed to suppress space-charge forces; the surface charge density cannot exceed the image-charge limit ε0E, and a solenoid after the gun performs emittance compensation to realign the transverse phase space of the slices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 陰極在不良真空下被氧化或污染，QE 逐週下降，操作者只好不斷加大雷射能量；雷射熱點使局部 QE 不均，電子束橫向分佈出現熱點，發射度與暗電流同時上升。
knowledge.textEn: A cathode oxidized or contaminated by poor vacuum loses QE week by week, so operators keep raising laser energy; laser hot spots make the local QE non-uniform, the electron beam's transverse profile develops hot spots, and emittance and dark current rise together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光陰極射頻電子槍：量子效率、熱發射度與空間電荷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Photocathode RF gun: quantum efficiency, thermal emittance and space charge" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 陰極在不良真空下被氧化或污染，QE 逐週下降，操作者只好不斷加大雷射能量；雷射熱點使局部 QE 不均，電子束橫向分佈出現熱點，發射度與暗電流同時上升。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。
optionsEn: A cathode oxidized or contaminated by poor vacuum loses QE week by week, so operators keep raising laser energy.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch.
quiz.explanation: 陰極在不良真空下被氧化或污染，QE 逐週下降，操作者只好不斷加大雷射能量；雷射熱點使局部 QE 不均，電子束橫向分佈出現熱點，發射度與暗電流同時上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A cathode oxidized or contaminated by poor vacuum loses QE week by week, so operators keep raising laser energy; laser hot spots make the local QE non-uniform, the electron beam's transverse profile develops hot spots, and emittance and dark current rise together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 束團壓縮先讓電子在離峰相位通過加速結構，建立頭低尾高的能量啁啾，再經四片偏轉磁鐵組成的磁束壓縮器，讓高能量電子走較短路徑追上前方。射頻電場是餘弦形，啁啾本身帶有二次曲率，壓縮後會把電流分佈扭成尖峰加長尾；在注入器後加一段頻率為主結構 4 倍的 X 波段結構，以減速相位運轉抵消曲率，使壓縮線性化。高梯度 C 波段結構孔徑小、短程尾場強，會在束團內產生額外能量變化，必須納入啁啾設計；壓縮器中的相干同步輻射則是發射度劣化的主要來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bunch compression first sends electrons off-crest through accelerating structures to build an energy chirp with the head lower and the tail higher, then through a four-dipole chicane where higher-energy electrons take a shorter path and catch up. Because the RF field is a cosine, the chirp carries a quadratic curvature that after compression twists the current profile into a spike with a long tail; an X-band section at four times the injector frequency, run at a decelerating phase after the injector, cancels the curvature and linearizes compression. High-gradient C-band structures have small irises and strong short-range wakefields that add energy variation within the bunch and must enter the chirp design, while coherent synchrotron radiation in the chicanes is the main source of emittance degradation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：注入器 S 波段 V_s = 300 MV、離峰 20°，曲率項 ∝ V_s·cos φ·k_s²；以四倍頻 X 波段抵消需 V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV（減速），最終能量因此少約 17.6 MeV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an S-band injector with V_s = 300 MV at 20° off crest, the curvature term scales as V_s·cos φ·k_s²; cancelling it with a fourth-harmonic X-band section needs V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV at decelerating phase, costing about 17.6 MeV of final energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器

Because the RF field is a cosine, the chirp carries a quadratic curvature that after compression twists the current profile into a spike with a long tail; an X-band section at four times the injector frequency, run at a decelerating phase after the injector, cancels the curvature and linearizes compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
