quiz.question: 關於「加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes" is correct?
options: 只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。
束團壓縮先讓電子在離峰相位通過加速結構，建立頭低尾高的能量啁啾，再經四片偏轉磁鐵組成的磁束壓縮器，讓高能量電子走較短路徑追上前方。
屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
optionsEn: Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch.

Bunch compression first sends electrons off-crest through accelerating structures to build an energy chirp with the head lower and the tail higher, then through a four-dipole chicane where higher-energy electrons take a shorter path and catch up.
The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.
quiz.explanation: 束團壓縮先讓電子在離峰相位通過加速結構，建立頭低尾高的能量啁啾，再經四片偏轉磁鐵組成的磁束壓縮器，讓高能量電子走較短路徑追上前方。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bunch compression first sends electrons off-crest through accelerating structures to build an energy chirp with the head lower and the tail higher, then through a four-dipole chicane where higher-energy electrons take a shorter path and catch up. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：注入器 S 波段 V_s = 300 MV、離峰 20°，曲率項 ∝ V_s·cos φ·k_s²；以四倍頻 X 波段抵消需 V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV（減速），最終能量因此少約 17.6 MeV。磁束壓縮器 R₅₆ ≈ −2θ²(ΔL + 2L_B/3)：θ = 0.0663 rad（3.8°）、L_B = 0.25 m、ΔL = 5 m 時 R₅₆ ≈ −2×0.0044×5.17 ≈ −45 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an S-band injector with V_s = 300 MV at 20° off crest, the curvature term scales as V_s·cos φ·k_s²; cancelling it with a fourth-harmonic X-band section needs V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV at decelerating phase, costing about 17.6 MeV of final energy. A chicane has R56 ≈ −2θ²(ΔL + 2L_B/3); with θ = 0.0663 rad (3.8°), L_B = 0.25 m and ΔL = 5 m, R56 ≈ −2×0.0044×5.17 ≈ −45 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橫向偏轉腔量壓縮前後的電流分佈，掃描 X 波段相位與振幅，找出電流分佈最對稱、尖峰最小的設定；把磁束壓縮器出口的相干輻射監測器訊號對射頻相位作圖，確認壓縮工作點；並以壓縮器前後的發射度量測估算 CSR 造成的劣化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the current profile before and after compression with a transverse deflector, scan X-band phase and amplitude to find the setting with the most symmetric profile and smallest spike, plot the signal of a coherent-radiation monitor at the chicane exit against RF phase to confirm the compression working point, and estimate CSR degradation from emittance measured before and after the chicane.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 注入器 S 波段 V_s = 300 MV、離峰 20°，曲率項 ∝ V_s·cos φ·k_s²；以四倍頻 X 波段抵消需 V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV（減速），最終能量因此少約 17.6 MeV。磁束壓縮器 R₅₆ ≈ −2θ²(ΔL + 2L_B/3)：θ = 0.0663 rad（3.8°）、L_B = 0.25 m、ΔL = 5 m 時 R₅₆ ≈ −2×0.0044×5.17 ≈ −45 mm。
knowledge.textEn: For an S-band injector with V_s = 300 MV at 20° off crest, the curvature term scales as V_s·cos φ·k_s²; cancelling it with a fourth-harmonic X-band section needs V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV at decelerating phase, costing about 17.6 MeV of final energy. A chicane has R56 ≈ −2θ²(ΔL + 2L_B/3); with θ = 0.0663 rad (3.8°), L_B = 0.25 m and ΔL = 5 m, R56 ≈ −2×0.0044×5.17 ≈ −45 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes", which statement holds?
options: 波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。
FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
注入器 S 波段 V_s = 300 MV、離峰 20°，曲率項 ∝ V_s·cos φ·k_s²。
optionsEn: If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.
An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.
For an S-band injector with V_s = 300 MV at 20° off crest, the curvature term scales as V_s·cos φ·k_s².
quiz.explanation: 注入器 S 波段 V_s = 300 MV、離峰 20°，曲率項 ∝ V_s·cos φ·k_s²；以四倍頻 X 波段抵消需 V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV（減速），最終能量因此少約 17.6 MeV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an S-band injector with V_s = 300 MV at 20° off crest, the curvature term scales as V_s·cos φ·k_s²; cancelling it with a fourth-harmonic X-band section needs V_x ≈ V_s·cos φ/n² = 300×0.94/16 ≈ 17.6 MV at decelerating phase, costing about 17.6 MeV of final energy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以橫向偏轉腔量壓縮前後的電流分佈，掃描 X 波段相位與振幅，找出電流分佈最對稱、尖峰最小的設定；把磁束壓縮器出口的相干輻射監測器訊號對射頻相位作圖，確認壓縮工作點；並以壓縮器前後的發射度量測估算 CSR 造成的劣化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the current profile before and after compression with a transverse deflector, scan X-band phase and amplitude to find the setting with the most symmetric profile and smallest spike, plot the signal of a coherent-radiation monitor at the chicane exit against RF phase to confirm the compression working point, and estimate CSR degradation from emittance measured before and after the chicane. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：X 波段線性化腔跳脫後未被察覺，壓縮後的電流出現數十 fs 的尖峰與長尾；尖峰處 CSR 使切片發射度惡化、脈衝能量下降，長尾則在波盪器中不貢獻增益，只增加輻射負載。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An X-band linearizer trip that goes unnoticed leaves a compressed current with a spike tens of femtoseconds long and a long tail; CSR in the spike spoils slice emittance and lowers pulse energy, while the tail contributes no gain in the undulator and only adds radiation load.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以橫向偏轉腔量壓縮前後的電流分佈，掃描 X 波段相位與振幅，找出電流分佈最對稱、尖峰最小的設定；把磁束壓縮器出口的相干輻射監測器訊號對射頻相位作圖，確認壓縮工作點；並以壓縮器前後的發射度量測估算 CSR 造成的劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the current profile before and after compression with a transverse deflector, scan X-band phase and amplitude to find the setting with the most symmetric profile and smallest spike, plot the signal of a coherent-radiation monitor at the chicane exit against RF phase to confirm the compression working point, and estimate CSR degradation from emittance measured before and after the chicane.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes"?
options: 以橫向偏轉腔量壓縮前後的電流分佈，掃描 X 波段相位與振幅，找出電流分佈最對稱、尖峰最小的設定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。
optionsEn: Measure the current profile before and after compression with a transverse deflector, scan X-band phase and amplitude to find the setting with the most symmetric profile and smallest spike, plot the signal of a coherent-radiation monitor at the chicane exit against RF phase to confirm the compression working point, and estimate CSR degradation from emittance measured before and after the chicane.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal.
quiz.explanation: 以橫向偏轉腔量壓縮前後的電流分佈，掃描 X 波段相位與振幅，找出電流分佈最對稱、尖峰最小的設定；把磁束壓縮器出口的相干輻射監測器訊號對射頻相位作圖，確認壓縮工作點；並以壓縮器前後的發射度量測估算 CSR 造成的劣化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the current profile before and after compression with a transverse deflector, scan X-band phase and amplitude to find the setting with the most symmetric profile and smallest spike, plot the signal of a coherent-radiation monitor at the chicane exit against RF phase to confirm the compression working point, and estimate CSR degradation from emittance measured before and after the chicane. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: X 波段線性化腔跳脫後未被察覺，壓縮後的電流出現數十 fs 的尖峰與長尾；尖峰處 CSR 使切片發射度惡化、脈衝能量下降，長尾則在波盪器中不貢獻增益，只增加輻射負載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An X-band linearizer trip that goes unnoticed leaves a compressed current with a spike tens of femtoseconds long and a long tail; CSR in the spike spoils slice emittance and lowers pulse energy, while the tail contributes no gain in the undulator and only adds radiation load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高梯度 C 波段結構孔徑小、短程尾場強，會在束團內產生額外能量變化，必須納入啁啾設計；壓縮器中的相干同步輻射則是發射度劣化的主要來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-gradient C-band structures have small irises and strong short-range wakefields that add energy variation within the bunch and must enter the chirp design, while coherent synchrotron radiation in the chicanes is the main source of emittance degradation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: X 波段線性化腔跳脫後未被察覺，壓縮後的電流出現數十 fs 的尖峰與長尾；尖峰處 CSR 使切片發射度惡化、脈衝能量下降，長尾則在波盪器中不貢獻增益，只增加輻射負載。
knowledge.textEn: An X-band linearizer trip that goes unnoticed leaves a compressed current with a spike tens of femtoseconds long and a long tail; CSR in the spike spoils slice emittance and lowers pulse energy, while the tail contributes no gain in the undulator and only adds radiation load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「加速結構、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accelerating structures, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
X 波段線性化腔跳脫後未被察覺，壓縮後的電流出現數十 fs 的尖峰與長尾。
屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An X-band linearizer trip that goes unnoticed leaves a compressed current with a spike tens of femtoseconds long and a long tail.
The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.
quiz.explanation: X 波段線性化腔跳脫後未被察覺，壓縮後的電流出現數十 fs 的尖峰與長尾；尖峰處 CSR 使切片發射度惡化、脈衝能量下降，長尾則在波盪器中不貢獻增益，只增加輻射負載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An X-band linearizer trip that goes unnoticed leaves a compressed current with a spike tens of femtoseconds long and a long tail; CSR in the spike spoils slice emittance and lowers pulse energy, while the tail contributes no gain in the undulator and only adds radiation load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔」與「抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector" and "Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 束團長度只有數十 fs，電子學無法直接量測。橫向偏轉腔以零交叉相位的橫向射頻場，讓束團頭尾得到方向相反的偏轉，把時間軸轉成螢光屏上的垂直位置；再配合水平偏轉的能譜儀，一張影像就能同時看到電流、切片能量散佈與能量啁啾。時間解析度受偏轉強度與電子束本身在屏上的垂直尺寸限制，偏轉腔也會增加切片能量散佈，因此量測設定本身要列入誤差分析。放在波盪器之後時，還能比較有無雷射作用時的切片能量損失，重建 X 光脈衝的時間形狀。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bunches only tens of femtoseconds long cannot be measured directly with electronics. A transverse deflecting cavity applies a transverse RF field at zero crossing so head and tail are kicked in opposite directions, mapping time onto vertical position on a screen; combined with a horizontally bending spectrometer, one image shows current, slice energy spread and energy chirp together. Time resolution is limited by the kick strength and by the beam's own vertical size at the screen, and the deflector also adds slice energy spread, so the measurement setup belongs in the error analysis. Placed after the undulator, it compares slice energy loss with and without lasing to reconstruct the X-ray pulse's temporal shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：縱向剪切 S = eV·k·R₃₄/E：C 波段 f = 5.712 GHz（k = 119.7 m⁻¹）、V = 20 MV、R₃₄ = 20 m、E = 3 GeV 時 S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16，1 fs（0.30 µm）在屏上拉開 4.8 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The longitudinal shear S = eV·k·R34/E with C-band f = 5.712 GHz (k = 119.7 m⁻¹), V = 20 MV, R34 = 20 m and E = 3 GeV is S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16, so 1 fs (0.30 µm) spreads to 4.8 µm on the screen.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔
knowledge.titleEn: Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector
knowledge.text: 束團長度只有數十 fs，電子學無法直接量測。橫向偏轉腔以零交叉相位的橫向射頻場，讓束團頭尾得到方向相反的偏轉，把時間軸轉成螢光屏上的垂直位置；再配合水平偏轉的能譜儀，一張影像就能同時看到電流、切片能量散佈與能量啁啾。
knowledge.textEn: Bunches only tens of femtoseconds long cannot be measured directly with electronics. A transverse deflecting cavity applies a transverse RF field at zero crossing so head and tail are kicked in opposite directions, mapping time onto vertical position on a screen; combined with a horizontally bending spectrometer, one image shows current, slice energy spread and energy chirp together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector" is correct?
options: 屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。
束團長度只有數十 fs，電子學無法直接量測。
optionsEn: The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.
RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time.
Bunches only tens of femtoseconds long cannot be measured directly with electronics.
quiz.explanation: 束團長度只有數十 fs，電子學無法直接量測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bunches only tens of femtoseconds long cannot be measured directly with electronics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：縱向剪切 S = eV·k·R₃₄/E：C 波段 f = 5.712 GHz（k = 119.7 m⁻¹）、V = 20 MV、R₃₄ = 20 m、E = 3 GeV 時 S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16，1 fs（0.30 µm）在屏上拉開 4.8 µm。若關閉偏轉腔時屏上垂直尺寸 σ_y0 = 50 µm，時間解析度 ≈ 50/4.8 ≈ 10.4 fs；要達到 5 fs，需把電壓或 R₃₄ 加倍，或把 σ_y0 降到 24 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The longitudinal shear S = eV·k·R34/E with C-band f = 5.712 GHz (k = 119.7 m⁻¹), V = 20 MV, R34 = 20 m and E = 3 GeV is S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16, so 1 fs (0.30 µm) spreads to 4.8 µm on the screen. With a vertical size σ_y0 = 50 µm at the screen when the deflector is off, the time resolution ≈ 50/4.8 ≈ 10.4 fs; reaching 5 fs requires doubling the voltage or R34, or cutting σ_y0 to 24 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以偏轉腔相位做小幅掃描，取屏上束流質心位移對相位的斜率作為時間標定（µm/fs）；在兩個零交叉（+90° 與 −90°）各量一次，以消除束團內原有的 y–z 相關；關閉偏轉腔量 σ_y0 確認解析度，並以相干輻射監測器的訊號趨勢交叉檢查壓縮量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the time axis by scanning the deflector phase slightly and taking the slope of centroid displacement versus phase (µm per fs); measure at both zero crossings, +90° and −90°, to cancel any intrinsic y–z correlation in the bunch; measure σ_y0 with the deflector off to confirm resolution, and cross-check compression against the coherent-radiation monitor trend.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 縱向剪切 S = eV·k·R₃₄/E：C 波段 f = 5.712 GHz（k = 119.7 m⁻¹）、V = 20 MV、R₃₄ = 20 m、E = 3 GeV 時 S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16，1 fs（0.30 µm）在屏上拉開 4.8 µm。若關閉偏轉腔時屏上垂直尺寸 σ_y0 = 50 µm，時間解析度 ≈ 50/4.8 ≈ 10.4 fs；要達到 5 fs，需把電壓或 R₃₄ 加倍，或把 σ_y0 降到 24 µm。
knowledge.textEn: The longitudinal shear S = eV·k·R34/E with C-band f = 5.712 GHz (k = 119.7 m⁻¹), V = 20 MV, R34 = 20 m and E = 3 GeV is S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16, so 1 fs (0.30 µm) spreads to 4.8 µm on the screen. With a vertical size σ_y0 = 50 µm at the screen when the deflector is off, the time resolution ≈ 50/4.8 ≈ 10.4 fs; reaching 5 fs requires doubling the voltage or R34, or cutting σ_y0 to 24 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector", which statement holds?
options: 縱向剪切 S = eV·k·R₃₄/E：C 波段 f = 5.712 GHz（k = 119.7 m⁻¹）、V = 20 MV、R₃₄ = 20 m、E = 3 GeV 時 S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16，1 fs（0.30 µm）在屏上拉開 4.8 µm。
偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。
電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。
optionsEn: The longitudinal shear S = eV·k·R34/E with C-band f = 5.712 GHz (k = 119.7 m⁻¹), V = 20 MV, R34 = 20 m and E = 3 GeV is S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16, so 1 fs (0.30 µm) spreads to 4.8 µm on the screen.
Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated.
The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal.
quiz.explanation: 縱向剪切 S = eV·k·R₃₄/E：C 波段 f = 5.712 GHz（k = 119.7 m⁻¹）、V = 20 MV、R₃₄ = 20 m、E = 3 GeV 時 S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16，1 fs（0.30 µm）在屏上拉開 4.8 µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The longitudinal shear S = eV·k·R34/E with C-band f = 5.712 GHz (k = 119.7 m⁻¹), V = 20 MV, R34 = 20 m and E = 3 GeV is S ≈ 20×119.7×20/3000 ≈ 16, so 1 fs (0.30 µm) spreads to 4.8 µm on the screen. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以偏轉腔相位做小幅掃描，取屏上束流質心位移對相位的斜率作為時間標定（µm/fs）；在兩個零交叉（+90° 與 −90°）各量一次，以消除束團內原有的 y–z 相關；關閉偏轉腔量 σ_y0 確認解析度，並以相干輻射監測器的訊號趨勢交叉檢查壓縮量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the time axis by scanning the deflector phase slightly and taking the slope of centroid displacement versus phase (µm per fs); measure at both zero crossings, +90° and −90°, to cancel any intrinsic y–z correlation in the bunch; measure σ_y0 with the deflector off to confirm resolution, and cross-check compression against the coherent-radiation monitor trend. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%；據此調整壓縮器後，實際峰值電流偏離設計，增益長度變長，飽和點移出波盪器末端。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low; tuning the compressors on that basis leaves the real peak current off design, lengthens the gain length and moves saturation past the end of the undulator.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以偏轉腔相位做小幅掃描，取屏上束流質心位移對相位的斜率作為時間標定（µm/fs）；在兩個零交叉（+90° 與 −90°）各量一次，以消除束團內原有的 y–z 相關；關閉偏轉腔量 σ_y0 確認解析度，並以相干輻射監測器的訊號趨勢交叉檢查壓縮量。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the time axis by scanning the deflector phase slightly and taking the slope of centroid displacement versus phase (µm per fs); measure at both zero crossings, +90° and −90°, to cancel any intrinsic y–z correlation in the bunch; measure σ_y0 with the deflector off to confirm resolution, and cross-check compression against the coherent-radiation monitor trend.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以偏轉腔相位做小幅掃描，取屏上束流質心位移對相位的斜率作為時間標定（µm/fs）。
電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate the time axis by scanning the deflector phase slightly and taking the slope of centroid displacement versus phase (µm per fs).
The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun.
quiz.explanation: 以偏轉腔相位做小幅掃描，取屏上束流質心位移對相位的斜率作為時間標定（µm/fs）；在兩個零交叉（+90° 與 −90°）各量一次，以消除束團內原有的 y–z 相關；關閉偏轉腔量 σ_y0 確認解析度，並以相干輻射監測器的訊號趨勢交叉檢查壓縮量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the time axis by scanning the deflector phase slightly and taking the slope of centroid displacement versus phase (µm per fs); measure at both zero crossings, +90° and −90°, to cancel any intrinsic y–z correlation in the bunch; measure σ_y0 with the deflector off to confirm resolution, and cross-check compression against the coherent-radiation monitor trend. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%；據此調整壓縮器後，實際峰值電流偏離設計，增益長度變長，飽和點移出波盪器末端。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low; tuning the compressors on that basis leaves the real peak current off design, lengthens the gain length and moves saturation past the end of the undulator. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：放在波盪器之後時，還能比較有無雷射作用時的切片能量損失，重建 X 光脈衝的時間形狀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Placed after the undulator, it compares slice energy loss with and without lasing to reconstruct the X-ray pulse's temporal shape.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%；據此調整壓縮器後，實際峰值電流偏離設計，增益長度變長，飽和點移出波盪器末端。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low; tuning the compressors on that basis leaves the real peak current off design, lengthens the gain length and moves saturation past the end of the undulator.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「飛秒級縱向診斷：橫向偏轉腔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics: the transverse deflector" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。
只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time.
Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low.
quiz.explanation: 只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%；據此調整壓縮器後，實際峰值電流偏離設計，增益長度變長，飽和點移出波盪器末端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low; tuning the compressors on that basis leaves the real peak current off design, lengthens the gain length and moves saturation past the end of the undulator. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 加速器每一段的射頻相位與振幅抖動，都會透過壓縮器轉換成束流參數的逐發變動：相位抖動改變啁啾，使壓縮因子與峰值電流抖動，進而改變增益長度與脈衝能量；振幅抖動造成能量偏差，經 R₅₆ 轉成到達時間偏移，並在最終能量上轉成光子波長抖動。壓縮因子在高壓縮時對啁啾非常敏感，因此第一級壓縮器之前的射頻穩定度要求最嚴，常需 0.02° 與 10⁻⁴ 等級，由低階射頻控制與光纖時序分配系統共同達成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Phase and amplitude jitter in every RF section becomes shot-to-shot variation of beam parameters through the compressors: phase jitter alters the chirp, so compression factor and peak current fluctuate, changing gain length and pulse energy; amplitude jitter produces energy deviation that R56 converts into arrival-time offset and, at the final energy, into photon-wavelength jitter. Because the compression factor is very sensitive to chirp at strong compression, RF stability before the first compressor is the most demanding, often at the 0.02° and 10⁻⁴ level, achieved jointly by low-level RF control and an optical-fibre timing distribution system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第一級壓縮 C = 1/(1 + hR₅₆) = 10，即 hR₅₆ = −0.9；啁啾 h ∝ sin φ，離峰 20° 時相位抖動 0.02°（3.49×10⁻⁴ rad）使 dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴，壓縮因子變動 dC/C ≈ C·|hR₅₆|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a first-stage compression C = 1/(1 + hR56) = 10, hR56 = −0.9; the chirp h ∝ sin φ, so at 20° off crest a phase jitter of 0.02° (3.49×10⁻⁴ rad) gives dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴ and a compression change dC/C ≈ C·|hR56|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間
knowledge.titleEn: Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time
knowledge.text: 加速器每一段的射頻相位與振幅抖動，都會透過壓縮器轉換成束流參數的逐發變動：相位抖動改變啁啾，使壓縮因子與峰值電流抖動，進而改變增益長度與脈衝能量；振幅抖動造成能量偏差，經 R₅₆ 轉成到達時間偏移，並在最終能量上轉成光子波長抖動。壓縮因子在高壓縮時對啁啾非常敏感，因此第一級壓縮器之前的射頻穩定度要求最嚴，常需 0.02° 與 10⁻⁴ 等級，由低階射頻控制與光纖時序分配系統共同達成。
knowledge.textEn: Phase and amplitude jitter in every RF section becomes shot-to-shot variation of beam parameters through the compressors: phase jitter alters the chirp, so compression factor and peak current fluctuate, changing gain length and pulse energy; amplitude jitter produces energy deviation that R56 converts into arrival-time offset and, at the final energy, into photon-wavelength jitter. Because the compression factor is very sensitive to chirp at strong compression, RF stability before the first compressor is the most demanding, often at the 0.02° and 10⁻⁴ level, achieved jointly by low-level RF control and an optical-fibre timing distribution system.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time" is correct?
options: 加速器每一段的射頻相位與振幅抖動，都會透過壓縮器轉換成束流參數的逐發變動：相位抖動改變啁啾，使壓縮因子與峰值電流抖動，進而改變增益長度與脈衝能量。
射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。
波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。
optionsEn: Phase and amplitude jitter in every RF section becomes shot-to-shot variation of beam parameters through the compressors: phase jitter alters the chirp, so compression factor and peak current fluctuate, changing gain length and pulse energy.
RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time.
If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.
quiz.explanation: 加速器每一段的射頻相位與振幅抖動，都會透過壓縮器轉換成束流參數的逐發變動：相位抖動改變啁啾，使壓縮因子與峰值電流抖動，進而改變增益長度與脈衝能量；振幅抖動造成能量偏差，經 R₅₆ 轉成到達時間偏移，並在最終能量上轉成光子波長抖動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase and amplitude jitter in every RF section becomes shot-to-shot variation of beam parameters through the compressors: phase jitter alters the chirp, so compression factor and peak current fluctuate, changing gain length and pulse energy; amplitude jitter produces energy deviation that R56 converts into arrival-time offset and, at the final energy, into photon-wavelength jitter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第一級壓縮 C = 1/(1 + hR₅₆) = 10，即 hR₅₆ = −0.9；啁啾 h ∝ sin φ，離峰 20° 時相位抖動 0.02°（3.49×10⁻⁴ rad）使 dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴，壓縮因子變動 dC/C ≈ C·|hR₅₆|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%。振幅抖動 10⁻⁴ 造成 δ = 10⁻⁴，經 R₅₆ = 45 mm 得 Δz = 4.5 µm，到達時間偏移約 15 fs。最終能量抖動 2×10⁻⁴ 使 12.4 keV 光子偏移約 5 eV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a first-stage compression C = 1/(1 + hR56) = 10, hR56 = −0.9; the chirp h ∝ sin φ, so at 20° off crest a phase jitter of 0.02° (3.49×10⁻⁴ rad) gives dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴ and a compression change dC/C ≈ C·|hR56|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%. Amplitude jitter of 10⁻⁴ gives δ = 10⁻⁴, which R56 = 45 mm turns into Δz = 4.5 µm, an arrival-time offset of about 15 fs. A final energy jitter of 2×10⁻⁴ shifts 12.4 keV photons by about 5 eV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐發記錄各射頻站的相位與振幅、各壓縮器後的相干輻射監測器訊號、到達時間監測器與能量 BPM，計算變數之間的相關係數與靈敏度矩陣；以刻意小幅改變單一站相位的方式驗證靈敏度，並把量到的抖動依預算表分配給各站。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log shot by shot the phase and amplitude of every RF station, the coherent-radiation monitor after each compressor, the bunch-arrival-time monitor and an energy BPM; compute correlation coefficients and a sensitivity matrix between them, verify each sensitivity by deliberately stepping one station's phase slightly, and allocate the measured jitter to stations according to the budget table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 第一級壓縮 C = 1/(1 + hR₅₆) = 10，即 hR₅₆ = −0.9；啁啾 h ∝ sin φ，離峰 20° 時相位抖動 0.02°（3.49×10⁻⁴ rad）使 dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴，壓縮因子變動 dC/C ≈ C·|hR₅₆|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%。振幅抖動 10⁻⁴ 造成 δ = 10⁻⁴，經 R₅₆ = 45 mm 得 Δz = 4.5 µm，到達時間偏移約 15 fs。最終能量抖動 2×10⁻⁴ 使 12.4 keV 光子偏移約 5 eV。
knowledge.textEn: For a first-stage compression C = 1/(1 + hR56) = 10, hR56 = −0.9; the chirp h ∝ sin φ, so at 20° off crest a phase jitter of 0.02° (3.49×10⁻⁴ rad) gives dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴ and a compression change dC/C ≈ C·|hR56|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%. Amplitude jitter of 10⁻⁴ gives δ = 10⁻⁴, which R56 = 45 mm turns into Δz = 4.5 µm, an arrival-time offset of about 15 fs. A final energy jitter of 2×10⁻⁴ shifts 12.4 keV photons by about 5 eV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time", which statement holds?
options: FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
第一級壓縮 C = 1/(1 + hR₅₆) = 10，即 hR₅₆ = −0.9。
電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。
optionsEn: An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.
For a first-stage compression C = 1/(1 + hR56) = 10, hR56 = −0.9.
The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun.
quiz.explanation: 第一級壓縮 C = 1/(1 + hR₅₆) = 10，即 hR₅₆ = −0.9；啁啾 h ∝ sin φ，離峰 20° 時相位抖動 0.02°（3.49×10⁻⁴ rad）使 dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴，壓縮因子變動 dC/C ≈ C·|hR₅₆|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a first-stage compression C = 1/(1 + hR56) = 10, hR56 = −0.9; the chirp h ∝ sin φ, so at 20° off crest a phase jitter of 0.02° (3.49×10⁻⁴ rad) gives dh/h = cot 20°×3.49×10⁻⁴ ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴ and a compression change dC/C ≈ C·|hR56|·dh/h ≈ 10×0.9×9.6×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.86%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐發記錄各射頻站的相位與振幅、各壓縮器後的相干輻射監測器訊號、到達時間監測器與能量 BPM，計算變數之間的相關係數與靈敏度矩陣；以刻意小幅改變單一站相位的方式驗證靈敏度，並把量到的抖動依預算表分配給各站。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log shot by shot the phase and amplitude of every RF station, the coherent-radiation monitor after each compressor, the bunch-arrival-time monitor and an energy BPM; compute correlation coefficients and a sensitivity matrix between them, verify each sensitivity by deliberately stepping one station's phase slightly, and allocate the measured jitter to stations according to the budget table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某一速調管調變器的高壓漣波增加，相位抖動從 0.02° 升到 0.1°，峰值電流抖動放大到約 4%，X 光脈衝能量的逐發起伏變大且與電流高度相關；若只看平均脈衝能量，問題會被誤判為波盪器失準。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Increased high-voltage ripple in one klystron modulator raises phase jitter from 0.02° to 0.1°, amplifying peak-current jitter to about 4%; X-ray pulse-energy fluctuation grows and correlates strongly with current, and looking only at average pulse energy misdiagnoses the problem as undulator misalignment.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐發記錄各射頻站的相位與振幅、各壓縮器後的相干輻射監測器訊號、到達時間監測器與能量 BPM，計算變數之間的相關係數與靈敏度矩陣；以刻意小幅改變單一站相位的方式驗證靈敏度，並把量到的抖動依預算表分配給各站。
knowledge.textEn: Log shot by shot the phase and amplitude of every RF station, the coherent-radiation monitor after each compressor, the bunch-arrival-time monitor and an energy BPM; compute correlation coefficients and a sensitivity matrix between them, verify each sensitivity by deliberately stepping one station's phase slightly, and allocate the measured jitter to stations according to the budget table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。
逐發記錄各射頻站的相位與振幅、各壓縮器後的相干輻射監測器訊號、到達時間監測器與能量 BPM，計算變數之間的相關係數與靈敏度矩陣。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch.
Log shot by shot the phase and amplitude of every RF station, the coherent-radiation monitor after each compressor, the bunch-arrival-time monitor and an energy BPM.
quiz.explanation: 逐發記錄各射頻站的相位與振幅、各壓縮器後的相干輻射監測器訊號、到達時間監測器與能量 BPM，計算變數之間的相關係數與靈敏度矩陣；以刻意小幅改變單一站相位的方式驗證靈敏度，並把量到的抖動依預算表分配給各站。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log shot by shot the phase and amplitude of every RF station, the coherent-radiation monitor after each compressor, the bunch-arrival-time monitor and an energy BPM; compute correlation coefficients and a sensitivity matrix between them, verify each sensitivity by deliberately stepping one station's phase slightly, and allocate the measured jitter to stations according to the budget table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某一速調管調變器的高壓漣波增加，相位抖動從 0.02° 升到 0.1°，峰值電流抖動放大到約 4%，X 光脈衝能量的逐發起伏變大且與電流高度相關；若只看平均脈衝能量，問題會被誤判為波盪器失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Increased high-voltage ripple in one klystron modulator raises phase jitter from 0.02° to 0.1°, amplifying peak-current jitter to about 4%; X-ray pulse-energy fluctuation grows and correlates strongly with current, and looking only at average pulse energy misdiagnoses the problem as undulator misalignment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓縮因子在高壓縮時對啁啾非常敏感，因此第一級壓縮器之前的射頻穩定度要求最嚴，常需 0.02° 與 10⁻⁴ 等級，由低階射頻控制與光纖時序分配系統共同達成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the compression factor is very sensitive to chirp at strong compression, RF stability before the first compressor is the most demanding, often at the 0.02° and 10⁻⁴ level, achieved jointly by low-level RF control and an optical-fibre timing distribution system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一速調管調變器的高壓漣波增加，相位抖動從 0.02° 升到 0.1°，峰值電流抖動放大到約 4%，X 光脈衝能量的逐發起伏變大且與電流高度相關；若只看平均脈衝能量，問題會被誤判為波盪器失準。
knowledge.textEn: Increased high-voltage ripple in one klystron modulator raises phase jitter from 0.02° to 0.1°, amplifying peak-current jitter to about 4%; X-ray pulse-energy fluctuation grows and correlates strongly with current, and looking only at average pulse energy misdiagnoses the problem as undulator misalignment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抖動預算：從射頻穩定度到峰值電流與到達時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Jitter budget: from RF stability to peak current and arrival time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某一速調管調變器的高壓漣波增加，相位抖動從 0.02° 升到 0.1°，峰值電流抖動放大到約 4%，X 光脈衝能量的逐發起伏變大且與電流高度相關。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。
optionsEn: Increased high-voltage ripple in one klystron modulator raises phase jitter from 0.02° to 0.1°, amplifying peak-current jitter to about 4%.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.
quiz.explanation: 某一速調管調變器的高壓漣波增加，相位抖動從 0.02° 升到 0.1°，峰值電流抖動放大到約 4%，X 光脈衝能量的逐發起伏變大且與電流高度相關；若只看平均脈衝能量，問題會被誤判為波盪器失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Increased high-voltage ripple in one klystron modulator raises phase jitter from 0.02° to 0.1°, amplifying peak-current jitter to about 4%; X-ray pulse-energy fluctuation grows and correlates strongly with current, and looking only at average pulse energy misdiagnoses the problem as undulator misalignment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化」與「增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding" and "Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波盪器線與自種子晶體」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波盪器由數十段 4 到 5 m 的模組組成，段間以四極聚焦、相位器與 BPM 銜接。電子軌道只要有微小角度偏差，路徑就比直線長，與光的相對相位滑移，使微束團與輻射失去同步；因此整條波盪器線要以束流基準對準，把軌道直線度做到每數公尺數微米。SASE 從雜訊起始，頻譜呈尖刺狀；硬 X 光自種子在中段插入鑽石晶體，以前半段 SASE 光經布拉格反射後的尾波作為窄頻種子，後半段只放大種子，使頻寬與穩定度大幅改善。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器線與自種子晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The undulator consists of tens of 4 to 5 m modules joined by quadrupoles, phase shifters and BPMs. Any small angular deviation lengthens the electron path relative to a straight line and slips its phase relative to the light, desynchronizing microbunches and radiation, so the whole line needs beam-based alignment to a straightness of a few micrometres over several metres. SASE starts from noise and has a spiky spectrum; hard X-ray self-seeding inserts a diamond crystal mid-line where the Bragg-reflected wake of the first half's SASE light serves as a narrow-band seed, and the second half amplifies only the seed, greatly improving bandwidth and stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：軌道角度 x' 使電子比直線多走 Δs = ½∫x'²ds。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An orbit angle x' makes the electron travel Δs = ½∫x'²ds more than a straight path.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波盪器線與自種子晶體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding
knowledge.text: 波盪器由數十段 4 到 5 m 的模組組成，段間以四極聚焦、相位器與 BPM 銜接。電子軌道只要有微小角度偏差，路徑就比直線長，與光的相對相位滑移，使微束團與輻射失去同步；因此整條波盪器線要以束流基準對準，把軌道直線度做到每數公尺數微米。
knowledge.textEn: The undulator consists of tens of 4 to 5 m modules joined by quadrupoles, phase shifters and BPMs. Any small angular deviation lengthens the electron path relative to a straight line and slips its phase relative to the light, desynchronizing microbunches and radiation, so the whole line needs beam-based alignment to a straightness of a few micrometres over several metres.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding" is correct?
options: 波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。
波盪器由數十段 4 到 5 m 的模組組成，段間以四極聚焦、相位器與 BPM 銜接。
偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。
optionsEn: If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little.
The undulator consists of tens of 4 to 5 m modules joined by quadrupoles, phase shifters and BPMs.
Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated.
quiz.explanation: 波盪器由數十段 4 到 5 m 的模組組成，段間以四極聚焦、相位器與 BPM 銜接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The undulator consists of tens of 4 to 5 m modules joined by quadrupoles, phase shifters and BPMs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波盪器線與自種子晶體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：軌道角度 x' 使電子比直線多走 Δs = ½∫x'²ds。在約兩個增益長度（3 m）內 x' = 2 µrad：Δs = ½×(2×10⁻⁶)²×3 = 6×10⁻¹² m，相對 0.1 nm 光的相位滑移 2π×6×10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 21.6°；x' = 1 µrad 時降為 5.4°。因此軌道角度要壓到約 1 µrad，相當於 3 m 內位置偏差約 3 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An orbit angle x' makes the electron travel Δs = ½∫x'²ds more than a straight path. With x' = 2 µrad over about two gain lengths (3 m), Δs = ½×(2×10⁻⁶)²×3 = 6×10⁻¹² m, a phase slip of 2π×6×10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 21.6° relative to 0.1 nm light; at x' = 1 µrad it falls to 5.4°. The orbit angle must therefore be held to about 1 µrad, equivalent to about 3 µm of position error over 3 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束流基準對準：在數個不同電子能量下記錄 BPM 讀數，四極偏移造成的軌道會隨能量改變，解出各四極與 BPM 的偏移並修正，反覆進行到軌道對能量不敏感；再逐段關閉間隙量自發輻射與增益，並以相位器掃描找出各段之間脈衝能量最大的設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use beam-based alignment: record BPM readings at several electron energies, since orbits caused by quadrupole offsets change with energy, solve for each quadrupole and BPM offset, correct, and iterate until the orbit is insensitive to energy; then close segments one by one to measure spontaneous emission and gain, and scan phase shifters to find the inter-segment settings that maximize pulse energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 軌道角度 x' 使電子比直線多走 Δs = ½∫x'²ds。在約兩個增益長度（3 m）內 x' = 2 µrad：Δs = ½×(2×10⁻⁶)²×3 = 6×10⁻¹² m，相對 0.1 nm 光的相位滑移 2π×6×10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 21.6°；x' = 1 µrad 時降為 5.4°。因此軌道角度要壓到約 1 µrad，相當於 3 m 內位置偏差約 3 µm。
knowledge.textEn: An orbit angle x' makes the electron travel Δs = ½∫x'²ds more than a straight path. With x' = 2 µrad over about two gain lengths (3 m), Δs = ½×(2×10⁻⁶)²×3 = 6×10⁻¹² m, a phase slip of 2π×6×10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 21.6° relative to 0.1 nm light; at x' = 1 µrad it falls to 5.4°. The orbit angle must therefore be held to about 1 µrad, equivalent to about 3 µm of position error over 3 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding", which statement holds?
options: 電子束能量散佈越小越好，降到零最理想。
只要加速到夠高能量，束團長度就會自動變短。
軌道角度 x' 使電子比直線多走 Δs = ½∫x'²ds。
optionsEn: The smaller the energy spread the better; zero would be ideal.
Accelerating to high enough energy automatically shortens the bunch.
An orbit angle x' makes the electron travel Δs = ½∫x'²ds more than a straight path.
quiz.explanation: 軌道角度 x' 使電子比直線多走 Δs = ½∫x'²ds。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An orbit angle x' makes the electron travel Δs = ½∫x'²ds more than a straight path. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波盪器線與自種子晶體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束流基準對準：在數個不同電子能量下記錄 BPM 讀數，四極偏移造成的軌道會隨能量改變，解出各四極與 BPM 的偏移並修正，反覆進行到軌道對能量不敏感；再逐段關閉間隙量自發輻射與增益，並以相位器掃描找出各段之間脈衝能量最大的設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use beam-based alignment: record BPM readings at several electron energies, since orbits caused by quadrupole offsets change with energy, solve for each quadrupole and BPM offset, correct, and iterate until the orbit is insensitive to energy; then close segments one by one to measure spontaneous emission and gain, and scan phase shifters to find the inter-segment settings that maximize pulse energy. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：波盪器段因地基沉陷或溫度梯度偏移數十微米卻未重新對準，只有部分段貢獻增益，飽和點後移，脈衝能量下降一半；若自種子晶體處的電子軌道偏移，種子與電子不重疊，種子化效果消失而只剩 SASE。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Undulator segments shifted tens of micrometres by foundation settlement or thermal gradients, but not realigned, leave only some segments contributing gain, pushing saturation downstream and halving pulse energy; if the orbit at the self-seeding crystal is off, the seed and electrons do not overlap, seeding vanishes and only SASE remains.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以束流基準對準：在數個不同電子能量下記錄 BPM 讀數，四極偏移造成的軌道會隨能量改變，解出各四極與 BPM 的偏移並修正，反覆進行到軌道對能量不敏感；再逐段關閉間隙量自發輻射與增益，並以相位器掃描找出各段之間脈衝能量最大的設定。
knowledge.textEn: Use beam-based alignment: record BPM readings at several electron energies, since orbits caused by quadrupole offsets change with energy, solve for each quadrupole and BPM offset, correct, and iterate until the orbit is insensitive to energy; then close segments one by one to measure spontaneous emission and gain, and scan phase shifters to find the inter-segment settings that maximize pulse energy.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding"?
options: 以束流基準對準：在數個不同電子能量下記錄 BPM 讀數，四極偏移造成的軌道會隨能量改變，解出各四極與 BPM 的偏移並修正，反覆進行到軌道對能量不敏感。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
optionsEn: Use beam-based alignment: record BPM readings at several electron energies, since orbits caused by quadrupole offsets change with energy, solve for each quadrupole and BPM offset, correct, and iterate until the orbit is insensitive to energy.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.

quiz.explanationEn: Use beam-based alignment: record BPM readings at several electron energies, since orbits caused by quadrupole offsets change with energy, solve for each quadrupole and BPM offset, correct, and iterate until the orbit is insensitive to energy; then close segments one by one to measure spontaneous emission and gain, and scan phase shifters to find the inter-segment settings that maximize pulse energy. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator-line integration: trajectory straightness, phase matching and seeding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波盪器線與自種子晶體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 波盪器段因地基沉陷或溫度梯度偏移數十微米卻未重新對準，只有部分段貢獻增益，飽和點後移，脈衝能量下降一半；若自種子晶體處的電子軌道偏移，種子與電子不重疊，種子化效果消失而只剩 SASE。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Undulator segments shifted tens of micrometres by foundation settlement or thermal gradients, but not realigned, leave only some segments contributing gain, pushing saturation downstream and halving pulse energy; if the orbit at the self-seeding crystal is off, the seed and electrons do not overlap, seeding vanishes and only SASE remains. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：SASE 從雜訊起始，頻譜呈尖刺狀；硬 X 光自種子在中段插入鑽石晶體，以前半段 SASE 光經布拉格反射後的尾波作為窄頻種子，後半段只放大種子，使頻寬與穩定度大幅改善。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: SASE starts from noise and has a spiky spectrum; hard X-ray self-seeding inserts a diamond crystal mid-line where the Bragg-reflected wake of the first half's SASE light serves as a narrow-band seed, and the second half amplifies only the seed, greatly improving bandwidth and stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波盪器只要磁場合格，電子軌道誤差影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the undulator field passes, electron orbit errors matter little." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 波盪器段因地基沉陷或溫度梯度偏移數十微米卻未重新對準，只有部分段貢獻增益，飽和點後移，脈衝能量下降一半；若自種子晶體處的電子軌道偏移，種子與電子不重疊，種子化效果消失而只剩 SASE。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波盪器線整合：軌道直線度、相位匹配與種子化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」如何決定自由電子雷射加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Free-electron-laser accelerators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試運轉的核心證據是增益曲線：逐段打開波盪器間隙，或以軌道踢出使後段失效，量 X 光脈衝能量對有效波盪器長度的關係；指數增長段的斜率給出實際增益長度，轉平的位置給出飽和點。實測增益長度與由量測束流參數預測的三維值比較，可以判斷是發射度、能量散佈還是軌道誤差在吃掉增益。交接時要把操作點（電荷、壓縮設定、雷射加熱器能量、波盪器錐度）連同增益曲線、脈衝能量統計、波長穩定度與射頻抖動預算一起留下。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The core commissioning evidence is the gain curve: open undulator gaps segment by segment, or kick the orbit to disable downstream sections, and measure X-ray pulse energy versus active undulator length; the slope of the exponential region gives the real gain length and the turnover gives the saturation point. Comparing the measured gain length with the three-dimensional prediction from measured beam parameters shows whether emittance, energy spread or orbit error is eating the gain. Handoff records the working point (charge, compression settings, laser-heater energy, undulator taper) together with the gain curve, pulse-energy statistics, wavelength stability and the RF jitter budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 z = 20 m 量到 10 µJ、z = 26 m 量到 400 µJ：L_g = Δz/ln(E₂/E₁) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m，比一維值 1.39 m 長約 17%，屬三維效應的合理範圍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Measuring 10 µJ at z = 20 m and 400 µJ at z = 26 m gives L_g = Δz/ln(E2/E1) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m, about 17% longer than the one-dimensional 1.39 m and within the normal range of three-dimensional effects.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接

knowledge.textEn: The core commissioning evidence is the gain curve: open undulator gaps segment by segment, or kick the orbit to disable downstream sections, and measure X-ray pulse energy versus active undulator length; the slope of the exponential region gives the real gain length and the turnover gives the saturation point. Comparing the measured gain length with the three-dimensional prediction from measured beam parameters shows whether emittance, energy spread or orbit error is eating the gain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff" is correct?
options: 偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。
FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
試運轉的核心證據是增益曲線：逐段打開波盪器間隙，或以軌道踢出使後段失效，量 X 光脈衝能量對有效波盪器長度的關係。
optionsEn: Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated.
An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.

The core commissioning evidence is the gain curve: open undulator gaps segment by segment, or kick the orbit to disable downstream sections, and measure X-ray pulse energy versus active undulator length.
quiz.explanation: 試運轉的核心證據是增益曲線：逐段打開波盪器間隙，或以軌道踢出使後段失效，量 X 光脈衝能量對有效波盪器長度的關係；指數增長段的斜率給出實際增益長度，轉平的位置給出飽和點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The core commissioning evidence is the gain curve: open undulator gaps segment by segment, or kick the orbit to disable downstream sections, and measure X-ray pulse energy versus active undulator length; the slope of the exponential region gives the real gain length and the turnover gives the saturation point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 z = 20 m 量到 10 µJ、z = 26 m 量到 400 µJ：L_g = Δz/ln(E₂/E₁) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m，比一維值 1.39 m 長約 17%，屬三維效應的合理範圍。飽和脈衝能量約為 ρ 乘以束團能量：4.9×10⁻⁴×200 pC×5.8 GV ≈ 0.57 mJ，在 12.4 keV 相當於 0.57 mJ/(12.4 keV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV) ≈ 2.9×10¹¹ 個光子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Measuring 10 µJ at z = 20 m and 400 µJ at z = 26 m gives L_g = Δz/ln(E2/E1) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m, about 17% longer than the one-dimensional 1.39 m and within the normal range of three-dimensional effects. The saturation pulse energy is roughly ρ times the bunch energy, 4.9×10⁻⁴×200 pC×5.8 GV ≈ 0.57 mJ, which at 12.4 keV is 0.57 mJ/(12.4 keV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV) ≈ 2.9×10¹¹ photons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：增益曲線每點至少平均數百發，以壓低 SASE 的統計起伏，並以絕對校正的氣體偵測器與熱電型能量計交叉校正脈衝能量；以錐度掃描確認飽和後的能量提取；交接前連續運轉 24 小時，記錄脈衝能量、波長與到達時間的統計，作為日後比對的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Average at least hundreds of shots per gain-curve point to suppress SASE statistical fluctuation, and cross-calibrate pulse energy between an absolutely calibrated gas detector and a thermal energy meter; scan the taper to confirm post-saturation energy extraction; before handoff run continuously for 24 hours logging pulse-energy, wavelength and arrival-time statistics as the baseline for later comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 在 z = 20 m 量到 10 µJ、z = 26 m 量到 400 µJ：L_g = Δz/ln(E₂/E₁) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m，比一維值 1.39 m 長約 17%，屬三維效應的合理範圍。飽和脈衝能量約為 ρ 乘以束團能量：4.9×10⁻⁴×200 pC×5.8 GV ≈ 0.57 mJ，在 12.4 keV 相當於 0.57 mJ/(12.4 keV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV) ≈ 2.9×10¹¹ 個光子。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring 10 µJ at z = 20 m and 400 µJ at z = 26 m gives L_g = Δz/ln(E2/E1) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m, about 17% longer than the one-dimensional 1.39 m and within the normal range of three-dimensional effects. The saturation pulse energy is roughly ρ times the bunch energy, 4.9×10⁻⁴×200 pC×5.8 GV ≈ 0.57 mJ, which at 12.4 keV is 0.57 mJ/(12.4 keV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV) ≈ 2.9×10¹¹ photons.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff", which statement holds?
options: 在 z = 20 m 量到 10 µJ、z = 26 m 量到 400 µJ：L_g = Δz/ln(E₂/E₁) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m，比一維值 1.39 m 長約 17%，屬三維效應的合理範圍。
電子槍之後的加速器可以降低正規化發射度，補回電子槍的不足。
屏上看到的垂直長度就是束團長度，不必扣除束流本身的尺寸。
optionsEn: Measuring 10 µJ at z = 20 m and 400 µJ at z = 26 m gives L_g = Δz/ln(E2/E1) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m, about 17% longer than the one-dimensional 1.39 m and within the normal range of three-dimensional effects.
The linac after the gun can reduce normalized emittance and make up for a poor gun.
The vertical length on the screen equals the bunch length with no need to remove the beam's own size.
