quiz.explanationEn: Measuring 10 µJ at z = 20 m and 400 µJ at z = 26 m gives L_g = Δz/ln(E2/E1) = 6/ln 40 ≈ 1.63 m, about 17% longer than the one-dimensional 1.39 m and within the normal range of three-dimensional effects. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 增益曲線每點至少平均數百發，以壓低 SASE 的統計起伏，並以絕對校正的氣體偵測器與熱電型能量計交叉校正脈衝能量；以錐度掃描確認飽和後的能量提取；交接前連續運轉 24 小時，記錄脈衝能量、波長與到達時間的統計，作為日後比對的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Average at least hundreds of shots per gain-curve point to suppress SASE statistical fluctuation, and cross-calibrate pulse energy between an absolutely calibrated gas detector and a thermal energy meter; scan the taper to confirm post-saturation energy extraction; before handoff run continuously for 24 hours logging pulse-energy, wavelength and arrival-time statistics as the baseline for later comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只以單發最大脈衝能量宣稱達標而忽略平均值與起伏，使用者排程後發現平均脈衝能量只有宣稱值的一半，而且隨冷卻水溫度週期變化，原因是加速結構溫度造成的相位漂移從未納入回授。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Claiming success from the single highest-energy shot while ignoring mean and fluctuation leads users, once scheduled, to find average pulse energy half the claimed value and varying with the cooling-water temperature cycle, because structure-temperature phase drift was never included in feedback.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 增益曲線每點至少平均數百發，以壓低 SASE 的統計起伏，並以絕對校正的氣體偵測器與熱電型能量計交叉校正脈衝能量；以錐度掃描確認飽和後的能量提取；交接前連續運轉 24 小時，記錄脈衝能量、波長與到達時間的統計，作為日後比對的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Average at least hundreds of shots per gain-curve point to suppress SASE statistical fluctuation, and cross-calibrate pulse energy between an absolutely calibrated gas detector and a thermal energy meter; scan the taper to confirm post-saturation energy extraction; before handoff run continuously for 24 hours logging pulse-energy, wavelength and arrival-time statistics as the baseline for later comparison.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
增益曲線每點至少平均數百發，以壓低 SASE 的統計起伏，並以絕對校正的氣體偵測器與熱電型能量計交叉校正脈衝能量。
射頻抖動只影響電子能量，不影響 X 光脈衝的到達時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Average at least hundreds of shots per gain-curve point to suppress SASE statistical fluctuation, and cross-calibrate pulse energy between an absolutely calibrated gas detector and a thermal energy meter.
RF jitter affects only electron energy, not the X-ray pulse arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 增益曲線每點至少平均數百發，以壓低 SASE 的統計起伏，並以絕對校正的氣體偵測器與熱電型能量計交叉校正脈衝能量；以錐度掃描確認飽和後的能量提取；交接前連續運轉 24 小時，記錄脈衝能量、波長與到達時間的統計，作為日後比對的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Average at least hundreds of shots per gain-curve point to suppress SASE statistical fluctuation, and cross-calibrate pulse energy between an absolutely calibrated gas detector and a thermal energy meter; scan the taper to confirm post-saturation energy extraction; before handoff run continuously for 24 hours logging pulse-energy, wavelength and arrival-time statistics as the baseline for later comparison. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只以單發最大脈衝能量宣稱達標而忽略平均值與起伏，使用者排程後發現平均脈衝能量只有宣稱值的一半，而且隨冷卻水溫度週期變化，原因是加速結構溫度造成的相位漂移從未納入回授。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming success from the single highest-energy shot while ignoring mean and fluctuation leads users, once scheduled, to find average pulse energy half the claimed value and varying with the cooling-water temperature cycle, because structure-temperature phase drift was never included in feedback. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時要把操作點（電荷、壓縮設定、雷射加熱器能量、波盪器錐度）連同增益曲線、脈衝能量統計、波長穩定度與射頻抖動預算一起留下。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handoff records the working point (charge, compression settings, laser-heater energy, undulator taper) together with the gain curve, pulse-energy statistics, wavelength stability and the RF jitter budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偵測器上看到 X 光，就表示 FEL 已經飽和。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Seeing X-rays on the detector means the FEL has saturated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以單發最大脈衝能量宣稱達標而忽略平均值與起伏，使用者排程後發現平均脈衝能量只有宣稱值的一半，而且隨冷卻水溫度週期變化，原因是加速結構溫度造成的相位漂移從未納入回授。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming success from the single highest-energy shot while ignoring mean and fluctuation leads users, once scheduled, to find average pulse energy half the claimed value and varying with the cooling-water temperature cycle, because structure-temperature phase drift was never included in feedback.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「增益曲線、飽和脈衝能量與試運轉交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gain curve, saturation pulse energy and commissioning handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
FEL 的輸出波長由雷射介質決定，與電子能量無關。
只以單發最大脈衝能量宣稱達標而忽略平均值與起伏，使用者排程後發現平均脈衝能量只有宣稱值的一半，而且隨冷卻水溫度週期變化，原因是加速結構溫度造成的相位漂移從未納入回授。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An FEL's output wavelength is set by a lasing medium and is independent of electron energy.

Claiming success from the single highest-energy shot while ignoring mean and fluctuation leads users, once scheduled, to find average pulse energy half the claimed value and varying with the cooling-water temperature cycle, because structure-temperature phase drift was never included in feedback.
quiz.explanation: 只以單發最大脈衝能量宣稱達標而忽略平均值與起伏，使用者排程後發現平均脈衝能量只有宣稱值的一半，而且隨冷卻水溫度週期變化，原因是加速結構溫度造成的相位漂移從未納入回授。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming success from the single highest-energy shot while ignoring mean and fluctuation leads users, once scheduled, to find average pulse energy half the claimed value and varying with the cooling-water temperature cycle, because structure-temperature phase drift was never included in feedback. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 粒子加速器射頻腔
summary: 以 500 MHz 級常溫銅射頻腔為主軸，從 TM010 模態與渡越時間因子推到銅壁損耗、分路阻抗與冷卻，再把輸入耦合器 β、網路分析儀與珠拉量測、熱失諧調諧、束流負載補償及速調管與低階射頻迴路整合成可交接的加速腔工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Built around a 500 MHz-class normal-conducting copper cavity, the course goes from the TM010 mode and transit-time factor to copper wall loss, shunt impedance and cooling, then integrates the input-coupler β, network-analyser and bead-pull measurements, thermal-detuning tuning, beam-loading compensation and the klystron plus LLRF loop into a transferable cavity engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise for a 500 MHz normal-conducting storage-ring cavity: the TM010 radius is R = 2.405c/(2πf) = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×5×10⁸) ≈ 0.2295 m. Assuming R/Q = 145 Ω and Q0 = 3.5×10⁴, R_sh = 5.08 MΩ, and a cavity voltage V = 0.55 MV costs P_c = V²/R_sh ≈ 59.6 kW. A beam of I0 = 0.3 A losing 0.20 MV per cavity takes P_b = 60 kW, so β_opt = 1 + 60/59.6 ≈ 2.01, Q_L = 3.5×10⁴/3.01 ≈ 11 600 and the half bandwidth is about 21.5 kHz. With cosφs = 0.20/0.55 = 0.364 and sinφs = 0.932, tanψ = 0.3×5.08×10⁶×0.932/(3.01×0.55×10⁶) ≈ 0.86 and the detuning is Δf ≈ 0.86×5×10⁸/(2×11 600) ≈ 18.4 kHz; the generator must supply P_g ≈ 119.6 kW, about 150 kW with 25% control and waveguide margin. Without beam Γ = 1.01/3.01 ≈ 0.33, so about 11% of the power is reflected. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率」與「渡越時間因子與能量增益」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency" and "Transit-time factor and energy gain": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻腔是把微波能量儲存在金屬空腔中的共振器，加速用的是 TM010 模態：電場沿束流軸向、在中心最大並沿半徑以貝索函數 J0 遞減，磁場沿方位角繞行並在側壁感應出表面電流。因為電場週期性反向，只有在電場指向前進方向的那半個週期穿過腔體的束團才會被加速，所以束團間距必須是射頻週期的整數倍。理想柱形腔的 TM010 頻率只由半徑決定，與長度無關；實際腔體加上鼻錐與束管後，頻率與場分布要用數值模擬修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An RF cavity is a resonator that stores microwave energy in a metal enclosure, and acceleration uses the TM010 mode: the electric field points along the beam axis, peaks at the centre and falls radially as the Bessel function J0, while the magnetic field circles azimuthally and drives surface currents in the side wall. Because the field reverses every half period, only bunches crossing the gap while the field points forward are accelerated, so bunch spacing must be an integer number of RF periods. In an ideal pillbox the TM010 frequency depends only on radius, not length; nose cones and beam pipes in a real cell shift frequency and field shape and must be corrected by numerical simulation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。R = 0.2255 m 時 f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz；改為 S 頻段 2998 MHz 只需 R ≈ 38.3 mm，因此頻率越高腔體越小、加工公差也越緊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0. With R = 0.2255 m, f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz; an S-band 2998 MHz cell needs only R ≈ 38.3 mm, so higher frequency means smaller cavities and tighter machining tolerances. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 2D 或 3D 電磁場本徵模求解器建模實際腔形，先對柱形腔解析解驗證網格收斂（誤差小於 0.1%），再與冷測時網路分析儀量到的 S21 共振峰比較；並以小天線沿軸掃描確認沒有把鄰近的 TM011 或 TE111 模態誤認為加速模。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model the real cell shape with a 2D or 3D electromagnetic eigenmode solver, first checking mesh convergence against the analytic pillbox result to better than 0.1%, then compare with the S21 resonance measured on a network analyser during cold test; scan a small antenna along the axis to confirm that a neighbouring TM011 or TE111 mode has not been mistaken for the accelerating mode.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。R = 0.2255 m 時 f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz；改為 S 頻段 2998 MHz 只需 R ≈ 38.3 mm，因此頻率越高腔體越小、加工公差也越緊。
knowledge.textEn: The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0. With R = 0.2255 m, f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz; an S-band 2998 MHz cell needs only R ≈ 38.3 mm, so higher frequency means smaller cavities and tighter machining tolerances.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency", which statement holds?
options: 耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。
腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。
optionsEn: The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match.
Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.
The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0.
quiz.explanation: 柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 2D 或 3D 電磁場本徵模求解器建模實際腔形，先對柱形腔解析解驗證網格收斂（誤差小於 0.1%），再與冷測時網路分析儀量到的 S21 共振峰比較；並以小天線沿軸掃描確認沒有把鄰近的 TM011 或 TE111 模態誤認為加速模。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model the real cell shape with a 2D or 3D electromagnetic eigenmode solver, first checking mesh convergence against the analytic pillbox result to better than 0.1%, then compare with the S21 resonance measured on a network analyser during cold test; scan a small antenna along the axis to confirm that a neighbouring TM011 or TE111 mode has not been mistaken for the accelerating mode. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 以 2D 或 3D 電磁場本徵模求解器建模實際腔形，先對柱形腔解析解驗證網格收斂（誤差小於 0.1%），再與冷測時網路分析儀量到的 S21 共振峰比較；並以小天線沿軸掃描確認沒有把鄰近的 TM011 或 TE111 模態誤認為加速模。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency"?

steps.title: 柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.observation: 連結機制：理想柱形腔的 TM010 頻率只由半徑決定，與長度無關；實際腔體加上鼻錐與束管後，頻率與場分布要用數值模擬修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In an ideal pillbox the TM010 frequency depends only on radius, not length; nose cones and beam pipes in a real cell shift frequency and field shape and must be corrected by numerical simulation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。
knowledge.textEn: Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。
間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping.
A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field.
quiz.explanation: 若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 渡越時間因子與能量增益：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Transit-time factor and energy gain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「加速間隙與同步相位」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。間隙越長，粒子看到的場相位跨度越大，T 越小；但間隙太短又會提高表面電場並降低分路阻抗，鼻錐形狀就是在兩者間取捨。粒子相對射頻波峰的到達相位 φ 決定能量增益與縱向聚焦：直線加速器常在波峰附近運轉，儲存環則刻意偏離波峰以取得相位穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「加速間隙與同步相位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T. A longer gap spans more RF phase and lowers T, while a very short gap raises the surface field and reduces shunt impedance, and nose-cone shaping is the compromise between the two. The arrival phase φ relative to the RF crest sets both energy gain and longitudinal focusing: linacs often run near crest, whereas storage rings deliberately run off crest to obtain phase stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「加速間隙與同步相位」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 渡越時間因子與能量增益
knowledge.text: 粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。間隙越長，粒子看到的場相位跨度越大，T 越小；但間隙太短又會提高表面電場並降低分路阻抗，鼻錐形狀就是在兩者間取捨。
knowledge.textEn: A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T. A longer gap spans more RF phase and lowers T, while a very short gap raises the surface field and reduces shunt impedance, and nose-cone shaping is the compromise between the two.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「渡越時間因子與能量增益」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transit-time factor and energy gain" is correct?
options: 間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。
R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。
optionsEn: A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field.
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.
A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T.
quiz.explanation: 粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 渡越時間因子與能量增益：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transit-time factor and energy gain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「加速間隙與同步相位」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。f = 508.9 MHz 時 λ = 0.589 m；β = 1、間隙 g = 0.20 m 得 x = 1.067、T ≈ 0.82；若 g = λ/2 = 0.295 m 則 T = 2/π ≈ 0.64，能量增益少了約 22%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ). At f = 508.9 MHz, λ = 0.589 m; for β = 1 and a gap g = 0.20 m, x = 1.067 and T ≈ 0.82, while g = λ/2 = 0.295 m gives T = 2/π ≈ 0.64, about 22% less energy gain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模擬取得軸向電場 Ez(z)，用數值積分 ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz 計算有效電壓，並與 ∫|Ez|dz 比值得到 T；有束流後以能譜儀或束流位置在色散段的偏移量測能量增益對相位的掃描曲線，峰值應落在預期的 V0·T。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take the on-axis field Ez(z) from simulation and evaluate the effective voltage ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz numerically, dividing by ∫|Ez|dz to obtain T; with beam, scan energy gain against phase using a spectrometer or the beam position in a dispersive section, and check that the peak equals the expected V0·T.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。f = 508.9 MHz 時 λ = 0.589 m；β = 1、間隙 g = 0.20 m 得 x = 1.067、T ≈ 0.82；若 g = λ/2 = 0.295 m 則 T = 2/π ≈ 0.64，能量增益少了約 22%。
knowledge.textEn: Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ). At f = 508.9 MHz, λ = 0.589 m; for β = 1 and a gap g = 0.20 m, x = 1.067 and T ≈ 0.82, while g = λ/2 = 0.295 m gives T = 2/π ≈ 0.64, about 22% less energy gain.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「渡越時間因子與能量增益」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transit-time factor and energy gain", which statement holds?
options: 能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。
網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。
束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。
optionsEn: Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ).
The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0.
The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition.
quiz.explanation: 能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 渡越時間因子與能量增益：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transit-time factor and energy gain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「加速間隙與同步相位」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以模擬取得軸向電場 Ez(z)，用數值積分 ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz 計算有效電壓，並與 ∫|Ez|dz 比值得到 T；有束流後以能譜儀或束流位置在色散段的偏移量測能量增益對相位的掃描曲線，峰值應落在預期的 V0·T。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take the on-axis field Ez(z) from simulation and evaluate the effective voltage ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz numerically, dividing by ∫|Ez|dz to obtain T; with beam, scan energy gain against phase using a spectrometer or the beam position in a dispersive section, and check that the peak equals the expected V0·T. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把間隙電壓直接當成束流獲得的電壓，會高估能量增益約 20% 到 40%，造成下游磁鐵設定錯誤、軌道偏離，並讓儲存環的相位穩定區（射頻桶）比設計小。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating gap voltage as beam voltage overestimates energy gain by roughly 20% to 40%, which mis-sets downstream magnets, displaces the orbit and leaves a storage ring with a smaller RF bucket than designed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模擬取得軸向電場 Ez(z)，用數值積分 ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz 計算有效電壓，並與 ∫|Ez|dz 比值得到 T；有束流後以能譜儀或束流位置在色散段的偏移量測能量增益對相位的掃描曲線，峰值應落在預期的 V0·T。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「渡越時間因子與能量增益」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transit-time factor and energy gain"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
把間隙電壓直接當成束流獲得的電壓，會高估能量增益約 20% 到 40%，造成下游磁鐵設定錯誤、軌道偏離，並讓儲存環的相位穩定區（射頻桶）比設計小。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.

Treating gap voltage as beam voltage overestimates energy gain by roughly 20% to 40%, which mis-sets downstream magnets, displaces the orbit and leaves a storage ring with a smaller RF bucket than designed.
quiz.explanation: 把間隙電壓直接當成束流獲得的電壓，會高估能量增益約 20% 到 40%，造成下游磁鐵設定錯誤、軌道偏離，並讓儲存環的相位穩定區（射頻桶）比設計小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gap voltage as beam voltage overestimates energy gain by roughly 20% to 40%, which mis-sets downstream magnets, displaces the orbit and leaves a storage ring with a smaller RF bucket than designed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗」與「輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance" and "Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。R/Q 只由腔形決定，代表單位儲能能產生多少加速電壓；分路阻抗 R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 則把腔形與材料損耗合在一起，決定維持某個電壓需要灌入多少瓦的銅損。這些熱量必須由嵌在腔壁的冷卻水道帶走，所以常溫腔設計同時是射頻問題也是熱工問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0. R/Q depends only on geometry and expresses how much accelerating voltage a given stored energy produces, while the shunt impedance R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 combines geometry with material loss and sets how many watts of copper loss are needed to hold a voltage. That heat must be carried away by water channels in the wall, so a normal-conducting cavity is a thermal design as much as an RF design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ；取幾何因子 G ≈ 200 Ω，Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ); for copper with σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m at 508.9 MHz the skin depth is about 2.9 µm and Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ, and with a geometry factor G ≈ 200 Ω, Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗
knowledge.titleEn: Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance
knowledge.text: 射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。R/Q 只由腔形決定，代表單位儲能能產生多少加速電壓；分路阻抗 R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 則把腔形與材料損耗合在一起，決定維持某個電壓需要灌入多少瓦的銅損。
knowledge.textEn: RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0. R/Q depends only on geometry and expresses how much accelerating voltage a given stored energy produces, while the shunt impedance R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 combines geometry with material loss and sets how many watts of copper loss are needed to hold a voltage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance" is correct?
options: 射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。
R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。
optionsEn: RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0.
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.
The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match.
quiz.explanation: 射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ；取幾何因子 G ≈ 200 Ω，Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴。若 R/Q = 150 Ω、Q0 = 3.3×10⁴，R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ，V = 0.6 MV 時 P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW；冷卻水溫升 5 K 需流量 ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s，約 210 L/min。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ); for copper with σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m at 508.9 MHz the skin depth is about 2.9 µm and Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ, and with a geometry factor G ≈ 200 Ω, Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴. With R/Q = 150 Ω and Q0 = 3.3×10⁴, R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ and holding V = 0.6 MV costs P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW; a 5 K water temperature rise needs ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s, about 210 L/min. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化；高功率測試時以進出水溫差乘以流量做量熱，與 V²/R_sh 預測的銅損比對，兩者差異超過 5% 就要追查電壓刻度或熱損路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation; at high power perform calorimetry from the water temperature rise times flow and compare with the V²/R_sh loss, chasing the voltage calibration or heat paths if they differ by more than 5%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ；取幾何因子 G ≈ 200 Ω，Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴。若 R/Q = 150 Ω、Q0 = 3.3×10⁴，R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ，V = 0.6 MV 時 P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW；冷卻水溫升 5 K 需流量 ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s，約 210 L/min。
knowledge.textEn: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ); for copper with σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m at 508.9 MHz the skin depth is about 2.9 µm and Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ, and with a geometry factor G ≈ 200 Ω, Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴. With R/Q = 150 Ω and Q0 = 3.3×10⁴, R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ and holding V = 0.6 MV costs P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW; a 5 K water temperature rise needs ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s, about 210 L/min.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance", which statement holds?
options: 腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ。
只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。
optionsEn: Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.
If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself.
quiz.explanation: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ；取幾何因子 G ≈ 200 Ω，Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ); for copper with σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m at 508.9 MHz the skin depth is about 2.9 µm and Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ, and with a geometry factor G ≈ 200 Ω, Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化；高功率測試時以進出水溫差乘以流量做量熱，與 V²/R_sh 預測的銅損比對，兩者差異超過 5% 就要追查電壓刻度或熱損路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation; at high power perform calorimetry from the water temperature rise times flow and compare with the V²/R_sh loss, chasing the voltage calibration or heat paths if they differ by more than 5%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻水道局部堵塞或流量分配不均，會在磁場最強的側壁形成熱點，局部膨脹使頻率漂移並造成表面疲勞裂紋，長期運轉後可能出現真空洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A partially blocked channel or poorly balanced flow creates a hot spot on the high-magnetic-field side wall, where local expansion drifts the frequency and cyclic stress cracks the surface, eventually leading to a vacuum leak after long operation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化；高功率測試時以進出水溫差乘以流量做量熱，與 V²/R_sh 預測的銅損比對，兩者差異超過 5% 就要追查電壓刻度或熱損路徑。
knowledge.textEn: During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation; at high power perform calorimetry from the water temperature rise times flow and compare with the V²/R_sh loss, chasing the voltage calibration or heat paths if they differ by more than 5%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。
冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency.
During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation.
quiz.explanation: 冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化；高功率測試時以進出水溫差乘以流量做量熱，與 V²/R_sh 預測的銅損比對，兩者差異超過 5% 就要追查電壓刻度或熱損路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation; at high power perform calorimetry from the water temperature rise times flow and compare with the V²/R_sh loss, chasing the voltage calibration or heat paths if they differ by more than 5%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷卻水道局部堵塞或流量分配不均，會在磁場最強的側壁形成熱點，局部膨脹使頻率漂移並造成表面疲勞裂紋，長期運轉後可能出現真空洩漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A partially blocked channel or poorly balanced flow creates a hot spot on the high-magnetic-field side wall, where local expansion drifts the frequency and cyclic stress cracks the surface, eventually leading to a vacuum leak after long operation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些熱量必須由嵌在腔壁的冷卻水道帶走，所以常溫腔設計同時是射頻問題也是熱工問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That heat must be carried away by water channels in the wall, so a normal-conducting cavity is a thermal design as much as an RF design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷卻水道局部堵塞或流量分配不均，會在磁場最強的側壁形成熱點，局部膨脹使頻率漂移並造成表面疲勞裂紋，長期運轉後可能出現真空洩漏。
knowledge.textEn: A partially blocked channel or poorly balanced flow creates a hot spot on the high-magnetic-field side wall, where local expansion drifts the frequency and cyclic stress cracks the surface, eventually leading to a vacuum leak after long operation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 冷卻水道局部堵塞或流量分配不均，會在磁場最強的側壁形成熱點，局部膨脹使頻率漂移並造成表面疲勞裂紋，長期運轉後可能出現真空洩漏。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: A partially blocked channel or poorly balanced flow creates a hot spot on the high-magnetic-field side wall, where local expansion drifts the frequency and cyclic stress cracks the surface, eventually leading to a vacuum leak after long operation.

The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match.

steps.title: 輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Input coupler and ceramic window” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 功率由波導或同軸線經耦合環或耦合孔送入腔體，耦合強度以 β = Q0/Q_ext 表示：β = 1 時無束流的腔體對源完全匹配，β > 1 為過耦合。真空與大氣之間由氧化鋁陶瓷窗隔開，窗面常鍍數奈米氮化鈦以降低二次電子發射係數。耦合器與窗是多重電子倍增最容易發生的地方：電子在 RF 場中來回撞擊表面，若二次電子產額大於 1 且飛行時間與射頻週期同步，電流就會雪崩式增加並加熱或擊穿窗片，因此新腔需要逐步升功率的老練。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power enters through a waveguide or coaxial line via a coupling loop or iris, and the coupling strength is β = Q0/Q_ext: at β = 1 an unloaded cavity is perfectly matched to the source, and β > 1 is over-coupled. An alumina ceramic window separates vacuum from air, often coated with a few nanometres of titanium nitride to lower secondary-electron yield. Couplers and windows are where multipacting is most likely: electrons strike surfaces repeatedly in the RF field, and when the secondary yield exceeds one and the flight time is synchronous with the RF period, current avalanches and can heat or puncture the window, which is why a new cavity is conditioned by raising power in steps. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input coupler and ceramic window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Input coupler and ceramic window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Power enters through a waveguide or coaxial line via a coupling loop or iris, and the coupling strength is β = Q0/Q_ext: at β = 1 an unloaded cavity is perfectly matched to the source, and β > 1 is over-coupled. An alumina ceramic window separates vacuum from air, often coated with a few nanometres of titanium nitride to lower secondary-electron yield.

quiz.question: 關於「輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting" is correct?

功率由波導或同軸線經耦合環或耦合孔送入腔體，耦合強度以 β = Q0/Q_ext 表示：β = 1 時無束流的腔體對源完全匹配，β > 1 為過耦合。

quiz.explanationEn: Power enters through a waveguide or coaxial line via a coupling loop or iris, and the coupling strength is β = Q0/Q_ext: at β = 1 an unloaded cavity is perfectly matched to the source, and β > 1 is over-coupled. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Input coupler and ceramic window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。若為了滿載束流把 β 設在 2.39，空載時 Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41，約 16.8% 的入射功率被反射；以銅損 72 kW 計，反射功率約 14.5 kW，必須由環形器與假負載吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1). If β is set to 2.39 for full beam current, the empty cavity gives Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41 and reflects about 16.8% of the incident power; with 72 kW of wall loss the reflected power is about 14.5 kW, which a circulator and dummy load must absorb. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以網路分析儀在共振頻率量 S11 的大小與相位，於 Smith 圖上判斷過耦合或欠耦合並算出 β；老練時同時記錄真空壓力、窗溫紅外影像、電子拾取探針與反射功率，確認在每個功率階段沒有持續的多重電子倍增訊號才往上加功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance with a network analyser and read over- or under-coupling from the Smith chart to compute β; during conditioning log vacuum pressure, infrared window temperature, electron-pickup probes and reflected power together, and raise power only when no persistent multipacting signature remains at each level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。若為了滿載束流把 β 設在 2.39，空載時 Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41，約 16.8% 的入射功率被反射；以銅損 72 kW 計，反射功率約 14.5 kW，必須由環形器與假負載吸收。
knowledge.textEn: Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1). If β is set to 2.39 for full beam current, the empty cavity gives Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41 and reflects about 16.8% of the incident power; with 72 kW of wall loss the reflected power is about 14.5 kW, which a circulator and dummy load must absorb.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting", which statement holds?
options: 束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。
把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。
無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。
optionsEn: The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition.
Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency.
Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1).
quiz.explanation: 無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Input coupler and ceramic window” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以網路分析儀在共振頻率量 S11 的大小與相位，於 Smith 圖上判斷過耦合或欠耦合並算出 β；老練時同時記錄真空壓力、窗溫紅外影像、電子拾取探針與反射功率，確認在每個功率階段沒有持續的多重電子倍增訊號才往上加功率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance with a network analyser and read over- or under-coupling from the Smith chart to compute β; during conditioning log vacuum pressure, infrared window temperature, electron-pickup probes and reflected power together, and raise power only when no persistent multipacting signature remains at each level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：窗片鍍層不足或老練過快時，多重電子倍增使窗片局部過熱產生熱應力裂紋，真空瞬間破壞並污染整個腔體與相鄰束管，需要長時間停機更換與重新烘烤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With an inadequate window coating or overly fast conditioning, multipacting overheats the window locally until thermal stress cracks it, breaking vacuum and contaminating the cavity and adjacent beam pipe, forcing a long shutdown for replacement and rebake.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以網路分析儀在共振頻率量 S11 的大小與相位，於 Smith 圖上判斷過耦合或欠耦合並算出 β；老練時同時記錄真空壓力、窗溫紅外影像、電子拾取探針與反射功率，確認在每個功率階段沒有持續的多重電子倍增訊號才往上加功率。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance with a network analyser and read over- or under-coupling from the Smith chart to compute β; during conditioning log vacuum pressure, infrared window temperature, electron-pickup probes and reflected power together, and raise power only when no persistent multipacting signature remains at each level.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting"?

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance with a network analyser and read over- or under-coupling from the Smith chart to compute β; during conditioning log vacuum pressure, infrared window temperature, electron-pickup probes and reflected power together, and raise power only when no persistent multipacting signature remains at each level. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
