stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping" and "Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「網路分析儀與珠拉台」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Network analyser and bead-pull bench” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。場分布以珠拉法量測：把小金屬或介電珠沿軸拉過腔體，依 Slater 微擾理論，珠子所在處的電場平方正比於共振頻率位移，由此重建 Ez(z) 並計算 R/Q 與多腔結構的場平坦度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「網路分析儀與珠拉台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext. The field profile is mapped by the bead-pull method: a small metal or dielectric bead is drawn along the axis and, by Slater perturbation theory, the square of the electric field at the bead is proportional to the resonant-frequency shift, from which Ez(z), R/Q and the field flatness of multi-cell structures are reconstructed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Network analyser and bead-pull bench”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「網路分析儀與珠拉台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Network analyser and bead-pull bench”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測
knowledge.titleEn: Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping
knowledge.text: 冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。場分布以珠拉法量測：把小金屬或介電珠沿軸拉過腔體，依 Slater 微擾理論，珠子所在處的電場平方正比於共振頻率位移，由此重建 Ez(z) 並計算 R/Q 與多腔結構的場平坦度。
knowledge.textEn: Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext. The field profile is mapped by the bead-pull method: a small metal or dielectric bead is drawn along the axis and, by Slater perturbation theory, the square of the electric field at the bead is proportional to the resonant-frequency shift, from which Ez(z), R/Q and the field flatness of multi-cell structures are reconstructed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping" is correct?
options: 網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。
腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。
optionsEn: The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0.
Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.

Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext.
quiz.explanation: 冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「網路分析儀與珠拉台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Network analyser and bead-pull bench” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。量得 f0 = 500.00 MHz、Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz，得 Q_L ≈ 16 500；共振時 |S11| = 0.2 且由相位判定為過耦合，β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5，因此 Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300，外部品質因數 Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500。若誤判為欠耦合，β = 0.67、Q0 ≈ 27 500，差了三分之一。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB. Measuring f0 = 500.00 MHz and Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz gives Q_L ≈ 16 500; with |S11| = 0.2 at resonance identified from its phase as over-coupled, β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5, so Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300 and the external quality factor is Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500. Misreading it as under-coupled gives β = 0.67 and Q0 ≈ 27 500, one third lower. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭；珠拉時以已知尺寸的金屬珠在柱形校正腔中量出形狀因子，再量待測腔，並重複拉珠三次確認頻率位移的重現性與室溫漂移扣除後的殘差小於 1%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange; for bead pulls, determine the bead form factor with a known metal bead in a pillbox reference cavity before measuring the cavity under test, repeat each pull three times and confirm that the frequency-shift residual after subtracting room-temperature drift is below 1%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。量得 f0 = 500.00 MHz、Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz，得 Q_L ≈ 16 500；共振時 |S11| = 0.2 且由相位判定為過耦合，β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5，因此 Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300，外部品質因數 Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500。若誤判為欠耦合，β = 0.67、Q0 ≈ 27 500，差了三分之一。
knowledge.textEn: The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB. Measuring f0 = 500.00 MHz and Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz gives Q_L ≈ 16 500; with |S11| = 0.2 at resonance identified from its phase as over-coupled, β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5, so Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300 and the external quality factor is Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500. Misreading it as under-coupled gives β = 0.67 and Q0 ≈ 27 500, one third lower.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping", which statement holds?
options: 有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。
只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。
間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。
optionsEn: The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB.
If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself.
A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field.
quiz.explanation: 有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「網路分析儀與珠拉台」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Network analyser and bead-pull bench” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭；珠拉時以已知尺寸的金屬珠在柱形校正腔中量出形狀因子，再量待測腔，並重複拉珠三次確認頻率位移的重現性與室溫漂移扣除後的殘差小於 1%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange; for bead pulls, determine the bead form factor with a known metal bead in a pillbox reference cavity before measuring the cavity under test, repeat each pull three times and confirm that the frequency-shift residual after subtracting room-temperature drift is below 1%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭；珠拉時以已知尺寸的金屬珠在柱形校正腔中量出形狀因子，再量待測腔，並重複拉珠三次確認頻率位移的重現性與室溫漂移扣除後的殘差小於 1%。
knowledge.textEn: Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange; for bead pulls, determine the bead form factor with a known metal bead in a pillbox reference cavity before measuring the cavity under test, repeat each pull three times and confirm that the frequency-shift residual after subtracting room-temperature drift is below 1%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭。
R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange.
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.
quiz.explanation: 先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭；珠拉時以已知尺寸的金屬珠在柱形校正腔中量出形狀因子，再量待測腔，並重複拉珠三次確認頻率位移的重現性與室溫漂移扣除後的殘差小於 1%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange; for bead pulls, determine the bead form factor with a known metal bead in a pillbox reference cavity before measuring the cavity under test, repeat each pull three times and confirm that the frequency-shift residual after subtracting room-temperature drift is below 1%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「網路分析儀與珠拉台」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Network analyser and bead-pull bench” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：場分布以珠拉法量測：把小金屬或介電珠沿軸拉過腔體，依 Slater 微擾理論，珠子所在處的電場平方正比於共振頻率位移，由此重建 Ez(z) 並計算 R/Q 與多腔結構的場平坦度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The field profile is mapped by the bead-pull method: a small metal or dielectric bead is drawn along the axis and, by Slater perturbation theory, the square of the electric field at the bead is proportional to the resonant-frequency shift, from which Ez(z), R/Q and the field flatness of multi-cell structures are reconstructed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。
knowledge.textEn: Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.
Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning.
quiz.explanation: 未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plunger tuner and frequency budget” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。運轉中的頻率必須維持在有載頻寬的一小部分內，否則振幅與相位會隨失諧而改變。實務上用柱塞或壁面變形式調諧器補償，調諧範圍必須涵蓋製造殘差、熱漂移與束流負載所需的刻意失諧，並保留餘量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away. In operation the frequency must stay within a small fraction of the loaded bandwidth, or amplitude and phase change with detuning. In practice a plunger or wall-deformation tuner compensates, and its range must cover fabrication residuals, thermal drift and the deliberate detuning required for beam loading, with margin. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plunger tuner and frequency budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Plunger tuner and frequency budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算
knowledge.titleEn: Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget
knowledge.text: 腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。運轉中的頻率必須維持在有載頻寬的一小部分內，否則振幅與相位會隨失諧而改變。
knowledge.textEn: Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away. In operation the frequency must stay within a small fraction of the loaded bandwidth, or amplitude and phase change with detuning.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget" is correct?
options: 腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。
腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。
optionsEn: Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away.
Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.
The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition.
quiz.explanation: 腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plunger tuner and frequency budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。銅 α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K，熱失諧 −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K；Q_L ≈ 9740 時半頻寬 f/(2Q_L) ≈ 26 kHz，冷卻水溫變化 0.5 K 造成 4.2 kHz 失諧，tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16，相位偏移約 9°。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz. Copper has α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K, so thermal detuning is −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K; with Q_L ≈ 9740 the half bandwidth f/(2Q_L) is about 26 kHz, and a 0.5 K water change detunes 4.2 kHz, giving tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16, a phase shift of about 9°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯；高功率時以入射與腔體探針的相位差作為失諧誤差訊號，觀察冷卻水溫階躍時調諧器是否在數秒內把相位拉回，並確認調諧器在最大熱負載與最大束流時仍留有至少 20% 行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis; at high power use the phase between forward and cavity-probe signals as the detuning error, watch the tuner restore phase within seconds after a water-temperature step, and confirm at least 20% of travel remains at maximum heat load and beam current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。銅 α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K，熱失諧 −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K；Q_L ≈ 9740 時半頻寬 f/(2Q_L) ≈ 26 kHz，冷卻水溫變化 0.5 K 造成 4.2 kHz 失諧，tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16，相位偏移約 9°。
knowledge.textEn: For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz. Copper has α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K, so thermal detuning is −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K; with Q_L ≈ 9740 the half bandwidth f/(2Q_L) is about 26 kHz, and a 0.5 K water change detunes 4.2 kHz, giving tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16, a phase shift of about 9°.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget", which statement holds?
options: 把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。
均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。
R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
optionsEn: Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency.
For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz.
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.
quiz.explanation: 均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Plunger tuner and frequency budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯；高功率時以入射與腔體探針的相位差作為失諧誤差訊號，觀察冷卻水溫階躍時調諧器是否在數秒內把相位拉回，並確認調諧器在最大熱負載與最大束流時仍留有至少 20% 行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis; at high power use the phase between forward and cavity-probe signals as the detuning error, watch the tuner restore phase within seconds after a water-temperature step, and confirm at least 20% of travel remains at maximum heat load and beam current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯；高功率時以入射與腔體探針的相位差作為失諧誤差訊號，觀察冷卻水溫階躍時調諧器是否在數秒內把相位拉回，並確認調諧器在最大熱負載與最大束流時仍留有至少 20% 行程。
knowledge.textEn: On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis; at high power use the phase between forward and cavity-probe signals as the detuning error, watch the tuner restore phase within seconds after a water-temperature step, and confirm at least 20% of travel remains at maximum heat load and beam current.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。
在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match.
On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis.
quiz.explanation: 在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯；高功率時以入射與腔體探針的相位差作為失諧誤差訊號，觀察冷卻水溫階躍時調諧器是否在數秒內把相位拉回，並確認調諧器在最大熱負載與最大束流時仍留有至少 20% 行程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis; at high power use the phase between forward and cavity-probe signals as the detuning error, watch the tuner restore phase within seconds after a water-temperature step, and confirm at least 20% of travel remains at maximum heat load and beam current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Plunger tuner and frequency budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實務上用柱塞或壁面變形式調諧器補償，調諧範圍必須涵蓋製造殘差、熱漂移與束流負載所需的刻意失諧，並保留餘量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In practice a plunger or wall-deformation tuner compensates, and its range must cover fabrication residuals, thermal drift and the deliberate detuning required for beam loading, with margin.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。
knowledge.textEn: If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。
optionsEn: If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition.
quiz.explanation: 若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束流負載補償與最佳耦合」與「功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling" and "Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束流負載補償與最佳耦合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流電流與腔體失諧」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam current and cavity detuning” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高電流束流穿過腔體時會感應出自身的場，等效上是一個與腔電壓不同相的電流源，稱為束流負載。為了讓發電機只看到純電阻負載、沒有反射，需同時把耦合係數提高到 β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c，並把腔體刻意失諧以抵消束流電流的虛部。電流越大失諧越大，當失諧接近儲存環迴轉頻率時，加速模的阻抗會落在相鄰迴轉諧波上，引發縱向耦合束團不穩定；KEKB 的 ARES 腔以額外的大儲能腔降低有效 R/Q 來解決此問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流電流與腔體失諧」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A high-current beam passing through the cavity induces its own field, equivalent to a current source out of phase with the cavity voltage, which is called beam loading. To present the generator with a purely resistive load and no reflection, the coupling is raised to β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c and the cavity is deliberately detuned to cancel the reactive part of the beam current. The detuning grows with current, and when it approaches the ring revolution frequency the accelerating-mode impedance lands on neighbouring revolution harmonics and drives longitudinal coupled-bunch instability; the ARES cavity at KEKB attached a large storage cavity to lower the effective R/Q and solve this. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam current and cavity detuning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設 V = 0.6 MV、R_sh = 5.0 MΩ、P_c = 72 kW，束流 I0 = 0.4 A、每腔能損 0.25 MV，P_b = 100 kW，β_opt = 2.39，Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740；cosφs = 0.25/0.6，sinφs ≈ 0.909，tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894，失諧 Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz（低於共振方向），發電機功率 P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take V = 0.6 MV, R_sh = 5.0 MΩ and P_c = 72 kW, with I0 = 0.4 A and 0.25 MV energy loss per cavity, so P_b = 100 kW, β_opt = 2.39 and Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740; cosφs = 0.25/0.6 and sinφs ≈ 0.909 give tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894 and a detuning Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz below resonance, with generator power P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流電流與腔體失諧」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam current and cavity detuning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

To present the generator with a purely resistive load and no reflection, the coupling is raised to β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c and the cavity is deliberately detuned to cancel the reactive part of the beam current.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「束流負載補償與最佳耦合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling" is correct?
options: 束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。
高電流束流穿過腔體時會感應出自身的場，等效上是一個與腔電壓不同相的電流源，稱為束流負載。
只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。

If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself.

quiz.explanationEn: A high-current beam passing through the cavity induces its own field, equivalent to a current source out of phase with the cavity voltage, which is called beam loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流負載補償與最佳耦合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流電流與腔體失諧」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam current and cavity detuning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設 V = 0.6 MV、R_sh = 5.0 MΩ、P_c = 72 kW，束流 I0 = 0.4 A、每腔能損 0.25 MV，P_b = 100 kW，β_opt = 2.39，Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740；cosφs = 0.25/0.6，sinφs ≈ 0.909，tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894，失諧 Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz（低於共振方向），發電機功率 P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take V = 0.6 MV, R_sh = 5.0 MΩ and P_c = 72 kW, with I0 = 0.4 A and 0.25 MV energy loss per cavity, so P_b = 100 kW, β_opt = 2.39 and Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740; cosφs = 0.25/0.6 and sinφs ≈ 0.909 give tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894 and a detuning Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz below resonance, with generator power P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較；以束流頻譜或縱向束團位置監測器觀察同步振盪邊帶，確認沒有在迴轉諧波上出現成長中的耦合束團模態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve; watch synchrotron sidebands on the beam spectrum or a longitudinal bunch-position monitor to confirm that no growing coupled-bunch mode appears at the revolution harmonics.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Take V = 0.6 MV, R_sh = 5.0 MΩ and P_c = 72 kW, with I0 = 0.4 A and 0.25 MV energy loss per cavity, so P_b = 100 kW, β_opt = 2.39 and Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740; cosφs = 0.25/0.6 and sinφs ≈ 0.909 give tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894 and a detuning Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz below resonance, with generator power P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 束流負載補償與最佳耦合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流電流與腔體失諧」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam current and cavity detuning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較；以束流頻譜或縱向束團位置監測器觀察同步振盪邊帶，確認沒有在迴轉諧波上出現成長中的耦合束團模態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve; watch synchrotron sidebands on the beam spectrum or a longitudinal bunch-position monitor to confirm that no growing coupled-bunch mode appears at the revolution harmonics. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失；β 固定在低電流值時，滿載下反射功率大增，環形器負載過熱跳機。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds; with β fixed at a low-current value, reflected power at full current overheats the circulator load and trips the system.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較；以束流頻譜或縱向束團位置監測器觀察同步振盪邊帶，確認沒有在迴轉諧波上出現成長中的耦合束團模態。
knowledge.textEn: Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve; watch synchrotron sidebands on the beam spectrum or a longitudinal bunch-position monitor to confirm that no growing coupled-bunch mode appears at the revolution harmonics.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流負載補償與最佳耦合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling"?
options: 逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0.
quiz.explanation: 逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較；以束流頻譜或縱向束團位置監測器觀察同步振盪邊帶，確認沒有在迴轉諧波上出現成長中的耦合束團模態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve; watch synchrotron sidebands on the beam spectrum or a longitudinal bunch-position monitor to confirm that no growing coupled-bunch mode appears at the revolution harmonics. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流負載補償與最佳耦合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流電流與腔體失諧」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam current and cavity detuning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失；β 固定在低電流值時，滿載下反射功率大增，環形器負載過熱跳機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds; with β fixed at a low-current value, reflected power at full current overheats the circulator load and trips the system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：電流越大失諧越大，當失諧接近儲存環迴轉頻率時，加速模的阻抗會落在相鄰迴轉諧波上，引發縱向耦合束團不穩定；KEKB 的 ARES 腔以額外的大儲能腔降低有效 R/Q 來解決此問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The detuning grows with current, and when it approaches the ring revolution frequency the accelerating-mode impedance lands on neighbouring revolution harmonics and drives longitudinal coupled-bunch instability; the ARES cavity at KEKB attached a large storage cavity to lower the effective R/Q and solve this.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失；β 固定在低電流值時，滿載下反射功率大增，環形器負載過熱跳機。
knowledge.textEn: With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds; with β fixed at a low-current value, reflected power at full current overheats the circulator load and trips the system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流負載補償與最佳耦合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失。
只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds.
If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself.
quiz.explanation: 失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失；β 固定在低電流值時，滿載下反射功率大增，環形器負載過熱跳機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds; with β fixed at a low-current value, reflected power at full current overheats the circulator load and trips the system. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」如何決定粒子加速器射頻腔的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF” determines the key performance of “Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻功率由速調管或模組化固態放大器提供，經波導、環形器與耦合器送入腔體；速調管單管可達百萬瓦但有高壓電源與陰極壽命問題，固態放大器以數百個電晶體模組合成，單模組失效只降低少量功率。低階射頻系統以數位 IQ 解調取樣腔體探針訊號，透過比例積分回授與前饋把振幅與相位鎖在設定值，並控制調諧器。驗收要同時證明場穩定度、跳機率、聯鎖反應與老練紀錄，而不只是達到額定電壓。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RF power comes from a klystron or a modular solid-state amplifier and flows through waveguide, circulator and coupler into the cavity; a single klystron reaches megawatts but brings a high-voltage modulator and cathode lifetime issues, while a solid-state amplifier combines hundreds of transistor modules so one module failure costs only a little power. The low-level RF system samples the cavity probe with digital IQ demodulation, locks amplitude and phase to setpoints with proportional-integral feedback and feed-forward, and drives the tuner. Acceptance must demonstrate field stability, trip rate, interlock response and conditioning history together, not merely rated voltage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff" is correct?
options: 只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。

steps.title: 功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。離峰 φ = 20°、振幅抖動 0.1%、相位抖動 0.1° = 1.745 mrad 時，tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴，總和 ≈ 1.18×10⁻³。迴路增益 G = 50 可把功率源 1% 漣波壓到約 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]. Off crest at φ = 20° with 0.1% amplitude jitter and 0.1° = 1.745 mrad phase jitter, tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴ and the total is ≈ 1.18×10⁻³. A loop gain G = 50 suppresses a 1% source ripple to about 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較；以注入步階與調變檢查迴路頻寬、相位餘裕與延遲；最後在滿電流下連續運轉數十小時統計跳機次數與原因，連同老練曲線、聯鎖測試與冷測數據一起寫入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification; check loop bandwidth, phase margin and delay with injected steps and modulation; finally run tens of hours at full current, tally trips by cause, and file them with conditioning curves, interlock tests and cold-test data in the handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。離峰 φ = 20°、振幅抖動 0.1%、相位抖動 0.1° = 1.745 mrad 時，tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴，總和 ≈ 1.18×10⁻³。迴路增益 G = 50 可把功率源 1% 漣波壓到約 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%。
knowledge.textEn: The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]. Off crest at φ = 20° with 0.1% amplitude jitter and 0.1° = 1.745 mrad phase jitter, tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴ and the total is ≈ 1.18×10⁻³. A loop gain G = 50 suppresses a 1% source ripple to about 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff", which statement holds?
options: 能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。
R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。
網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。
optionsEn: The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²].
A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.
The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0.
quiz.explanation: 能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較；以注入步階與調變檢查迴路頻寬、相位餘裕與延遲；最後在滿電流下連續運轉數十小時統計跳機次數與原因，連同老練曲線、聯鎖測試與冷測數據一起寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification; check loop bandwidth, phase margin and delay with injected steps and modulation; finally run tens of hours at full current, tally trips by cause, and file them with conditioning curves, interlock tests and cold-test data in the handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流；速調管工作在飽和區時沒有控制餘量，電源漣波直接傳到加速相位，表現為光束線光源點的時序與能量抖動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam; a klystron driven into saturation leaves no control headroom, so modulator ripple passes straight into the accelerating phase and shows up as timing and energy jitter at the beamline source point.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較；以注入步階與調變檢查迴路頻寬、相位餘裕與延遲；最後在滿電流下連續運轉數十小時統計跳機次數與原因，連同老練曲線、聯鎖測試與冷測數據一起寫入交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification; check loop bandwidth, phase margin and delay with injected steps and modulation; finally run tens of hours at full current, tally trips by cause, and file them with conditioning curves, interlock tests and cold-test data in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較。
腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification.
Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較；以注入步階與調變檢查迴路頻寬、相位餘裕與延遲；最後在滿電流下連續運轉數十小時統計跳機次數與原因，連同老練曲線、聯鎖測試與冷測數據一起寫入交接文件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification; check loop bandwidth, phase margin and delay with injected steps and modulation; finally run tens of hours at full current, tally trips by cause, and file them with conditioning curves, interlock tests and cold-test data in the handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流；速調管工作在飽和區時沒有控制餘量，電源漣波直接傳到加速相位，表現為光束線光源點的時序與能量抖動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam; a klystron driven into saturation leaves no control headroom, so modulator ripple passes straight into the accelerating phase and shows up as timing and energy jitter at the beamline source point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收要同時證明場穩定度、跳機率、聯鎖反應與老練紀錄，而不只是達到額定電壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance must demonstrate field stability, trip rate, interlock response and conditioning history together, not merely rated voltage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流；速調管工作在飽和區時沒有控制餘量，電源漣波直接傳到加速相位，表現為光束線光源點的時序與能量抖動。
knowledge.textEn: Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam; a klystron driven into saturation leaves no control headroom, so modulator ripple passes straight into the accelerating phase and shows up as timing and energy jitter at the beamline source point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。
迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency.
Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam.
quiz.explanation: 迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流；速調管工作在飽和區時沒有控制餘量，電源漣波直接傳到加速相位，表現為光束線光源點的時序與能量抖動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam; a klystron driven into saturation leaves no control headroom, so modulator ripple passes straight into the accelerating phase and shows up as timing and energy jitter at the beamline source point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 超導加速腔製作
summary: 以 TESLA 型 1.3 GHz 九腔鈮製超導加速腔為對象，從 BCS 表面電阻與 Q₀ = G/Rs 出發，走過高 RRR 鈮板、深拉與電子束焊、電解拋光與烘烤、2 K 垂直測試與頻率調諧，最後整合成低溫模組並交付驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the TESLA-type 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavity, start from BCS surface resistance and Q₀ = G/Rs, then follow high-RRR niobium sheet, deep drawing and electron-beam welding, electropolishing and baking, 2 K vertical testing and frequency tuning, and end with cryomodule integration and an acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Q₀ 與製冷電力練習：1.3 GHz 九腔在 2.0 K，用 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω 得 R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ；假設 R_res = 4 nΩ，R_s = 15 nΩ，Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰。在 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m 下 V = 16.6 MV，P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W。一個 8 腔模組動態負載 118 W，加靜態 10 W 為 128 W；以每瓦 2 K 需 700 W 電力估計，製冷電力約 90 kW。若殘餘電阻因磁通捕獲升到 14 nΩ，R_s = 25 nΩ，Q₀ 降到 1.08×10¹⁰，模組電力升到約 146 kW。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Q₀ and refrigeration exercise: a 1.3 GHz nine-cell at 2.0 K has R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ from R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω; assuming R_res = 4 nΩ, R_s = 15 nΩ and Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰. At E_acc = 16 MV/m and L = 1.038 m, V = 16.6 MV and P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W. An 8-cavity module then has 118 W dynamic plus 10 W static load, 128 W; at an assumed 700 W of electricity per watt at 2 K the refrigeration draws about 90 kW. If trapped flux raises the residual resistance to 14 nΩ, R_s = 25 nΩ, Q₀ falls to 1.08×10¹⁰ and the module's electrical demand rises to about 146 kW. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」與「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" and "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。腔壁為鈮，臨界溫度 9.25 K，浸在 2 K 的超流氦中；壁面電流只在約 40 nm 的穿透深度內流動，表面電阻為奈歐姆等級，使品質因數 Q₀ 達 10¹⁰ 量級。系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The wall is niobium with a critical temperature of 9.25 K, immersed in 2 K superfluid helium; wall current flows only within the roughly 40 nm penetration depth, the surface resistance is at the nano-ohm level, and the quality factor Q₀ reaches the 10¹⁰ range. The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity
knowledge.text: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。腔壁為鈮，臨界溫度 9.25 K，浸在 2 K 的超流氦中；壁面電流只在約 40 nm 的穿透深度內流動，表面電阻為奈歐姆等級，使品質因數 Q₀ 達 10¹⁰ 量級。
knowledge.textEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The wall is niobium with a critical temperature of 9.25 K, immersed in 2 K superfluid helium; wall current flows only within the roughly 40 nm penetration depth, the surface resistance is at the nano-ohm level, and the quality factor Q₀ reaches the 10¹⁰ range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" is correct?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.
A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz.
Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
quiz.explanation: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。取 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m（V = 16.6 MV）、R/Q = 1036 Ω、Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰：P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W（連續波）。若 Q₀ 只有 1×10¹⁰，同樣梯度下耗散升到約 27 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. With Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ the same gradient dissipates about 27 W. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。取 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m（V = 16.6 MV）、R/Q = 1036 Ω、Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰：P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W（連續波）。若 Q₀ 只有 1×10¹⁰，同樣梯度下耗散升到約 27 W。
knowledge.textEn: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. With Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ the same gradient dissipates about 27 W.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity", which statement holds?
options: 焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
optionsEn: After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
quiz.explanation: 腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
knowledge.textEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity"?
options: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
knowledge.textEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。實際表面電阻 R_s = R_BCS + R_res，殘餘電阻 R_res 來自捕獲磁通、氫化物析出與表面汙染，與溫度無關。品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS. The real surface resistance is R_s = R_BCS + R_res, where the residual term comes from trapped magnetic flux, hydride precipitation and surface contamination and does not depend on temperature. The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
