steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存
knowledge.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀
knowledge.text: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。
knowledge.textEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀" is correct?
options: 只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。
optionsEn: Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter.
quiz.explanation: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。在頻率 f = 1.3 GHz：溫度 T = 2.0 K 時 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ；溫度 4.2 K 時 ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ。加上殘餘電阻 R_res = 5 nΩ，2 K 的總表面電阻 R_s ≈ 16 nΩ，品質因數 Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰；4.2 K 時 Q₀ 只剩約 5×10⁸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. At f = 1.3 GHz: T = 2.0 K gives R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ; T = 4.2 K gives ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ. Adding R_res = 5 nΩ, R_s at 2 K is ≈ 16 nΩ and Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰, while at 4.2 K Q₀ falls to about 5×10⁸. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。在頻率 f = 1.3 GHz：溫度 T = 2.0 K 時 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ；溫度 4.2 K 時 ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ。加上殘餘電阻 R_res = 5 nΩ，2 K 的總表面電阻 R_s ≈ 16 nΩ，品質因數 Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰；4.2 K 時 Q₀ 只剩約 5×10⁸。
knowledge.textEn: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. At f = 1.3 GHz: T = 2.0 K gives R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ; T = 4.2 K gives ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ. Adding R_res = 5 nΩ, R_s at 2 K is ≈ 16 nΩ and Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰, while at 4.2 K Q₀ falls to about 5×10⁸.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀", which statement holds?
options: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin.
Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。
knowledge.textEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res。
腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
quiz.explanation: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
knowledge.textEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall.
quiz.explanation: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場」與「成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field" and "Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。高 RRR 的意義不在超導本身，而在 4.2 K 以下的熱導率，4.2 K 時 κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K)。射頻表面上若有正常導電的缺陷或夾雜，局部發熱必須經由約 2.8 mm 厚的壁傳到氦槽；熱導率不足時缺陷周圍溫度超過 T_c，正常區域雪崩擴張，即熱崩潰（quench）。板材出廠要做渦電流或 SQUID 掃描找出夾雜，並以拉伸試驗確認深拉所需的延展性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities. The value of high RRR is not superconductivity itself but thermal conductivity below 4.2 K, approximately κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K) at 4.2 K. A normal-conducting defect or inclusion on the RF surface heats locally and the heat must cross the roughly 2.8 mm wall to the helium bath; with insufficient conductivity the surrounding temperature exceeds T_c, the normal zone avalanches outward and the cavity quenches. Sheets are eddy-current or SQUID scanned for inclusions and tensile-tested for the ductility needed in deep drawing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場
knowledge.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field
knowledge.text: 腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。高 RRR 的意義不在超導本身，而在 4.2 K 以下的熱導率，4.2 K 時 κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K)。
knowledge.textEn: Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities. The value of high RRR is not superconductivity itself but thermal conductivity below 4.2 K, approximately κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K) at 4.2 K.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field" is correct?
options: 腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
optionsEn: Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
quiz.explanation: 腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。取 κ = 75 W/(m·K)（RRR 300）、T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K、a = 50 µm、R_n = 10 mΩ：H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m，即 B ≈ 83 mT；以 TESLA 腔 B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) 換算，崩潰梯度約 19 MV/m。若 RRR 只有 40（κ ≈ 10），同一缺陷在約 7 MV/m 就崩潰。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance. For κ = 75 W/(m·K) (RRR 300), T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K, a = 50 µm and R_n = 10 mΩ: H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m, i.e. B ≈ 83 mT; with the TESLA ratio B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) the quench gradient is about 19 MV/m. With RRR 40 (κ ≈ 10) the same defect quenches near 7 MV/m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。取 κ = 75 W/(m·K)（RRR 300）、T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K、a = 50 µm、R_n = 10 mΩ：H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m，即 B ≈ 83 mT；以 TESLA 腔 B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) 換算，崩潰梯度約 19 MV/m。若 RRR 只有 40（κ ≈ 10），同一缺陷在約 7 MV/m 就崩潰。
knowledge.textEn: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance. For κ = 75 W/(m·K) (RRR 300), T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K, a = 50 µm and R_n = 10 mΩ: H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m, i.e. B ≈ 83 mT; with the TESLA ratio B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) the quench gradient is about 19 MV/m. With RRR 40 (κ ≈ 10) the same defect quenches near 7 MV/m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field", which statement holds?
options: 鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。
腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
optionsEn: A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
quiz.explanation: 缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。
knowledge.textEn: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.
Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number.
quiz.explanation: 每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：板材出廠要做渦電流或 SQUID 掃描找出夾雜，並以拉伸試驗確認深拉所需的延展性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sheets are eddy-current or SQUID scanned for inclusions and tensile-tested for the ductility needed in deep drawing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。
knowledge.textEn: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
optionsEn: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
quiz.explanation: 一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔；赤道焊道位於磁場最強處，焊道底面必須平滑無飛濺。焊接後表面有約 100 到 150 µm 的損傷層，用電解拋光（EP，HF–H₂SO₄ 電解液）或緩衝化學拋光（BCP）移除。接著 800 °C 真空退火數小時除氫，避免降溫時析出氫化鈮；最後再做輕度 EP、超純水高壓沖洗（HPR）、ISO 4 無塵室組裝與 120 °C 烘烤 48 小時，後者可明顯抑制高場 Q 下降。本課只說明公開的工藝邏輯，不含配方細節。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell. The equator weld sits where the magnetic field is highest, so its underbead must be smooth and spatter-free. Welding leaves a damage layer of roughly 100 to 150 µm that is removed by electropolishing (EP, an HF–H₂SO₄ electrolyte) or buffered chemical polishing (BCP). A vacuum anneal at 800 °C for several hours then degasses hydrogen so that niobium hydride cannot precipitate on cooldown; a light final EP, ultrapure-water high-pressure rinsing (HPR), ISO 4 cleanroom assembly and a 120 °C bake for 48 hours follow, the bake strongly reducing the high-field Q drop. This course covers only public process logic, not recipes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈
knowledge.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain
knowledge.text: 半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔；赤道焊道位於磁場最強處，焊道底面必須平滑無飛濺。焊接後表面有約 100 到 150 µm 的損傷層，用電解拋光（EP，HF–H₂SO₄ 電解液）或緩衝化學拋光（BCP）移除。
knowledge.textEn: Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell. The equator weld sits where the magnetic field is highest, so its underbead must be smooth and spatter-free.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain" is correct?
options: 焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
optionsEn: After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.

Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell.
Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
quiz.explanation: 半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔；赤道焊道位於磁場最強處，焊道底面必須平滑無飛濺。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。取 j = 30 mA/cm²：速率 ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min，移除 150 µm 約需 6.2 小時；一支九腔內表面約 1.2 m²，對應電流約 360 A。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol. For j = 30 mA/cm²: rate ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min, so removing 150 µm takes about 6.2 hours; a nine-cell inner surface of about 1.2 m² corresponds to roughly 360 A of cell current. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。取 j = 30 mA/cm²：速率 ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min，移除 150 µm 約需 6.2 小時；一支九腔內表面約 1.2 m²，對應電流約 360 A。
knowledge.textEn: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol. For j = 30 mA/cm²: rate ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min, so removing 150 µm takes about 6.2 hours; a nine-cell inner surface of about 1.2 m² corresponds to roughly 360 A of cell current.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain", which statement holds?
options: 垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。
optionsEn: A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.
The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol.
quiz.explanation: EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%. Inspect equator welds by borescope and surface replica for roughness, and confirm by witness-sample thermal desorption that hydrogen drops to a few wt. ppm after the 800 °C anneal. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）；赤道焊道若有一個 0.5 mm 的焊孔，便成為場發射與崩潰的固定起點。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease); a single 0.5 mm pinhole in an equator weld becomes a permanent site for field emission and quench.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。
knowledge.textEn: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%. Inspect equator welds by borescope and surface replica for roughness, and confirm by witness-sample thermal desorption that hydrogen drops to a few wt. ppm after the 800 °C anneal.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain"?
options: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
quiz.explanation: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）；赤道焊道若有一個 0.5 mm 的焊孔，便成為場發射與崩潰的固定起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease); a single 0.5 mm pinhole in an equator weld becomes a permanent site for field emission and quench. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本課只說明公開的工藝邏輯，不含配方細節。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This course covers only public process logic, not recipes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）；赤道焊道若有一個 0.5 mm 的焊孔，便成為場發射與崩潰的固定起點。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease); a single 0.5 mm pinhole in an equator weld becomes a permanent site for field emission and quench.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease).
Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
quiz.explanation: 省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）；赤道焊道若有一個 0.5 mm 的焊孔，便成為場發射與崩潰的固定起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease); a single 0.5 mm pinhole in an equator weld becomes a permanent site for field emission and quench. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線」與「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve" and "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。先在低場量射頻關斷後的指數衰減時間 τ，得到負載品質因數 Q_L = ω·τ；由前向與反射功率算出耦合係數 β，Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β)。接著逐步升場，每一點以穩態功率平衡求 P_diss 與儲能 U，得 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線，同時記錄輻射劑量率（場發射）與崩潰梯度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency. At low field the exponential decay time τ after switching the RF off gives the loaded quality factor Q_L = ω·τ; the coupling factor β from forward and reflected power yields Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β). The field is then raised step by step, and at each point the steady-state power balance gives P_diss and the stored energy U, producing the Q₀(E_acc) curve while the radiation dose rate (field emission) and the quench gradient are logged. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線
knowledge.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve
knowledge.text: 整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。先在低場量射頻關斷後的指數衰減時間 τ，得到負載品質因數 Q_L = ω·τ；由前向與反射功率算出耦合係數 β，Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β)。
knowledge.textEn: The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency. At low field the exponential decay time τ after switching the RF off gives the loaded quality factor Q_L = ω·τ; the coupling factor β from forward and reflected power yields Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve" is correct?
options: Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。
optionsEn: Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency.
quiz.explanation: 整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量到 τ = 1.2 s：Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹；臨界耦合 β = 1 時 Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰。升場後穩態量得 P_diss = 10 W，則 V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴，V ≈ 14.4 MV，E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m。電纜校正誤差 ±0.2 dB 對應功率 ±4.7%，換成場為 ±2.3%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰. With the field raised and a steady-state P_diss = 10 W, V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴, V ≈ 14.4 MV and E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m. A ±0.2 dB cable-calibration error is ±4.7% in power and ±2.3% in field. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 量到 τ = 1.2 s：Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹；臨界耦合 β = 1 時 Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰。升場後穩態量得 P_diss = 10 W，則 V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴，V ≈ 14.4 MV，E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m。電纜校正誤差 ±0.2 dB 對應功率 ±4.7%，換成場為 ±2.3%。
knowledge.textEn: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰. With the field raised and a steady-state P_diss = 10 W, V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴, V ≈ 14.4 MV and E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m. A ±0.2 dB cable-calibration error is ±4.7% in power and ±2.3% in field.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve", which statement holds?
options: 腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
quiz.explanation: 量到 τ = 1.2 s：Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹；臨界耦合 β = 1 時 Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
quiz.explanation: 每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接著逐步升場，每一點以穩態功率平衡求 P_diss 與儲能 U，得 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線，同時記錄輻射劑量率（場發射）與崩潰梯度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The field is then raised step by step, and at each point the steady-state power balance gives P_diss and the stored energy U, producing the Q₀(E_acc) curve while the radiation dose rate (field emission) and the quench gradient are logged.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。
knowledge.textEn: An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two.
quiz.explanation: 耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。製作後以珠拉法（bead-pull）量軸上場分佈：小珠沿軸移動造成的頻率擾動正比於局部 E²（Slater 擾動定理），得到每腔室的相對振幅，場平坦度定義為 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg，驗收通常要求 ≥ 95%。再以調諧機塑性拉伸或壓縮個別腔室校正頻率，並把整體頻率對準目標。運轉中腔壁受輻射壓力（勞倫茲力）而內凹，頻率隨 E_acc² 下降；加上氦壓波動與機械微震動，構成失諧預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early. After fabrication a bead-pull measures the on-axis field: the frequency perturbation from a small bead moved along the axis is proportional to the local E² (Slater's theorem), giving each cell's relative amplitude; field flatness is defined as 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg and acceptance usually requires ≥ 95%. A tuning machine then plastically stretches or squeezes individual cells and sets the overall frequency. In operation radiation pressure (the Lorentz force) dents the wall inward so the frequency drops with E_acc²; together with helium-pressure fluctuations and microphonics this forms the detuning budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算
knowledge.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget
knowledge.text: 九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。製作後以珠拉法（bead-pull）量軸上場分佈：小珠沿軸移動造成的頻率擾動正比於局部 E²（Slater 擾動定理），得到每腔室的相對振幅，場平坦度定義為 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg，驗收通常要求 ≥ 95%。
knowledge.textEn: All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early. After fabrication a bead-pull measures the on-axis field: the frequency perturbation from a small bead moved along the axis is proportional to the local E² (Slater's theorem), giving each cell's relative amplitude; field flatness is defined as 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg and acceptance usually requires ≥ 95%.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget" is correct?
options: 九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。負載帶寬 f/Q_L 在 Q_L = 3×10⁶ 時為 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz，失諧超過一個帶寬，脈衝內必須靠壓電調諧器補償；若氦壓靈敏度為 20 Hz/mbar，±1 mbar 的壓力波動再貢獻 ±20 Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz. The loaded bandwidth f/Q_L at Q_L = 3×10⁶ is 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz, so the detuning exceeds one bandwidth and a piezo tuner must compensate within the pulse; with a pressure sensitivity of 20 Hz/mbar, ±1 mbar of helium-pressure ripple adds ±20 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據；低溫測試時量頻率對氦壓的斜率與 Δf 對 E_acc² 的斜率，與設計值 K_L 比對；以頻譜分析儀記錄微震動的 rms 失諧，確認落在預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning; at 2 K measure the frequency slope against helium pressure and Δf against E_acc² and compare with the design K_L; log the rms microphonic detuning with a spectrum analyzer and confirm it fits the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。負載帶寬 f/Q_L 在 Q_L = 3×10⁶ 時為 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz，失諧超過一個帶寬，脈衝內必須靠壓電調諧器補償；若氦壓靈敏度為 20 Hz/mbar，±1 mbar 的壓力波動再貢獻 ±20 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz. The loaded bandwidth f/Q_L at Q_L = 3×10⁶ is 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz, so the detuning exceeds one bandwidth and a piezo tuner must compensate within the pulse; with a pressure sensitivity of 20 Hz/mbar, ±1 mbar of helium-pressure ripple adds ±20 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget", which statement holds?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
optionsEn: A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.
Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
quiz.explanation: 勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據；低溫測試時量頻率對氦壓的斜率與 Δf 對 E_acc² 的斜率，與設計值 K_L 比對；以頻譜分析儀記錄微震動的 rms 失諧，確認落在預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning; at 2 K measure the frequency slope against helium pressure and Δf against E_acc² and compare with the design K_L; log the rms microphonic detuning with a spectrum analyzer and confirm it fits the budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：場平坦度只有 85% 的腔，最熱的腔室在平均 20 MV/m 時已達 24 MV/m，整支腔在該腔室崩潰而被判定為低性能，其實是調諧問題；未補償的勞倫茲失諧則讓脈衝後段功率大量反射。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A cavity at 85% flatness has its hottest cell at 24 MV/m when the average is 20 MV/m, quenches there and is judged low-performance when the real issue is tuning; uncompensated Lorentz detuning reflects most of the power late in the pulse.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據；低溫測試時量頻率對氦壓的斜率與 Δf 對 E_acc² 的斜率，與設計值 K_L 比對；以頻譜分析儀記錄微震動的 rms 失諧，確認落在預算內。
knowledge.textEn: At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning; at 2 K measure the frequency slope against helium pressure and Δf against E_acc² and compare with the design K_L; log the rms microphonic detuning with a spectrum analyzer and confirm it fits the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning.
quiz.explanation: 室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據；低溫測試時量頻率對氦壓的斜率與 Δf 對 E_acc² 的斜率，與設計值 K_L 比對；以頻譜分析儀記錄微震動的 rms 失諧，確認落在預算內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning; at 2 K measure the frequency slope against helium pressure and Δf against E_acc² and compare with the design K_L; log the rms microphonic detuning with a spectrum analyzer and confirm it fits the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 場平坦度只有 85% 的腔，最熱的腔室在平均 20 MV/m 時已達 24 MV/m，整支腔在該腔室崩潰而被判定為低性能，其實是調諧問題；未補償的勞倫茲失諧則讓脈衝後段功率大量反射。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A cavity at 85% flatness has its hottest cell at 24 MV/m when the average is 20 MV/m, quenches there and is judged low-performance when the real issue is tuning; uncompensated Lorentz detuning reflects most of the power late in the pulse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運轉中腔壁受輻射壓力（勞倫茲力）而內凹，頻率隨 E_acc² 下降；加上氦壓波動與機械微震動，構成失諧預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In operation radiation pressure (the Lorentz force) dents the wall inward so the frequency drops with E_acc²; together with helium-pressure fluctuations and microphonics this forms the detuning budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場平坦度只有 85% 的腔，最熱的腔室在平均 20 MV/m 時已達 24 MV/m，整支腔在該腔室崩潰而被判定為低性能，其實是調諧問題；未補償的勞倫茲失諧則讓脈衝後段功率大量反射。
knowledge.textEn: A cavity at 85% flatness has its hottest cell at 24 MV/m when the average is 20 MV/m, quenches there and is judged low-performance when the real issue is tuning; uncompensated Lorentz detuning reflects most of the power late in the pulse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場平坦度只有 85% 的腔，最熱的腔室在平均 20 MV/m 時已達 24 MV/m，整支腔在該腔室崩潰而被判定為低性能，其實是調諧問題。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: A cavity at 85% flatness has its hottest cell at 24 MV/m when the average is 20 MV/m, quenches there and is judged low-performance when the real issue is tuning.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 場平坦度只有 85% 的腔，最熱的腔室在平均 20 MV/m 時已達 24 MV/m，整支腔在該腔室崩潰而被判定為低性能，其實是調諧問題；未補償的勞倫茲失諧則讓脈衝後段功率大量反射。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A cavity at 85% flatness has its hottest cell at 24 MV/m when the average is 20 MV/m, quenches there and is judged low-performance when the real issue is tuning; uncompensated Lorentz detuning reflects most of the power late in the pulse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」與「驗收判準、統計與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration" and "Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。基波功率耦合器把室溫波導功率經陶瓷窗送入 2 K 的腔，外部品質因數 Q_ext 依束流負載選定；高階模耦合器把束流激發的寄生模導出。八支腔在無塵室內串接成腔串，與雙相氦管、熱屏、磁屏蔽與真空容器一起組成低溫模組。靜態漏熱與動態射頻耗散共同決定 2 K 製冷機的規模。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable; the vessel carries a slow stepper tuner and a fast piezo element that change frequency by stretching the whole cavity. The fundamental power coupler brings room-temperature waveguide power through a ceramic window into the 2 K cavity, its external quality factor Q_ext chosen for the beam loading; higher-order-mode couplers extract beam-excited parasitic modes. Eight cavities are assembled into a string in the cleanroom and, with the two-phase helium line, thermal shields, magnetic shielding and vacuum vessel, form a cryomodule. Static heat leak plus dynamic RF dissipation set the size of the 2 K refrigerator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
