steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合
knowledge.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration
knowledge.text: 通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。基波功率耦合器把室溫波導功率經陶瓷窗送入 2 K 的腔，外部品質因數 Q_ext 依束流負載選定；高階模耦合器把束流激發的寄生模導出。
knowledge.textEn: A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable; the vessel carries a slow stepper tuner and a fast piezo element that change frequency by stretching the whole cavity. The fundamental power coupler brings room-temperature waveguide power through a ceramic window into the 2 K cavity, its external quality factor Q_ext chosen for the beam loading; higher-order-mode couplers extract beam-excited parasitic modes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration" is correct?
options: 垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。
腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
optionsEn: A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
quiz.explanation: 通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable; the vessel carries a slow stepper tuner and a fast piezo element that change frequency by stretching the whole cavity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。一個模組若有 8 支腔各 10 W 動態耗散加 10 W 靜態漏熱，2 K 負載 90 W，電力約 54 到 68 kW；若 Q₀ 從 2.7×10¹⁰ 退化到 1×10¹⁰，動態負載升到 216 W，電力需求幾乎三倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity. A module with 8 cavities at 10 W dynamic each plus 10 W static leak has a 90 W load at 2 K, about 54 to 68 kW of electrical power; if Q₀ degrades from 2.7×10¹⁰ to 1×10¹⁰ the dynamic load rises to 216 W and the power demand nearly triples. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。一個模組若有 8 支腔各 10 W 動態耗散加 10 W 靜態漏熱，2 K 負載 90 W，電力約 54 到 68 kW；若 Q₀ 從 2.7×10¹⁰ 退化到 1×10¹⁰，動態負載升到 216 W，電力需求幾乎三倍。
knowledge.textEn: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity. A module with 8 cavities at 10 W dynamic each plus 10 W static leak has a 90 W load at 2 K, about 54 to 68 kW of electrical power; if Q₀ degrades from 2.7×10¹⁰ to 1×10¹⁰ the dynamic load rises to 216 W and the power demand nearly triples.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration", which statement holds?
options: 只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。
optionsEn: Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149.
quiz.explanation: 2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks; a poorly coated coupler ceramic window multipacts and blocks the power ramp.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration"?
options: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
optionsEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
quiz.explanation: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks; a poorly coated coupler ceramic window multipacts and blocks the power ramp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：靜態漏熱與動態射頻耗散共同決定 2 K 製冷機的規模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Static heat leak plus dynamic RF dissipation set the size of the 2 K refrigerator.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。
knowledge.textEn: A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks; a poorly coated coupler ceramic window multipacts and blocks the power ramp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週。
腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
quiz.explanation: 無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks; a poorly coated coupler ceramic window multipacts and blocks the power ramp. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。可用梯度定義為三者的最小值：崩潰梯度扣除安全邊際、Q₀ 仍高於規格的梯度、場發射輻射低於限值的梯度。未達標的腔依失效原因決定重做 HPR、重做輕度 EP 或退回重新焊接；統計上的良率決定需要多少備用腔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location. The usable gradient is the minimum of three values: the quench gradient minus a safety margin, the gradient at which Q₀ still meets specification, and the gradient at which field-emission radiation stays below the limit. Cavities that fall short are routed by failure cause to a repeat HPR, a light EP or a return to welding; the statistical yield sets how many spare cavities to order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。可用梯度定義為三者的最小值：崩潰梯度扣除安全邊際、Q₀ 仍高於規格的梯度、場發射輻射低於限值的梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location. The usable gradient is the minimum of three values: the quench gradient minus a safety margin, the gradient at which Q₀ still meets specification, and the gradient at which field-emission radiation stays below the limit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「驗收判準、統計與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。
optionsEn: A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.

Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location.
quiz.explanation: 量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。若規格是 23.6 MV/m 且 800 支腔中 75% 第一次就過，另 20% 經重做 HPR 後通過，總良率 95%，為交付 800 支合格腔需投產約 842 支。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m. If the specification is 23.6 MV/m and 75% of 800 cavities pass first time while another 20% pass after a repeat HPR, the overall yield is 95% and about 842 cavities must be produced to deliver 800 accepted ones. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。若規格是 23.6 MV/m 且 800 支腔中 75% 第一次就過，另 20% 經重做 HPR 後通過，總良率 95%，為交付 800 支合格腔需投產約 842 支。
knowledge.textEn: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m. If the specification is 23.6 MV/m and 75% of 800 cavities pass first time while another 20% pass after a repeat HPR, the overall yield is 95% and about 842 cavities must be produced to deliver 800 accepted ones.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗收判準、統計與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。
optionsEn: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
quiz.explanation: 某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只以崩潰梯度排序腔體而忽略場發射紀錄，裝進模組後輻射使鄰近電子元件與低溫絕緣劣化，加速器被迫以低於設計的梯度運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Ranking cavities by quench gradient alone while ignoring the field-emission record puts radiation sources into the module that degrade nearby electronics and cryogenic insulation, and the accelerator runs below design gradient.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。
knowledge.textEn: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收判準、統計與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
quiz.explanation: 交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只以崩潰梯度排序腔體而忽略場發射紀錄，裝進模組後輻射使鄰近電子元件與低溫絕緣劣化，加速器被迫以低於設計的梯度運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Ranking cavities by quench gradient alone while ignoring the field-emission record puts radiation sources into the module that degrade nearby electronics and cryogenic insulation, and the accelerator runs below design gradient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未達標的腔依失效原因決定重做 HPR、重做輕度 EP 或退回重新焊接；統計上的良率決定需要多少備用腔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cavities that fall short are routed by failure cause to a repeat HPR, a light EP or a return to welding; the statistical yield sets how many spare cavities to order.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 鈕扣 BPM 靈敏度與解析度練習：圓管半徑 R = 20 mm，四鈕扣在 ±45°，k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm。束流偏移 50 µm 時 Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³。每電極 500 MHz 訊號為 −1.7 dBm，經 1 MHz 帶通濾波後熱雜訊 −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 109.3 dB，振幅相對雜訊 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶，σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm（理論熱雜訊極限）；實務上 ADC 與電子學雜訊讓逐圈解析度落在約 0.5 µm。若一路電纜增益偏 0.5%，假偏移為 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm，是熱雜訊極限的數百倍，說明增益校正比低雜訊放大器更關鍵。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Button-BPM sensitivity and resolution exercise: pipe radius R = 20 mm, four buttons at ±45°, k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm. A 50 µm beam offset gives Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³. Each electrode delivers −1.7 dBm at 500 MHz; after a 1 MHz band-pass the thermal noise −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 109.3 dB, the relative amplitude noise is 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶, σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶ and σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm as the thermal-noise limit; in practice ADC and electronics noise put turn-by-turn resolution near 0.5 µm. If one cable's gain is off by 0.5%, the false offset is 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm, hundreds of times the thermal limit, showing that gain calibration matters more than a lower-noise amplifier. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」與「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" and "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bunch field and wall image current” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。管壁上的任何電極只要截取一部分鏡像電流，就得到與束團縱向分佈相同時間形狀的訊號；因此位置監測器量的不是束團本身，而是鏡像電荷在圓周上的分佈。束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself. Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch field and wall image current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bunch field and wall image current”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜
knowledge.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch
knowledge.text: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。管壁上的任何電極只要截取一部分鏡像電流，就得到與束團縱向分佈相同時間形狀的訊號；因此位置監測器量的不是束團本身，而是鏡像電荷在圓周上的分佈。
knowledge.textEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" is correct?
options: 鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。
電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。
差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
optionsEn: A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly.

An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current.
Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
quiz.explanation: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bunch field and wall image current” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。束團 σ_z = 10 mm 對應 σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps，高斯頻譜在 f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz 處降到 e^(−1/2)；在 500 MHz 的處理頻率上 ωσ_t ≈ 0.10，形狀因子 exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995，幾乎不衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. A bunch with σ_z = 10 mm has σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps, and its Gaussian spectrum falls to e^(−1/2) near f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz; at the 500 MHz processing frequency ωσ_t ≈ 0.10 and the form factor exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995 is nearly unity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。束團 σ_z = 10 mm 對應 σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps，高斯頻譜在 f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz 處降到 e^(−1/2)；在 500 MHz 的處理頻率上 ωσ_t ≈ 0.10，形狀因子 exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995，幾乎不衰減。
knowledge.textEn: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. A bunch with σ_z = 10 mm has σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps, and its Gaussian spectrum falls to e^(−1/2) near f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz; at the 500 MHz processing frequency ωσ_t ≈ 0.10 and the form factor exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995 is nearly unity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch", which statement holds?
options: 只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。
optionsEn: If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.

A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch.
quiz.explanation: 3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bunch field and wall image current” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。
knowledge.textEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch"?
options: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bunch field and wall image current” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
knowledge.textEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity.
Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
quiz.explanation: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四鈕扣差和比」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four-button difference-over-sum” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。四個鈕扣放在 ±45° 與 ±135°，把對角兩組的和相減再除以四者總和，得到與 x 成正比而與束流電流無關的差和比；y 方向同理。靈敏度由管半徑與電極位置決定，非線性項隨 (r/R)³ 增長，所以大位移需要用邊界元素計算或實驗室校正表修正。解析度則由各電極訊號的訊雜比與處理頻寬決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四鈕扣差和比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic. Sensitivity is set by pipe radius and electrode positions, and the nonlinear terms grow as (r/R)³, so large displacements need boundary-element calculations or a laboratory calibration map. Resolution is set by the signal-to-noise ratio of each electrode and the processing bandwidth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-button difference-over-sum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四鈕扣差和比」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Four-button difference-over-sum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度
knowledge.text: 圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。四個鈕扣放在 ±45° 與 ±135°，把對角兩組的和相減再除以四者總和，得到與 x 成正比而與束流電流無關的差和比；y 方向同理。
knowledge.textEn: When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution" is correct?
options: 差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。
圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。
optionsEn: Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy.
When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement.
quiz.explanation: 圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四鈕扣差和比」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four-button difference-over-sum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。R = 20 mm 時 k_x = 14.1 mm，x = 100 µm 給出 Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³。若每個電極在 1 MHz 頻寬內的訊號功率為 −20 dBm，熱雜訊 kTB = −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 91 dB，振幅相對雜訊 σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵；四電極的 σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵，位置解析度 σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. For R = 20 mm, k_x = 14.1 mm and x = 100 µm gives Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³. If each electrode delivers −20 dBm in a 1 MHz bandwidth while thermal noise kTB = −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 91 dB, the relative amplitude noise is σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵, four electrodes give σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵, and the position resolution is σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution", which statement holds?
options: BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。

quiz.explanationEn: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四鈕扣差和比」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four-button difference-over-sum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率」與「機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency" and "Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鈕扣是一片直徑數毫米的金屬圓片，經陶瓷絕緣的 50 Ω 同軸饋通引出；它對管壁有數 pF 的電容 C_b。鏡像電流截取的比例近似於鈕扣面積除以管壁周長乘以束團長度，形成一個電流源推動 C_b 與 50 Ω 負載的並聯：低頻時訊號正比於 ω（微分特性），高於轉折頻率 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) 後趨於平坦。轉移阻抗 Z_t 把束流的頻譜分量轉成電極電壓，是設計電子學增益與功率預算的起點。條帶電極（stripline）與腔式 BPM 分別以行波方向性與偶極模共振取得更高靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A button is a metal disc of a few millimetres diameter brought out through a ceramic-insulated 50 Ω coaxial feedthrough, with a capacitance C_b of a few picofarads to the wall. The fraction of image current it intercepts is about the button area divided by the wall circumference, forming a current source that drives C_b in parallel with the 50 Ω load: at low frequency the signal is proportional to ω (differentiating), and above the corner frequency 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) it flattens. The transfer impedance Z_t converts each spectral component of the beam current into electrode voltage and is the starting point for electronics gain and power budgets. Stripline pickups and cavity BPMs reach higher sensitivity through travelling-wave directivity and dipole-mode resonance respectively. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C_b = 5 pF 時轉折頻率 f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With C_b = 5 pF the corner frequency is f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C_b = 5 pF 時轉折頻率 f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz。高頻漸近轉移阻抗 |Z_t,∞| = A/(2πR·βc·C_b)：A = 78.5 mm²（直徑 10 mm）、2πR = 125.7 mm、c·C_b = 1.5×10⁻³ m·Ω⁻¹，得 0.42 Ω；在 500 MHz 時 ωRC = 0.785，|Z_t| = 0.42×0.785/√(1 + 0.785²) ≈ 0.26 Ω。儲存環平均電流 500 mA 的 500 MHz 傅立葉振幅約 2×0.5 = 1.0 A，電極電壓振幅約 0.26 V，饋入 50 Ω 的功率 V²/(2×50) ≈ 0.68 mW ≈ −1.7 dBm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With C_b = 5 pF the corner frequency is f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz. The high-frequency asymptote of the transfer impedance is |Z_t,∞| = A/(2πR·βc·C_b): A = 78.5 mm² (10 mm diameter), 2πR = 125.7 mm and c·C_b = 1.5×10⁻³ m·Ω⁻¹ give 0.42 Ω; at 500 MHz, ωRC = 0.785 and |Z_t| = 0.42×0.785/√(1 + 0.785²) ≈ 0.26 Ω. A 500 mA storage-ring current has a 500 MHz Fourier amplitude of about 2×0.5 = 1.0 A, so the electrode voltage amplitude is about 0.26 V and the power into 50 Ω is V²/(2×50) ≈ 0.68 mW ≈ −1.7 dBm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry; on the wire test bench measure the frequency response of Z_t and compare with the formula; after installation back out Z_t from the 500 MHz power at a known beam current, and require the three to agree within 1 dB.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry; on the wire test bench measure the frequency response of Z_t and compare with the formula; after installation back out Z_t from the 500 MHz power at a known beam current, and require the three to agree within 1 dB. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：陶瓷饋通在烘烤後出現微裂縫，鈕扣電容與匹配改變，單一電極訊號下降 0.5 dB；由於差和比假設四電極相同，位置讀數瞬間偏移上百微米，看起來像真的軌道變化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A ceramic feedthrough that micro-cracks after bakeout changes the button capacitance and match, dropping one electrode by 0.5 dB; because difference-over-sum assumes identical electrodes, the position reading jumps by over a hundred micrometres and looks like a real orbit change.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry; on the wire test bench measure the frequency response of Z_t and compare with the formula; after installation back out Z_t from the 500 MHz power at a known beam current, and require the three to agree within 1 dB.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。
用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly.
Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry.
quiz.explanation: 用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry; on the wire test bench measure the frequency response of Z_t and compare with the formula; after installation back out Z_t from the 500 MHz power at a known beam current, and require the three to agree within 1 dB. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 陶瓷饋通在烘烤後出現微裂縫，鈕扣電容與匹配改變，單一電極訊號下降 0.5 dB；由於差和比假設四電極相同，位置讀數瞬間偏移上百微米，看起來像真的軌道變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A ceramic feedthrough that micro-cracks after bakeout changes the button capacitance and match, dropping one electrode by 0.5 dB; because difference-over-sum assumes identical electrodes, the position reading jumps by over a hundred micrometres and looks like a real orbit change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：條帶電極（stripline）與腔式 BPM 分別以行波方向性與偶極模共振取得更高靈敏度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stripline pickups and cavity BPMs reach higher sensitivity through travelling-wave directivity and dipole-mode resonance respectively.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 陶瓷饋通在烘烤後出現微裂縫，鈕扣電容與匹配改變，單一電極訊號下降 0.5 dB；由於差和比假設四電極相同，位置讀數瞬間偏移上百微米，看起來像真的軌道變化。
knowledge.textEn: A ceramic feedthrough that micro-cracks after bakeout changes the button capacitance and match, dropping one electrode by 0.5 dB; because difference-over-sum assumes identical electrodes, the position reading jumps by over a hundred micrometres and looks like a real orbit change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pickup transfer impedance and the capacitive corner frequency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 陶瓷饋通在烘烤後出現微裂縫，鈕扣電容與匹配改變，單一電極訊號下降 0.5 dB；由於差和比假設四電極相同，位置讀數瞬間偏移上百微米，看起來像真的軌道變化。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
optionsEn: A ceramic feedthrough that micro-cracks after bakeout changes the button capacitance and match, dropping one electrode by 0.5 dB.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.

quiz.explanationEn: A ceramic feedthrough that micro-cracks after bakeout changes the button capacitance and match, dropping one electrode by 0.5 dB; because difference-over-sum assumes identical electrodes, the position reading jumps by over a hundred micrometres and looks like a real orbit change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: BPM 本體由不鏽鋼或鋁整體加工，四個饋通孔位的機械公差在數十微米，外側加工出測量基準面供雷射追蹤儀測量，把電極幾何中心連到儲存環的測量網。電氣中心與機械中心不一致的來源有：電極尺寸與電容差異、電纜衰減差異、電子學通道增益差異。因為差和比對四路增益極敏感，任何通道的 1% 差異就是數十微米的假偏移，所以工程上以通道交叉切換、導頻（pilot tone）或束流基準對準把增益誤差移出量測鏈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The BPM block is machined from one piece of stainless steel or aluminium with the four feedthrough ports toleranced to tens of micrometres, and external fiducial surfaces are machined so that a laser tracker can tie the electrode geometric centre to the ring survey network. The electrical centre departs from the mechanical centre because of electrode size and capacitance differences, cable attenuation differences and electronics channel gains. Since difference-over-sum is extremely sensitive to the four gains, a 1% mismatch in any channel is a false offset of tens of micrometres, so engineering removes gain error from the chain by channel crossbar switching, a pilot tone or beam-based alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Let one of four electrodes have gain 1.01 with the beam centred: Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01, Σ = 4.01, Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³ and the false offset is x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset" is correct?
options: 只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
BPM 本體由不鏽鋼或鋁整體加工，四個饋通孔位的機械公差在數十微米，外側加工出測量基準面供雷射追蹤儀測量，把電極幾何中心連到儲存環的測量網。
BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
optionsEn: If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.

The BPM block is machined from one piece of stainless steel or aluminium with the four feedthrough ports toleranced to tens of micrometres, and external fiducial surfaces are machined so that a laser tracker can tie the electrode geometric centre to the ring survey network.
A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration.
quiz.explanation: BPM 本體由不鏽鋼或鋁整體加工，四個饋通孔位的機械公差在數十微米，外側加工出測量基準面供雷射追蹤儀測量，把電極幾何中心連到儲存環的測量網。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The BPM block is machined from one piece of stainless steel or aluminium with the four feedthrough ports toleranced to tens of micrometres, and external fiducial surfaces are machined so that a laser tracker can tie the electrode geometric centre to the ring survey network. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設四電極中有一路增益為 1.01、其餘為 1，束流在中心：Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01，Σ = 4.01，Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³，假偏移 x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm。同軸電纜衰減的溫度係數約 0.2%/K，10 dB 的電纜溫差 1 K 造成約 0.02 dB（0.46%）的增益差，相當於約 16 µm 的漂移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Let one of four electrodes have gain 1.01 with the beam centred: Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01, Σ = 4.01, Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³ and the false offset is x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm. Coaxial-cable attenuation has a temperature coefficient of about 0.2%/K, so a 1 K difference on a 10 dB cable gives about 0.02 dB (0.46%) of gain mismatch, equivalent to about 16 µm of drift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作後用三次元量床量四個饋通孔相對基準面的位置；安裝前在導線測試台量電氣中心對機械中心的偏移並存入資料庫；上線後用導頻或切換法持續量四通道增益比，與實驗室值比對，差異超過 0.1 dB 時觸發檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After machining, measure the four port positions relative to the fiducials on a coordinate-measuring machine; before installation measure the electrical-to-mechanical centre offset on the wire bench and store it in the database; once operating, track the four channel gain ratios continuously with a pilot tone or crossbar switching, compare with laboratory values and flag any change beyond 0.1 dB.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：四條電纜長度相同但走線不同，其中一條貼近熱源，日夜溫差讓位置讀數以 24 小時週期漂移數十微米，被誤當成地基沉降去修正磁鐵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Four cables of equal length but different routing, one near a heat source, make the reading drift by tens of micrometres on a 24-hour cycle that is mistaken for ground settlement and corrected by moving magnets.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 四條電纜長度相同但走線不同，其中一條貼近熱源，日夜溫差讓位置讀數以 24 小時週期漂移數十微米，被誤當成地基沉降去修正磁鐵。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Four cables of equal length but different routing, one near a heat source, make the reading drift by tens of micrometres on a 24-hour cycle that is mistaken for ground settlement and corrected by moving magnets. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為差和比對四路增益極敏感，任何通道的 1% 差異就是數十微米的假偏移，所以工程上以通道交叉切換、導頻（pilot tone）或束流基準對準把增益誤差移出量測鏈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Since difference-over-sum is extremely sensitive to the four gains, a 1% mismatch in any channel is a false offset of tens of micrometres, so engineering removes gain error from the chain by channel crossbar switching, a pilot tone or beam-based alignment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 四條電纜長度相同但走線不同，其中一條貼近熱源，日夜溫差讓位置讀數以 24 小時週期漂移數十微米，被誤當成地基沉降去修正磁鐵。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
四條電纜長度相同但走線不同，其中一條貼近熱源，日夜溫差讓位置讀數以 24 小時週期漂移數十微米，被誤當成地基沉降去修正磁鐵。
BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Four cables of equal length but different routing, one near a heat source, make the reading drift by tens of micrometres on a 24-hour cycle that is mistaken for ground settlement and corrected by moving magnets.
