stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束流基準對準與電子學校正」與「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration" and "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束流基準對準與電子學校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。束流基準對準的做法是改變某個四極的強度，若束流偏離其磁中心，就會產生與偏移成正比的踢角，造成全環軌道變化；調整局部軌道直到四極強度改變不再引起軌道變化，此時 BPM 讀數就是該 BPM 對四極中心的偏移。這個偏移同時包含電氣中心誤差與機械安裝誤差，是後續所有軌道校正的零點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected. Beam-based alignment changes the strength of one quadrupole; if the beam is off its magnetic centre, a kick proportional to the offset appears and the whole-ring orbit changes. The local orbit is adjusted until a strength change no longer moves the orbit, and the BPM reading at that point is its offset from the quadrupole centre. This offset contains both the electrical-centre error and the mechanical installation error and becomes the zero point for all later orbit correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四極強度改變 Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹、束流偏移 x_q = 100 µm 時踢角 Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A quadrupole strength change Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹ with a beam offset x_q = 100 µm gives a kick Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流基準對準與電子學校正
knowledge.text: 軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。束流基準對準的做法是改變某個四極的強度，若束流偏離其磁中心，就會產生與偏移成正比的踢角，造成全環軌道變化；調整局部軌道直到四極強度改變不再引起軌道變化，此時 BPM 讀數就是該 BPM 對四極中心的偏移。
knowledge.textEn: What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected. Beam-based alignment changes the strength of one quadrupole; if the beam is off its magnetic centre, a kick proportional to the offset appears and the whole-ring orbit changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束流基準對準與電子學校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration" is correct?
options: BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。
optionsEn: A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.
What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected.
quiz.explanation: 軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流基準對準與電子學校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四極強度改變 Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹、束流偏移 x_q = 100 µm 時踢角 Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad。下游 BPM 的軌道變化 Δx = Δθ·√(β_q·β)·cos(Δφ − πν)/(2 sin πν)；取 √(β_q·β) = 10 m、ν = 14.2（2 sin πν ≈ 1.18）、cos 項 ≈ 1，Δx ≈ 1×10⁻⁶×10/1.18 ≈ 8.5 µm。BPM 解析度 1 µm 時，對準精度約 100 µm×(1/8.5) ≈ 12 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A quadrupole strength change Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹ with a beam offset x_q = 100 µm gives a kick Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad. The orbit change at a downstream BPM is Δx = Δθ·√(β_q·β)·cos(Δφ − πν)/(2 sin πν); with √(β_q·β) = 10 m, ν = 14.2 (2 sin πν ≈ 1.18) and the cosine term ≈ 1, Δx ≈ 1×10⁻⁶×10/1.18 ≈ 8.5 µm. With 1 µm BPM resolution the alignment precision is about 100 µm×(1/8.5) ≈ 12 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個四極做正負兩個方向的強度調變並掃描局部軌道，擬合軌道變化對 BPM 讀數的直線，零交點即偏移；重複三次取標準差作為對準不確定度，並與雷射追蹤儀的機械測量值比較，差異應在機械公差內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Modulate each quadrupole in both polarities while scanning the local orbit, fit a straight line of orbit change against BPM reading, and take the zero crossing as the offset; repeat three times and use the standard deviation as the alignment uncertainty, then compare with the laser-tracker mechanical survey, which should agree within mechanical tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「束流基準對準與電子學校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration", which statement holds?
options: 四極強度改變 Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹、束流偏移 x_q = 100 µm 時踢角 Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad。
BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。
差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。

A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever.

quiz.explanationEn: A quadrupole strength change Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹ with a beam offset x_q = 100 µm gives a kick Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad. Keep units when recalculating.

Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Running beam-based alignment with BPM electronics whose gains were never calibrated freezes temperature-dependent gain error into the offsets; months later the cables age, the zero point has moved and the orbit is 'corrected' to the wrong place.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個四極做正負兩個方向的強度調變並掃描局部軌道，擬合軌道變化對 BPM 讀數的直線，零交點即偏移；重複三次取標準差作為對準不確定度，並與雷射追蹤儀的機械測量值比較，差異應在機械公差內。
knowledge.textEn: Modulate each quadrupole in both polarities while scanning the local orbit, fit a straight line of orbit change against BPM reading, and take the zero crossing as the offset; repeat three times and use the standard deviation as the alignment uncertainty, then compare with the laser-tracker mechanical survey, which should agree within mechanical tolerance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流基準對準與電子學校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration"?

對每個四極做正負兩個方向的強度調變並掃描局部軌道，擬合軌道變化對 BPM 讀數的直線，零交點即偏移。
鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Modulate each quadrupole in both polarities while scanning the local orbit, fit a straight line of orbit change against BPM reading, and take the zero crossing as the offset.
A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流基準對準與電子學校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Running beam-based alignment with BPM electronics whose gains were never calibrated freezes temperature-dependent gain error into the offsets; months later the cables age, the zero point has moved and the orbit is 'corrected' to the wrong place. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個偏移同時包含電氣中心誤差與機械安裝誤差，是後續所有軌道校正的零點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This offset contains both the electrical-centre error and the mechanical installation error and becomes the zero point for all later orbit correction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流基準對準與電子學校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam-based alignment and electronics calibration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.
Running beam-based alignment with BPM electronics whose gains were never calibrated freezes temperature-dependent gain error into the offsets.
quiz.explanation: 以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Running beam-based alignment with BPM electronics whose gains were never calibrated freezes temperature-dependent gain error into the offsets; months later the cables age, the zero point has moved and the orbit is 'corrected' to the wrong place. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-BPM correlation and drift log” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差；慢軌道量測以 10 kHz 以下頻寬把雜訊平均掉；長期穩定則由電纜、電子學與機械的溫度漂移主導。解析度不能只靠電子學自測，要用三 BPM 相關法：用兩個 BPM 的讀數經傳輸矩陣預測中間 BPM 的位置，殘差的分佈寬度反映真實解析度。束流電流變化、填充模式與束流尺寸也會透過電子學非線性混入讀數，都要在預算表中各佔一列。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The BPM error budget separates three time scales: turn-by-turn measurement is limited by thermal noise and ADC quantisation, with resolution degrading as the square root of bandwidth; slow orbit measurement averages the noise below about 10 kHz; long-term stability is dominated by temperature drift of cables, electronics and mechanics. Resolution cannot be certified by the electronics alone, so the three-BPM correlation is used: two BPM readings predict the middle one through transfer matrices and the residual width reflects the true resolution. Beam-current changes, fill pattern and beam size also leak into readings through electronics nonlinearity and each takes a line in the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-BPM correlation and drift log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three-BPM correlation and drift log”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算
knowledge.titleEn: Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget
knowledge.text: BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差；慢軌道量測以 10 kHz 以下頻寬把雜訊平均掉；長期穩定則由電纜、電子學與機械的溫度漂移主導。解析度不能只靠電子學自測，要用三 BPM 相關法：用兩個 BPM 的讀數經傳輸矩陣預測中間 BPM 的位置，殘差的分佈寬度反映真實解析度。
knowledge.textEn: The BPM error budget separates three time scales: turn-by-turn measurement is limited by thermal noise and ADC quantisation, with resolution degrading as the square root of bandwidth; slow orbit measurement averages the noise below about 10 kHz; long-term stability is dominated by temperature drift of cables, electronics and mechanics. Resolution cannot be certified by the electronics alone, so the three-BPM correlation is used: two BPM readings predict the middle one through transfer matrices and the residual width reflects the true resolution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget" is correct?
options: BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: The BPM error budget separates three time scales: turn-by-turn measurement is limited by thermal noise and ADC quantisation, with resolution degrading as the square root of bandwidth.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差；慢軌道量測以 10 kHz 以下頻寬把雜訊平均掉；長期穩定則由電纜、電子學與機械的溫度漂移主導。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The BPM error budget separates three time scales: turn-by-turn measurement is limited by thermal noise and ADC quantisation, with resolution degrading as the square root of bandwidth; slow orbit measurement averages the noise below about 10 kHz; long-term stability is dominated by temperature drift of cables, electronics and mechanics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-BPM correlation and drift log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。量到 σ_res = 1.5 µm、a = b = 0.5，則 σ = 1.5/√1.5 ≈ 1.22 µm。頻寬縮放：逐圈 500 kHz 頻寬下 σ = 1.2 µm，換成 10 Hz 的慢軌道頻寬，σ ≈ 1.2×√(10/5×10⁵) ≈ 5 nm，此時實際極限轉為電子學 1/f 雜訊與漂移，而非熱雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²). A measured σ_res = 1.5 µm with a = b = 0.5 gives σ = 1.5/√1.5 ≈ 1.22 µm. Bandwidth scaling: σ = 1.2 µm at the 500 kHz turn-by-turn bandwidth becomes σ ≈ 1.2×√(10/5×10⁵) ≈ 5 nm at a 10 Hz slow-orbit bandwidth, where the practical limit shifts to electronics 1/f noise and drift rather than thermal noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較；同時記錄機房溫度與電纜溫度，對讀數做相關分析取得每 K 的漂移係數，填入預算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law; log rack and cable temperatures in parallel, correlate them with the readings to extract a drift coefficient per kelvin and enter it in the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。量到 σ_res = 1.5 µm、a = b = 0.5，則 σ = 1.5/√1.5 ≈ 1.22 µm。頻寬縮放：逐圈 500 kHz 頻寬下 σ = 1.2 µm，換成 10 Hz 的慢軌道頻寬，σ ≈ 1.2×√(10/5×10⁵) ≈ 5 nm，此時實際極限轉為電子學 1/f 雜訊與漂移，而非熱雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²). A measured σ_res = 1.5 µm with a = b = 0.5 gives σ = 1.5/√1.5 ≈ 1.22 µm. Bandwidth scaling: σ = 1.2 µm at the 500 kHz turn-by-turn bandwidth becomes σ ≈ 1.2×√(10/5×10⁵) ≈ 5 nm at a 10 Hz slow-orbit bandwidth, where the practical limit shifts to electronics 1/f noise and drift rather than thermal noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget", which statement holds?
options: 鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。
三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。
鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。

Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²).
A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-BPM correlation and drift log” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較；同時記錄機房溫度與電纜溫度，對讀數做相關分析取得每 K 的漂移係數，填入預算表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law; log rack and cable temperatures in parallel, correlate them with the readings to extract a drift coefficient per kelvin and enter it in the budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把電子學在輸入端短路時量到的雜訊當作 BPM 解析度寫進規格，上線後因束流抖動與電纜漂移，實際解析度差十倍，軌道回授被迫降低增益。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Quoting the electronics noise measured with a shorted input as the BPM resolution leaves the real resolution ten times worse once beam jitter and cable drift enter, and the orbit feedback has to run at reduced gain.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較；同時記錄機房溫度與電纜溫度，對讀數做相關分析取得每 K 的漂移係數，填入預算表。
knowledge.textEn: With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law; log rack and cable temperatures in parallel, correlate them with the readings to extract a drift coefficient per kelvin and enter it in the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.
With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law.
quiz.explanation: 以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較；同時記錄機房溫度與電纜溫度，對讀數做相關分析取得每 K 的漂移係數，填入預算表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law; log rack and cable temperatures in parallel, correlate them with the readings to extract a drift coefficient per kelvin and enter it in the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three-BPM correlation and drift log” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把電子學在輸入端短路時量到的雜訊當作 BPM 解析度寫進規格，上線後因束流抖動與電纜漂移，實際解析度差十倍，軌道回授被迫降低增益。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Quoting the electronics noise measured with a shorted input as the BPM resolution leaves the real resolution ten times worse once beam jitter and cable drift enter, and the orbit feedback has to run at reduced gain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束流電流變化、填充模式與束流尺寸也會透過電子學非線性混入讀數，都要在預算表中各佔一列。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beam-current changes, fill pattern and beam size also leak into readings through electronics nonlinearity and each takes a line in the budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把電子學在輸入端短路時量到的雜訊當作 BPM 解析度寫進規格，上線後因束流抖動與電纜漂移，實際解析度差十倍，軌道回授被迫降低增益。
knowledge.textEn: Quoting the electronics noise measured with a shorted input as the BPM resolution leaves the real resolution ten times worse once beam jitter and cable drift enter, and the orbit feedback has to run at reduced gain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把電子學在輸入端短路時量到的雜訊當作 BPM 解析度寫進規格，上線後因束流抖動與電纜漂移，實際解析度差十倍，軌道回授被迫降低增益。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: Quoting the electronics noise measured with a shorted input as the BPM resolution leaves the real resolution ten times worse once beam jitter and cable drift enter, and the orbit feedback has to run at reduced gain.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: 把電子學在輸入端短路時量到的雜訊當作 BPM 解析度寫進規格，上線後因束流抖動與電纜漂移，實際解析度差十倍，軌道回授被迫降低增益。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Quoting the electronics noise measured with a shorted input as the BPM resolution leaves the real resolution ten times worse once beam jitter and cable drift enter, and the orbit feedback has to run at reduced gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合」與「試運轉驗證與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration" and "Commissioning validation and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速軌道回授迴路」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast orbit-feedback loop” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。快速資料經低延遲網路送到軌道回授控制器，控制器用反應矩陣的奇異值分解求出校正磁鐵電流，壓制地面振動、冷卻水與電源波動造成的軌道雜訊。整合還包括時序（與迴旋頻率同步的觸發）、束流位置連鎖（保護插件磁鐵與真空腔）以及所有校正常數的集中管理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速軌道回授迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams. The fast stream goes over a low-latency network to the orbit-feedback controller, which inverts the response matrix by singular-value decomposition to set corrector-magnet currents that suppress orbit noise from ground motion, cooling water and power-supply ripple. Integration also covers timing (triggers locked to the revolution frequency), a beam-position interlock protecting insertion devices and the vacuum chamber, and central management of all calibration constants. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast orbit-feedback loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速軌道回授迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fast orbit-feedback loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合
knowledge.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration
knowledge.text: 數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。快速資料經低延遲網路送到軌道回授控制器，控制器用反應矩陣的奇異值分解求出校正磁鐵電流，壓制地面振動、冷卻水與電源波動造成的軌道雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams. The fast stream goes over a low-latency network to the orbit-feedback controller, which inverts the response matrix by singular-value decomposition to set corrector-magnet currents that suppress orbit noise from ground motion, cooling water and power-supply ripple.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration" is correct?
options: 回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。
BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。
optionsEn: Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.

Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams.
A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速軌道回授迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast orbit-feedback loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。回授迴路頻寬 f_bw = 150 Hz 時，對遠低於 f_bw 的擾動抑制比約為 f/f_bw：10 Hz 的地面振動擾動 15 µm 被壓到 15×(10/150) = 1 µm；對 50 Hz 電源漣波僅壓到 1/3；100 Hz 以上幾乎無效，必須從源頭消除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm. With a feedback bandwidth f_bw = 150 Hz the suppression of disturbances well below f_bw is about f/f_bw: a 15 µm ground-motion disturbance at 10 Hz is reduced to 15×(10/150) = 1 µm; 50 Hz mains ripple is only cut to one third; above 100 Hz the loop is nearly ineffective and the source must be removed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix; in closed loop compare orbit power spectral densities with feedback on and off, confirm the suppression curve matches the designed f/f_bw, and check that no noise-amplification peak appears near f_bw.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。回授迴路頻寬 f_bw = 150 Hz 時，對遠低於 f_bw 的擾動抑制比約為 f/f_bw：10 Hz 的地面振動擾動 15 µm 被壓到 15×(10/150) = 1 µm；對 50 Hz 電源漣波僅壓到 1/3；100 Hz 以上幾乎無效，必須從源頭消除。
knowledge.textEn: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm. With a feedback bandwidth f_bw = 150 Hz the suppression of disturbances well below f_bw is about f/f_bw: a 15 µm ground-motion disturbance at 10 Hz is reduced to 15×(10/150) = 1 µm; 50 Hz mains ripple is only cut to one third; above 100 Hz the loop is nearly ineffective and the source must be removed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration", which statement holds?
options: 差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。
optionsEn: Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.
A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm.
quiz.explanation: 光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速軌道回授迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fast orbit-feedback loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix; in closed loop compare orbit power spectral densities with feedback on and off, confirm the suppression curve matches the designed f/f_bw, and check that no noise-amplification peak appears near f_bw. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一個 BPM 的饋通損壞後讀數劇烈跳動，若未被自動剔除，回授會把假訊號當真軌道去修正，全環軌道隨之振盪，插件磁鐵連鎖觸發而掉束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A BPM with a damaged feedthrough produces wildly jumping readings; if it is not automatically excluded, the feedback corrects the false signal as a real orbit, the whole ring oscillates and the insertion-device interlock dumps the beam.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。
knowledge.textEn: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix; in closed loop compare orbit power spectral densities with feedback on and off, confirm the suppression curve matches the designed f/f_bw, and check that no noise-amplification peak appears near f_bw.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration"?
options: 開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
optionsEn: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration.
quiz.explanation: 開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix; in closed loop compare orbit power spectral densities with feedback on and off, confirm the suppression curve matches the designed f/f_bw, and check that no noise-amplification peak appears near f_bw. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速軌道回授迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fast orbit-feedback loop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一個 BPM 的饋通損壞後讀數劇烈跳動，若未被自動剔除，回授會把假訊號當真軌道去修正，全環軌道隨之振盪，插件磁鐵連鎖觸發而掉束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A BPM with a damaged feedthrough produces wildly jumping readings; if it is not automatically excluded, the feedback corrects the false signal as a real orbit, the whole ring oscillates and the insertion-device interlock dumps the beam. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整合還包括時序（與迴旋頻率同步的觸發）、束流位置連鎖（保護插件磁鐵與真空腔）以及所有校正常數的集中管理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Integration also covers timing (triggers locked to the revolution frequency), a beam-position interlock protecting insertion devices and the vacuum chamber, and central management of all calibration constants.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個 BPM 的饋通損壞後讀數劇烈跳動，若未被自動剔除，回授會把假訊號當真軌道去修正，全環軌道隨之振盪，插件磁鐵連鎖觸發而掉束。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
一個 BPM 的饋通損壞後讀數劇烈跳動，若未被自動剔除，回授會把假訊號當真軌道去修正，全環軌道隨之振盪，插件磁鐵連鎖觸發而掉束。
BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A BPM with a damaged feedthrough produces wildly jumping readings.
A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 一個 BPM 的饋通損壞後讀數劇烈跳動，若未被自動剔除，回授會把假訊號當真軌道去修正，全環軌道隨之振盪，插件磁鐵連鎖觸發而掉束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A BPM with a damaged feedthrough produces wildly jumping readings; if it is not automatically excluded, the feedback corrects the false signal as a real orbit, the whole ring oscillates and the insertion-device interlock dumps the beam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試運轉驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning validation and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibration database and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。試運轉時逐一驗證極性（移動軌道確認讀數方向）、增益（與已知磁鐵踢角比較）、時序（逐圈資料對應正確的束團）與連鎖門檻，並把結果寫入驗收報告。之後任何電纜更換或電子學維修都必須觸發對應項目的重新校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients. Commissioning verifies polarity (move the orbit and check the sign), gain (compare with a known corrector kick), timing (turn-by-turn data mapped to the right bunch) and interlock thresholds one by one, and records the results in the acceptance report. Afterwards any cable replacement or electronics repair must trigger re-calibration of the affected items. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration database and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：增益驗證：校正磁鐵踢角 20 µrad，模型預測某 BPM 位移 Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm；量到 160 µm，比值 1.046，表示 k_x 需修正 4.6%，超過 2% 的驗收門檻必須回到導線台重新校正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Gain verification: a 20 µrad corrector kick predicts at some BPM Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm; a measured 160 µm gives a ratio of 1.046, meaning k_x needs a 4.6% correction, beyond the 2% acceptance threshold, so the unit goes back to the wire bench for re-calibration.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Calibration database and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試運轉驗證與工程交接
knowledge.text: 交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。試運轉時逐一驗證極性（移動軌道確認讀數方向）、增益（與已知磁鐵踢角比較）、時序（逐圈資料對應正確的束團）與連鎖門檻，並把結果寫入驗收報告。
knowledge.textEn: The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients. Commissioning verifies polarity (move the orbit and check the sign), gain (compare with a known corrector kick), timing (turn-by-turn data mapped to the right bunch) and interlock thresholds one by one, and records the results in the acceptance report.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning validation and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。
鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。
交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。
optionsEn: A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever.
A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly.

The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients.
quiz.explanation: 交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試運轉驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning validation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibration database and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：增益驗證：校正磁鐵踢角 20 µrad，模型預測某 BPM 位移 Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm；量到 160 µm，比值 1.046，表示 k_x 需修正 4.6%，超過 2% 的驗收門檻必須回到導線台重新校正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gain verification: a 20 µrad corrector kick predicts at some BPM Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm; a measured 160 µm gives a ratio of 1.046, meaning k_x needs a 4.6% correction, beyond the 2% acceptance threshold, so the unit goes back to the wire bench for re-calibration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用全環校正磁鐵逐一踢束流，建立量測反應矩陣並與光學模型矩陣比較，對每個 BPM 擬合增益與極性；把校正常數的版本、量測日期與操作者寫入資料庫，交接時隨機抽取三個 BPM 從原始數據重算常數，確認可重現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Kick the beam with every corrector in turn, build the measured response matrix, compare it with the optics-model matrix and fit gain and polarity for each BPM; store version, date and operator of every constant in the database, and at handoff recompute the constants of three randomly chosen BPMs from raw data to prove reproducibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 增益驗證：校正磁鐵踢角 20 µrad，模型預測某 BPM 位移 Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm；量到 160 µm，比值 1.046，表示 k_x 需修正 4.6%，超過 2% 的驗收門檻必須回到導線台重新校正。
knowledge.textEn: Gain verification: a 20 µrad corrector kick predicts at some BPM Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm; a measured 160 µm gives a ratio of 1.046, meaning k_x needs a 4.6% correction, beyond the 2% acceptance threshold, so the unit goes back to the wire bench for re-calibration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「試運轉驗證與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning validation and engineering handoff", which statement holds?

鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。
BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。

A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy.
A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration.
quiz.explanation: 增益驗證：校正磁鐵踢角 20 µrad，模型預測某 BPM 位移 Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm；量到 160 µm，比值 1.046，表示 k_x 需修正 4.6%，超過 2% 的驗收門檻必須回到導線台重新校正。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Gain verification: a 20 µrad corrector kick predicts at some BPM Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm; a measured 160 µm gives a ratio of 1.046, meaning k_x needs a 4.6% correction, beyond the 2% acceptance threshold, so the unit goes back to the wire bench for re-calibration. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試運轉驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning validation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Calibration database and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用全環校正磁鐵逐一踢束流，建立量測反應矩陣並與光學模型矩陣比較，對每個 BPM 擬合增益與極性；把校正常數的版本、量測日期與操作者寫入資料庫，交接時隨機抽取三個 BPM 從原始數據重算常數，確認可重現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Kick the beam with every corrector in turn, build the measured response matrix, compare it with the optics-model matrix and fit gain and polarity for each BPM; store version, date and operator of every constant in the database, and at handoff recompute the constants of three randomly chosen BPMs from raw data to prove reproducibility. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：校正常數存在個人電腦的試算表裡，維修後更換電子學卻沿用舊常數，該 BPM 的零點偏移了 50 µm，數週內軌道回授一直把束流推離插件磁鐵的最佳位置而無人察覺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Constants kept in a personal spreadsheet survive an electronics swap unchanged, the BPM zero shifts by 50 µm, and for weeks the orbit feedback pushes the beam away from the insertion-device optimum without anyone noticing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用全環校正磁鐵逐一踢束流，建立量測反應矩陣並與光學模型矩陣比較，對每個 BPM 擬合增益與極性；把校正常數的版本、量測日期與操作者寫入資料庫，交接時隨機抽取三個 BPM 從原始數據重算常數，確認可重現。
knowledge.textEn: Kick the beam with every corrector in turn, build the measured response matrix, compare it with the optics-model matrix and fit gain and polarity for each BPM; store version, date and operator of every constant in the database, and at handoff recompute the constants of three randomly chosen BPMs from raw data to prove reproducibility.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試運轉驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning validation and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用全環校正磁鐵逐一踢束流，建立量測反應矩陣並與光學模型矩陣比較，對每個 BPM 擬合增益與極性。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Kick the beam with every corrector in turn, build the measured response matrix, compare it with the optics-model matrix and fit gain and polarity for each BPM.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Si(111) 雙晶單色器 10 keV 練習：λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å，sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977，θ = 11.40°，tanθ = 0.2017。Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad；入射垂直發散 23 µrad FWHM、液氮冷卻後熱斜率 7.7 µrad，合成角寬 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。若晶體改為室溫水冷、熱斜率 350 µrad，角寬變成約 352 µrad，ΔE ≈ 17 eV 且反射率崩潰，XANES 無法進行。固定出口 H = 20 mm 時 D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm；編碼器 0.1 µrad 對應 δE ≈ 5 meV。Cu K 邊若量到 8976 eV 而非 8979 eV，零點修正 Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Si(111) double-crystal exercise at 10 keV: λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å, sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977, θ = 11.40°, tanθ = 0.2017. Darwin width ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad; with 23 µrad FWHM incident vertical divergence and a 7.7 µrad thermal slope after nitrogen cooling, the combined angular width is √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad, ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV. With a room-temperature water-cooled crystal and a 350 µrad thermal slope the width becomes about 352 µrad, ΔE ≈ 17 eV and the reflectivity collapses, making XANES impossible. For a fixed exit H = 20 mm, D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm; a 0.1 µrad encoder step corresponds to δE ≈ 5 meV. If the Cu K edge reads 8976 eV instead of 8979 eV, the zero correction is Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad. Values are teaching assumptions, not any beamline's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍」與「動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range" and "Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 插件磁鐵送來的白光含有從數百 eV 到數十 keV 的連續光譜，單色器的工作是用完美矽單晶的晶格週期當作繞射光柵，只讓滿足布拉格條件 λ = 2d·sinθ 的波長以角度 2θ 反射出去。Si(111) 的面間距 d = 3.1356 Å，Si(311) 與 Si(511) 則用更小的 d 換取更高解析度。雙晶配置讓第二晶體把光束折回與入射平行，改變能量只需同步轉動兩晶體的布拉格角；可用能量範圍由機構能達到的最小與最大角度決定，低能端受限於大角度下晶體幾何與窗口吸收，高能端受限於小角度下的足跡與角解析度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The white beam from an insertion device carries a continuous spectrum from a few hundred eV to tens of keV; the monochromator uses the lattice period of a perfect silicon crystal as a diffraction grating so that only wavelengths satisfying the Bragg condition λ = 2d·sinθ are reflected at 2θ. Si(111) has d = 3.1356 Å, while Si(311) and Si(511) trade smaller d for higher resolution. The double-crystal arrangement lets the second crystal return the beam parallel to the incident one, so changing energy only requires rotating both crystals together; the usable range is set by the smallest and largest Bragg angles the mechanics can reach, limited at low energy by crystal geometry and window absorption at large angles and at high energy by beam footprint and angular resolution at small angles. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV)，sinθ = λ/2d，2d = 6.2712 Å。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV), sinθ = λ/2d with 2d = 6.2712 Å.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Si(111) has d = 3.1356 Å, while Si(311) and Si(511) trade smaller d for higher resolution.

quiz.question: 關於「布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range" is correct?
options: 單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。

完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。
optionsEn: A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.
The white beam from an insertion device carries a continuous spectrum from a few hundred eV to tens of keV.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV)，sinθ = λ/2d，2d = 6.2712 Å。E = 10 keV：λ = 1.2398 Å，sinθ = 0.1977，θ = 11.40°；E = 4 keV：λ = 3.0995 Å，θ = 29.62°；E = 30 keV：λ = 0.4133 Å，θ = 3.78°。因此一台涵蓋 4 到 30 keV 的 Si(111) 單色器，布拉格軸行程約 26°。此結果說明布拉格角隨能量變化的幅度，直接決定測角器行程、角度解析與晶體冷卻座的設計空間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV), sinθ = λ/2d with 2d = 6.2712 Å. E = 10 keV: λ = 1.2398 Å, sinθ = 0.1977, θ = 11.40°; E = 4 keV: λ = 3.0995 Å, θ = 29.62°; E = 30 keV: λ = 0.4133 Å, θ = 3.78°. A Si(111) monochromator covering 4 to 30 keV therefore needs about 26° of Bragg-axis travel. These numbers show how far the Bragg angle swings with energy, which sets goniometer travel, angular resolution and the space available for the cooled crystal mount. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以布拉格軸編碼器讀值與公式算出的能量，對照下游離子腔量到的已知元素吸收邊（例如 Cu K 邊 8979 eV）位置，確認角度到能量的轉換在整個行程內單調且無機械間隙；再比較 Si(111) 與 Si(311) 在同一能量下的角度差是否符合 d 值比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the energy computed from the Bragg-axis encoder with the positions of known absorption edges measured in the downstream ion chamber, such as the Cu K edge at 8979 eV, confirming that the angle-to-energy conversion is monotonic without backlash over the whole travel; then check that the angle difference between Si(111) and Si(311) at one energy matches the ratio of d values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以布拉格軸編碼器讀值與公式算出的能量，對照下游離子腔量到的已知元素吸收邊（例如 Cu K 邊 8979 eV）位置，確認角度到能量的轉換在整個行程內單調且無機械間隙；再比較 Si(111) 與 Si(311) 在同一能量下的角度差是否符合 d 值比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the energy computed from the Bragg-axis encoder with the positions of known absorption edges measured in the downstream ion chamber, such as the Cu K edge at 8979 eV, confirming that the angle-to-energy conversion is monotonic without backlash over the whole travel; then check that the angle difference between Si(111) and Si(311) at one energy matches the ratio of d values. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把編碼器零點直接當作 θ = 0 而不做吸收邊校正，整條能量軸系統性偏移數 eV，XAFS 量測的邊位置與文獻對不上，所有化學態判讀都錯位。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Taking the encoder zero as θ = 0 without an absorption-edge calibration shifts the entire energy axis by several eV, so XAFS edge positions disagree with the literature and every chemical-state assignment is displaced.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把編碼器零點直接當作 θ = 0 而不做吸收邊校正，整條能量軸系統性偏移數 eV，XAFS 量測的邊位置與文獻對不上，所有化學態判讀都錯位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Taking the encoder zero as θ = 0 without an absorption-edge calibration shifts the entire energy axis by several eV, so XAFS edge positions disagree with the literature and every chemical-state assignment is displaced. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雙晶配置讓第二晶體把光束折回與入射平行，改變能量只需同步轉動兩晶體的布拉格角；可用能量範圍由機構能達到的最小與最大角度決定，低能端受限於大角度下晶體幾何與窗口吸收，高能端受限於小角度下的足跡與角解析度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The double-crystal arrangement lets the second crystal return the beam parallel to the incident one, so changing energy only requires rotating both crystals together; the usable range is set by the smallest and largest Bragg angles the mechanics can reach, limited at low energy by crystal geometry and window absorption at large angles and at high energy by beam footprint and angular resolution at small angles.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完美晶體的布拉格反射不是無限窄的 δ 函數：動力學繞射理論顯示在一個有限角度範圍內反射率接近 100%，這個範圍稱為 Darwin 寬度，由結構因子、波長與偏振決定，Si(111) 的相對寬度 ΔE/E 約 1.3×10⁻⁴，幾乎與能量無關。單色器輸出的能量頻寬是 Darwin 寬度與入射光束發散角在角度空間的卷積，再透過微分布拉格式 ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ 轉成能量；低能量大角度時 cotθ 小，解析度較好，高能量小角度時同樣的角度誤差放大成更大的能量誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfect-crystal Bragg reflection is not an infinitely narrow delta function: dynamical diffraction theory shows near-100% reflectivity over a finite angular range, the Darwin width, set by the structure factor, wavelength and polarisation; for Si(111) the relative width ΔE/E is about 1.3×10⁻⁴ and nearly independent of energy. The output bandwidth is the convolution in angle of the Darwin width with the incident beam divergence, converted to energy through the differentiated Bragg law ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ; at low energy and large angle cotθ is small and resolution is good, while at high energy and small angle the same angular error becomes a larger energy error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 10 keV, θ = 11.40° and tanθ = 0.2017: the Si(111) Darwin width is ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad (about 5.5 arcsec).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A perfect crystal reflects one exact wavelength, so resolution is set only by mechanical precision." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The output bandwidth is the convolution in angle of the Darwin width with the incident beam divergence, converted to energy through the differentiated Bragg law ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ; at low energy and large angle cotθ is small and resolution is good, while at high energy and small angle the same angular error becomes a larger energy error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A perfect crystal reflects one exact wavelength, so resolution is set only by mechanical precision. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution" is correct?
options: 完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。
矽晶體夠厚、熱容夠大，幾百瓦的熱負載不會改變反射。
完美晶體的布拉格反射不是無限窄的 δ 函數：動力學繞射理論顯示在一個有限角度範圍內反射率接近 100%，這個範圍稱為 Darwin 寬度，由結構因子、波長與偏振決定，Si(111) 的相對寬度 ΔE/E 約 1.3×10⁻⁴，幾乎與能量無關。
optionsEn: A perfect crystal reflects one exact wavelength, so resolution is set only by mechanical precision.
A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection.

A perfect-crystal Bragg reflection is not an infinitely narrow delta function: dynamical diffraction theory shows near-100% reflectivity over a finite angular range, the Darwin width, set by the structure factor, wavelength and polarisation.
quiz.explanation: 完美晶體的布拉格反射不是無限窄的 δ 函數：動力學繞射理論顯示在一個有限角度範圍內反射率接近 100%，這個範圍稱為 Darwin 寬度，由結構因子、波長與偏振決定，Si(111) 的相對寬度 ΔE/E 約 1.3×10⁻⁴，幾乎與能量無關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 keV、θ = 11.40°、tanθ = 0.2017：Si(111) 的 Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad（約 5.5 角秒）。若聚頻磁鐵垂直發散 FWHM 為 23 µrad，合成角寬 √(26.8² + 23²) ≈ 35.3 µrad，ΔE/E = 35.3×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.75×10⁻⁴，即 ΔE ≈ 1.75 eV；把上游狹縫收到發散 5 µrad，則 ΔE/E ≈ 1.35×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.35 eV，逼近晶體本徵極限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 10 keV, θ = 11.40° and tanθ = 0.2017: the Si(111) Darwin width is ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad (about 5.5 arcsec). With an undulator vertical divergence of 23 µrad FWHM the combined angular width is √(26.8² + 23²) ≈ 35.3 µrad, so ΔE/E = 35.3×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.75×10⁻⁴, i.e. ΔE ≈ 1.75 eV; closing the upstream slit to 5 µrad divergence gives ΔE/E ≈ 1.35×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.35 eV, close to the intrinsic crystal limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定第一晶體，以壓電驅動第二晶體掃描俯仰角並記錄離子腔強度，得到雙晶搖擺曲線；其寬度應接近兩條 Darwin 曲線的自相關寬度加上發散貢獻，若量到的寬度明顯大於計算值（例如 45 µrad 對 35 µrad），就表示晶體受應變或熱變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve; its width should approach the autocorrelation width of two Darwin curves plus the divergence term, and a measured width clearly above the calculation (say 45 µrad against 35 µrad) indicates strained or thermally distorted crystals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A monochromator outputs a single energy with nothing else mixed in.
quiz.explanation: 10 keV、θ = 11.40°、tanθ = 0.2017：Si(111) 的 Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad（約 5.5 角秒）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 10 keV, θ = 11.40° and tanθ = 0.2017: the Si(111) Darwin width is ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad (about 5.5 arcsec). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 固定第一晶體，以壓電驅動第二晶體掃描俯仰角並記錄離子腔強度，得到雙晶搖擺曲線；其寬度應接近兩條 Darwin 曲線的自相關寬度加上發散貢獻，若量到的寬度明顯大於計算值（例如 45 µrad 對 35 µrad），就表示晶體受應變或熱變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve; its width should approach the autocorrelation width of two Darwin curves plus the divergence term, and a measured width clearly above the calculation (say 45 µrad against 35 µrad) indicates strained or thermally distorted crystals. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了提高通量把上游狹縫全開，發散角 60 µrad 使 10 keV 的能量頻寬變成約 3.3 eV，XANES 的精細結構被抹平，使用者得到的不是更好的資料而是更糟的解析度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Opening the upstream slit fully for flux lets a 60 µrad divergence widen the 10 keV bandwidth to about 3.3 eV, washing out XANES fine structure, so the user gets worse resolution rather than better data.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
