knowledge.textEn: With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve; its width should approach the autocorrelation width of two Darwin curves plus the divergence term, and a measured width clearly above the calculation (say 45 µrad against 35 µrad) indicates strained or thermally distorted crystals.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
固定第一晶體，以壓電驅動第二晶體掃描俯仰角並記錄離子腔強度，得到雙晶搖擺曲線。
液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve.
With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift.
quiz.explanation: 固定第一晶體，以壓電驅動第二晶體掃描俯仰角並記錄離子腔強度，得到雙晶搖擺曲線；其寬度應接近兩條 Darwin 曲線的自相關寬度加上發散貢獻，若量到的寬度明顯大於計算值（例如 45 µrad 對 35 µrad），就表示晶體受應變或熱變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve; its width should approach the autocorrelation width of two Darwin curves plus the divergence term, and a measured width clearly above the calculation (say 45 µrad against 35 µrad) indicates strained or thermally distorted crystals. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了提高通量把上游狹縫全開，發散角 60 µrad 使 10 keV 的能量頻寬變成約 3.3 eV，XANES 的精細結構被抹平，使用者得到的不是更好的資料而是更糟的解析度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Opening the upstream slit fully for flux lets a 60 µrad divergence widen the 10 keV bandwidth to about 3.3 eV, washing out XANES fine structure, so the user gets worse resolution rather than better data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單色器輸出的能量頻寬是 Darwin 寬度與入射光束發散角在角度空間的卷積，再透過微分布拉格式 ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ 轉成能量；低能量大角度時 cotθ 小，解析度較好，高能量小角度時同樣的角度誤差放大成更大的能量誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The output bandwidth is the convolution in angle of the Darwin width with the incident beam divergence, converted to energy through the differentiated Bragg law ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ; at low energy and large angle cotθ is small and resolution is good, while at high energy and small angle the same angular error becomes a larger energy error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A perfect crystal reflects one exact wavelength, so resolution is set only by mechanical precision." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻」與「晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling" and "Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 第一晶體承受插件磁鐵白光中數百瓦的吸收功率，功率集中在數平方毫米的足跡內，形成局部溫升與熱凸起；凸起的斜率誤差一旦與 Darwin 寬度同量級，反射率下降、頻寬變寬、出射方向偏移。矽的熱性能指標是熱導率與熱膨脹係數之比 κ/α：室溫下 κ ≈ 148 W/(m·K)、α ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/K；降到 77 K 時 κ 升到約 1300 W/(m·K)，α 變成約 −0.5×10⁻⁶/K（在約 125 K 穿越零點），κ/α 改善四十倍以上。因此第一晶體以液氮直接或間接冷卻，第二晶體可為間接冷卻或銅辮熱連接。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first crystal absorbs hundreds of watts of the insertion-device white beam concentrated in a footprint of a few square millimetres, producing a local temperature rise and a thermal bump; once the bump's slope error is comparable to the Darwin width, reflectivity drops, bandwidth widens and the exit direction shifts. Silicon's thermal figure of merit is the ratio of conductivity to expansion coefficient κ/α: at room temperature κ ≈ 148 W/(m·K) and α ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/K; at 77 K κ rises to about 1300 W/(m·K) while α becomes about −0.5×10⁻⁶/K (crossing zero near 125 K), improving κ/α by more than forty times. The first crystal is therefore cooled directly or indirectly by liquid nitrogen, and the second by indirect cooling or copper braids. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽晶體夠厚、熱容夠大，幾百瓦的熱負載不會改變反射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling" is correct?
options: 第一晶體承受插件磁鐵白光中數百瓦的吸收功率，功率集中在數平方毫米的足跡內，形成局部溫升與熱凸起。

A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection.

quiz.explanation: 第一晶體承受插件磁鐵白光中數百瓦的吸收功率，功率集中在數平方毫米的足跡內，形成局部溫升與熱凸起；凸起的斜率誤差一旦與 Darwin 寬度同量級，反射率下降、頻寬變寬、出射方向偏移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。P = 200 W，2 mm 高的光束在 θ = 11.4° 下足跡 L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm，P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m。室溫：α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W，斜率 ≈ 350 µrad，是 Darwin 寬度 27 µrad 的十三倍，反射幾乎崩潰；77 K：|α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W，斜率 ≈ 7.7 µrad，約 Darwin 寬度的 0.3 倍，可接受（精確值需有限元素分析）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam. P = 200 W; a 2 mm tall beam at θ = 11.4° has footprint L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm, so P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m. Room temperature: α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W, slope ≈ 350 µrad, thirteen times the 27 µrad Darwin width and the reflection collapses; at 77 K: |α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, slope ≈ 7.7 µrad, about 0.3 Darwin widths and acceptable (exact values need finite-element analysis). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power; a width that grows linearly with power together with a shifting peak is the fingerprint of the thermal bump; monitor the crystal thermocouples and nitrogen flow at the same time to confirm the crystal stays near 80 K.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。P = 200 W，2 mm 高的光束在 θ = 11.4° 下足跡 L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm，P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m。室溫：α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W，斜率 ≈ 350 µrad，是 Darwin 寬度 27 µrad 的十三倍，反射幾乎崩潰；77 K：|α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W，斜率 ≈ 7.7 µrad，約 Darwin 寬度的 0.3 倍，可接受（精確值需有限元素分析）。
knowledge.textEn: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam. P = 200 W; a 2 mm tall beam at θ = 11.4° has footprint L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm, so P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m. Room temperature: α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W, slope ≈ 350 µrad, thirteen times the 27 µrad Darwin width and the reflection collapses; at 77 K: |α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, slope ≈ 7.7 µrad, about 0.3 Darwin widths and acceptable (exact values need finite-element analysis).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling", which statement holds?

一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。
液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。
optionsEn: If the energy resolution meets specification, the monochromator is stable.
One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam.
With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift.
quiz.explanation: 一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power; a width that grows linearly with power together with a shifting peak is the fingerprint of the thermal bump; monitor the crystal thermocouples and nitrogen flow at the same time to confirm the crystal stays near 80 K. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：液氮管路中的沸騰或泵浦脈動以 20 到 50 Hz 搖動第一晶體，搖擺曲線看起來很寬，單色光強度以同樣頻率閃爍，使用者資料出現週期性雜訊，誤以為是儲存環不穩。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Boiling or pump pulsation in the nitrogen lines shakes the first crystal at 20 to 50 Hz; the rocking curve looks broad, the monochromatic intensity flickers at the same frequency, and users see periodic noise they blame on the storage ring.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power; a width that grows linearly with power together with a shifting peak is the fingerprint of the thermal bump; monitor the crystal thermocouples and nitrogen flow at the same time to confirm the crystal stays near 80 K.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。
在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.
Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power.
quiz.explanation: 在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power; a width that grows linearly with power together with a shifting peak is the fingerprint of the thermal bump; monitor the crystal thermocouples and nitrogen flow at the same time to confirm the crystal stays near 80 K. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 液氮管路中的沸騰或泵浦脈動以 20 到 50 Hz 搖動第一晶體，搖擺曲線看起來很寬，單色光強度以同樣頻率閃爍，使用者資料出現週期性雜訊，誤以為是儲存環不穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Boiling or pump pulsation in the nitrogen lines shakes the first crystal at 20 to 50 Hz; the rocking curve looks broad, the monochromatic intensity flickers at the same frequency, and users see periodic noise they blame on the storage ring. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此第一晶體以液氮直接或間接冷卻，第二晶體可為間接冷卻或銅辮熱連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The first crystal is therefore cooled directly or indirectly by liquid nitrogen, and the second by indirect cooling or copper braids.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矽晶體夠厚、熱容夠大，幾百瓦的熱負載不會改變反射。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 液氮管路中的沸騰或泵浦脈動以 20 到 50 Hz 搖動第一晶體，搖擺曲線看起來很寬，單色光強度以同樣頻率閃爍，使用者資料出現週期性雜訊，誤以為是儲存環不穩。
knowledge.textEn: Boiling or pump pulsation in the nitrogen lines shakes the first crystal at 20 to 50 Hz; the rocking curve looks broad, the monochromatic intensity flickers at the same frequency, and users see periodic noise they blame on the storage ring.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 液氮管路中的沸騰或泵浦脈動以 20 到 50 Hz 搖動第一晶體，搖擺曲線看起來很寬，單色光強度以同樣頻率閃爍，使用者資料出現週期性雜訊，誤以為是儲存環不穩。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。
optionsEn: Boiling or pump pulsation in the nitrogen lines shakes the first crystal at 20 to 50 Hz.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy.
quiz.explanation: 液氮管路中的沸騰或泵浦脈動以 20 到 50 Hz 搖動第一晶體，搖擺曲線看起來很寬，單色光強度以同樣頻率閃爍，使用者資料出現週期性雜訊，誤以為是儲存環不穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Boiling or pump pulsation in the nitrogen lines shakes the first crystal at 20 to 50 Hz; the rocking curve looks broad, the monochromatic intensity flickers at the same frequency, and users see periodic noise they blame on the storage ring. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 晶體必須以無應變方式夾持，任何夾持力都會彎曲晶格、讓 Darwin 曲線變寬；常見做法是重力或輕壓的運動學支撐、銦箔熱界面與對稱的夾具。兩晶體平行且相隔垂直距離 D 時，出射光束相對入射光束的高度偏移為 H = 2D·cosθ；要在改變能量時維持固定出口高度，D 必須隨 θ 改變，由第二晶體的平移台完成。整個晶體籠裝在布拉格軸上，由真空內步進或伺服馬達驅動，高解析度編碼器讀取角度；第二晶體另有壓電俯仰與滾轉微調。所有機構都在高真空中並承受液氮管路的熱收縮。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crystals must be held strain-free, since any clamping force bends the lattice and widens the Darwin curve; common practice uses gravity or lightly loaded kinematic supports, indium-foil thermal interfaces and symmetric fixtures. With the two crystals parallel and separated by a perpendicular gap D, the exit beam is offset from the incident one by H = 2D·cosθ; keeping a fixed exit height while changing energy requires D to vary with θ, done by the second crystal's translation stage. The crystal cage sits on the Bragg axis driven by in-vacuum stepper or servo motors with a high-resolution encoder, and the second crystal carries piezo pitch and roll fine adjustments. Everything operates in high vacuum while coping with the thermal contraction of the nitrogen lines. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：固定出口高度 H = 20 mm：D = H/(2cosθ)，30 keV（θ = 3.78°）時 D = 10.02 mm，4 keV（θ = 29.62°）時 D = 11.50 mm，平移行程約 1.5 mm；D 誤差 10 µm 使出口高度偏 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fixed exit height H = 20 mm: D = H/(2cosθ), giving D = 10.02 mm at 30 keV (θ = 3.78°) and 11.50 mm at 4 keV (θ = 29.62°), a translation range of about 1.5 mm; a 10 µm error in D shifts the exit height by 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度
knowledge.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution
knowledge.text: 晶體必須以無應變方式夾持，任何夾持力都會彎曲晶格、讓 Darwin 曲線變寬；常見做法是重力或輕壓的運動學支撐、銦箔熱界面與對稱的夾具。兩晶體平行且相隔垂直距離 D 時，出射光束相對入射光束的高度偏移為 H = 2D·cosθ；要在改變能量時維持固定出口高度，D 必須隨 θ 改變，由第二晶體的平移台完成。
knowledge.textEn: Crystals must be held strain-free, since any clamping force bends the lattice and widens the Darwin curve; common practice uses gravity or lightly loaded kinematic supports, indium-foil thermal interfaces and symmetric fixtures. With the two crystals parallel and separated by a perpendicular gap D, the exit beam is offset from the incident one by H = 2D·cosθ; keeping a fixed exit height while changing energy requires D to vary with θ, done by the second crystal's translation stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution" is correct?
options: 只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。
晶體必須以無應變方式夾持，任何夾持力都會彎曲晶格、讓 Darwin 曲線變寬；常見做法是重力或輕壓的運動學支撐、銦箔熱界面與對稱的夾具。
矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。
optionsEn: As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy.
Crystals must be held strain-free, since any clamping force bends the lattice and widens the Darwin curve.
Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample.
quiz.explanation: 晶體必須以無應變方式夾持，任何夾持力都會彎曲晶格、讓 Darwin 曲線變寬；常見做法是重力或輕壓的運動學支撐、銦箔熱界面與對稱的夾具。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crystals must be held strain-free, since any clamping force bends the lattice and widens the Darwin curve; common practice uses gravity or lightly loaded kinematic supports, indium-foil thermal interfaces and symmetric fixtures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：固定出口高度 H = 20 mm：D = H/(2cosθ)，30 keV（θ = 3.78°）時 D = 10.02 mm，4 keV（θ = 29.62°）時 D = 11.50 mm，平移行程約 1.5 mm；D 誤差 10 µm 使出口高度偏 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm。角度解析度轉成能量步長：δE = E·cotθ·δθ，在 10 keV、cotθ = 4.96、編碼器解析度 0.1 µrad 時 δE ≈ 10⁴×4.96×10⁻⁷ ≈ 5 meV，足以支撐 1 eV 等級的頻寬掃描。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fixed exit height H = 20 mm: D = H/(2cosθ), giving D = 10.02 mm at 30 keV (θ = 3.78°) and 11.50 mm at 4 keV (θ = 29.62°), a translation range of about 1.5 mm; a 10 µm error in D shifts the exit height by 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm. Angular resolution maps to an energy step δE = E·cotθ·δθ; at 10 keV with cotθ = 4.96 and a 0.1 µrad encoder resolution, δE ≈ 10⁴×4.96×10⁻⁷ ≈ 5 meV, ample for scanning a 1 eV-class bandwidth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝晶體後在實驗室以雷射自準直儀量夾持前後的反射面傾斜變化，應小於 1 µrad；上線後用下游四象限光束位置偵測器在整個能量範圍掃描，記錄出口高度對能量的曲線，殘差應在 ±10 µm 內；以自準直儀或干涉儀檢查編碼器的線性與回差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After mounting, measure with a laser autocollimator the change in reflecting-surface tilt before and after clamping, which should stay below 1 µrad; once installed, scan the whole energy range while a downstream quadrant beam-position detector records exit height against energy, with residuals within ±10 µm; check encoder linearity and backlash with an autocollimator or interferometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 固定出口高度 H = 20 mm：D = H/(2cosθ)，30 keV（θ = 3.78°）時 D = 10.02 mm，4 keV（θ = 29.62°）時 D = 11.50 mm，平移行程約 1.5 mm；D 誤差 10 µm 使出口高度偏 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm。角度解析度轉成能量步長：δE = E·cotθ·δθ，在 10 keV、cotθ = 4.96、編碼器解析度 0.1 µrad 時 δE ≈ 10⁴×4.96×10⁻⁷ ≈ 5 meV，足以支撐 1 eV 等級的頻寬掃描。
knowledge.textEn: Fixed exit height H = 20 mm: D = H/(2cosθ), giving D = 10.02 mm at 30 keV (θ = 3.78°) and 11.50 mm at 4 keV (θ = 29.62°), a translation range of about 1.5 mm; a 10 µm error in D shifts the exit height by 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm. Angular resolution maps to an energy step δE = E·cotθ·δθ; at 10 keV with cotθ = 4.96 and a 0.1 µrad encoder resolution, δE ≈ 10⁴×4.96×10⁻⁷ ≈ 5 meV, ample for scanning a 1 eV-class bandwidth.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.

steps.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 安裝晶體後在實驗室以雷射自準直儀量夾持前後的反射面傾斜變化，應小於 1 µrad；上線後用下游四象限光束位置偵測器在整個能量範圍掃描，記錄出口高度對能量的曲線，殘差應在 ±10 µm 內；以自準直儀或干涉儀檢查編碼器的線性與回差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After mounting, measure with a laser autocollimator the change in reflecting-surface tilt before and after clamping, which should stay below 1 µrad; once installed, scan the whole energy range while a downstream quadrant beam-position detector records exit height against energy, with residuals within ±10 µm; check encoder linearity and backlash with an autocollimator or interferometer. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：銦箔界面在熱循環後局部脫開，第一晶體一側升溫而另一側維持 80 K，溫度梯度把晶體彎成柱面，搖擺曲線裂成雙峰，通量掉一半且能量標定隨之漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An indium interface that partly delaminates after thermal cycling lets one side of the first crystal warm while the other stays at 80 K; the gradient bends the crystal into a cylinder, the rocking curve splits into two peaks, flux halves and the energy calibration drifts.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝晶體後在實驗室以雷射自準直儀量夾持前後的反射面傾斜變化，應小於 1 µrad；上線後用下游四象限光束位置偵測器在整個能量範圍掃描，記錄出口高度對能量的曲線，殘差應在 ±10 µm 內；以自準直儀或干涉儀檢查編碼器的線性與回差。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: After mounting, measure with a laser autocollimator the change in reflecting-surface tilt before and after clamping, which should stay below 1 µrad; once installed, scan the whole energy range while a downstream quadrant beam-position detector records exit height against energy, with residuals within ±10 µm; check encoder linearity and backlash with an autocollimator or interferometer. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 銦箔界面在熱循環後局部脫開，第一晶體一側升溫而另一側維持 80 K，溫度梯度把晶體彎成柱面，搖擺曲線裂成雙峰，通量掉一半且能量標定隨之漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An indium interface that partly delaminates after thermal cycling lets one side of the first crystal warm while the other stays at 80 K; the gradient bends the crystal into a cylinder, the rocking curve splits into two peaks, flux halves and the energy calibration drifts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所有機構都在高真空中並承受液氮管路的熱收縮。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Everything operates in high vacuum while coping with the thermal contraction of the nitrogen lines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 銦箔界面在熱循環後局部脫開，第一晶體一側升溫而另一側維持 80 K，溫度梯度把晶體彎成柱面，搖擺曲線裂成雙峰，通量掉一半且能量標定隨之漂移。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
銦箔界面在熱循環後局部脫開，第一晶體一側升溫而另一側維持 80 K，溫度梯度把晶體彎成柱面，搖擺曲線裂成雙峰，通量掉一半且能量標定隨之漂移。
矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。

An indium interface that partly delaminates after thermal cycling lets one side of the first crystal warm while the other stays at 80 K.

quiz.explanationEn: An indium interface that partly delaminates after thermal cycling lets one side of the first crystal warm while the other stays at 80 K; the gradient bends the crystal into a cylinder, the rocking curve splits into two peaks, flux halves and the energy calibration drifts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定」與「能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking" and "Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量軸的絕對校正用金屬箔的 K 邊或 L 邊：在單色器後放離子腔 I₀、箔與離子腔 I₁，掃描能量並取 ln(I₀/I₁) 的一階導數極大值為邊位置，與公認值比較，把差異換算成布拉格角偏移修正編碼器零點。多個吸收邊可同時檢查能量軸的線性。日常運轉中第二晶體的平行度用峰值鎖定回授維持：把第二晶體俯仰停在搖擺曲線的斜坡或以抖動法鎖在峰頂，補償熱漂移。還要記錄多束繞射造成的「毛刺」能量位置，避免誤判為樣品訊號。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Absolute energy calibration uses the K or L edges of metal foils: with an ion chamber I₀, the foil and an ion chamber I₁ behind the monochromator, scan energy, take the maximum of the first derivative of ln(I₀/I₁) as the edge position, compare with the accepted value and convert the difference into a Bragg-angle correction of the encoder zero. Several edges together check the linearity of the energy axis. In routine operation the second crystal's parallelism is held by peak-locking feedback, either parking its pitch on the rocking-curve flank or dithering to lock on the peak, compensating thermal drift. The energies of multiple-beam diffraction 'glitches' are also logged so they are not mistaken for sample features. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Cu K 邊公認值 8979 eV，θ = 12.72°、tanθ = 0.2257；若量到 8976 eV（偏 −3 eV），由 ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ 得 |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 角秒，須把編碼器零點修正這個量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The accepted Cu K edge is 8979 eV, with θ = 12.72° and tanθ = 0.2257; a measured 8976 eV (−3 eV) gives, from ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ, |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 arcsec, which must be applied to the encoder zero.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定
knowledge.titleEn: Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking
knowledge.text: 能量軸的絕對校正用金屬箔的 K 邊或 L 邊：在單色器後放離子腔 I₀、箔與離子腔 I₁，掃描能量並取 ln(I₀/I₁) 的一階導數極大值為邊位置，與公認值比較，把差異換算成布拉格角偏移修正編碼器零點。多個吸收邊可同時檢查能量軸的線性。
knowledge.textEn: Absolute energy calibration uses the K or L edges of metal foils: with an ion chamber I₀, the foil and an ion chamber I₁ behind the monochromator, scan energy, take the maximum of the first derivative of ln(I₀/I₁) as the edge position, compare with the accepted value and convert the difference into a Bragg-angle correction of the encoder zero. Several edges together check the linearity of the energy axis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking" is correct?
options: 矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。
只要能量解析度達標，單色器就算穩定。
能量軸的絕對校正用金屬箔的 K 邊或 L 邊：在單色器後放離子腔 I₀、箔與離子腔 I₁，掃描能量並取 ln(I₀/I₁) 的一階導數極大值為邊位置，與公認值比較，把差異換算成布拉格角偏移修正編碼器零點。
optionsEn: Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample.
If the energy resolution meets specification, the monochromator is stable.

Absolute energy calibration uses the K or L edges of metal foils: with an ion chamber I₀, the foil and an ion chamber I₁ behind the monochromator, scan energy, take the maximum of the first derivative of ln(I₀/I₁) as the edge position, compare with the accepted value and convert the difference into a Bragg-angle correction of the encoder zero.

quiz.explanationEn: Absolute energy calibration uses the K or L edges of metal foils: with an ion chamber I₀, the foil and an ion chamber I₁ behind the monochromator, scan energy, take the maximum of the first derivative of ln(I₀/I₁) as the edge position, compare with the accepted value and convert the difference into a Bragg-angle correction of the encoder zero. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Cu K 邊公認值 8979 eV，θ = 12.72°、tanθ = 0.2257；若量到 8976 eV（偏 −3 eV），由 ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ 得 |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 角秒，須把編碼器零點修正這個量。若同時 Fe K 邊（7112 eV）偏 −2.4 eV、Zn K 邊（9659 eV）偏 −3.2 eV，三者換算出的 Δθ 一致，表示是零點誤差而非 d 值或機械非線性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The accepted Cu K edge is 8979 eV, with θ = 12.72° and tanθ = 0.2257; a measured 8976 eV (−3 eV) gives, from ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ, |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 arcsec, which must be applied to the encoder zero. If the Fe K edge (7112 eV) reads −2.4 eV and the Zn K edge (9659 eV) reads −3.2 eV at the same time, the three convert to the same Δθ, indicating a zero offset rather than a d-spacing or mechanical nonlinearity error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次更換晶體或維修後掃描至少三個吸收邊，擬合編碼器零點與可能的尺度因子；把擬合殘差列在校正紀錄中並要求小於 0.2 eV；再以搖擺曲線掃描量出寬度並與單元 2 的計算值比較，作為晶體狀態的健康指標。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Cu K 邊公認值 8979 eV，θ = 12.72°、tanθ = 0.2257；若量到 8976 eV（偏 −3 eV），由 ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ 得 |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 角秒，須把編碼器零點修正這個量。若同時 Fe K 邊（7112 eV）偏 −2.4 eV、Zn K 邊（9659 eV）偏 −3.2 eV，三者換算出的 Δθ 一致，表示是零點誤差而非 d 值或機械非線性。
knowledge.textEn: The accepted Cu K edge is 8979 eV, with θ = 12.72° and tanθ = 0.2257; a measured 8976 eV (−3 eV) gives, from ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ, |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 arcsec, which must be applied to the encoder zero. If the Fe K edge (7112 eV) reads −2.4 eV and the Zn K edge (9659 eV) reads −3.2 eV at the same time, the three convert to the same Δθ, indicating a zero offset rather than a d-spacing or mechanical nonlinearity error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次更換晶體或維修後掃描至少三個吸收邊，擬合編碼器零點與可能的尺度因子；把擬合殘差列在校正紀錄中並要求小於 0.2 eV；再以搖擺曲線掃描量出寬度並與單元 2 的計算值比較，作為晶體狀態的健康指標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After every crystal change or maintenance scan at least three absorption edges and fit the encoder zero plus any scale factor; list the fit residuals in the calibration record and require them below 0.2 eV; then scan the rocking curve, measure its width and compare with the unit-2 calculation as a crystal-health indicator. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：峰值鎖定回授把第二晶體鎖在搖擺曲線斜坡的錯誤側，溫度漂移時回授反向推動，單色光強度在幾分鐘內掉到零，掃描資料出現無法解釋的斷崖。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Peak-locking feedback parked on the wrong flank of the rocking curve drives the second crystal the wrong way under thermal drift, the monochromatic intensity falls to zero within minutes and scans show an unexplained cliff.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 峰值鎖定回授把第二晶體鎖在搖擺曲線斜坡的錯誤側，溫度漂移時回授反向推動，單色光強度在幾分鐘內掉到零，掃描資料出現無法解釋的斷崖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Peak-locking feedback parked on the wrong flank of the rocking curve drives the second crystal the wrong way under thermal drift, the monochromatic intensity falls to zero within minutes and scans show an unexplained cliff. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 峰值鎖定回授把第二晶體鎖在搖擺曲線斜坡的錯誤側，溫度漂移時回授反向推動，單色光強度在幾分鐘內掉到零，掃描資料出現無法解釋的斷崖。

quiz.question: 在「能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單色器的誤差預算分成兩張表：能量解析度表把 Darwin 寬度、入射發散、熱凸起斜率、晶體應變與角度抖動在角度空間以均方根相加後除以 tanθ；穩定度表則追蹤第二晶體相對第一晶體的角度漂移與振動對強度與出射指向的影響。因為出射方向是入射方向加上兩倍的晶體角度誤差，微弧度級的俯仰變化在數十公尺外就是數十微米的光束位移，對聚焦到微米等級的實驗是不可接受的；而在搖擺曲線斜坡上工作時，同樣的角度抖動直接變成強度雜訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The monochromator error budget comes in two tables: the resolution table adds the Darwin width, incident divergence, thermal-bump slope, crystal strain and angular jitter in quadrature in angle space and divides by tanθ; the stability table tracks how angular drift and vibration of the second crystal relative to the first affect intensity and exit pointing. Because the exit direction is the incident direction plus twice the crystal angle error, microradian pitch changes become tens of micrometres of beam motion tens of metres downstream, unacceptable for experiments focused to micrometre spots; and when working on the rocking-curve flank the same angular jitter turns directly into intensity noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：角度預算（10 keV）：Darwin 26.8 µrad、發散 23 µrad、熱斜率 7.7 µrad、應變 5 µrad、抖動 2 µrad，均方根合成 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Angular budget at 10 keV: Darwin 26.8 µrad, divergence 23 µrad, thermal slope 7.7 µrad, strain 5 µrad, jitter 2 µrad, combining in quadrature to √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad, so ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要能量解析度達標，單色器就算穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the energy resolution meets specification, the monochromator is stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：角度預算（10 keV）：Darwin 26.8 µrad、發散 23 µrad、熱斜率 7.7 µrad、應變 5 µrad、抖動 2 µrad，均方根合成 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。指向：第二晶體俯仰 1 µrad 的 rms 振動使出射光束角度變化 2 µrad，在 20 m 外位移 40 µm；若鎖在搖擺曲線半高處、10% 到 90% 的斜坡寬約 10 µrad，1 µrad 抖動約造成 8% 的強度調變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Angular budget at 10 keV: Darwin 26.8 µrad, divergence 23 µrad, thermal slope 7.7 µrad, strain 5 µrad, jitter 2 µrad, combining in quadrature to √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad, so ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV. Pointing: 1 µrad rms pitch vibration of the second crystal changes the exit angle by 2 µrad, a 40 µm displacement 20 m downstream; locked at half-height on a flank whose 10% to 90% width is about 10 µrad, 1 µrad of jitter produces roughly 8% intensity modulation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在下游 20 m 處用高頻寬光束位置偵測器與離子腔同時記錄，計算位置與強度的功率譜密度，找出與液氮泵、真空泵或樓板振動一致的頻率峰；把積分後的 rms 角度抖動填回預算表，與分配值比較。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 角度預算（10 keV）：Darwin 26.8 µrad、發散 23 µrad、熱斜率 7.7 µrad、應變 5 µrad、抖動 2 µrad，均方根合成 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。指向：第二晶體俯仰 1 µrad 的 rms 振動使出射光束角度變化 2 µrad，在 20 m 外位移 40 µm；若鎖在搖擺曲線半高處、10% 到 90% 的斜坡寬約 10 µrad，1 µrad 抖動約造成 8% 的強度調變。
knowledge.textEn: Angular budget at 10 keV: Darwin 26.8 µrad, divergence 23 µrad, thermal slope 7.7 µrad, strain 5 µrad, jitter 2 µrad, combining in quadrature to √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7² + 5² + 2²) ≈ 36.5 µrad, so ΔE/E ≈ 36.5×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.81×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV. Pointing: 1 µrad rms pitch vibration of the second crystal changes the exit angle by 2 µrad, a 40 µm displacement 20 m downstream; locked at half-height on a flank whose 10% to 90% width is about 10 µrad, 1 µrad of jitter produces roughly 8% intensity modulation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在下游 20 m 處用高頻寬光束位置偵測器與離子腔同時記錄，計算位置與強度的功率譜密度，找出與液氮泵、真空泵或樓板振動一致的頻率峰；把積分後的 rms 角度抖動填回預算表，與分配值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record simultaneously a high-bandwidth beam-position detector 20 m downstream and the ion chamber, compute power spectral densities of position and intensity, and identify peaks coinciding with the nitrogen pump, vacuum pumps or floor vibration; integrate to an rms angular jitter and enter it in the budget against the allocation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了「提高穩定度」把回授增益調到最大，迴路在 30 Hz 自激，第二晶體以 5 µrad 振盪，強度雜訊與光束跳動反而比不加回授時更差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Turning the feedback gain to maximum 'for stability' makes the loop oscillate at 30 Hz, the second crystal swings by 5 µrad and intensity noise and beam jitter become worse than without feedback.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角度穩定度頻譜與出射光束指向」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Angular-stability spectrum and exit-beam pointing” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了「提高穩定度」把回授增益調到最大，迴路在 30 Hz 自激，第二晶體以 5 µrad 振盪，強度雜訊與光束跳動反而比不加回授時更差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Turning the feedback gain to maximum 'for stability' makes the loop oscillate at 30 Hz, the second crystal swings by 5 µrad and intensity noise and beam jitter become worse than without feedback. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為出射方向是入射方向加上兩倍的晶體角度誤差，微弧度級的俯仰變化在數十公尺外就是數十微米的光束位移，對聚焦到微米等級的實驗是不可接受的；而在搖擺曲線斜坡上工作時，同樣的角度抖動直接變成強度雜訊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the exit direction is the incident direction plus twice the crystal angle error, microradian pitch changes become tens of micrometres of beam motion tens of metres downstream, unacceptable for experiments focused to micrometre spots; and when working on the rocking-curve flank the same angular jitter turns directly into intensity noise.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要能量解析度達標，單色器就算穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the energy resolution meets specification, the monochromator is stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了「提高穩定度」把回授增益調到最大，迴路在 30 Hz 自激，第二晶體以 5 µrad 振盪，強度雜訊與光束跳動反而比不加回授時更差。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高次諧波抑制與光束線整合」與「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Harmonic rejection and beamline integration" and "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Si(111) 在選定 10 keV 時也同時以 (333) 反射讓 30 keV 通過（(222) 在鑽石結構中為禁制反射），高次諧波會污染吸收光譜與繞射資料。兩種抑制方法互補：一是把第二晶體稍微失諧，因為高次反射的 Darwin 寬度窄得多，失諧幾微弧度就能大幅抑制諧波而只損失部分基頻；二是在單色器後放一對掠角反射鏡，利用全外反射的臨界角與能量成反比的性質，把高於截止能量的光子拒於門外。整合時還要考慮上游白光狹縫定義功率與發散、鈹窗、下游聚焦鏡與實驗站的光束位置偵測器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With Si(111) set to 10 keV the (333) reflection also passes 30 keV ((222) is forbidden in the diamond structure), and higher harmonics contaminate absorption spectra and diffraction data. Two complementary suppression methods exist: detuning the second crystal slightly, since the harmonic Darwin width is far narrower, so a few microradians of detuning strongly suppresses the harmonic while costing only part of the fundamental; and a pair of grazing-incidence mirrors after the monochromator, exploiting the fact that the total-external-reflection critical angle scales inversely with energy, so photons above the cutoff energy are rejected. Integration also covers the upstream white-beam slit that defines power and divergence, beryllium windows, downstream focusing mirrors and the beam-position detectors in the experimental station. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單色器輸出只有一個能量，不會有其他能量混入。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monochromator outputs a single energy with nothing else mixed in." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單色器輸出只有一個能量，不會有其他能量混入。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
