steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。失諧法：Si(333) 的 ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵，在 θ = 11.4° 的角寬只有約 2 µrad，第二晶體失諧 10 µrad 時基頻約保留 70%，諧波降到約 1%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³. Detuning: Si(333) has ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵, an angular width of only about 2 µrad at θ = 11.4°, so detuning the second crystal by 10 µrad keeps about 70% of the fundamental while the harmonic drops to about 1%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄；確認基頻損失與諧波抑制符合預期，並把最佳失諧量寫入自動化程序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out; confirm that fundamental loss and harmonic suppression behave as expected and store the optimum detuning in the automation sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。失諧法：Si(333) 的 ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵，在 θ = 11.4° 的角寬只有約 2 µrad，第二晶體失諧 10 µrad 時基頻約保留 70%，諧波降到約 1%。
knowledge.textEn: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³. Detuning: Si(333) has ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵, an angular width of only about 2 µrad at θ = 11.4°, so detuning the second crystal by 10 µrad keeps about 70% of the fundamental while the harmonic drops to about 1%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高次諧波抑制與光束線整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Harmonic rejection and beamline integration", which statement holds?
options: 完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。
只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。
銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad。
optionsEn: A perfect crystal reflects one exact wavelength, so resolution is set only by mechanical precision.
As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy.
For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad.
quiz.explanation: 銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄；確認基頻損失與諧波抑制符合預期，並把最佳失諧量寫入自動化程序。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out; confirm that fundamental loss and harmonic suppression behave as expected and store the optimum detuning in the automation sequence. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在 4 keV 工作時為了通量把諧波鏡移出光路，Si(333) 讓 12 keV 的三次諧波進入樣品，XAFS 的邊躍升被壓低、EXAFS 振幅錯誤，資料分析得到不存在的配位數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Moving the harmonic mirror out at 4 keV for flux lets Si(333) pass a 12 keV third harmonic into the sample; the XAFS edge jump is suppressed, EXAFS amplitudes are wrong and the analysis yields coordination numbers that do not exist.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄；確認基頻損失與諧波抑制符合預期，並把最佳失諧量寫入自動化程序。
knowledge.textEn: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out; confirm that fundamental loss and harmonic suppression behave as expected and store the optimum detuning in the automation sequence.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高次諧波抑制與光束線整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Harmonic rejection and beamline integration"?
options: 用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。
optionsEn: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample.
quiz.explanation: 用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄；確認基頻損失與諧波抑制符合預期，並把最佳失諧量寫入自動化程序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out; confirm that fundamental loss and harmonic suppression behave as expected and store the optimum detuning in the automation sequence. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在 4 keV 工作時為了通量把諧波鏡移出光路，Si(333) 讓 12 keV 的三次諧波進入樣品，XAFS 的邊躍升被壓低、EXAFS 振幅錯誤，資料分析得到不存在的配位數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Moving the harmonic mirror out at 4 keV for flux lets Si(333) pass a 12 keV third harmonic into the sample; the XAFS edge jump is suppressed, EXAFS amplitudes are wrong and the analysis yields coordination numbers that do not exist. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整合時還要考慮上游白光狹縫定義功率與發散、鈹窗、下游聚焦鏡與實驗站的光束位置偵測器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Integration also covers the upstream white-beam slit that defines power and divergence, beryllium windows, downstream focusing mirrors and the beam-position detectors in the experimental station.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單色器輸出只有一個能量，不會有其他能量混入。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A monochromator outputs a single energy with nothing else mixed in." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在 4 keV 工作時為了通量把諧波鏡移出光路，Si(333) 讓 12 keV 的三次諧波進入樣品，XAFS 的邊躍升被壓低、EXAFS 振幅錯誤，資料分析得到不存在的配位數。
knowledge.textEn: Moving the harmonic mirror out at 4 keV for flux lets Si(333) pass a 12 keV third harmonic into the sample; the XAFS edge jump is suppressed, EXAFS amplitudes are wrong and the analysis yields coordination numbers that do not exist.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高次諧波抑制與光束線整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Harmonic rejection and beamline integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
在 4 keV 工作時為了通量把諧波鏡移出光路，Si(333) 讓 12 keV 的三次諧波進入樣品，XAFS 的邊躍升被壓低、EXAFS 振幅錯誤，資料分析得到不存在的配位數。
液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Moving the harmonic mirror out at 4 keV for flux lets Si(333) pass a 12 keV third harmonic into the sample.
With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift.
quiz.explanation: 在 4 keV 工作時為了通量把諧波鏡移出光路，Si(333) 讓 12 keV 的三次諧波進入樣品，XAFS 的邊躍升被壓低、EXAFS 振幅錯誤，資料分析得到不存在的配位數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving the harmonic mirror out at 4 keV for flux lets Si(333) pass a 12 keV third harmonic into the sample; the XAFS edge jump is suppressed, EXAFS amplitudes are wrong and the analysis yields coordination numbers that do not exist. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 交接時要證明單色器在數天尺度上仍符合規格：能量漂移（以重複掃描吸收邊追蹤）、強度穩定（與儲存環電流正規化後的 I₀ 漂移）、出射位置漂移與液氮系統的溫度紀錄。能量漂移主要來自晶體溫度改變面間距與機構的熱膨脹；液氮冷卻的好處之一是矽在 77 K 的膨脹係數很小，但布拉格軸的鋼製機構仍以約 12×10⁻⁶/K 膨脹，必須靠環境溫控。文件包含能量校正表、搖擺曲線基準、毛刺能量表、最佳失諧量、連鎖門檻（晶體溫度、液氮流量、真空）與維護程序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handoff must show that the monochromator still meets specification over days: energy drift (tracked by repeated edge scans), intensity stability (I₀ drift after normalising to ring current), exit-position drift and the temperature log of the nitrogen system. Energy drift comes mainly from crystal temperature changing the d-spacing and from thermal expansion of the mechanics; one benefit of nitrogen cooling is silicon's tiny expansion coefficient at 77 K, but the steel Bragg-axis mechanics still expand at about 12×10⁻⁶/K and rely on environmental temperature control. The documentation holds the energy-calibration table, rocking-curve baseline, glitch-energy table, optimum detuning, interlock thresholds (crystal temperature, nitrogen flow, vacuum) and maintenance procedures. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 交接時要證明單色器在數天尺度上仍符合規格：能量漂移（以重複掃描吸收邊追蹤）、強度穩定（與儲存環電流正規化後的 I₀ 漂移）、出射位置漂移與液氮系統的溫度紀錄。能量漂移主要來自晶體溫度改變面間距與機構的熱膨脹；液氮冷卻的好處之一是矽在 77 K 的膨脹係數很小，但布拉格軸的鋼製機構仍以約 12×10⁻⁶/K 膨脹，必須靠環境溫控。
knowledge.textEn: Handoff must show that the monochromator still meets specification over days: energy drift (tracked by repeated edge scans), intensity stability (I₀ drift after normalising to ring current), exit-position drift and the temperature log of the nitrogen system. Energy drift comes mainly from crystal temperature changing the d-spacing and from thermal expansion of the mechanics; one benefit of nitrogen cooling is silicon's tiny expansion coefficient at 77 K, but the steel Bragg-axis mechanics still expand at about 12×10⁻⁶/K and rely on environmental temperature control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。
單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。
交接時要證明單色器在數天尺度上仍符合規格：能量漂移（以重複掃描吸收邊追蹤）、強度穩定（與儲存環電流正規化後的 I₀ 漂移）、出射位置漂移與液氮系統的溫度紀錄。
optionsEn: With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift.
A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.

Handoff must show that the monochromator still meets specification over days: energy drift (tracked by repeated edge scans), intensity stability (I₀ drift after normalising to ring current), exit-position drift and the temperature log of the nitrogen system.
quiz.explanation: 交接時要證明單色器在數天尺度上仍符合規格：能量漂移（以重複掃描吸收邊追蹤）、強度穩定（與儲存環電流正規化後的 I₀ 漂移）、出射位置漂移與液氮系統的溫度紀錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Handoff must show that the monochromator still meets specification over days: energy drift (tracked by repeated edge scans), intensity stability (I₀ drift after normalising to ring current), exit-position drift and the temperature log of the nitrogen system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。77 K 下 α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K，ΔT = +2 K 給 ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶，10 keV 時 +10 meV；室溫晶體（α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K）同樣 2 K 則漂移 −52 meV。機構：鋼製 100 mm 臂長溫變 0.1 K 伸長 0.12 µm，相當於約 1.2 µrad 的角度，ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV，是晶體項的六倍，所以機櫃與棚屋溫控到 ±0.1 K 是驗收條件。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT. At 77 K with α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K, ΔT = +2 K gives ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶, i.e. +10 meV at 10 keV; a room-temperature crystal (α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K) drifts −52 meV for the same 2 K. Mechanics: a 100 mm steel arm changing by 0.1 K lengthens by 0.12 µm, roughly 1.2 µrad of angle, so ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV, six times the crystal term, which is why hutch and rack temperature control to ±0.1 K is an acceptance condition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。77 K 下 α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K，ΔT = +2 K 給 ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶，10 keV 時 +10 meV；室溫晶體（α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K）同樣 2 K 則漂移 −52 meV。機構：鋼製 100 mm 臂長溫變 0.1 K 伸長 0.12 µm，相當於約 1.2 µrad 的角度，ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV，是晶體項的六倍，所以機櫃與棚屋溫控到 ±0.1 K 是驗收條件。
knowledge.textEn: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT. At 77 K with α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K, ΔT = +2 K gives ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶, i.e. +10 meV at 10 keV; a room-temperature crystal (α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K) drifts −52 meV for the same 2 K. Mechanics: a 100 mm steel arm changing by 0.1 K lengthens by 0.12 µm, roughly 1.2 µrad of angle, so ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV, six times the crystal term, which is why hutch and rack temperature control to ±0.1 K is an acceptance condition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。
矽晶體夠厚、熱容夠大，幾百瓦的熱負載不會改變反射。
矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。
optionsEn: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT.
A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection.
Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample.
quiz.explanation: 晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。
knowledge.textEn: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度。
只要能量解析度達標，單色器就算穩定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature.
If the energy resolution meets specification, the monochromator is stable.
quiz.explanation: 連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：文件包含能量校正表、搖擺曲線基準、毛刺能量表、最佳失諧量、連鎖門檻（晶體溫度、液氮流量、真空）與維護程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The documentation holds the energy-calibration table, rocking-curve baseline, glitch-energy table, optimum detuning, interlock thresholds (crystal temperature, nitrogen flow, vacuum) and maintenance procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。
knowledge.textEn: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。
空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.
Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV.
quiz.explanation: 空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高亮度 X 光束線
summary: 以 3 GeV 儲存環上的波盪器硬 X 光束線為例，說明光束線為何只能保存而不能增加亮度，並把掠射全反射鏡、前端熱負載、鏡面斜率誤差與量測、光束位置穩定度、Kirkpatrick–Baez 聚焦與通量校正串成一份可驗收的光束線工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using an undulator hard X-ray beamline on a 3 GeV storage ring, the course shows why a beamline can only preserve and never increase brilliance, then links grazing-incidence mirrors, front-end heat load, mirror slope error and its metrology, beam-position stability, Kirkpatrick–Baez focusing and flux calibration into an acceptance-ready beamline engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: KB 奈米聚焦預算練習：E = 15 keV（λ ≈ 0.827 Å），垂直 KB 鏡長 L = 0.12 m、掠射角 θ = 3.5 mrad（低於 Rh 在 15 keV 的臨界角約 4.5 mrad），p = 50 m、q = 0.12 m。孔徑 A = L·θ = 0.42 mm，NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³，繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm；光源垂直 FWHM 12 µm 乘以 M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ 得 28.8 nm；斜率誤差 50 nrad rms 貢獻 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm；鏡面俯仰振動 10 nrad rms 貢獻約 5.7 nm。平方和 √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM。兩面 Rh 鏡各以反射率 0.85 計，傳輸約 72%。若斜率誤差放寬到 0.1 µrad，該項變為 56.5 nm，總光斑約 67 nm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際光束線規格。
workedExample.textEn: KB nanofocus budget exercise: E = 15 keV (λ ≈ 0.827 Å), vertical KB mirror length L = 0.12 m, grazing angle θ = 3.5 mrad (below the Rh critical angle of about 4.5 mrad at 15 keV), p = 50 m and q = 0.12 m. The aperture is A = L·θ = 0.42 mm, NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm; a 12 µm FWHM vertical source times M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ gives 28.8 nm; 50 nrad rms slope error contributes 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm; 10 nrad rms pitch vibration adds about 5.7 nm. The quadrature sum √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM. Taking reflectivity 0.85 for each of the two Rh mirrors, transmission is about 72%. Relaxing slope error to 0.1 µrad makes that term 56.5 nm and the total spot about 67 nm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real beamline specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」與「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" and "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波盪器光源點與相空間」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undulator source point and phase space” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。依 Liouville 定理，被動光學元件只能重新分配相空間而不能壓縮它：鏡子可以把光斑縮小，但發散角必然等比放大，任何像差、散射、振動或不匹配的孔徑都只會損失亮度。因此光束線設計的核心是讓每個元件的接收度與光源相空間匹配，並把亮度損失分配到可量化的項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器光源點與相空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. By Liouville's theorem passive optics can only redistribute phase space, never compress it: a mirror can shrink the spot but the divergence grows in proportion, and every aberration, scatter, vibration or mismatched aperture can only lose brilliance. The core of beamline design is therefore to match each element's acceptance to the source phase space and assign brilliance losses to quantifiable items. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator source point and phase space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å).

knowledge.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度
knowledge.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance
knowledge.text: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。依 Liouville 定理，被動光學元件只能重新分配相空間而不能壓縮它：鏡子可以把光斑縮小，但發散角必然等比放大，任何像差、散射、振動或不匹配的孔徑都只會損失亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. By Liouville's theorem passive optics can only redistribute phase space, never compress it: a mirror can shrink the spot but the divergence grows in proportion, and every aberration, scatter, vibration or mismatched aperture can only lose brilliance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" is correct?
options: 加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。
X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
optionsEn: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space.
X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.
quiz.explanation: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波盪器光源點與相空間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undulator source point and phase space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。若電子束 ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad、ε_y = 16 pm·rad（假設 1% 耦合），各平面同調分率 ε_r/(ε + ε_r) 為 0.49% 與 33%，總同調分率約 0.16%，水平方向是瓶頸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å). For electron emittances ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad and ε_y = 16 pm·rad (1% coupling assumed), the per-plane coherent fraction ε_r/(ε + ε_r) is 0.49% and 33%, giving about 0.16% overall, with the horizontal plane as the bottleneck. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。若電子束 ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad、ε_y = 16 pm·rad（假設 1% 耦合），各平面同調分率 ε_r/(ε + ε_r) 為 0.49% 與 33%，總同調分率約 0.16%，水平方向是瓶頸。

For electron emittances ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad and ε_y = 16 pm·rad (1% coupling assumed), the per-plane coherent fraction ε_r/(ε + ε_r) is 0.49% and 33%, giving about 0.16% overall, with the horizontal plane as the bottleneck.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波盪器光源點與相空間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Undulator source point and phase space” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡子長度或狹縫開口與光源相空間不匹配時，邊緣光被截斷或帶著像差進入聚焦，樣品處通量與同調度同時低於預期，而每個元件單獨檢查都顯示合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波盪器光源點與相空間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Undulator source point and phase space” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡子長度或狹縫開口與光源相空間不匹配時，邊緣光被截斷或帶著像差進入聚焦，樣品處通量與同調度同時低於預期，而每個元件單獨檢查都顯示合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此光束線設計的核心是讓每個元件的接收度與光源相空間匹配，並把亮度損失分配到可量化的項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The core of beamline design is therefore to match each element's acceptance to the source phase space and assign brilliance losses to quantifiable items.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「掠射鏡塗層條帶」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。臨界角 θc = √(2δ)，而 δ 與材料電子密度及波長平方成正比，所以高密度塗層（Rh、Pt）能在較大角度或較高能量下反射，矽則較早截止。光束線利用這個能量截止：選擇塗層條帶與掠射角，讓所需能量完整反射，而單色器同時通過的三倍、五倍高次諧波被濾掉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected. The critical angle is θc = √(2δ), and δ scales with the material's electron density and with wavelength squared, so dense coatings such as Rh or Pt reflect at larger angles or higher energies while silicon cuts off earlier. Beamlines exploit this cut-off: choosing the coating stripe and grazing angle passes the wanted energy fully while rejecting the third and fifth harmonics that the monochromator also transmits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grazing-mirror coating stripes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Grazing-mirror coating stripes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off
knowledge.text: X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。臨界角 θc = √(2δ)，而 δ 與材料電子密度及波長平方成正比，所以高密度塗層（Rh、Pt）能在較大角度或較高能量下反射，矽則較早截止。
knowledge.textEn: At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected. The critical angle is θc = √(2δ), and δ scales with the material's electron density and with wavelength squared, so dense coatings such as Rh or Pt reflect at larger angles or higher energies while silicon cuts off earlier.

knowledge.text: 誤解：X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off" is correct?
options: X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。
optionsEn: X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected.
quiz.explanation: X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。掠射角 3 mrad 時，Si 條帶約在 10.4 keV 截止、Rh 條帶約在 22 keV 截止；要在 8 keV 工作並抑制 24 keV 的三次諧波，應選 Si 條帶或把 Rh 條帶角度提高到約 3.5 mrad 以上。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. At 3 mrad grazing the Si stripe cuts off near 10.4 keV and the Rh stripe near 22 keV; to work at 8 keV while rejecting the 24 keV third harmonic, use the Si stripe or raise a Rh stripe above about 3.5 mrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。掠射角 3 mrad 時，Si 條帶約在 10.4 keV 截止、Rh 條帶約在 22 keV 截止；要在 8 keV 工作並抑制 24 keV 的三次諧波，應選 Si 條帶或把 Rh 條帶角度提高到約 3.5 mrad 以上。
knowledge.textEn: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. At 3 mrad grazing the Si stripe cuts off near 10.4 keV and the Rh stripe near 22 keV; to work at 8 keV while rejecting the 24 keV third harmonic, use the Si stripe or raise a Rh stripe above about 3.5 mrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off", which statement holds?
options: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。
斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh.
The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「掠射鏡塗層條帶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。
knowledge.textEn: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）。
光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections.
Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
quiz.explanation: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光束線利用這個能量截止：選擇塗層條帶與掠射角，讓所需能量完整反射，而單色器同時通過的三倍、五倍高次諧波被濾掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beamlines exploit this cut-off: choosing the coating stripe and grazing angle passes the wanted energy fully while rejecting the third and fifth harmonics that the monochromator also transmits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.

Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis.
quiz.explanation: 把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載」與「斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load" and "Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front-end masks and first mirror” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波盪器送出的總功率是千瓦級，但實驗需要的單色光子功率只有毫瓦到瓦級，所以光束線前段的任務是安全地把多餘功率丟掉。前端區以水冷銅合金固定遮罩與可動狹縫限制角度範圍，濾片與第一面鏡進一步吸收低能與高能部分。第一個承受白光的光學元件會因局部溫度梯度產生熱鼓包，改變斜率與焦距；材料以 α/k（熱膨脹係數除以熱導率）衡量，矽冷卻到約 125 K 時熱膨脹係數趨近零，是高功率密度元件的常見解法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An undulator delivers kilowatts of total power while the experiment needs only milliwatts to watts of monochromatic photons, so the front of the beamline must dump the excess safely. The front end limits the angular range with water-cooled copper-alloy fixed masks and movable slits, and filters and the first mirror absorb further low- and high-energy power. The first optic to see white beam develops a thermal bump from local temperature gradients that alters slope and focal length; materials are ranked by α/k, expansion coefficient over conductivity, and silicon cooled to about 125 K, where its expansion coefficient approaches zero, is the usual answer for high power density. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end masks and first mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total power is P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Front-end masks and first mirror”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.

quiz.explanation: 波盪器送出的總功率是千瓦級，但實驗需要的單色光子功率只有毫瓦到瓦級，所以光束線前段的任務是安全地把多餘功率丟掉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An undulator delivers kilowatts of total power while the experiment needs only milliwatts to watts of monochromatic photons, so the front of the beamline must dump the excess safely. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Front-end masks and first mirror” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]。E = 3 GeV、λu = 22 mm、K = 1.5（B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T）、L = 3 m、I = 0.5 A，P ≈ 4.6 kW；而 12.8 keV（第 7 諧波）處 10¹⁴ ph/s 的光只攜帶約 0.2 W。α/k：室溫矽 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W，Glidcop ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W，室溫矽的熱變形約只有銅合金的四成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total power is P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]. For E = 3 GeV, λu = 22 mm, K = 1.5 (B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T), L = 3 m and I = 0.5 A, P ≈ 4.6 kW, while 10¹⁴ ph/s at 12.8 keV (seventh harmonic) carries only about 0.2 W. α/k is ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W for room-temperature silicon and ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W for Glidcop, so room-temperature silicon distorts only about 40% as much as the copper alloy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化；運轉時比較冷卻水量熱、元件熱電偶讀值與預測值，並在不同間隙與電流下量測焦點位置漂移，驗證熱變形模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute absorbed power on each mask, filter and mirror with a power-density code and feed it into finite-element thermal-structural analysis to obtain the surface slope change; in operation compare water calorimetry and thermocouple readings with prediction, and measure focal-position drift at different gaps and currents to validate the thermal-deformation model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For E = 3 GeV, λu = 22 mm, K = 1.5 (B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T), L = 3 m and I = 0.5 A, P ≈ 4.6 kW, while 10¹⁴ ph/s at 12.8 keV (seventh harmonic) carries only about 0.2 W. α/k is ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W for room-temperature silicon and ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W for Glidcop, so room-temperature silicon distorts only about 40% as much as the copper alloy.

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Front-end masks and first mirror” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化；運轉時比較冷卻水量熱、元件熱電偶讀值與預測值，並在不同間隙與電流下量測焦點位置漂移，驗證熱變形模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute absorbed power on each mask, filter and mirror with a power-density code and feed it into finite-element thermal-structural analysis to obtain the surface slope change; in operation compare water calorimetry and thermocouple readings with prediction, and measure focal-position drift at different gaps and currents to validate the thermal-deformation model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：閉合波盪器間隙或提高儲存電流後，第一面鏡的熱鼓包使焦點沿光軸移動並放大光斑，使用者看到通量隨時間與間隙變化；若遮罩接收角估錯，射線直接照到未冷卻的法蘭，造成真空洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After closing the undulator gap or raising stored current, the thermal bump on the first mirror shifts the focus along the axis and enlarges the spot, so users see flux vary with time and gap; if a mask acceptance angle is wrong, radiation strikes an uncooled flange and causes a vacuum leak.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化。

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Front-end masks and first mirror” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 閉合波盪器間隙或提高儲存電流後，第一面鏡的熱鼓包使焦點沿光軸移動並放大光斑，使用者看到通量隨時間與間隙變化；若遮罩接收角估錯，射線直接照到未冷卻的法蘭，造成真空洩漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After closing the undulator gap or raising stored current, the thermal bump on the first mirror shifts the focus along the axis and enlarges the spot, so users see flux vary with time and gap; if a mask acceptance angle is wrong, radiation strikes an uncooled flange and causes a vacuum leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：第一個承受白光的光學元件會因局部溫度梯度產生熱鼓包，改變斜率與焦距；材料以 α/k（熱膨脹係數除以熱導率）衡量，矽冷卻到約 125 K 時熱膨脹係數趨近零，是高功率密度元件的常見解法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The first optic to see white beam develops a thermal bump from local temperature gradients that alters slope and focal length; materials are ranked by α/k, expansion coefficient over conductivity, and silicon cooled to about 125 K, where its expansion coefficient approaches zero, is the usual answer for high power density.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掠射鏡長達數百毫米，因為掠射角只有毫弧度，光斑在鏡面上被拉長數百倍。鏡面誤差依空間尺度分成兩類：毫米到全長尺度的斜率誤差使反射光偏折兩倍，在焦點處加寬光斑；微米以下的高頻粗糙度則把光散射出鏡面反射方向，降低反射率。現代鏡體以單晶矽製作，經確定性拋光、離子束修形或彈性發射加工把斜率誤差壓到 0.1 µrad 甚至 50 nrad 均方根以下。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grazing mirrors are hundreds of millimetres long because a milliradian grazing angle stretches the footprint hundreds of times. Surface errors fall into two classes by length scale: slope errors from millimetres to full length deflect the reflected ray by twice the error and broaden the focus, while sub-micrometre roughness scatters light out of the specular direction and lowers reflectivity. Modern blanks are single-crystal silicon brought to 0.1 µrad or even below 50 nrad RMS slope error by deterministic polishing, ion-beam figuring or elastic emission machining. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Surface errors fall into two classes by length scale: slope errors from millimetres to full length deflect the reflected ray by twice the error and broaden the focus, while sub-micrometre roughness scatters light out of the specular direction and lowers reflectivity.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。粗糙度造成的反射率損失 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]：σ = 0.3 nm、θ = 3 mrad、λ = 1 Å 時約 1.3%，σ = 1 nm 時升到約 13%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM). Roughness costs reflectivity 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]: about 1.3% for σ = 0.3 nm, θ = 3 mrad and λ = 1 Å, rising to about 13% for σ = 1 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造過程中交替使用斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀量測，依每次量測的殘差規劃下一次修形停留時間；粗糙度以白光干涉與 AFM 在不同取樣長度量測並合成功率譜密度，確認各頻段 σ 都在預算內，再把量到的表面高度圖代入波前傳播模擬預測焦斑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During fabrication alternate slope profilometry and stitching interferometry, planning each figuring dwell map from the previous residual; measure roughness with white-light interferometry and AFM at several sampling lengths, merge them into a power spectral density, confirm each band's σ is in budget, and propagate the measured height map through a wavefront simulation to predict the focus.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM). Roughness costs reflectivity 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]: about 1.3% for σ = 0.3 nm, θ = 3 mrad and λ = 1 Å, rising to about 13% for σ = 1 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 製造過程中交替使用斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀量測，依每次量測的殘差規劃下一次修形停留時間；粗糙度以白光干涉與 AFM 在不同取樣長度量測並合成功率譜密度，確認各頻段 σ 都在預算內，再把量到的表面高度圖代入波前傳播模擬預測焦斑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During fabrication alternate slope profilometry and stitching interferometry, planning each figuring dwell map from the previous residual; measure roughness with white-light interferometry and AFM at several sampling lengths, merge them into a power spectral density, confirm each band's σ is in budget, and propagate the measured height map through a wavefront simulation to predict the focus. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只要求全長 PV 高度而沒有規定斜率誤差與中頻譜段時，鏡面可能高度合格卻帶有數毫米週期的波紋，在焦點兩側產生衛星峰並破壞相干成像的條紋對比。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Specifying only full-length PV height without slope error and mid-frequency bands can yield a mirror that passes height yet carries millimetre-period ripple, creating satellite peaks beside the focus and destroying fringe contrast in coherent imaging.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只要求全長 PV 高度而沒有規定斜率誤差與中頻譜段時，鏡面可能高度合格卻帶有數毫米週期的波紋，在焦點兩側產生衛星峰並破壞相干成像的條紋對比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Specifying only full-length PV height without slope error and mid-frequency bands can yield a mirror that passes height yet carries millimetre-period ripple, creating satellite peaks beside the focus and destroying fringe contrast in coherent imaging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代鏡體以單晶矽製作，經確定性拋光、離子束修形或彈性發射加工把斜率誤差壓到 0.1 µrad 甚至 50 nrad 均方根以下。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern blanks are single-crystal silicon brought to 0.1 µrad or even below 50 nrad RMS slope error by deterministic polishing, ion-beam figuring or elastic emission machining.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
