stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」與「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation" and "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡面斜率誤差小到 50 nrad 時，量測本身成為瓶頸：長程輪廓儀與奈米光學量測機以自準直儀或筆形光束量測斜率並積分成高度，拼接干涉儀則把多個子孔徑拼成全長高度圖。兩種方法的系統誤差來源不同，交叉比對才可信。鏡子裝上彎曲機構或冷卻夾具後形狀還會改變，因此最後要在光束線上以刀口掃描、斑點追蹤或光柵干涉直接量測 X 光波前，把離線數據與線上表現連起來。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When slope errors reach 50 nrad, metrology itself becomes the bottleneck: long trace profilers and nanometre optical component measuring machines measure slope with autocollimators or pencil beams and integrate it into height, while stitching interferometers combine sub-apertures into a full-length height map. The two have different systematic errors and must be cross-checked to be trusted. Mounting on a bender or cooled holder changes the shape again, so the final step measures the X-ray wavefront on the beamline by knife-edge scans, speckle tracking or grating interferometry, linking ex-situ data to in-situ performance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。L = 300 mm、Δs = 0.5 µrad 時 Δh ≈ 18.8 nm。若規格是 0.15 µrad rms，量測不確定度應低於其三分之一，約 50 nrad rms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. With L = 300 mm and Δs = 0.5 µrad, Δh ≈ 18.8 nm. If the specification is 0.15 µrad rms, measurement uncertainty should be below a third of it, about 50 nrad rms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。L = 300 mm、Δs = 0.5 µrad 時 Δh ≈ 18.8 nm。若規格是 0.15 µrad rms，量測不確定度應低於其三分之一，約 50 nrad rms。
knowledge.textEn: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. With L = 300 mm and Δs = 0.5 µrad, Δh ≈ 18.8 nm. If the specification is 0.15 µrad rms, measurement uncertainty should be below a third of it, about 50 nrad rms.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation", which statement holds?
options: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。
光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
optionsEn: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8.
Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
quiz.explanation: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鏡子裝上彎曲機構或冷卻夾具後形狀還會改變，因此最後要在光束線上以刀口掃描、斑點追蹤或光柵干涉直接量測 X 光波前，把離線數據與線上表現連起來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mounting on a bender or cooled holder changes the shape again, so the final step measures the X-ray wavefront on the beamline by knife-edge scans, speckle tracking or grating interferometry, linking ex-situ data to in-situ performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
knowledge.textEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。一般要求光斑位置的穩定度優於光斑尺寸的 10%。光束線用刀片式或鑽石四象限 X 光束位置監測器量測光束位置，再以壓電致動器回授鏡面或單色器角度；振動來源包括地板、冷卻水流、液氮沸騰與真空幫浦，必須用預算表逐項分配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The usual requirement is spot-position stability better than 10% of the spot size. Beamlines measure position with blade-type or diamond quadrant X-ray beam-position monitors and feed back to mirror or monochromator angles with piezo actuators; vibration sources include the floor, cooling-water flow, liquid-nitrogen boiling and vacuum pumps, and each must be allocated in a budget table. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算
knowledge.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget
knowledge.text: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。一般要求光斑位置的穩定度優於光斑尺寸的 10%。
knowledge.textEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The usual requirement is spot-position stability better than 10% of the spot size.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget" is correct?
options: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。距光源 30 m 的上游平面鏡俯仰 50 nrad 使虛光源移動 2δ×30 m = 3 µm，經縮小倍率 M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 後只移動 15 nm；對 100 nm 光斑，KB 的俯仰穩定度需優於約 17 nrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. A 50 nrad pitch on an upstream flat mirror 30 m from the source moves the virtual source by 2δ×30 m = 3 µm, which the demagnification M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 reduces to 15 nm; for a 100 nm spot the KB pitch must be stable to better than about 17 nrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。距光源 30 m 的上游平面鏡俯仰 50 nrad 使虛光源移動 2δ×30 m = 3 µm，經縮小倍率 M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 後只移動 15 nm；對 100 nm 光斑，KB 的俯仰穩定度需優於約 17 nrad。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. A 50 nrad pitch on an upstream flat mirror 30 m from the source moves the virtual source by 2δ×30 m = 3 µm, which the demagnification M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 reduces to 15 nm; for a 100 nm spot the KB pitch must be stable to better than about 17 nrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget", which statement holds?
options: 加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
optionsEn: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
quiz.explanation: KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。
knowledge.textEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。
以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor.
Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles.
quiz.explanation: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光束線用刀片式或鑽石四象限 X 光束位置監測器量測光束位置，再以壓電致動器回授鏡面或單色器角度；振動來源包括地板、冷卻水流、液氮沸騰與真空幫浦，必須用預算表逐項分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beamlines measure position with blade-type or diamond quadrant X-ray beam-position monitors and feed back to mirror or monochromator angles with piezo actuators; vibration sources include the floor, cooling-water flow, liquid-nitrogen boiling and vacuum pumps, and each must be allocated in a budget table.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。
knowledge.textEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」與「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source" and "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。焦斑由三項決定：光源大小乘以縮小倍率 q/p、鏡面孔徑造成的繞射極限、以及斜率誤差與振動。水平發射度大時，常在中段放置次級光源狹縫，把縮小倍率作用在狹縫開口上，以通量換取更小的光斑與更高的同調度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range. The spot is set by three terms: source size times the demagnification q/p, the diffraction limit from the mirror aperture, and slope error plus vibration. When horizontal emittance is large, a secondary-source slit is placed mid-beamline so the demagnification acts on the slit opening, trading flux for a smaller spot and higher coherence. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源
knowledge.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source
knowledge.text: Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。焦斑由三項決定：光源大小乘以縮小倍率 q/p、鏡面孔徑造成的繞射極限、以及斜率誤差與振動。
knowledge.textEn: A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range. The spot is set by three terms: source size times the demagnification q/p, the diffraction limit from the mirror aperture, and slope error plus vibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source" is correct?
options: 只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。
光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
optionsEn: With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range.
Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
quiz.explanation: Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。水平以 20 µm 次級狹縫、距 KB 30 m、q = 0.3 m，幾何像約 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature. Horizontally a 20 µm secondary slit 30 m upstream with q = 0.3 m images to about 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。水平以 20 µm 次級狹縫、距 KB 30 m、q = 0.3 m，幾何像約 0.2 µm。
knowledge.textEn: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature. Horizontally a 20 µm secondary slit 30 m upstream with q = 0.3 m images to about 0.2 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source", which statement holds?
options: X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。
鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm。
optionsEn: X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.
Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor.
With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm.
quiz.explanation: 鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。
knowledge.textEn: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source"?
options: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。
optionsEn: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline.
quiz.explanation: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水平發射度大時，常在中段放置次級光源狹縫，把縮小倍率作用在狹縫開口上，以通量換取更小的光斑與更高的同調度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When horizontal emittance is large, a secondary-source slit is placed mid-beamline so the demagnification acts on the slit opening, trading flux for a smaller spot and higher coherence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。
knowledge.textEn: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。
光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other.
Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
quiz.explanation: 兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。通量通常用已知厚度的矽光二極體量測，光子在矽中每產生一對電子電洞平均需約 3.66 eV，再修正吸收比例；同時要與光源計算值比較，找出傳輸損失落在哪個元件。輻射屏蔽實驗站與聯鎖系統的驗證由輻射安全單位依法規執行，屬於交接文件的必要部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. Flux is usually measured with a silicon photodiode of known thickness, where each electron–hole pair costs about 3.66 eV on average, corrected for the absorbed fraction, and compared with the source calculation to locate where transmission is lost. Verification of the shielded hutch and its interlocks is performed by the radiation-safety group under regulation and is a required part of the handoff record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff
knowledge.text: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。通量通常用已知厚度的矽光二極體量測，光子在矽中每產生一對電子電洞平均需約 3.66 eV，再修正吸收比例；同時要與光源計算值比較，找出傳輸損失落在哪個元件。
knowledge.textEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. Flux is usually measured with a silicon photodiode of known thickness, where each electron–hole pair costs about 3.66 eV on average, corrected for the absorbed fraction, and compared with the source calculation to locate where transmission is lost.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff" is correct?
options: 光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。
optionsEn: Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors.
quiz.explanation: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。光二極體電流 I = 0.5 mA、w = 3.66 eV、E = 12.4 keV、300 µm 矽在此能量的吸收比 η ≈ 0.70 時，N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s；若光源計算在同頻寬給出 3×10¹² ph/s，光束線傳輸約 44%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). With photodiode current I = 0.5 mA, w = 3.66 eV, E = 12.4 keV and an absorbed fraction η ≈ 0.70 for 300 µm silicon at this energy, N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s; if the source calculation predicts 3×10¹² ph/s in the same bandwidth, beamline transmission is about 44%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。光二極體電流 I = 0.5 mA、w = 3.66 eV、E = 12.4 keV、300 µm 矽在此能量的吸收比 η ≈ 0.70 時，N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s；若光源計算在同頻寬給出 3×10¹² ph/s，光束線傳輸約 44%。
knowledge.textEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). With photodiode current I = 0.5 mA, w = 3.66 eV, E = 12.4 keV and an absorbed fraction η ≈ 0.70 for 300 µm silicon at this energy, N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s; if the source calculation predicts 3×10¹² ph/s in the same bandwidth, beamline transmission is about 44%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。
optionsEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η).
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline.
quiz.explanation: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。
knowledge.textEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
quiz.explanation: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輻射屏蔽實驗站與聯鎖系統的驗證由輻射安全單位依法規執行，屬於交接文件的必要部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verification of the shielded hutch and its interlocks is performed by the radiation-safety group under regulation and is a required part of the handoff record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination.
quiz.explanation: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 中子散射儀
summary: 從中子的德布羅意波長與毫電子伏特能量出發，說明反應爐與散裂源如何經緩速器產生熱與冷中子，再把超鏡導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀的單色器與分析器、³He 偵測器效率、釩標準歸一化與背景計數統計整合成一份可驗收的中子散射儀工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from the de Broglie wavelength and millielectronvolt energy of neutrons, the course shows how reactors and spallation sources produce thermal and cold neutrons through moderators, then integrates supermirror guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis monochromators and analysers, ³He detector efficiency, vanadium normalisation and background counting statistics into an acceptance-ready neutron-scattering instrument record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冷中子飛行時間能譜練習：入射波長 λi = 4 Å，vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s，Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV。樣品到偵測器 L2 = 3.0 m，彈性中子飛行時間 t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms。若中子在樣品激發 ħω = 1.0 meV 的激發，Ef ≈ 4.11 meV，λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å，vf ≈ 887 m/s，t2 ≈ 3.382 ms，比彈性晚約 0.349 ms。彈性能量解析度 ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2，取等效時間不確定 Δt = 15 µs，ΔE/E ≈ 0.99%，ΔE ≈ 51 µeV。若源頻率 60 Hz、源到偵測器總路徑 23 m，4 Å 中子總飛行 23.26 ms 已超過 16.67 ms 框架，帶寬斬波器必須把波長範圍限制在約 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å 以內。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cold-neutron time-of-flight exercise: incident wavelength λi = 4 Å gives vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s and Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV. With sample-to-detector distance L2 = 3.0 m the elastic flight time is t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms. If the neutron creates a ħω = 1.0 meV excitation in the sample, Ef ≈ 4.11 meV, λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å, vf ≈ 887 m/s and t2 ≈ 3.382 ms, arriving about 0.349 ms after the elastic line. The elastic energy resolution is ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2; taking an effective timing uncertainty Δt = 15 µs gives ΔE/E ≈ 0.99% and ΔE ≈ 51 µeV. At a 60 Hz source with a 23 m total source-to-detector path, a 4 Å neutron takes 23.26 ms, longer than the 16.67 ms frame, so the bandwidth choppers must restrict the band to about 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中子波長、速度與能量換算」與「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" and "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱中子與冷中子能譜」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。散射長度隨同位素不規則變化，氫與氘的差異讓軟物質可以做對比變換。熱中子的波長約 1 到 2 Å，與原子間距相當，能量約數十 meV，與聲子和磁激發相當，所以同一束中子能同時量結構與動力學，這是中子散射儀存在的物理理由。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. Scattering lengths vary irregularly between isotopes, and the hydrogen–deuterium difference allows contrast variation in soft matter. Thermal neutrons have wavelengths of about 1 to 2 Å, comparable to interatomic spacings, and energies of tens of meV, comparable to phonons and magnetic excitations, so one beam probes structure and dynamics together, which is the physical reason neutron-scattering instruments exist. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算
knowledge.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion
knowledge.text: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。散射長度隨同位素不規則變化，氫與氘的差異讓軟物質可以做對比變換。
knowledge.textEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. Scattering lengths vary irregularly between isotopes, and the hydrogen–deuterium difference allows contrast variation in soft matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子波長、速度與能量換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" is correct?
options: 原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
optionsEn: Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force.
With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
quiz.explanation: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s]，E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]。λ = 1.798 Å 對應 v ≈ 2200 m/s、E ≈ 25.3 meV（室溫熱中子）；λ = 4 Å 的冷中子 v = 989 m/s、E ≈ 5.11 meV；λ = 1 Å 則 E ≈ 81.8 meV。波長加倍，速度減半而能量降為四分之一。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV. Doubling the wavelength halves the speed and quarters the energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱中子與冷中子能譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱中子的波長約 1 到 2 Å，與原子間距相當，能量約數十 meV，與聲子和磁激發相當，所以同一束中子能同時量結構與動力學，這是中子散射儀存在的物理理由。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thermal neutrons have wavelengths of about 1 to 2 Å, comparable to interatomic spacings, and energies of tens of meV, comparable to phonons and magnetic excitations, so one beam probes structure and dynamics together, which is the physical reason neutron-scattering instruments exist.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。

quiz.questionEn: When "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。彈性散射只看 Q，給出結構；非彈性散射同時看 Q 與 ħω，給出聲子或磁子色散。因為 ki、kf 與散射角受運動學三角形約束，給定入射能量時並不是每一組 (Q, ω) 都能到達，儀器設計必須先確認目標激發落在可達區域內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample. Elastic scattering looks at Q only and yields structure; inelastic scattering looks at Q and ħω together and yields phonon or magnon dispersions. Because ki, kf and the scattering angle are tied by the kinematic triangle, not every (Q, ω) pair is reachable for a given incident energy, so instrument design must first confirm that the target excitation lies in the accessible region. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
