steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。λ = 2.359 Å、2θ = 90° 時 Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹，對應晶面間距 d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å；ħω = Ei − Ef。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. For λ = 2.359 Å and 2θ = 90°, Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹, corresponding to a lattice spacing d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å; the energy transfer is ħω = Ei − Ef. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。λ = 2.359 Å、2θ = 90° 時 Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹，對應晶面間距 d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å；ħω = Ei − Ef。
knowledge.textEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. For λ = 2.359 Å and 2θ = 90°, Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹, corresponding to a lattice spacing d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å; the energy transfer is ħω = Ei − Ef.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer", which statement holds?
options: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。
飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。
optionsEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²].
A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.
quiz.explanation: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。
knowledge.textEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
quiz.explanation: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為 ki、kf 與散射角受運動學三角形約束，給定入射能量時並不是每一組 (Q, ω) 都能到達，儀器設計必須先確認目標激發落在可達區域內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because ki, kf and the scattering angle are tied by the kinematic triangle, not every (Q, ω) pair is reachable for a given incident energy, so instrument design must first confirm that the target excitation lies in the accessible region.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
knowledge.textEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.
With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist.
quiz.explanation: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中子源與緩速器」與「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutron sources and moderators" and "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。兩者都必須經過緩速器，讓中子與輕原子核多次彈性碰撞降到熱平衡：室溫輕水或重水產生熱中子，約 20 K 的液態氫冷源把頻譜推向長波長。緩速器的材料、溫度、體積與耦合方式決定了中子頻譜峰值與脈衝寬度，對散裂源而言是通量與時間解析度的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. Both need a moderator, in which repeated elastic collisions with light nuclei bring the neutrons to thermal equilibrium: room-temperature light or heavy water yields thermal neutrons, and a liquid-hydrogen cold source near 20 K shifts the spectrum to long wavelengths. Moderator material, temperature, volume and coupling set the spectral peak and the pulse width, which for a spallation source is a trade between flux and time resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 中子源與緩速器
knowledge.text: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。兩者都必須經過緩速器，讓中子與輕原子核多次彈性碰撞降到熱平衡：室溫輕水或重水產生熱中子，約 20 K 的液態氫冷源把頻譜推向長波長。
knowledge.textEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. Both need a moderator, in which repeated elastic collisions with light nuclei bring the neutrons to thermal equilibrium: room-temperature light or heavy water yields thermal neutrons, and a liquid-hydrogen cold source near 20 K shifts the spectrum to long wavelengths.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子源與緩速器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron sources and moderators" is correct?
options: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
optionsEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.
A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.
quiz.explanation: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。2 MeV 降到 25.3 meV：氫 ξ = 1，n ≈ 18；氘 ξ = 0.725，n ≈ 25；碳 ξ = 0.158，n ≈ 115，所以含氫材料最短距離內完成緩速，但氫的吸收也較大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. From 2 MeV to 25.3 meV: hydrogen with ξ = 1 needs n ≈ 18, deuterium with ξ = 0.725 needs n ≈ 25 and carbon with ξ = 0.158 needs n ≈ 115, so hydrogenous moderators slow neutrons in the shortest distance, though hydrogen also absorbs more. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。2 MeV 降到 25.3 meV：氫 ξ = 1，n ≈ 18；氘 ξ = 0.725，n ≈ 25；碳 ξ = 0.158，n ≈ 115，所以含氫材料最短距離內完成緩速，但氫的吸收也較大。
knowledge.textEn: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. From 2 MeV to 25.3 meV: hydrogen with ξ = 1 needs n ≈ 18, deuterium with ξ = 0.725 needs n ≈ 25 and carbon with ξ = 0.158 needs n ≈ 115, so hydrogenous moderators slow neutrons in the shortest distance, though hydrogen also absorbs more.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子源與緩速器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron sources and moderators", which statement holds?
options: 中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
optionsEn: A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
quiz.explanation: 從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子源與緩速器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron sources and moderators"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator.
quiz.explanation: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩速器的材料、溫度、體積與耦合方式決定了中子頻譜峰值與脈衝寬度，對散裂源而言是通量與時間解析度的取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moderator material, temperature, volume and coupling set the spectral peak and the pulse width, which for a spallation source is a trade between flux and time resolution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中子源與緩速器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Neutron sources and moderators" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
optionsEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.

quiz.explanationEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「超鏡中子導管」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Supermirror neutron guide” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。超鏡在鎳層之上疊加數百到上千層厚度漸變的 Ni/Ti 多層膜，以布拉格反射把臨界角延伸到鎳的 m 倍。導管越長、m 值越高，能傳輸的發散角越大，但每次反射的損耗會隨反彈次數累積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超鏡中子導管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. Supermirrors stack hundreds to thousands of graded Ni/Ti multilayers on top of nickel, using Bragg reflection to extend the critical angle to m times that of nickel. Longer guides and higher m transport more divergence, but per-reflection loss accumulates with the number of bounces. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Supermirror neutron guide”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「超鏡中子導管」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Supermirror neutron guide”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. Supermirrors stack hundreds to thousands of graded Ni/Ti multilayers on top of nickel, using Bragg reflection to extend the critical angle to m times that of nickel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value" is correct?

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超鏡中子導管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supermirror neutron guide” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。m = 3、λ = 4 Å 時 θc ≈ 1.2°。長 50 m、寬 50 mm 的導管，平均角度 0.6° 的中子反彈次數 N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5；每次反射率 0.95 時傳輸 ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58，降到 0.90 則只剩約 0.33。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. For m = 3 and λ = 4 Å, θc ≈ 1.2°. In a 50 m long, 50 mm wide guide a neutron at a mean angle of 0.6° bounces N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5 times; at 0.95 reflectivity per bounce transmission is ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58, dropping to about 0.33 at 0.90. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。m = 3、λ = 4 Å 時 θc ≈ 1.2°。長 50 m、寬 50 mm 的導管，平均角度 0.6° 的中子反彈次數 N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5；每次反射率 0.95 時傳輸 ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58，降到 0.90 則只剩約 0.33。
knowledge.textEn: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. For m = 3 and λ = 4 Å, θc ≈ 1.2°. In a 50 m long, 50 mm wide guide a neutron at a mean angle of 0.6° bounces N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5 times; at 0.95 reflectivity per bounce transmission is ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58, dropping to about 0.33 at 0.90.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value", which statement holds?
options: 三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。
原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。
optionsEn: Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.
Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å].
quiz.explanation: 天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「超鏡中子導管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Supermirror neutron guide” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value"?
options: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
optionsEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
quiz.explanation: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超鏡中子導管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Supermirror neutron guide” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導管越長、m 值越高，能傳輸的發散角越大，但每次反射的損耗會隨反彈次數累積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Longer guides and higher m transport more divergence, but per-reflection loss accumulates with the number of bounces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。
飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument.
A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」與「中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" and "Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Disk choppers and flight path” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。散裂源本身是脈衝，反應爐則需以高速旋轉的盤式或費米斬波器把連續束切成短脈衝。波長解析度由脈衝時間寬度相對於總飛行時間的比例與飛行路徑不確定度決定；而相鄰脈衝的慢中子不能追上下一個脈衝的快中子，否則發生框架重疊，因此還需要帶寬斬波器限制每個脈衝的波長範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. A spallation source is pulsed by nature, while a reactor needs fast-spinning disk or Fermi choppers to cut the continuous beam into short pulses. Wavelength resolution is set by pulse width relative to total flight time and by path-length uncertainty; slow neutrons of one pulse must not overlap fast neutrons of the next, or frame overlap occurs, so bandwidth choppers limit the wavelength band of each pulse. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Disk choppers and flight path”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Disk choppers and flight path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度
knowledge.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution
knowledge.text: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。散裂源本身是脈衝，反應爐則需以高速旋轉的盤式或費米斬波器把連續束切成短脈衝。
knowledge.textEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. A spallation source is pulsed by nature, while a reactor needs fast-spinning disk or Fermi choppers to cut the continuous beam into short pulses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" is correct?
options: 飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。
optionsEn: A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy.
quiz.explanation: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Disk choppers and flight path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。L = 20 m、λ = 4 Å 時 t ≈ 20.2 ms。60 Hz 源每框架 16.67 ms，可用帶寬 Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å。緩速器脈衝寬 100 µs 與路徑不確定 2 cm 時，Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. A 60 Hz source gives 16.67 ms per frame and a usable bandwidth Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å. With a 100 µs moderator pulse and a 2 cm path uncertainty, Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。L = 20 m、λ = 4 Å 時 t ≈ 20.2 ms。60 Hz 源每框架 16.67 ms，可用帶寬 Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å。緩速器脈衝寬 100 µs 與路徑不確定 2 cm 時，Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%。
knowledge.textEn: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. A 60 Hz source gives 16.67 ms per frame and a usable bandwidth Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å. With a 100 µs moderator pulse and a 2 cm path uncertainty, Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution", which statement holds?
options: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Disk choppers and flight path” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。
knowledge.textEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Disk choppers and flight path” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波長解析度由脈衝時間寬度相對於總飛行時間的比例與飛行路徑不確定度決定；而相鄰脈衝的慢中子不能追上下一個脈衝的快中子，否則發生框架重疊，因此還需要帶寬斬波器限制每個脈衝的波長範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wavelength resolution is set by pulse width relative to total flight time and by path-length uncertainty; slow neutrons of one pulse must not overlap fast neutrons of the next, or frame overlap occurs, so bandwidth choppers limit the wavelength band of each pulse.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「³He 正比管與釩標準」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子本身不游離，必須先被核反應轉成帶電粒子：³He(n,p)³H 反應釋放 764 keV，正比管收集質子與氚的游離電荷，伽瑪射線產生的訊號小很多，容易以脈高鑑別排除。³He 吸收截面與波長成正比，長波長效率高；但 ³He 供應短缺促使 ¹⁰B 塗層氣體偵測器與 ⁶Li 閃爍體等替代方案發展。各偵測器管的效率不同，必須以幾乎純非同調散射的釩樣品做歸一化，讓不同角度的強度可以比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「³He 正比管與釩標準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons do not ionise directly and must first be converted into charged particles by a nuclear reaction: ³He(n,p)³H releases 764 keV, a proportional tube collects the ionisation of the proton and triton, and gamma rays give much smaller signals that pulse-height discrimination rejects. The ³He absorption cross-section is proportional to wavelength, so long wavelengths are detected efficiently; the ³He supply shortage has driven alternatives such as ¹⁰B-lined gas detectors and ⁶Li scintillators. Tubes differ in efficiency, so they are normalised against vanadium, an almost purely incoherent scatterer, to make intensities at different angles comparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「³He 正比管與釩標準」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化
knowledge.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation
knowledge.text: 中子本身不游離，必須先被核反應轉成帶電粒子：³He(n,p)³H 反應釋放 764 keV，正比管收集質子與氚的游離電荷，伽瑪射線產生的訊號小很多，容易以脈高鑑別排除。³He 吸收截面與波長成正比，長波長效率高；但 ³He 供應短缺促使 ¹⁰B 塗層氣體偵測器與 ⁶Li 閃爍體等替代方案發展。
knowledge.textEn: Neutrons do not ionise directly and must first be converted into charged particles by a nuclear reaction: ³He(n,p)³H releases 764 keV, a proportional tube collects the ionisation of the proton and triton, and gamma rays give much smaller signals that pulse-height discrimination rejects. The ³He absorption cross-section is proportional to wavelength, so long wavelengths are detected efficiently; the ³He supply shortage has driven alternatives such as ¹⁰B-lined gas detectors and ⁶Li scintillators.

knowledge.text: 誤解：中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation" is correct?
options: 中子本身不游離，必須先被核反應轉成帶電粒子：³He(n,p)³H 反應釋放 764 keV，正比管收集質子與氚的游離電荷，伽瑪射線產生的訊號小很多，容易以脈高鑑別排除。

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「³He 正比管與釩標準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。10 bar、293 K 的 ³He 數密度 n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³，σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b，平均路徑 x ≈ 20 mm 時 η ≈ 93%；λ = 1 Å 時 σ ≈ 2966 b、η ≈ 77%；λ = 4 Å 時 η ≈ 99.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以中子源與伽瑪源分別量測每支管的脈高譜，設定在 764 keV 全能峰與壁效應肩部以下、伽瑪訊號以上的鑑別門檻；量測釩樣品的彈性散射強度並扣除空容器背景，得到每支管的相對效率表，與上次校正比較，變化超過 2% 的管要檢查高壓與氣體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pulse-height spectra for every tube with a neutron source and a gamma source, and set the discriminator below the 764 keV full-energy peak and wall-effect shoulder but above the gamma signal; measure elastic scattering from vanadium, subtract the empty-can background to obtain a relative-efficiency table, compare with the last calibration, and check high voltage and gas for any tube that changed by more than 2%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「³He 正比管與釩標準」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以中子源與伽瑪源分別量測每支管的脈高譜，設定在 764 keV 全能峰與壁效應肩部以下、伽瑪訊號以上的鑑別門檻；量測釩樣品的彈性散射強度並扣除空容器背景，得到每支管的相對效率表，與上次校正比較，變化超過 2% 的管要檢查高壓與氣體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pulse-height spectra for every tube with a neutron source and a gamma source, and set the discriminator below the 764 keV full-energy peak and wall-effect shoulder but above the gamma signal; measure elastic scattering from vanadium, subtract the empty-can background to obtain a relative-efficiency table, compare with the last calibration, and check high voltage and gas for any tube that changed by more than 2%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the discriminator too low gamma background leaks in and buries weak inelastic signals; a leaking tube or drifting high voltage lowers efficiency, and without regular vanadium normalisation the data show angle-dependent false intensity changes that are misread as sample texture.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「³He 正比管與釩標準」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the discriminator too low gamma background leaks in and buries weak inelastic signals; a leaking tube or drifting high voltage lowers efficiency, and without regular vanadium normalisation the data show angle-dependent false intensity changes that are misread as sample texture. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：各偵測器管的效率不同，必須以幾乎純非同調散射的釩樣品做歸一化，讓不同角度的強度可以比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tubes differ in efficiency, so they are normalised against vanadium, an almost purely incoherent scatterer, to make intensities at different angles comparable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」與「背景、計數統計與試車交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution" and "Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 三軸譜儀以三個旋轉軸依序決定入射能量（單色器）、樣品取向與散射角、以及散射能量（分析器），可以在 (Q, ω) 空間中逐點量測任意路徑。熱導熱解石墨 PG(002) 晶體常用作單色器與分析器，並以彎曲晶面聚焦提高通量。固定 Ef = 14.7 meV 的設定可讓 PG 濾片有效抑制 λ/2 高次諧波。儀器解析度是一個四維橢球，其大小與方向由準直器、晶體鑲嵌度與散射幾何決定，量測聲子時必須讓橢球長軸沿色散方向才能得到尖銳的峰。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A triple-axis spectrometer uses three rotation axes in sequence to set the incident energy (monochromator), the sample orientation and scattering angle, and the scattered energy (analyser), measuring point by point along any path in (Q, ω) space. Pyrolytic graphite PG(002) crystals commonly serve as monochromator and analyser, with curved arrays focusing to raise flux. Fixing Ef = 14.7 meV lets a PG filter suppress the λ/2 harmonic effectively. The resolution is a four-dimensional ellipsoid whose size and orientation are set by collimators, crystal mosaic and scattering geometry, and a phonon peak is sharp only when the ellipsoid's long axis lies along the dispersion. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “PG monochromator, analyser and filter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “PG monochromator, analyser and filter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度
knowledge.text: 三軸譜儀以三個旋轉軸依序決定入射能量（單色器）、樣品取向與散射角、以及散射能量（分析器），可以在 (Q, ω) 空間中逐點量測任意路徑。熱導熱解石墨 PG(002) 晶體常用作單色器與分析器，並以彎曲晶面聚焦提高通量。

Pyrolytic graphite PG(002) crystals commonly serve as monochromator and analyser, with curved arrays focusing to raise flux.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。同一角度也會反射 λf/2 的二次諧波，其能量為 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV，必須由 PG 濾片衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°. The same angle also reflects the λf/2 second harmonic, whose energy is 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV, and the PG filter must attenuate it. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

The same angle also reflects the λf/2 second harmonic, whose energy is 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV, and the PG filter must attenuate it.
