Monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) put the charge-collecting layer and front-end circuit in the same wafer; ALICE ITS2's ALPIDE uses a 180 nm CMOS imaging process with pixels of about 29×27 µm² thinned to 50 µm, eliminating bumps and a second silicon layer, at the cost of collecting charge mainly from an epitaxial layer tens of micrometres thick and having lower radiation tolerance and timing performance than hybrids.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS" is correct?
options: 混合式像素把高阻值感測器與 CMOS 讀出晶片分開製造，再以每像素一顆的焊錫或銦凸塊倒裝接合，因此感測器可採 n-in-n 或 n-in-p 的抗輻射設計，讀出晶片可用先進製程。
MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。
漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。
optionsEn: Hybrid pixels fabricate a high-resistivity sensor and a CMOS readout chip separately and flip-chip join them with one solder or indium bump per pixel, so the sensor can use radiation-hard n-in-n or n-in-p designs while the readout chip uses an advanced process.
MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing.
Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.
quiz.explanation: 混合式像素把高阻值感測器與 CMOS 讀出晶片分開製造，再以每像素一顆的焊錫或銦凸塊倒裝接合，因此感測器可採 n-in-n 或 n-in-p 的抗輻射設計，讀出晶片可用先進製程；CMS Phase-1 像素為 100×150 µm²、285 µm 厚，每顆讀出晶片 52×80 像素。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hybrid pixels fabricate a high-resistivity sensor and a CMOS readout chip separately and flip-chip join them with one solder or indium bump per pixel, so the sensor can use radiation-hard n-in-n or n-in-p designs while the readout chip uses an advanced process; CMS Phase-1 pixels are 100×150 µm², 285 µm thick, with 52×80 pixels per readout chip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面積比 (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19；二元解析度 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm 對 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm。物質量（矽 X₀ = 9.37 cm）：285 µm 感測器 ≈ 0.30% X₀，175 µm 讀出晶片 ≈ 0.19% X₀；50 µm MAPS 僅 ≈ 0.053% X₀。MAPS 收集電極電容約 5 fF，1,300 e⁻ 產生 ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV，可用極低功耗的像素內放大器判斷；混合式輸入電容約 150 fF，需要電荷靈敏放大器。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Area ratio (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19; binary resolution 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm versus 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm. Material (silicon X₀ = 9.37 cm): a 285 µm sensor is ≈ 0.30% X₀ and a 175 µm readout chip ≈ 0.19% X₀, whereas a 50 µm MAPS is only ≈ 0.053% X₀. A MAPS collection electrode of about 5 fF turns 1,300 e⁻ into ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV, enough for a very low-power in-pixel amplifier; a hybrid input of about 150 fF needs a charge-sensitive amplifier. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊；MAPS 在測試束量效率與假命中率對門檻的曲線，確認在效率高於 99% 的門檻下，假命中率低於每像素每事件 10⁻⁶。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps; for MAPS, measure efficiency and fake-hit rate versus threshold in a test beam and confirm that at a threshold giving above 99% efficiency the fake-hit rate stays below 10⁻⁶ per pixel per event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面積比 (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19；二元解析度 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm 對 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm。物質量（矽 X₀ = 9.37 cm）：285 µm 感測器 ≈ 0.30% X₀，175 µm 讀出晶片 ≈ 0.19% X₀；50 µm MAPS 僅 ≈ 0.053% X₀。MAPS 收集電極電容約 5 fF，1,300 e⁻ 產生 ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV，可用極低功耗的像素內放大器判斷；混合式輸入電容約 150 fF，需要電荷靈敏放大器。
knowledge.textEn: Area ratio (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19; binary resolution 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm versus 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm. Material (silicon X₀ = 9.37 cm): a 285 µm sensor is ≈ 0.30% X₀ and a 175 µm readout chip ≈ 0.19% X₀, whereas a 50 µm MAPS is only ≈ 0.053% X₀. A MAPS collection electrode of about 5 fF turns 1,300 e⁻ into ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV, enough for a very low-power in-pixel amplifier; a hybrid input of about 150 fF needs a charge-sensitive amplifier.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS", which statement holds?
options: 像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。
optionsEn: Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.
quiz.explanationEn: Area ratio (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19; binary resolution 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm versus 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊；MAPS 在測試束量效率與假命中率對門檻的曲線，確認在效率高於 99% 的門檻下，假命中率低於每像素每事件 10⁻⁶。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps; for MAPS, measure efficiency and fake-hit rate versus threshold in a test beam and confirm that at a threshold giving above 99% efficiency the fake-hit rate stays below 10⁻⁶ per pixel per event. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓；MAPS 若磊晶層太薄或反向偏壓不足，電荷擴散到多個像素後各自低於門檻，效率下降且叢集形狀異常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Bumps crack under thermal cycling because of differential strain between sensor and readout chip, turning the pixel dead while its noise actually falls, so a noise-only health check misses it; in MAPS a thin epitaxial layer or insufficient reverse bias lets charge diffuse over several pixels that each stay below threshold, lowering efficiency and distorting cluster shapes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊；MAPS 在測試束量效率與假命中率對門檻的曲線，確認在效率高於 99% 的門檻下，假命中率低於每像素每事件 10⁻⁶。
knowledge.textEn: For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps; for MAPS, measure efficiency and fake-hit rate versus threshold in a test beam and confirm that at a threshold giving above 99% efficiency the fake-hit rate stays below 10⁻⁶ per pixel per event.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.
For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps.
quiz.explanation: 混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊；MAPS 在測試束量效率與假命中率對門檻的曲線，確認在效率高於 99% 的門檻下，假命中率低於每像素每事件 10⁻⁶。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps; for MAPS, measure efficiency and fake-hit rate versus threshold in a test beam and confirm that at a threshold giving above 99% efficiency the fake-hit rate stays below 10⁻⁶ per pixel per event. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓；MAPS 若磊晶層太薄或反向偏壓不足，電荷擴散到多個像素後各自低於門檻，效率下降且叢集形狀異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Bumps crack under thermal cycling because of differential strain between sensor and readout chip, turning the pixel dead while its noise actually falls, so a noise-only health check misses it; in MAPS a thin epitaxial layer or insufficient reverse bias lets charge diffuse over several pixels that each stay below threshold, lowering efficiency and distorting cluster shapes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單體式主動像素感測器（MAPS）把電荷收集層與前端電路做在同一片晶圓上，例如 ALICE ITS2 的 ALPIDE 以 180 nm CMOS 影像感測製程製作約 29×27 µm² 的像素並薄化到 50 µm，省去凸塊與第二層矽；代價是電荷主要來自數十微米的磊晶層，抗輻射能力與時間解析度不如混合式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) put the charge-collecting layer and front-end circuit in the same wafer; ALICE ITS2's ALPIDE uses a 180 nm CMOS imaging process with pixels of about 29×27 µm² thinned to 50 µm, eliminating bumps and a second silicon layer, at the cost of collecting charge mainly from an epitaxial layer tens of micrometres thick and having lower radiation tolerance and timing performance than hybrids.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓；MAPS 若磊晶層太薄或反向偏壓不足，電荷擴散到多個像素後各自低於門檻，效率下降且叢集形狀異常。
knowledge.textEn: Bumps crack under thermal cycling because of differential strain between sensor and readout chip, turning the pixel dead while its noise actually falls, so a noise-only health check misses it; in MAPS a thin epitaxial layer or insufficient reverse bias lets charge diffuse over several pixels that each stay below threshold, lowering efficiency and distorting cluster shapes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。
optionsEn: Bumps crack under thermal cycling because of differential strain between sensor and readout chip, turning the pixel dead while its noise actually falls, so a noise-only health check misses it.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.
quiz.explanation: 凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓；MAPS 若磊晶層太薄或反向偏壓不足，電荷擴散到多個像素後各自低於門檻，效率下降且叢集形狀異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 強子與高能粒子在矽晶格中造成位移損傷，以 1 MeV 中子等效通量 Φ_eq 計量，產生能隙中間的缺陷能階，帶來三種後果：漏電流依 ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V 線性增加；有效摻雜改變，使 n 型基體發生型別反轉並讓空乏電壓持續上升；以及載子被缺陷捕獲使收集電荷下降。漏電流依 T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) 強烈依賴溫度，約每降 7 K 減半，所以內層像素必須冷到攝氏零下十到二十度；漏電流發熱又會加熱感測器，冷卻不足就會形成熱失控。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hadrons and energetic particles cause displacement damage in the silicon lattice, quantified by the 1 MeV neutron-equivalent fluence Φ_eq, creating mid-gap defect levels with three consequences: leakage current rises linearly as ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V; effective doping changes, inverting n-type bulk and steadily raising the depletion voltage; and carriers are trapped, reducing collected charge. Leakage follows T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) and roughly halves for every 7 K of cooling, so inner pixel layers must run at −10 to −20 °C; because the leakage current itself heats the sensor, insufficient cooling leads to thermal runaway. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway" is correct?

steps.title: 輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。100×150×285 µm³ 像素體積 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³，Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 時 20 °C 漏電流 ≈ 171 nA；換到 −10 °C 乘以 (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053，約 9 nA。66,560 像素的模組約 0.6 mA，400 V 偏壓下發熱 0.24 W。型別反轉後 N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³，285 µm 的空乏電壓升到約 930 V，超過偏壓上限，只能部分空乏運作。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing. A 100×150×285 µm³ pixel has a volume of 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³, so at Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² it leaks about 171 nA at 20 °C; scaling to −10 °C multiplies by (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053, about 9 nA. A 66,560-pixel module then draws about 0.6 mA and dissipates 0.24 W at 400 V. After inversion N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the 285 µm depletion voltage climbs to about 930 V, beyond the bias limit, so the sensor runs partially depleted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：運轉期間定期量 I–V，把電流換算到 20 °C 再除以感測器體積，畫漏電流對累積亮度或模擬通量的直線，斜率應與 α 相符；以偏壓掃描量叢集電荷對偏壓的曲線求有效空乏電壓，決定何時提高偏壓；再比對各模組溫度感測值與漏電流的溫度相依性，找出熱接觸不良的模組。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During operation take periodic I–V scans, normalise the current to 20 °C and divide by sensor volume, and plot leakage against integrated luminosity or simulated fluence, expecting a slope consistent with α; use bias scans of cluster charge versus voltage to find the effective depletion voltage and decide when to raise bias; compare each module's temperature readings with the temperature dependence of its leakage to identify modules with poor thermal contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。100×150×285 µm³ 像素體積 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³，Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 時 20 °C 漏電流 ≈ 171 nA；換到 −10 °C 乘以 (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053，約 9 nA。66,560 像素的模組約 0.6 mA，400 V 偏壓下發熱 0.24 W。型別反轉後 N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³，285 µm 的空乏電壓升到約 930 V，超過偏壓上限，只能部分空乏運作。
knowledge.textEn: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing. A 100×150×285 µm³ pixel has a volume of 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³, so at Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² it leaks about 171 nA at 20 °C; scaling to −10 °C multiplies by (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053, about 9 nA. A 66,560-pixel module then draws about 0.6 mA and dissipates 0.24 W at 400 V. After inversion N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the 285 µm depletion voltage climbs to about 930 V, beyond the bias limit, so the sensor runs partially depleted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway", which statement holds?
options: 感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。
每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。
optionsEn: If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.
Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.
α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing.
quiz.explanation: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 運轉期間定期量 I–V，把電流換算到 20 °C 再除以感測器體積，畫漏電流對累積亮度或模擬通量的直線，斜率應與 α 相符；以偏壓掃描量叢集電荷對偏壓的曲線求有效空乏電壓，決定何時提高偏壓；再比對各模組溫度感測值與漏電流的溫度相依性，找出熱接觸不良的模組。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During operation take periodic I–V scans, normalise the current to 20 °C and divide by sensor volume, and plot leakage against integrated luminosity or simulated fluence, expecting a slope consistent with α; use bias scans of cluster charge versus voltage to find the effective depletion voltage and decide when to raise bias; compare each module's temperature readings with the temperature dependence of its leakage to identify modules with poor thermal contact. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻板與模組間的導熱膠脫層時，局部溫度升高約 7 K 就讓漏電流加倍，發熱再推高溫度，最終電源電流達上限而跳脫，該模組退出運轉；若偏壓未隨空乏電壓上升而調高，收集電荷持續下降，效率先在最內層崩落。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the thermal adhesive between cooling plate and module delaminates, a local rise of about 7 K doubles the leakage, the extra heat raises temperature further, and the supply eventually hits its current limit and trips, removing the module; if bias is not raised as the depletion voltage climbs, collected charge keeps falling and efficiency collapses first in the innermost layer.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 運轉期間定期量 I–V，把電流換算到 20 °C 再除以感測器體積，畫漏電流對累積亮度或模擬通量的直線，斜率應與 α 相符；以偏壓掃描量叢集電荷對偏壓的曲線求有效空乏電壓，決定何時提高偏壓；再比對各模組溫度感測值與漏電流的溫度相依性，找出熱接觸不良的模組。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway"?
options: 運轉期間定期量 I–V，把電流換算到 20 °C 再除以感測器體積，畫漏電流對累積亮度或模擬通量的直線，斜率應與 α 相符。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: During operation take periodic I–V scans, normalise the current to 20 °C and divide by sensor volume, and plot leakage against integrated luminosity or simulated fluence, expecting a slope consistent with α; use bias scans of cluster charge versus voltage to find the effective depletion voltage and decide when to raise bias; compare each module's temperature readings with the temperature dependence of its leakage to identify modules with poor thermal contact. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷卻板與模組間的導熱膠脫層時，局部溫度升高約 7 K 就讓漏電流加倍，發熱再推高溫度，最終電源電流達上限而跳脫，該模組退出運轉；若偏壓未隨空乏電壓上升而調高，收集電荷持續下降，效率先在最內層崩落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the thermal adhesive between cooling plate and module delaminates, a local rise of about 7 K doubles the leakage, the extra heat raises temperature further, and the supply eventually hits its current limit and trips, removing the module; if bias is not raised as the depletion voltage climbs, collected charge keeps falling and efficiency collapses first in the innermost layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：漏電流依 T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) 強烈依賴溫度，約每降 7 K 減半，所以內層像素必須冷到攝氏零下十到二十度；漏電流發熱又會加熱感測器，冷卻不足就會形成熱失控。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Leakage follows T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) and roughly halves for every 7 K of cooling, so inner pixel layers must run at −10 to −20 °C; because the leakage current itself heats the sensor, insufficient cooling leads to thermal runaway.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷卻板與模組間的導熱膠脫層時，局部溫度升高約 7 K 就讓漏電流加倍，發熱再推高溫度，最終電源電流達上限而跳脫，該模組退出運轉；若偏壓未隨空乏電壓上升而調高，收集電荷持續下降，效率先在最內層崩落。
knowledge.textEn: When the thermal adhesive between cooling plate and module delaminates, a local rise of about 7 K doubles the leakage, the extra heat raises temperature further, and the supply eventually hits its current limit and trips, removing the module; if bias is not raised as the depletion voltage climbs, collected charge keeps falling and efficiency collapses first in the innermost layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

When the thermal adhesive between cooling plate and module delaminates, a local rise of about 7 K doubles the leakage, the extra heat raises temperature further, and the supply eventually hits its current limit and trips, removing the module.
Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」與「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" and "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12；當電荷因 Lorentz 偏移、斜入射或擴散分到兩個像素時，用類比電荷資訊（ADC 或 ToT）做重心或 η 修正內插，解析度可比二元讀出好約三倍。良好的電荷分享需要低門檻與低雜訊，否則邊緣像素的小訊號會被切掉，叢集退化成單像素。驗證解析度需要比待測元件更準的參考，也就是由數層薄 MAPS 組成的測試束望遠鏡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. Good sharing requires low threshold and low noise, otherwise the small signal in the edge pixel is cut and the cluster collapses to a single pixel. Verifying resolution needs a reference more precise than the device under test, which is a beam telescope built from several thin MAPS planes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Binary: σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm in rφ and 150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm in z.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. Good sharing requires low threshold and low noise, otherwise the small signal in the edge pixel is cut and the cluster collapses to a single pixel.

quiz.question: 關於「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" is correct?
options: 解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。
像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12。
optionsEn: Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm.
Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12.
quiz.explanation: 若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12；當電荷因 Lorentz 偏移、斜入射或擴散分到兩個像素時，用類比電荷資訊（ADC 或 ToT）做重心或 η 修正內插，解析度可比二元讀出好約三倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：二元：σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm（rφ）、150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm（z）。利用 Lorentz 分享後 rφ 可達約 10 µm。測試束量得殘差寬度 σ_res = 10.5 µm、望遠鏡外插誤差 σ_tel = 3.0 µm，則 σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm；若忽略望遠鏡項，等於把解析度高估約 4%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Binary: σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm in rφ and 150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm in z. With Lorentz sharing, rφ reaches about 10 µm. If the test beam gives a residual width σ_res = 10.5 µm and the telescope extrapolation error is σ_tel = 3.0 µm, then σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm; ignoring the telescope term overstates the error by about 4%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係；分別對叢集大小 1、2、3 以上的事件求殘差，確認多數事件為雙像素叢集，並畫像素內效率圖，檢查角落與凸塊附近的效率損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle; compute residuals separately for cluster sizes 1, 2 and 3 or more, confirm that most events are two-pixel clusters, and map in-pixel efficiency to check for losses at corners and near the bump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 二元：σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm（rφ）、150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm（z）。利用 Lorentz 分享後 rφ 可達約 10 µm。測試束量得殘差寬度 σ_res = 10.5 µm、望遠鏡外插誤差 σ_tel = 3.0 µm，則 σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm；若忽略望遠鏡項，等於把解析度高估約 4%。
knowledge.textEn: Binary: σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm in rφ and 150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm in z. With Lorentz sharing, rφ reaches about 10 µm. If the test beam gives a residual width σ_res = 10.5 µm and the telescope extrapolation error is σ_tel = 3.0 µm, then σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm; ignoring the telescope term overstates the error by about 4%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams", which statement holds?
options: 殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。
只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。
optionsEn: Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.
Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage.
quiz.explanationEn: Binary: σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm in rφ and 150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm in z. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係；分別對叢集大小 1、2、3 以上的事件求殘差，確認多數事件為雙像素叢集，並畫像素內效率圖，檢查角落與凸塊附近的效率損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle; compute residuals separately for cluster sizes 1, 2 and 3 or more, confirm that most events are two-pixel clusters, and map in-pixel efficiency to check for losses at corners and near the bump. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係；分別對叢集大小 1、2、3 以上的事件求殘差，確認多數事件為雙像素叢集，並畫像素內效率圖，檢查角落與凸塊附近的效率損失。
knowledge.textEn: At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle; compute residuals separately for cluster sizes 1, 2 and 3 or more, confirm that most events are two-pixel clusters, and map in-pixel efficiency to check for losses at corners and near the bump.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係。
MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。

At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle.
MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing.
quiz.explanation: 在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係；分別對叢集大小 1、2、3 以上的事件求殘差，確認多數事件為雙像素叢集，並畫像素內效率圖，檢查角落與凸塊附近的效率損失。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle; compute residuals separately for cluster sizes 1, 2 and 3 or more, confirm that most events are two-pixel clusters, and map in-pixel efficiency to check for losses at corners and near the bump. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗證解析度需要比待測元件更準的參考，也就是由數層薄 MAPS 組成的測試束望遠鏡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verifying resolution needs a reference more precise than the device under test, which is a beam telescope built from several thin MAPS planes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。
knowledge.textEn: After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value.
quiz.explanation: 照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「每層物質量與束管」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Per-layer material and beam pipe” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 追蹤器每一層的矽、讀出晶片、冷卻管、碳纖維支撐與電纜都會讓粒子發生多重庫侖散射，散射角寬度依 Highland 公式與 √(x/X₀) 成正比、與動量成反比。低動量粒子的撞擊參數與頂點解析度通常由物質量而非像素解析度決定，所以內層設計的競賽是降低 X/X₀ 並縮小第一層半徑；只有在高動量時才回到幾何項，由命中解析度與層間槓桿臂決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「每層物質量與束管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum. For low-momentum particles the impact-parameter and vertex resolution is usually set by material rather than by pixel resolution, so inner-layer design becomes a contest to cut X/X₀ and shrink the first-layer radius; only at high momentum does the geometric term, set by hit resolution and the lever arm between layers, dominate again. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Per-layer material and beam pipe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「每層物質量與束管」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Per-layer material and beam pipe”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter" is correct?
options: 追蹤器每一層的矽、讀出晶片、冷卻管、碳纖維支撐與電纜都會讓粒子發生多重庫侖散射，散射角寬度依 Highland 公式與 √(x/X₀) 成正比、與動量成反比。
像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。
optionsEn: Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum.
Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.
