quiz.explanationEn: Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每層物質量與束管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Per-layer material and beam pipe” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]。x/X₀ = 1.0%、p = 1 GeV/c：θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad，在 r₁ = 29 mm 的第一層貢獻 ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm。兩層幾何項 σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁)，σ = 10 µm、r₂ = 68 mm 得 19 µm；合計 √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm。若每層降到 0.35% X₀，θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad，合計約 26 µm；在 10 GeV/c 時散射項只剩 3 µm，總和約 19 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]. For x/X₀ = 1.0% and p = 1 GeV/c, θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad, contributing ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm at a first layer of radius r₁ = 29 mm. The two-layer geometric term σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁) with σ = 10 µm and r₂ = 68 mm gives 19 µm, for a total of √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm. Cutting each layer to 0.35% X₀ gives θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad and a total near 26 µm; at 10 GeV/c the scattering term is only 3 µm and the total is about 19 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較；另把撞擊參數解析度對 p_T 的曲線擬合成 a ⊕ b/p_T，a 對應幾何項、b 對應散射項，與設計值比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry; fit the impact-parameter resolution versus p_T as a ⊕ b/p_T, where a is the geometric term and b the scattering term, and compare both with the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]。x/X₀ = 1.0%、p = 1 GeV/c：θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad，在 r₁ = 29 mm 的第一層貢獻 ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm。兩層幾何項 σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁)，σ = 10 µm、r₂ = 68 mm 得 19 µm；合計 √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm。若每層降到 0.35% X₀，θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad，合計約 26 µm；在 10 GeV/c 時散射項只剩 3 µm，總和約 19 µm。
knowledge.textEn: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]. For x/X₀ = 1.0% and p = 1 GeV/c, θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad, contributing ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm at a first layer of radius r₁ = 29 mm. The two-layer geometric term σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁) with σ = 10 µm and r₂ = 68 mm gives 19 µm, for a total of √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm. Cutting each layer to 0.35% X₀ gives θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad and a total near 26 µm; at 10 GeV/c the scattering term is only 3 µm and the total is about 19 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter", which statement holds?
options: 每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。
optionsEn: Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.
MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing.
quiz.explanation: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「每層物質量與束管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Per-layer material and beam pipe” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較；另把撞擊參數解析度對 p_T 的曲線擬合成 a ⊕ b/p_T，a 對應幾何項、b 對應散射項，與設計值比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry; fit the impact-parameter resolution versus p_T as a ⊕ b/p_T, where a is the geometric term and b the scattering term, and compare both with the design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較；另把撞擊參數解析度對 p_T 的曲線擬合成 a ⊕ b/p_T，a 對應幾何項、b 對應散射項，與設計值比對。
knowledge.textEn: Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry; fit the impact-parameter resolution versus p_T as a ⊕ b/p_T, where a is the geometric term and b the scattering term, and compare both with the design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。
以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.

Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry.
quiz.explanation: 以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較；另把撞擊參數解析度對 p_T 的曲線擬合成 a ⊕ b/p_T，a 對應幾何項、b 對應散射項，與設計值比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry; fit the impact-parameter resolution versus p_T as a ⊕ b/p_T, where a is the geometric term and b the scattering term, and compare both with the design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每層物質量與束管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Per-layer material and beam pipe” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低動量粒子的撞擊參數與頂點解析度通常由物質量而非像素解析度決定，所以內層設計的競賽是降低 X/X₀ 並縮小第一層半徑；只有在高動量時才回到幾何項，由命中解析度與層間槓桿臂決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For low-momentum particles the impact-parameter and vertex resolution is usually set by material rather than by pixel resolution, so inner-layer design becomes a contest to cut X/X₀ and shrink the first-layer radius; only at high momentum does the geometric term, set by hit resolution and the lever arm between layers, dominate again.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。
optionsEn: Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.
quiz.explanation: 模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬」與「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth" and "Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-column buffers and data links” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。觸發式讀出必須把每個命中保留到第一級觸發決定到來（CMS 約 4 µs），讀出晶片以雙欄為單位暫存時間戳記與電荷，緩衝滿了新命中就遺失；被觸發的事件再經串列鏈路送出，鏈路頻寬決定可承受的觸發率。因此系統效率損失不只來自感測器，也來自數位架構的死時間與緩衝溢位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. Triggered readout must hold every hit until the first-level trigger decision arrives, about 4 µs at CMS; the readout chip buffers timestamps and charge per double column and loses new hits once the buffer is full, and triggered events then leave over serial links whose bandwidth sets the sustainable trigger rate. System inefficiency therefore comes not only from the sensor but also from dead time and buffer overflow in the digital architecture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Double-column buffers and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Double-column buffers and data links”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬
knowledge.titleEn: Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth
knowledge.text: 內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。觸發式讀出必須把每個命中保留到第一級觸發決定到來（CMS 約 4 µs），讀出晶片以雙欄為單位暫存時間戳記與電荷，緩衝滿了新命中就遺失；被觸發的事件再經串列鏈路送出，鏈路頻寬決定可承受的觸發率。
knowledge.textEn: Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. Triggered readout must hold every hit until the first-level trigger decision arrives, about 4 µs at CMS; the readout chip buffers timestamps and charge per double column and loses new hits once the buffer is full, and triggered events then leave over serial links whose bandwidth sets the sustainable trigger rate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth" is correct?
options: 感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。
內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。
殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。
optionsEn: If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.
Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity.
Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.
quiz.explanation: 內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-column buffers and data links” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。一個 160 像素的雙欄（0.024 cm²）命中率 4.8 MHz，4 µs 延遲內平均暫存 19.2 筆；依 Poisson 分佈，32 格緩衝的溢位機率約 0.26%，24 格則約 11.6%。每顆 0.62 cm² 讀出晶片每次交叉 3.1 個命中，100 kHz 觸發、每命中 24 bit 約 7.5 Mbit/s，尚不含標頭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴. A 160-pixel double column (0.024 cm²) sees 4.8 MHz and holds on average 19.2 hits during a 4 µs latency; by Poisson statistics a 32-slot buffer overflows with probability about 0.26% and a 24-slot buffer about 11.6%. Each 0.62 cm² readout chip sees 3.1 hits per crossing, so a 100 kHz trigger at 24 bits per hit needs about 7.5 Mbit/s before headers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較；運轉時監控觸發後的命中數、鏈路錯誤計數與 FIFO 滿旗標，確認在設計亮度下由緩衝與死時間造成的效率損失低於 1%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model; during operation monitor hits per trigger, link error counters and FIFO-full flags, confirming that buffer and dead-time losses stay below 1% at design luminosity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。一個 160 像素的雙欄（0.024 cm²）命中率 4.8 MHz，4 µs 延遲內平均暫存 19.2 筆；依 Poisson 分佈，32 格緩衝的溢位機率約 0.26%，24 格則約 11.6%。每顆 0.62 cm² 讀出晶片每次交叉 3.1 個命中，100 kHz 觸發、每命中 24 bit 約 7.5 Mbit/s，尚不含標頭。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴. A 160-pixel double column (0.024 cm²) sees 4.8 MHz and holds on average 19.2 hits during a 4 µs latency; by Poisson statistics a 32-slot buffer overflows with probability about 0.26% and a 24-slot buffer about 11.6%. Each 0.62 cm² readout chip sees 3.1 hits per crossing, so a 100 kHz trigger at 24 bits per hit needs about 7.5 Mbit/s before headers.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth", which statement holds?
options: 只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。
漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。
假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。
optionsEn: Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage.
Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.
Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴.
quiz.explanation: 假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Double-column buffers and data links” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較；運轉時監控觸發後的命中數、鏈路錯誤計數與 FIFO 滿旗標，確認在設計亮度下由緩衝與死時間造成的效率損失低於 1%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model; during operation monitor hits per trigger, link error counters and FIFO-full flags, confirming that buffer and dead-time losses stay below 1% at design luminosity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差；這正是高亮度升級時讀出晶片要加大緩衝並改用高速數位鏈路的主要理由之一。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias; this is one of the main reasons high-luminosity upgrades enlarge readout-chip buffers and move to fast digital links.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較；運轉時監控觸發後的命中數、鏈路錯誤計數與 FIFO 滿旗標，確認在設計亮度下由緩衝與死時間造成的效率損失低於 1%。
knowledge.textEn: Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model; during operation monitor hits per trigger, link error counters and FIFO-full flags, confirming that buffer and dead-time losses stay below 1% at design luminosity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth"?
options: 以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。
optionsEn: Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm.
quiz.explanation: 以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較；運轉時監控觸發後的命中數、鏈路錯誤計數與 FIFO 滿旗標，確認在設計亮度下由緩衝與死時間造成的效率損失低於 1%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model; during operation monitor hits per trigger, link error counters and FIFO-full flags, confirming that buffer and dead-time losses stay below 1% at design luminosity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Double-column buffers and data links” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差；這正是高亮度升級時讀出晶片要加大緩衝並改用高速數位鏈路的主要理由之一。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias; this is one of the main reasons high-luminosity upgrades enlarge readout-chip buffers and move to fast digital links. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此系統效率損失不只來自感測器，也來自數位架構的死時間與緩衝溢位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: System inefficiency therefore comes not only from the sensor but also from dead time and buffer overflow in the digital architecture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差；這正是高亮度升級時讀出晶片要加大緩衝並改用高速數位鏈路的主要理由之一。
knowledge.textEn: As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias; this is one of the main reasons high-luminosity upgrades enlarge readout-chip buffers and move to fast digital links.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差。
殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias.
Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.
quiz.explanation: 亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差；這正是高亮度升級時讀出晶片要加大緩衝並改用高速數位鏈路的主要理由之一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias; this is one of the main reasons high-luminosity upgrades enlarge readout-chip buffers and move to fast digital links. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「軌跡殘差與對準參數」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Track residuals and alignment parameters” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。某些整體變形如扭轉、伸縮與弓形，讓所有軌跡仍然擬合良好卻系統性地偏移動量，稱為弱模態，只能靠宇宙射線、束暈軌跡或 Z→μμ 質量約束打破。試運轉交接必須包含幾何版本、Lorentz 角、門檻與遮罩像素表以及對準驗證圖。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. Certain global deformations such as twist, telescope and bowing leave every track well fitted yet bias momentum systematically; these weak modes are broken only with cosmic rays, beam-halo tracks or Z→μμ mass constraints. The commissioning handoff must include the geometry version, Lorentz angle, thresholds and masked-pixel tables, and alignment validation plots. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Track residuals and alignment parameters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Track residuals and alignment parameters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接
knowledge.titleEn: Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff
knowledge.text: 安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。某些整體變形如扭轉、伸縮與弓形，讓所有軌跡仍然擬合良好卻系統性地偏移動量，稱為弱模態，只能靠宇宙射線、束暈軌跡或 Z→μμ 質量約束打破。
knowledge.textEn: After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. Certain global deformations such as twist, telescope and bowing leave every track well fitted yet bias momentum systematically; these weak modes are broken only with cosmic rays, beam-halo tracks or Z→μμ mass constraints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff" is correct?
options: 殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。
每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。
optionsEn: Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.
Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.

After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit.
quiz.explanation: 安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Track residuals and alignment parameters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。CMS 追蹤器約 17,000 個模組 × 6 自由度 ≈ 10⁵ 個參數。弓高 s = L²/(8R)，R = p_T/(0.3B)：p_T = 45 GeV/c、B = 3.8 T 得 R ≈ 39.5 m；L = 1.1 m 時 s ≈ 3.8 mm，10 µm 的系統弓高偏差造成約 0.26% 的動量偏差，且正負電荷方向相反。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor. The CMS tracker's roughly 17,000 modules × 6 degrees of freedom give about 10⁵ parameters. Sagitta s = L²/(8R) with R = p_T/(0.3B): p_T = 45 GeV/c and B = 3.8 T give R ≈ 39.5 m, and L = 1.1 m gives s ≈ 3.8 mm, so a 10 µm systematic sagitta bias shifts momentum by about 0.26%, with opposite sign for opposite charges. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度；把宇宙射線分成上下兩半各自重建並比較軌跡參數差；檢查 Z→μμ 重建質量對方位角、偽快度與電荷的相依性以找出弱模態；交接文件列出幾何版本、偏壓與溫度、門檻與遮罩表及上述驗證圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution; split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, reconstruct each, and compare track-parameter differences; check the dependence of the reconstructed Z→μμ mass on azimuth, pseudorapidity and charge to expose weak modes; the handoff document lists geometry version, bias and temperature, thresholds and mask tables, and these validation plots.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。CMS 追蹤器約 17,000 個模組 × 6 自由度 ≈ 10⁵ 個參數。弓高 s = L²/(8R)，R = p_T/(0.3B)：p_T = 45 GeV/c、B = 3.8 T 得 R ≈ 39.5 m；L = 1.1 m 時 s ≈ 3.8 mm，10 µm 的系統弓高偏差造成約 0.26% 的動量偏差，且正負電荷方向相反。
knowledge.textEn: Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor. The CMS tracker's roughly 17,000 modules × 6 degrees of freedom give about 10⁵ parameters. Sagitta s = L²/(8R) with R = p_T/(0.3B): p_T = 45 GeV/c and B = 3.8 T give R ≈ 39.5 m, and L = 1.1 m gives s ≈ 3.8 mm, so a 10 µm systematic sagitta bias shifts momentum by about 0.26%, with opposite sign for opposite charges.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff", which statement holds?
options: 每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。
MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。
解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。
optionsEn: Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor.
MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing.
Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm.
quiz.explanation: 每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「軌跡殘差與對準參數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Track residuals and alignment parameters” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度；把宇宙射線分成上下兩半各自重建並比較軌跡參數差；檢查 Z→μμ 重建質量對方位角、偽快度與電荷的相依性以找出弱模態；交接文件列出幾何版本、偏壓與溫度、門檻與遮罩表及上述驗證圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution; split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, reconstruct each, and compare track-parameter differences; check the dependence of the reconstructed Z→μμ mass on azimuth, pseudorapidity and charge to expose weak modes; the handoff document lists geometry version, bias and temperature, thresholds and mask tables, and these validation plots. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只用對撞軌跡對準時殘差看起來完美，卻殘留扭轉弱模態，使正負電荷的動量出現相反偏差，μ⁺ 與 μ⁻ 的質量峰錯開；熱循環或磁場開關後若未重做對準，模組數微米的位移也會讓撞擊參數解析度悄悄變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Aligning with collision tracks alone can give perfect-looking residuals while leaving a twist weak mode that biases positive and negative momenta in opposite directions and separates the μ⁺ and μ⁻ mass peaks; if alignment is not redone after thermal cycles or magnet ramps, module shifts of a few micrometres silently degrade impact-parameter resolution.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度；把宇宙射線分成上下兩半各自重建並比較軌跡參數差；檢查 Z→μμ 重建質量對方位角、偽快度與電荷的相依性以找出弱模態；交接文件列出幾何版本、偏壓與溫度、門檻與遮罩表及上述驗證圖。
knowledge.textEn: Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution; split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, reconstruct each, and compare track-parameter differences; check the dependence of the reconstructed Z→μμ mass on azimuth, pseudorapidity and charge to expose weak modes; the handoff document lists geometry version, bias and temperature, thresholds and mask tables, and these validation plots.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度。
像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution.
Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
quiz.explanation: 畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度；把宇宙射線分成上下兩半各自重建並比較軌跡參數差；檢查 Z→μμ 重建質量對方位角、偽快度與電荷的相依性以找出弱模態；交接文件列出幾何版本、偏壓與溫度、門檻與遮罩表及上述驗證圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution; split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, reconstruct each, and compare track-parameter differences; check the dependence of the reconstructed Z→μμ mass on azimuth, pseudorapidity and charge to expose weak modes; the handoff document lists geometry version, bias and temperature, thresholds and mask tables, and these validation plots. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Track residuals and alignment parameters” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只用對撞軌跡對準時殘差看起來完美，卻殘留扭轉弱模態，使正負電荷的動量出現相反偏差，μ⁺ 與 μ⁻ 的質量峰錯開；熱循環或磁場開關後若未重做對準，模組數微米的位移也會讓撞擊參數解析度悄悄變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning with collision tracks alone can give perfect-looking residuals while leaving a twist weak mode that biases positive and negative momenta in opposite directions and separates the μ⁺ and μ⁻ mass peaks; if alignment is not redone after thermal cycles or magnet ramps, module shifts of a few micrometres silently degrade impact-parameter resolution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試運轉交接必須包含幾何版本、Lorentz 角、門檻與遮罩像素表以及對準驗證圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The commissioning handoff must include the geometry version, Lorentz angle, thresholds and masked-pixel tables, and alignment validation plots.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
只用對撞軌跡對準時殘差看起來完美，卻殘留扭轉弱模態，使正負電荷的動量出現相反偏差，μ⁺ 與 μ⁻ 的質量峰錯開。

Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.

title: 時間投影室偵測器
summary: 以 CERN ALICE 的 90 m³ 時間投影室為範本：從 400 V/cm 下的電子漂移與擴散，到四層 GEM 讀出的增益與離子回流，再把雷射、氪校正、空間電荷畸變圖與 524,160 通道的連續讀出整合成可交接的偵測器效能紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the 90 m³ ALICE TPC at CERN as the template: from electron drift and diffusion at 400 V/cm, through gain and ion back-flow of four-GEM readout, to laser and krypton calibration, space-charge distortion maps and continuous readout of 524,160 channels, integrated into a transferable detector performance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
