quiz.question: 在「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 增益隨大氣壓每天漂移 1–2% 卻沒有參考信號追蹤時，整條 dE/dx 曲線上下移動，鑑別帶互相滲入，電子與 π 的誤判率上升。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。
optionsEn: When gain drifts 1–2% per day with air pressure and no reference tracks it, the whole dE/dx curve shifts, identification bands leak into each other and electron–pion misidentification rises.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.
quiz.explanation: 增益隨大氣壓每天漂移 1–2% 卻沒有參考信號追蹤時，整條 dE/dx 曲線上下移動，鑑別帶互相滲入，電子與 π 的誤判率上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When gain drifts 1–2% per day with air pressure and no reference tracks it, the whole dE/dx curve shifts, identification bands leak into each other and electron–pion misidentification rises. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」與「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow" and "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SAMPA front end and readout chain” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。524,160 個通道把數位化波形經光纖連續送出，沒有觸發也沒有死時間，再由 FPGA 讀出卡扣除共模雜訊並做零抑制，才把資料率壓到可儲存的範圍。前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range. Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SAMPA front end and readout chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “SAMPA front end and readout chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流
knowledge.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow
knowledge.text: 每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。524,160 個通道把數位化波形經光纖連續送出，沒有觸發也沒有死時間，再由 FPGA 讀出卡扣除共模雜訊並做零抑制，才把資料率壓到可儲存的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow" is correct?
options: 連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。
每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
optionsEn: Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.

Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
quiz.explanation: 每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SAMPA front end and readout chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。
knowledge.textEn: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow", which statement holds?
options: 磁場會同時壓低橫向與縱向擴散。
氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致。
optionsEn: The magnetic field suppresses both transverse and longitudinal diffusion.
Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.
Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes.
quiz.explanation: 原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “SAMPA front end and readout chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow"?
options: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。
optionsEn: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.
quiz.explanation: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “SAMPA front end and readout chain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
knowledge.textEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
quiz.explanation: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, performance validation and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉與校正資料庫」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning and calibration database” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「試運轉與校正資料庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database. The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning and calibration database”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「試運轉與校正資料庫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning and calibration database”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。

The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure.

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff" is correct?

電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。
整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。
optionsEn: If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.

System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database.
quiz.explanation: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, performance validation and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉與校正資料庫」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning and calibration database” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Gluckstern 估計 σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4))：取 σ_rφ = 0.8 mm、B = 0.5 T、L = 1.6 m、N = 152、pT = 10 GeV/c，得 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%，這就是單獨 TPC 在高動量區的解析度量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度；用 K⁰ₛ 與 Λ 的不變質量寬度驗證動量尺度與解析度；核對校正資料庫中每個參數的生效區間與來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly; verify momentum scale and resolution from the invariant-mass widths of K⁰ₛ and Λ; check validity intervals and provenance of every parameter in the calibration database.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。
漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。
optionsEn: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum.
If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform.
Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.
quiz.explanationEn: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, performance validation and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「試運轉與校正資料庫」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Commissioning and calibration database” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度；用 K⁰ₛ 與 Λ 的不變質量寬度驗證動量尺度與解析度；核對校正資料庫中每個參數的生效區間與來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly; verify momentum scale and resolution from the invariant-mass widths of K⁰ₛ and Λ; check validity intervals and provenance of every parameter in the calibration database. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度；用 K⁰ₛ 與 Λ 的不變質量寬度驗證動量尺度與解析度；核對校正資料庫中每個參數的生效區間與來源。
knowledge.textEn: Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly; verify momentum scale and resolution from the invariant-mass widths of K⁰ₛ and Λ; check validity intervals and provenance of every parameter in the calibration database.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度。
對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly.
A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.
quiz.explanation: 把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度；用 K⁰ₛ 與 Λ 的不變質量寬度驗證動量尺度與解析度；核對校正資料庫中每個參數的生效區間與來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly; verify momentum scale and resolution from the invariant-mass widths of K⁰ₛ and Λ; check validity intervals and provenance of every parameter in the calibration database. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, performance validation and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉與校正資料庫」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Commissioning and calibration database” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。
knowledge.textEn: If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。
交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.
If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps.
quiz.explanation: 交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
summary: 以矽微條與 HPGe 前端為例，從 Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏積分出發，推導 ENC 的串聯、並聯與 1/f 項如何隨電容與整形時間變化，再把脈衝校正、能量解析度分解、ASIC 數位化與門檻佔用率整合成可交接的讀出系統驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Using silicon-strip and HPGe front ends as examples, start from Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive integration, derive how the series, parallel and 1/f terms of ENC scale with capacitance and shaping time, then integrate pulse calibration, resolution decomposition, ASIC digitisation and threshold occupancy into a transferable readout-validation record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊預算練習：矽微條感測器 C_d = 20 pF，加上前端輸入電容 3 pF 與走線 2 pF，總 C = 25 pF；輸入電晶體 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz，漏電流 1 nA，回授電阻 100 MΩ，CR-RC 整形 τ = 1 µs。並聯雜訊電流 i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。串聯項 ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻，並聯項 ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻，合計 200 e⁻。MIP 訊號 24,000 e⁻，訊噪比 120。若感測器受輻照後漏電流升到 100 nA，i_n 升到 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz，ENC_p = 1070 e⁻，總 ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻，訊噪比降到 22；把 τ 縮短到 0.2 µs 後 ENC_s = 335、ENC_p = 480，總 ENC ≈ 585 e⁻，訊噪比回到 41。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際晶片的規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise: a silicon strip sensor with C_d = 20 pF plus 3 pF of front-end input capacitance and 2 pF of trace gives C = 25 pF; the input transistor has e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, leakage is 1 nA, the feedback resistor 100 MΩ, with CR-RC shaping at τ = 1 µs. Parallel noise current i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz. Series term ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻, parallel term ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻, total 200 e⁻. The MIP signal of 24,000 e⁻ gives a signal-to-noise ratio of 120. If irradiation raises leakage to 100 nA, i_n becomes 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz, ENC_p = 1070 e⁻, total ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻ and the ratio drops to 22; shortening τ to 0.2 µs gives ENC_s = 335 and ENC_p = 480, total ≈ 585 e⁻, restoring the ratio to 41. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real chip's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」與「等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" and "Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「感測器電荷與回授電容」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場；電流對時間積分才等於訊號電荷。矽中一個最小游離粒子每微米約產生 80 個電子電洞對，300 µm 厚的感測器給出約 2.4×10⁴ 個電子，只有 3.8 fC。電荷靈敏前置放大器把這些電荷積分到回授電容 C_f 上，輸出 Q/C_f 與偵測器電容無關，前提是開迴路增益夠大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器電荷與回授電容」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground; only the time integral of this current equals the signal charge. A minimum-ionising particle creates about 80 electron–hole pairs per micrometre of silicon, so a 300 µm sensor yields about 2.4×10⁴ electrons, only 3.8 fC. A charge-sensitive preamplifier integrates this charge onto its feedback capacitor C_f, giving an output Q/C_f that is independent of detector capacitance provided the open-loop gain is large enough. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC；C_f = 100 fF 時 V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV（10 mV/fC）；輸入端看到的等效電容為 (A+1)·C_f，要讓偵測器電容 C_d = 20 pF 的電荷幾乎全部流進回授電容需 A·C_f ≫ C_d：取 A = 10⁴，(A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF，電荷收集損失僅 C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC; with C_f = 100 fF, V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV (10 mV/fC); the capacitance seen at the input is (A+1)·C_f, and to pull nearly all the charge of a C_d = 20 pF detector into the feedback capacitor one needs A·C_f ≫ C_d: with A = 10⁴, (A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF and the charge-collection loss is only C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「感測器電荷與回授電容」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" is correct?
options: 電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。
偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場。
整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。
optionsEn: The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance.

A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground.
Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
quiz.explanation: 偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場；電流對時間積分才等於訊號電荷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground; only the time integral of this current equals the signal charge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器電荷與回授電容」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC；C_f = 100 fF 時 V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV（10 mV/fC）；輸入端看到的等效電容為 (A+1)·C_f，要讓偵測器電容 C_d = 20 pF 的電荷幾乎全部流進回授電容需 A·C_f ≫ C_d：取 A = 10⁴，(A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF，電荷收集損失僅 C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC; with C_f = 100 fF, V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV (10 mV/fC); the capacitance seen at the input is (A+1)·C_f, and to pull nearly all the charge of a C_d = 20 pF detector into the feedback capacitor one needs A·C_f ≫ C_d: with A = 10⁴, (A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF and the charge-collection loss is only C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification", which statement holds?
options: 雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。
數位整形可以同時消除雜訊與堆積的限制。
optionsEn: Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side.
Digital shaping removes both the noise and the pile-up limits.
quiz.explanation: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC；C_f = 100 fF 時 V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV（10 mV/fC）；輸入端看到的等效電容為 (A+1)·C_f，要讓偵測器電容 C_d = 20 pF 的電荷幾乎全部流進回授電容需 A·C_f ≫ C_d：取 A = 10⁴，(A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF，電荷收集損失僅 C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC; with C_f = 100 fF, V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV (10 mV/fC); the capacitance seen at the input is (A+1)·C_f, and to pull nearly all the charge of a C_d = 20 pF detector into the feedback capacitor one needs A·C_f ≫ C_d: with A = 10⁴, (A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF and the charge-collection loss is only C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器電荷與回授電容」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。
knowledge.textEn: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification"?
options: 以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要 ADC 位元數夠多，類比前端的雜訊就不重要。
optionsEn: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With enough ADC bits, analogue front-end noise no longer matters.
quiz.explanation: 以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器電荷與回授電容」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：電荷靈敏前置放大器把這些電荷積分到回授電容 C_f 上，輸出 Q/C_f 與偵測器電容無關，前提是開迴路增益夠大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A charge-sensitive preamplifier integrates this charge onto its feedback capacitor C_f, giving an output Q/C_f that is independent of detector capacitance provided the open-loop gain is large enough.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
knowledge.textEn: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.
Longer shaping time always means lower noise.

steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ENC 公式與整形時間」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ENC relation and shaping time” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把所有雜訊折算到輸入端，以等效雜訊電荷 ENC 表示：串聯（電壓）雜訊來自輸入電晶體的通道熱雜訊 e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m，經輸入總電容 C 轉成電荷，隨整形時間 τ 縮短而增大；並聯（電流）雜訊來自漏電流的散粒雜訊 2qI 與回授電阻的熱雜訊 4kT/R_f，隨 τ 加長而增大；1/f 雜訊與 τ 無關，只隨 C² 成長。ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C²，F 為整形器的形狀因子，CR-RC 整形的 F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC 公式與整形時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All noise is referred to the input as an equivalent noise charge (ENC): series (voltage) noise comes from the channel thermal noise of the input transistor, e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m, converted to charge through the total input capacitance C and growing as the shaping time τ shortens; parallel (current) noise comes from leakage-current shot noise 2qI and feedback-resistor thermal noise 4kT/R_f and grows as τ lengthens; 1/f noise is independent of τ and scales only with C². ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C², where the F factors depend on the shaper, with F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92 for CR-RC shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC relation and shaping time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設：總輸入電容 C = 25 pF、輸入電晶體雜訊 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、漏電流 I_leak = 1 nA、回授電阻 R_f = 100 MΩ、整形時間 τ = 1 µs、CR-RC 整形：並聯雜訊電流密度 i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz；串聯項 ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻；並聯項 ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻；合計 √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms（忽略 1/f 項）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take C = 25 pF, e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, I_leak = 1 nA, R_f = 100 MΩ, τ = 1 µs and CR-RC shaping: i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz; series term ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻; parallel term ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻; total √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms (ignoring the 1/f term).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer shaping time always means lower noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ENC 公式與整形時間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ENC relation and shaping time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。
把所有雜訊折算到輸入端，以等效雜訊電荷 ENC 表示：串聯（電壓）雜訊來自輸入電晶體的通道熱雜訊 e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m，經輸入總電容 C 轉成電荷，隨整形時間 τ 縮短而增大。
optionsEn: Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
A bigger input transistor with larger gate capacitance always gives lower noise.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ENC 公式與整形時間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ENC relation and shaping time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設：總輸入電容 C = 25 pF、輸入電晶體雜訊 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、漏電流 I_leak = 1 nA、回授電阻 R_f = 100 MΩ、整形時間 τ = 1 µs、CR-RC 整形：並聯雜訊電流密度 i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz；串聯項 ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻；並聯項 ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻；合計 √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms（忽略 1/f 項）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take C = 25 pF, e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, I_leak = 1 nA, R_f = 100 MΩ, τ = 1 µs and CR-RC shaping: i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz; series term ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻; parallel term ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻; total √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms (ignoring the 1/f term). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用脈衝產生器注入固定電荷，把輸出峰值分佈的標準差換算成 ENC；掃描整形時間 0.25–8 µs 畫出 ENC 對 τ 的曲線，短 τ 端斜率 −1/2 對應串聯項、長 τ 端斜率 +1/2 對應並聯項、中間平坦段代表 1/f 項；再固定 τ、改變輸入電容量出斜率 dENC/dC。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a fixed charge from a pulser and convert the standard deviation of the output peak distribution into ENC; scan shaping time from 0.25 to 8 µs and plot ENC versus τ, where the −1/2 slope at short τ is the series term, the +1/2 slope at long τ the parallel term and a flat region the 1/f term; then fix τ and vary input capacitance to measure the slope dENC/dC.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ENC 公式與整形時間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ENC relation and shaping time” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用脈衝產生器注入固定電荷，把輸出峰值分佈的標準差換算成 ENC；掃描整形時間 0.25–8 µs 畫出 ENC 對 τ 的曲線，短 τ 端斜率 −1/2 對應串聯項、長 τ 端斜率 +1/2 對應並聯項、中間平坦段代表 1/f 項；再固定 τ、改變輸入電容量出斜率 dENC/dC。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject a fixed charge from a pulser and convert the standard deviation of the output peak distribution into ENC; scan shaping time from 0.25 to 8 µs and plot ENC versus τ, where the −1/2 slope at short τ is the series term, the +1/2 slope at long τ the parallel term and a flat region the 1/f term; then fix τ and vary input capacitance to measure the slope dENC/dC. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偵測器受輻射損傷後漏電流從 1 nA 升到 1 µA，散粒雜訊電流增大 √1000 ≈ 32 倍，並聯項主導，原本最佳的 1 µs 整形變成雜訊災難，解析度惡化到數千個電子。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After radiation damage raises leakage from 1 nA to 1 µA the shot-noise current grows by √1000 ≈ 32, the parallel term dominates, the formerly optimal 1 µs shaping becomes a noise disaster and resolution degrades to thousands of electrons.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ENC 公式與整形時間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ENC relation and shaping time” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 偵測器受輻射損傷後漏電流從 1 nA 升到 1 µA，散粒雜訊電流增大 √1000 ≈ 32 倍，並聯項主導，原本最佳的 1 µs 整形變成雜訊災難，解析度惡化到數千個電子。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After radiation damage raises leakage from 1 nA to 1 µA the shot-noise current grows by √1000 ≈ 32, the parallel term dominates, the formerly optimal 1 µs shaping becomes a noise disaster and resolution degrades to thousands of electrons. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C²，F 為整形器的形狀因子，CR-RC 整形的 F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C², where the F factors depend on the shaper, with F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92 for CR-RC shaping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer shaping time always means lower noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輸入電晶體、電容匹配與回授元件」與「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Input transistor, capacitance matching and feedback elements" and "Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輸入電晶體、電容匹配與回授元件：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Input transistor, capacitance matching and feedback elements: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「輸入電晶體與回授網路」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Input transistor and feedback network” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯雜訊由輸入電晶體的跨導與閘極電容決定：JFET 在室溫到 120 K 之間 g_m 高、1/f 雜訊低，是 HPGe 與 Si(Li) 光譜儀的傳統選擇；深次微米 CMOS 讓每通道功耗降到毫瓦等級，適合數十萬通道的 ASIC。閘極電容會加進總電容 C，若 g_m ∝ √C_gs（強反轉、固定電流密度），最佳條件是 C_gs ≈ C_d，這就是電容匹配法則。回授元件必須極低漏電與低介電吸收：C_f 用 NP0/C0G 或晶片上的金屬電容，放電路徑用 GΩ 級電阻、脈衝重置或連續的電晶體回授。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Series noise is set by the transconductance and gate capacitance of the input transistor: a JFET between room temperature and 120 K offers high g_m and low 1/f noise and remains the traditional choice for HPGe and Si(Li) spectrometers, while deep-submicron CMOS brings per-channel power down to milliwatts for ASICs with hundreds of thousands of channels. The gate capacitance adds to the total C, and if g_m ∝ √C_gs (strong inversion at fixed current density) the optimum is C_gs ≈ C_d, the capacitive-matching rule. Feedback elements must have extremely low leakage and dielectric absorption: C_f is an NP0/C0G or on-chip metal capacitor, and discharge uses a GΩ-class resistor, pulsed reset or continuous transistor feedback. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input transistor and feedback network”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輸入電晶體的電壓雜訊密度 e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m)：室溫 T = 300 K、Γ = 0.7、跨導 g_m = 20 mS 時 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J，e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz；同一顆 JFET 冷卻到 120 K，4kT 降為 6.6×10⁻²¹ J，e_n ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz，串聯雜訊電荷按比例降低 37%；回授電阻從 100 MΩ 提高到 1 GΩ，其熱雜訊電流由 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ 降到 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m): at T = 300 K, Γ = 0.7 and g_m = 20 mS, 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J and e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz; cooling the same JFET to 120 K lowers 4kT to 6.6×10⁻²¹ J and e_n to ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz, cutting the series noise charge by 37%; raising the feedback resistor from 100 MΩ to 1 GΩ reduces its thermal noise current from 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ to 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger input transistor with larger gate capacitance always gives lower noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Input transistor and feedback network”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 輸入電晶體、電容匹配與回授元件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Input transistor, capacitance matching and feedback elements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Input transistor and feedback network” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輸入電晶體的電壓雜訊密度 e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m)：室溫 T = 300 K、Γ = 0.7、跨導 g_m = 20 mS 時 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J，e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz；同一顆 JFET 冷卻到 120 K，4kT 降為 6.6×10⁻²¹ J，e_n ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz，串聯雜訊電荷按比例降低 37%；回授電阻從 100 MΩ 提高到 1 GΩ，其熱雜訊電流由 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ 降到 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m): at T = 300 K, Γ = 0.7 and g_m = 20 mS, 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J and e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz; cooling the same JFET to 120 K lowers 4kT to 6.6×10⁻²¹ J and e_n to ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz, cutting the series noise charge by 37%; raising the feedback resistor from 100 MΩ to 1 GΩ reduces its thermal noise current from 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ to 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以小訊號法量輸入電晶體在工作點的 g_m、以阻抗分析儀量 C_gs；用頻譜分析儀量輸出雜訊密度除以增益得到 e_n(f) 與 1/f 轉角；對回授電阻與電容做 pA 級漏電流與介電吸收測試；冷卻前後各量一次 ENC 曲線，確認改善量符合 √T 的預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure g_m at the operating point with a small-signal method and C_gs with an impedance analyser; obtain e_n(f) and the 1/f corner by dividing the output noise density from a spectrum analyser by the gain; test the feedback resistor and capacitor for pA-level leakage and dielectric absorption; measure the ENC curve before and after cooling and confirm the improvement follows the √T prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 輸入電晶體的電壓雜訊密度 e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m)：室溫 T = 300 K、Γ = 0.7、跨導 g_m = 20 mS 時 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J，e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz；同一顆 JFET 冷卻到 120 K，4kT 降為 6.6×10⁻²¹ J，e_n ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz，串聯雜訊電荷按比例降低 37%；回授電阻從 100 MΩ 提高到 1 GΩ，其熱雜訊電流由 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ 降到 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。
knowledge.textEn: e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m): at T = 300 K, Γ = 0.7 and g_m = 20 mS, 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J and e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz; cooling the same JFET to 120 K lowers 4kT to 6.6×10⁻²¹ J and e_n to ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz, cutting the series noise charge by 37%; raising the feedback resistor from 100 MΩ to 1 GΩ reduces its thermal noise current from 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ to 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz.

steps.title: 輸入電晶體、電容匹配與回授元件：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Input transistor, capacitance matching and feedback elements: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「輸入電晶體與回授網路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Input transistor and feedback network” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以小訊號法量輸入電晶體在工作點的 g_m、以阻抗分析儀量 C_gs；用頻譜分析儀量輸出雜訊密度除以增益得到 e_n(f) 與 1/f 轉角；對回授電阻與電容做 pA 級漏電流與介電吸收測試；冷卻前後各量一次 ENC 曲線，確認改善量符合 √T 的預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure g_m at the operating point with a small-signal method and C_gs with an impedance analyser; obtain e_n(f) and the 1/f corner by dividing the output noise density from a spectrum analyser by the gain; test the feedback resistor and capacitor for pA-level leakage and dielectric absorption; measure the ENC curve before and after cooling and confirm the improvement follows the √T prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：回授電阻若用一般厚膜電阻，其過剩雜訊與電壓係數讓並聯雜訊比 4kT/R 大數倍，而且高阻值下的寄生電容使放電時間常數隨溫度漂移，基線在高計數率時堆積。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A plain thick-film feedback resistor adds excess noise and voltage dependence that make parallel noise several times 4kT/R, and the parasitic capacitance across a high value lets the discharge time constant drift with temperature so the baseline piles up at high count rate.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance.

steps.title: 輸入電晶體、電容匹配與回授元件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Input transistor, capacitance matching and feedback elements: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Input transistor and feedback network” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 回授電阻若用一般厚膜電阻，其過剩雜訊與電壓係數讓並聯雜訊比 4kT/R 大數倍，而且高阻值下的寄生電容使放電時間常數隨溫度漂移，基線在高計數率時堆積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A plain thick-film feedback resistor adds excess noise and voltage dependence that make parallel noise several times 4kT/R, and the parasitic capacitance across a high value lets the discharge time constant drift with temperature so the baseline piles up at high count rate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：回授元件必須極低漏電與低介電吸收：C_f 用 NP0/C0G 或晶片上的金屬電容，放電路徑用 GΩ 級電阻、脈衝重置或連續的電晶體回授。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Feedback elements must have extremely low leakage and dielectric absorption: C_f is an NP0/C0G or on-chip metal capacitor, and discharge uses a GΩ-class resistor, pulsed reset or continuous transistor feedback.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger input transistor with larger gate capacitance always gives lower noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 回授電阻若用一般厚膜電阻，其過剩雜訊與電壓係數讓並聯雜訊比 4kT/R 大數倍，而且高阻值下的寄生電容使放電時間常數隨溫度漂移，基線在高計數率時堆積。
knowledge.textEn: A plain thick-film feedback resistor adds excess noise and voltage dependence that make parallel noise several times 4kT/R, and the parasitic capacitance across a high value lets the discharge time constant drift with temperature so the baseline piles up at high count rate.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 回授電阻若用一般厚膜電阻，其過剩雜訊與電壓係數讓並聯雜訊比 4kT/R 大數倍，而且高阻值下的寄生電容使放電時間常數隨溫度漂移，基線在高計數率時堆積。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: A plain thick-film feedback resistor adds excess noise and voltage dependence that make parallel noise several times 4kT/R, and the parasitic capacitance across a high value lets the discharge time constant drift with temperature so the baseline piles up at high count rate.

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bias network, grounding and layout” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。偏壓透過大電阻與 AC 耦合電容送到感測器，耦合電容必須承受全偏壓且漏電極低；接地採單點或星形，讓偵測器回流電流與數位地分開，否則切換式電源與時脈的 100 kHz–10 MHz 干擾正好落在整形器通帶內。低雜訊讀出有一半是機械與佈局工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count. Bias reaches the sensor through a large resistor and an AC-coupling capacitor that must hold the full bias with negligible leakage; grounding must be single-point or star so that detector return currents stay separate from the digital ground, otherwise switching-regulator and clock interference at 100 kHz–10 MHz lands exactly inside the shaper passband. Half of low-noise readout is mechanical and layout engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias network, grounding and layout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF；多出 3 pF 走線電容使串聯項升到 168 e⁻，總 ENC 從 200 變成 √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻（+7%）；偏壓電阻 R_b = 10 MΩ 的熱雜訊電流 √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz，比 1 nA 漏電流的散粒雜訊 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ 還大，改用 100 MΩ 則降到 1.3×10⁻¹⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bias network, grounding and layout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bias network, grounding and layout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF；多出 3 pF 走線電容使串聯項升到 168 e⁻，總 ENC 從 200 變成 √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻（+7%）；偏壓電阻 R_b = 10 MΩ 的熱雜訊電流 √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz，比 1 nA 漏電流的散粒雜訊 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ 還大，改用 100 MΩ 則降到 1.3×10⁻¹⁴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較；用近場探棒與頻譜分析儀找出通帶內的干擾譜線並逐一追到來源；量偏壓耦合電容在工作電壓下的 pA 級漏電流；每次接地改動前後各量一次基線 RMS。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design; locate in-band interference lines with a near-field probe and spectrum analyser and trace each to its source; measure bias-coupling capacitor leakage at working voltage at the pA level; record baseline RMS before and after every grounding change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance.
