Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbulent layers are carried across the aperture by wind at speed v, and under Taylor's frozen-flow hypothesis the phase pattern translates, giving the wavefront a characteristic Greenwood frequency f_G = 0.427·v/r0; with a control −3 dB bandwidth f_3dB, the residual temporal error is σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3). The other limit is angular: two lines of sight separated by θ cross different turbulence, leaving σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3) with the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ set by the turbulence-weighted mean height h̄. These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz; for f_3dB = 50 Hz the K-band temporal error is σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²; the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″ at K but only 1.9″ at 500 nm; the coherence time τ0 = 0.314·r0/v is 4.5 ms at 500 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 v = 10 m/s、h̄ = 5 km：500 nm 時 f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz，K 波段 f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz；若 f_3dB = 50 Hz，K 波段時間誤差 σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²；等暈角 θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″（K），在 500 nm 只有 1.9″；相干時間 τ0 = 0.314·r0/v 在 500 nm 為 4.5 ms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz; for f_3dB = 50 Hz the K-band temporal error is σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²; the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″ at K but only 1.9″ at 500 nm; the coherence time τ0 = 0.314·r0/v is 4.5 ms at 500 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從波前感測器遙測資料算各模態的時間功率譜，擬合其轉折頻率與 f_G 預測比較；以 MASS-DIMM 的 τ0 與 θ0 統計核對台址模型；在不同離軸角放置參考星觀測同一目標，量 Strehl 隨角度的下降並擬合 (θ/θ0)^(5/3)。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the temporal power spectra of the modes from wavefront-sensor telemetry and compare their knee frequencies with the predicted f_G; check the site model against MASS-DIMM statistics of τ0 and θ0; observe a target with reference stars at several off-axis angles, measure the Strehl fall-off and fit (θ/θ0)^(5/3).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz; for f_3dB = 50 Hz the K-band temporal error is σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²; the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″ at K but only 1.9″ at 500 nm; the coherence time τ0 = 0.314·r0/v is 4.5 ms at 500 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement", which statement holds?
options: 感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。
即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。
optionsEn: With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz.
Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl.
A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth.
quiz.explanationEn: With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz; for f_3dB = 50 Hz the K-band temporal error is σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²; the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″ at K but only 1.9″ at 500 nm; the coherence time τ0 = 0.314·r0/v is 4.5 ms at 500 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從波前感測器遙測資料算各模態的時間功率譜，擬合其轉折頻率與 f_G 預測比較；以 MASS-DIMM 的 τ0 與 θ0 統計核對台址模型；在不同離軸角放置參考星觀測同一目標，量 Strehl 隨角度的下降並擬合 (θ/θ0)^(5/3)。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the temporal power spectra of the modes from wavefront-sensor telemetry and compare their knee frequencies with the predicted f_G; check the site model against MASS-DIMM statistics of τ0 and θ0; observe a target with reference stars at several off-axis angles, measure the Strehl fall-off and fit (θ/θ0)^(5/3). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：高空急流讓有效風速從 10 m/s 升到 30 m/s，f_G 增為三倍，固定 50 Hz 頻寬的迴路殘差 σ_t² 增為 3^(5/3) ≈ 6.2 倍，Strehl 在不改任何硬體的情況下崩落。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A jet stream raising the effective wind speed from 10 to 30 m/s triples f_G, the residual σ_t² of a fixed 50 Hz loop grows by 3^(5/3) ≈ 6.2, and the Strehl collapses without any hardware change.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從波前感測器遙測資料算各模態的時間功率譜，擬合其轉折頻率與 f_G 預測比較；以 MASS-DIMM 的 τ0 與 θ0 統計核對台址模型；在不同離軸角放置參考星觀測同一目標，量 Strehl 隨角度的下降並擬合 (θ/θ0)^(5/3)。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the temporal power spectra of the modes from wavefront-sensor telemetry and compare their knee frequencies with the predicted f_G; check the site model against MASS-DIMM statistics of τ0 and θ0; observe a target with reference stars at several off-axis angles, measure the Strehl fall-off and fit (θ/θ0)^(5/3).

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deformable secondary and ELT M4” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 變形鏡以一片薄殼承載連續反射面，由音圈致動器以電容感測閉迴路定位：VLT 的變形副鏡在約 1.1 m 的薄殼上有 1170 個致動器，ELT 的 M4 則是 2.4 m 平面鏡、六片 1.95 mm 厚的玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器，每秒更新 1000 次、行程 ±50 µm。致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A deformable mirror carries a continuous reflective facesheet on a thin shell positioned in closed loop by voice-coil actuators with capacitive sensing: the VLT deformable secondary has 1170 actuators behind a shell of about 1.1 m, while the ELT M4 is a 2.4 m flat built from six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells with more than 5000 voice coils, updated 1000 times per second with ±50 µm of stroke. The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deformable secondary and ELT M4”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: VLT: pupil area π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m², 52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m² per actuator, projected pitch d ≈ 0.21 m; with r0 = 0.85 m at K, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器越多越好，數量不會受其他因素限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Deformable secondary and ELT M4”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deformable secondary and ELT M4” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VLT：瞳面積 π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m²，52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m²／致動器，投影間距 d ≈ 0.21 m；K 波段 r0 = 0.85 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad²。ELT：有效瞳面積約 1100 m²，1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m²，d ≈ 0.45 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad²，單由擬合項得到 Strehl ≈ 0.91。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: VLT: pupil area π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m², 52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m² per actuator, projected pitch d ≈ 0.21 m; with r0 = 0.85 m at K, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad². ELT: effective pupil area about 1100 m², 1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m², d ≈ 0.45 m, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad², a Strehl of ≈ 0.91 from the fitting term alone. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each actuator's influence function and inter-actuator coupling with an interferometer, confirming stroke, linearity and hysteresis; command Zernike combinations on the shell and measure the closed-loop figure residual; use the capacitive-sensor readings for a loop frequency response to confirm stability margins at 1 kHz update; compute the actual fitting error from high-resolution interferograms and compare with 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

ELT: effective pupil area about 1100 m², 1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m², d ≈ 0.45 m, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad², a Strehl of ≈ 0.91 from the fitting term alone.

steps.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Deformable secondary and ELT M4” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each actuator's influence function and inter-actuator coupling with an interferometer, confirming stroke, linearity and hysteresis; command Zernike combinations on the shell and measure the closed-loop figure residual; use the capacitive-sensor readings for a loop frequency response to confirm stability margins at 1 kHz update; compute the actual fitting error from high-resolution interferograms and compare with 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：薄殼上單一致動器失效或電容感測器漂移，鄰近區域出現固定的面形凸起，造成 PSF 的對稱斑點；若行程預算未含望遠鏡風擾與主鏡像差，致動器在壞視寧度下飽和，迴路發散。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single failed actuator or a drifting capacitive sensor on the shell leaves a fixed bump that produces symmetric speckles in the PSF; if the stroke budget omits wind shake and primary-mirror aberrations, actuators saturate in poor seeing and the loop diverges.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each actuator's influence function and inter-actuator coupling with an interferometer, confirming stroke, linearity and hysteresis; command Zernike combinations on the shell and measure the closed-loop figure residual; use the capacitive-sensor readings for a loop frequency response to confirm stability margins at 1 kHz update; compute the actual fitting error from high-resolution interferograms and compare with 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3).

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。

以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.

quiz.explanation: 以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each actuator's influence function and inter-actuator coupling with an interferometer, confirming stroke, linearity and hysteresis; command Zernike combinations on the shell and measure the closed-loop figure residual; use the capacitive-sensor readings for a loop frequency response to confirm stability margins at 1 kHz update; compute the actual fitting error from high-resolution interferograms and compare with 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3). steps.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Deformable secondary and ELT M4” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 薄殼上單一致動器失效或電容感測器漂移，鄰近區域出現固定的面形凸起，造成 PSF 的對稱斑點；若行程預算未含望遠鏡風擾與主鏡像差，致動器在壞視寧度下飽和，迴路發散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A single failed actuator or a drifting capacitive sensor on the shell leaves a fixed bump that produces symmetric speckles in the PSF; if the stroke budget omits wind shake and primary-mirror aberrations, actuators saturate in poor seeing and the loop diverges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器越多越好，數量不會受其他因素限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Shack–Hartmann sensor divides the pupil into subapertures with a lenslet array, and the spot displacement in each subaperture is proportional to the local wavefront slope; a pyramid sensor instead places a four-sided prism at the focus and measures slopes from intensity differences between four pupil images, with higher sensitivity to small aberrations. Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required. Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：子孔徑 d ≈ r0 時光點接近繞射極限，光子雜訊相位變異約 σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph)：N_ph = 500 光子／子孔徑／幀 → 0.0099 rad²（700 nm 感測），換到 K 波段乘 (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10 得 0.0010 rad²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For d ≈ r0 the spot is near diffraction-limited and the photon-noise phase variance is about σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph): N_ph = 500 photons per subaperture per frame → 0.0099 rad² at 700 nm sensing, or 0.0010 rad² at K after multiplying by (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required.

steps.title: 波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：子孔徑 d ≈ r0 時光點接近繞射極限，光子雜訊相位變異約 σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph)：N_ph = 500 光子／子孔徑／幀 → 0.0099 rad²（700 nm 感測），換到 K 波段乘 (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10 得 0.0010 rad²。亮度預算：R = 10 等星約 7×10⁵ 光子/s/m²（100 nm 帶寬，教學值），0.045 m² 子孔徑在 1 kHz 下每幀 32 光子，乘 0.3 的通量效率只剩約 10 光子，σ_ph² ≈ 0.49 rad² → K 波段 0.05 rad²，所以全速 NGS AO 需要約 R < 9 的星。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For d ≈ r0 the spot is near diffraction-limited and the photon-noise phase variance is about σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph): N_ph = 500 photons per subaperture per frame → 0.0099 rad² at 700 nm sensing, or 0.0010 rad² at K after multiplying by (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10. Brightness budget: an R = 10 star gives about 7×10⁵ photons/s/m² in a 100 nm band (teaching value), a 0.045 m² subaperture at 1 kHz collects 32 photons per frame, and a throughput of 0.3 leaves about 10, giving σ_ph² ≈ 0.49 rad² → 0.05 rad² at K, so full-speed NGS AO needs stars brighter than about R = 9. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍；逐步衰減光源量重心雜訊對光子數的關係，確認 σ ∝ 1/√N_ph；用 ⁵⁵Fe 或光子轉移曲線量相機的增益與讀出雜訊；在天上對不同星等的星做閉迴路，記錄 Strehl 對星等的曲線並找出轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range; attenuate the source stepwise and record centroid noise versus photon count to confirm σ ∝ 1/√N_ph; measure camera gain and read noise with a photon-transfer curve; close the loop on sky on stars of different magnitudes and record the Strehl-versus-magnitude curve to find the knee.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍；逐步衰減光源量重心雜訊對光子數的關係，確認 σ ∝ 1/√N_ph；用 ⁵⁵Fe 或光子轉移曲線量相機的增益與讀出雜訊；在天上對不同星等的星做閉迴路，記錄 Strehl 對星等的曲線並找出轉折。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range; attenuate the source stepwise and record centroid noise versus photon count to confirm σ ∝ 1/√N_ph; measure camera gain and read noise with a photon-transfer curve; close the loop on sky on stars of different magnitudes and record the Strehl-versus-magnitude curve to find the knee. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍；逐步衰減光源量重心雜訊對光子數的關係，確認 σ ∝ 1/√N_ph；用 ⁵⁵Fe 或光子轉移曲線量相機的增益與讀出雜訊；在天上對不同星等的星做閉迴路，記錄 Strehl 對星等的曲線並找出轉折。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range; attenuate the source stepwise and record centroid noise versus photon count to confirm σ ∝ 1/√N_ph; measure camera gain and read noise with a photon-transfer curve; close the loop on sky on stars of different magnitudes and record the Strehl-versus-magnitude curve to find the knee.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness"?
options: 以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。
optionsEn: Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is.
quiz.explanation: 以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍；逐步衰減光源量重心雜訊對光子數的關係，確認 σ ∝ 1/√N_ph；用 ⁵⁵Fe 或光子轉移曲線量相機的增益與讀出雜訊；在天上對不同星等的星做閉迴路，記錄 Strehl 對星等的曲線並找出轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range; attenuate the source stepwise and record centroid noise versus photon count to confirm σ ∝ 1/√N_ph; measure camera gain and read noise with a photon-transfer curve; close the loop on sky on stars of different magnitudes and record the Strehl-versus-magnitude curve to find the knee. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)².
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。
knowledge.textEn: A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。
感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed.
Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl.
quiz.explanation: 微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正」與「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration" and "Error budget and the Strehl ratio": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正
knowledge.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration
knowledge.text: 控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。
knowledge.textEn: The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration" is correct?
options: 感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。
Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。
控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D。
optionsEn: Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl.
Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.
The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D.
quiz.explanation: 控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。NCPA 殘差 50 nm rms 在 K 波段對應 σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad²，Strehl 損失約 2%；若未校正而殘留 150 nm，σ² ≈ 0.18 rad²，Strehl 損失 17%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time. An NCPA residual of 50 nm rms corresponds at K to σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad², a Strehl loss of about 2%; left uncalibrated at 150 nm, σ² ≈ 0.18 rad² and the loss is 17%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。NCPA 殘差 50 nm rms 在 K 波段對應 σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad²，Strehl 損失約 2%；若未校正而殘留 150 nm，σ² ≈ 0.18 rad²，Strehl 損失 17%。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time. An NCPA residual of 50 nm rms corresponds at K to σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad², a Strehl loss of about 2%; left uncalibrated at 150 nm, σ² ≈ 0.18 rad² and the loss is 17%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration", which statement holds?
options: 量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s。
感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。
只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。
optionsEn: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz.
Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed.
A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is.
quiz.explanation: 量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration"?

比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜。
致動器越多越好，數量不會受其他因素限制。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes.
More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count.
quiz.explanation: 比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error budget and the Strehl ratio: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Strehl 預算表」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strehl budget table” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Strehl 預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strehl budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: K band, bright on-axis NGS: fitting 0.028 + temporal 0.022 + measurement 0.001 + aliasing 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + chromatic and other 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915; jitter σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad with λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad gives S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86; total Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Strehl 預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Strehl budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Error budget and the Strehl ratio" is correct?
options: AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。
Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。
即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。
optionsEn: AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent.
Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.
A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth.

steps.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error budget and the Strehl ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Strehl 預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strehl budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：K 波段、亮 NGS 在軸上：擬合 0.028 + 時間 0.022 + 量測 0.001 + 混疊 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + 色散與其他 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915；抖動 σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad，λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad，S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86；總 Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79。換到 H 波段（1.65 µm）各項乘 (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78，σ² = 0.158 → 0.85，S_j ≈ 0.78，總 Strehl ≈ 0.66。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: K band, bright on-axis NGS: fitting 0.028 + temporal 0.022 + measurement 0.001 + aliasing 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + chromatic and other 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915; jitter σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad with λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad gives S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86; total Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79. At H band (1.65 µm) every term is multiplied by (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78, σ² = 0.158 → 0.85, S_j ≈ 0.78, total Strehl ≈ 0.66. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line; measure the actual Strehl from the science-camera PSF normalised to the same total flux as the diffraction-limited PSF; estimate the jitter term from accelerometer vibration spectra of the telescope; repeat under different seeing and plot Strehl versus r0 against the budget model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: K band, bright on-axis NGS: fitting 0.028 + temporal 0.022 + measurement 0.001 + aliasing 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + chromatic and other 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915; jitter σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad with λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad gives S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86; total Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79. At H band (1.65 µm) every term is multiplied by (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78, σ² = 0.158 → 0.85, S_j ≈ 0.78, total Strehl ≈ 0.66.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

致動器越多越好，數量不會受其他因素限制。

More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count.
