steps.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Error budget and the Strehl ratio: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Strehl 預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Strehl budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line; measure the actual Strehl from the science-camera PSF normalised to the same total flux as the diffraction-limited PSF; estimate the jitter term from accelerometer vibration spectra of the telescope; repeat under different seeing and plot Strehl versus r0 against the budget model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line; measure the actual Strehl from the science-camera PSF normalised to the same total flux as the diffraction-limited PSF; estimate the jitter term from accelerometer vibration spectra of the telescope; repeat under different seeing and plot Strehl versus r0 against the budget model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Error budget and the Strehl ratio"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。
從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size.
Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line.
quiz.explanation: 從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line; measure the actual Strehl from the science-camera PSF normalised to the same total flux as the diffraction-limited PSF; estimate the jitter term from accelerometer vibration spectra of the telescope; repeat under different seeing and plot Strehl versus r0 against the budget model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Error budget and the Strehl ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Strehl 預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Strehl budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。
knowledge.textEn: A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Error budget and the Strehl ratio" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。
optionsEn: A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth.
quiz.explanation: 預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」與「天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin" and "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「即時控制器與迴路延遲」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Real-time controller and loop latency” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Real-time controller and loop latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Real-time controller and loop latency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度
knowledge.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin
knowledge.text: 即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。
knowledge.textEn: Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin" is correct?
options: 即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。
即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。
感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。
optionsEn: A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth.
Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator.
Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed.
quiz.explanation: 即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Real-time controller and loop latency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_s = 1 kHz、增益 g = 0.5：交越頻率 ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz；延遲 τ_d = 2 幀 = 2 ms 在 80 Hz 造成 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° 落後，相位裕度 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°；要維持 45° 裕度，f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz，對應 g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39。運算量：2480 個斜率 × 1170 致動器 ≈ 2.9×10⁶ 次乘加／幀，1 kHz 下 2.9 GMAC/s；ELT 約 10⁴ 斜率 × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷／幀，500 Hz 下 27 GMAC/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Computation: 2480 slopes × 1170 actuators ≈ 2.9×10⁶ multiply-accumulates per frame, 2.9 GMAC/s at 1 kHz; for the ELT about 10⁴ slopes × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷ per frame, 27 GMAC/s at 500 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Computation: 2480 slopes × 1170 actuators ≈ 2.9×10⁶ multiply-accumulates per frame, 2.9 GMAC/s at 1 kHz; for the ELT about 10⁴ slopes × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷ per frame, 27 GMAC/s at 500 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin", which statement holds?
options: 只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。
波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。
optionsEn: A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is.
Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size.
f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz.
quiz.explanationEn: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「即時控制器與迴路延遲」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Real-time controller and loop latency” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。
knowledge.textEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin"?
options: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。
optionsEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl.
quiz.explanation: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Real-time controller and loop latency” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。
感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain.
Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain. steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “On-sky validation and telemetry record” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On-sky validation closes the loop on reference stars of different magnitudes and off-axis angles, measuring Strehl, FWHM and encircled energy; sensor and deformable-mirror telemetry are recorded synchronously to reconstruct the residual-phase power spectrum and infer the PSF; performance statistics are built against site conditions across a range of seeing and coherence time. The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “On-sky validation and telemetry record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量到 Strehl 後反推殘差：σ = √(−ln S)，S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad，在 K 波段為 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms；S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “On-sky validation and telemetry record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接

The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。

A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “On-sky validation and telemetry record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量到 Strehl 後反推殘差：σ = √(−ln S)，S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad，在 K 波段為 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms；S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm。操作上限：視寧度 1.2″ 時 r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm，擬合項放大 (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 倍到 0.068 rad²，時間項同樣放大，K 波段總 σ² 從 0.089 升到約 0.21，Strehl 降到 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70（仍可用）；視寧度 2″ 則 σ² ≈ 0.5，Strehl 約 0.5。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm. Operating ceiling: at 1.2″ seeing r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm, the fitting term grows by (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 to 0.068 rad² and the temporal term likewise, the K-band total σ² rises from 0.089 to about 0.21 and the Strehl drops to 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70, still usable; at 2″ seeing σ² ≈ 0.5 and the Strehl is about 0.5. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm. Operating ceiling: at 1.2″ seeing r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm, the fitting term grows by (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 to 0.068 rad² and the temporal term likewise, the K-band total σ² rises from 0.089 to about 0.21 and the Strehl drops to 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70, still usable; at 2″ seeing σ² ≈ 0.5 and the Strehl is about 0.5.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff", which statement holds?

More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count.

quiz.explanationEn: Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “On-sky validation and telemetry record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型。
Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model.
Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.
quiz.explanation: 對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “On-sky validation and telemetry record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。
交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.

If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared.
quiz.explanation: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
summary: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
summaryEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 主動修正練習：假設一面 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄鏡位於天頂角 45°。鏡重 226 kN，軸向分量 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN，150 支平均每支約 1,065 N，側向同為約 160 kN。夜間鏡體穿厚度溫差 0.4 K、α = 0.05 ppm/K：κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，矢高 κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm，交給副鏡以離焦修正。感測器量得像散係數 600 nm，主鏡迴路增益 0.3、每 45 s 修正一次，要降到 40 nm 需 n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6，即 8 次、約 6 分鐘。殘差預算為拋光 30、印痕 15、主動 25、熱 20、風 15 nm，RSS ≈ 49 nm，在 1.0 µm 的 Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Active-correction exercise: assume an 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus at 45° zenith angle. The 226 kN weight has an axial component of 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN, about 1,065 N on average for each of 150 actuators, and a lateral component of about 160 kN as well. At night a 0.4 K through-thickness difference with α = 0.05 ppm/K gives κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag of κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm, which the secondary removes as defocus. The sensor reports 600 nm of astigmatism; with gain 0.3 and one correction every 45 s, reaching 40 nm needs n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes. A residual budget of polishing 30, print-through 15, active 25, thermal 20 and wind 15 nm gives RSS ≈ 49 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91 at 1.0 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形
knowledge.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus
knowledge.text: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" is correct?
options: 主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure.
Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
quiz.explanation: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。若只在外緣簡支，中心撓度 w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm（a = 4.1 m）；同口徑做成 1.37 m 厚（1:6）只撓 0.031 mm，但質量達 183 噸。改用 150 點支撐，每點分攤約 0.35 m²、跨距約 0.59 m，撓度隨跨距四次方縮小 (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵，量級降到數十 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa. Simply supported only at the rim, the centre deflection w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm for a = 4.1 m; the same aperture at 1.37 m thickness (1:6) sags only 0.031 mm but weighs 183 tonnes. With 150 supports each carrying about 0.35 m² over a span near 0.59 m, deflection scales down with the fourth power of span, (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵, to the order of tens of nanometres. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。若只在外緣簡支，中心撓度 w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm（a = 4.1 m）；同口徑做成 1.37 m 厚（1:6）只撓 0.031 mm，但質量達 183 噸。改用 150 點支撐，每點分攤約 0.35 m²、跨距約 0.59 m，撓度隨跨距四次方縮小 (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵，量級降到數十 nm。
knowledge.textEn: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa. Simply supported only at the rim, the centre deflection w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm for a = 4.1 m; the same aperture at 1.37 m thickness (1:6) sags only 0.031 mm but weighs 183 tonnes. With 150 supports each carrying about 0.35 m² over a span near 0.59 m, deflection scales down with the fourth power of span, (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵, to the order of tens of nanometres.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus", which statement holds?

optionsEn: With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.
For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa.

quiz.explanationEn: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus"?

Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely.
Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
quiz.explanation: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正
knowledge.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction
knowledge.text: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。
knowledge.textEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction" is correct?
options: 主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。
主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.

Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence.
quiz.explanation: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。模態剛性 ∝ ω²，同振幅下三葉形所需力約為像散的 (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 倍、四葉形約 17 倍；若 ±120 N 力預算能修 1 µm 像散（教學假設），同樣力只修約 0.18 µm 三葉形或 0.06 µm 四葉形。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz. Modal stiffness scales as ω², so at equal amplitude trefoil needs about (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 times the force of astigmatism and quadrafoil about 17 times; if a ±120 N budget corrects 1 µm of astigmatism (teaching assumption), the same force corrects only about 0.18 µm of trefoil or 0.06 µm of quadrafoil. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。模態剛性 ∝ ω²，同振幅下三葉形所需力約為像散的 (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 倍、四葉形約 17 倍；若 ±120 N 力預算能修 1 µm 像散（教學假設），同樣力只修約 0.18 µm 三葉形或 0.06 µm 四葉形。
knowledge.textEn: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz. Modal stiffness scales as ω², so at equal amplitude trefoil needs about (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 times the force of astigmatism and quadrafoil about 17 times; if a ±120 N budget corrects 1 µm of astigmatism (teaching assumption), the same force corrects only about 0.18 µm of trefoil or 0.06 µm of quadrafoil.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction", which statement holds?
options: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。
optionsEn: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)).
Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.
quiz.explanation: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。
knowledge.textEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣。
只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix.
If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.

quiz.explanationEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。
knowledge.textEn: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.

If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」與「側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy" and "Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “150 axial actuators and load cells” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “150 axial actuators and load cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “150 axial actuators and load cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “150 axial actuators and load cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。ESO 為拋光殘差保留約 ±120 N 主動力，約為天頂被動載重的 8%；若要把力設定誤差壓在主動預算的 1% 以內，每支力精度需約 1 N 或更好。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN. ESO reserves about ±120 N of active force for figuring errors, about 8% of the zenith passive load; keeping set-point errors within 1% of that active budget requires about 1 N force accuracy per actuator or better. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
