steps.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. Because edge sensors are relative, global piston, tip and tilt of the whole mirror are unobservable and are handed to telescope pointing and secondary focus; another mode, in which every segment tilts slightly radially to mimic a change of primary curvature, is seen only through the sensors' weak dihedral-angle sensitivity and suffers the largest noise amplification. Sensors only hold relative positions, so the absolute phasing zero must come from an optical measurement, and optical phase is unique only within one wavelength: this is the origin of the 2π ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器；36 片環狀排列共有 84 條共用邊，每邊 2 個感測器共 168 個量測，對 108 − 3 = 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators; the 36-segment ring layout has 84 shared edges, and two sensors per edge give 168 measurements, about 1.6 times over-determined for the 108 − 3 = 105 controllable degrees of freedom.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源
knowledge.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity
knowledge.text: 每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。
knowledge.textEn: Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. Because edge sensors are relative, global piston, tip and tilt of the whole mirror are unobservable and are handed to telescope pointing and secondary focus; another mode, in which every segment tilts slightly radially to mimic a change of primary curvature, is seen only through the sensors' weak dihedral-angle sensitivity and suffers the largest noise amplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity" is correct?
options: 邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。
感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。
每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。
optionsEn: All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased.
A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely.
Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims.
quiz.explanation: 每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器；36 片環狀排列共有 84 條共用邊，每邊 2 個感測器共 168 個量測，對 108 − 3 = 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。ELT：ESO 2020 年公告 798 片 × 3 = 2,394 支致動器與 4,608 個邊緣感測器。以 SVD 重建時，若最弱模態的奇異值只有最強者的 1/30，該模態的感測雜訊約被放大 30 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators; the 36-segment ring layout has 84 shared edges, and two sensors per edge give 168 measurements, about 1.6 times over-determined for the 108 − 3 = 105 controllable degrees of freedom. ELT: ESO's 2020 announcement lists 798 × 3 = 2,394 actuators and 4,608 edge sensors. In an SVD reconstructor, a weakest mode whose singular value is 1/30 of the strongest has its sensor noise amplified about 30 times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由幾何建立感測器對致動器的響應矩陣，再在鏡上逐一推動每支致動器、記錄所有感測器輸出，比對量測矩陣與模型；對矩陣做 SVD，列出奇異值頻譜，確認恰有三個零奇異值（整體 piston、tip、tilt），並找出最弱的曲率類模態，評估其雜訊放大。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the sensor-to-actuator response matrix from geometry, then poke each actuator on the mirror in turn and record every sensor to compare the measured matrix with the model; decompose the matrix by SVD, list the singular-value spectrum, confirm exactly three zero singular values for global piston, tip and tilt, and identify the weakest curvature-like mode to assess its noise amplification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器；36 片環狀排列共有 84 條共用邊，每邊 2 個感測器共 168 個量測，對 108 − 3 = 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。ELT：ESO 2020 年公告 798 片 × 3 = 2,394 支致動器與 4,608 個邊緣感測器。以 SVD 重建時，若最弱模態的奇異值只有最強者的 1/30，該模態的感測雜訊約被放大 30 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators; the 36-segment ring layout has 84 shared edges, and two sensors per edge give 168 measurements, about 1.6 times over-determined for the 108 − 3 = 105 controllable degrees of freedom. ELT: ESO's 2020 announcement lists 798 × 3 = 2,394 actuators and 4,608 edge sensors. In an SVD reconstructor, a weakest mode whose singular value is 1/30 of the strongest has its sensor noise amplified about 30 times.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity", which statement holds?
options: Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器。
單一波長的干涉量測就能唯一決定任意大小的段鏡階差。
自適應光學會自動修掉段鏡之間的階差，所以主鏡共相不必太精確。
optionsEn: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators.
Single-wavelength interferometry uniquely determines a segment step of any size.
Adaptive optics automatically removes steps between segments, so primary phasing need not be precise.
quiz.explanation: Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器；36 片環狀排列共有 84 條共用邊，每邊 2 個感測器共 168 個量測，對 108 − 3 = 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators; the 36-segment ring layout has 84 shared edges, and two sensors per edge give 168 measurements, about 1.6 times over-determined for the 108 − 3 = 105 controllable degrees of freedom. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 由幾何建立感測器對致動器的響應矩陣，再在鏡上逐一推動每支致動器、記錄所有感測器輸出，比對量測矩陣與模型；對矩陣做 SVD，列出奇異值頻譜，確認恰有三個零奇異值（整體 piston、tip、tilt），並找出最弱的曲率類模態，評估其雜訊放大。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the sensor-to-actuator response matrix from geometry, then poke each actuator on the mirror in turn and record every sensor to compare the measured matrix with the model; decompose the matrix by SVD, list the singular-value spectrum, confirm exactly three zero singular values for global piston, tip and tilt, and identify the weakest curvature-like mode to assess its noise amplification. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若重建器沒有排除不可觀測模態，量測雜訊與數值誤差會讓整面鏡緩慢累積整體 piston 或 tip/tilt，直到致動器行程耗盡；最弱的曲率模態若未加權處理，會隨溫度漂移讓影像離焦，而邊緣感測器讀數看起來一切正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the reconstructor does not exclude the unobservable modes, measurement noise and numerical error slowly accumulate global piston or tip/tilt until actuator stroke runs out; an unweighted weakest curvature mode drifts with temperature and defocuses the image while every edge-sensor reading looks normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由幾何建立感測器對致動器的響應矩陣，再在鏡上逐一推動每支致動器、記錄所有感測器輸出，比對量測矩陣與模型；對矩陣做 SVD，列出奇異值頻譜，確認恰有三個零奇異值（整體 piston、tip、tilt），並找出最弱的曲率類模態，評估其雜訊放大。
knowledge.textEn: Build the sensor-to-actuator response matrix from geometry, then poke each actuator on the mirror in turn and record every sensor to compare the measured matrix with the model; decompose the matrix by SVD, list the singular-value spectrum, confirm exactly three zero singular values for global piston, tip and tilt, and identify the weakest curvature-like mode to assess its noise amplification.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
由幾何建立感測器對致動器的響應矩陣，再在鏡上逐一推動每支致動器、記錄所有感測器輸出，比對量測矩陣與模型。
更換段鏡只是機械工作，裝回原位即可，不需重新共相。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Build the sensor-to-actuator response matrix from geometry, then poke each actuator on the mirror in turn and record every sensor to compare the measured matrix with the model.
Exchanging a segment is purely mechanical; putting it back needs no re-phasing.
quiz.explanation: 由幾何建立感測器對致動器的響應矩陣，再在鏡上逐一推動每支致動器、記錄所有感測器輸出，比對量測矩陣與模型；對矩陣做 SVD，列出奇異值頻譜，確認恰有三個零奇異值（整體 piston、tip、tilt），並找出最弱的曲率類模態，評估其雜訊放大。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the sensor-to-actuator response matrix from geometry, then poke each actuator on the mirror in turn and record every sensor to compare the measured matrix with the model; decompose the matrix by SVD, list the singular-value spectrum, confirm exactly three zero singular values for global piston, tip and tilt, and identify the weakest curvature-like mode to assess its noise amplification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若重建器沒有排除不可觀測模態，量測雜訊與數值誤差會讓整面鏡緩慢累積整體 piston 或 tip/tilt，直到致動器行程耗盡；最弱的曲率模態若未加權處理，會隨溫度漂移讓影像離焦，而邊緣感測器讀數看起來一切正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the reconstructor does not exclude the unobservable modes, measurement noise and numerical error slowly accumulate global piston or tip/tilt until actuator stroke runs out; an unweighted weakest curvature mode drifts with temperature and defocuses the image while every edge-sensor reading looks normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sensors only hold relative positions, so the absolute phasing zero must come from an optical measurement, and optical phase is unique only within one wavelength: this is the origin of the 2π ambiguity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若重建器沒有排除不可觀測模態，量測雜訊與數值誤差會讓整面鏡緩慢累積整體 piston 或 tip/tilt，直到致動器行程耗盡；最弱的曲率模態若未加權處理，會隨溫度漂移讓影像離焦，而邊緣感測器讀數看起來一切正常。
knowledge.textEn: If the reconstructor does not exclude the unobservable modes, measurement noise and numerical error slowly accumulate global piston or tip/tilt until actuator stroke runs out; an unweighted weakest curvature mode drifts with temperature and defocuses the image while every edge-sensor reading looks normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。
若重建器沒有排除不可觀測模態，量測雜訊與數值誤差會讓整面鏡緩慢累積整體 piston 或 tip/tilt，直到致動器行程耗盡。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely.
If the reconstructor does not exclude the unobservable modes, measurement noise and numerical error slowly accumulate global piston or tip/tilt until actuator stroke runs out.
quiz.explanation: 若重建器沒有排除不可觀測模態，量測雜訊與數值誤差會讓整面鏡緩慢累積整體 piston 或 tip/tilt，直到致動器行程耗盡；最弱的曲率模態若未加權處理，會隨溫度漂移讓影像離焦，而邊緣感測器讀數看起來一切正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the reconstructor does not exclude the unobservable modes, measurement noise and numerical error slowly accumulate global piston or tip/tilt until actuator stroke runs out; an unweighted weakest curvature mode drifts with temperature and defocuses the image while every edge-sensor reading looks normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝」與「段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Edge sensors: sensitivity, thermal and humidity drift, mounting" and "Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Edge sensors: sensitivity, thermal and humidity drift, mounting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電容式邊緣感測器」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capacitive edge sensor” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 使用電容式邊緣感測器：一片段鏡邊緣裝驅動電極，相鄰段鏡裝感測電極，兩片的相對高度改變重疊面積或間隙，進而改變電容。奈米級解析對應的電容變化只有 aF 等級，所以感測器採差動或比例量測並以鎖相偵測抑制雜訊。真正困難的是長期穩定：支架熱膨脹、空氣濕度改變介電常數與電極污染都會產生看似真實的高度變化，而控制迴路會忠實地把這些漂移變成真實的段鏡移動。ELT 的感測器另外量測段鏡間隙與剪切。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容式邊緣感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Keck uses capacitive edge sensors: a drive electrode on one segment's edge faces a sense electrode on its neighbour, and a change in relative height alters overlap area or gap and hence capacitance. Nanometre resolution corresponds to attofarad changes, so the sensors use differential or ratiometric measurement with lock-in detection to suppress noise. The real difficulty is long-term stability: bracket thermal expansion, humidity-driven changes in air permittivity and electrode contamination all create apparent height changes, and the control loop faithfully converts these drifts into real segment motion. The ELT sensors additionally measure intersegment gap and shear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Capacitive edge sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：剪切式電容 C = ε₀·w·h/g：電極寬 w = 50 mm、重疊高 h = 10 mm、間隙 g = 2 mm（教學假設），C ≈ 2.2 pF，dC/dh = ε₀·w/g ≈ 0.22 aF/nm，1 nm 對應 ΔC/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁷。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Shear-type capacitance C = ε₀·w·h/g: with electrode width w = 50 mm, overlap h = 10 mm and gap g = 2 mm (teaching assumptions), C ≈ 2.2 pF and dC/dh = ε₀·w/g ≈ 0.22 aF/nm, so 1 nm corresponds to ΔC/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁷.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝
knowledge.titleEn: Edge sensors: sensitivity, thermal and humidity drift, mounting
knowledge.text: Keck 使用電容式邊緣感測器：一片段鏡邊緣裝驅動電極，相鄰段鏡裝感測電極，兩片的相對高度改變重疊面積或間隙，進而改變電容。奈米級解析對應的電容變化只有 aF 等級，所以感測器採差動或比例量測並以鎖相偵測抑制雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: Keck uses capacitive edge sensors: a drive electrode on one segment's edge faces a sense electrode on its neighbour, and a change in relative height alters overlap area or gap and hence capacitance. Nanometre resolution corresponds to attofarad changes, so the sensors use differential or ratiometric measurement with lock-in detection to suppress noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

steps.title: 邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Edge sensors: sensitivity, thermal and humidity drift, mounting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電容式邊緣感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Capacitive edge sensor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：剪切式電容 C = ε₀·w·h/g：電極寬 w = 50 mm、重疊高 h = 10 mm、間隙 g = 2 mm（教學假設），C ≈ 2.2 pF，dC/dh = ε₀·w/g ≈ 0.22 aF/nm，1 nm 對應 ΔC/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁷。支架長 50 mm、CTE 1 ppm/K 時每 1 K 漂移約 50 nm；改用 Zerodur（0.05 ppm/K）則約 2.5 nm/K，說明安裝材料與溫度補償的必要。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Shear-type capacitance C = ε₀·w·h/g: with electrode width w = 50 mm, overlap h = 10 mm and gap g = 2 mm (teaching assumptions), C ≈ 2.2 pF and dC/dh = ε₀·w/g ≈ 0.22 aF/nm, so 1 nm corresponds to ΔC/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁷. A 50 mm bracket with CTE 1 ppm/K drifts about 50 nm per kelvin, whereas Zerodur at 0.05 ppm/K gives about 2.5 nm/K, showing why mounting material and temperature compensation matter. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在溫濕度可控的測試台上把一對感測器固定在已知相對位置，掃描溫度與濕度並記錄輸出，求溫度係數與濕度係數；再以干涉儀作參考掃描相對高度，得到增益與線性度；安裝後長期比對感測器讀數與共相相機量測之差，估計實際漂移率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a test stand with controlled temperature and humidity, fix a sensor pair at a known relative position, sweep temperature and humidity, and record the output to obtain temperature and humidity coefficients; scan the relative height against an interferometer reference to obtain gain and linearity; after installation, compare sensor readings with phasing-camera measurements over the long term to estimate the real drift rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Edge sensors: sensitivity, thermal and humidity drift, mounting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電容式邊緣感測器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Capacitive edge sensor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在溫濕度可控的測試台上把一對感測器固定在已知相對位置，掃描溫度與濕度並記錄輸出，求溫度係數與濕度係數；再以干涉儀作參考掃描相對高度，得到增益與線性度；安裝後長期比對感測器讀數與共相相機量測之差，估計實際漂移率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a test stand with controlled temperature and humidity, fix a sensor pair at a known relative position, sweep temperature and humidity, and record the output to obtain temperature and humidity coefficients; scan the relative height against an interferometer reference to obtain gain and linearity; after installation, compare sensor readings with phasing-camera measurements over the long term to estimate the real drift rate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雨季濕度上升使感測器讀數產生 20 nm 等級的偏移，控制迴路據此移動段鏡，在乾燥夜晚校正好的共相狀態被悄悄破壞，影像暈圈變亮；若電極被灰塵或冷凝污染，單一感測器的跳動會透過重建器擴散到鄰近數片段鏡。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Rising humidity in the wet season shifts sensor readings by about 20 nm, the loop moves the segments accordingly, the phasing calibrated on a dry night is silently destroyed and the halo brightens; if dust or condensation contaminates an electrode, one sensor's jumps spread through the reconstructor to several neighbouring segments.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正
knowledge.titleEn: Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction
knowledge.text: 每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。
knowledge.textEn: Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction" is correct?
options: 致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。
每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲。
單一波長的干涉量測就能唯一決定任意大小的段鏡階差。
optionsEn: With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter.
Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight.
Single-wavelength interferometry uniquely determines a segment step of any size.
quiz.explanation: 每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。風載：ELT 段鏡對角 1.4 m、面積約 1.27 m²，圓頂內風速 3 m/s、空氣密度 0.9 kg/m³，動壓 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa、總力約 5.2 N；若 30% 為擾動，1.5 N 在 100 N/µm 的支撐剛性（教學假設）下造成約 15 nm 的 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits. Wind: an ELT segment 1.4 m across corners has about 1.27 m² of area; with 3 m/s wind inside the dome and air density 0.9 kg/m³ the dynamic pressure 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa gives about 5.2 N; if 30% of that fluctuates, 1.5 N on a 100 N/µm support stiffness (teaching assumption) produces about 15 nm of piston jitter. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在測試台以干涉儀量致動器的步進、遲滯與長期蠕變，並以激振器量段鏡在支撐上的頻率響應，取得剛性與第一共振頻率；在望遠鏡上比對風速計讀數與邊緣感測器高頻頻譜的相關性，估計風載項的大小。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance; on the telescope correlate anemometer readings with the high-frequency spectrum of the edge sensors to size the wind term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。風載：ELT 段鏡對角 1.4 m、面積約 1.27 m²，圓頂內風速 3 m/s、空氣密度 0.9 kg/m³，動壓 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa、總力約 5.2 N；若 30% 為擾動，1.5 N 在 100 N/µm 的支撐剛性（教學假設）下造成約 15 nm 的 piston 抖動。
knowledge.textEn: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits. Wind: an ELT segment 1.4 m across corners has about 1.27 m² of area; with 3 m/s wind inside the dome and air density 0.9 kg/m³ the dynamic pressure 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa gives about 5.2 N; if 30% of that fluctuates, 1.5 N on a 100 N/µm support stiffness (teaching assumption) produces about 15 nm of piston jitter.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction", which statement holds?
options: 自適應光學會自動修掉段鏡之間的階差，所以主鏡共相不必太精確。
每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。
ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。
optionsEn: Adaptive optics automatically removes steps between segments, so primary phasing need not be precise.
If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited.
The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits.
quiz.explanation: ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在測試台以干涉儀量致動器的步進、遲滯與長期蠕變，並以激振器量段鏡在支撐上的頻率響應，取得剛性與第一共振頻率；在望遠鏡上比對風速計讀數與邊緣感測器高頻頻譜的相關性，估計風載項的大小。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance; on the telescope correlate anemometer readings with the high-frequency spectrum of the edge sensors to size the wind term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：致動器遲滯或背隙使小步修正失效，控制迴路持續在兩個位置間跳動形成極限環，感測器讀數呈鋸齒狀；whiffletree 樞軸卡滯時段鏡在仰角變化下產生像散，即使三點位置正確，該段的繞射暈仍異常明亮。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Actuator hysteresis or backlash defeats small corrections, the loop hops between two positions in a limit cycle and sensor readings show a sawtooth; a sticking whiffletree pivot lets the segment develop astigmatism as elevation changes, so its diffraction halo stays unusually bright even though its three-point position is correct.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在測試台以干涉儀量致動器的步進、遲滯與長期蠕變，並以激振器量段鏡在支撐上的頻率響應，取得剛性與第一共振頻率；在望遠鏡上比對風速計讀數與邊緣感測器高頻頻譜的相關性，估計風載項的大小。
knowledge.textEn: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance; on the telescope correlate anemometer readings with the high-frequency spectrum of the edge sensors to size the wind term.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction"?
options: 在測試台以干涉儀量致動器的步進、遲滯與長期蠕變，並以激振器量段鏡在支撐上的頻率響應，取得剛性與第一共振頻率。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。
optionsEn: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased.

quiz.explanationEn: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance; on the telescope correlate anemometer readings with the high-frequency spectrum of the edge sensors to size the wind term. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 致動器遲滯或背隙使小步修正失效，控制迴路持續在兩個位置間跳動形成極限環，感測器讀數呈鋸齒狀；whiffletree 樞軸卡滯時段鏡在仰角變化下產生像散，即使三點位置正確，該段的繞射暈仍異常明亮。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Actuator hysteresis or backlash defeats small corrections, the loop hops between two positions in a limit cycle and sensor readings show a sawtooth; a sticking whiffletree pivot lets the segment develop astigmatism as elevation changes, so its diffraction halo stays unusually bright even though its three-point position is correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 致動器遲滯或背隙使小步修正失效，控制迴路持續在兩個位置間跳動形成極限環，感測器讀數呈鋸齒狀；whiffletree 樞軸卡滯時段鏡在仰角變化下產生像散，即使三點位置正確，該段的繞射暈仍異常明亮。
knowledge.textEn: Actuator hysteresis or backlash defeats small corrections, the loop hops between two positions in a limit cycle and sensor readings show a sawtooth; a sticking whiffletree pivot lets the segment develop astigmatism as elevation changes, so its diffraction halo stays unusually bright even though its three-point position is correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segment support: actuator stroke, stiffness and figure correction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

單一波長的干涉量測就能唯一決定任意大小的段鏡階差。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長」與「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength" and "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 的共相相機在瞳面放置跨越段鏡邊界的小圓孔，每個孔同時收集兩片段鏡的光並形成一個繞射影像，兩片之間的 piston 階差會改變干涉圖樣的形狀。單一窄頻波長下，相位只在 λ/2（表面）範圍內唯一，超出就產生 2π 模糊；寬頻光的相干長度短，干涉對比隨階差衰減，可在數十微米範圍內粗略定出零點；雙波長則以合成波長 Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| 擴大唯一範圍。實務上先寬頻捕獲，再窄頻精調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Keck phasing camera places small circular apertures across intersegment edges in the pupil; each aperture collects light from two segments and forms one diffraction image whose shape changes with the piston step between them. At a single narrowband wavelength the phase is unique only within λ/2 of surface height, beyond which the 2π ambiguity appears; broadband light has a short coherence length, so fringe contrast decays with step size and locates the zero coarsely over tens of micrometres; two wavelengths form a synthetic wavelength Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| that extends the unique range. In practice segments are captured broadband first and then refined narrowband. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：窄頻 λ = 0.85 µm：表面唯一範圍 ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一波長的干涉量測就能唯一決定任意大小的段鏡階差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Single-wavelength interferometry uniquely determines a segment step of any size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：窄頻 λ = 0.85 µm：表面唯一範圍 ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm。雙波長 0.80 與 0.85 µm：Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm，表面範圍擴到 ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm。寬頻 Δλ = 0.2 µm 的相干長度 L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm；Keck 寬頻演算法以多組濾光片把捕獲範圍擴到 ±30 µm，並收斂到約 30 nm 殘差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm. Dual wavelength at 0.80 and 0.85 µm: Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm, extending the surface range to ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm. Broadband with Δλ = 0.2 µm has coherence length L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm; the Keck broadband algorithm uses several filters to extend capture to ±30 µm and converges to about 30 nm residual. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm. Dual wavelength at 0.80 and 0.85 µm: Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm, extending the surface range to ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm. Broadband with Δλ = 0.2 µm has coherence length L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm; the Keck broadband algorithm uses several filters to extend capture to ±30 µm and converges to about 30 nm residual.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只用窄頻量測一片剛裝上、piston 誤差 0.5 µm 的段鏡，波前誤差 1.0 µm 被折疊成看似 0.075 µm 的小誤差，控制器修正後段鏡穩定鎖在錯誤的條紋上，相鄰段鏡也被重建器拉偏，整面鏡出現難以診斷的階梯。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring a newly installed segment with 0.5 µm of piston using narrowband light alone folds its 1.0 µm wavefront error into an apparent 0.075 µm, the controller locks the segment onto the wrong fringe, the reconstructor drags its neighbours off as well, and the mirror develops a hard-to-diagnose staircase.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。
knowledge.textEn: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.explanationEn: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若只用窄頻量測一片剛裝上、piston 誤差 0.5 µm 的段鏡，波前誤差 1.0 µm 被折疊成看似 0.075 µm 的小誤差，控制器修正後段鏡穩定鎖在錯誤的條紋上，相鄰段鏡也被重建器拉偏，整面鏡出現難以診斷的階梯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring a newly installed segment with 0.5 µm of piston using narrowband light alone folds its 1.0 µm wavefront error into an apparent 0.075 µm, the controller locks the segment onto the wrong fringe, the reconstructor drags its neighbours off as well, and the mirror develops a hard-to-diagnose staircase. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor set-points and phasing budget” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 共相相機只能在望遠鏡指向亮星時偶爾使用，平時主鏡靠邊緣感測器的設定點維持形狀：先以光學量測把主鏡共相，再記錄當時全部感測器的讀數作為目標值，迴路此後只負責維持這組讀數。因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The phasing camera can be used only occasionally while the telescope points at a bright star, so most of the time the mirror is held by edge-sensor set points: the primary is phased optically, every sensor reading at that moment is recorded as its target, and the loop thereafter only maintains those readings. The error budget therefore contains sensor noise amplified by the reconstructor, sensor drift between calibrations, phasing-camera measurement error, actuator resolution and wind disturbance, added root-sum-square and converted to Strehl to decide how often to recalibrate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor set-points and phasing budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面 piston RMS 預算（教學假設）：感測器雜訊經放大 3 nm、校正間漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS ≈ 24 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「共相只需要在建造完成時做一次，之後感測器會永遠維持。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Phasing is done once at commissioning and the sensors maintain it forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensor set-points and phasing budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor set-points and phasing budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面 piston RMS 預算（教學假設）：感測器雜訊經放大 3 nm、校正間漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS ≈ 24 nm。Strehl = exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]：2.2 µm 約 0.98、1.65 µm 約 0.97、1.0 µm 約 0.91。若漂移項增為 40 nm，RSS ≈ 44 nm，1.0 µm 的 Strehl 降到約 0.74，就是需要更頻繁校正的訊號。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm. Strehl = exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.97 at 1.65 µm and 0.91 at 1.0 µm. If drift grows to 40 nm, RSS ≈ 44 nm and Strehl at 1.0 µm falls to about 0.74, the signal that calibration must become more frequent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在兩次完整校正之間每隔數小時抽量部分段鏡邊界，畫實測階差對時間、溫度與濕度的漂移曲線；把長期統計填入預算表各項，檢查漂移項是否主導，據此訂出重新校正的間隔與觸發條件，例如溫度變化超過某個門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Between full calibrations, spot-check a subset of edges every few hours and plot measured steps against time, temperature and humidity; enter long-term statistics into each budget line, check whether drift dominates, and set the recalibration interval and triggers, such as a temperature change beyond a threshold, accordingly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm. Strehl = exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.97 at 1.65 µm and 0.91 at 1.0 µm. If drift grows to 40 nm, RSS ≈ 44 nm and Strehl at 1.0 µm falls to about 0.74, the signal that calibration must become more frequent.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", which statement holds?
options: 每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。
表面 piston RMS 預算（教學假設）：感測器雜訊經放大 3 nm、校正間漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS ≈ 24 nm。
感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。
optionsEn: If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited.
Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm.
A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 表面 piston RMS 預算（教學假設）：感測器雜訊經放大 3 nm、校正間漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS ≈ 24 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor set-points and phasing budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在兩次完整校正之間每隔數小時抽量部分段鏡邊界，畫實測階差對時間、溫度與濕度的漂移曲線；把長期統計填入預算表各項，檢查漂移項是否主導，據此訂出重新校正的間隔與觸發條件，例如溫度變化超過某個門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Between full calibrations, spot-check a subset of edges every few hours and plot measured steps against time, temperature and humidity; enter long-term statistics into each budget line, check whether drift dominates, and set the recalibration interval and triggers, such as a temperature change beyond a threshold, accordingly. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若校正只在溫度穩定的夜晚做一次就長期沿用，感測器溫度係數造成的漂移隨季節累積，影像品質逐月下降，而所有感測器讀數仍緊貼設定點，讓人誤以為主鏡狀態良好。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If calibration is done once on a thermally stable night and then reused indefinitely, drift from the sensors' temperature coefficients accumulates with the seasons and image quality declines month by month, while every sensor still sits on its set point and the mirror appears healthy.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在兩次完整校正之間每隔數小時抽量部分段鏡邊界，畫實測階差對時間、溫度與濕度的漂移曲線；把長期統計填入預算表各項，檢查漂移項是否主導，據此訂出重新校正的間隔與觸發條件，例如溫度變化超過某個門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Between full calibrations, spot-check a subset of edges every few hours and plot measured steps against time, temperature and humidity; enter long-term statistics into each budget line, check whether drift dominates, and set the recalibration interval and triggers, such as a temperature change beyond a threshold, accordingly.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。

quiz.explanationEn: Between full calibrations, spot-check a subset of edges every few hours and plot measured steps against time, temperature and humidity; enter long-term statistics into each budget line, check whether drift dominates, and set the recalibration interval and triggers, such as a temperature change beyond a threshold, accordingly. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instructionEn: If calibration is done once on a thermally stable night and then reused indefinitely, drift from the sensors' temperature coefficients accumulates with the seasons and image quality declines month by month, while every sensor still sits on its set point and the mirror appears healthy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「共相只需要在建造完成時做一次，之後感測器會永遠維持。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Phasing is done once at commissioning and the sensors maintain it forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 若校正只在溫度穩定的夜晚做一次就長期沿用，感測器溫度係數造成的漂移隨季節累積，影像品質逐月下降，而所有感測器讀數仍緊貼設定點，讓人誤以為主鏡狀態良好。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
