knowledge.text: 焦面位移 δ ≈ f²/L：等效焦距 f ≈ 120 m、L = 90 km 時 δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm；天頂角 30° 時 L ≈ 104 km、δ ≈ 139 mm，追蹤一夜要移動 20 mm 以上。鈉層高度變化 1 km 對 8.2 m 口徑產生的離焦 PV = (D²/8)(1/H − 1/(H + ΔH)) ≈ 8.4 m² × 1.22×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ ≈ 1.03 µm，RMS ≈ 0.30 µm；對 39 m 口徑 PV 約 23 µm。
knowledge.textEn: Focal shift δ ≈ f²/L: with an effective focal length f ≈ 120 m and L = 90 km, δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm; at 30° zenith angle L ≈ 104 km and δ ≈ 139 mm, so tracking over a night moves the stage by more than 20 mm. A 1 km change in sodium altitude produces defocus PV = (D²/8)(1/H − 1/(H + ΔH)) ≈ 8.4 m² × 1.22×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ ≈ 1.03 µm on an 8.2 m aperture, about 0.30 µm RMS, and about 23 µm PV on a 39 m aperture.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing", which statement holds?
options: 鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
焦面位移 δ ≈ f²/L：等效焦距 f ≈ 120 m、L = 90 km 時 δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。
optionsEn: The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.
Focal shift δ ≈ f²/L: with an effective focal length f ≈ 120 m and L = 90 km, δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
quiz.explanation: 焦面位移 δ ≈ f²/L：等效焦距 f ≈ 120 m、L = 90 km 時 δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm；天頂角 30° 時 L ≈ 104 km、δ ≈ 139 mm，追蹤一夜要移動 20 mm 以上。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Focal shift δ ≈ f²/L: with an effective focal length f ≈ 120 m and L = 90 km, δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm; at 30° zenith angle L ≈ 104 km and δ ≈ 139 mm, so tracking over a night moves the stage by more than 20 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鈉層高度變化與焦距追蹤」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sodium altitude variations and focus tracking” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄鈉雷射雷達量到的鈉層重心高度與 LGS 感測器回報的離焦，求兩者的相關與比例係數，應與 D²/8 的幾何關係一致；再比較真值感測器開關前後科學影像的焦距漂移，確認低頻焦距由自然星決定，並檢查對焦平台位置是否隨 1/L 正確追蹤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the sodium centroid altitude from a lidar together with the defocus reported by the LGS sensor and derive their correlation and scale factor, which should match the D²/8 geometry; compare science-image focus drift with the truth sensor on and off to confirm that low-frequency focus is set by the natural star, and check that the focus-stage position tracks 1/L correctly. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時記錄鈉雷射雷達量到的鈉層重心高度與 LGS 感測器回報的離焦，求兩者的相關與比例係數，應與 D²/8 的幾何關係一致；再比較真值感測器開關前後科學影像的焦距漂移，確認低頻焦距由自然星決定，並檢查對焦平台位置是否隨 1/L 正確追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Log the sodium centroid altitude from a lidar together with the defocus reported by the LGS sensor and derive their correlation and scale factor, which should match the D²/8 geometry; compare science-image focus drift with the truth sensor on and off to confirm that low-frequency focus is set by the natural star, and check that the focus-stage position tracks 1/L correctly.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
同時記錄鈉雷射雷達量到的鈉層重心高度與 LGS 感測器回報的離焦，求兩者的相關與比例係數，應與 D²/8 的幾何關係一致。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.
Log the sodium centroid altitude from a lidar together with the defocus reported by the LGS sensor and derive their correlation and scale factor, which should match the D²/8 geometry.
quiz.explanation: 同時記錄鈉雷射雷達量到的鈉層重心高度與 LGS 感測器回報的離焦，求兩者的相關與比例係數，應與 D²/8 的幾何關係一致；再比較真值感測器開關前後科學影像的焦距漂移，確認低頻焦距由自然星決定，並檢查對焦平台位置是否隨 1/L 正確追蹤。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the sodium centroid altitude from a lidar together with the defocus reported by the LGS sensor and derive their correlation and scale factor, which should match the D²/8 geometry; compare science-image focus drift with the truth sensor on and off to confirm that low-frequency focus is set by the natural star, and check that the focus-stage position tracks 1/L correctly. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鈉層高度變化與焦距追蹤」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sodium altitude variations and focus tracking” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解法是讓 LGS 迴路的離焦只作為快速的相對量，再以自然星的低階真值感測器慢速校正絕對焦距，同一顆自然星通常也提供 tip-tilt。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The remedy is to treat LGS defocus only as a fast relative quantity and to correct absolute focus slowly with a natural-star low-order truth sensor, the same natural star that usually supplies tip-tilt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。
knowledge.textEn: Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。
optionsEn: Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合」與「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration" and "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「多雷射星組與斷層重建」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。VLT UT4 的 4LGSF 以四道 22 W 雷射服務 MUSE 與 HAWK-I 的自適應光學模組。多雷射同時運轉帶來新的整合問題：連續波雷射在低空的瑞利散射光柱會落進其他雷射的感測器視場形成互擾，各雷射的指向、功率與偏振必須一致，而星組幾何決定高層湍流的覆蓋程度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多雷射星組與斷層重建」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction. The 4LGSF on VLT UT4 uses four 22 W lasers to serve the adaptive-optics modules of MUSE and HAWK-I. Running several lasers at once creates new integration issues: the low-altitude Rayleigh plume of each continuous-wave beam falls into other lasers' sensor fields as cross-talk, pointing, power and polarisation must match across lasers, and asterism geometry sets how well high layers are covered. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「多雷射星組與斷層重建」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合
knowledge.text: 單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。VLT UT4 的 4LGSF 以四道 22 W 雷射服務 MUSE 與 HAWK-I 的自適應光學模組。
knowledge.textEn: The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction. The 4LGSF on VLT UT4 uses four 22 W lasers to serve the adaptive-optics modules of MUSE and HAWK-I.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration" is correct?
options: 雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。
單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。
雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。
optionsEn: More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.

The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction.
Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination.
quiz.explanation: 單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多雷射星組與斷層重建」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。足跡同時縮小為 D(1 − h/H)，h = 15 km 時為 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m。若四顆導引星位於半徑 30″ 的方形頂點，15 km 層的四個足跡各自錯開約 2 m，在目標方向的 6.8 m 圓內留下覆蓋較薄的區域，限制高層修正品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km. The footprint also shrinks to D(1 − h/H), 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m at 15 km. With four beacons at the corners of a square of radius 30″, the four footprints on the 15 km layer are offset by about 2 m each, leaving thinly covered regions inside the 6.8 m target circle that limit high-layer correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能；在天上逐一開關各雷射，量其他感測器的背景變化，建立互擾地圖與對應的子孔徑遮罩；比較單雷射與多雷射模式的 Strehl 與視場內均勻性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles; on sky switch each laser on and off in turn, measure the background change in the other sensors, and build a cross-talk map with matching subaperture masks; compare Strehl and field uniformity between single-laser and multi-laser modes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。足跡同時縮小為 D(1 − h/H)，h = 15 km 時為 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m。若四顆導引星位於半徑 30″ 的方形頂點，15 km 層的四個足跡各自錯開約 2 m，在目標方向的 6.8 m 圓內留下覆蓋較薄的區域，限制高層修正品質。
knowledge.textEn: A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km. The footprint also shrinks to D(1 − h/H), 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m at 15 km. With four beacons at the corners of a square of radius 30″, the four footprints on the 15 km layer are offset by about 2 m each, leaving thinly covered regions inside the 6.8 m target circle that limit high-layer correction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration", which statement holds?
options: 有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。
鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。
optionsEn: With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.
Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.
A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km.
quiz.explanation: 離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「多雷射星組與斷層重建」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能；在天上逐一開關各雷射，量其他感測器的背景變化，建立互擾地圖與對應的子孔徑遮罩；比較單雷射與多雷射模式的 Strehl 與視場內均勻性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles; on sky switch each laser on and off in turn, measure the background change in the other sensors, and build a cross-talk map with matching subaperture masks; compare Strehl and field uniformity between single-laser and multi-laser modes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影；某道雷射功率偏低而斷層權重未調整時，該方向的雜訊會污染整個重建。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions; if one laser runs low in power and the tomographic weights are not adjusted, noise from that direction contaminates the whole reconstruction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能；在天上逐一開關各雷射，量其他感測器的背景變化，建立互擾地圖與對應的子孔徑遮罩；比較單雷射與多雷射模式的 Strehl 與視場內均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles; on sky switch each laser on and off in turn, measure the background change in the other sensors, and build a cross-talk map with matching subaperture masks; compare Strehl and field uniformity between single-laser and multi-laser modes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration"?
options: 以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。
optionsEn: Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能；在天上逐一開關各雷射，量其他感測器的背景變化，建立互擾地圖與對應的子孔徑遮罩；比較單雷射與多雷射模式的 Strehl 與視場內均勻性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles; on sky switch each laser on and off in turn, measure the background change in the other sensors, and build a cross-talk map with matching subaperture masks; compare Strehl and field uniformity between single-laser and multi-laser modes. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多雷射星組與斷層重建」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影；某道雷射功率偏低而斷層權重未調整時，該方向的雜訊會污染整個重建。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions; if one laser runs low in power and the tomographic weights are not adjusted, noise from that direction contaminates the whole reconstruction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多雷射同時運轉帶來新的整合問題：連續波雷射在低空的瑞利散射光柱會落進其他雷射的感測器視場形成互擾，各雷射的指向、功率與偏振必須一致，而星組幾何決定高層湍流的覆蓋程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Running several lasers at once creates new integration issues: the low-altitude Rayleigh plume of each continuous-wave beam falls into other lasers' sensor fields as cross-talk, pointing, power and polarisation must match across lasers, and asterism geometry sets how well high layers are covered.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影；某道雷射功率偏低而斷層權重未調整時，該方向的雜訊會污染整個重建。
knowledge.textEn: Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions; if one laser runs low in power and the tomographic weights are not adjusted, noise from that direction contaminates the whole reconstruction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影。
雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions.
Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影；某道雷射功率偏低而斷層權重未調整時，該方向的雜訊會污染整個重建。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions; if one laser runs low in power and the tomographic weights are not adjusted, noise from that direction contaminates the whole reconstruction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射導引星的運轉必須遵守當地航空主管機關與天文台的安全規範：依核准程序協調空域，運轉中由觀察員或自動偵測系統在航機接近時中止發射，並依衛星協調單位提供的預測關閉時段暫停發射；這些是程序與紀錄要求，不是雷射操作細節。性能驗證則把前面各單元的模型對上天上的量測：回波通量、光點尺寸、LGS 與 NGS 模式的 Strehl、斷層重建的視場均勻性。交接文件要記錄雷射頻率與功率設定、偏振與回泵狀態、互擾遮罩、對焦追蹤參數與每晚的關閉事件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Laser guide-star operation must follow the rules of the local aviation authority and the observatory: airspace is coordinated under an approved procedure, propagation is halted by spotters or automatic detection systems when aircraft approach, and it is paused during predicted closure windows supplied by a satellite-coordination body; these are procedural and record-keeping requirements, not laser operating details. Performance validation matches the earlier models against on-sky data: return flux, spot size, Strehl in LGS and NGS modes and field uniformity of the tomographic reconstruction. The handoff file records laser frequency and power settings, polarisation and repump state, cross-talk masks, focus-tracking parameters and each night's closure events. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff
knowledge.text: 雷射導引星的運轉必須遵守當地航空主管機關與天文台的安全規範：依核准程序協調空域，運轉中由觀察員或自動偵測系統在航機接近時中止發射，並依衛星協調單位提供的預測關閉時段暫停發射；這些是程序與紀錄要求，不是雷射操作細節。性能驗證則把前面各單元的模型對上天上的量測：回波通量、光點尺寸、LGS 與 NGS 模式的 Strehl、斷層重建的視場均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: Laser guide-star operation must follow the rules of the local aviation authority and the observatory: airspace is coordinated under an approved procedure, propagation is halted by spotters or automatic detection systems when aircraft approach, and it is paused during predicted closure windows supplied by a satellite-coordination body; these are procedural and record-keeping requirements, not laser operating details. Performance validation matches the earlier models against on-sky data: return flux, spot size, Strehl in LGS and NGS modes and field uniformity of the tomographic reconstruction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff" is correct?
options: 雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。
鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
雷射導引星的運轉必須遵守當地航空主管機關與天文台的安全規範：依核准程序協調空域，運轉中由觀察員或自動偵測系統在航機接近時中止發射，並依衛星協調單位提供的預測關閉時段暫停發射。

Laser guide-star operation must follow the rules of the local aviation authority and the observatory: airspace is coordinated under an approved procedure, propagation is halted by spotters or automatic detection systems when aircraft approach, and it is paused during predicted closure windows supplied by a satellite-coordination body.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。比回波正規化：量得 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²)、出口功率 20 W、鈉柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻²，回波/功率 = 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W)，再除以以 10⁹ cm⁻² 為單位的柱密度 4，得 1×10⁵，可作為跨夜比較的系統健康指標。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each. Normalised return: with a measured 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²), 20 W output and a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻², return per watt is 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W), and dividing by the column density in units of 10⁹ cm⁻², 4, gives 1×10⁵, a system-health index comparable across nights. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻；驗收時對同一目標分別以 NGS AO 與 LGS AO 量 Strehl 與半高全寬，差異應符合錐效應與 tip-tilt 預算；安全協調紀錄由天文台安全負責人審核歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds; at acceptance measure Strehl and FWHM on the same target in NGS AO and LGS AO modes and confirm that the difference matches the cone-effect and tip-tilt budgets; the observatory safety officer reviews and archives the coordination records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。比回波正規化：量得 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²)、出口功率 20 W、鈉柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻²，回波/功率 = 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W)，再除以以 10⁹ cm⁻² 為單位的柱密度 4，得 1×10⁵，可作為跨夜比較的系統健康指標。
knowledge.textEn: Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each. Normalised return: with a measured 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²), 20 W output and a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻², return per watt is 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W), and dividing by the column density in units of 10⁹ cm⁻², 4, gives 1×10⁵, a system-health index comparable across nights.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。
LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。
optionsEn: Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻；驗收時對同一目標分別以 NGS AO 與 LGS AO 量 Strehl 與半高全寬，差異應符合錐效應與 tip-tilt 預算；安全協調紀錄由天文台安全負責人審核歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds; at acceptance measure Strehl and FWHM on the same target in NGS AO and LGS AO modes and confirm that the difference matches the cone-effect and tip-tilt budgets; the observatory safety officer reviews and archives the coordination records. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲；交接文件若缺少回泵與偏振設定，下一個團隊遇到回波下降時無從判斷是鈉層、雷射還是光路的問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition; a handoff file missing repump and polarisation settings leaves the next team unable to tell whether a return drop comes from the sodium layer, the laser or the optical path.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻；驗收時對同一目標分別以 NGS AO 與 LGS AO 量 Strehl 與半高全寬，差異應符合錐效應與 tip-tilt 預算；安全協調紀錄由天文台安全負責人審核歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds; at acceptance measure Strehl and FWHM on the same target in NGS AO and LGS AO modes and confirm that the difference matches the cone-effect and tip-tilt budgets; the observatory safety officer reviews and archives the coordination records.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻。
LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds.
LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed.
quiz.explanation: 每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻；驗收時對同一目標分別以 NGS AO 與 LGS AO 量 Strehl 與半高全寬，差異應符合錐效應與 tip-tilt 預算；安全協調紀錄由天文台安全負責人審核歸檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds; at acceptance measure Strehl and FWHM on the same target in NGS AO and LGS AO modes and confirm that the difference matches the cone-effect and tip-tilt budgets; the observatory safety officer reviews and archives the coordination records. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲；交接文件若缺少回泵與偏振設定，下一個團隊遇到回波下降時無從判斷是鈉層、雷射還是光路的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition; a handoff file missing repump and polarisation settings leaves the next team unable to tell whether a return drop comes from the sodium layer, the laser or the optical path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件要記錄雷射頻率與功率設定、偏振與回泵狀態、互擾遮罩、對焦追蹤參數與每晚的關閉事件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff file records laser frequency and power settings, polarisation and repump state, cross-talk masks, focus-tracking parameters and each night's closure events.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲；交接文件若缺少回泵與偏振設定，下一個團隊遇到回波下降時無從判斷是鈉層、雷射還是光路的問題。
knowledge.textEn: If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition; a handoff file missing repump and polarisation settings leaves the next team unable to tell whether a return drop comes from the sodium layer, the laser or the optical path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.
If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition.
quiz.explanation: 若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲；交接文件若缺少回泵與偏振設定，下一個團隊遇到回波下降時無從判斷是鈉層、雷射還是光路的問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition; a handoff file missing repump and polarisation settings leaves the next team unable to tell whether a return drop comes from the sodium layer, the laser or the optical path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 天文高解析光譜儀
summary: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。
summaryEn: Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 徑向速度預算練習：設計 R = 140 000、λ = 550 nm，每解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s = 18.7 nm。8.2 m 望遠鏡、1″ 光纖、R4 光柵需要 d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m 的準直光束。環境：0.1 m 鋁支架在 1 mK 漂移下貢獻 0.12 m/s，10⁻⁵ hPa 的穩定真空貢獻 0.8 mm/s 可忽略。光子雜訊：Q = 15 000、N_e = 4×10⁹，σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s。加入校正 0.10、光纖 0.10、偵測器 0.10、熱機構 0.12 m/s，總 RSS = √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s。要以 5σ 偵測半振幅 K = 0.09 m/s 的地球類行星，約需 N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 次獨立量測，且尚未計入恆星活動。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Radial-velocity budget exercise: design for R = 140 000 at λ = 550 nm with four 10 µm pixels per resolution element, giving 535 m/s per pixel and 1 m/s = 18.7 nm. An 8.2 m telescope with a 1″ fibre and an R4 grating needs a collimated beam d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m. Environment: a 0.1 m aluminium mount drifting 1 mK contributes 0.12 m/s, while a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa vacuum contributes a negligible 0.8 mm/s. Photon noise with Q = 15 000 and N_e = 4×10⁹ is σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s. Adding calibration 0.10, fibre 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.12 m/s gives a total RSS of √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s. Detecting an Earth analogue with semi-amplitude K = 0.09 m/s at 5σ then needs about N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 independent measurements, before stellar activity is considered. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」與「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" and "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Doppler shift of stellar lines” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doppler shift of stellar lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力
knowledge.text: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。
knowledge.textEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。
optionsEn: Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.
When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Doppler shift of stellar lines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。R = 140 000 時解析元素 Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm，相當於 c/R = 2141 m/s；若每個解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s 等於偵測器上 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，約為像素的 1/535。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm. At R = 140 000 the resolution element is Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm, equivalent to c/R = 2141 m/s; sampled by four 10 µm pixels each pixel spans 535 m/s, so 1 m/s is a line shift of 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm on the detector, about 1/535 of a pixel. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Doppler shift of stellar lines” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline. steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating. The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “R4 echelle and cross-disperser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散
knowledge.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion
knowledge.text: 階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion" is correct?
options: 階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。
optionsEn: A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion.
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.
An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ).
quiz.explanation: 階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。Littrow 下 m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6，取 m = 112，閃耀波長 548.2 nm，FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm。角色散 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm；相機焦距 0.70 m 時線色散 10.2 µm/pm，3.93 pm 的解析元素佔 40 µm，即 4 個 10 µm 像素。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°. In Littrow, m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6, so order 112 blazes at 548.2 nm with FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm. Angular dispersion is 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm; a 0.70 m camera gives 10.2 µm/pm, so a 3.93 pm resolution element covers 40 µm, four 10 µm pixels. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。Littrow 下 m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6，取 m = 112，閃耀波長 548.2 nm，FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm。角色散 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm；相機焦距 0.70 m 時線色散 10.2 µm/pm，3.93 pm 的解析元素佔 40 µm，即 4 個 10 µm 像素。
knowledge.textEn: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°. In Littrow, m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6, so order 112 blazes at 548.2 nm with FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm. Angular dispersion is 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm; a 0.70 m camera gives 10.2 µm/pm, so a 3.93 pm resolution element covers 40 µm, four 10 µm pixels.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion", which statement holds?
options: ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。
optionsEn: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.
CCD pixels form a perfect grid, so only wavelength needs calibrating.
quiz.explanation: 31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。
knowledge.textEn: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量。
重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin.
Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time.
quiz.explanation: 以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。
knowledge.textEn: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.

With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids.
quiz.explanation: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割」與「真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing" and "Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光纖饋入與擾頻器」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibre feed and scrambler” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 對狹縫限制的光譜儀，R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B：望遠鏡口徑 D_T 越大、天空孔徑 φ 越大，要維持同樣的 R 就需要越大的準直光束與光柵，這是 8 m 級望遠鏡高解析光譜儀體積龐大的根源。光纖把望遠鏡焦面與溫控光譜儀分開，並以擾頻讓輸出的近場與遠場不再跟隨輸入光點位置；八角形或方形芯光纖改善近場擾頻，雙擾頻器以透鏡交換近場與遠場。瞳切割與變形光學把光束切半或壓縮單一方向，等效縮小所需的光柵尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光纖饋入與擾頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large. Fibres separate the telescope focus from the thermally controlled spectrograph and scramble the light so the output near and far fields no longer follow the input spot position; octagonal or square cores improve near-field scrambling and a double scrambler swaps near and far fields with lenses. Pupil slicing and anamorphic optics split the beam or compress one axis, effectively shrinking the grating required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fibre feed and scrambler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad, D_T = 8.2 m and R4, R = 140 000 needs d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m and R = 190 000 needs 0.94 m, while a 3.6 m telescope at R = 115 000 needs only 0.25 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割
knowledge.titleEn: Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing
knowledge.text: 對狹縫限制的光譜儀，R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B：望遠鏡口徑 D_T 越大、天空孔徑 φ 越大，要維持同樣的 R 就需要越大的準直光束與光柵，這是 8 m 級望遠鏡高解析光譜儀體積龐大的根源。光纖把望遠鏡焦面與溫控光譜儀分開，並以擾頻讓輸出的近場與遠場不再跟隨輸入光點位置；八角形或方形芯光纖改善近場擾頻，雙擾頻器以透鏡交換近場與遠場。
knowledge.textEn: For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large. Fibres separate the telescope focus from the thermally controlled spectrograph and scramble the light so the output near and far fields no longer follow the input spot position; octagonal or square cores improve near-field scrambling and a double scrambler swaps near and far fields with lenses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。
optionsEn: For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large.
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.

steps.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光纖饋入與擾頻器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fibre feed and scrambler” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad、D_T = 8.2 m、R4：R = 140 000 需 d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m，R = 190 000 需 0.94 m；3.6 m 望遠鏡在 R = 115 000 只需 0.25 m。擾頻：導星誤差使光點移動 10% 狹縫寬時，無擾頻位移 0.1×c/R = 214 m/s，擾頻增益 10⁴ 時降為 2.1 cm/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad, D_T = 8.2 m and R4, R = 140 000 needs d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m and R = 190 000 needs 0.94 m, while a 3.6 m telescope at R = 115 000 needs only 0.25 m. Scrambling: a guiding error moving the spot by 10% of the slit width shifts lines by 0.1×c/R = 214 m/s unscrambled, but only 2.1 cm/s with a scrambling gain of 10⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗室把光點於光纖入口面逐步偏移，以光譜儀量譜線重心變化，或以相機直接拍攝輸出近場與遠場的光重心，擾頻增益等於輸入相對位移除以輸出相對位移；同時量測焦比劣化，確認輸出光錐不超出準直鏡接受角而造成光損與照明變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the lab, step the spot across the fibre entrance and measure the line-centroid change with the spectrograph, or image the output near and far fields directly with a camera; scrambling gain is the relative input displacement divided by the relative output displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: With φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad, D_T = 8.2 m and R4, R = 140 000 needs d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m and R = 190 000 needs 0.94 m, while a 3.6 m telescope at R = 115 000 needs only 0.25 m. Scrambling: a guiding error moving the spot by 10% of the slit width shifts lines by 0.1×c/R = 214 m/s unscrambled, but only 2.1 cm/s with a scrambling gain of 10⁴.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光纖饋入與擾頻器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fibre feed and scrambler” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗室把光點於光纖入口面逐步偏移，以光譜儀量譜線重心變化，或以相機直接拍攝輸出近場與遠場的光重心，擾頻增益等於輸入相對位移除以輸出相對位移；同時量測焦比劣化，確認輸出光錐不超出準直鏡接受角而造成光損與照明變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the lab, step the spot across the fibre entrance and measure the line-centroid change with the spectrograph, or image the output near and far fields directly with a camera; scrambling gain is the relative input displacement divided by the relative output displacement. Also measure focal-ratio degradation to ensure the output cone stays within the collimator acceptance and causes neither light loss nor illumination changes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：圓形芯光纖的近場擾頻不完全，導星偏移與大氣色散沿光纖殘留成 m/s 級速度誤差；光纖受彎曲與應力時產生模態雜訊，在高訊噪比光譜中形成無法平均掉的斑紋，直接限制校正源與亮星的精度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Circular-core fibres scramble the near field incompletely, so guiding offsets and atmospheric dispersion leak through as m/s-level velocity errors; bending and stress create modal noise, a speckle pattern that does not average out at high SNR and directly limits the precision on calibration sources and bright stars.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在實驗室把光點於光纖入口面逐步偏移，以光譜儀量譜線重心變化，或以相機直接拍攝輸出近場與遠場的光重心，擾頻增益等於輸入相對位移除以輸出相對位移；同時量測焦比劣化，確認輸出光錐不超出準直鏡接受角而造成光損與照明變化。
knowledge.textEn: In the lab, step the spot across the fibre entrance and measure the line-centroid change with the spectrograph, or image the output near and far fields directly with a camera; scrambling gain is the relative input displacement divided by the relative output displacement. Also measure focal-ratio degradation to ensure the output cone stays within the collimator acceptance and causes neither light loss nor illumination changes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光纖饋入與擾頻器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fibre feed and scrambler” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 圓形芯光纖的近場擾頻不完全，導星偏移與大氣色散沿光纖殘留成 m/s 級速度誤差；光纖受彎曲與應力時產生模態雜訊，在高訊噪比光譜中形成無法平均掉的斑紋，直接限制校正源與亮星的精度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Circular-core fibres scramble the near field incompletely, so guiding offsets and atmospheric dispersion leak through as m/s-level velocity errors; bending and stress create modal noise, a speckle pattern that does not average out at high SNR and directly limits the precision on calibration sources and bright stars. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：瞳切割與變形光學把光束切半或壓縮單一方向，等效縮小所需的光柵尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pupil slicing and anamorphic optics split the beam or compress one axis, effectively shrinking the grating required.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
