steps.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度；抽到 10⁻⁵ hPa 並保持穩定時降為 0.8 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計
knowledge.text: 光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。
knowledge.textEn: Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability" is correct?
options: 只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。
光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。
ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
optionsEn: If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters.

Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.
quiz.explanation: 光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度；抽到 10⁻⁵ hPa 並保持穩定時降為 0.8 mm/s。Zerodur 光柵 α = 5×10⁻⁸/K、ΔT = 1 mK 給 c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s；但 0.1 m 長的鋁偵測器支架每 mK 伸長 2.3 nm，以 18.7 nm/(m/s) 換算為 0.12 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa. A Zerodur grating with α = 5×10⁻⁸/K and ΔT = 1 mK gives c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s, but a 0.1 m aluminium detector mount grows 2.3 nm per mK, which at 18.7 nm per m/s is 0.12 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數；同時以同步參考光纖的 ThAr 或標準具譜線量測夜間漂移，把漂移對溫度與壓力做回歸，得出 m/s/mK 與 m/s/hPa 係數並與模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks; simultaneously measure nightly drift with ThAr or etalon lines through the simultaneous-reference fibre, regress drift against temperature and pressure, and compare the fitted m/s per mK and m/s per hPa coefficients with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度；抽到 10⁻⁵ hPa 並保持穩定時降為 0.8 mm/s。Zerodur 光柵 α = 5×10⁻⁸/K、ΔT = 1 mK 給 c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s；但 0.1 m 長的鋁偵測器支架每 mK 伸長 2.3 nm，以 18.7 nm/(m/s) 換算為 0.12 m/s。
knowledge.textEn: Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa. A Zerodur grating with α = 5×10⁻⁸/K and ΔT = 1 mK gives c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s, but a 0.1 m aluminium detector mount grows 2.3 nm per mK, which at 18.7 nm per m/s is 0.12 m/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability", which statement holds?
options: CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。
解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度。
optionsEn: CCD pixels form a perfect grid, so only wavelength needs calibrating.
Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.
Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa.
quiz.explanation: 空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度；抽到 10⁻⁵ hPa 並保持穩定時降為 0.8 mm/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數；同時以同步參考光纖的 ThAr 或標準具譜線量測夜間漂移，把漂移對溫度與壓力做回歸，得出 m/s/mK 與 m/s/hPa 係數並與模型比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks; simultaneously measure nightly drift with ThAr or etalon lines through the simultaneous-reference fibre, regress drift against temperature and pressure, and compare the fitted m/s per mK and m/s per hPa coefficients with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偵測器冷卻循環或液氮補充造成的熱脈衝經支架傳到光學座，產生與觀測排程相關的 m/s 級跳動；若真空容器洩漏率逐漸上升，壓力漂移帶來緩慢的速度趨勢，很容易被誤認為長週期行星。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Thermal pulses from detector cooling cycles or liquid-nitrogen refills conduct through mounts to the bench and create m/s-level jumps correlated with the observing schedule; a slowly rising vacuum leak rate produces a pressure drift and a gradual velocity trend that is easily mistaken for a long-period planet.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數；同時以同步參考光纖的 ThAr 或標準具譜線量測夜間漂移，把漂移對溫度與壓力做回歸，得出 m/s/mK 與 m/s/hPa 係數並與模型比較。
knowledge.textEn: Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks; simultaneously measure nightly drift with ThAr or etalon lines through the simultaneous-reference fibre, regress drift against temperature and pressure, and compare the fitted m/s per mK and m/s per hPa coefficients with the model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability"?
options: 在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。
optionsEn: Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion.
quiz.explanation: 在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數；同時以同步參考光纖的 ThAr 或標準具譜線量測夜間漂移，把漂移對溫度與壓力做回歸，得出 m/s/mK 與 m/s/hPa 係數並與模型比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks; simultaneously measure nightly drift with ThAr or etalon lines through the simultaneous-reference fibre, regress drift against temperature and pressure, and compare the fitted m/s per mK and m/s per hPa coefficients with the model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 偵測器冷卻循環或液氮補充造成的熱脈衝經支架傳到光學座，產生與觀測排程相關的 m/s 級跳動；若真空容器洩漏率逐漸上升，壓力漂移帶來緩慢的速度趨勢，很容易被誤認為長週期行星。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal pulses from detector cooling cycles or liquid-nitrogen refills conduct through mounts to the bench and create m/s-level jumps correlated with the observing schedule; a slowly rising vacuum leak rate produces a pressure drift and a gradual velocity trend that is easily mistaken for a long-period planet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偵測器冷卻循環或液氮補充造成的熱脈衝經支架傳到光學座，產生與觀測排程相關的 m/s 級跳動；若真空容器洩漏率逐漸上升，壓力漂移帶來緩慢的速度趨勢，很容易被誤認為長週期行星。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
偵測器冷卻循環或液氮補充造成的熱脈衝經支架傳到光學座，產生與觀測排程相關的 m/s 級跳動。
ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Thermal pulses from detector cooling cycles or liquid-nitrogen refills conduct through mounts to the bench and create m/s-level jumps correlated with the observing schedule.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.

quiz.explanationEn: Thermal pulses from detector cooling cycles or liquid-nitrogen refills conduct through mounts to the bench and create m/s-level jumps correlated with the observing schedule; a slowly rising vacuum leak rate produces a pressure drift and a gradual velocity trend that is easily mistaken for a long-period planet. stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳」與「光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs" and "Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波長解把像素位置對應到真空波長，校正源決定能達到的精度。ThAr 空心陰極燈提供數千條絕對波長已知的譜線，但亮度差異大、彼此混疊，氬線隨燈壓位移且燈管會老化；Fabry–Pérot 標準具產生間距均勻、亮度一致的密集譜線，適合描繪像素尺度的色散，但絕對位置隨腔長漂移，需要用 ThAr 或原子譜線錨定。雷射頻率梳的每條梳齒 f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep 由原子鐘參考，間距需經濾波腔放大到 15 至 30 GHz 才能被光譜儀解析，提供最高的準確度與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The wavelength solution maps pixel position to vacuum wavelength, and the calibration source sets the attainable precision. ThAr hollow-cathode lamps give thousands of lines with known absolute wavelengths, but their brightness varies widely, lines blend, argon lines shift with lamp pressure and lamps age; Fabry–Pérot etalons give dense, evenly spaced lines of uniform brightness that map dispersion at pixel scale, but their absolute positions drift with cavity length and must be anchored to ThAr or atomic lines. A laser frequency comb, with each tooth at f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep referenced to an atomic clock, needs filter cavities to raise its spacing to 15 to 30 GHz so the spectrograph can resolve it, and delivers the highest accuracy and repeatability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：真空間隙 L = 7.5 mm 的標準具 FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz，在 550 nm 對應 Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm，約為 R = 140 000 解析元素（3.93 pm）的 5.1 倍，譜線彼此分離。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An etalon with a 7.5 mm vacuum gap has FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz, or Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm at 550 nm, about 5.1 times the 3.93 pm resolution element at R = 140 000, so lines are well separated.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：真空間隙 L = 7.5 mm 的標準具 FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz，在 550 nm 對應 Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm，約為 R = 140 000 解析元素（3.93 pm）的 5.1 倍，譜線彼此分離。要穩定到 1 m/s，腔長變化須小於 L×(1 m/s)/c = 25 pm。250 MHz 頻率梳經 100 倍濾波得 25 GHz 間距，譜線間隔 25.2 pm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An etalon with a 7.5 mm vacuum gap has FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz, or Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm at 550 nm, about 5.1 times the 3.93 pm resolution element at R = 140 000, so lines are well separated. Holding it to 1 m/s requires the gap to change by less than L×(1 m/s)/c = 25 pm. A 250 MHz comb filtered by a factor of 100 gives 25 GHz spacing, lines every 25.2 pm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每晚以 ThAr 與標準具或頻率梳各取一組校正影像，對每一級擬合二維多項式或分段色散解，把殘差 rms 換算成速度並與光子雜訊預期比較；比較 ThAr 解與頻率梳解的差值可揭露像素尺寸不均與譜線表誤差，連續多晚追蹤標準具譜線可得其漂移斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each night take ThAr and etalon or comb calibration frames, fit a two-dimensional polynomial or piecewise dispersion solution per order, convert residual rms to velocity and compare with the photon-noise expectation; differencing the ThAr and comb solutions exposes pixel-size non-uniformity and line-list errors, and tracking etalon lines over several nights yields the etalon drift slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每晚以 ThAr 與標準具或頻率梳各取一組校正影像，對每一級擬合二維多項式或分段色散解，把殘差 rms 換算成速度並與光子雜訊預期比較；比較 ThAr 解與頻率梳解的差值可揭露像素尺寸不均與譜線表誤差，連續多晚追蹤標準具譜線可得其漂移斜率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each night take ThAr and etalon or comb calibration frames, fit a two-dimensional polynomial or piecewise dispersion solution per order, convert residual rms to velocity and compare with the photon-noise expectation; differencing the ThAr and comb solutions exposes pixel-size non-uniformity and line-list errors, and tracking etalon lines over several nights yields the etalon drift slope. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：頻率梳濾波腔失鎖時，被抑制的鄰近梳齒重新出現，每條譜線變成不對稱的混疊，重心偏移數 m/s 卻仍看似正常譜線；更換 ThAr 燈管後若沒有重新建立參考，氬線壓力位移會讓整個波長解出現跳點。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When a comb's filter cavity loses lock, suppressed neighbouring modes reappear and each line becomes an asymmetric blend whose centroid moves several m/s while still looking normal; replacing a ThAr lamp without re-establishing the reference lets argon pressure shifts introduce a jump into the whole wavelength solution.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 頻率梳濾波腔失鎖時，被抑制的鄰近梳齒重新出現，每條譜線變成不對稱的混疊，重心偏移數 m/s 卻仍看似正常譜線；更換 ThAr 燈管後若沒有重新建立參考，氬線壓力位移會讓整個波長解出現跳點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When a comb's filter cavity loses lock, suppressed neighbouring modes reappear and each line becomes an asymmetric blend whose centroid moves several m/s while still looking normal; replacing a ThAr lamp without re-establishing the reference lets argon pressure shifts introduce a jump into the whole wavelength solution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雷射頻率梳的每條梳齒 f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep 由原子鐘參考，間距需經濾波腔放大到 15 至 30 GHz 才能被光譜儀解析，提供最高的準確度與可重現性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A laser frequency comb, with each tooth at f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep referenced to an atomic clock, needs filter cavities to raise its spacing to 15 to 30 GHz so the spectrograph can resolve it, and delivers the highest accuracy and repeatability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photon noise and RV budget table” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在光子雜訊限制下，RV 不確定度 σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e)，N_e 是全部光譜收集到的光電子數，品質因子 Q 描述光譜中譜線的密度與陡度：低溫、慢自轉的 K 矮星 Q 高，高溫、快自轉的 A 型星 Q 很低。實際精度還要加上儀器項：校正源、光纖照明變化、偵測器、熱機構漂移與地球大氣吸收線污染，各項以均方根相加。預算表的目的是讓每個子系統負責人事先知道自己能分到多少誤差，而不是事後找解釋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In the photon-noise limit the RV uncertainty is σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e), where N_e is the number of photoelectrons collected over the spectrum and the quality factor Q describes line density and steepness: cool, slowly rotating K dwarfs have high Q while hot, fast-rotating A stars have very low Q. Real precision adds instrumental terms, namely calibration source, fibre-illumination changes, detector, thermo-mechanical drift and telluric-line contamination, combined root-sum-square. The budget table tells each subsystem owner in advance how much error they may consume rather than explaining failures afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon noise and RV budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曝光時間一直加倍，RV 誤差就會無限下降。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photon noise and RV budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 Q = 15 000（教學假設）、N_e = 10⁸：σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s；要達 0.1 m/s 需 N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰。預算範例：光子 0.50、校正 0.10、光纖照明 0.10、偵測器 0.10、熱機構 0.05 m/s，RSS = √(0.25 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0025) = 0.53 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰. Example budget: photon 0.50, calibration 0.10, fibre illumination 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.05 m/s give RSS = √(0.25 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0025) = 0.53 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每次曝光由萃取光譜計算光子雜訊 σ_v，與同一晚連續曝光的實際散佈比較，平方差即為未建模的儀器項；對 RV 標準星的長期序列計算 rms 與 Allan 偏差，若在數小時以上的時間尺度不再隨 1/√N 下降，代表儀器漂移或恆星活動等系統誤差主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the photon-noise σ_v of every exposure from its extracted spectrum and compare with the actual scatter of consecutive exposures in one night; the quadrature difference is the unmodelled instrumental term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰. Example budget: photon 0.50, calibration 0.10, fibre illumination 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.05 m/s give RSS = √(0.25 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0025) = 0.53 m/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget", which statement holds?
options: 解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
optionsEn: Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.
Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰.
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.
quiz.explanationEn: Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photon noise and RV budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每次曝光由萃取光譜計算光子雜訊 σ_v，與同一晚連續曝光的實際散佈比較，平方差即為未建模的儀器項；對 RV 標準星的長期序列計算 rms 與 Allan 偏差，若在數小時以上的時間尺度不再隨 1/√N 下降，代表儀器漂移或恆星活動等系統誤差主導。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the photon-noise σ_v of every exposure from its extracted spectrum and compare with the actual scatter of consecutive exposures in one night; the quadrature difference is the unmodelled instrumental term. For long RV-standard series compute rms and Allan deviation, and if they stop falling as 1/√N beyond a few hours, systematics such as instrumental drift or stellar activity dominate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：預算只列光子雜訊而忽略月光與天光在光纖中的污染，暗星在接近滿月時出現與月亮相對速度相關的 m/s 偏差；把溫度與焦點這類相關項目當成獨立項做 RSS，會低估總誤差並讓驗收表看似合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A budget that lists only photon noise ignores moonlight and sky contamination in the fibre, so faint stars near full Moon show m/s biases tied to the Moon's relative velocity; treating correlated terms such as temperature and focus as independent in the RSS underestimates the total and makes the acceptance table look compliant.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每次曝光由萃取光譜計算光子雜訊 σ_v，與同一晚連續曝光的實際散佈比較，平方差即為未建模的儀器項；對 RV 標準星的長期序列計算 rms 與 Allan 偏差，若在數小時以上的時間尺度不再隨 1/√N 下降，代表儀器漂移或恆星活動等系統誤差主導。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the photon-noise σ_v of every exposure from its extracted spectrum and compare with the actual scatter of consecutive exposures in one night; the quadrature difference is the unmodelled instrumental term. For long RV-standard series compute rms and Allan deviation, and if they stop falling as 1/√N beyond a few hours, systematics such as instrumental drift or stellar activity dominate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 預算只列光子雜訊而忽略月光與天光在光纖中的污染，暗星在接近滿月時出現與月亮相對速度相關的 m/s 偏差；把溫度與焦點這類相關項目當成獨立項做 RSS，會低估總誤差並讓驗收表看似合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Detector systematics and spectral extraction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Large CCD and extraction pipeline” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二維梯狀影像要經過級追蹤、散射光扣除、最佳萃取與閃耀函數平場校正，才得到每一級的一維光譜，再以交叉相關遮罩或模板比對求 RV。大面積 CCD 帶進三種與速度相關的系統誤差：電荷轉移效率不足使譜線向讀出方向拖尾，且拖尾比例隨通量改變；光罩拼接造成週期性的像素尺寸誤差；像素內量子效率不均。地球公轉使恆星譜線一年內在偵測器上來回移動數十個像素，這些誤差因此被轉成週期一年的假訊號。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The two-dimensional ladder becomes one-dimensional spectra per order only after order tracing, scattered-light subtraction, optimal extraction and blaze flat-field correction, and RV is then derived by cross-correlation masks or template matching. Large CCDs add three velocity-related systematics: charge-transfer inefficiency trails lines toward the readout with a flux-dependent fraction, mask stitching creates periodic pixel-size errors, and quantum efficiency varies within each pixel. Earth's orbit sweeps stellar lines tens of pixels across the detector each year, turning these errors into spurious annual signals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Large CCD and extraction pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：CTE = 0.999999、4096 次轉移後殘留比例 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41%，若這部分電荷延後一個像素，重心偏移 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s，低通量時更大。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With CTE = 0.999999, 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41% of the charge is left behind after 4096 transfers; deferred by one pixel it moves the centroid 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s, more at low flux.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "CCD pixels form a perfect grid, so only wavelength needs calibrating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Large CCD and extraction pipeline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detector systematics and spectral extraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Large CCD and extraction pipeline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：CTE = 0.999999、4096 次轉移後殘留比例 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41%，若這部分電荷延後一個像素，重心偏移 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s，低通量時更大。地球軌道速度 ±30 km/s 使譜線移動 ±30 000/535 = ±56 px；10 nm 的拼接邊界誤差相當於 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s 的跳動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With CTE = 0.999999, 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41% of the charge is left behind after 4096 transfers; deferred by one pixel it moves the centroid 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s, more at low flux. Earth's orbital ±30 km/s sweeps lines by ±30 000/535 = ±56 px, so a 10 nm stitching-boundary error is a 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s jump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表；改變標準具溫度或使用頻率梳讓譜線掃過偵測器，繪出每個拼接區塊的有效像素位置；以同一顆星不同訊噪比的曝光檢查 RV 是否與訊噪比相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table; tune the etalon temperature or use a comb to sweep lines across the detector and map the effective pixel positions of each stitching block; test whether RV correlates with signal-to-noise ratio using exposures of one star at different signal levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: CTE = 0.999999、4096 次轉移後殘留比例 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41%，若這部分電荷延後一個像素，重心偏移 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s，低通量時更大。地球軌道速度 ±30 km/s 使譜線移動 ±30 000/535 = ±56 px；10 nm 的拼接邊界誤差相當於 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s 的跳動。
knowledge.textEn: With CTE = 0.999999, 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41% of the charge is left behind after 4096 transfers; deferred by one pixel it moves the centroid 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s, more at low flux. Earth's orbital ±30 km/s sweeps lines by ±30 000/535 = ±56 px, so a 10 nm stitching-boundary error is a 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s jump.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detector systematics and spectral extraction", which statement holds?
options: 階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。
只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。
CTE = 0.999999、4096 次轉移後殘留比例 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41%，若這部分電荷延後一個像素，重心偏移 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s，低通量時更大。
optionsEn: A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion.
If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters.
With CTE = 0.999999, 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41% of the charge is left behind after 4096 transfers.

steps.title: 偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detector systematics and spectral extraction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Large CCD and extraction pipeline” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表；改變標準具溫度或使用頻率梳讓譜線掃過偵測器，繪出每個拼接區塊的有效像素位置；以同一顆星不同訊噪比的曝光檢查 RV 是否與訊噪比相關。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table; tune the etalon temperature or use a comb to sweep lines across the detector and map the effective pixel positions of each stitching block; test whether RV correlates with signal-to-noise ratio using exposures of one star at different signal levels. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星；更換 CCD 控制器時序後 CTE 改變，前後資料出現無法解釋的零點偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An uncorrected stitching error yields a one-year signal of about 1 m/s locked to Earth's orbit, easily misreported as a habitable-zone planet; changing the CCD controller timing alters CTE and leaves an unexplained zero-point offset between data taken before and after.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表；改變標準具溫度或使用頻率梳讓譜線掃過偵測器，繪出每個拼接區塊的有效像素位置；以同一顆星不同訊噪比的曝光檢查 RV 是否與訊噪比相關。
knowledge.textEn: Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table; tune the etalon temperature or use a comb to sweep lines across the detector and map the effective pixel positions of each stitching block; test whether RV correlates with signal-to-noise ratio using exposures of one star at different signal levels.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Detector systematics and spectral extraction"?
options: 用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
optionsEn: Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.
quiz.explanation: 用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表；改變標準具溫度或使用頻率梳讓譜線掃過偵測器，繪出每個拼接區塊的有效像素位置；以同一顆星不同訊噪比的曝光檢查 RV 是否與訊噪比相關。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table; tune the etalon temperature or use a comb to sweep lines across the detector and map the effective pixel positions of each stitching block; test whether RV correlates with signal-to-noise ratio using exposures of one star at different signal levels. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detector systematics and spectral extraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Large CCD and extraction pipeline” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星；更換 CCD 控制器時序後 CTE 改變，前後資料出現無法解釋的零點偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An uncorrected stitching error yields a one-year signal of about 1 m/s locked to Earth's orbit, easily misreported as a habitable-zone planet; changing the CCD controller timing alters CTE and leaves an unexplained zero-point offset between data taken before and after. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地球公轉使恆星譜線一年內在偵測器上來回移動數十個像素，這些誤差因此被轉成週期一年的假訊號。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Earth's orbit sweeps stellar lines tens of pixels across the detector each year, turning these errors into spurious annual signals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星；更換 CCD 控制器時序後 CTE 改變，前後資料出現無法解釋的零點偏移。

quiz.question: 在「偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detector systematics and spectral extraction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time. Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。公轉加速度 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s²，同樣 60 s 只造成 0.36 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. The orbital acceleration 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s² adds only 0.36 m/s for the same 60 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。公轉加速度 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s²，同樣 60 s 只造成 0.36 m/s。
knowledge.textEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. The orbital acceleration 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s² adds only 0.36 m/s for the same 60 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
optionsEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s².
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.
quiz.explanation: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s。
曝光時間一直加倍，RV 誤差就會無限下降。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s.
Doubling the exposure time keeps reducing RV error without limit.
quiz.explanation: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.

Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals.
quiz.explanation: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
summary: 以 ESO VLTI（GRAVITY，四台望遠鏡、K 波段）與 CHARA 陣列（六台 1 m 望遠鏡、331 m 基線）為對象，從相干長度與地球自轉造成的光程差變化出發，建立延遲線機構、雷射計量、條紋追蹤、可見度校正與天體測量誤差預算的完整工程鏈。
summaryEn: Using the ESO VLTI with GRAVITY (four telescopes, K band) and the CHARA Array (six 1 m telescopes, 331 m baseline) as the reference instruments, the course starts from coherence length and the Earth-rotation delay rate and builds the full engineering chain of delay-line mechanics, laser metrology, fringe tracking, visibility calibration and astrometric error budgets.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 光程控制練習：假設 VLTI 基線 B = 130 m、K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm。相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm；地球自轉造成的最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s，1 kHz 迴路每週期改變 9.5 µm。若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，K 波段 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms；迴路延遲 3 ms 時 σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad²，殘餘光程差 ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm，條紋對比因子 exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97。要達到 10 µas 天體測量，差分光程需量到 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm；若每秒雜訊 50 nm，1800 s 平均後 1.2 nm，統計上足夠，但基線誤差 1 mm 仍留下 7.7 µas 的系統下限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Path-control exercise: assume a VLTI baseline B = 130 m, K band λ = 2.2 µm, Δλ = 0.4 µm. Coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm; the maximum Earth-rotation delay rate ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s, so a 1 kHz loop sees 9.5 µm per cycle. If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, the K-band τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms; with a 3 ms loop latency σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad², the residual OPD ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm and the contrast factor exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97. For 10 µas astrometry the differential OPD must be measured to 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm; with 50 nm per-second noise, 1800 s of averaging gives 1.2 nm, statistically sufficient, but a 1 mm baseline error still leaves a 7.7 µas systematic floor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」與「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" and "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基線向量與幾何延遲」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Baseline vector and geometric delay” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基線向量與幾何延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Baseline vector and geometric delay”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「基線向量與幾何延遲」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Baseline vector and geometric delay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度
knowledge.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution
knowledge.text: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。
knowledge.textEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" is correct?
options: 干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量。
頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
optionsEn: An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object.
A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.
quiz.explanation: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基線向量與幾何延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。若星在離基線法線 30° 的方向，130 m 基線的幾何延遲為 130·sin30° = 65 m，必須由延遲線補償。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. CHARA with a 331 m baseline at λ = 0.55 µm reaches λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas. For a star 30° from the baseline normal, the geometric delay on the 130 m baseline is 130·sin30° = 65 m, which the delay lines must compensate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。若星在離基線法線 30° 的方向，130 m 基線的幾何延遲為 130·sin30° = 65 m，必須由延遲線補償。
knowledge.textEn: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. CHARA with a 331 m baseline at λ = 0.55 µm reaches λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas. For a star 30° from the baseline normal, the geometric delay on the 130 m baseline is 130·sin30° = 65 m, which the delay lines must compensate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution", which statement holds?
options: 真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas。
optionsEn: Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas.
quiz.explanation: VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基線向量與幾何延遲」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Baseline vector and geometric delay” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。
knowledge.textEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution"?
options: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。
optionsEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基線向量與幾何延遲」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
