steps.title: 光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用內部校正光源在實驗室內產生條紋，量出每個輸出的實際相移（不會剛好 90°）與穿透係數，建立像素到可見度矩陣（P2VM）；再用同一光源確認閉合相位在雜訊內為零，並在晶片溫度改變 1 K 後重測 P2VM，評估漂移量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate fringes with the internal calibration source, measure each output's actual phase shift (never exactly 90°) and transmission to build the pixel-to-visibility matrix (P2VM); then confirm with the same source that the closure phase is zero within noise, and re-measure the P2VM after a 1 K change of chip temperature to quantify drift. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用內部校正光源在實驗室內產生條紋，量出每個輸出的實際相移（不會剛好 90°）與穿透係數，建立像素到可見度矩陣（P2VM）；再用同一光源確認閉合相位在雜訊內為零，並在晶片溫度改變 1 K 後重測 P2VM，評估漂移量。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：四台望遠鏡繞任一三角形把三條基線的相位相加得到閉合相位，望遠鏡各自的活塞誤差在相加時互相抵消，使閉合相位成為不受大氣影響的影像觀測量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Summing the phases of the three baselines around any telescope triangle gives the closure phase, in which telescope-specific piston errors cancel, so it is an atmosphere-free imaging observable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
knowledge.textEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias.
If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接
knowledge.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff
knowledge.text: 光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff" is correct?
options: 延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。
optionsEn: If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.

Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability.

quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。
knowledge.textEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。
optionsEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩次觀測之間基線模型被更新卻未記錄，天體測量結果出現數十微角秒的跳變，被當成軌道運動發表；或延遲線維護後計量零點改變，條紋追蹤在特定時角總是失鎖。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion; or a metrology zero point changed by delay-line maintenance makes fringe tracking fail at particular hour angles.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
quiz.explanation: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩次觀測之間基線模型被更新卻未記錄，天體測量結果出現數十微角秒的跳變，被當成軌道運動發表；或延遲線維護後計量零點改變，條紋追蹤在特定時角總是失鎖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion; or a metrology zero point changed by delay-line maintenance makes fringe tracking fail at particular hour angles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion.

title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
summary: 以 ALMA 前端（4 K SIS 混頻器與 15 K 低溫 HEMT 中頻放大器）與綠堤 100 m 望遠鏡（GBT）的公分波接收機為對象，從輻射計方程與 SEFD 出發，拆解饋源照明、Friis 雜訊級聯、量子雜訊極限、Y 因子校正、Allan 變異數與低溫恆溫器整合，最後落到接收機驗收與交接。
summaryEn: Using the ALMA front end (4 K SIS mixers with 15 K cryogenic HEMT IF amplifiers) and the centimetre-wave receivers of the 100 m Green Bank Telescope as reference designs, the course starts from the radiometer equation and SEFD and works through feed illumination, the Friis noise cascade, the quantum noise limit, Y-factor calibration, Allan variance and cryostat integration, ending with receiver acceptance and handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊鏈練習：假設饋源與正交模轉換器在 15 K、損耗 0.3 dB（L = 1.072），第一級低溫 HEMT T₁ = 3 K、G₁ = 35 dB（3162），第二級室溫放大器 T₂ = 150 K。前端損耗貢獻 (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K，Friis 級聯 T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K。加上天空 5 K、地面溢出 3 K、宇宙微波背景 2.7 K，Tsys ≈ 15 K。對 GBT（A_eff ≈ 5500 m²）SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy；以 B = 100 MHz、τ = 60 s 積分，流量靈敏度 ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy。若前端損耗增加到 1 dB（L = 1.259），T_rx 升到 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K，Tsys 變成約 18 K，相同靈敏度需要的時間增加 (18/15)² = 1.44 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-chain exercise: assume the feed and orthomode transducer at 15 K with 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072), a first-stage cryogenic HEMT with T₁ = 3 K and G₁ = 35 dB (3162), and a room-temperature second stage with T₂ = 150 K. The front-end loss contributes (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K and the Friis cascade gives T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K. Adding 5 K of sky, 3 K of ground spillover and 2.7 K of cosmic microwave background gives Tsys ≈ 15 K. For the GBT (A_eff ≈ 5500 m²) SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy; integrating B = 100 MHz for τ = 60 s gives a flux sensitivity ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy. If the front-end loss grows to 1 dB (L = 1.259), T_rx rises to 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K, Tsys becomes about 18 K and the time for the same sensitivity grows by (18/15)² = 1.44. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」與「饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD" and "Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System noise temperature Tsys” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System noise temperature Tsys”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “System noise temperature Tsys”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD
knowledge.text: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。
knowledge.textEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD" is correct?
options: 雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。
電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。
把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。
optionsEn: Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts.
The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G.
The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System noise temperature Tsys” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。取頻寬 B = 1 MHz、積分時間 τ = 1 s，溫度靈敏度 ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K，對應的流量靈敏度 ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. With B = 1 MHz and τ = 1 s, ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K, a flux sensitivity ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. With B = 1 MHz and τ = 1 s, ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K, a flux sensitivity ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD", which statement holds?
options: 混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。
積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。
綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²。
optionsEn: Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.
Longer integration always gives better sensitivity.
For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy.
quiz.explanation: 綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “System noise temperature Tsys” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “System noise temperature Tsys” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。
knowledge.textEn: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等。
把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6.
The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波紋饋源喇叭」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrugated feed horn” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波紋饋源喇叭產生近似高斯的對稱波束去照明副反射鏡，邊緣照明強度（edge taper）決定了兩個互相拉扯的效率：照明越均勻，照明效率越高，但從副鏡邊緣溢出的能量也越多；溢出的波束若看到 280 K 的地面，就直接把地面雜訊加進 Tsys。總孔徑效率還要乘上表面精度造成的 Ruze 因子與遮擋損失，所以毫米波望遠鏡的面板精度與饋源設計是一體考慮的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波紋饋源喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A corrugated feed horn produces a nearly Gaussian symmetric beam that illuminates the subreflector, and the edge taper sets two competing efficiencies: a flatter illumination raises illumination efficiency but spills more power past the subreflector edge, and spillover that sees the 280 K ground adds ground noise straight into Tsys. The total aperture efficiency is further multiplied by the Ruze factor from surface accuracy and by blockage, so panel accuracy and feed design of a millimetre telescope are considered together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Corrugated feed horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Ruze 表面效率因子 η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：ALMA 12 m 天線的表面精度 ε = 25 µm，在 Band 7（λ = 0.87 mm）時 η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88，在 Band 9（λ = 0.45 mm）時降到 0.61。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ruze factor η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]: with the 25 µm surface accuracy of an ALMA 12 m antenna, η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88 at Band 7 (λ = 0.87 mm) and drops to 0.61 at Band 9 (λ = 0.45 mm).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波紋饋源喇叭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Corrugated feed horn”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波紋饋源喇叭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrugated feed horn” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Ruze 表面效率因子 η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：ALMA 12 m 天線的表面精度 ε = 25 µm，在 Band 7（λ = 0.87 mm）時 η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88，在 Band 9（λ = 0.45 mm）時降到 0.61。若饋源有 2% 的波束溢出到 280 K 的地面，加入系統雜訊溫度的量為 0.02×280 = 5.6 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ruze factor η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]: with the 25 µm surface accuracy of an ALMA 12 m antenna, η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88 at Band 7 (λ = 0.87 mm) and drops to 0.61 at Band 9 (λ = 0.45 mm). If 2% of the feed beam spills onto 280 K ground, the noise added to Tsys is 0.02×280 = 5.6 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在近場天線量測場量饋源波束方向圖與邊緣照明；上望遠鏡後用亮度溫度已知的行星量孔徑效率，在數個頻率重複，把效率對頻率的曲線用 Ruze 公式擬合出等效表面誤差 ε，與全像法（holography）量到的面板誤差比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the feed beam pattern and edge taper on a near-field antenna range; on the telescope, measure aperture efficiency with planets of known brightness temperature at several frequencies and fit the efficiency-versus-frequency curve with the Ruze formula to extract an equivalent surface error ε, then compare it with the panel errors from holography.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

If 2% of the feed beam spills onto 280 K ground, the noise added to Tsys is 0.02×280 = 5.6 K.

quiz.explanation: Ruze 表面效率因子 η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：ALMA 12 m 天線的表面精度 ε = 25 µm，在 Band 7（λ = 0.87 mm）時 η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88，在 Band 9（λ = 0.45 mm）時降到 0.61。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Ruze factor η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]: with the 25 µm surface accuracy of an ALMA 12 m antenna, η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88 at Band 7 (λ = 0.87 mm) and drops to 0.61 at Band 9 (λ = 0.45 mm). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波紋饋源喇叭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Corrugated feed horn” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在近場天線量測場量饋源波束方向圖與邊緣照明；上望遠鏡後用亮度溫度已知的行星量孔徑效率，在數個頻率重複，把效率對頻率的曲線用 Ruze 公式擬合出等效表面誤差 ε，與全像法（holography）量到的面板誤差比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the feed beam pattern and edge taper on a near-field antenna range; on the telescope, measure aperture efficiency with planets of known brightness temperature at several frequencies and fit the efficiency-versus-frequency curve with the Ruze formula to extract an equivalent surface error ε, then compare it with the panel errors from holography. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：饋源相位中心沒有放在副鏡焦點時，波束出現離焦與高旁瓣，增益下降且溢出雜訊增加；真空窗內若結露或結霜，損耗在饋源之前發生，每 0.1 dB 損耗在室溫下就加入約 7 K 雜訊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A feed phase centre not placed at the subreflector focus defocuses the beam and raises sidelobes, lowering gain and increasing spillover noise; condensation or frost inside the vacuum window adds loss ahead of the feed, and every 0.1 dB of room-temperature loss adds about 7 K of noise.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the feed beam pattern and edge taper on a near-field antenna range.
Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope.

steps.title: 饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波紋饋源喇叭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Corrugated feed horn” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 饋源相位中心沒有放在副鏡焦點時，波束出現離焦與高旁瓣，增益下降且溢出雜訊增加；真空窗內若結露或結霜，損耗在饋源之前發生，每 0.1 dB 損耗在室溫下就加入約 7 K 雜訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A feed phase centre not placed at the subreflector focus defocuses the beam and raises sidelobes, lowering gain and increasing spillover noise; condensation or frost inside the vacuum window adds loss ahead of the feed, and every 0.1 dB of room-temperature loss adds about 7 K of noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總孔徑效率還要乘上表面精度造成的 Ruze 因子與遮擋損失，所以毫米波望遠鏡的面板精度與饋源設計是一體考慮的。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The total aperture efficiency is further multiplied by the Ruze factor from surface accuracy and by blockage, so panel accuracy and feed design of a millimetre telescope are considered together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature.
A feed phase centre not placed at the subreflector focus defocuses the beam and raises sidelobes, lowering gain and increasing spillover noise.
quiz.explanation: 饋源相位中心沒有放在副鏡焦點時，波束出現離焦與高旁瓣，增益下降且溢出雜訊增加；真空窗內若結露或結霜，損耗在饋源之前發生，每 0.1 dB 損耗在室溫下就加入約 7 K 雜訊。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯」與「SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade" and "SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。Friis 公式 T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … 說明只要第一級增益夠高，後級雜訊就被壓到可以忽略；相反地，放在第一級之前的任何損耗 L 都把後面所有雜訊乘上 L，並自己加入 (L−1)·T_phys 的雜訊，因此饋源、正交模轉換器與波導必須做到最短、最冷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K. The Friis formula T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … shows that with enough first-stage gain the later stages become negligible; conversely any loss L ahead of the first stage multiplies everything behind it by L and adds (L−1)·T_phys of its own, which is why the feed, orthomode transducer and waveguide must be as short and as cold as possible. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第一級 LNA T₁ = 2 K、G₁ = 40 dB（10⁴），室溫第二級 T₂ = 100 K：T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A first-stage LNA with T₁ = 2 K and G₁ = 40 dB (10⁴) followed by a room-temperature stage with T₂ = 100 K gives T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯
knowledge.titleEn: HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade
knowledge.text: 公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。Friis 公式 T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … 說明只要第一級增益夠高，後級雜訊就被壓到可以忽略；相反地，放在第一級之前的任何損耗 L 都把後面所有雜訊乘上 L，並自己加入 (L−1)·T_phys 的雜訊，因此饋源、正交模轉換器與波導必須做到最短、最冷。
knowledge.textEn: Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K. The Friis formula T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … shows that with enough first-stage gain the later stages become negligible; conversely any loss L ahead of the first stage multiplies everything behind it by L and adds (L−1)·T_phys of its own, which is why the feed, orthomode transducer and waveguide must be as short and as cold as possible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade" is correct?
options: 公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。
增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。
混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。
optionsEn: Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K.
Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature.
Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.
quiz.explanation: 公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第一級 LNA T₁ = 2 K、G₁ = 40 dB（10⁴），室溫第二級 T₂ = 100 K：T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K。若 LNA 前有 0.3 dB 損耗（L = 1.072）處於 20 K，則加入 (L−1)×20 = 1.4 K 且 LNA 雜訊變成 1.072×2 = 2.1 K，總接收機雜訊 ≈ 3.6 K——0.3 dB 的前端損耗讓雜訊幾乎加倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A first-stage LNA with T₁ = 2 K and G₁ = 40 dB (10⁴) followed by a room-temperature stage with T₂ = 100 K gives T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K. A 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072) at 20 K ahead of the LNA adds (L−1)×20 = 1.4 K and scales the LNA noise to 1.072×2 = 2.1 K, so the receiver noise becomes ≈ 3.6 K: 0.3 dB of front-end loss nearly doubles the noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在低溫測試平台用冷衰減器法或熱／冷負載的 Y 因子法量 LNA 的雜訊溫度與增益對頻率曲線；掃描汲極電流找出最低雜訊的偏壓點；把各級量測值代入 Friis 公式，與整機量到的接收機雜訊比較，差額即為未計入的前端損耗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a cryogenic test bench measure the LNA noise temperature and gain versus frequency by the cold-attenuator or hot/cold-load Y-factor method; sweep the drain current to find the minimum-noise bias point; insert the stage values into the Friis formula and compare with the receiver noise measured as a whole, the difference being unaccounted front-end loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072) at 20 K ahead of the LNA adds (L−1)×20 = 1.4 K and scales the LNA noise to 1.072×2 = 2.1 K, so the receiver noise becomes ≈ 3.6 K: 0.3 dB of front-end loss nearly doubles the noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade", which statement holds?

quiz.explanation: 第一級 LNA T₁ = 2 K、G₁ = 40 dB（10⁴），室溫第二級 T₂ = 100 K：T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A first-stage LNA with T₁ = 2 K and G₁ = 40 dB (10⁴) followed by a room-temperature stage with T₂ = 100 K gives T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在低溫測試平台用冷衰減器法或熱／冷負載的 Y 因子法量 LNA 的雜訊溫度與增益對頻率曲線；掃描汲極電流找出最低雜訊的偏壓點；把各級量測值代入 Friis 公式，與整機量到的接收機雜訊比較，差額即為未計入的前端損耗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a cryogenic test bench measure the LNA noise temperature and gain versus frequency by the cold-attenuator or hot/cold-load Y-factor method; sweep the drain current to find the minimum-noise bias point; insert the stage values into the Friis formula and compare with the receiver noise measured as a whole, the difference being unaccounted front-end loss. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：HEMT 在低溫下增益上升，若輸入輸出隔離不足會在帶外振盪，表現為寬頻雜訊突升與增益不穩；汲極偏壓過高造成自熱，雜訊溫度隨時間緩慢上升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: HEMT gain rises when cold, and with insufficient input–output isolation the amplifier oscillates out of band, showing up as a sudden broadband noise rise and unstable gain; too high a drain bias causes self-heating and the noise temperature creeps up with time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: HEMT 在低溫下增益上升，若輸入輸出隔離不足會在帶外振盪，表現為寬頻雜訊突升與增益不穩；汲極偏壓過高造成自熱，雜訊溫度隨時間緩慢上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: HEMT gain rises when cold, and with insufficient input–output isolation the amplifier oscillates out of band, showing up as a sudden broadband noise rise and unstable gain; too high a drain bias causes self-heating and the noise temperature creeps up with time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Friis 公式 T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … 說明只要第一級增益夠高，後級雜訊就被壓到可以忽略；相反地，放在第一級之前的任何損耗 L 都把後面所有雜訊乘上 L，並自己加入 (L−1)·T_phys 的雜訊，因此饋源、正交模轉換器與波導必須做到最短、最冷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Friis formula T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … shows that with enough first-stage gain the later stages become negligible; conversely any loss L ahead of the first stage multiplies everything behind it by L and adds (L−1)·T_phys of its own, which is why the feed, orthomode transducer and waveguide must be as short and as cold as possible.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SIS 混頻器與本振」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SIS mixer and local oscillator” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 ALMA 的毫米／次毫米波段（84–950 GHz），HEMT 放大器的雜訊已不夠低，所以前端改用 4 K 的 Nb/AlOx/Nb 超導–絕緣–超導（SIS）穿隧接面當混頻器：本振光子協助電子穿隧，把天體訊號降頻到 4–12 GHz 的中頻，再交給低溫 HEMT 放大。SIS 混頻器的雜訊可以接近量子極限 hν/k，而 Nb 的能隙限制了可用頻率，更高頻段改用 NbTiN 電極；混頻器、本振耦合與中頻放大器都裝在同一個卡匣裡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SIS 混頻器與本振」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In the ALMA millimetre and submillimetre bands (84–950 GHz) HEMT amplifiers are no longer quiet enough, so the front end uses 4 K Nb/AlOx/Nb superconductor–insulator–superconductor (SIS) tunnel junctions as mixers: local-oscillator photons assist electron tunnelling and the sky signal is down-converted to a 4–12 GHz IF that is then amplified by cryogenic HEMTs. SIS mixer noise can approach the quantum limit hν/k, and the niobium gap limits the usable frequency, so higher bands use NbTiN electrodes; mixer, LO coupling and IF amplifier sit together in one cartridge. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SIS mixer and local oscillator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量子雜訊極限 hν/k：230 GHz 為 11.0 K，345 GHz 為 16.6 K，650 GHz 為 31.2 K，870 GHz 為 41.8 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Quantum noise limit hν/k: 11.0 K at 230 GHz, 16.6 K at 345 GHz, 31.2 K at 650 GHz and 41.8 K at 870 GHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SIS 混頻器與本振」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “SIS mixer and local oscillator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SIS 混頻器與本振」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SIS mixer and local oscillator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量子雜訊極限 hν/k：230 GHz 為 11.0 K，345 GHz 為 16.6 K，650 GHz 為 31.2 K，870 GHz 為 41.8 K。一台 230 GHz 接收機若 T_rx = 40 K，即約 3.6 倍量子極限。Nb 能隙電壓約 2.8 mV，對應能隙頻率 2Δ/h ≈ 680 GHz；230 GHz 的光子台階寬度 hν/e = 0.95 mV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Quantum noise limit hν/k: 11.0 K at 230 GHz, 16.6 K at 345 GHz, 31.2 K at 650 GHz and 41.8 K at 870 GHz. A 230 GHz receiver with T_rx = 40 K sits at about 3.6 times the quantum limit. The niobium gap voltage of about 2.8 mV corresponds to a gap frequency 2Δ/h ≈ 680 GHz, and the photon step at 230 GHz is hν/e = 0.95 mV wide. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測有本振與無本振的 I–V 曲線，確認能隙以下出現寬度 hν/e 的光子台階；在真空窗前放 300 K 與 77 K 負載做 Y 因子，掃描本振功率找出中頻輸出功率對雜訊最佳的泵浦點；核對磁場線圈是否壓制了 Josephson 電流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pumped and unpumped I–V curves and confirm photon steps of width hν/e below the gap; place 300 K and 77 K loads in front of the vacuum window for a Y-factor measurement while sweeping LO power to find the pumping point that optimises IF output versus noise; check that the magnet coil suppresses the Josephson current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A 230 GHz receiver with T_rx = 40 K sits at about 3.6 times the quantum limit. The niobium gap voltage of about 2.8 mV corresponds to a gap frequency 2Δ/h ≈ 680 GHz, and the photon step at 230 GHz is hν/e = 0.95 mV wide.

quiz.explanation: 量子雜訊極限 hν/k：230 GHz 為 11.0 K，345 GHz 為 16.6 K，650 GHz 為 31.2 K，870 GHz 為 41.8 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Quantum noise limit hν/k: 11.0 K at 230 GHz, 16.6 K at 345 GHz, 31.2 K at 650 GHz and 41.8 K at 870 GHz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SIS 混頻器與本振」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “SIS mixer and local oscillator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測有本振與無本振的 I–V 曲線，確認能隙以下出現寬度 hν/e 的光子台階；在真空窗前放 300 K 與 77 K 負載做 Y 因子，掃描本振功率找出中頻輸出功率對雜訊最佳的泵浦點；核對磁場線圈是否壓制了 Josephson 電流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pumped and unpumped I–V curves and confirm photon steps of width hν/e below the gap; place 300 K and 77 K loads in front of the vacuum window for a Y-factor measurement while sweeping LO power to find the pumping point that optimises IF output versus noise; check that the magnet coil suppresses the Josephson current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：本振功率過高或磁場未調好時，Josephson 雜訊使增益跳動、雜訊暴增；4 K 平台熱接觸退化讓接面溫度升到 5 K，能隙縮小、漏電流增加，接收機雜訊隨溫度一路爬升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Too much LO power or a mis-set magnetic field lets Josephson noise make the gain jump and the noise explode; a degraded thermal contact on the 4 K stage raises the junction to 5 K, the gap shrinks, leakage current rises and the receiver noise climbs with temperature.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測有本振與無本振的 I–V 曲線，確認能隙以下出現寬度 hν/e 的光子台階；在真空窗前放 300 K 與 77 K 負載做 Y 因子，掃描本振功率找出中頻輸出功率對雜訊最佳的泵浦點；核對磁場線圈是否壓制了 Josephson 電流。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Record pumped and unpumped I–V curves and confirm photon steps of width hν/e below the gap.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.

quiz.explanationEn: Record pumped and unpumped I–V curves and confirm photon steps of width hν/e below the gap; place 300 K and 77 K loads in front of the vacuum window for a Y-factor measurement while sweeping LO power to find the pumping point that optimises IF output versus noise; check that the magnet coil suppresses the Josephson current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SIS 混頻器與本振」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “SIS mixer and local oscillator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 本振功率過高或磁場未調好時，Josephson 雜訊使增益跳動、雜訊暴增；4 K 平台熱接觸退化讓接面溫度升到 5 K，能隙縮小、漏電流增加，接收機雜訊隨溫度一路爬升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Too much LO power or a mis-set magnetic field lets Josephson noise make the gain jump and the noise explode; a degraded thermal contact on the 4 K stage raises the junction to 5 K, the gap shrinks, leakage current rises and the receiver noise climbs with temperature. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: SIS mixer noise can approach the quantum limit hν/k, and the niobium gap limits the usable frequency, so higher bands use NbTiN electrodes; mixer, LO coupling and IF amplifier sit together in one cartridge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Too much LO power or a mis-set magnetic field lets Josephson noise make the gain jump and the noise explode.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正」與「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Y-factor, noise diode and Tsys calibration" and "Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Y-factor, noise diode and Tsys calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hot/cold loads and noise diode” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接收機雜訊以 Y 因子法量測：對溫度 T_hot 與 T_cold 的兩個黑體負載記錄輸出功率比 Y = P_hot/P_cold，解得 T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1)。日常觀測不方便搬負載，改用耦合進前端的雜訊二極體：它注入已知的 T_cal，由開／關功率比得到 Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1)，而 T_cal 本身必須定期用負載回溯校正。毫米波系統（如 ALMA 的校正裝置）用常溫與加熱負載，再配合天空傾角掃描求大氣不透明度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Receiver noise is measured by the Y-factor method: record the output-power ratio Y = P_hot/P_cold for two blackbody loads at T_hot and T_cold and solve T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1). Since loads are impractical during routine observing, a noise diode coupled into the front end injects a known T_cal, and the on/off power ratio gives Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1), with T_cal itself traced back to the loads periodically. Millimetre systems such as the ALMA calibration device use ambient and heated loads together with sky dips to obtain the atmospheric opacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hot/cold loads and noise diode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With T_hot = 295 K, T_cold = 77 K and a measured Y = 3.2, T_rx = (295 − 3.2×77)/2.2 = 22.1 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hot/cold loads and noise diode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正

knowledge.text: 接收機雜訊以 Y 因子法量測：對溫度 T_hot 與 T_cold 的兩個黑體負載記錄輸出功率比 Y = P_hot/P_cold，解得 T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1)。日常觀測不方便搬負載，改用耦合進前端的雜訊二極體：它注入已知的 T_cal，由開／關功率比得到 Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1)，而 T_cal 本身必須定期用負載回溯校正。

Since loads are impractical during routine observing, a noise diode coupled into the front end injects a known T_cal, and the on/off power ratio gives Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1), with T_cal itself traced back to the loads periodically.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Y-factor, noise diode and Tsys calibration" is correct?
options: 雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。
積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。
接收機雜訊以 Y 因子法量測：對溫度 T_hot 與 T_cold 的兩個黑體負載記錄輸出功率比 Y = P_hot/P_cold，解得 T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1)。
optionsEn: Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever.
Longer integration always gives better sensitivity.
Receiver noise is measured by the Y-factor method: record the output-power ratio Y = P_hot/P_cold for two blackbody loads at T_hot and T_cold and solve T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1).

steps.title: Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Y-factor, noise diode and Tsys calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hot/cold loads and noise diode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T_hot = 295 K、T_cold = 77 K、量到 Y = 3.2：T_rx = (295 − 3.2×77)/2.2 = 22.1 K。若冷負載因結霜實際為 80 K，同一個 Y 解出 T_rx = 17.7 K，誤差達 4 K。雜訊二極體 T_cal = 2 K、P_on/P_off = 1.08 時 Tsys = 2/0.08 = 25 K，與 T_rx 22 K 加上約 3 K 天空貢獻一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With T_hot = 295 K, T_cold = 77 K and a measured Y = 3.2, T_rx = (295 − 3.2×77)/2.2 = 22.1 K. If frost makes the cold load effectively 80 K, the same Y yields T_rx = 17.7 K, a 4 K error. A noise diode with T_cal = 2 K and P_on/P_off = 1.08 gives Tsys = 2/0.08 = 25 K, consistent with T_rx = 22 K plus about 3 K of sky. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在真空窗前以負載做 Y 因子，每月用同一程序回溯校正雜訊二極體的 T_cal；觀測時記錄 Tsys 對仰角的曲線（天空傾角），用 T_sky = T_atm(1 − e^(−τ/sinEl)) 擬合不透明度，確認扣除大氣後的 T_rx 與實驗室值一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Do a Y-factor at the vacuum window with loads and re-trace the noise-diode T_cal against them monthly with the same procedure; during observing log Tsys versus elevation (sky dip), fit the opacity with T_sky = T_atm(1 − e^(−τ/sinEl)) and confirm that T_rx after removing the atmosphere matches the laboratory value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gain stability and Allan variance” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輻射計雜訊隨 1/√τ 下降，但放大器的 1/f 增益漲落與大氣發射的起伏會隨 τ 增加而上升，兩者相加在 Allan 變異數圖上形成一個最小值，對應的 τ_A 就是單次積分的上限。超過 τ_A 再積分只會更差，因此總功率觀測必須以快於 τ_A 的節奏做位置、波束或頻率切換；對 ALMA 這種寬頻系統，增益穩定度的規格比雜訊溫度更難達成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Radiometer noise falls as 1/√τ, but 1/f gain fluctuations of the amplifiers and fluctuations of atmospheric emission rise with τ; their sum produces a minimum in the Allan-variance plot, and the corresponding τ_A is the ceiling on a single integration. Integrating beyond τ_A only makes things worse, so total-power observing must switch position, beam or frequency faster than τ_A; for a wideband system such as ALMA the gain-stability specification is harder to meet than the noise temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gain stability and Allan variance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer integration always gives better sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gain stability and Allan variance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
