Integrating beyond τ_A only makes things worse, so total-power observing must switch position, beam or frequency faster than τ_A; for a wideband system such as ALMA the gain-stability specification is harder to meet than the noise temperature.

knowledge.text: 誤解：積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Longer integration always gives better sensitivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 輻射計雜訊隨 1/√τ 下降，但放大器的 1/f 增益漲落與大氣發射的起伏會隨 τ 增加而上升，兩者相加在 Allan 變異數圖上形成一個最小值，對應的 τ_A 就是單次積分的上限。
積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。
真空抽得夠低，低溫腔內就沒有熱負載。

quiz.explanationEn: Radiometer noise falls as 1/√τ, but 1/f gain fluctuations of the amplifiers and fluctuations of atmospheric emission rise with τ; their sum produces a minimum in the Allan-variance plot, and the corresponding τ_A is the ceiling on a single integration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gain stability and Allan variance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²]。B = 2 GHz、Tsys = 50 K 時，τ = 1 s 的輻射計項為 50/√2e9 = 1.1 mK；若 ΔG/G = 1e−4，增益項已達 5 mK。兩項相等的時間 τ_A = 1/[B(ΔG/G)²] = 1/(2e9×1e−8) = 0.05 s，所以切換必須快於 20 Hz，或把增益穩定到 1e−5 使 τ_A 延長到 5 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²]. With B = 2 GHz and Tsys = 50 K the radiometer term at τ = 1 s is 50/√2e9 = 1.1 mK; with ΔG/G = 1e−4 the gain term is already 5 mK. The two are equal at τ_A = 1/[B(ΔG/G)²] = 1/(2e9×1e−8) = 0.05 s, so switching must run faster than 20 Hz, or the gain must be stabilised to 1e−5 to stretch τ_A to 5 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對穩定負載記錄至少 1 小時的總功率時間序列，計算 Allan 偏差對 τ 的曲線：白雜訊段斜率 −1/2、平坦段為 1/f、上升段為漂移；讀出 τ_A 並與預定的切換週期比較，切換週期必須明顯短於 τ_A。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record at least one hour of total-power time series on a stable load and compute the Allan deviation versus τ: the white-noise segment has slope −1/2, the flat segment is 1/f and the rising segment is drift; read off τ_A and compare with the planned switching cycle, which must be clearly shorter than τ_A.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

The two are equal at τ_A = 1/[B(ΔG/G)²] = 1/(2e9×1e−8) = 0.05 s, so switching must run faster than 20 Hz, or the gain must be stabilised to 1e−5 to stretch τ_A to 5 s.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gain stability and Allan variance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對穩定負載記錄至少 1 小時的總功率時間序列，計算 Allan 偏差對 τ 的曲線：白雜訊段斜率 −1/2、平坦段為 1/f、上升段為漂移；讀出 τ_A 並與預定的切換週期比較，切換週期必須明顯短於 τ_A。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record at least one hour of total-power time series on a stable load and compute the Allan deviation versus τ: the white-noise segment has slope −1/2, the flat segment is 1/f and the rising segment is drift; read off τ_A and compare with the planned switching cycle, which must be clearly shorter than τ_A. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：GM 低溫機 1 Hz 的活塞週期讓 LNA 溫度微幅起伏，增益隨之調變，Allan 圖在 1 s 附近出現凸起、頻譜上出現 1 Hz 諧波；電源漣波也會以同樣方式進入資料。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The 1 Hz piston cycle of a GM cryocooler modulates the LNA temperature slightly and hence its gain, producing a bump near 1 s in the Allan plot and 1 Hz harmonics in the spectrum; power-supply ripple enters the data the same way.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對穩定負載記錄至少 1 小時的總功率時間序列，計算 Allan 偏差對 τ 的曲線：白雜訊段斜率 −1/2、平坦段為 1/f、上升段為漂移；讀出 τ_A 並與預定的切換週期比較，切換週期必須明顯短於 τ_A。
knowledge.textEn: Record at least one hour of total-power time series on a stable load and compute the Allan deviation versus τ: the white-noise segment has slope −1/2, the flat segment is 1/f and the rising segment is drift; read off τ_A and compare with the planned switching cycle, which must be clearly shorter than τ_A.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。

Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.

quiz.explanationEn: Record at least one hour of total-power time series on a stable load and compute the Allan deviation versus τ: the white-noise segment has slope −1/2, the flat segment is 1/f and the rising segment is drift; read off τ_A and compare with the planned switching cycle, which must be clearly shorter than τ_A. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gain stability and Allan variance” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: GM 低溫機 1 Hz 的活塞週期讓 LNA 溫度微幅起伏，增益隨之調變，Allan 圖在 1 s 附近出現凸起、頻譜上出現 1 Hz 諧波；電源漣波也會以同樣方式進入資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The 1 Hz piston cycle of a GM cryocooler modulates the LNA temperature slightly and hence its gain, producing a bump near 1 s in the Allan plot and 1 Hz harmonics in the spectrum; power-supply ripple enters the data the same way. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超過 τ_A 再積分只會更差，因此總功率觀測必須以快於 τ_A 的節奏做位置、波束或頻率切換；對 ALMA 這種寬頻系統，增益穩定度的規格比雜訊溫度更難達成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Integrating beyond τ_A only makes things worse, so total-power observing must switch position, beam or frequency faster than τ_A; for a wideband system such as ALMA the gain-stability specification is harder to meet than the noise temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer integration always gives better sensitivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波」與「驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves" and "Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ALMA 的前端把多個波段卡匣裝進同一個低溫恆溫器，三級 GM 低溫機提供約 110 K、15 K 與 4 K 的平台；熱負載來自輻射、波導與同軸線的傳導，以及放大器本身的耗散，每一級的預算都要算清楚。真空窗與紅外濾片必須在該波段低損耗，但窗與饋源之間任何殘餘反射都會形成駐波，使頻帶響應出現週期性漣波，週期為 c/(2L)，L 是兩反射面的間距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The ALMA front end packs several band cartridges into one cryostat whose three-stage GM cryocooler provides stages near 110 K, 15 K and 4 K; heat loads come from radiation, conduction through waveguides and coaxial lines, and the dissipation of the amplifiers themselves, and every stage needs its own budget. The vacuum window and infrared filter must be low-loss in band, yet any residual reflection between the window and the feed forms a standing wave that imprints periodic ripple on the bandpass with period c/(2L), L being the spacing of the two reflecting surfaces. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輻射負載 Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold)：300 K 外殼對 110 K 屏蔽、有效發射率 0.05、面積 1 m² 時 Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W，這決定了第一級的需求。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Radiative load Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold): a 300 K shell facing a 110 K shield with effective emissivity 0.05 over 1 m² gives Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W, which sizes the first stage.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空抽得夠低，低溫腔內就沒有熱負載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A good enough vacuum means there is no heat load into the cryostat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The vacuum window and infrared filter must be low-loss in band, yet any residual reflection between the window and the feed forms a standing wave that imprints periodic ripple on the bandpass with period c/(2L), L being the spacing of the two reflecting surfaces.

quiz.question: 關於「低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

ALMA 的前端把多個波段卡匣裝進同一個低溫恆溫器，三級 GM 低溫機提供約 110 K、15 K 與 4 K 的平台。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輻射負載 Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold)：300 K 外殼對 110 K 屏蔽、有效發射率 0.05、面積 1 m² 時 Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W，這決定了第一級的需求。窗與饋源相距 L = 0.3 m 時，駐波漣波週期 Δν = c/(2L) = 3e8/0.6 = 500 MHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Radiative load Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold): a 300 K shell facing a 110 K shield with effective emissivity 0.05 over 1 m² gives Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W, which sizes the first stage. With the window 0.3 m from the feed, the standing-wave ripple period is Δν = c/(2L) = 3e8/0.6 = 500 MHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較；用平坦負載量頻帶響應，對漣波做傅立葉分析得到週期 Δν，反推 L = c/(2Δν) 找出是哪一對反射面；檢查真空度是否維持在 1e−6 mbar 以下、長時間是否上升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model; measure the bandpass on a flat load, Fourier-analyse the ripple to get its period Δν and locate the reflecting pair from L = c/(2Δν); check that the vacuum stays below 1e−6 mbar and does not rise over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

With the window 0.3 m from the feed, the standing-wave ripple period is Δν = c/(2L) = 3e8/0.6 = 500 MHz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves", which statement holds?
options: 把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。
混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。

optionsEn: The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.
Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.

steps.title: 低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較；用平坦負載量頻帶響應，對漣波做傅立葉分析得到週期 Δν，反推 L = c/(2Δν) 找出是哪一對反射面；檢查真空度是否維持在 1e−6 mbar 以下、長時間是否上升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model; measure the bandpass on a flat load, Fourier-analyse the ripple to get its period Δν and locate the reflecting pair from L = c/(2Δν); check that the vacuum stays below 1e−6 mbar and does not rise over time. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化；低溫機氦氣污染則讓 4 K 級漂到 5 K 以上，SIS 性能同時衰退。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks; helium contamination of the cryocooler drifts the 4 K stage above 5 K and the SIS performance falls with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較；用平坦負載量頻帶響應，對漣波做傅立葉分析得到週期 Δν，反推 L = c/(2Δν) 找出是哪一對反射面；檢查真空度是否維持在 1e−6 mbar 以下、長時間是否上升。
knowledge.textEn: Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model; measure the bandpass on a flat load, Fourier-analyse the ripple to get its period Δν and locate the reflecting pair from L = c/(2Δν); check that the vacuum stays below 1e−6 mbar and does not rise over time.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves"?
options: 記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。
optionsEn: Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較；用平坦負載量頻帶響應，對漣波做傅立葉分析得到週期 Δν，反推 L = c/(2Δν) 找出是哪一對反射面；檢查真空度是否維持在 1e−6 mbar 以下、長時間是否上升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model; measure the bandpass on a flat load, Fourier-analyse the ripple to get its period Δν and locate the reflecting pair from L = c/(2Δν); check that the vacuum stays below 1e−6 mbar and does not rise over time. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化；低溫機氦氣污染則讓 4 K 級漂到 5 K 以上，SIS 性能同時衰退。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks; helium contamination of the cryocooler drifts the 4 K stage above 5 K and the SIS performance falls with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：真空窗與紅外濾片必須在該波段低損耗，但窗與饋源之間任何殘餘反射都會形成駐波，使頻帶響應出現週期性漣波，週期為 c/(2L)，L 是兩反射面的間距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The vacuum window and infrared filter must be low-loss in band, yet any residual reflection between the window and the feed forms a standing wave that imprints periodic ripple on the bandpass with period c/(2L), L being the spacing of the two reflecting surfaces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空抽得夠低，低溫腔內就沒有熱負載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A good enough vacuum means there is no heat load into the cryostat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化；低溫機氦氣污染則讓 4 K 級漂到 5 K 以上，SIS 性能同時衰退。
knowledge.textEn: A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks; helium contamination of the cryocooler drifts the 4 K stage above 5 K and the SIS performance falls with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化。
通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks.
Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope.
quiz.explanation: 真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化；低溫機氦氣污染則讓 4 K 級漂到 5 K 以上，SIS 性能同時衰退。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks; helium contamination of the cryocooler drifts the 4 K stage above 5 K and the SIS performance falls with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Receiver acceptance and performance record” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號；上望遠鏡後再用行星量孔徑效率、量各波段的指向與焦點偏移、量 Tsys 對可降水量的關係。交接文件必須有校正表、T_cal、相位中心位置與操作限制，否則實驗室合格的接收機在望遠鏡上無法重現相同靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals; on the telescope it continues with aperture efficiency from planets, pointing and focus offsets per band and Tsys versus precipitable water vapour. The handoff record must contain calibration tables, T_cal, phase-centre positions and operating limits, otherwise a receiver that passed in the lab cannot reproduce the same sensitivity on the telescope. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Receiver acceptance and performance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Receiver acceptance and performance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff
knowledge.text: 一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號；上望遠鏡後再用行星量孔徑效率、量各波段的指向與焦點偏移、量 Tsys 對可降水量的關係。交接文件必須有校正表、T_cal、相位中心位置與操作限制，否則實驗室合格的接收機在望遠鏡上無法重現相同靈敏度。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals; on the telescope it continues with aperture efficiency from planets, pointing and focus offsets per band and Tsys versus precipitable water vapour. The handoff record must contain calibration tables, T_cal, phase-centre positions and operating limits, otherwise a receiver that passed in the lab cannot reproduce the same sensitivity on the telescope.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff" is correct?
options: 通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。
雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。
一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號。
optionsEn: Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope.
Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts.

Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals.
quiz.explanation: 一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號；上望遠鏡後再用行星量孔徑效率、量各波段的指向與焦點偏移、量 Tsys 對可降水量的關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals; on the telescope it continues with aperture efficiency from planets, pointing and focus offsets per band and Tsys versus precipitable water vapour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Receiver acceptance and performance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。雙邊帶分離接收機若影像抑制只有 10 dB，影像邊帶 10% 的天空雜訊（例如 50 K）會洩漏成 5 K 的額外 Tsys；交叉極化 −20 dB 代表 1% 的洩漏，對 1% 偏振的天體而言洩漏與訊號同量級，必須做 D-term 校正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band. A sideband-separating receiver with only 10 dB image rejection leaks 10% of the image-band sky noise (say 50 K) as 5 K of extra Tsys; −20 dB cross-polarisation means 1% leakage, equal to the signal for a 1% polarised source, so D-term calibration is mandatory. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在測試平台跑完整個驗收矩陣（負載 Y 因子、波束掃描器、向量網路分析儀量中頻），再做上機試觀測：行星效率、類星體指向、Tsys 對仰角；產出含 T_rx 曲線、Allan 圖與效率表的性能紀錄，並在每次維修後重跑縮減版回歸測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the full acceptance matrix on the test set (load Y-factor, beam scanner, vector network analyser for the IF), then commission on sky with planet efficiencies, quasar pointing and Tsys versus elevation; produce a performance record with T_rx curves, Allan plots and an efficiency table, and rerun a reduced regression set after every repair.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。雙邊帶分離接收機若影像抑制只有 10 dB，影像邊帶 10% 的天空雜訊（例如 50 K）會洩漏成 5 K 的額外 Tsys；交叉極化 −20 dB 代表 1% 的洩漏，對 1% 偏振的天體而言洩漏與訊號同量級，必須做 D-term 校正。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band. A sideband-separating receiver with only 10 dB image rejection leaks 10% of the image-band sky noise (say 50 K) as 5 K of extra Tsys; −20 dB cross-polarisation means 1% leakage, equal to the signal for a 1% polarised source, so D-term calibration is mandatory.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。
增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。
雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。
optionsEn: Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band.
Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature.
Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Receiver acceptance and performance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在測試平台跑完整個驗收矩陣（負載 Y 因子、波束掃描器、向量網路分析儀量中頻），再做上機試觀測：行星效率、類星體指向、Tsys 對仰角；產出含 T_rx 曲線、Allan 圖與效率表的性能紀錄，並在每次維修後重跑縮減版回歸測試。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the full acceptance matrix on the test set (load Y-factor, beam scanner, vector network analyser for the IF), then commission on sky with planet efficiencies, quasar pointing and Tsys versus elevation; produce a performance record with T_rx curves, Allan plots and an efficiency table, and rerun a reduced regression set after every repair. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：實驗室合格的接收機上機後 Tsys 偏高，原因可能是本振雜散、相位中心沒對到焦點，或校正表沒有一起更新；若只核對實驗室報告而沒有上機驗證，這類問題會留到科學資料才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A receiver that passed in the lab shows elevated Tsys on the telescope because of an LO spur, a phase centre not at the focus or calibration tables that were not updated together; if acceptance only checks the lab report without on-sky verification, such problems surface only in science data.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在測試平台跑完整個驗收矩陣（負載 Y 因子、波束掃描器、向量網路分析儀量中頻），再做上機試觀測：行星效率、類星體指向、Tsys 對仰角；產出含 T_rx 曲線、Allan 圖與效率表的性能紀錄，並在每次維修後重跑縮減版回歸測試。
knowledge.textEn: Run the full acceptance matrix on the test set (load Y-factor, beam scanner, vector network analyser for the IF), then commission on sky with planet efficiencies, quasar pointing and Tsys versus elevation; produce a performance record with T_rx curves, Allan plots and an efficiency table, and rerun a reduced regression set after every repair.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

steps.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Receiver acceptance and performance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 實驗室合格的接收機上機後 Tsys 偏高，原因可能是本振雜散、相位中心沒對到焦點，或校正表沒有一起更新；若只核對實驗室報告而沒有上機驗證，這類問題會留到科學資料才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A receiver that passed in the lab shows elevated Tsys on the telescope because of an LO spur, a phase centre not at the focus or calibration tables that were not updated together; if acceptance only checks the lab report without on-sky verification, such problems surface only in science data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須有校正表、T_cal、相位中心位置與操作限制，否則實驗室合格的接收機在望遠鏡上無法重現相同靈敏度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must contain calibration tables, T_cal, phase-centre positions and operating limits, otherwise a receiver that passed in the lab cannot reproduce the same sensitivity on the telescope.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 電波陣列相關器
summary: 以 ALMA 的 64 天線基線相關器與 VLA 的 WIDAR 相關器為參照，說明可見度如何由兩天線電壓的互相關產生、幾何延遲與條紋旋轉如何即時補償、3 位元量化與 FX 架構如何決定靈敏度與運算量，再把相位／頻帶校正、時脈分配與端到端驗收整理成可交接的工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the ALMA 64-antenna baseline correlator and the VLA WIDAR correlator as references, the course explains how visibilities arise from cross-correlating two antennas' voltages, how geometric delay and fringe rotation are compensated in real time, how 3-bit quantisation and the FX architecture set sensitivity and compute load, and then organises phase and bandpass calibration, clock distribution and end-to-end acceptance into a handoff record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 相關器預算練習：設 N = 64 台天線，基線數 64×63/2 = 2016。最長基線 16 km 的延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 ≈ 900 Hz；2 GHz 頻寬要把相干損失壓在 1% 以內，殘餘延遲需 ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps，小於 250 ps 的取樣週期，所以要做分數延遲。3 位元量化效率 0.96。複數乘加速率 = 2016×4 極化×8 GHz = 6.5e13 次/s。影像靈敏度：43 台天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、7.5 GHz、1 小時，σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy；若改用 2 位元（η_q = 0.88），同樣靈敏度需要 (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 倍的時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Correlator budget exercise: take N = 64 antennas, giving 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines. On the 16 km longest baseline the delay rate is ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz ≈ 900 Hz; keeping the coherence loss over 2 GHz below 1% needs a residual delay ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps, smaller than the 250 ps sampling period, hence fractional delay. The 3-bit quantisation efficiency is 0.96. The complex multiply-accumulate rate is 2016×4 polarisations×8 GHz = 6.5e13 per second. Image sensitivity: with 43 antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, 7.5 GHz and 1 hour, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy; switching to 2 bits (η_q = 0.88) would need (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 times longer for the same sensitivity. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」與「延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" and "Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣
knowledge.text: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。
knowledge.textEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" is correct?
options: 每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。
相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)。
延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。
optionsEn: Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.
The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v).
Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.
quiz.explanation: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。在 230 GHz（λ = 1.3 mm）、最長基線 16 km 時解析度 λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas；最短基線 15 m 的最大角尺度 ≈ 18″；12 m 天線主波束約 23″。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. At 230 GHz (λ = 1.3 mm) with a 16 km longest baseline the resolution is λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas; the 15 m shortest baseline gives a largest angular scale of about 18″, and the 12 m primary beam is about 23″. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. At 230 GHz (λ = 1.3 mm) with a 16 km longest baseline the resolution is λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas; the 15 m shortest baseline gives a largest angular scale of about 18″, and the 12 m primary beam is about 23″.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling", which statement holds?
options: 相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。
ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。
optionsEn: Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored.
The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.questionEn: When "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一波前到達不同天線的時間差 τ_g = B·ŝ/c 隨地球自轉連續改變，相關器必須在相乘之前以整數取樣加分數延遲把它補回來，並以條紋旋轉抵消因延遲變化而產生的自然條紋頻率，否則積分時訊號會自己抵消。殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arrival-time difference of one wavefront at different antennas, τ_g = B·ŝ/c, changes continuously with Earth rotation, so the correlator must restore it before multiplying, using an integer-sample plus fractional delay, and must apply fringe rotation to cancel the natural fringe frequency produced by the changing delay, otherwise the signal averages itself away. A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Geometric delay and fringe rotation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基線 16 km：最大幾何延遲 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs，延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 = 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 16 km baseline the maximum geometric delay is 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs, the delay rate ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz is 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Geometric delay and fringe rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 同一波前到達不同天線的時間差 τ_g = B·ŝ/c 隨地球自轉連續改變，相關器必須在相乘之前以整數取樣加分數延遲把它補回來，並以條紋旋轉抵消因延遲變化而產生的自然條紋頻率，否則積分時訊號會自己抵消。殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。
knowledge.textEn: The arrival-time difference of one wavefront at different antennas, τ_g = B·ŝ/c, changes continuously with Earth rotation, so the correlator must restore it before multiplying, using an integer-sample plus fractional delay, and must apply fringe rotation to cancel the natural fringe frequency produced by the changing delay, otherwise the signal averages itself away. A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss" is correct?

8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基線 16 km：最大幾何延遲 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs，延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 = 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz。要把 2 GHz 頻寬的相干損失限制在 1% 以內，需 πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245，即 Δτ ≤ 39 ps，而 4 GS/s 的取樣週期是 250 ps，所以必須做分數延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 16 km baseline the maximum geometric delay is 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs, the delay rate ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz is 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz. Keeping the coherence loss over a 2 GHz band below 1% requires πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245, i.e. Δτ ≤ 39 ps, while the sampling period at 4 GS/s is 250 ps, so fractional delay is mandatory. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A time-stamp or sampling-clock slip of one sample (250 ps) puts half a turn of phase slope across a 2 GHz band, the broadband amplitude on every baseline of that antenna collapses to near zero and it looks like a dead antenna when the fault is the correlator's delay model.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。
knowledge.textEn: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss"?

optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

quiz.explanationEn: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget. steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A time-stamp or sampling-clock slip of one sample (250 ps) puts half a turn of phase slope across a 2 GHz band, the broadband amplitude on every baseline of that antenna collapses to near zero and it looks like a dead antenna when the fault is the correlator's delay model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣、量化位元數與相關效率」與「FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency" and "FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣、量化位元數與相關效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「數位化器與量化效率」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每台天線的中頻訊號以 Nyquist 速率取樣後只保留少數位元：ALMA 以 4 GS/s、3 位元數位化 2 GHz 基頻，WIDAR 則提供 3 位元與 8 位元取樣器。粗量化損失的是訊噪比而非線性度，只要門檻相對訊號均方根設在最佳位置，1 位元效率 0.64、2 位元 0.88、3 位元 0.96、4 位元 0.99；自動位準控制讓輸入功率維持在門檻的最佳比例，相關係數再以 van Vleck 修正還原。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「數位化器與量化效率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each antenna's IF is sampled at the Nyquist rate and only a few bits are kept: ALMA digitises 2 GHz basebands at 4 GS/s with 3 bits, and WIDAR offers 3-bit and 8-bit samplers. Coarse quantisation costs signal-to-noise rather than linearity: with thresholds optimally placed relative to the signal rms, the efficiency is 0.64 for 1 bit, 0.88 for 2 bits, 0.96 for 3 bits and 0.99 for 4 bits; automatic level control keeps the input power at the optimum ratio to the thresholds, and the correlation coefficient is restored by the van Vleck correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：靈敏度正比於量化效率 η_q，達到相同靈敏度所需時間正比於 1/η_q²：從 3 位元（0.963）降到 2 位元（0.881）要多花 (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 倍時間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sensitivity scales with the quantisation efficiency η_q and the time to reach a given sensitivity with 1/η_q²: dropping from 3 bits (0.963) to 2 bits (0.881) costs (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 times longer.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「數位化器與量化效率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Coarse quantisation costs signal-to-noise rather than linearity: with thresholds optimally placed relative to the signal rms, the efficiency is 0.64 for 1 bit, 0.88 for 2 bits, 0.96 for 3 bits and 0.99 for 4 bits; automatic level control keeps the input power at the optimum ratio to the thresholds, and the correlation coefficient is restored by the van Vleck correction.

steps.title: 取樣、量化位元數與相關效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「數位化器與量化效率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：靈敏度正比於量化效率 η_q，達到相同靈敏度所需時間正比於 1/η_q²：從 3 位元（0.963）降到 2 位元（0.881）要多花 (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 倍時間。資料量：64 台天線 × 4 個基頻 × 2 個極化 × 4 GS/s × 3 位元 = 6.1 Tb/s 進入相關器。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sensitivity scales with the quantisation efficiency η_q and the time to reach a given sensitivity with 1/η_q²: dropping from 3 bits (0.963) to 2 bits (0.881) costs (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 times longer. Data volume: 64 antennas × 4 basebands × 2 polarisations × 4 GS/s × 3 bits = 6.1 Tb/s entering the correlator. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較；把同一雜訊源分到兩個輸入，量測相關係數並與含 van Vleck 修正的理論值比較；最後在校正器上檢查實際靈敏度是否符合 η_q。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds; split one noise source into two inputs, measure the correlation coefficient and compare with the van Vleck-corrected theory; finally check on a calibrator that the achieved sensitivity matches η_q.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
