steps.title: 取樣、量化位元數與相關效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「數位化器與量化效率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較；把同一雜訊源分到兩個輸入，量測相關係數並與含 van Vleck 修正的理論值比較；最後在校正器上檢查實際靈敏度是否符合 η_q。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds; split one noise source into two inputs, measure the correlation coefficient and compare with the van Vleck-corrected theory; finally check on a calibrator that the achieved sensitivity matches η_q. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear; strong radio-frequency interference saturates the sampler and produces spurious correlation and comb-like spectral artefacts.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較；把同一雜訊源分到兩個輸入，量測相關係數並與含 van Vleck 修正的理論值比較；最後在校正器上檢查實際靈敏度是否符合 η_q。
knowledge.textEn: Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds; split one noise source into two inputs, measure the correlation coefficient and compare with the van Vleck-corrected theory; finally check on a calibrator that the achieved sensitivity matches η_q.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「取樣、量化位元數與相關效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。
讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.
Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds.
quiz.explanation: 讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較；把同一雜訊源分到兩個輸入，量測相關係數並與含 van Vleck 修正的理論值比較；最後在校正器上檢查實際靈敏度是否符合 η_q。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds; split one noise source into two inputs, measure the correlation coefficient and compare with the van Vleck-corrected theory; finally check on a calibrator that the achieved sensitivity matches η_q. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 取樣、量化位元數與相關效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「數位化器與量化效率」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear; strong radio-frequency interference saturates the sampler and produces spurious correlation and comb-like spectral artefacts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：粗量化損失的是訊噪比而非線性度，只要門檻相對訊號均方根設在最佳位置，1 位元效率 0.64、2 位元 0.88、3 位元 0.96、4 位元 0.99；自動位準控制讓輸入功率維持在門檻的最佳比例，相關係數再以 van Vleck 修正還原。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coarse quantisation costs signal-to-noise rather than linearity: with thresholds optimally placed relative to the signal rms, the efficiency is 0.64 for 1 bit, 0.88 for 2 bits, 0.96 for 3 bits and 0.99 for 4 bits; automatic level control keeps the input power at the optimum ratio to the thresholds, and the correlation coefficient is restored by the van Vleck correction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。
knowledge.textEn: Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear; strong radio-frequency interference saturates the sampler and produces spurious correlation and comb-like spectral artefacts.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「取樣、量化位元數與相關效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
optionsEn: Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
quiz.explanation: 輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear; strong radio-frequency interference saturates the sampler and produces spurious correlation and comb-like spectral artefacts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）；XF 或滯後式相關器則先相乘再做傅立葉轉換，ALMA 的基線相關器是帶數位濾波器組的混合架構。F 的運算量隨 N 線性成長，X 的運算量隨 N² 成長，兩者之間需要一個把「按天線排列」的資料轉成「按頻率排列」的角落交換網路；CASPER 的開源 FPGA 板與 GPU 的 X 引擎讓新陣列可以快速組出相關器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X); an XF or lag correlator multiplies first and Fourier-transforms afterwards, and the ALMA baseline correlator is a hybrid with digital filter banks in front. The F cost grows linearly with N while the X cost grows as N², and between them a corner-turn network reorders data from antenna order to frequency order; CASPER's open-source FPGA boards and GPU X-engines let new arrays assemble correlators quickly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：複數乘加速率 R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total：ALMA 64 台天線、每基線 4 個極化乘積、每極化 8 GHz 總頻寬時 R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 次/s，每次約 8 個實數運算即約 5e14 運算/s；VLA 27 台天線同條件為 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 次/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Complex multiply-accumulate rate R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total: for 64 ALMA antennas, 4 polarisation products per baseline and 8 GHz total bandwidth per polarisation, R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 per second, about 5e14 real operations per second at 8 per CMAC; the 27 VLA antennas under the same conditions need 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 per second.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作
knowledge.titleEn: FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation
knowledge.text: FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）；XF 或滯後式相關器則先相乘再做傅立葉轉換，ALMA 的基線相關器是帶數位濾波器組的混合架構。F 的運算量隨 N 線性成長，X 的運算量隨 N² 成長，兩者之間需要一個把「按天線排列」的資料轉成「按頻率排列」的角落交換網路；CASPER 的開源 FPGA 板與 GPU 的 X 引擎讓新陣列可以快速組出相關器。
knowledge.textEn: An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X); an XF or lag correlator multiplies first and Fourier-transforms afterwards, and the ALMA baseline correlator is a hybrid with digital filter banks in front. The F cost grows linearly with N while the X cost grows as N², and between them a corner-turn network reorders data from antenna order to frequency order; CASPER's open-source FPGA boards and GPU X-engines let new arrays assemble correlators quickly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation" is correct?
options: 相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。
optionsEn: Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X).
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanation: FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）；XF 或滯後式相關器則先相乘再做傅立葉轉換，ALMA 的基線相關器是帶數位濾波器組的混合架構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X); an XF or lag correlator multiplies first and Fourier-transforms afterwards, and the ALMA baseline correlator is a hybrid with digital filter banks in front. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作：定量估算
steps.titleEn: FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：複數乘加速率 R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total：ALMA 64 台天線、每基線 4 個極化乘積、每極化 8 GHz 總頻寬時 R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 次/s，每次約 8 個實數運算即約 5e14 運算/s；VLA 27 台天線同條件為 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 次/s。天線數加倍，X 引擎負載約增為 4 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Complex multiply-accumulate rate R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total: for 64 ALMA antennas, 4 polarisation products per baseline and 8 GHz total bandwidth per polarisation, R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 per second, about 5e14 real operations per second at 8 per CMAC; the 27 VLA antennas under the same conditions need 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 per second. Doubling the antenna count roughly quadruples the X-engine load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測試向量產生器把同一組相關雜訊送進所有輸入，所有基線應得到相同的振幅與相位；對單一天線加入已知延遲，檢查每個通道的相位斜率是否正確通過角落交換；長時間滿載運轉並統計封包遺失率與 FPGA 錯誤計數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase; insert a known delay on one antenna and verify that the per-channel phase slope passes correctly through the corner turn; run at full load for hours while counting dropped packets and FPGA error flags.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Complex multiply-accumulate rate R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total: for 64 ALMA antennas, 4 polarisation products per baseline and 8 GHz total bandwidth per polarisation, R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 per second, about 5e14 real operations per second at 8 per CMAC; the 27 VLA antennas under the same conditions need 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 per second. Doubling the antenna count roughly quadruples the X-engine load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.explanationEn: Complex multiply-accumulate rate R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total: for 64 ALMA antennas, 4 polarisation products per baseline and 8 GHz total bandwidth per polarisation, R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 per second, about 5e14 real operations per second at 8 per CMAC; the 27 VLA antennas under the same conditions need 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 per second. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用測試向量產生器把同一組相關雜訊送進所有輸入，所有基線應得到相同的振幅與相位；對單一天線加入已知延遲，檢查每個通道的相位斜率是否正確通過角落交換；長時間滿載運轉並統計封包遺失率與 FPGA 錯誤計數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase; insert a known delay on one antenna and verify that the per-channel phase slope passes correctly through the corner turn; run at full load for hours while counting dropped packets and FPGA error flags. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降；FPGA 時序收斂失敗造成的位元錯誤看起來像額外雜訊，只有測試向量才能揪出來。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels; bit errors from a failed FPGA timing closure look like extra noise and are only exposed by test vectors.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用測試向量產生器把同一組相關雜訊送進所有輸入，所有基線應得到相同的振幅與相位；對單一天線加入已知延遲，檢查每個通道的相位斜率是否正確通過角落交換；長時間滿載運轉並統計封包遺失率與 FPGA 錯誤計數。
knowledge.textEn: Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase; insert a known delay on one antenna and verify that the per-channel phase slope passes correctly through the corner turn; run at full load for hours while counting dropped packets and FPGA error flags.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation"?

optionsEn: Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.

quiz.explanationEn: Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase; insert a known delay on one antenna and verify that the per-channel phase slope passes correctly through the corner turn; run at full load for hours while counting dropped packets and FPGA error flags. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降；FPGA 時序收斂失敗造成的位元錯誤看起來像額外雜訊，只有測試向量才能揪出來。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels; bit errors from a failed FPGA timing closure look like extra noise and are only exposed by test vectors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：F 的運算量隨 N 線性成長，X 的運算量隨 N² 成長，兩者之間需要一個把「按天線排列」的資料轉成「按頻率排列」的角落交換網路；CASPER 的開源 FPGA 板與 GPU 的 X 引擎讓新陣列可以快速組出相關器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The F cost grows linearly with N while the X cost grows as N², and between them a corner-turn network reorders data from antenna order to frequency order; CASPER's open-source FPGA boards and GPU X-engines let new arrays assemble correlators quickly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降；FPGA 時序收斂失敗造成的位元錯誤看起來像額外雜訊，只有測試向量才能揪出來。
knowledge.textEn: Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels; bit errors from a failed FPGA timing closure look like extra noise and are only exposed by test vectors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels.
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanation: 角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降；FPGA 時序收斂失敗造成的位元錯誤看起來像額外雜訊，只有測試向量才能揪出來。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels; bit errors from a failed FPGA timing closure look like extra noise and are only exposed by test vectors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相位校正、閉合量與自校正」與「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration" and "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相位校正、閉合量與自校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「天線增益與閉合量」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Antenna gains and closure quantities” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij；由於 N(N−1)/2 條基線遠多於 N 個未知增益，閉合相位（三角形相位和）與閉合振幅不受天線增益影響，可用來檢驗資料並做自校正。ALMA 以每隔數分鐘觀測相位校正器加上每台天線的水氣輻射計，把大氣水氣造成的快速相位起伏即時修掉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天線增益與閉合量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij; because the N(N−1)/2 baselines greatly outnumber the N unknown gains, closure phases (sums around triangles) and closure amplitudes are immune to antenna gains and serve both to check the data and to self-calibrate. ALMA observes a phase calibrator every few minutes and uses a water-vapour radiometer on each antenna to remove the fast atmospheric phase fluctuations in real time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Antenna gains and closure quantities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N = 64：2016 條基線對 64 個增益，獨立閉合相位 (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 個、閉合振幅 N(N−3)/2 = 1952 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「天線增益與閉合量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Antenna gains and closure quantities”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相位校正、閉合量與自校正
knowledge.titleEn: Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration
knowledge.text: 大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij；由於 N(N−1)/2 條基線遠多於 N 個未知增益，閉合相位（三角形相位和）與閉合振幅不受天線增益影響，可用來檢驗資料並做自校正。ALMA 以每隔數分鐘觀測相位校正器加上每台天線的水氣輻射計，把大氣水氣造成的快速相位起伏即時修掉。
knowledge.textEn: Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij; because the N(N−1)/2 baselines greatly outnumber the N unknown gains, closure phases (sums around triangles) and closure amplitudes are immune to antenna gains and serve both to check the data and to self-calibrate. ALMA observes a phase calibrator every few minutes and uses a water-vapour radiometer on each antenna to remove the fast atmospheric phase fluctuations in real time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相位校正、閉合量與自校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration" is correct?
options: 增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。
FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。
大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij。
optionsEn: Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored.
Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij.
quiz.explanation: 大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij；由於 N(N−1)/2 條基線遠多於 N 個未知增益，閉合相位（三角形相位和）與閉合振幅不受天線增益影響，可用來檢驗資料並做自校正。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij; because the N(N−1)/2 baselines greatly outnumber the N unknown gains, closure phases (sums around triangles) and closure amplitudes are immune to antenna gains and serve both to check the data and to self-calibrate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相位校正、閉合量與自校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天線增益與閉合量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Antenna gains and closure quantities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = 64：2016 條基線對 64 個增益，獨立閉合相位 (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 個、閉合振幅 N(N−3)/2 = 1952 個。大氣路徑起伏 100 µm 在 λ = 1.3 mm 的相位為 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad（28°），相干因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89；水氣輻射計修到 20 µm 後為 0.995。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes. A 100 µm atmospheric path fluctuation at λ = 1.3 mm is a phase of 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad (28°), a coherence factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89; after water-vapour-radiometer correction to 20 µm it is 0.995. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把校正器的增益解套用到另一顆校正器，殘餘相位散布應落在熱雜訊內；校正器的閉合相位應為零；比較有無水氣輻射計修正的相位均方根；自校正後影像的動態範圍應明顯提升且不產生假源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Transfer the gain solutions from one calibrator to another and confirm the residual phase scatter sits within thermal noise; closure phases of the calibrator should be zero; compare the phase rms with and without water-vapour-radiometer correction; after self-calibration the image dynamic range should rise clearly without creating spurious sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N = 64：2016 條基線對 64 個增益，獨立閉合相位 (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 個、閉合振幅 N(N−3)/2 = 1952 個。大氣路徑起伏 100 µm 在 λ = 1.3 mm 的相位為 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad（28°），相干因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89；水氣輻射計修到 20 µm 後為 0.995。
knowledge.textEn: For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes. A 100 µm atmospheric path fluctuation at λ = 1.3 mm is a phase of 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad (28°), a coherence factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89; after water-vapour-radiometer correction to 20 µm it is 0.995.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相位校正、閉合量與自校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration", which statement holds?
options: 相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。
延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。
optionsEn: For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes.
The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.
Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.
quiz.explanation: N = 64：2016 條基線對 64 個增益，獨立閉合相位 (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 個、閉合振幅 N(N−3)/2 = 1952 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相位校正、閉合量與自校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「天線增益與閉合量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Antenna gains and closure quantities” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把校正器的增益解套用到另一顆校正器，殘餘相位散布應落在熱雜訊內；校正器的閉合相位應為零；比較有無水氣輻射計修正的相位均方根；自校正後影像的動態範圍應明顯提升且不產生假源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Transfer the gain solutions from one calibrator to another and confirm the residual phase scatter sits within thermal noise; closure phases of the calibrator should be zero; compare the phase rms with and without water-vapour-radiometer correction; after self-calibration the image dynamic range should rise clearly without creating spurious sources. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：校正器離目標太遠或切換週期太長時，大氣相位在兩次校正之間已經改變，影像模糊、振幅損失，弱源消失；條紋擬合解錯 2π 整數會讓某天線相位對頻率出現錯誤斜率。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A calibrator too far from the target or a cycle too long lets the atmospheric phase change between calibrations, blurring the image, losing amplitude and erasing faint sources; a fringe-fit solution off by an integer 2π gives one antenna a wrong phase slope across frequency.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 校正器離目標太遠或切換週期太長時，大氣相位在兩次校正之間已經改變，影像模糊、振幅損失，弱源消失；條紋擬合解錯 2π 整數會讓某天線相位對頻率出現錯誤斜率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A calibrator too far from the target or a cycle too long lets the atmospheric phase change between calibrations, blurring the image, losing amplitude and erasing faint sources; a fringe-fit solution off by an integer 2π gives one antenna a wrong phase slope across frequency. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每台天線的濾波器與數位化器給出自己的複數頻帶響應 B_i(ν)，必須用強而平坦的校正器解出並除掉。通道化本身也有響應：單純 FFT 的通道旁瓣只有 −13 dB，強譜線會洩漏到鄰近通道；多相濾波器組給出平頂通道與 60 dB 以上的洩漏抑制。譜線觀測的頻譜動態範圍由頻帶解的訊噪比、頻帶穩定度與洩漏共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each antenna's filters and digitiser impose their own complex bandpass B_i(ν), which must be solved from a strong flat-spectrum calibrator and divided out. Channelisation has a response of its own: a plain FFT channel has sidelobes of only −13 dB, so strong lines leak into neighbouring channels, whereas a polyphase filter bank gives flat-topped channels with more than 60 dB of leakage rejection. The spectral dynamic range of line observations is set jointly by the bandpass solution's signal-to-noise, bandpass stability and leakage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ALMA 12 m 天線在 Band 6 的 SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An ALMA 12 m antenna at Band 6 has SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ALMA 12 m 天線在 Band 6 的 SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy。每通道 1 MHz、積分 300 s 的單基線雜訊 = 2600/√(2×1e6×300) = 0.106 Jy；以天線為基礎解頻帶時平均 63 條基線，σ ≈ 0.106/√63 = 0.013 Jy，對 5 Jy 校正器為 0.27%，對應的譜線對連續譜動態範圍下限約 370:1。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An ALMA 12 m antenna at Band 6 has SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy. The single-baseline noise per 1 MHz channel in 300 s is 2600/√(2×1e6×300) = 0.106 Jy; an antenna-based bandpass solution averages 63 baselines, σ ≈ 0.106/√63 = 0.013 Jy, 0.27% of a 5 Jy calibrator, a line-to-continuum dynamic-range floor of about 370:1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise.
quiz.explanation: 把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：譜線觀測的頻譜動態範圍由頻帶解的訊噪比、頻帶穩定度與洩漏共同決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The spectral dynamic range of line observations is set jointly by the bandpass solution's signal-to-noise, bandpass stability and leakage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。
knowledge.textEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。
optionsEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」與「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" and "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「頻率參考與資料流」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency reference and data flow” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頻率參考與資料流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Frequency reference and data flow”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「頻率參考與資料流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Frequency reference and data flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率
knowledge.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate
knowledge.text: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。
knowledge.textEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" is correct?
options: GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。
所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）。
相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。
optionsEn: GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.

Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector).
The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.
quiz.explanation: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率參考與資料流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency reference and data flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。輸出資料率：2016 基線 × 4 極化 × 4 基頻 × 2048 通道 × 8 byte，每 1 s 一次 = 528 MB/s；改為 16 s 積分並平均 2 個通道後約 16.5 MB/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Output data rate: 2016 baselines × 4 polarisations × 4 basebands × 2048 channels × 8 bytes every 1 s = 528 MB/s; with 16 s integrations and 2-channel averaging it falls to about 16.5 MB/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。輸出資料率：2016 基線 × 4 極化 × 4 基頻 × 2048 通道 × 8 byte，每 1 s 一次 = 528 MB/s；改為 16 s 積分並平均 2 個通道後約 16.5 MB/s。
knowledge.textEn: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Output data rate: 2016 baselines × 4 polarisations × 4 basebands × 2048 channels × 8 bytes every 1 s = 528 MB/s; with 16 s integrations and 2-channel averaging it falls to about 16.5 MB/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate", which statement holds?
options: 延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。
相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。
optionsEn: Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.
Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm.
quiz.explanation: 10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「頻率參考與資料流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Frequency reference and data flow” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。
knowledge.textEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate"?
options: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。
optionsEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanation: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率參考與資料流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Frequency reference and data flow” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干。
相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow.
The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.

quiz.explanationEn: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「相關器驗收與營運交接」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相關器的驗收分三層：板級測試向量、整機滿載運轉，以及上機試觀測——點源影像的動態範圍、流量尺度、頻譜純度、閉合量與每一種觀測模式（通道數、頻寬、積分時間）都要有紀錄。交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相關器驗收與營運交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Correlator acceptance has three layers: board-level test vectors, full-load operation of the whole machine, and on-sky commissioning where point-source image dynamic range, flux scale, spectral purity, closure quantities and every observing mode (channel count, bandwidth, integration time) are recorded. Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「相關器驗收與營運交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra.

quiz.question: 關於「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。

Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相關器驗收與營運交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱雜訊影像靈敏度 σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]：43 台 12 m 天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、η_q = 0.96、總頻寬 7.5 GHz、τ = 1 h 時 σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy。驗收準則：源外區域量到的影像均方根不超過理論值的 1.2 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Acceptance criterion: the image rms measured in a source-free region must not exceed 1.2 times the theoretical value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱雜訊影像靈敏度 σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]：43 台 12 m 天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、η_q = 0.96、總頻寬 7.5 GHz、τ = 1 h 時 σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy。驗收準則：源外區域量到的影像均方根不超過理論值的 1.2 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Acceptance criterion: the image rms measured in a source-free region must not exceed 1.2 times the theoretical value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。

8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better.
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「相關器驗收與營運交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較。
FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy.

quiz.explanation: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相關器驗收與營運交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
knowledge.textEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。
韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.
A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis.
quiz.explanation: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
summary: 以 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺（40 kg 熔融石英測試質量、0.4 mm 石英纖維）與 Virgo 的超級衰減器為對象，從地面震動與 10⁻¹⁹ m 的位移目標出發，推導單擺 1/f² 與四級 1/f⁸ 的傳遞函數、擺動稀釋後的熱雜訊、葉片彈簧垂直隔振與致動層級，再整合局部阻尼、雜訊預算、真空安裝與鎖定取得，最後落到懸吊驗收與交接。
summaryEn: Using the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum (40 kg fused-silica test mass on 0.4 mm silica fibres) and the Virgo superattenuator as reference designs, the course starts from ground motion and the 10⁻¹⁹ m displacement target, derives the single-pendulum 1/f² and four-stage 1/f⁸ transfer functions, the dilution-reduced thermal noise, blade-spring vertical isolation and the actuation hierarchy, then integrates local damping, noise budgeting, in-vacuum installation and lock acquisition, ending with suspension acceptance and handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
