steps.title: 冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「冷光闌與熱背景」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cold stop and thermal background” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 分別在快門關閉、冷光闌遮蔽與正常狀態下量背景率，三者相減可分離偵測器暗電流、儀器內部漏光與外部熱背景；旋轉儀器找出背景隨方位變化的漏光；用低溫二極體溫度計記錄偵測器溫度穩定度並與暗幀偏移做相關分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the background rate with the shutter closed, with the cold stop blanked and in normal configuration; subtracting the three separates detector dark current, internal light leaks and external thermal background; rotate the instrument to find leaks that vary with orientation; log the detector temperature with cryogenic diode sensors and correlate its stability with dark-frame offsets. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷光闌外有一塊暖的反射面或一條漏光路徑時，背景升高十倍，長曝光的極限星等損失超過一個星等；多層絕熱材料碰到冷平台造成熱短路，偵測器溫度上升而暗電流隨之暴增。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A warm reflective surface or a light-leak path outside the cold stop raises the background tenfold and costs more than a magnitude of depth in long exposures; multilayer insulation touching the cold stage creates a thermal short, the detector warms and the dark current explodes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別在快門關閉、冷光闌遮蔽與正常狀態下量背景率，三者相減可分離偵測器暗電流、儀器內部漏光與外部熱背景；旋轉儀器找出背景隨方位變化的漏光；用低溫二極體溫度計記錄偵測器溫度穩定度並與暗幀偏移做相關分析。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the background rate with the shutter closed, with the cold stop blanked and in normal configuration; subtracting the three separates detector dark current, internal light leaks and external thermal background; rotate the instrument to find leaks that vary with orientation; log the detector temperature with cryogenic diode sensors and correlate its stability with dark-frame offsets.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate"?
options: 分別在快門關閉、冷光闌遮蔽與正常狀態下量背景率，三者相減可分離偵測器暗電流、儀器內部漏光與外部熱背景。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
紅外混成陣列像 CCD 一樣，是靠電荷轉移來讀出的。
optionsEn: Measure the background rate with the shutter closed, with the cold stop blanked and in normal configuration.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An infrared hybrid array reads out by charge transfer, like a CCD.
quiz.explanation: 分別在快門關閉、冷光闌遮蔽與正常狀態下量背景率，三者相減可分離偵測器暗電流、儀器內部漏光與外部熱背景；旋轉儀器找出背景隨方位變化的漏光；用低溫二極體溫度計記錄偵測器溫度穩定度並與暗幀偏移做相關分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the background rate with the shutter closed, with the cold stop blanked and in normal configuration; subtracting the three separates detector dark current, internal light leaks and external thermal background; rotate the instrument to find leaks that vary with orientation; log the detector temperature with cryogenic diode sensors and correlate its stability with dark-frame offsets. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「冷光闌與熱背景」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cold stop and thermal background” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷光闌外有一塊暖的反射面或一條漏光路徑時，背景升高十倍，長曝光的極限星等損失超過一個星等；多層絕熱材料碰到冷平台造成熱短路，偵測器溫度上升而暗電流隨之暴增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A warm reflective surface or a light-leak path outside the cold stop raises the background tenfold and costs more than a magnitude of depth in long exposures; multilayer insulation touching the cold stage creates a thermal short, the detector warms and the dark current explodes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：任何 290 K 的表面以 Planck 定律輻射，其光子率乘上像素的 AΩ、頻寬、發射率與 QE 就是背景電子率，在 K 波段已是每像素每秒數百個電子的量級，在 L、M 波段更高數個數量級；偵測器溫度本身要穩定在 ±10 mK，否則暗電流與偏壓一起漂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Any 290 K surface radiates by Planck's law, and its photon radiance times the pixel AΩ, bandwidth, emissivity and QE is the background electron rate, already hundreds of electrons per pixel per second in the K band and orders of magnitude more in the L and M bands; the detector temperature itself must hold to ±10 mK or dark current and bias drift together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷光闌外有一塊暖的反射面或一條漏光路徑時，背景升高十倍，長曝光的極限星等損失超過一個星等；多層絕熱材料碰到冷平台造成熱短路，偵測器溫度上升而暗電流隨之暴增。
knowledge.textEn: A warm reflective surface or a light-leak path outside the cold stop raises the background tenfold and costs more than a magnitude of depth in long exposures; multilayer insulation touching the cold stage creates a thermal short, the detector warms and the dark current explodes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
冷光闌外有一塊暖的反射面或一條漏光路徑時，背景升高十倍，長曝光的極限星等損失超過一個星等；多層絕熱材料碰到冷平台造成熱短路，偵測器溫度上升而暗電流隨之暴增。
讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A warm reflective surface or a light-leak path outside the cold stop raises the background tenfold and costs more than a magnitude of depth in long exposures.
More reads always lower the noise, without limit.
quiz.explanation: 冷光闌外有一塊暖的反射面或一條漏光路徑時，背景升高十倍，長曝光的極限星等損失超過一個星等；多層絕熱材料碰到冷平台造成熱短路，偵測器溫度上升而暗電流隨之暴增。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A warm reflective surface or a light-leak path outside the cold stop raises the background tenfold and costs more than a magnitude of depth in long exposures; multilayer insulation touching the cold stage creates a thermal short, the detector warms and the dark current explodes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」與「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp" and "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 因為讀取不破壞電荷，同一次曝光可以多次取樣：相關雙取樣（CDS）在重置後與曝光結束各讀一次以消除 kTC 重置雜訊；Fowler-N 在曝光頭尾各讀 N 次平均，讀出雜訊約降 √N；up-the-ramp 在曝光期間等間隔連續讀取並對斜率做線性擬合，不只壓低讀出雜訊，還能辨識宇宙射線並在飽和前取回訊號。改善的極限由 1/f 雜訊與每次讀取在輸出端附近產生的放大器輝光決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because reading does not destroy the charge, one exposure can be sampled many times: correlated double sampling (CDS) reads once after reset and once at the end to remove kTC reset noise; Fowler-N averages N reads at each end and lowers read noise by about √N; up-the-ramp reads at equal intervals throughout the exposure and fits the slope, which not only reduces read noise but also identifies cosmic rays and recovers the signal before saturation. The improvement is bounded by 1/f noise and by the amplifier glow deposited near the outputs on every read. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：NIRCam 短波 CDS 讀出雜訊約 15.8 e⁻，單次讀取 ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The NIRCam short-wave CDS read noise is about 15.8 e⁻, so a single read is ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More reads always lower the noise, without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp
knowledge.titleEn: Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp
knowledge.text: 因為讀取不破壞電荷，同一次曝光可以多次取樣：相關雙取樣（CDS）在重置後與曝光結束各讀一次以消除 kTC 重置雜訊；Fowler-N 在曝光頭尾各讀 N 次平均，讀出雜訊約降 √N；up-the-ramp 在曝光期間等間隔連續讀取並對斜率做線性擬合，不只壓低讀出雜訊，還能辨識宇宙射線並在飽和前取回訊號。改善的極限由 1/f 雜訊與每次讀取在輸出端附近產生的放大器輝光決定。
knowledge.textEn: Because reading does not destroy the charge, one exposure can be sampled many times: correlated double sampling (CDS) reads once after reset and once at the end to remove kTC reset noise; Fowler-N averages N reads at each end and lowers read noise by about √N; up-the-ramp reads at equal intervals throughout the exposure and fits the slope, which not only reduces read noise but also identifies cosmic rays and recovers the signal before saturation. The improvement is bounded by 1/f noise and by the amplifier glow deposited near the outputs on every read.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More reads always lower the noise, without limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp" is correct?
options: 讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。
平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。
因為讀取不破壞電荷，同一次曝光可以多次取樣：相關雙取樣（CDS）在重置後與曝光結束各讀一次以消除 kTC 重置雜訊。
optionsEn: More reads always lower the noise, without limit.
Flat-fielding removes persistence as well.
Because reading does not destroy the charge, one exposure can be sampled many times: correlated double sampling (CDS) reads once after reset and once at the end to remove kTC reset noise.
quiz.explanation: 因為讀取不破壞電荷，同一次曝光可以多次取樣：相關雙取樣（CDS）在重置後與曝光結束各讀一次以消除 kTC 重置雜訊；Fowler-N 在曝光頭尾各讀 N 次平均，讀出雜訊約降 √N；up-the-ramp 在曝光期間等間隔連續讀取並對斜率做線性擬合，不只壓低讀出雜訊，還能辨識宇宙射線並在飽和前取回訊號。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because reading does not destroy the charge, one exposure can be sampled many times: correlated double sampling (CDS) reads once after reset and once at the end to remove kTC reset noise; Fowler-N averages N reads at each end and lowers read noise by about √N; up-the-ramp reads at equal intervals throughout the exposure and fits the slope, which not only reduces read noise but also identifies cosmic rays and recovers the signal before saturation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：NIRCam 短波 CDS 讀出雜訊約 15.8 e⁻，單次讀取 ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻。等間隔 N 次讀取的斜率擬合，總訊號的讀出雜訊 σ = σ_r·√[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]：N = 2 回到 √2·σ_r = CDS；N = 93（1000 s RAPID）係數 0.355，σ ≈ 4.0 e⁻。實測 1000 s 有效雜訊約 7.8 e⁻，差額來自 1/f 雜訊與暗電流的散粒雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The NIRCam short-wave CDS read noise is about 15.8 e⁻, so a single read is ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻. For a slope fit to N equally spaced reads the read noise on the total signal is σ = σ_r·√[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]: N = 2 returns √2·σ_r, the CDS value; N = 93 (1000 s RAPID) gives a factor 0.355 and σ ≈ 4.0 e⁻. The measured 1000 s effective noise of about 7.8 e⁻ differs because of 1/f noise and dark-current shot noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在零光通量下拍不同讀取次數的短斜坡，量擬合後的雜訊對 N 的曲線，與 √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))] 比較；偏離的程度揭露 1/f 雜訊與輝光；同時用參考像素修正共模漂移，看雜訊是否進一步下降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At zero flux take short ramps with different numbers of reads, measure the fitted noise versus N and compare with √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]; the departure reveals 1/f noise and glow; apply reference-pixel correction for common-mode drift and check whether the noise falls further.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: NIRCam 短波 CDS 讀出雜訊約 15.8 e⁻，單次讀取 ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻。等間隔 N 次讀取的斜率擬合，總訊號的讀出雜訊 σ = σ_r·√[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]：N = 2 回到 √2·σ_r = CDS；N = 93（1000 s RAPID）係數 0.355，σ ≈ 4.0 e⁻。實測 1000 s 有效雜訊約 7.8 e⁻，差額來自 1/f 雜訊與暗電流的散粒雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: The NIRCam short-wave CDS read noise is about 15.8 e⁻, so a single read is ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻. For a slope fit to N equally spaced reads the read noise on the total signal is σ = σ_r·√[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]: N = 2 returns √2·σ_r, the CDS value; N = 93 (1000 s RAPID) gives a factor 0.355 and σ ≈ 4.0 e⁻. The measured 1000 s effective noise of about 7.8 e⁻ differs because of 1/f noise and dark-current shot noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp", which statement holds?
options: NIRCam 短波 CDS 讀出雜訊約 15.8 e⁻，單次讀取 ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻。
規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。
紅外混成陣列像 CCD 一樣，是靠電荷轉移來讀出的。
optionsEn: The NIRCam short-wave CDS read noise is about 15.8 e⁻, so a single read is ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻.
Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point.
An infrared hybrid array reads out by charge transfer, like a CCD.
quiz.explanation: NIRCam 短波 CDS 讀出雜訊約 15.8 e⁻，單次讀取 ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The NIRCam short-wave CDS read noise is about 15.8 e⁻, so a single read is ≈ 15.8/√2 = 11.2 e⁻. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在零光通量下拍不同讀取次數的短斜坡，量擬合後的雜訊對 N 的曲線，與 √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))] 比較；偏離的程度揭露 1/f 雜訊與輝光；同時用參考像素修正共模漂移，看雜訊是否進一步下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At zero flux take short ramps with different numbers of reads, measure the fitted noise versus N and compare with √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]; the departure reveals 1/f noise and glow; apply reference-pixel correction for common-mode drift and check whether the noise falls further. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：每次讀取在輸出端附近沉積約 0.5 e⁻ 的輝光時，93 次讀取累積 46 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻ 已超過多次取樣省下的讀出雜訊，所以讀取次數存在最佳值；盲目增加 N 反而讓角落像素變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If each read deposits about 0.5 e⁻ of glow near the outputs, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved by multi-sampling, so there is an optimum number of reads; blindly increasing N makes the corner pixels worse.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在零光通量下拍不同讀取次數的短斜坡，量擬合後的雜訊對 N 的曲線，與 √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))] 比較；偏離的程度揭露 1/f 雜訊與輝光；同時用參考像素修正共模漂移，看雜訊是否進一步下降。
knowledge.textEn: At zero flux take short ramps with different numbers of reads, measure the fitted noise versus N and compare with √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]; the departure reveals 1/f noise and glow; apply reference-pixel correction for common-mode drift and check whether the noise falls further.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在零光通量下拍不同讀取次數的短斜坡，量擬合後的雜訊對 N 的曲線，與 √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))] 比較。
暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
At zero flux take short ramps with different numbers of reads, measure the fitted noise versus N and compare with √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))].
Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 在零光通量下拍不同讀取次數的短斜坡，量擬合後的雜訊對 N 的曲線，與 √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))] 比較；偏離的程度揭露 1/f 雜訊與輝光；同時用參考像素修正共模漂移，看雜訊是否進一步下降。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At zero flux take short ramps with different numbers of reads, measure the fitted noise versus N and compare with √[12(N−1)/(N(N+1))]; the departure reveals 1/f noise and glow; apply reference-pixel correction for common-mode drift and check whether the noise falls further. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非破壞性讀出與取樣策略」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Non-destructive reads and sampling strategy” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 每次讀取在輸出端附近沉積約 0.5 e⁻ 的輝光時，93 次讀取累積 46 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻ 已超過多次取樣省下的讀出雜訊，所以讀取次數存在最佳值；盲目增加 N 反而讓角落像素變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If each read deposits about 0.5 e⁻ of glow near the outputs, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved by multi-sampling, so there is an optimum number of reads; blindly increasing N makes the corner pixels worse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改善的極限由 1/f 雜訊與每次讀取在輸出端附近產生的放大器輝光決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The improvement is bounded by 1/f noise and by the amplifier glow deposited near the outputs on every read.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More reads always lower the noise, without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 每次讀取在輸出端附近沉積約 0.5 e⁻ 的輝光時，93 次讀取累積 46 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻ 已超過多次取樣省下的讀出雜訊，所以讀取次數存在最佳值；盲目增加 N 反而讓角落像素變差。
knowledge.textEn: If each read deposits about 0.5 e⁻ of glow near the outputs, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved by multi-sampling, so there is an optimum number of reads; blindly increasing N makes the corner pixels worse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。
每次讀取在輸出端附近沉積約 0.5 e⁻ 的輝光時，93 次讀取累積 46 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻ 已超過多次取樣省下的讀出雜訊，所以讀取次數存在最佳值。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Flat-fielding removes persistence as well.

If each read deposits about 0.5 e⁻ of glow near the outputs, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved by multi-sampling, so there is an optimum number of reads.
quiz.explanation: 每次讀取在輸出端附近沉積約 0.5 e⁻ 的輝光時，93 次讀取累積 46 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻ 已超過多次取樣省下的讀出雜訊，所以讀取次數存在最佳值；盲目增加 N 反而讓角落像素變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If each read deposits about 0.5 e⁻ of glow near the outputs, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved by multi-sampling, so there is an optimum number of reads; blindly increasing N makes the corner pixels worse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 非線性、持續影像與校正鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「線性度、持續影像與平場」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Linearity, persistence and flat field” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 像素節點電容隨偏壓改變，訊號接近滿阱時響應偏低數個百分比，需要逐像素的多項式校正；持續影像（persistence）是亮源曝光後被耗盡區陷阱捕獲的電荷在隨後數分鐘到數小時慢慢釋放，JWST 文件給出的量級約為前次照度的 0.1%；平場修正像素間 QE 差異與光學漸暈，像素間電容把約 1% 的訊號模糊到鄰近像素，參考像素則用來扣除偏壓漂移。這些效應彼此獨立，必須各自校正、依序套用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「線性度、持續影像與平場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pixel node capacitance changes with bias, so the response falls short by several percent near full well and needs a per-pixel polynomial correction; persistence is charge captured by traps in the depletion region during a bright exposure and released over the following minutes to hours, of order 0.1% of the previous illumination according to the JWST documentation; flat fields correct pixel-to-pixel QE differences and optical vignetting, interpixel capacitance blurs about 1% of the signal into neighbours, and reference pixels remove bias drift. These effects are independent and must each be calibrated and applied in sequence. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Linearity, persistence and flat field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：非線性模型 S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true)，a = 5×10⁻⁷/e⁻：S_true = 50,000 e⁻ 時 S_meas = 48,750（低 2.5%），100,000 e⁻ 時低 5%；校正後殘差 0.1% 在 50 ke⁻ 為 50 e⁻，低於光子雜訊 √50000 = 224 e⁻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nonlinearity model S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true) with a = 5×10⁻⁷ per e⁻: at S_true = 50,000 e⁻, S_meas = 48,750 (2.5% low), and 5% low at 100,000 e⁻; a post-correction residual of 0.1% is 50 e⁻ at 50 ke⁻, below the photon noise √50000 = 224 e⁻.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Flat-fielding removes persistence as well." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「線性度、持續影像與平場」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Linearity, persistence and flat field”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 非線性、持續影像與校正鏈
knowledge.titleEn: Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain
knowledge.text: 像素節點電容隨偏壓改變，訊號接近滿阱時響應偏低數個百分比，需要逐像素的多項式校正；持續影像（persistence）是亮源曝光後被耗盡區陷阱捕獲的電荷在隨後數分鐘到數小時慢慢釋放，JWST 文件給出的量級約為前次照度的 0.1%；平場修正像素間 QE 差異與光學漸暈，像素間電容把約 1% 的訊號模糊到鄰近像素，參考像素則用來扣除偏壓漂移。這些效應彼此獨立，必須各自校正、依序套用。
knowledge.textEn: The pixel node capacitance changes with bias, so the response falls short by several percent near full well and needs a per-pixel polynomial correction; persistence is charge captured by traps in the depletion region during a bright exposure and released over the following minutes to hours, of order 0.1% of the previous illumination according to the JWST documentation; flat fields correct pixel-to-pixel QE differences and optical vignetting, interpixel capacitance blurs about 1% of the signal into neighbours, and reference pixels remove bias drift. These effects are independent and must each be calibrated and applied in sequence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Flat-fielding removes persistence as well. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain" is correct?
options: 像素節點電容隨偏壓改變，訊號接近滿阱時響應偏低數個百分比，需要逐像素的多項式校正。
平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。
線材越粗越好，因為電阻越低雜訊越小。
optionsEn: The pixel node capacitance changes with bias, so the response falls short by several percent near full well and needs a per-pixel polynomial correction.
Flat-fielding removes persistence as well.
Thicker wires are always better because lower resistance means less noise.
quiz.explanation: 像素節點電容隨偏壓改變，訊號接近滿阱時響應偏低數個百分比，需要逐像素的多項式校正；持續影像（persistence）是亮源曝光後被耗盡區陷阱捕獲的電荷在隨後數分鐘到數小時慢慢釋放，JWST 文件給出的量級約為前次照度的 0.1%；平場修正像素間 QE 差異與光學漸暈，像素間電容把約 1% 的訊號模糊到鄰近像素，參考像素則用來扣除偏壓漂移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pixel node capacitance changes with bias, so the response falls short by several percent near full well and needs a per-pixel polynomial correction; persistence is charge captured by traps in the depletion region during a bright exposure and released over the following minutes to hours, of order 0.1% of the previous illumination according to the JWST documentation; flat fields correct pixel-to-pixel QE differences and optical vignetting, interpixel capacitance blurs about 1% of the signal into neighbours, and reference pixels remove bias drift. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非線性、持續影像與校正鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「線性度、持續影像與平場」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Linearity, persistence and flat field” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：非線性模型 S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true)，a = 5×10⁻⁷/e⁻：S_true = 50,000 e⁻ 時 S_meas = 48,750（低 2.5%），100,000 e⁻ 時低 5%；校正後殘差 0.1% 在 50 ke⁻ 為 50 e⁻，低於光子雜訊 √50000 = 224 e⁻。持續影像：前次 80,000 e⁻ 的曝光留下 0.1% = 80 e⁻，若在 1000 s 內釋放即 0.08 e⁻/s，是長波暗電流 0.035 e⁻/s 的兩倍多。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nonlinearity model S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true) with a = 5×10⁻⁷ per e⁻: at S_true = 50,000 e⁻, S_meas = 48,750 (2.5% low), and 5% low at 100,000 e⁻; a post-correction residual of 0.1% is 50 e⁻ at 50 ke⁻, below the photon noise √50000 = 224 e⁻. Persistence: a previous 80,000 e⁻ exposure leaves 0.1% = 80 e⁻, which released over 1000 s is 0.08 e⁻/s, more than twice the long-wave dark current of 0.035 e⁻/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用穩定 LED 照明拍線性度斜坡並逐像素擬合多項式；做持續影像測試：先飽和再連續拍數小時暗幀，擬合釋放曲線；用積分球對每個濾光片拍平場；最後在星場上檢查測光重複性是否在 1% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take linearity ramps under stable LED illumination and fit per-pixel polynomials; run a persistence test by saturating and then taking dark frames for hours to fit the release curve; take flats with an integrating sphere in every filter; finally check photometric repeatability on a star field to within 1%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 非線性模型 S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true)，a = 5×10⁻⁷/e⁻：S_true = 50,000 e⁻ 時 S_meas = 48,750（低 2.5%），100,000 e⁻ 時低 5%；校正後殘差 0.1% 在 50 ke⁻ 為 50 e⁻，低於光子雜訊 √50000 = 224 e⁻。持續影像：前次 80,000 e⁻ 的曝光留下 0.1% = 80 e⁻，若在 1000 s 內釋放即 0.08 e⁻/s，是長波暗電流 0.035 e⁻/s 的兩倍多。
knowledge.textEn: Nonlinearity model S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true) with a = 5×10⁻⁷ per e⁻: at S_true = 50,000 e⁻, S_meas = 48,750 (2.5% low), and 5% low at 100,000 e⁻; a post-correction residual of 0.1% is 50 e⁻ at 50 ke⁻, below the photon noise √50000 = 224 e⁻. Persistence: a previous 80,000 e⁻ exposure leaves 0.1% = 80 e⁻, which released over 1000 s is 0.08 e⁻/s, more than twice the long-wave dark current of 0.035 e⁻/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain", which statement holds?
options: 紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。
非線性模型 S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true)，a = 5×10⁻⁷/e⁻：S_true = 50,000 e⁻ 時 S_meas = 48,750（低 2.5%），100,000 e⁻ 時低 5%。
暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。
optionsEn: Infrared detectors are cooled only to reduce readout-electronics noise.
Nonlinearity model S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true) with a = 5×10⁻⁷ per e⁻: at S_true = 50,000 e⁻, S_meas = 48,750 (2.5% low), and 5% low at 100,000 e⁻.
Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 非線性模型 S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true)，a = 5×10⁻⁷/e⁻：S_true = 50,000 e⁻ 時 S_meas = 48,750（低 2.5%），100,000 e⁻ 時低 5%；校正後殘差 0.1% 在 50 ke⁻ 為 50 e⁻，低於光子雜訊 √50000 = 224 e⁻。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Nonlinearity model S_meas = S_true(1 − a·S_true) with a = 5×10⁻⁷ per e⁻: at S_true = 50,000 e⁻, S_meas = 48,750 (2.5% low), and 5% low at 100,000 e⁻; a post-correction residual of 0.1% is 50 e⁻ at 50 ke⁻, below the photon noise √50000 = 224 e⁻. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 非線性、持續影像與校正鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「線性度、持續影像與平場」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Linearity, persistence and flat field” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用穩定 LED 照明拍線性度斜坡並逐像素擬合多項式；做持續影像測試：先飽和再連續拍數小時暗幀，擬合釋放曲線；用積分球對每個濾光片拍平場；最後在星場上檢查測光重複性是否在 1% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take linearity ramps under stable LED illumination and fit per-pixel polynomials; run a persistence test by saturating and then taking dark frames for hours to fit the release curve; take flats with an integrating sphere in every filter; finally check photometric repeatability on a star field to within 1%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在亮星場之後立刻觀測暗場，前一場星的潛影以假源的形式出現在新影像中；未校正的非線性讓亮星測光偏低數個百分比，而且偏差隨亮度變化，破壞顏色與星等尺度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Observing a faint field right after a bright star field makes the previous stars appear as spurious sources in the new image; uncorrected nonlinearity biases bright-star photometry low by several percent with a brightness-dependent error that corrupts colours and the magnitude scale.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用穩定 LED 照明拍線性度斜坡並逐像素擬合多項式；做持續影像測試：先飽和再連續拍數小時暗幀，擬合釋放曲線；用積分球對每個濾光片拍平場；最後在星場上檢查測光重複性是否在 1% 內。
knowledge.textEn: Take linearity ramps under stable LED illumination and fit per-pixel polynomials; run a persistence test by saturating and then taking dark frames for hours to fit the release curve; take flats with an integrating sphere in every filter; finally check photometric repeatability on a star field to within 1%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。
用穩定 LED 照明拍線性度斜坡並逐像素擬合多項式。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature.
Take linearity ramps under stable LED illumination and fit per-pixel polynomials.
quiz.explanation: 用穩定 LED 照明拍線性度斜坡並逐像素擬合多項式；做持續影像測試：先飽和再連續拍數小時暗幀，擬合釋放曲線；用積分球對每個濾光片拍平場；最後在星場上檢查測光重複性是否在 1% 內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take linearity ramps under stable LED illumination and fit per-pixel polynomials; run a persistence test by saturating and then taking dark frames for hours to fit the release curve; take flats with an integrating sphere in every filter; finally check photometric repeatability on a star field to within 1%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 非線性、持續影像與校正鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「線性度、持續影像與平場」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Linearity, persistence and flat field” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在亮星場之後立刻觀測暗場，前一場星的潛影以假源的形式出現在新影像中；未校正的非線性讓亮星測光偏低數個百分比，而且偏差隨亮度變化，破壞顏色與星等尺度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Observing a faint field right after a bright star field makes the previous stars appear as spurious sources in the new image; uncorrected nonlinearity biases bright-star photometry low by several percent with a brightness-dependent error that corrupts colours and the magnitude scale. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些效應彼此獨立，必須各自校正、依序套用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These effects are independent and must each be calibrated and applied in sequence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Flat-fielding removes persistence as well." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在亮星場之後立刻觀測暗場，前一場星的潛影以假源的形式出現在新影像中；未校正的非線性讓亮星測光偏低數個百分比，而且偏差隨亮度變化，破壞顏色與星等尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Observing a faint field right after a bright star field makes the previous stars appear as spurious sources in the new image; uncorrected nonlinearity biases bright-star photometry low by several percent with a brightness-dependent error that corrupts colours and the magnitude scale.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在亮星場之後立刻觀測暗場，前一場星的潛影以假源的形式出現在新影像中；未校正的非線性讓亮星測光偏低數個百分比，而且偏差隨亮度變化，破壞顏色與星等尺度。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
線材越粗越好，因為電阻越低雜訊越小。
optionsEn: Observing a faint field right after a bright star field makes the previous stars appear as spurious sources in the new image.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Thicker wires are always better because lower resistance means less noise.
quiz.explanation: 在亮星場之後立刻觀測暗場，前一場星的潛影以假源的形式出現在新影像中；未校正的非線性讓亮星測光偏低數個百分比，而且偏差隨亮度變化，破壞顏色與星等尺度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Observing a faint field right after a bright star field makes the previous stars appear as spurious sources in the new image; uncorrected nonlinearity biases bright-star photometry low by several percent with a brightness-dependent error that corrupts colours and the magnitude scale. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾」與「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference" and "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SIDECAR ASIC 與低溫線束」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SIDECAR ASIC and cryogenic harness” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SIDECAR ASIC 在低溫端直接驅動 HAWAII-2RG 的時脈與偏壓並把輸出數位化（16 位元、100 kHz 或 12 位元、5 MHz），避免長距離類比線路拾取雜訊，JWST 的每一塊 H2RG 都配一顆。從低溫端到室溫電子的線束必須用低熱導的磷青銅或錳銅細線，否則傳導熱負載會壓垮低溫平台；接地要單點、時脈線要與類比線分開，否則時脈拾取在影像上形成固定圖案，參考像素只能部分消除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SIDECAR ASIC 與低溫線束」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SIDECAR ASIC drives the HAWAII-2RG clocks and biases and digitises its outputs on the cold side (16 bits at 100 kHz or 12 bits at 5 MHz), avoiding noise pickup over long analogue lines; every JWST H2RG has one. The harness from the cold stage to the warm electronics must use low-conductivity phosphor-bronze or manganin wire, or the conductive heat load overwhelms the cold stage; grounding must be single-point and clock lines separated from analogue lines, otherwise clock pickup imprints fixed patterns that reference pixels remove only partially. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SIDECAR ASIC and cryogenic harness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線束熱負載 Q = n·k·A·ΔT/L：100 條 AWG 36 磷青銅線（截面 1.27×10⁻⁸ m²、k ≈ 10 W/m/K）、L = 0.5 m、ΔT = 260 K，Q = 100×10×1.27×10⁻⁸×260/0.5 ≈ 6.6 mW；改用銅線（k ≈ 400）則為 264 mW，多 40 倍，對只有毫瓦級預算的 40 K 平台不可接受。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harness heat load Q = n·k·A·ΔT/L: 100 AWG 36 phosphor-bronze wires (cross-section 1.27×10⁻⁸ m², k ≈ 10 W/m/K), L = 0.5 m and ΔT = 260 K give Q = 100×10×1.27×10⁻⁸×260/0.5 ≈ 6.6 mW; copper (k ≈ 400) would give 264 mW, 40 times more, unacceptable for a 40 K stage with a milliwatt budget.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「線材越粗越好，因為電阻越低雜訊越小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker wires are always better because lower resistance means less noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾
knowledge.titleEn: Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference
knowledge.text: SIDECAR ASIC 在低溫端直接驅動 HAWAII-2RG 的時脈與偏壓並把輸出數位化（16 位元、100 kHz 或 12 位元、5 MHz），避免長距離類比線路拾取雜訊，JWST 的每一塊 H2RG 都配一顆。從低溫端到室溫電子的線束必須用低熱導的磷青銅或錳銅細線，否則傳導熱負載會壓垮低溫平台；接地要單點、時脈線要與類比線分開，否則時脈拾取在影像上形成固定圖案，參考像素只能部分消除。
knowledge.textEn: The SIDECAR ASIC drives the HAWAII-2RG clocks and biases and digitises its outputs on the cold side (16 bits at 100 kHz or 12 bits at 5 MHz), avoiding noise pickup over long analogue lines; every JWST H2RG has one. The harness from the cold stage to the warm electronics must use low-conductivity phosphor-bronze or manganin wire, or the conductive heat load overwhelms the cold stage; grounding must be single-point and clock lines separated from analogue lines, otherwise clock pickup imprints fixed patterns that reference pixels remove only partially.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：線材越粗越好，因為電阻越低雜訊越小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker wires are always better because lower resistance means less noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。
optionsEn: Thicker wires are always better because lower resistance means less noise.
The SIDECAR ASIC drives the HAWAII-2RG clocks and biases and digitises its outputs on the cold side (16 bits at 100 kHz or 12 bits at 5 MHz), avoiding noise pickup over long analogue lines.

steps.title: 低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SIDECAR ASIC 與低溫線束」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SIDECAR ASIC and cryogenic harness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線束熱負載 Q = n·k·A·ΔT/L：100 條 AWG 36 磷青銅線（截面 1.27×10⁻⁸ m²、k ≈ 10 W/m/K）、L = 0.5 m、ΔT = 260 K，Q = 100×10×1.27×10⁻⁸×260/0.5 ≈ 6.6 mW；改用銅線（k ≈ 400）則為 264 mW，多 40 倍，對只有毫瓦級預算的 40 K 平台不可接受。數位化：增益 2 e⁻/ADU 時量化雜訊 2/√12 = 0.58 e⁻，遠低於 11 e⁻ 的單次讀出雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harness heat load Q = n·k·A·ΔT/L: 100 AWG 36 phosphor-bronze wires (cross-section 1.27×10⁻⁸ m², k ≈ 10 W/m/K), L = 0.5 m and ΔT = 260 K give Q = 100×10×1.27×10⁻⁸×260/0.5 ≈ 6.6 mW; copper (k ≈ 400) would give 264 mW, 40 times more, unacceptable for a 40 K stage with a milliwatt budget. Digitisation: at 2 e⁻/ADU the quantisation noise is 2/√12 = 0.58 e⁻, far below the 11 e⁻ single-read noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把 ASIC 輸入短路量純電子雜訊；對暗幀做二維傅立葉分析找出拾取線的頻率並對應到時脈或電源；由低溫平台的溫差或保冷時間反推線束熱負載並與計算比較；檢查參考像素修正後的殘餘條紋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Short the ASIC inputs to measure the pure electronics noise; two-dimensional Fourier analysis of dark frames reveals pickup lines whose frequencies map to clocks or power supplies; infer the harness heat load from the cold-stage temperature difference or hold time and compare with the calculation; check the residual striping after reference-pixel correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SIDECAR ASIC 與低溫線束」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “SIDECAR ASIC and cryogenic harness” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把 ASIC 輸入短路量純電子雜訊；對暗幀做二維傅立葉分析找出拾取線的頻率並對應到時脈或電源；由低溫平台的溫差或保冷時間反推線束熱負載並與計算比較；檢查參考像素修正後的殘餘條紋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Short the ASIC inputs to measure the pure electronics noise; two-dimensional Fourier analysis of dark frames reveals pickup lines whose frequencies map to clocks or power supplies; infer the harness heat load from the cold-stage temperature difference or hold time and compare with the calculation; check the residual striping after reference-pixel correction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：暖電子與低溫恆溫器之間形成接地迴路，影像出現 50/60 Hz 的水平條帶，參考像素只能去掉一部分；若為了低電阻改用粗銅線，低溫機負載超支，偵測器永遠到不了設計溫度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A ground loop between the warm electronics and the cryostat produces 50/60 Hz horizontal banding that reference pixels only partly remove; thick copper wire chosen for low resistance overloads the cooler and the detector never reaches its design temperature.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低溫讀出電子、線束熱負載與干擾」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference"?
options: 把 ASIC 輸入短路量純電子雜訊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

quiz.explanationEn: Short the ASIC inputs to measure the pure electronics noise; two-dimensional Fourier analysis of dark frames reveals pickup lines whose frequencies map to clocks or power supplies; infer the harness heat load from the cold-stage temperature difference or hold time and compare with the calculation; check the residual striping after reference-pixel correction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.titleEn: Cryogenic readout electronics, harness heat load and interference: failure diagnosis

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「特性化矩陣與操作點」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Characterisation matrix and operating point” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整特性化包含 QE(λ)、增益、讀出雜訊、暗電流對溫度、滿阱、線性度、持續影像、像素間電容、壞像素圖、串音與可操作像素比例（通常要求 ≥ 99%）。操作點（溫度、偏壓、讀出模式）是取捨：偏壓高則滿阱大、QE 稍好但持續影像與暗電流較高；偏壓低則相反。交接時附上校正檔與「偵測器手冊」，並在望遠鏡上以實際觀測驗證背景極限曝光時間是否符合預測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「特性化矩陣與操作點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Full characterisation covers QE(λ), gain, read noise, dark current versus temperature, full well, linearity, persistence, interpixel capacitance, bad-pixel map, crosstalk and operability (usually required ≥ 99%). The operating point (temperature, bias, read mode) is a trade: higher bias gives a larger full well and slightly better QE but more persistence and dark current, lower bias the reverse. Handoff includes calibration files and a detector handbook, and on the telescope the background-limited exposure time is verified against prediction with real observations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Characterisation matrix and operating point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：背景極限條件：背景散粒雜訊等於讀出雜訊時 t = σ_read²/背景率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Background-limited condition: background shot noise equals read noise at t = σ_read²/background rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「特性化矩陣與操作點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Characterisation matrix and operating point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff
knowledge.text: 完整特性化包含 QE(λ)、增益、讀出雜訊、暗電流對溫度、滿阱、線性度、持續影像、像素間電容、壞像素圖、串音與可操作像素比例（通常要求 ≥ 99%）。操作點（溫度、偏壓、讀出模式）是取捨：偏壓高則滿阱大、QE 稍好但持續影像與暗電流較高；偏壓低則相反。
knowledge.textEn: Full characterisation covers QE(λ), gain, read noise, dark current versus temperature, full well, linearity, persistence, interpixel capacitance, bad-pixel map, crosstalk and operability (usually required ≥ 99%). The operating point (temperature, bias, read mode) is a trade: higher bias gives a larger full well and slightly better QE but more persistence and dark current, lower bias the reverse.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff" is correct?
options: 規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。
紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。
完整特性化包含 QE(λ)、增益、讀出雜訊、暗電流對溫度、滿阱、線性度、持續影像、像素間電容、壞像素圖、串音與可操作像素比例（通常要求 ≥ 99%）。
optionsEn: Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point.
Infrared detectors are cooled only to reduce readout-electronics noise.

Full characterisation covers QE(λ), gain, read noise, dark current versus temperature, full well, linearity, persistence, interpixel capacitance, bad-pixel map, crosstalk and operability (usually required ≥ 99%).
quiz.explanation: 完整特性化包含 QE(λ)、增益、讀出雜訊、暗電流對溫度、滿阱、線性度、持續影像、像素間電容、壞像素圖、串音與可操作像素比例（通常要求 ≥ 99%）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Full characterisation covers QE(λ), gain, read noise, dark current versus temperature, full well, linearity, persistence, interpixel capacitance, bad-pixel map, crosstalk and operability (usually required ≥ 99%). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「特性化矩陣與操作點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Characterisation matrix and operating point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：背景極限條件：背景散粒雜訊等於讀出雜訊時 t = σ_read²/背景率。多次取樣後 σ_read = 7 e⁻、太空長波背景 2 e⁻/s/像素：t = 49/2 ≈ 25 s，要讓讀出雜訊可忽略需 ≥ 5 倍，約 120 s；地面 K 波段背景 400 e⁻/s 時僅 0.12 s。暗電流 0.035 e⁻/s 在 1000 s 累積 35 e⁻，散粒雜訊 5.9 e⁻ 與讀出雜訊同量級，所以長曝光要求暗電流 < 0.05 e⁻/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Background-limited condition: background shot noise equals read noise at t = σ_read²/background rate. With σ_read = 7 e⁻ after multi-sampling and a space long-wave background of 2 e⁻/s/pixel, t = 49/2 ≈ 25 s, and making read noise negligible needs ≥ 5 times that, about 120 s; a ground-based K-band background of 400 e⁻/s needs only 0.12 s. Dark current of 0.035 e⁻/s accumulates 35 e⁻ in 1000 s with shot noise 5.9 e⁻, comparable to the read noise, so long exposures require dark current below 0.05 e⁻/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出驗收表：每項指標對規格、量測方法與不確定度；可操作性以逐像素通過全部準則的比例計算，低於 99% 需說明；用模擬星場做一次「類科學」測試驗證暗源測光；簽核後把操作點與校正檔一併交付。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compile the acceptance table listing every metric against specification, method and uncertainty; compute operability as the fraction of pixels passing all criteria and justify anything below 99%; run a science-like test with a simulated star field to verify faint-source photometry; after sign-off deliver the operating point together with the calibration files.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 背景極限條件：背景散粒雜訊等於讀出雜訊時 t = σ_read²/背景率。多次取樣後 σ_read = 7 e⁻、太空長波背景 2 e⁻/s/像素：t = 49/2 ≈ 25 s，要讓讀出雜訊可忽略需 ≥ 5 倍，約 120 s；地面 K 波段背景 400 e⁻/s 時僅 0.12 s。暗電流 0.035 e⁻/s 在 1000 s 累積 35 e⁻，散粒雜訊 5.9 e⁻ 與讀出雜訊同量級，所以長曝光要求暗電流 < 0.05 e⁻/s。
knowledge.textEn: Background-limited condition: background shot noise equals read noise at t = σ_read²/background rate. With σ_read = 7 e⁻ after multi-sampling and a space long-wave background of 2 e⁻/s/pixel, t = 49/2 ≈ 25 s, and making read noise negligible needs ≥ 5 times that, about 120 s; a ground-based K-band background of 400 e⁻/s needs only 0.12 s. Dark current of 0.035 e⁻/s accumulates 35 e⁻ in 1000 s with shot noise 5.9 e⁻, comparable to the read noise, so long exposures require dark current below 0.05 e⁻/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 背景極限條件：背景散粒雜訊等於讀出雜訊時 t = σ_read²/背景率。
暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。
讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。
optionsEn: Background-limited condition: background shot noise equals read noise at t = σ_read²/background rate.
Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength.
More reads always lower the noise, without limit.
quiz.explanation: 背景極限條件：背景散粒雜訊等於讀出雜訊時 t = σ_read²/背景率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Background-limited condition: background shot noise equals read noise at t = σ_read²/background rate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「特性化矩陣與操作點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Characterisation matrix and operating point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 列出驗收表：每項指標對規格、量測方法與不確定度；可操作性以逐像素通過全部準則的比例計算，低於 99% 需說明；用模擬星場做一次「類科學」測試驗證暗源測光；簽核後把操作點與校正檔一併交付。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compile the acceptance table listing every metric against specification, method and uncertainty; compute operability as the fraction of pixels passing all criteria and justify anything below 99%; run a science-like test with a simulated star field to verify faint-source photometry; after sign-off deliver the operating point together with the calibration files. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了最低暗電流選了低偏壓，結果滿阱太小、亮校正星全部飽和；或為了 QE 選高偏壓，持續影像讓後續每一個暗場都有潛影；實驗室與望遠鏡上的操作點不一致時，實驗室校正檔全部失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Choosing a low bias for minimum dark current leaves the full well too small and saturates every bright calibration star; choosing a high bias for QE lets persistence haunt every subsequent faint field; when the laboratory and telescope operating points differ, all the laboratory calibration files become invalid.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 列出驗收表：每項指標對規格、量測方法與不確定度；可操作性以逐像素通過全部準則的比例計算，低於 99% 需說明；用模擬星場做一次「類科學」測試驗證暗源測光；簽核後把操作點與校正檔一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: Compile the acceptance table listing every metric against specification, method and uncertainty; compute operability as the fraction of pixels passing all criteria and justify anything below 99%; run a science-like test with a simulated star field to verify faint-source photometry; after sign-off deliver the operating point together with the calibration files.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
列出驗收表：每項指標對規格、量測方法與不確定度。
平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Compile the acceptance table listing every metric against specification, method and uncertainty.
Flat-fielding removes persistence as well.
quiz.explanation: 列出驗收表：每項指標對規格、量測方法與不確定度；可操作性以逐像素通過全部準則的比例計算，低於 99% 需說明；用模擬星場做一次「類科學」測試驗證暗源測光；簽核後把操作點與校正檔一併交付。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compile the acceptance table listing every metric against specification, method and uncertainty; compute operability as the fraction of pixels passing all criteria and justify anything below 99%; run a science-like test with a simulated star field to verify faint-source photometry; after sign-off deliver the operating point together with the calibration files. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「特性化矩陣與操作點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Characterisation matrix and operating point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了最低暗電流選了低偏壓，結果滿阱太小、亮校正星全部飽和；或為了 QE 選高偏壓，持續影像讓後續每一個暗場都有潛影；實驗室與望遠鏡上的操作點不一致時，實驗室校正檔全部失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing a low bias for minimum dark current leaves the full well too small and saturates every bright calibration star; choosing a high bias for QE lets persistence haunt every subsequent faint field; when the laboratory and telescope operating points differ, all the laboratory calibration files become invalid. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時附上校正檔與「偵測器手冊」，並在望遠鏡上以實際觀測驗證背景極限曝光時間是否符合預測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handoff includes calibration files and a detector handbook, and on the telescope the background-limited exposure time is verified against prediction with real observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了最低暗電流選了低偏壓，結果滿阱太小、亮校正星全部飽和；或為了 QE 選高偏壓，持續影像讓後續每一個暗場都有潛影；實驗室與望遠鏡上的操作點不一致時，實驗室校正檔全部失效。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing a low bias for minimum dark current leaves the full well too small and saturates every bright calibration star; choosing a high bias for QE lets persistence haunt every subsequent faint field; when the laboratory and telescope operating points differ, all the laboratory calibration files become invalid.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。
為了最低暗電流選了低偏壓，結果滿阱太小、亮校正星全部飽和。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Infrared detectors are cooled only to reduce readout-electronics noise.
Choosing a low bias for minimum dark current leaves the full well too small and saturates every bright calibration star.
quiz.explanation: 為了最低暗電流選了低偏壓，結果滿阱太小、亮校正星全部飽和；或為了 QE 選高偏壓，持續影像讓後續每一個暗場都有潛影；實驗室與望遠鏡上的操作點不一致時，實驗室校正檔全部失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing a low bias for minimum dark current leaves the full well too small and saturates every bright calibration star; choosing a high bias for QE lets persistence haunt every subsequent faint field; when the laboratory and telescope operating points differ, all the laboratory calibration files become invalid. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 超導奈米線單光子偵測器
summary: 從偏置在臨界電流附近的 NbN 或 WSi 奈米線出發，說明一個 0.8 eV 的 1550 nm 光子如何讓整個截面失超並送出 mV 級脈衝，再把光學腔吸收、薄膜與奈米微影、L_k/R 重置、可溯源效率校正、暗計數與時間抖動、2.5 K 低溫整合與操作點選擇串成可交接的單光子接收機紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from an NbN or WSi nanowire biased near its critical current, show how one 0.8 eV photon at 1550 nm drives the whole cross-section normal and launches a millivolt pulse, then link optical-cavity absorption, film growth and nanolithography, L_k/R reset, traceable efficiency calibration, dark counts and timing jitter, 2.5 K cryogenic integration and operating-point choice into a transferable single-photon receiver record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單光子接收通道練習：1550 nm 光子 E = 0.80 eV。16 µm 方形曲折線長 1.28 mm、12 800 個方塊、L_k = 1.02 µH，接 50 Ω 得 τ = 20.5 ns，90% 恢復需 47 ns；在 10 Mcps 下約 37% 的光子落在恢復期內，因此實際應用把計數率限制在 1 Mcps（4.6%）或改用交錯式多像素。效率校正：12.8 fW（10⁵ 光子/s）入射得 93 000 cps，扣除 100 cps 暗計數後 SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015。雜訊：DCR = 10 cps 時 NEP = 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz。時間：σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps，FWHM 19.2 ps，對應光達距離解析度 1.2 mm。若晶片溫度由 2.5 K 漂到 2.6 K，固定偏置由 0.900 升到 0.906 Ic，暗計數約增 1.6 倍至 16 cps，NEP 增為 √1.6 ≈ 1.26 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Single-photon receiver channel exercise: a 1550 nm photon has E = 0.80 eV. A 16 µm square meander 1.28 mm long with 12 800 squares has L_k = 1.02 µH, and into 50 Ω gives τ = 20.5 ns with 90% recovery after 47 ns; at 10 Mcps about 37% of photons land in the recovery window, so the application either limits count rate to 1 Mcps (4.6%) or moves to an interleaved multi-pixel design. Efficiency calibration: 12.8 fW (10⁵ photons per second) yields 93 000 cps, and subtracting 100 cps dark gives SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015. Noise: at DCR = 10 cps, NEP = 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz. Timing: σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps, FWHM 19.2 ps, a lidar range resolution of 1.2 mm. If the chip drifts from 2.5 K to 2.6 K, the fixed bias moves from 0.900 to 0.906 Ic, dark counts grow about 1.6 times to 16 cps and NEP rises by √1.6 ≈ 1.26. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」與「系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" and "System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超導奈米線通常是厚 5 到 7 nm、寬約 100 nm 的 NbN 或 WSi 曲折線，冷到臨界溫度以下並以直流偏置在臨界電流 Ic 的九成左右。吸收一個光子後，能量打斷庫柏對並產生大量準粒子與聲子，形成局部的抑制超導區；電流被迫繞過這個熱點，旁邊截面的電流密度超過臨界值，整段截面轉為約 kΩ 的電阻態。由於這個電阻遠大於 50 Ω 的讀出負載，偏置電流轉入放大器形成電壓脈衝，熱點冷卻後超導恢復、電流再經動態電感流回奈米線。偏置越靠近 Ic，能量越低的光子也能觸發，但暗計數同時上升。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A superconducting nanowire is typically a meander of NbN or WSi 5 to 7 nm thick and about 100 nm wide, cooled below its critical temperature and DC-biased at about 90% of its critical current Ic. An absorbed photon breaks Cooper pairs and creates a cloud of quasiparticles and phonons, forming a local region of suppressed superconductivity; current is forced around this hotspot, the neighbouring cross-section exceeds the critical current density and the whole section turns resistive at about a kilohm. Because that resistance far exceeds the 50 Ω readout load, the bias current diverts into the amplifier as a voltage pulse; the hotspot then cools, superconductivity returns and current flows back into the wire through its kinetic inductance. Biasing closer to Ic lets lower-energy photons trigger but also raises dark counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ = 1550 nm 光子能量 E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV；取 NbN 的 Tc = 9 K，BCS 能隙 Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV，一個光子的能量約為 590 個 Δ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1550 nm photon carries E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV; for NbN with Tc = 9 K the BCS gap is Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV, so one photon holds about 590 gap energies.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
