quiz.question: 關於「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" is correct?
options: SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。
超導奈米線通常是厚 5 到 7 nm、寬約 100 nm 的 NbN 或 WSi 曲折線，冷到臨界溫度以下並以直流偏置在臨界電流 Ic 的九成左右。
奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。
optionsEn: An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier.
A superconducting nanowire is typically a meander of NbN or WSi 5 to 7 nm thick and about 100 nm wide, cooled below its critical temperature and DC-biased at about 90% of its critical current Ic.
Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film.
quiz.explanation: 超導奈米線通常是厚 5 到 7 nm、寬約 100 nm 的 NbN 或 WSi 曲折線，冷到臨界溫度以下並以直流偏置在臨界電流 Ic 的九成左右。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A superconducting nanowire is typically a meander of NbN or WSi 5 to 7 nm thick and about 100 nm wide, cooled below its critical temperature and DC-biased at about 90% of its critical current Ic. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = 1550 nm 光子能量 E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV；取 NbN 的 Tc = 9 K，BCS 能隙 Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV，一個光子的能量約為 590 個 Δ。線寬 100 nm、厚 6 nm、Jc = 5 MA/cm² 時 Ic = 5×10¹⁰ A/m² × 6×10⁻¹⁶ m² = 30 µA；偏置 0.9·Ic = 27 µA 全部轉入 50 Ω 得 1.35 mV 脈衝，需約 40 dB 放大才到 135 mV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 1550 nm photon carries E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV; for NbN with Tc = 9 K the BCS gap is Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV, so one photon holds about 590 gap energies. A wire 100 nm wide and 6 nm thick with Jc = 5 MA/cm² has Ic = 5×10¹⁰ A/m² × 6×10⁻¹⁶ m² = 30 µA; diverting a 0.9·Ic = 27 µA bias into 50 Ω gives a 1.35 mV pulse, needing about 40 dB of gain to reach 135 mV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在暗環境下慢慢掃描偏置電流並記錄電壓，奈米線失超跳變的位置即為 Ic，與由薄膜 Jc 與線截面估算的值比較；再以弱光照射記錄計數率對偏置的曲線，確認在 0.8 到 0.95 Ic 之間出現飽和平台，並以示波器量脈衝振幅是否等於 I_b×50 Ω×增益。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In darkness, slowly sweep the bias and record the voltage; the switching jump marks Ic, to be compared with the value estimated from film Jc and wire cross-section.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: λ = 1550 nm 光子能量 E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV；取 NbN 的 Tc = 9 K，BCS 能隙 Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV，一個光子的能量約為 590 個 Δ。線寬 100 nm、厚 6 nm、Jc = 5 MA/cm² 時 Ic = 5×10¹⁰ A/m² × 6×10⁻¹⁶ m² = 30 µA；偏置 0.9·Ic = 27 µA 全部轉入 50 Ω 得 1.35 mV 脈衝，需約 40 dB 放大才到 135 mV。
knowledge.textEn: A 1550 nm photon carries E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV; for NbN with Tc = 9 K the BCS gap is Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV, so one photon holds about 590 gap energies. A wire 100 nm wide and 6 nm thick with Jc = 5 MA/cm² has Ic = 5×10¹⁰ A/m² × 6×10⁻¹⁶ m² = 30 µA; diverting a 0.9·Ic = 27 µA bias into 50 Ω gives a 1.35 mV pulse, needing about 40 dB of gain to reach 135 mV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation", which statement holds?
options: 奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。
暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。
λ = 1550 nm 光子能量 E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV。
optionsEn: Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster.
Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment.
A 1550 nm photon carries E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV; for NbN with Tc = 9 K the BCS gap is Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV, so one photon holds about 590 gap energies.
quiz.explanation: λ = 1550 nm 光子能量 E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV；取 NbN 的 Tc = 9 K，BCS 能隙 Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV，一個光子的能量約為 590 個 Δ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 1550 nm photon carries E = hc/λ = 0.80 eV; for NbN with Tc = 9 K the BCS gap is Δ = 1.76·k_B·Tc ≈ 1.36 meV, so one photon holds about 590 gap energies. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在暗環境下慢慢掃描偏置電流並記錄電壓，奈米線失超跳變的位置即為 Ic，與由薄膜 Jc 與線截面估算的值比較；再以弱光照射記錄計數率對偏置的曲線，確認在 0.8 到 0.95 Ic 之間出現飽和平台，並以示波器量脈衝振幅是否等於 I_b×50 Ω×增益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In darkness, slowly sweep the bias and record the voltage; the switching jump marks Ic, to be compared with the value estimated from film Jc and wire cross-section. Then illuminate weakly and record count rate versus bias, confirming a saturation plateau between 0.8 and 0.95 Ic, and check on an oscilloscope that the pulse amplitude equals I_b × 50 Ω × amplifier gain. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在暗環境下慢慢掃描偏置電流並記錄電壓，奈米線失超跳變的位置即為 Ic，與由薄膜 Jc 與線截面估算的值比較；再以弱光照射記錄計數率對偏置的曲線，確認在 0.8 到 0.95 Ic 之間出現飽和平台，並以示波器量脈衝振幅是否等於 I_b×50 Ω×增益。
knowledge.textEn: In darkness, slowly sweep the bias and record the voltage; the switching jump marks Ic, to be compared with the value estimated from film Jc and wire cross-section. Then illuminate weakly and record count rate versus bias, confirming a saturation plateau between 0.8 and 0.95 Ic, and check on an oscilloscope that the pulse amplitude equals I_b × 50 Ω × amplifier gain.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation"?
options: 在暗環境下慢慢掃描偏置電流並記錄電壓，奈米線失超跳變的位置即為 Ic，與由薄膜 Jc 與線截面估算的值比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。
optionsEn: In darkness, slowly sweep the bias and record the voltage.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature.
quiz.explanation: 在暗環境下慢慢掃描偏置電流並記錄電壓，奈米線失超跳變的位置即為 Ic，與由薄膜 Jc 與線截面估算的值比較；再以弱光照射記錄計數率對偏置的曲線，確認在 0.8 到 0.95 Ic 之間出現飽和平台，並以示波器量脈衝振幅是否等於 I_b×50 Ω×增益。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In darkness, slowly sweep the bias and record the voltage; the switching jump marks Ic, to be compared with the value estimated from film Jc and wire cross-section. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偏置越靠近 Ic，能量越低的光子也能觸發，但暗計數同時上升。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Biasing closer to Ic lets lower-energy photons trigger but also raises dark counts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感。
奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift.
Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film.
quiz.explanation: 偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光學腔與吸收堆疊」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Optical cavity and absorber stack” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系統偵測效率是三項的乘積：光纖到奈米線的耦合、奈米線對光的吸收，以及吸收後產生脈衝的內部效率。數奈米厚的 NbN 單次通過只吸收約三成，因此把奈米線放在四分之一波長介電間隔層與金屬鏡或分散式布拉格反射鏡形成的光學腔中，讓吸收提高到九成以上。曲折線的填充因子與線方向造成偏振相依：電場平行於線時吸收較強。單模光纖在 1550 nm 的模場直徑約 10.4 µm，主動區必須大於光點並容納對準誤差，這又牽動線長與重置速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光學腔與吸收堆疊」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System detection efficiency is the product of three terms: fibre-to-nanowire coupling, absorption in the nanowire and the internal efficiency of turning an absorption into a pulse. A few-nanometre NbN film absorbs only about 30% in a single pass, so the nanowire sits in an optical cavity formed by a quarter-wave dielectric spacer and a metal mirror or distributed Bragg reflector, raising absorption above 90%. The meander fill factor and wire direction make absorption polarisation-dependent, stronger with the electric field parallel to the wires. Single-mode fibre has a mode-field diameter of about 10.4 µm at 1550 nm, so the active area must exceed the spot and absorb alignment error, which in turn sets wire length and reset speed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Optical cavity and absorber stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光學腔與吸收堆疊」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Optical cavity and absorber stack”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率

knowledge.textEn: System detection efficiency is the product of three terms: fibre-to-nanowire coupling, absorption in the nanowire and the internal efficiency of turning an absorption into a pulse. A few-nanometre NbN film absorbs only about 30% in a single pass, so the nanowire sits in an optical cavity formed by a quarter-wave dielectric spacer and a metal mirror or distributed Bragg reflector, raising absorption above 90%.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency" is correct?
options: 奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。

steps.title: 系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光學腔與吸收堆疊」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Optical cavity and absorber stack” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93。耦合：模場直徑 10.4 µm 的高斯光點偏移 2 µm 落在 16 µm 方形主動區時收集 98.7%，若主動區縮到 10 µm 只剩 82.5%。偏振：平行吸收 0.95、垂直 0.75，非偏振光平均 0.85，偏振比 1.27。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93. Coupling: a Gaussian spot with 10.4 µm mode-field diameter offset by 2 µm on a 16 µm square active area collects 98.7%, but only 82.5% on a 10 µm square. Polarisation: parallel absorption 0.95 and perpendicular 0.75 average 0.85 for unpolarised light, a polarisation ratio of 1.27. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可調波長光源掃描 1450 到 1650 nm 的 SDE，與光學腔模擬的吸收頻譜比較，峰值位置可反推介電間隔層厚度；用偏振控制器找出最大與最小計數率求偏振比；以紅外顯微鏡或背向反射量測光纖與晶片的對準偏移，確認耦合項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan SDE from 1450 to 1650 nm with a tunable source and compare with the simulated cavity absorption spectrum, whose peak position reveals the dielectric spacer thickness; use a polarisation controller to find maximum and minimum count rates for the polarisation ratio; measure fibre-to-chip alignment offset with an infrared microscope or back-reflection to confirm the coupling term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93。耦合：模場直徑 10.4 µm 的高斯光點偏移 2 µm 落在 16 µm 方形主動區時收集 98.7%，若主動區縮到 10 µm 只剩 82.5%。偏振：平行吸收 0.95、垂直 0.75，非偏振光平均 0.85，偏振比 1.27。
knowledge.textEn: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93. Coupling: a Gaussian spot with 10.4 µm mode-field diameter offset by 2 µm on a 16 µm square active area collects 98.7%, but only 82.5% on a 10 µm square. Polarisation: parallel absorption 0.95 and perpendicular 0.75 average 0.85 for unpolarised light, a polarisation ratio of 1.27.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。
optionsEn: Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature.
quiz.explanation: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: SDE = η_c × η_abs × η_int = 0.98 × 0.96 × 0.99 ≈ 0.93. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光學腔與吸收堆疊」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Optical cavity and absorber stack” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以可調波長光源掃描 1450 到 1650 nm 的 SDE，與光學腔模擬的吸收頻譜比較，峰值位置可反推介電間隔層厚度；用偏振控制器找出最大與最小計數率求偏振比；以紅外顯微鏡或背向反射量測光纖與晶片的對準偏移，確認耦合項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan SDE from 1450 to 1650 nm with a tunable source and compare with the simulated cavity absorption spectrum, whose peak position reveals the dielectric spacer thickness; use a polarisation controller to find maximum and minimum count rates for the polarisation ratio; measure fibre-to-chip alignment offset with an infrared microscope or back-reflection to confirm the coupling term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光學腔的間隔層厚度偏差讓吸收峰從 1550 nm 移到 1500 nm，在目標波長的效率掉一成以上；應用端若光纖偏振隨溫度變化，偏振比 1.27 的偵測器會讓計數率起伏，被誤判為光源不穩。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A spacer-thickness error moves the cavity absorption peak from 1550 nm to 1500 nm and costs more than 10% efficiency at the target wavelength; if the application fibre's polarisation drifts with temperature, a detector with a 1.27 polarisation ratio makes count rates wander and is blamed on an unstable source.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可調波長光源掃描 1450 到 1650 nm 的 SDE，與光學腔模擬的吸收頻譜比較，峰值位置可反推介電間隔層厚度；用偏振控制器找出最大與最小計數率求偏振比；以紅外顯微鏡或背向反射量測光纖與晶片的對準偏移，確認耦合項。
knowledge.textEn: Scan SDE from 1450 to 1650 nm with a tunable source and compare with the simulated cavity absorption spectrum, whose peak position reveals the dielectric spacer thickness; use a polarisation controller to find maximum and minimum count rates for the polarisation ratio; measure fibre-to-chip alignment offset with an infrared microscope or back-reflection to confirm the coupling term.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency: failure diagnosis

steps.observation: 連結機制：單模光纖在 1550 nm 的模場直徑約 10.4 µm，主動區必須大於光點並容納對準誤差，這又牽動線長與重置速度。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「系統偵測效率：耦合、吸收與內部效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System detection efficiency: coupling, absorption, internal efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

A spacer-thickness error moves the cavity absorption peak from 1550 nm to 1500 nm and costs more than 10% efficiency at the target wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 光學腔的間隔層厚度偏差讓吸收峰從 1550 nm 移到 1500 nm，在目標波長的效率掉一成以上；應用端若光纖偏振隨溫度變化，偏振比 1.27 的偵測器會讓計數率起伏，被誤判為光源不穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A spacer-thickness error moves the cavity absorption peak from 1550 nm to 1500 nm and costs more than 10% efficiency at the target wavelength; if the application fibre's polarisation drifts with temperature, a detector with a 1.27 polarisation ratio makes count rates wander and is blamed on an unstable source. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感」與「重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance" and "Reset time, latching and maximum count rate": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NbN 以反應式磁控濺鍍沉積在矽、氧化矽或預先鍍好的反射鏡堆疊上，厚度與氮含量決定 Tc 與每方塊數百歐姆的片電阻；WSi 等非晶材料對基板晶格不敏感、內部效率平台寬，但 Tc 只有數 K，需要 1 K 以下操作。電子束微影與反應式離子蝕刻定義 100 nm 線寬、200 nm 節距的曲折線，轉角做成圓弧以減少電流擁擠。整條線的 Ic 由最窄或最薄的一點決定，單一縮頸就會限制整個偵測器能用的偏置。庫柏對的動能使奈米線具有動態電感，與長寬比成正比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: NbN is grown by reactive magnetron sputtering on silicon, silicon oxide or a pre-deposited mirror stack, and thickness and nitrogen content set Tc and a sheet resistance of several hundred ohms per square; amorphous WSi is insensitive to substrate lattice and has a broad internal-efficiency plateau, but its Tc of a few kelvin requires sub-kelvin operation. Electron-beam lithography and reactive-ion etching define a meander with 100 nm lines on a 200 nm pitch, with rounded bends to reduce current crowding. The whole wire's Ic is set by its narrowest or thinnest point, so a single constriction limits the usable bias of the entire detector. The kinetic energy of Cooper pairs gives the wire a kinetic inductance proportional to its length-to-width ratio. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：16 µm × 16 µm 主動區、200 nm 節距共 80 條線，總長 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm，方塊數 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800；取每方塊 80 pH，L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH，填充因子 0.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 16 µm × 16 µm active area on a 200 nm pitch holds 80 lines, total length 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm and 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800 squares; at 80 pH per square L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH, with fill factor 0.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance" is correct?
options: NbN 以反應式磁控濺鍍沉積在矽、氧化矽或預先鍍好的反射鏡堆疊上，厚度與氮含量決定 Tc 與每方塊數百歐姆的片電阻。
只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。
奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。
optionsEn: NbN is grown by reactive magnetron sputtering on silicon, silicon oxide or a pre-deposited mirror stack, and thickness and nitrogen content set Tc and a sheet resistance of several hundred ohms per square.
If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter.
Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster.

quiz.explanationEn: NbN is grown by reactive magnetron sputtering on silicon, silicon oxide or a pre-deposited mirror stack, and thickness and nitrogen content set Tc and a sheet resistance of several hundred ohms per square; amorphous WSi is insensitive to substrate lattice and has a broad internal-efficiency plateau, but its Tc of a few kelvin requires sub-kelvin operation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：16 µm × 16 µm 主動區、200 nm 節距共 80 條線，總長 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm，方塊數 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800；取每方塊 80 pH，L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH，填充因子 0.5。若某處線寬縮到 80 nm（−20%），整條線 Ic 由 30 µA 降到 24 µA，可用偏置 0.9×24 = 21.6 µA 可能已落在效率平台之外。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 16 µm × 16 µm active area on a 200 nm pitch holds 80 lines, total length 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm and 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800 squares; at 80 pH per square L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH, with fill factor 0.5. If one spot narrows to 80 nm (−20%), the whole wire's Ic drops from 30 µA to 24 µA and the usable bias of 0.9×24 = 21.6 µA may fall outside the efficiency plateau. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一晶圓上做四點探針測片電阻與 R(T) 曲線求 Tc，與穿透式或 X 光反射量測的膜厚比較；以掃描式電子顯微鏡抽檢線寬分布，並由室溫電阻除以片電阻求方塊數；低溫下量 Ic 與脈衝衰減時間，交叉檢查動態電感與縮頸是否存在。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sheet resistance and the R(T) curve on witness structures from the same wafer to obtain Tc, comparing with film thickness from transmission microscopy or X-ray reflectivity; sample linewidth distributions by scanning electron microscopy and divide room-temperature resistance by sheet resistance to count squares; at low temperature measure Ic and pulse decay time to cross-check kinetic inductance and the presence of constrictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 16 µm × 16 µm 主動區、200 nm 節距共 80 條線，總長 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm，方塊數 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800；取每方塊 80 pH，L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH，填充因子 0.5。若某處線寬縮到 80 nm（−20%），整條線 Ic 由 30 µA 降到 24 µA，可用偏置 0.9×24 = 21.6 µA 可能已落在效率平台之外。
knowledge.textEn: A 16 µm × 16 µm active area on a 200 nm pitch holds 80 lines, total length 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm and 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800 squares; at 80 pH per square L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH, with fill factor 0.5. If one spot narrows to 80 nm (−20%), the whole wire's Ic drops from 30 µA to 24 µA and the usable bias of 0.9×24 = 21.6 µA may fall outside the efficiency plateau.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance", which statement holds?
options: 暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。
16 µm × 16 µm 主動區、200 nm 節距共 80 條線，總長 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm，方塊數 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800。
偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。
optionsEn: Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment.
A 16 µm × 16 µm active area on a 200 nm pitch holds 80 lines, total length 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm and 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800 squares.
Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice.
quiz.explanation: 16 µm × 16 µm 主動區、200 nm 節距共 80 條線，總長 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm，方塊數 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800；取每方塊 80 pH，L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH，填充因子 0.5。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 16 µm × 16 µm active area on a 200 nm pitch holds 80 lines, total length 80×16 µm = 1.28 mm and 1.28 mm/100 nm = 12 800 squares; at 80 pH per square L_k ≈ 12 800 × 80 pH = 1.02 µH, with fill factor 0.5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一晶圓上做四點探針測片電阻與 R(T) 曲線求 Tc，與穿透式或 X 光反射量測的膜厚比較；以掃描式電子顯微鏡抽檢線寬分布，並由室溫電阻除以片電阻求方塊數；低溫下量 Ic 與脈衝衰減時間，交叉檢查動態電感與縮頸是否存在。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sheet resistance and the R(T) curve on witness structures from the same wafer to obtain Tc, comparing with film thickness from transmission microscopy or X-ray reflectivity; sample linewidth distributions by scanning electron microscopy and divide room-temperature resistance by sheet resistance to count squares; at low temperature measure Ic and pulse decay time to cross-check kinetic inductance and the presence of constrictions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：微影拼接邊界或灰塵造成一處縮頸，元件 Ic 只有設計的七成，計數率對偏置曲線看不到平台，系統效率永遠停在 60% 左右；若只看室溫電阻篩選，這種缺陷無法被發現，直到降溫測試才浪費一整輪低溫週期。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A lithography stitching boundary or particle creates one constriction, leaving device Ic at 70% of design so the count-rate curve never reaches a plateau and system efficiency stalls near 60%; screening by room-temperature resistance alone cannot reveal such defects, which surface only after a whole wasted cooldown cycle.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一晶圓上做四點探針測片電阻與 R(T) 曲線求 Tc，與穿透式或 X 光反射量測的膜厚比較；以掃描式電子顯微鏡抽檢線寬分布，並由室溫電阻除以片電阻求方塊數；低溫下量 Ic 與脈衝衰減時間，交叉檢查動態電感與縮頸是否存在。
knowledge.textEn: Measure sheet resistance and the R(T) curve on witness structures from the same wafer to obtain Tc, comparing with film thickness from transmission microscopy or X-ray reflectivity; sample linewidth distributions by scanning electron microscopy and divide room-temperature resistance by sheet resistance to count squares; at low temperature measure Ic and pulse decay time to cross-check kinetic inductance and the presence of constrictions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。
在同一晶圓上做四點探針測片電阻與 R(T) 曲線求 Tc，與穿透式或 X 光反射量測的膜厚比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier.
Measure sheet resistance and the R(T) curve on witness structures from the same wafer to obtain Tc, comparing with film thickness from transmission microscopy or X-ray reflectivity.
quiz.explanation: 在同一晶圓上做四點探針測片電阻與 R(T) 曲線求 Tc，與穿透式或 X 光反射量測的膜厚比較；以掃描式電子顯微鏡抽檢線寬分布，並由室溫電阻除以片電阻求方塊數；低溫下量 Ic 與脈衝衰減時間，交叉檢查動態電感與縮頸是否存在。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure sheet resistance and the R(T) curve on witness structures from the same wafer to obtain Tc, comparing with film thickness from transmission microscopy or X-ray reflectivity; sample linewidth distributions by scanning electron microscopy and divide room-temperature resistance by sheet resistance to count squares; at low temperature measure Ic and pulse decay time to cross-check kinetic inductance and the presence of constrictions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 微影拼接邊界或灰塵造成一處縮頸，元件 Ic 只有設計的七成，計數率對偏置曲線看不到平台，系統效率永遠停在 60% 左右；若只看室溫電阻篩選，這種缺陷無法被發現，直到降溫測試才浪費一整輪低溫週期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A lithography stitching boundary or particle creates one constriction, leaving device Ic at 70% of design so the count-rate curve never reaches a plateau and system efficiency stalls near 60%; screening by room-temperature resistance alone cannot reveal such defects, which surface only after a whole wasted cooldown cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：庫柏對的動能使奈米線具有動態電感，與長寬比成正比。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The kinetic energy of Cooper pairs gives the wire a kinetic inductance proportional to its length-to-width ratio.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 微影拼接邊界或灰塵造成一處縮頸，元件 Ic 只有設計的七成，計數率對偏置曲線看不到平台，系統效率永遠停在 60% 左右；若只看室溫電阻篩選，這種缺陷無法被發現，直到降溫測試才浪費一整輪低溫週期。
knowledge.textEn: A lithography stitching boundary or particle creates one constriction, leaving device Ic at 70% of design so the count-rate curve never reaches a plateau and system efficiency stalls near 60%; screening by room-temperature resistance alone cannot reveal such defects, which surface only after a whole wasted cooldown cycle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄膜沉積、奈米微影與動態電感」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Film deposition, nanolithography and kinetic inductance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 微影拼接邊界或灰塵造成一處縮頸，元件 Ic 只有設計的七成，計數率對偏置曲線看不到平台，系統效率永遠停在 60% 左右。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。
optionsEn: A lithography stitching boundary or particle creates one constriction, leaving device Ic at 70% of design so the count-rate curve never reaches a plateau and system efficiency stalls near 60%.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster.
quiz.explanation: 微影拼接邊界或灰塵造成一處縮頸，元件 Ic 只有設計的七成，計數率對偏置曲線看不到平台，系統效率永遠停在 60% 左右；若只看室溫電阻篩選，這種缺陷無法被發現，直到降溫測試才浪費一整輪低溫週期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A lithography stitching boundary or particle creates one constriction, leaving device Ic at 70% of design so the count-rate curve never reaches a plateau and system efficiency stalls near 60%; screening by room-temperature resistance alone cannot reveal such defects, which surface only after a whole wasted cooldown cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Reset time, latching and maximum count rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 熱點消失後，偏置電流以 I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)) 回流，時間常數 τ = L_k/R_L 由動態電感與讀出負載決定；電流還沒回到接近 I_b 前，偵測效率偏低，因此死時間約為數個 τ。縮短奈米線可降低 L_k 而加快重置，但若電流回流速度快於熱點冷卻，奈米線會被焦耳熱維持在電阻態而閂鎖，必須切斷偏置才能恢復。高計數率時 AC 耦合放大器的基線偏移也會分走偏置電流。交錯式多像素陣列把光分給多條較短的線，同時兼顧速度與耦合面積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After the hotspot vanishes the bias current returns as I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)), with τ = L_k/R_L set by kinetic inductance and the readout load; until the current is close to I_b the efficiency is reduced, so the dead time is several τ. Shortening the wire lowers L_k and speeds reset, but if current returns faster than the hotspot cools, Joule heating holds the wire resistive and it latches until the bias is removed. At high count rates the baseline shift of an AC-coupled amplifier also steals bias current. Interleaved multi-pixel arrays share light among several shorter wires to combine speed with coupling area. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：L_k = 1.02 µH、R_L = 50 Ω：τ = 20.5 ns，回到 90% 偏置需 τ·ln10 = 47 ns。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With L_k = 1.02 µH and R_L = 50 Ω, τ = 20.5 ns and reaching 90% of bias takes τ·ln10 = 47 ns.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reset time, latching and maximum count rate" is correct?
options: 奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。
熱點消失後，偏置電流以 I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)) 回流，時間常數 τ = L_k/R_L 由動態電感與讀出負載決定。
計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
optionsEn: Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster.
After the hotspot vanishes the bias current returns as I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)), with τ = L_k/R_L set by kinetic inductance and the readout load.
Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 熱點消失後，偏置電流以 I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)) 回流，時間常數 τ = L_k/R_L 由動態電感與讀出負載決定；電流還沒回到接近 I_b 前，偵測效率偏低，因此死時間約為數個 τ。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reset time, latching and maximum count rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：L_k = 1.02 µH、R_L = 50 Ω：τ = 20.5 ns，回到 90% 偏置需 τ·ln10 = 47 ns。泊松到達率 1 Mcps 時，落在前一次偵測後 47 ns 內的光子比例 1 − e^(−0.047) = 4.6%；10 Mcps 時升為 1 − e^(−0.47) = 37%。若把 L_k 降到 100 nH，τ = 2 ns，回流可能快於熱點冷卻而閂鎖。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With L_k = 1.02 µH and R_L = 50 Ω, τ = 20.5 ns and reaching 90% of bias takes τ·ln10 = 47 ns. At a Poisson rate of 1 Mcps, 1 − e^(−0.047) = 4.6% of photons arrive within 47 ns of the previous detection; at 10 Mcps this rises to 1 − e^(−0.47) = 37%. Cutting L_k to 100 nH gives τ = 2 ns, fast enough that current may return before the hotspot cools and the wire latches. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續光源產生高計數率，記錄相鄰事件間隔的直方圖，短間隔處的缺口形狀直接顯示效率恢復曲線並可擬合 τ；同時掃描入射光強，畫出計數率對光子通量的曲線，找出效率下降 3 dB 的計數率；逐步提高偏置確認閂鎖門檻，並記錄脈衝衰減時間與 L_k/R 的一致性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drive high count rates with a CW source and histogram the intervals between consecutive events; the notch at short intervals directly shows the efficiency-recovery curve and can be fitted for τ.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: L_k = 1.02 µH、R_L = 50 Ω：τ = 20.5 ns，回到 90% 偏置需 τ·ln10 = 47 ns。泊松到達率 1 Mcps 時，落在前一次偵測後 47 ns 內的光子比例 1 − e^(−0.047) = 4.6%；10 Mcps 時升為 1 − e^(−0.47) = 37%。若把 L_k 降到 100 nH，τ = 2 ns，回流可能快於熱點冷卻而閂鎖。
knowledge.textEn: With L_k = 1.02 µH and R_L = 50 Ω, τ = 20.5 ns and reaching 90% of bias takes τ·ln10 = 47 ns. At a Poisson rate of 1 Mcps, 1 − e^(−0.047) = 4.6% of photons arrive within 47 ns of the previous detection; at 10 Mcps this rises to 1 − e^(−0.47) = 37%. Cutting L_k to 100 nH gives τ = 2 ns, fast enough that current may return before the hotspot cools and the wire latches.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reset time, latching and maximum count rate", which statement holds?
options: 只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。
SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。
L_k = 1.02 µH、R_L = 50 Ω：τ = 20.5 ns，回到 90% 偏置需 τ·ln10 = 47 ns。
optionsEn: If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature.
An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier.
With L_k = 1.02 µH and R_L = 50 Ω, τ = 20.5 ns and reaching 90% of bias takes τ·ln10 = 47 ns.
quiz.explanation: L_k = 1.02 µH、R_L = 50 Ω：τ = 20.5 ns，回到 90% 偏置需 τ·ln10 = 47 ns。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With L_k = 1.02 µH and R_L = 50 Ω, τ = 20.5 ns and reaching 90% of bias takes τ·ln10 = 47 ns. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reset time, latching and maximum count rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以連續光源產生高計數率，記錄相鄰事件間隔的直方圖，短間隔處的缺口形狀直接顯示效率恢復曲線並可擬合 τ；同時掃描入射光強，畫出計數率對光子通量的曲線，找出效率下降 3 dB 的計數率；逐步提高偏置確認閂鎖門檻，並記錄脈衝衰減時間與 L_k/R 的一致性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drive high count rates with a CW source and histogram the intervals between consecutive events; the notch at short intervals directly shows the efficiency-recovery curve and can be fitted for τ. Sweep the incident flux to plot count rate versus photon flux and find the rate at which efficiency falls by 3 dB; raise bias stepwise to locate the latching threshold, and confirm the pulse decay time agrees with L_k/R. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求速度把奈米線改短，在高光量下元件反覆閂鎖，計數突然歸零直到偏置被重置，自動化量測卻把這段時間記為無光；或在高計數率下忽略 AC 耦合的基線偏移，量到的效率比真實低兩成且隨計數率漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Shortening the wire for speed makes the device latch repeatedly under strong light, counts drop to zero until the bias is reset, and automated runs log that interval as darkness; ignoring AC-coupling baseline shift at high count rates yields efficiencies 20% low that drift with count rate.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續光源產生高計數率，記錄相鄰事件間隔的直方圖，短間隔處的缺口形狀直接顯示效率恢復曲線並可擬合 τ；同時掃描入射光強，畫出計數率對光子通量的曲線，找出效率下降 3 dB 的計數率；逐步提高偏置確認閂鎖門檻，並記錄脈衝衰減時間與 L_k/R 的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: Drive high count rates with a CW source and histogram the intervals between consecutive events; the notch at short intervals directly shows the efficiency-recovery curve and can be fitted for τ. Sweep the incident flux to plot count rate versus photon flux and find the rate at which efficiency falls by 3 dB; raise bias stepwise to locate the latching threshold, and confirm the pulse decay time agrees with L_k/R.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reset time, latching and maximum count rate"?
options: 以連續光源產生高計數率，記錄相鄰事件間隔的直方圖，短間隔處的缺口形狀直接顯示效率恢復曲線並可擬合 τ。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。
optionsEn: Drive high count rates with a CW source and histogram the intervals between consecutive events.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film.
quiz.explanation: 以連續光源產生高計數率，記錄相鄰事件間隔的直方圖，短間隔處的缺口形狀直接顯示效率恢復曲線並可擬合 τ；同時掃描入射光強，畫出計數率對光子通量的曲線，找出效率下降 3 dB 的計數率；逐步提高偏置確認閂鎖門檻，並記錄脈衝衰減時間與 L_k/R 的一致性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Drive high count rates with a CW source and histogram the intervals between consecutive events; the notch at short intervals directly shows the efficiency-recovery curve and can be fitted for τ. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reset time, latching and maximum count rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求速度把奈米線改短，在高光量下元件反覆閂鎖，計數突然歸零直到偏置被重置，自動化量測卻把這段時間記為無光；或在高計數率下忽略 AC 耦合的基線偏移，量到的效率比真實低兩成且隨計數率漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening the wire for speed makes the device latch repeatedly under strong light, counts drop to zero until the bias is reset, and automated runs log that interval as darkness; ignoring AC-coupling baseline shift at high count rates yields efficiencies 20% low that drift with count rate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交錯式多像素陣列把光分給多條較短的線，同時兼顧速度與耦合面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Interleaved multi-pixel arrays share light among several shorter wires to combine speed with coupling area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重置時間、閂鎖與最高計數率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reset time, latching and maximum count rate" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
為了追求速度把奈米線改短，在高光量下元件反覆閂鎖，計數突然歸零直到偏置被重置，自動化量測卻把這段時間記為無光。
計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shortening the wire for speed makes the device latch repeatedly under strong light, counts drop to zero until the bias is reset, and automated runs log that interval as darkness.
Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 為了追求速度把奈米線改短，在高光量下元件反覆閂鎖，計數突然歸零直到偏置被重置，自動化量測卻把這段時間記為無光；或在高計數率下忽略 AC 耦合的基線偏移，量到的效率比真實低兩成且隨計數率漂移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shortening the wire for speed makes the device latch repeatedly under strong light, counts drop to zero until the bias is reset, and automated runs log that interval as darkness; ignoring AC-coupling baseline shift at high count rates yields efficiencies 20% low that drift with count rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」與「暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency" and "Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率的可溯源校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「校正衰減器與功率計」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibrated attenuators and power meter” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。做法是讓 1550 nm 雷射先經校正過的光功率計量測，再串接數個已校正的光纖衰減器把功率降到每秒約十萬個光子，於偏振控制器掃描下記錄計數率，扣除暗計數後除以光子通量。功率計需可溯源到國家計量標準，並在實際使用的功率與波長點驗證線性；衰減器的重複性、接頭插拔與光纖彎曲損失都要列入不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正衰減器與功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat. A 1550 nm laser is first measured with a calibrated optical power meter, then passed through several calibrated fibre attenuators that reduce it to about one hundred thousand photons per second, and the count rate is recorded while a polarisation controller is scanned; dark counts are subtracted and the result divided by the photon flux. The power meter must be traceable to a national standard and verified for linearity at the power and wavelength used, while attenuator repeatability, connector remating and fibre-bend loss all enter the uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibrated attenuators and power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每秒 10⁵ 個光子 × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW，從 1 µW 出發需 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB 衰減。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 10⁵ photons per second × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW, so starting from 1 µW needs 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB of attenuation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「校正衰減器與功率計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Calibrated attenuators and power meter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統偵測效率的可溯源校正
knowledge.titleEn: Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency
knowledge.text: 系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。做法是讓 1550 nm 雷射先經校正過的光功率計量測，再串接數個已校正的光纖衰減器把功率降到每秒約十萬個光子，於偏振控制器掃描下記錄計數率，扣除暗計數後除以光子通量。
knowledge.textEn: System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat. A 1550 nm laser is first measured with a calibrated optical power meter, then passed through several calibrated fibre attenuators that reduce it to about one hundred thousand photons per second, and the count rate is recorded while a polarisation controller is scanned; dark counts are subtracted and the result divided by the photon flux.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency" is correct?
options: 計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。
系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。
optionsEn: Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment.
System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat.
quiz.explanation: 系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率的可溯源校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正衰減器與功率計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibrated attenuators and power meter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每秒 10⁵ 個光子 × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW，從 1 µW 出發需 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB 衰減。量到 93 000 cps、暗計數 100 cps：SDE = (93 000 − 100)/100 000 = 0.929。三段衰減各 ±0.03 dB，RSS 0.052 dB 即 1.2%；功率計 1.0%；合成 1.6%，SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 10⁵ photons per second × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW, so starting from 1 µW needs 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB of attenuation. Measuring 93 000 cps with 100 cps dark gives SDE = (93 000 − 100)/100 000 = 0.929. Three attenuation stages at ±0.03 dB each give an RSS of 0.052 dB, or 1.2%; with 1.0% from the power meter the combined uncertainty is 1.6%, so SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩組不同組合的衰減器重複量測，兩者差異應在合成不確定度內；在三個不同光子通量（例如 10⁴、10⁵、10⁶ /s）量 SDE，確認沒有計數率造成的效率下降；量測前後各接一次功率計檢查雷射漂移，並記錄偏振最大值與平均值兩種 SDE。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the measurement with two different attenuator combinations and require agreement within the combined uncertainty; measure SDE at three photon fluxes such as 10⁴, 10⁵ and 10⁶ per second to confirm no count-rate-induced efficiency loss; reconnect the power meter before and after to check laser drift, and report SDE both at the polarisation maximum and averaged.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: 10⁵ photons per second × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW, so starting from 1 µW needs 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB of attenuation. Measuring 93 000 cps with 100 cps dark gives SDE = (93 000 − 100)/100 000 = 0.929. Three attenuation stages at ±0.03 dB each give an RSS of 0.052 dB, or 1.2%; with 1.0% from the power meter the combined uncertainty is 1.6%, so SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。
奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。
optionsEn: 10⁵ photons per second × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW, so starting from 1 µW needs 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB of attenuation.
Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice.
Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film.
quiz.explanation: 每秒 10⁵ 個光子 × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW，從 1 µW 出發需 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB 衰減。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 10⁵ photons per second × 1.28×10⁻¹⁹ J = 12.8 fW, so starting from 1 µW needs 10·log(10⁻⁶/1.28×10⁻¹⁴) = 78.9 dB of attenuation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率的可溯源校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「校正衰減器與功率計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Calibrated attenuators and power meter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩組不同組合的衰減器重複量測，兩者差異應在合成不確定度內；在三個不同光子通量（例如 10⁴、10⁵、10⁶ /s）量 SDE，確認沒有計數率造成的效率下降；量測前後各接一次功率計檢查雷射漂移，並記錄偏振最大值與平均值兩種 SDE。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat the measurement with two different attenuator combinations and require agreement within the combined uncertainty; measure SDE at three photon fluxes such as 10⁴, 10⁵ and 10⁶ per second to confirm no count-rate-induced efficiency loss; reconnect the power meter before and after to check laser drift, and report SDE both at the polarisation maximum and averaged. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩組不同組合的衰減器重複量測，兩者差異應在合成不確定度內；在三個不同光子通量（例如 10⁴、10⁵、10⁶ /s）量 SDE，確認沒有計數率造成的效率下降；量測前後各接一次功率計檢查雷射漂移，並記錄偏振最大值與平均值兩種 SDE。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat the measurement with two different attenuator combinations and require agreement within the combined uncertainty; measure SDE at three photon fluxes such as 10⁴, 10⁵ and 10⁶ per second to confirm no count-rate-induced efficiency loss; reconnect the power meter before and after to check laser drift, and report SDE both at the polarisation maximum and averaged.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以兩組不同組合的衰減器重複量測，兩者差異應在合成不確定度內。
只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Repeat the measurement with two different attenuator combinations and require agreement within the combined uncertainty.
If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以兩組不同組合的衰減器重複量測，兩者差異應在合成不確定度內；在三個不同光子通量（例如 10⁴、10⁵、10⁶ /s）量 SDE，確認沒有計數率造成的效率下降；量測前後各接一次功率計檢查雷射漂移，並記錄偏振最大值與平均值兩種 SDE。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat the measurement with two different attenuator combinations and require agreement within the combined uncertainty; measure SDE at three photon fluxes such as 10⁴, 10⁵ and 10⁶ per second to confirm no count-rate-induced efficiency loss; reconnect the power meter before and after to check laser drift, and report SDE both at the polarisation maximum and averaged. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統偵測效率的可溯源校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「校正衰減器與功率計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Calibrated attenuators and power meter” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率計需可溯源到國家計量標準，並在實際使用的功率與波長點驗證線性；衰減器的重複性、接頭插拔與光纖彎曲損失都要列入不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The power meter must be traceable to a national standard and verified for linearity at the power and wavelength used, while attenuator repeatability, connector remating and fibre-bend loss all enter the uncertainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。
只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment.
Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short.
quiz.explanation: 只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dark counts and jitter histogram” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暗計數分為本質與外來兩類：本質暗計數來自靠近 Ic 時的磁通渦旋穿越與相位滑移，隨偏置指數上升；外來暗計數主要是室溫黑體輻射沿光纖傳進來的光子與雜散光，可用低溫端的光纖彎繞或濾波器抑制。時間抖動由放大器雜訊除以脈衝斜率、長奈米線上脈衝傳播位置不同造成的幾何抖動、熱點本身的隨機性，以及計時電子學共同決定，以平方和相加。雜訊等效功率 NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η 把效率與暗計數合成一個指標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dark counts are intrinsic or extrinsic: intrinsic counts come from vortex crossings and phase slips near Ic and grow exponentially with bias, while extrinsic counts are mostly room-temperature blackbody photons guided down the fibre plus stray light, suppressed by cold fibre loops or filters. Timing jitter combines amplifier noise divided by pulse slope, geometric jitter from where along a long wire the pulse starts, intrinsic hotspot randomness and the timing electronics, added in quadrature. The noise-equivalent power NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η merges efficiency and dark counts into one figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dark counts and jitter histogram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：脈衝 0.2 V、10–90% 上升 400 ps，斜率 0.2×0.8/400 = 0.4 mV/ps；放大器雜訊 3 mV rms 給 σ = 7.5 ps，加計時電子學 3 ps 與雷射 1 ps，σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps，FWHM = 2.355×8.1 = 19.2 ps。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 0.2 V pulse with 400 ps 10–90% rise has slope 0.2×0.8/400 = 0.4 mV/ps; 3 mV rms amplifier noise gives σ = 7.5 ps, and with 3 ps of timing electronics and 1 ps of laser σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps, FWHM = 2.355×8.1 = 19.2 ps.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Dark counts and jitter histogram”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dark counts and jitter histogram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：脈衝 0.2 V、10–90% 上升 400 ps，斜率 0.2×0.8/400 = 0.4 mV/ps；放大器雜訊 3 mV rms 給 σ = 7.5 ps，加計時電子學 3 ps 與雷射 1 ps，σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps，FWHM = 2.355×8.1 = 19.2 ps。NEP：DCR = 10 cps、η = 0.93 時 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz；DCR = 1000 cps、η = 0.95 時 6.0×10⁻¹⁸，效率多 2% 卻換來 10 倍 NEP。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 0.2 V pulse with 400 ps 10–90% rise has slope 0.2×0.8/400 = 0.4 mV/ps; 3 mV rms amplifier noise gives σ = 7.5 ps, and with 3 ps of timing electronics and 1 ps of laser σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps, FWHM = 2.355×8.1 = 19.2 ps. NEP: at DCR = 10 cps and η = 0.93 it is 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz; at DCR = 1000 cps and η = 0.95 it is 6.0×10⁻¹⁸, ten times worse for 2% more efficiency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：遮住光纖輸入並分別在低溫端加或不加濾波的情況下量 DCR 對偏置曲線，區分本質與黑體貢獻；以飛秒或皮秒脈衝雷射與時間相關單光子計數器記錄到達時間直方圖，求 FWHM 與長尾，並換用低溫放大器或改變觸發準位驗證雜訊項的比重。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cap the fibre input and measure DCR versus bias with and without cold filtering to separate intrinsic and blackbody contributions; record arrival-time histograms with a femtosecond or picosecond pulsed laser and a time-correlated single-photon counter to obtain FWHM and tail, then switch to a cryogenic amplifier or change the trigger level to confirm the weight of the noise term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

NEP: at DCR = 10 cps and η = 0.93 it is 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz; at DCR = 1000 cps and η = 0.95 it is 6.0×10⁻¹⁸, ten times worse for 2% more efficiency.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。

A 0.2 V pulse with 400 ps 10–90% rise has slope 0.2×0.8/400 = 0.4 mV/ps.
If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter.

steps.title: 暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Dark counts and jitter histogram” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 遮住光纖輸入並分別在低溫端加或不加濾波的情況下量 DCR 對偏置曲線，區分本質與黑體貢獻；以飛秒或皮秒脈衝雷射與時間相關單光子計數器記錄到達時間直方圖，求 FWHM 與長尾，並換用低溫放大器或改變觸發準位驗證雜訊項的比重。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cap the fibre input and measure DCR versus bias with and without cold filtering to separate intrinsic and blackbody contributions; record arrival-time histograms with a femtosecond or picosecond pulsed laser and a time-correlated single-photon counter to obtain FWHM and tail, then switch to a cryogenic amplifier or change the trigger level to confirm the weight of the noise term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：實驗室日光燈或未遮光的光纖跳線讓暗計數高出百倍，卻被歸咎於偵測器本身；時間抖動直方圖若只報 FWHM 而忽略長尾，量子通訊的時間窗會漏掉一部分光子並把鄰近時間窗的錯誤率推高。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Room lighting or an unshielded fibre patch cord can raise dark counts a hundredfold and be blamed on the detector itself; reporting only the jitter FWHM while ignoring the long tail lets a quantum-communication time window miss photons and raise the error rate in neighbouring bins.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 遮住光纖輸入並分別在低溫端加或不加濾波的情況下量 DCR 對偏置曲線，區分本質與黑體貢獻；以飛秒或皮秒脈衝雷射與時間相關單光子計數器記錄到達時間直方圖，求 FWHM 與長尾，並換用低溫放大器或改變觸發準位驗證雜訊項的比重。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instructionEn: Room lighting or an unshielded fibre patch cord can raise dark counts a hundredfold and be blamed on the detector itself; reporting only the jitter FWHM while ignoring the long tail lets a quantum-communication time window miss photons and raise the error rate in neighbouring bins. steps.observation: 連結機制：雜訊等效功率 NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η 把效率與暗計數合成一個指標。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 實驗室日光燈或未遮光的光纖跳線讓暗計數高出百倍，卻被歸咎於偵測器本身；時間抖動直方圖若只報 FWHM 而忽略長尾，量子通訊的時間窗會漏掉一部分光子並把鄰近時間窗的錯誤率推高。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「暗計數、時間抖動與雜訊等效功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dark counts, timing jitter and noise-equivalent power" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 實驗室日光燈或未遮光的光纖跳線讓暗計數高出百倍，卻被歸咎於偵測器本身。
