只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。
optionsEn: Room lighting or an unshielded fibre patch cord can raise dark counts a hundredfold and be blamed on the detector itself.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室日光燈或未遮光的光纖跳線讓暗計數高出百倍，卻被歸咎於偵測器本身；時間抖動直方圖若只報 FWHM 而忽略長尾，量子通訊的時間窗會漏掉一部分光子並把鄰近時間窗的錯誤率推高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Room lighting or an unshielded fibre patch cord can raise dark counts a hundredfold and be blamed on the detector itself; reporting only the jitter FWHM while ignoring the long tail lets a quantum-communication time window miss photons and raise the error rate in neighbouring bins. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低溫、射頻與光纖整合」與「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration" and "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低溫、射頻與光纖整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。光纖與同軸線穿過 40 K 與 4 K 級時都要熱錨定，同軸線材質決定熱負載與訊號衰減；偏置透過 bias tee 注入，放大器可放在室溫或低溫級。冷頭以約 1 Hz 振動，若光纖與晶片沒有自對準封裝，振動會調變耦合效率。溫度變化直接改變 Ic，使固定偏置下的 I_b/Ic 漂移，進而改變效率與暗計數；接地迴路與射頻干擾則產生假計數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K. Fibres and coaxial lines must be heat-sunk as they pass the 40 K and 4 K stages, and the coax material sets heat load and signal attenuation; bias enters through a bias tee and the amplifier may sit at room temperature or on a cold stage. The cold head vibrates at about 1 Hz, which modulates coupling unless fibre and chip are in a self-aligned package. Temperature changes shift Ic directly, so a fixed bias drifts in I_b/Ic and changes efficiency and dark counts, while ground loops and RF interference create false counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)² and Tc = 9 K, Ic scales as 0.9228 at 2.5 K and 0.9165 at 2.6 K, a 0.68% drop.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低溫、射頻與光纖整合
knowledge.text: NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。光纖與同軸線穿過 40 K 與 4 K 級時都要熱錨定，同軸線材質決定熱負載與訊號衰減；偏置透過 bias tee 注入，放大器可放在室溫或低溫級。
knowledge.textEn: NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K. Fibres and coaxial lines must be heat-sunk as they pass the 40 K and 4 K stages, and the coax material sets heat load and signal attenuation; bias enters through a bias tee and the amplifier may sit at room temperature or on a cold stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低溫、射頻與光纖整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration" is correct?
options: 只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。
NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。
偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。
optionsEn: If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature.
NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K.
Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice.
quiz.explanation: NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低溫、射頻與光纖整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)²、Tc = 9 K：2.5 K 時 0.9228，2.6 K 時 0.9165，Ic 下降 0.68%。在 2.5 K 設定 0.900·Ic 的固定偏置，到 2.6 K 變成 0.906·Ic；若暗計數每增加 3% Ic 上升 10 倍，0.6% 的漂移使暗計數變為 10^(0.6/3) ≈ 1.6 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)² and Tc = 9 K, Ic scales as 0.9228 at 2.5 K and 0.9165 at 2.6 K, a 0.68% drop. A fixed bias set at 0.900·Ic at 2.5 K becomes 0.906·Ic at 2.6 K; if dark counts rise tenfold per 3% of Ic, this 0.6% drift multiplies them by 10^(0.6/3) ≈ 1.6. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄冷卻曲線、基礎溫度與溫度起伏，與 Ic 隨時間的變化做相關；在冷頭運轉與短暫停機時比較計數率起伏頻譜，判斷 1 Hz 振動造成的耦合調變；以頻譜分析儀檢查放大器輸出的射頻干擾，並在偏置歸零時量測假計數率作為電子學背景。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the cooldown curve, base temperature and its fluctuation and correlate them with Ic over time; compare the count-rate fluctuation spectrum with the cold head running and briefly stopped to identify 1 Hz vibration-induced coupling modulation; inspect the amplifier output on a spectrum analyser for RF interference and measure the false-count rate at zero bias as the electronics background.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)²、Tc = 9 K：2.5 K 時 0.9228，2.6 K 時 0.9165，Ic 下降 0.68%。在 2.5 K 設定 0.900·Ic 的固定偏置，到 2.6 K 變成 0.906·Ic；若暗計數每增加 3% Ic 上升 10 倍，0.6% 的漂移使暗計數變為 10^(0.6/3) ≈ 1.6 倍。
knowledge.textEn: With Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)² and Tc = 9 K, Ic scales as 0.9228 at 2.5 K and 0.9165 at 2.6 K, a 0.68% drop. A fixed bias set at 0.900·Ic at 2.5 K becomes 0.906·Ic at 2.6 K; if dark counts rise tenfold per 3% of Ic, this 0.6% drift multiplies them by 10^(0.6/3) ≈ 1.6.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低溫、射頻與光纖整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration", which statement holds?
options: 奈米線越薄吸收越少，所以效率高一定是因為膜比較厚。
奈米線越短越好，因為重置時間越短。
optionsEn: Thinner wires absorb less, so high efficiency must come from a thicker film.
Shorter nanowires are always better because they reset faster.
With Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)² and Tc = 9 K, Ic scales as 0.9228 at 2.5 K and 0.9165 at 2.6 K, a 0.68% drop.
quiz.explanation: 以 Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)²、Tc = 9 K：2.5 K 時 0.9228，2.6 K 時 0.9165，Ic 下降 0.68%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With Ic(T) ∝ 1 − (T/Tc)² and Tc = 9 K, Ic scales as 0.9228 at 2.5 K and 0.9165 at 2.6 K, a 0.68% drop. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低溫、射頻與光纖整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄冷卻曲線、基礎溫度與溫度起伏，與 Ic 隨時間的變化做相關；在冷頭運轉與短暫停機時比較計數率起伏頻譜，判斷 1 Hz 振動造成的耦合調變；以頻譜分析儀檢查放大器輸出的射頻干擾，並在偏置歸零時量測假計數率作為電子學背景。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the cooldown curve, base temperature and its fluctuation and correlate them with Ic over time; compare the count-rate fluctuation spectrum with the cold head running and briefly stopped to identify 1 Hz vibration-induced coupling modulation; inspect the amplifier output on a spectrum analyser for RF interference and measure the false-count rate at zero bias as the electronics background. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：同軸線沒有在 4 K 級熱錨定，熱負載讓晶片溫度比冷頭高 0.3 K，Ic 下降使原先的偏置點跑到平台外，所有通道效率一起下降卻找不到原因；機櫃與冷頭壓縮機共用接地時，壓縮機馬達的雜訊在計數中出現週期性假事件。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Coax not heat-sunk at the 4 K stage lets the chip run 0.3 K above the cold head, Ic falls and the bias point leaves the plateau, so every channel loses efficiency for no apparent reason; sharing ground between the rack and the cryocooler compressor injects motor noise that appears as periodic false events in the counts.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄冷卻曲線、基礎溫度與溫度起伏，與 Ic 隨時間的變化做相關；在冷頭運轉與短暫停機時比較計數率起伏頻譜，判斷 1 Hz 振動造成的耦合調變；以頻譜分析儀檢查放大器輸出的射頻干擾，並在偏置歸零時量測假計數率作為電子學背景。
knowledge.textEn: Log the cooldown curve, base temperature and its fluctuation and correlate them with Ic over time; compare the count-rate fluctuation spectrum with the cold head running and briefly stopped to identify 1 Hz vibration-induced coupling modulation; inspect the amplifier output on a spectrum analyser for RF interference and measure the false-count rate at zero bias as the electronics background.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低溫、射頻與光纖整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration"?
options: 記錄冷卻曲線、基礎溫度與溫度起伏，與 Ic 隨時間的變化做相關。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
optionsEn: Log the cooldown curve, base temperature and its fluctuation and correlate them with Ic over time.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 記錄冷卻曲線、基礎溫度與溫度起伏，與 Ic 隨時間的變化做相關；在冷頭運轉與短暫停機時比較計數率起伏頻譜，判斷 1 Hz 振動造成的耦合調變；以頻譜分析儀檢查放大器輸出的射頻干擾，並在偏置歸零時量測假計數率作為電子學背景。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the cooldown curve, base temperature and its fluctuation and correlate them with Ic over time; compare the count-rate fluctuation spectrum with the cold head running and briefly stopped to identify 1 Hz vibration-induced coupling modulation; inspect the amplifier output on a spectrum analyser for RF interference and measure the false-count rate at zero bias as the electronics background. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低溫、射頻與光纖整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 同軸線沒有在 4 K 級熱錨定，熱負載讓晶片溫度比冷頭高 0.3 K，Ic 下降使原先的偏置點跑到平台外，所有通道效率一起下降卻找不到原因；機櫃與冷頭壓縮機共用接地時，壓縮機馬達的雜訊在計數中出現週期性假事件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Coax not heat-sunk at the 4 K stage lets the chip run 0.3 K above the cold head, Ic falls and the bias point leaves the plateau, so every channel loses efficiency for no apparent reason; sharing ground between the rack and the cryocooler compressor injects motor noise that appears as periodic false events in the counts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溫度變化直接改變 Ic，使固定偏置下的 I_b/Ic 漂移，進而改變效率與暗計數；接地迴路與射頻干擾則產生假計數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature changes shift Ic directly, so a fixed bias drifts in I_b/Ic and changes efficiency and dark counts, while ground loops and RF interference create false counts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要冷頭溫度讀數正確，晶片溫度就一定一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the cold-head thermometer reads correctly, the chip must be at the same temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同軸線沒有在 4 K 級熱錨定，熱負載讓晶片溫度比冷頭高 0.3 K，Ic 下降使原先的偏置點跑到平台外，所有通道效率一起下降卻找不到原因；機櫃與冷頭壓縮機共用接地時，壓縮機馬達的雜訊在計數中出現週期性假事件。
knowledge.textEn: Coax not heat-sunk at the 4 K stage lets the chip run 0.3 K above the cold head, Ic falls and the bias point leaves the plateau, so every channel loses efficiency for no apparent reason; sharing ground between the rack and the cryocooler compressor injects motor noise that appears as periodic false events in the counts.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低溫、射頻與光纖整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cryogenic, RF and fibre integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
同軸線沒有在 4 K 級熱錨定，熱負載讓晶片溫度比冷頭高 0.3 K，Ic 下降使原先的偏置點跑到平台外，所有通道效率一起下降卻找不到原因。
偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Coax not heat-sunk at the 4 K stage lets the chip run 0.3 K above the cold head, Ic falls and the bias point leaves the plateau, so every channel loses efficiency for no apparent reason.
Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice.
quiz.explanation: 同軸線沒有在 4 K 級熱錨定，熱負載讓晶片溫度比冷頭高 0.3 K，Ic 下降使原先的偏置點跑到平台外，所有通道效率一起下降卻找不到原因；機櫃與冷頭壓縮機共用接地時，壓縮機馬達的雜訊在計數中出現週期性假事件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coax not heat-sunk at the 4 K stage lets the chip run 0.3 K above the cold head, Ic falls and the bias point leaves the plateau, so every channel loses efficiency for no apparent reason; sharing ground between the rack and the cryocooler compressor injects motor noise that appears as periodic false events in the counts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」如何決定超導奈米線單光子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance curves and application link” determines the key performance of “Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收把前面的模型逐項轉成量測：效率對偏置曲線與平台寬度、暗計數對偏置、操作點的時間抖動直方圖、事件間隔直方圖得到的重置時間、計數率飽和曲線、偏振比、降溫時間與溫度穩定度，以及閂鎖門檻。操作點不是單看最高效率，而是依應用指標選擇：量子金鑰分配看金鑰率與錯誤率，深空光通訊看抖動與脈衝位置調變時槽寬，光達看距離解析度。交接紀錄要列出每個通道的 Ic、偏置、溫度、放大器設定與參考面定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: efficiency versus bias and plateau width, dark counts versus bias, the jitter histogram at the operating point, reset time from the inter-event histogram, the count-rate saturation curve, polarisation ratio, cooldown time and temperature stability, and the latching threshold. The operating point is chosen not for maximum efficiency alone but by the application metric: secret-key rate and error rate for quantum key distribution, jitter against pulse-position-modulation slot width for deep-space optical links, and range resolution for lidar. The handoff record lists each channel's Ic, bias, temperature, amplifier settings and reference-plane definition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance curves and application link”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光達距離解析度 δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lidar range resolution is δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance curves and application link”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance curves and application link” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光達距離解析度 δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm。量子金鑰分配用 100 ps 時間窗：σ = 8.1 ps 的高斯抖動落在 ±50 ps 外的比例約 8×10⁻¹⁰，而 DCR = 10 cps 時每個時間窗的暗計數機率 10×10⁻¹⁰ = 1×10⁻⁹，兩者同量級，錯誤率由此估算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lidar range resolution is δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm. For quantum key distribution with 100 ps time bins, a Gaussian jitter of σ = 8.1 ps leaves about 8×10⁻¹⁰ of detections outside ±50 ps, while a DCR of 10 cps gives a dark-count probability of 10×10⁻¹⁰ = 1×10⁻⁹ per bin, the same order, from which the error rate is estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依固定順序執行：降溫與基礎溫度紀錄；各通道 Ic；效率與暗計數對偏置；在選定偏置量時間抖動與重置時間；計數率飽和曲線；偏振比；長時間（例如 12 小時）穩定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Execute in a fixed order: cooldown and base-temperature log; Ic for each channel; efficiency and dark counts versus bias; jitter and reset time at the chosen bias; count-rate saturation curve; polarisation ratio; long-term stability over, for example, 12 hours.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光達距離解析度 δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm。量子金鑰分配用 100 ps 時間窗：σ = 8.1 ps 的高斯抖動落在 ±50 ps 外的比例約 8×10⁻¹⁰，而 DCR = 10 cps 時每個時間窗的暗計數機率 10×10⁻¹⁰ = 1×10⁻⁹，兩者同量級，錯誤率由此估算。
knowledge.textEn: Lidar range resolution is δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm. For quantum key distribution with 100 ps time bins, a Gaussian jitter of σ = 8.1 ps leaves about 8×10⁻¹⁰ of detections outside ±50 ps, while a DCR of 10 cps gives a dark-count probability of 10×10⁻¹⁰ = 1×10⁻⁹ per bin, the same order, from which the error rate is estimated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 光達距離解析度 δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm。
只要平均線寬正確，少數幾個窄點不影響性能。
計數率除以雷射標示功率換算的光子數，就是可靠的效率。
optionsEn: Lidar range resolution is δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm.
If the average linewidth is right, a few narrow spots do not matter.
Count rate divided by photons from the laser's nameplate power gives a reliable efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 光達距離解析度 δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lidar range resolution is δz = c·σ_t/2 = 3×10⁸ × 8.1×10⁻¹² / 2 ≈ 1.2 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance curves and application link” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依固定順序執行：降溫與基礎溫度紀錄；各通道 Ic；效率與暗計數對偏置；在選定偏置量時間抖動與重置時間；計數率飽和曲線；偏振比；長時間（例如 12 小時）穩定度。全部結果與模型值並列於驗收表，偏離超過允收範圍時記錄原因並重新調整偏置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Execute in a fixed order: cooldown and base-temperature log; Ic for each channel; efficiency and dark counts versus bias; jitter and reset time at the chosen bias; count-rate saturation curve; polarisation ratio; long-term stability over, for example, 12 hours. Enter every result beside its model value in the acceptance table, and record the cause and readjust the bias whenever an item exceeds its allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時只留下一個「最佳偏置」數字而沒有記錄當時的溫度與 Ic，下次降溫後基礎溫度略有不同，同一偏置可能落在暗計數暴增區或效率不足區，應用端的金鑰率與錯誤率突然變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Handing over only a single best bias value without the temperature and Ic at which it was set means that after the next cooldown, with a slightly different base temperature, the same bias may sit in the dark-count surge or below the plateau, abruptly worsening the key rate and error rate in the application.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依固定順序執行：降溫與基礎溫度紀錄；各通道 Ic；效率與暗計數對偏置；在選定偏置量時間抖動與重置時間；計數率飽和曲線；偏振比；長時間（例如 12 小時）穩定度。全部結果與模型值並列於驗收表，偏離超過允收範圍時記錄原因並重新調整偏置。
knowledge.textEn: Execute in a fixed order: cooldown and base-temperature log; Ic for each channel; efficiency and dark counts versus bias; jitter and reset time at the chosen bias; count-rate saturation curve; polarisation ratio; long-term stability over, for example, 12 hours. Enter every result beside its model value in the acceptance table, and record the cause and readjust the bias whenever an item exceeds its allowance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
依固定順序執行：降溫與基礎溫度紀錄；各通道 Ic；效率與暗計數對偏置；在選定偏置量時間抖動與重置時間；計數率飽和曲線；偏振比；長時間（例如 12 小時）穩定度。
暗計數完全由偵測器決定，與光纖和環境無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Execute in a fixed order: cooldown and base-temperature log.
Dark counts are set entirely by the detector, regardless of fibre and environment.
quiz.explanation: 依固定順序執行：降溫與基礎溫度紀錄；各通道 Ic；效率與暗計數對偏置；在選定偏置量時間抖動與重置時間；計數率飽和曲線；偏振比；長時間（例如 12 小時）穩定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Execute in a fixed order: cooldown and base-temperature log; Ic for each channel; efficiency and dark counts versus bias; jitter and reset time at the chosen bias; count-rate saturation curve; polarisation ratio; long-term stability over, for example, 12 hours. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance curves and application link” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時只留下一個「最佳偏置」數字而沒有記錄當時的溫度與 Ic，下次降溫後基礎溫度略有不同，同一偏置可能落在暗計數暴增區或效率不足區，應用端的金鑰率與錯誤率突然變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Handing over only a single best bias value without the temperature and Ic at which it was set means that after the next cooldown, with a slightly different base temperature, the same bias may sit in the dark-count surge or below the plateau, abruptly worsening the key rate and error rate in the application. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要列出每個通道的 Ic、偏置、溫度、放大器設定與參考面定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record lists each channel's Ic, bias, temperature, amplifier settings and reference-plane definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偏置設在效率最高點永遠是最佳選擇。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Biasing at maximum efficiency is always the best choice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接時只留下一個「最佳偏置」數字而沒有記錄當時的溫度與 Ic，下次降溫後基礎溫度略有不同，同一偏置可能落在暗計數暴增區或效率不足區，應用端的金鑰率與錯誤率突然變差。
knowledge.textEn: Handing over only a single best bias value without the temperature and Ic at which it was set means that after the next cooldown, with a slightly different base temperature, the same bias may sit in the dark-count surge or below the plateau, abruptly worsening the key rate and error rate in the application.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
SNSPD 像光電倍增管一樣靠電子倍增放大訊號。
交接時只留下一個「最佳偏置」數字而沒有記錄當時的溫度與 Ic，下次降溫後基礎溫度略有不同，同一偏置可能落在暗計數暴增區或效率不足區，應用端的金鑰率與錯誤率突然變差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An SNSPD amplifies its signal by electron multiplication like a photomultiplier.

Handing over only a single best bias value without the temperature and Ic at which it was set means that after the next cooldown, with a slightly different base temperature, the same bias may sit in the dark-count surge or below the plateau, abruptly worsening the key rate and error rate in the application.
quiz.explanation: 交接時只留下一個「最佳偏置」數字而沒有記錄當時的溫度與 Ic，下次降溫後基礎溫度略有不同，同一偏置可能落在暗計數暴增區或效率不足區，應用端的金鑰率與錯誤率突然變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Handing over only a single best bias value without the temperature and Ic at which it was set means that after the next cooldown, with a slightly different base temperature, the same bias may sit in the dark-count surge or below the plateau, abruptly worsening the key rate and error rate in the application. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
summary: 以天文與光譜用的背照式深冷 CCD 為對象，從矽吸收深度與三相時脈的電荷搬運出發，說明為何一個角落像素要經過 8192 次轉移仍不能掉電荷，再把浮動擴散輸出放大器、減薄與深空乏、暗電流溫度律、光子轉移與 Fe-55 增益、像素合併與宇宙射線、多輸出串擾整合成可驗收的相機紀錄。
summaryEn: Using back-illuminated, deep-cooled CCDs for astronomy and spectroscopy, start from silicon absorption depth and three-phase charge transport to show why a corner pixel must survive 8192 transfers without losing charge, then integrate the floating-diffusion output amplifier, thinning and deep depletion, the dark-current temperature law, photon-transfer and Fe-55 gain, binning and cosmic rays, and multi-output crosstalk into an acceptable camera record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 暗弱源曝光規劃練習：窄頻濾鏡下目標每像素 0.02 e⁻/s、天光 0.05 e⁻/s，曝光 900 s，得 S = 18 e⁻、天光 45 e⁻。情境 A：−80 °C（暗電流 0.00013 e⁻/px/s，累積 0.12 e⁻）、50 kHz 讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻，SNR = 18/√(18 + 45 + 0.12 + 8.41) = 18/8.46 = 2.13。情境 B：改用 1 MHz 讀出（7.0 e⁻），SNR = 18/√(112.1) = 1.70。情境 C：只冷到 −40 °C（約 0.0118 e⁻/px/s，累積 10.6 e⁻）、2.9 e⁻，SNR = 18/9.06 = 1.99。若在 A 條件下做晶片上 2×2 合併，SNR = 72/√(72 + 180 + 0.47 + 8.41) = 4.46，比軟體合併的 4.26 只多 5%，因為此時天光已主導雜訊。代價是 2048² 影像以 50 kHz 讀出需 84 s，1 MHz 只需 4.2 s。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Faint-source exposure-planning exercise: through a narrowband filter the target gives 0.02 e⁻/s per pixel and the sky 0.05 e⁻/s; a 900 s exposure yields S = 18 e⁻ and 45 e⁻ of sky. Case A: −80 °C (dark 0.00013 e⁻/px/s, 0.12 e⁻ accumulated) with 2.9 e⁻ read noise at 50 kHz gives SNR = 18/√(18 + 45 + 0.12 + 8.41) = 18/8.46 = 2.13. Case B: 1 MHz readout with 7.0 e⁻ gives SNR = 18/√(112.1) = 1.70. Case C: cooling only to −40 °C (about 0.0118 e⁻/px/s, 10.6 e⁻) with 2.9 e⁻ gives SNR = 18/9.06 = 1.99. Binning 2×2 on chip under case A gives SNR = 72/√(72 + 180 + 0.47 + 8.41) = 4.46, only 5% above the 4.26 of software binning because sky noise now dominates. The cost is readout time: a 2048² frame needs 84 s at 50 kHz but only 4.2 s at 1 MHz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」與「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" and "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背照式矽吸收層」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。前照式 CCD 的光要先穿過多晶矽電極，藍光與紫外在電極中被吸收，量子效率只有四成左右；背照式 CCD 把晶片減薄後從背面受光，加上抗反射膜可在可見光超過九成。但矽對紅光與近紅外的吸收長度很長，900 nm 約 33 µm、1000 nm 約 156 µm，薄元件的紅端效率下降，且前後表面反射形成干涉條紋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式矽吸收層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. In a front-illuminated CCD light must first cross polysilicon gates that absorb blue and ultraviolet, limiting QE to about 40%; a back-illuminated CCD is thinned and illuminated from the back, and with an antireflection coating exceeds 90% in the visible. However, silicon's absorption length is long in the red and near infrared, about 33 µm at 900 nm and 156 µm at 1000 nm, so thin devices lose red response and reflections from both surfaces create interference fringes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率
knowledge.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency
knowledge.text: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。前照式 CCD 的光要先穿過多晶矽電極，藍光與紫外在電極中被吸收，量子效率只有四成左右；背照式 CCD 把晶片減薄後從背面受光，加上抗反射膜可在可見光超過九成。
knowledge.textEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. In a front-illuminated CCD light must first cross polysilicon gates that absorb blue and ultraviolet, limiting QE to about 40%; a back-illuminated CCD is thinned and illuminated from the back, and with an antireflection coating exceeds 90% in the visible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" is correct?
options: 背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。
CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。
optionsEn: A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter.
A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs.
quiz.explanation: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背照式矽吸收層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。15 µm 厚、n = 3.6 的矽在 900 nm 的條紋間距 λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm，夜天光的窄發射線會產生明顯條紋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. A 15 µm layer with n = 3.6 has a fringe spacing at 900 nm of λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm, so narrow night-sky emission lines produce strong fringes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。15 µm 厚、n = 3.6 的矽在 900 nm 的條紋間距 λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm，夜天光的窄發射線會產生明顯條紋。
knowledge.textEn: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. A 15 µm layer with n = 3.6 has a fringe spacing at 900 nm of λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm, so narrow night-sky emission lines produce strong fringes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。
吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%。
optionsEn: Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.
Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.
Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%.
quiz.explanation: 吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「背照式矽吸收層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把薄背照式 CCD 用在近紅外光譜，條紋振幅可達一到三成，若平場與科學影像的照明光譜不同，條紋無法除掉，天光扣除留下週期性殘差；背面鈍化不良時紫外 QE 隨照光歷史漂移，同一顆星的流量前後不一致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a thin back-illuminated CCD for near-infrared spectroscopy produces fringes of 10% to 30%, and if flat-field and science illumination spectra differ the fringes do not divide out, leaving periodic sky-subtraction residuals; with poor backside passivation ultraviolet QE drifts with illumination history so the same star's flux changes from frame to frame.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。
knowledge.textEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency"?
options: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。
optionsEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor.
quiz.explanation: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背照式矽吸收層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把薄背照式 CCD 用在近紅外光譜，條紋振幅可達一到三成，若平場與科學影像的照明光譜不同，條紋無法除掉，天光扣除留下週期性殘差；背面鈍化不良時紫外 QE 隨照光歷史漂移，同一顆星的流量前後不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using a thin back-illuminated CCD for near-infrared spectroscopy produces fringes of 10% to 30%, and if flat-field and science illumination spectra differ the fringes do not divide out, leaving periodic sky-subtraction residuals; with poor backside passivation ultraviolet QE drifts with illumination history so the same star's flux changes from frame to frame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但矽對紅光與近紅外的吸收長度很長，900 nm 約 33 µm、1000 nm 約 156 µm，薄元件的紅端效率下降，且前後表面反射形成干涉條紋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: However, silicon's absorption length is long in the red and near infrared, about 33 µm at 900 nm and 156 µm at 1000 nm, so thin devices lose red response and reflections from both surfaces create interference fringes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三相時脈與電荷轉移」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: CCD 的每個像素是埋入式通道上的 MOS 電容，曝光時光電子被收集在電極下的電位井中。讀出時以三相時脈依序升降相鄰電極的電壓，把整排電荷包一行一行往水平暫存器平移，再一格一格移到輸出放大器。每次轉移留下的比例稱為電荷轉移無效率 CTI，來源是矽中的缺陷陷阱、太空中質子造成的位移損傷與表面態；陷阱先捕獲電子再延後釋放，使影像沿讀出方向拖尾。CTI 在低訊號、低背景時最嚴重，因為沒有其他電荷先把陷阱填滿。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each CCD pixel is a MOS capacitor over a buried channel, and during exposure photoelectrons collect in the potential well under the gates. Readout raises and lowers adjacent gate voltages with three-phase clocks so whole rows of charge packets step toward the serial register and then, pixel by pixel, to the output amplifier. The fraction left behind per transfer is the charge-transfer inefficiency CTI, caused by bulk defect traps, proton displacement damage in space and surface states; traps capture electrons and release them later, trailing the image along the readout direction. CTI is worst at low signal and low background because no other charge has filled the traps first. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Readout raises and lowers adjacent gate voltages with three-phase clocks so whole rows of charge packets step toward the serial register and then, pixel by pixel, to the output amplifier.

knowledge.text: 誤解：CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency" is correct?
options: CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。CTE = 0.999999 時保留 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918，損失 0.82%；CTE = 0.99999 時保留 0.921，損失 7.9%。Fe-55 的 1616 e⁻ X 光事件經 4096 次 CTE = 0.99999 平行轉移剩 1551 e⁻，峰值隨列號線性下降 4%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all. At CTE = 0.999999 it keeps 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918, losing 0.82%; at CTE = 0.99999 it keeps 0.921, losing 7.9%. A 1616 e⁻ Fe-55 X-ray event after 4096 parallel transfers at CTE = 0.99999 retains 1551 e⁻, so the peak falls linearly by 4% across the rows. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate uniformly with an Fe-55 source, select single-pixel events and plot event amplitude against row and column number; the slope divided by the transfer count gives CTI per transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。CTE = 0.999999 時保留 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918，損失 0.82%；CTE = 0.99999 時保留 0.921，損失 7.9%。Fe-55 的 1616 e⁻ X 光事件經 4096 次 CTE = 0.99999 平行轉移剩 1551 e⁻，峰值隨列號線性下降 4%。
knowledge.textEn: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all. At CTE = 0.999999 it keeps 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918, losing 0.82%; at CTE = 0.99999 it keeps 0.921, losing 7.9%. A 1616 e⁻ Fe-55 X-ray event after 4096 parallel transfers at CTE = 0.99999 retains 1551 e⁻, so the peak falls linearly by 4% across the rows.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency", which statement holds?

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三相時脈與電荷轉移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate uniformly with an Fe-55 source, select single-pixel events and plot event amplitude against row and column number; the slope divided by the transfer count gives CTI per transfer. Use extended pixel edge response as well, reading the overscan after a flat-field exposure to measure the charge that trails beyond the last column; repeat at several temperatures and clock voltages to find the operating point with the best CTE. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry; accepting CTE with bright flats only hides the severe low-signal trailing until science data reveal it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。
knowledge.textEn: Illuminate uniformly with an Fe-55 source, select single-pixel events and plot event amplitude against row and column number; the slope divided by the transfer count gives CTI per transfer. Use extended pixel edge response as well, reading the overscan after a flat-field exposure to measure the charge that trails beyond the last column; repeat at several temperatures and clock voltages to find the operating point with the best CTE.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry; accepting CTE with bright flats only hides the severe low-signal trailing until science data reveal it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CTI 在低訊號、低背景時最嚴重，因為沒有其他電荷先把陷阱填滿。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: CTI is worst at low signal and low background because no other charge has filled the traps first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。
