knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某段真空因洩漏或除氣使壓力升高十倍，產生的 H⁰ 不受磁鐵偏轉，在下游第一個偏轉磁鐵處集中撞擊管壁，局部活化超出維護限制；斬波線準直偏差使發射度成長超出預算，PSB 的亮度目標因此落空，即使總傳輸率看起來正常。
knowledge.textEn: A leak or outgassing that raises pressure tenfold in one section produces H⁰ that ignores the magnets and concentrates on the beam pipe at the first downstream dipole, pushing local activation beyond maintenance limits; a chopper-line misalignment that grows emittance beyond budget makes the PSB miss its brightness target even though overall transmission looks normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發射度成長、束流損失與 H⁻ 剝離預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Emittance growth, beam loss and H⁻ stripping budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某段真空因洩漏或除氣使壓力升高十倍，產生的 H⁰ 不受磁鐵偏轉，在下游第一個偏轉磁鐵處集中撞擊管壁，局部活化超出維護限制。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。
optionsEn: A leak or outgassing that raises pressure tenfold in one section produces H⁰ that ignores the magnets and concentrates on the beam pipe at the first downstream dipole, pushing local activation beyond maintenance limits.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete.
quiz.explanation: 某段真空因洩漏或除氣使壓力升高十倍，產生的 H⁰ 不受磁鐵偏轉，在下游第一個偏轉磁鐵處集中撞擊管壁，局部活化超出維護限制；斬波線準直偏差使發射度成長超出預算，PSB 的亮度目標因此落空，即使總傳輸率看起來正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A leak or outgassing that raises pressure tenfold in one section produces H⁰ that ignores the magnets and concentrates on the beam pipe at the first downstream dipole, pushing local activation beyond maintenance limits; a chopper-line misalignment that grows emittance beyond budget makes the PSB miss its brightness target even though overall transmission looks normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈」與「分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting" and "Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。每個環的注入區以局部軌道凸起讓 H⁻ 與循環質子會合，H⁻ 穿過薄碳膜時兩個電子被剝離，變成質子留在環內；未完全剝離的 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 被導向內部吸收器。注入期間逐步改變凸起高度做橫向相空間塗佈，以得到目標發射度與分布；但循環質子每圈都可能再穿過碳膜，引起多重庫侖散射、核反應損失與碳膜加熱，因此塗佈與凸起收回時序必須讓穿膜次數最少。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. In each ring a local orbit bump brings the H⁻ beam alongside the circulating protons, and on crossing a thin carbon foil both electrons are stripped, leaving protons that stay in the ring; partially stripped H⁰ and unstripped H⁻ are steered to an internal dump. The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈
knowledge.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting
knowledge.text: 160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。每個環的注入區以局部軌道凸起讓 H⁻ 與循環質子會合，H⁻ 穿過薄碳膜時兩個電子被剝離，變成質子留在環內；未完全剝離的 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 被導向內部吸收器。
knowledge.textEn: The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. In each ring a local orbit bump brings the H⁻ beam alongside the circulating protons, and on crossing a thin carbon foil both electrons are stripped, leaving protons that stay in the ring; partially stripped H⁰ and unstripped H⁻ are steered to an internal dump.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting" is correct?
options: 剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。
160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。
每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。
optionsEn: A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete.
The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings.
If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too.
quiz.explanation: 160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。每環注入 100 µs 約 99 圈；25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ 個質子（教學假設）；若剝離效率 98%，每環有 3.1×10¹¹ 個粒子送往 H⁰ 吸收器。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern. A 100 µs injection per ring spans about 99 turns; 25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ protons as a teaching assumption, and at 98% stripping efficiency 3.1×10¹¹ particles per ring go to the H⁰ dump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。每環注入 100 µs 約 99 圈；25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ 個質子（教學假設）；若剝離效率 98%，每環有 3.1×10¹¹ 個粒子送往 H⁰ 吸收器。
knowledge.textEn: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern. A 100 µs injection per ring spans about 99 turns; 25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ protons as a teaching assumption, and at 98% stripping efficiency 3.1×10¹¹ particles per ring go to the H⁰ dump.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting", which statement holds?
options: 加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。
斬波器會浪費束流，所以越少用越好。
optionsEn: The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive.
A chopper only wastes beam, so it should be used as little as possible.
The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m.
quiz.explanation: PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting"?
options: 以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。
optionsEn: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy.
quiz.explanation: 以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：注入期間逐步改變凸起高度做橫向相空間塗佈，以得到目標發射度與分布；但循環質子每圈都可能再穿過碳膜，引起多重庫侖散射、核反應損失與碳膜加熱，因此塗佈與凸起收回時序必須讓穿膜次數最少。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。
knowledge.textEn: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失。
每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses.
If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too.
quiz.explanation: 碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reliability run and handoff record” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。整機可用率是串聯子系統可用率的乘積，所以離子源、每一座 RF 站、真空、電源與控制都要分配可用率預算。交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. Overall availability is the product of series subsystem availabilities, so source, every RF station, vacuum, power supplies and controls each receive an availability budget. The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reliability run and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reliability run and handoff record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接
knowledge.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff
knowledge.text: Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。整機可用率是串聯子系統可用率的乘積，所以離子源、每一座 RF 站、真空、電源與控制都要分配可用率預算。
knowledge.textEn: Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. Overall availability is the product of series subsystem availabilities, so source, every RF station, vacuum, power supplies and controls each receive an availability budget.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff" is correct?
options: 每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。
Linac4 的主要目的是提高 LHC 的對撞能量。
Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。
optionsEn: If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too.
Linac4's main purpose is to raise the LHC collision energy.

Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown.
quiz.explanation: Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reliability run and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設 20 座 RF 站各有 99.5% 可用率：0.995²⁰ = 0.905，再乘以離子源 0.99 得 0.896；若每站提升到 99.8%，0.998²⁰ = 0.961，乘以 0.99 得 0.951。可見在串聯系統中，每站僅 0.3% 的改善就讓整機可用率提高約 5.5 個百分點。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source. In a series system a 0.3% improvement per station thus lifts overall availability by about 5.5 percentage points. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設 20 座 RF 站各有 99.5% 可用率：0.995²⁰ = 0.905，再乘以離子源 0.99 得 0.896；若每站提升到 99.8%，0.998²⁰ = 0.961，乘以 0.99 得 0.951。可見在串聯系統中，每站僅 0.3% 的改善就讓整機可用率提高約 5.5 個百分點。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source. In a series system a 0.3% improvement per station thus lifts overall availability by about 5.5 percentage points.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff", which statement holds?
options: 假設 20 座 RF 站各有 99.5% 可用率：0.995²⁰ = 0.905，再乘以離子源 0.99 得 0.896。
RFQ 只負責加速，聚焦完全靠外部磁鐵。
只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。
optionsEn: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896.
The RFQ only accelerates; focusing is done entirely by external magnets.
Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy.
quiz.explanationEn: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reliability run and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時沒有保存各腔的相位掃描參考與離子源參數，某座速調管更換後操作團隊無法快速恢復設定點，停機時間拉長；離子源銫消耗的緩慢變化沒有被記錄，強度逐週下降被誤判為 RF 問題，排查方向錯誤而延誤修復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without saved phase-scan references and source parameters in the handoff, a klystron replacement leaves operations unable to restore set points quickly and downtime stretches; an unlogged slow change in source caesium consumption causes a week-by-week intensity decline that is misdiagnosed as an RF problem, sending troubleshooting the wrong way and delaying repair.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV。
只要損失少於總束流的 1%，就不會造成問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet.
Losing less than 1% of the beam can never cause a problem.
quiz.explanation: 驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reliability run and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時沒有保存各腔的相位掃描參考與離子源參數，某座速調管更換後操作團隊無法快速恢復設定點，停機時間拉長；離子源銫消耗的緩慢變化沒有被記錄，強度逐週下降被誤判為 RF 問題，排查方向錯誤而延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without saved phase-scan references and source parameters in the handoff, a klystron replacement leaves operations unable to restore set points quickly and downtime stretches; an unlogged slow change in source caesium consumption causes a week-by-week intensity decline that is misdiagnosed as an RF problem, sending troubleshooting the wrong way and delaying repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接時沒有保存各腔的相位掃描參考與離子源參數，某座速調管更換後操作團隊無法快速恢復設定點，停機時間拉長；離子源銫消耗的緩慢變化沒有被記錄，強度逐週下降被誤判為 RF 問題，排查方向錯誤而延誤修復。
knowledge.textEn: Without saved phase-scan references and source parameters in the handoff, a klystron replacement leaves operations unable to restore set points quickly and downtime stretches; an unlogged slow change in source caesium consumption causes a week-by-week intensity decline that is misdiagnosed as an RF problem, sending troubleshooting the wrong way and delaying repair.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

summary: 以 SPS 的 744 台常溫偶極磁鐵與 Bρ = 3.3356·p 為起點，理解它如何把 26 GeV/c 質子加速到 450 GeV/c，再把 200 MHz 行波腔與固態放大器、非晶碳鍍膜、線掃描器發射度量測、三階共振慢引出損失預算與向 LHC 轉移的機器保護整合成可驗收的注入器工程。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 斜坡設計練習：SPS 周長 6911.5 m、ρ = 741.3 m，從 26 GeV/c 加速到 450 GeV/c，Bρ 由 86.7 增到 1501 T·m，B 由 0.117 增到 2.02 T。假設平均斜率 Ḃ = 0.2 T/s：斜坡時間 = (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s；每圈能量增益 ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV；f_rev = 43.38 kHz，斜坡約 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ 圈，4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV，與 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c 的動量增量一致。若可用射頻電壓為 7 MV（假設），同步相位 sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146，φs ≈ 8.4°，仍保留足夠的桶面積；把 Ḃ 提高到 0.4 T/s 則 ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV、sin φs ≈ 0.29，桶面積明顯縮小，大強度束流更易失捕。數值為教學假設，不代表實際運轉設定。
workedExample.textEn: Ramp-design exercise: with C = 6911.5 m and ρ = 741.3 m, accelerating from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c raises Bρ from 86.7 to 1501 T·m and B from 0.117 to 2.02 T. Assuming an average Ḃ = 0.2 T/s, the ramp lasts (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s; the energy gain per turn is ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV; at f_rev = 43.38 kHz the ramp spans about 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ turns, and 4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV matches the 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c momentum gain. With 7 MV of RF voltage (assumed) the synchronous phase is sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146, φs ≈ 8.4°, leaving ample bucket area; raising Ḃ to 0.4 T/s gives ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV and sin φs ≈ 0.29, visibly shrinking the bucket so high-intensity beam is more easily lost. Values are teaching assumptions, not operational settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」與「射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV" and "RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “744 main dipole magnets” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “744 main dipole magnets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “744 main dipole magnets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強
knowledge.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV
knowledge.text: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。
knowledge.textEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c].

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV" is correct?
options: SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。
轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。
optionsEn: The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets.
Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.
quiz.explanation: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “744 main dipole magnets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。
knowledge.textEn: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV", which statement holds?
options: 只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。
optionsEn: If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m.
quiz.explanation: 744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「744 台主偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “744 main dipole magnets” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「200 MHz 行波加速腔」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Longitudinal stability depends on the slip factor η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²: above transition, higher-momentum particles take longer per turn. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics" is correct?

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz；h = 4620 時 f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz，桶距 5 ns。26 GeV/c 時 γ = 27.73：Q26（γt = 22.8）η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴；Q20（γt = 18）η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³，約大 2.9 倍。縱向不穩定門檻隨 |η| 上升，因此在相同阻抗下 Q20 可承受更高的束團強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart. At 26 GeV/c, γ = 27.73: for Q26 (γt = 22.8), η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴; for Q20 (γt = 18), η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³, about 2.9 times larger. Longitudinal instability thresholds rise with |η|, so Q20 tolerates higher bunch intensity for the same impedance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

At 26 GeV/c, γ = 27.73: for Q26 (γt = 22.8), η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴; for Q20 (γt = 18), η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³, about 2.9 times larger. Longitudinal instability thresholds rise with |η|, so Q20 tolerates higher bunch intensity for the same impedance.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
