stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」與「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget" and "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速線掃描器」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast wire scanners” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速線掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread. Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast wire scanners”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速線掃描器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fast wire scanners”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算
knowledge.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget
knowledge.text: SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。
knowledge.textEn: The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget" is correct?
options: 幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。
optionsEn: Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ).
quiz.explanation: SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速線掃描器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast wire scanners” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：450 GeV/c 時 βγ = 479.6；假設 ε_n = 2.0 µm、β_w = 70 m：σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm。若 D = 0.5 m、δ = 3×10⁻⁴，D·δ = 0.15 mm，量得 √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm；忽略色散修正會算成 2.15 µm，高估 7.7%。β_w 的 5% 誤差直接造成 5% 的發射度誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm. With D = 0.5 m and δ = 3×10⁻⁴, D·δ = 0.15 mm and the measured width is √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm; skipping the dispersion correction yields 2.15 µm, a 7.7% overestimate. A 5% error in β_w maps directly into a 5% emittance error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm. With D = 0.5 m and δ = 3×10⁻⁴, D·δ = 0.15 mm and the measured width is √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm; skipping the dispersion correction yields 2.15 µm, a 7.7% overestimate. A 5% error in β_w maps directly into a 5% emittance error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget", which statement holds?
options: 固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。
轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。
optionsEn: If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.
quiz.explanationEn: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速線掃描器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fast wire scanners” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測。
常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam.
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.
quiz.explanation: 以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速線掃描器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fast wire scanners” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber.
quiz.explanation: 束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires. A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算
knowledge.titleEn: Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget
knowledge.text: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。
knowledge.textEn: Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget" is correct?
options: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
optionsEn: Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。有效寬度 0.55 mm、假設步距 17 mm：損失 ≈ 3.2%；每次 3.5×10¹³ 顆中約 1.1×10¹² 顆打在分離器區，能量 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ，10.8 s 循環平均約 6.7 kW。彎晶遮蔽使損失再降約 40%，比例約 1.9%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step. With a 0.55 mm effective width and an assumed 17 mm step, the loss is ≈ 3.2%; of 3.5×10¹³ protons per spill about 1.1×10¹² hit the septum region, depositing 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ, about 6.7 kW averaged over a 10.8 s cycle. Bent-crystal shadowing cuts the loss by about 40% more, to roughly 1.9%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較；以二次發射監測器的 spill 時間訊號做頻譜分析，檢查 50 Hz 及其諧波漣波與工作因子；改變六極強度或步距後重測損失，確認損失與步距成反比的趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model; analyse the spectrum of the spill time signal from secondary-emission monitors for 50 Hz harmonics and duty factor; repeat the loss measurement after changing sextupole strength or step size to confirm the inverse dependence on step.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。有效寬度 0.55 mm、假設步距 17 mm：損失 ≈ 3.2%；每次 3.5×10¹³ 顆中約 1.1×10¹² 顆打在分離器區，能量 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ，10.8 s 循環平均約 6.7 kW。彎晶遮蔽使損失再降約 40%，比例約 1.9%。
knowledge.textEn: Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step. With a 0.55 mm effective width and an assumed 17 mm step, the loss is ≈ 3.2%; of 3.5×10¹³ protons per spill about 1.1×10¹² hit the septum region, depositing 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ, about 6.7 kW averaged over a 10.8 s cycle. Bent-crystal shadowing cuts the loss by about 40% more, to roughly 1.9%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget", which statement holds?
options: SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。
常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。
optionsEn: The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step.
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.
quiz.explanation: 損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較；以二次發射監測器的 spill 時間訊號做頻譜分析，檢查 50 Hz 及其諧波漣波與工作因子；改變六極強度或步距後重測損失，確認損失與步距成反比的趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model; analyse the spectrum of the spill time signal from secondary-emission monitors for 50 Hz harmonics and duty factor; repeat the loss measurement after changing sextupole strength or step size to confirm the inverse dependence on step. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降；長期損失使分離器區活化累積，維修前需等待衰減並增加人員劑量。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls; persistent losses accumulate activation in the septum region, forcing cool-down waits and higher personnel dose before maintenance.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較；以二次發射監測器的 spill 時間訊號做頻譜分析，檢查 50 Hz 及其諧波漣波與工作因子；改變六極強度或步距後重測損失，確認損失與步距成反比的趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model; analyse the spectrum of the spill time signal from secondary-emission monitors for 50 Hz harmonics and duty factor; repeat the loss measurement after changing sextupole strength or step size to confirm the inverse dependence on step.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model.
quiz.explanation: 以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較；以二次發射監測器的 spill 時間訊號做頻譜分析，檢查 50 Hz 及其諧波漣波與工作因子；改變六極強度或步距後重測損失，確認損失與步距成反比的趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model; analyse the spectrum of the spill time signal from secondary-emission monitors for 50 Hz harmonics and duty factor; repeat the loss measurement after changing sextupole strength or step size to confirm the inverse dependence on step. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降；長期損失使分離器區活化累積，維修前需等待衰減並增加人員劑量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls; persistent losses accumulate activation in the septum region, forcing cool-down waits and higher personnel dose before maintenance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降；長期損失使分離器區活化累積，維修前需等待衰減並增加人員劑量。
knowledge.textEn: Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls; persistent losses accumulate activation in the septum region, forcing cool-down waits and higher personnel dose before maintenance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
optionsEn: Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降；長期損失使分離器區活化累積，維修前需等待衰減並增加人員劑量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls; persistent losses accumulate activation in the septum region, forcing cool-down waits and higher personnel dose before maintenance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護」與「多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection" and "Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. Extraction kickers must reach full field inside the inter-train gap, and any timing or strength error can steer a whole high-energy train into the transfer line or the LHC injection region; movable injection-protection collimators (TCDI) therefore sit at the end of the lines, an interlock system checks orbit, intensity and magnet currents before extraction, and a low-intensity probe beam validates the path first. Train intensity and emittance set LHC luminosity and also the damage potential of a mistake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護
knowledge.titleEn: Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection
knowledge.text: SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。
knowledge.textEn: The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. Extraction kickers must reach full field inside the inter-train gap, and any timing or strength error can steer a whole high-energy train into the transfer line or the LHC injection region; movable injection-protection collimators (TCDI) therefore sit at the end of the lines, an interlock system checks orbit, intensity and magnet currents before extraction, and a low-intensity probe beam validates the path first.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection" is correct?
options: 450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。
固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。
optionsEn: Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long.
If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
quiz.explanation: SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一串 4×72 = 288 束團、每束團 1.15×10¹¹ 顆、450 GeV：E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ；LIU 強度 2.3×10¹¹ 時約 4.8 MJ。熔化 1 kg 銅需 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J，一串足以熔化約 3.9 至 7.8 kg 銅。LHC 每環 2808 束團約需 2808/288 ≈ 10 次轉移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹. Melting 1 kg of copper takes 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J, so one train could melt about 3.9 to 7.8 kg of copper. Filling 2808 bunches per LHC ring needs about 2808/288 ≈ 10 transfers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪；定期掃描 TCDI 準直器相對束流的中心與以 σ 計的開口；並以刻意給錯設定的測試確認互鎖確實阻止高強度引出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC; periodically scan the TCDI collimators to verify their centring and opening in units of σ; and confirm with deliberately wrong settings that the interlock actually blocks high-intensity extraction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹. Melting 1 kg of copper takes 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J, so one train could melt about 3.9 to 7.8 kg of copper. Filling 2808 bunches per LHC ring needs about 2808/288 ≈ 10 transfers.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection", which statement holds?
options: 轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。
只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
optionsEn: Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.
If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹.
quiz.explanationEn: A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪；定期掃描 TCDI 準直器相對束流的中心與以 σ 計的開口；並以刻意給錯設定的測試確認互鎖確實阻止高強度引出。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC; periodically scan the TCDI collimators to verify their centring and opening in units of σ; and confirm with deliberately wrong settings that the interlock actually blocks high-intensity extraction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：引出踢磁鐵的某個模組未觸發或時序偏移，束串得到錯誤偏角；若保護準直器開口偏大或位置漂移，數 MJ 束流可能打穿真空室並損壞磁鐵線圈，修復需停機數週並延誤 LHC 物理運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If one extraction-kicker module fails to fire or fires late, the train receives the wrong deflection; with a protection collimator opened too wide or drifted, the multi-megajoule beam can pierce the vacuum chamber and damage magnet coils, costing weeks of repair and delaying LHC physics.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪；定期掃描 TCDI 準直器相對束流的中心與以 σ 計的開口；並以刻意給錯設定的測試確認互鎖確實阻止高強度引出。
knowledge.textEn: Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC; periodically scan the TCDI collimators to verify their centring and opening in units of σ; and confirm with deliberately wrong settings that the interlock actually blocks high-intensity extraction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection"?
options: 每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。
optionsEn: Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly.
quiz.explanation: 每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪；定期掃描 TCDI 準直器相對束流的中心與以 σ 計的開口；並以刻意給錯設定的測試確認互鎖確實阻止高強度引出。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC; periodically scan the TCDI collimators to verify their centring and opening in units of σ; and confirm with deliberately wrong settings that the interlock actually blocks high-intensity extraction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 引出踢磁鐵的某個模組未觸發或時序偏移，束串得到錯誤偏角；若保護準直器開口偏大或位置漂移，數 MJ 束流可能打穿真空室並損壞磁鐵線圈，修復需停機數週並延誤 LHC 物理運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If one extraction-kicker module fails to fire or fires late, the train receives the wrong deflection; with a protection collimator opened too wide or drifted, the multi-megajoule beam can pierce the vacuum chamber and damage magnet coils, costing weeks of repair and delaying LHC physics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Train intensity and emittance set LHC luminosity and also the damage potential of a mistake.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

引出踢磁鐵的某個模組未觸發或時序偏移，束串得到錯誤偏角。
固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If one extraction-kicker module fails to fire or fires late, the train receives the wrong deflection.
If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
quiz.explanation: 引出踢磁鐵的某個模組未觸發或時序偏移，束串得到錯誤偏角；若保護準直器開口偏大或位置漂移，數 MJ 束流可能打穿真空室並損壞磁鐵線圈，修復需停機數週並延誤 LHC 物理運轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。LIU 升級把 200 MHz 行波腔由 4 座增為 6 座，並由 Thales 交付兩套固態功率放大器：每套 16 座 144 kW 放大塔、每塔 80 個 1.8 kW 功率模組，全系統 5120 顆電晶體，以大量並聯換取優雅降級與高可用度。驗收必須同時證明束流參數與系統可用度達標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings. The LIU upgrade increased the 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities from four to six and Thales delivered two solid-state transmitters, each with sixteen 144 kW amplifier towers of eighty 1.8 kW RF modules, 5120 transistors in all, trading massive parallelism for graceful degradation and high availability. Acceptance must demonstrate both beam parameters and system availability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收

The LIU upgrade increased the 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities from four to six and Thales delivered two solid-state transmitters, each with sixteen 144 kW amplifier towers of eighty 1.8 kW RF modules, 5120 transistors in all, trading massive parallelism for graceful degradation and high availability.

knowledge.text: 誤解：固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance" is correct?

SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。
optionsEn: If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.

The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings.
quiz.explanation: SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。每座 80 模組的放大塔失去 1 個模組：144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW，僅降 2.5%；全系統 2560 模組總額定 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW。固定靶循環 10.8 s 中平頂 4.8 s，工作因子 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%；超循環插入 LHC 填充循環時，北區平均強度按時間比例下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)². An 80-module tower losing one module gives 144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW, only 2.5% less; the 2560 modules total 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW rated. A 10.8 s fixed-target cycle with a 4.8 s flat top has a duty factor of 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%, and inserting LHC filling cycles into the supercycle lowers North Area average intensity in proportion to time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。每座 80 模組的放大塔失去 1 個模組：144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW，僅降 2.5%；全系統 2560 模組總額定 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW。固定靶循環 10.8 s 中平頂 4.8 s，工作因子 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%；超循環插入 LHC 填充循環時，北區平均強度按時間比例下降。
knowledge.textEn: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)². An 80-module tower losing one module gives 144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW, only 2.5% less; the 2560 modules total 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW rated. A 10.8 s fixed-target cycle with a 4.8 s flat top has a duty factor of 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%, and inserting LHC filling cycles into the supercycle lowers North Area average intensity in proportion to time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance", which statement holds?
options: N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。
常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。
幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。
optionsEn: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)².
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.
Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly.
quiz.explanation: N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻水或電源的單點故障同時切掉多座放大塔時，並聯冗餘失效，腔電壓不足使高強度束流在斜坡中失捕而損失；排程若只追求北區強度而壓縮 LHC 循環，填充延遲，整體物理產出反而下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp; a schedule that squeezes LHC cycles to maximize North Area intensity delays fills and lowers total physics output.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。
knowledge.textEn: Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
quiz.explanation: 逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷卻水或電源的單點故障同時切掉多座放大塔時，並聯冗餘失效，腔電壓不足使高強度束流在斜坡中失捕而損失；排程若只追求北區強度而壓縮 LHC 循環，填充延遲，整體物理產出反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp; a schedule that squeezes LHC cycles to maximize North Area intensity delays fills and lowers total physics output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收必須同時證明束流參數與系統可用度達標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance must demonstrate both beam parameters and system availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp.

title: CERN 反質子減速器
summary: 以 26 GeV/c 質子打銥靶、在 3.57 GeV/c 收集反質子為起點，理解 AD 如何把它們逐平台減速到 100 MeV/c，再由周長 30.4 m 的 ELENA 降到 100 keV，並把隨機冷卻、電子冷卻、Schottky 診斷、極高真空與效率鏈整合成可交接給 ALPHA、AEgIS、BASE 等實驗的低能反物質工程。
summaryEn: Starting from 26 GeV/c protons on an iridium target and antiproton collection at 3.57 GeV/c, see how the AD decelerates them plateau by plateau to 100 MeV/c and the 30.4 m ELENA ring takes them to 100 keV, then integrate stochastic and electron cooling, Schottky diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and the efficiency chain into low-energy antimatter engineering handed to experiments such as ALPHA, AEgIS and BASE.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 減速平台規劃練習：PS 送來的束團長 25 ns、全寬動量分散約 6%（教學假設）。縱向相空間面積守恆，束團旋轉把長度拉到 150 ns 時，理想 Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%，實測約 1.5%，差額來自射頻非線性與絲化。隨機冷卻把 Δp/p 壓到約 0.07% 後才減速；若在 Δp 近似不變下直接從 3.57 減到 0.1 GeV/c，Δp/p 會放大 3.57/0.1 = 35.7 倍，由 0.07% 變成 2.5%，遠超出環的動量接受度，因此每個平台都要再冷卻。100 MeV/c 冷卻後 Δp/p ≈ 0.01%，非相對論近似 ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p，5.31 MeV 的動能分散約 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV；ELENA 在 100 keV 引出時 Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³，ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV。相較之下，以箔片把 5.3 MeV 直接降能時出口能譜寬達數百 keV，只有很小比例落在阱可捕捉的 keV 窗口。數值為教學假設，不代表實機設定。
workedExample.textEn: Deceleration-plateau exercise: bunches from the PS are 25 ns long with a full momentum spread of about 6% (teaching assumption). Longitudinal phase-space area is conserved, so rotating the bunch to 150 ns ideally gives Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%, while about 1.5% is measured, the difference coming from RF nonlinearity and filamentation. Stochastic cooling brings Δp/p to about 0.07% before deceleration; decelerating straight from 3.57 to 0.1 GeV/c with Δp roughly constant would multiply Δp/p by 3.57/0.1 = 35.7, from 0.07% to 2.5%, far beyond the ring's momentum acceptance, which is why every plateau cools again. After cooling at 100 MeV/c, Δp/p ≈ 0.01%; non-relativistically ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p, so the 5.31 MeV kinetic-energy spread is about 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV; ELENA extracts at 100 keV with Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³, giving ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV. By contrast, degrading 5.3 MeV directly in a foil produces an exit spectrum hundreds of keV wide, of which only a small fraction lands in the trappable keV window. Values are teaching assumptions, not machine settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反質子產生、收集與產額」與「減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Antiproton production, collection and yield" and "Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「銥靶與磁喇叭」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Iridium target and magnetic horn” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銥靶與磁喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference. Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Iridium target and magnetic horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「銥靶與磁喇叭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Iridium target and magnetic horn”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額
knowledge.text: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。
knowledge.textEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反質子產生、收集與產額」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Antiproton production, collection and yield" is correct?
options: 反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。
動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。
optionsEn: Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target.
An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy.
quiz.explanation: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銥靶與磁喇叭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Iridium target and magnetic horn” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。產額：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷ 顆 ÷ 1.5×10¹³ 顆質子 ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶。磁喇叭假設電流 400 kA，半徑 2 cm 處 B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T，對 Bρ = 11.9 T·m 的 3.57 GeV/c 粒子提供強聚焦。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Yield: about 5×10⁷ antiprotons injected into the AD ÷ 1.5×10¹³ protons ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶. Assuming a 400 kA horn current, the field at r = 2 cm is B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T, strong focusing for 3.57 GeV/c particles with Bρ = 11.9 T·m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。產額：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷ 顆 ÷ 1.5×10¹³ 顆質子 ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶。磁喇叭假設電流 400 kA，半徑 2 cm 處 B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T，對 Bρ = 11.9 T·m 的 3.57 GeV/c 粒子提供強聚焦。
knowledge.textEn: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Yield: about 5×10⁷ antiprotons injected into the AD ÷ 1.5×10¹³ protons ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶. Assuming a 400 kA horn current, the field at r = 2 cm is B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T, strong focusing for 3.57 GeV/c particles with Bρ = 11.9 T·m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「反質子產生、收集與產額」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Antiproton production, collection and yield", which statement holds?
options: 電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。
反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。
p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。
optionsEn: Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.
Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.
The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c.
quiz.explanation: p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「銥靶與磁喇叭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Iridium target and magnetic horn” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once.

steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反質子產生、收集與產額」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「銥靶與磁喇叭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Iridium target and magnetic horn” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AD 是倒著運轉的同步加速器：磁場與射頻頻率同步下降，把反質子由 3.57 GeV/c 依序減到 2 GeV/c、300 MeV/c 與 100 MeV/c。加速器以動量描述粒子，因為磁剛度 Bρ 正比於動量；實驗端則關心動能。減速時幾何發射度按 1/(βγ) 反向增長、相對動量分散也變大，就像加速時的絕熱阻尼倒過來；若不在平台上冷卻，束流會在減速途中撐滿孔徑而流失。射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The AD is a synchrotron run in reverse: field and RF frequency fall together, taking antiprotons from 3.57 GeV/c to 2 GeV/c, 300 MeV/c and 100 MeV/c. Accelerator physicists describe particles by momentum because magnetic rigidity Bρ is proportional to it, while experiments care about kinetic energy. During deceleration geometric emittance grows as 1/(βγ) and relative momentum spread widens, adiabatic damping run backwards; without cooling on the plateaus the beam would fill the aperture and be lost on the way down. The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 3.57 GeV/c, E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV, kinetic energy 2.75 GeV and β = 0.967; at 100 MeV/c the kinetic energy is 5.31 MeV and β = 0.106.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長
knowledge.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth

quiz.question: 關於「減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth" is correct?
options: 動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。
隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。

Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.
