steps.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線；在每條線末端量測束團長度、發射度與每束團數量，並與實驗阱中實際捕獲數比較，求出從 ELENA 引出到阱內的傳輸效率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation; at the end of each line measure bunch length, emittance and particles per bunch, and compare with the number actually captured in the experiment's trap to obtain the transfer efficiency from ELENA extraction to trap. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降；四個束團的分配時序錯誤時，某一實驗區整個循環都沒有束流。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency; a timing error in distributing the four bunches leaves one experimental zone without beam for the whole cycle.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線；在每條線末端量測束團長度、發射度與每束團數量，並與實驗阱中實際捕獲數比較，求出從 ELENA 引出到阱內的傳輸效率。
knowledge.textEn: During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation; at the end of each line measure bunch length, emittance and particles per bunch, and compare with the number actually captured in the experiment's trap to obtain the transfer efficiency from ELENA extraction to trap.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments"?
options: 試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
一般的直流電流變壓器就能精確量出 AD 的反質子數。
optionsEn: During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An ordinary DC current transformer can accurately count the AD's antiprotons.
quiz.explanation: 試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線；在每條線末端量測束團長度、發射度與每束團數量，並與實驗阱中實際捕獲數比較，求出從 ELENA 引出到阱內的傳輸效率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation; at the end of each line measure bunch length, emittance and particles per bunch, and compare with the number actually captured in the experiment's trap to obtain the transfer efficiency from ELENA extraction to trap. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降；四個束團的分配時序錯誤時，某一實驗區整個循環都沒有束流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency; a timing error in distributing the four bunches leaves one experimental zone without beam for the whole cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：結果使可捕捉的反質子數增加 10 到 100 倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The result is 10 to 100 times more trappable antiprotons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降；四個束團的分配時序錯誤時，某一實驗區整個循環都沒有束流。
knowledge.textEn: Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency; a timing error in distributing the four bunches leaves one experimental zone without beam for the whole cycle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降。
AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency.
The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant.
quiz.explanation: 傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降；四個束團的分配時序錯誤時，某一實驗區整個循環都沒有束流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency; a timing error in distributing the four bunches leaves one experimental zone without beam for the whole cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The roughly 100 s AD cycle” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。循環時間約 100 至 110 s，主要由各平台冷卻時間決定；縮短冷卻會降低束流品質，延長則降低速率。交接紀錄需列出每個平台的強度、發射度、動量分散、循環時間與可用度，讓 ALPHA、AEgIS、ASACUSA、BASE、GBAR 等實驗共享同一份基準，才能把阱內數量的變化追溯到加速器端或實驗端。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The cycle lasts about 100 to 110 s, dominated by cooling time on the plateaus; shortening cooling degrades beam quality while lengthening it lowers the rate. The handoff record must list intensity, emittance, momentum spread, cycle time and availability for every plateau so that ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR and others share one baseline and changes in trapped numbers can be traced to the accelerator or the experiment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The roughly 100 s AD cycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “The roughly 100 s AD cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接
knowledge.titleEn: Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff
knowledge.text: AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。循環時間約 100 至 110 s，主要由各平台冷卻時間決定；縮短冷卻會降低束流品質，延長則降低速率。
knowledge.textEn: The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The cycle lasts about 100 to 110 s, dominated by cooling time on the plateaus; shortening cooling degrades beam quality while lengthening it lowers the rate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff" is correct?
options: AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。
反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。
optionsEn: The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant.
Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.

The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency.
quiz.explanation: AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The roughly 100 s AD cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。以 110 s 循環計，一天約 785 個循環，送出約 1.4×10¹⁰ 顆反質子。1 ng 反質子約 6.0×10¹⁴ 顆，以此速率需約 4.2×10⁴ 天（約 116 年），說明 AD 的產出只適合精密量測，不是生產反物質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%). With a 110 s cycle there are about 785 cycles a day, delivering about 1.4×10¹⁰ antiprotons. One nanogram of antiprotons is about 6.0×10¹⁴ particles, which at this rate takes about 4.2×10⁴ days (about 116 years), showing that the AD's output suits precision measurement, not antimatter production. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數；把效率鏈的每個係數做成趨勢圖，任何係數掉出歷史範圍即觸發檢查；年度停機後以標準循環重新量測全鏈效率，並與前一年的基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts; plot every coefficient of the efficiency chain as a trend and trigger an investigation whenever one leaves its historical band; after the annual shutdown re-measure the full chain on a standard cycle and compare with the previous year's baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。以 110 s 循環計，一天約 785 個循環，送出約 1.4×10¹⁰ 顆反質子。1 ng 反質子約 6.0×10¹⁴ 顆，以此速率需約 4.2×10⁴ 天（約 116 年），說明 AD 的產出只適合精密量測，不是生產反物質。
knowledge.textEn: About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%). With a 110 s cycle there are about 785 cycles a day, delivering about 1.4×10¹⁰ antiprotons. One nanogram of antiprotons is about 6.0×10¹⁴ particles, which at this rate takes about 4.2×10⁴ days (about 116 years), showing that the AD's output suits precision measurement, not antimatter production.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff", which statement holds?
options: 注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。
隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。
一般的直流電流變壓器就能精確量出 AD 的反質子數。
optionsEn: About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%).
Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.
An ordinary DC current transformer can accurately count the AD's antiprotons.
quiz.explanation: 注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “The roughly 100 s AD cycle” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數；把效率鏈的每個係數做成趨勢圖，任何係數掉出歷史範圍即觸發檢查；年度停機後以標準循環重新量測全鏈效率，並與前一年的基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts; plot every coefficient of the efficiency chain as a trend and trigger an investigation whenever one leaves its historical band; after the annual shutdown re-measure the full chain on a standard cycle and compare with the previous year's baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位；實驗端更換捕捉電極或降能結構卻未通知，效率下降會被錯怪為加速器問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located; an unannounced change of trap electrodes or degrader at an experiment makes its efficiency loss look like an accelerator problem.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數；把效率鏈的每個係數做成趨勢圖，任何係數掉出歷史範圍即觸發檢查；年度停機後以標準循環重新量測全鏈效率，並與前一年的基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts; plot every coefficient of the efficiency chain as a trend and trigger an investigation whenever one leaves its historical band; after the annual shutdown re-measure the full chain on a standard cycle and compare with the previous year's baseline.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數。
反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts.
Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.
quiz.explanation: 每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數；把效率鏈的每個係數做成趨勢圖，任何係數掉出歷史範圍即觸發檢查；年度停機後以標準循環重新量測全鏈效率，並與前一年的基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts; plot every coefficient of the efficiency chain as a trend and trigger an investigation whenever one leaves its historical band; after the annual shutdown re-measure the full chain on a standard cycle and compare with the previous year's baseline. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “The roughly 100 s AD cycle” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位；實驗端更換捕捉電極或降能結構卻未通知，效率下降會被錯怪為加速器問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located; an unannounced change of trap electrodes or degrader at an experiment makes its efficiency loss look like an accelerator problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄需列出每個平台的強度、發射度、動量分散、循環時間與可用度，讓 ALPHA、AEgIS、ASACUSA、BASE、GBAR 等實驗共享同一份基準，才能把阱內數量的變化追溯到加速器端或實驗端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must list intensity, emittance, momentum spread, cycle time and availability for every plateau so that ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR and others share one baseline and changes in trapped numbers can be traced to the accelerator or the experiment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位；實驗端更換捕捉電極或降能結構卻未通知，效率下降會被錯怪為加速器問題。
knowledge.textEn: Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located; an unannounced change of trap electrodes or degrader at an experiment makes its efficiency loss look like an accelerator problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located.
quiz.explanation: 只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位；實驗端更換捕捉電極或降能結構卻未通知，效率下降會被錯怪為加速器問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located; an unannounced change of trap electrodes or degrader at an experiment makes its efficiency loss look like an accelerator problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 台灣光子源 TPS
summary: 以 TPS 的 48 台 1.19 T 偶極與每圈 853 keV 的輻射損失為起點，理解 24 單元 DBA 晶格如何達到 1.6 nm·rad 的發射度，再把 240 台四極的磁中心對準、KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔、束流壽命預算、250 Hz 快速軌道回授、同隧道 496.8 m 增能環與真空內波盪器整合成可交接的 3 GeV 光源工程。
summaryEn: Starting from TPS's 48 dipoles at 1.19 T and its 853 keV energy loss per turn, see how a 24-cell DBA lattice reaches 1.6 nm·rad emittance, then integrate magnetic-centre alignment of 240 quadrupoles, KEKB-type 500 MHz superconducting cavities, the lifetime budget, 250 Hz fast orbit feedback, a 496.8 m booster in the same tunnel and in-vacuum undulators into a transferable 3 GeV light-source record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 頂注與光學熱穩定練習：假設光束線第一面反射鏡在 500 mA 時吸收 200 W，熱致斜率靈敏度 0.05 µrad/W，鏡面到樣品 30 m，聚焦光點 5 µm。衰減模式下壽命 τ = 10 h，4 h 後電流 I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA，吸收功率變化 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W，鏡面斜率變化 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad，反射光偏角加倍為 6.6 µrad，在 30 m 外光點移動 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm，是光點尺寸的 40 倍。頂注每 2 min 補注一次時電流起伏 ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%，功率變化 0.67 W，斜率 0.033 µrad，光點移動約 2 µm，小於光點的一半。補注所需電荷 ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC。數值為教學假設，不代表 TPS 實際光束線規格。
workedExample.textEn: Top-up and optics thermal-stability exercise: assume the first beamline mirror absorbs 200 W at 500 mA, has a thermal slope sensitivity of 0.05 µrad/W, sits 30 m from the sample and focuses to a 5 µm spot. In decay mode with τ = 10 h, after 4 h the current is I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA, the absorbed power changes by 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W, the mirror slope by 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad and the reflected beam by twice that, 6.6 µrad, moving the spot 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm at 30 m, forty times the spot size. With top-up every 2 min the current ripple is ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%, the power change 0.67 W, the slope change 0.033 µrad and the spot motion about 2 µm, less than half the spot. Each top-up needs ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC. Values are teaching assumptions, not TPS beamline specifications.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」與「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" and "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn. At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “48 dipoles at 1.19 T”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失
knowledge.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn
knowledge.text: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。
knowledge.textEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" is correct?
options: 臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。
TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.
The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m；θ = 2π/48 = 7.5°、L = 1.1 m → ρ = 8.40 m，B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T。E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV。500 mA 時 P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW，水平每 mrad 約 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m; with θ = 2π/48 = 7.5° and L = 1.1 m, ρ = 8.40 m and B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T. E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV. At 500 mA the power is P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW, about 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W per horizontal milliradian. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m; with θ = 2π/48 = 7.5° and L = 1.1 m, ρ = 8.40 m and B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T. E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV. At 500 mA the power is P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW, about 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W per horizontal milliradian.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn", which statement holds?
options: 超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。
先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。
optionsEn: Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.
First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn.
quiz.explanation: 先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。
knowledge.textEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn"?
options: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss).
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。
knowledge.textEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「24 個雙彎消色散單元」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “24 double-bend achromat cells” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。TPS 採 24 單元雙彎消色散（DBA）晶格，共 48 台偶極，留出 6 段 12 m 與 18 段 7 m 的直線段給插件磁鐵與射頻腔。嚴格消色散時直線段色散為零，但發射度有理論下限；TPS 允許直線段帶少量色散，把發射度壓到低於嚴格 DBA 下限的 1.6 nm·rad，代價是光源點的有效束流尺寸要加上色散與能量分散的貢獻。垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities. A strict achromat keeps zero dispersion in the straights but has a theoretical emittance floor; TPS allows slight dispersion in the straights to reach 1.6 nm·rad, below that strict-DBA floor, at the cost of adding a dispersion-times-energy-spread term to the effective source size. The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “24 double-bend achromat cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “24 double-bend achromat cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度
knowledge.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance
knowledge.text: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。TPS 採 24 單元雙彎消色散（DBA）晶格，共 48 台偶極，留出 6 段 12 m 與 18 段 7 m 的直線段給插件磁鐵與射頻腔。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance" is correct?
options: 發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。
optionsEn: Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance.
quiz.explanation: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “24 double-bend achromat cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。γ = 5871、θ = 0.1309 rad、C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m、J_x = 1：ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad。TPS 實際 1.6 nm·rad 對應因子 F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054，介於 DBA 下限 0.0645 與 TME 0.0215 之間；ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). With γ = 5871, θ = 0.1309 rad, C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m and J_x = 1, ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad. The actual 1.6 nm·rad corresponds to F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054, between the DBA floor of 0.0645 and the TME value of 0.0215; ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。γ = 5871、θ = 0.1309 rad、C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m、J_x = 1：ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad。TPS 實際 1.6 nm·rad 對應因子 F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054，介於 DBA 下限 0.0645 與 TME 0.0215 之間；ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%。
knowledge.textEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). With γ = 5871, θ = 0.1309 rad, C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m and J_x = 1, ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad. The actual 1.6 nm·rad corresponds to F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054, between the DBA floor of 0.0645 and the TME value of 0.0215; ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance", which statement holds?
options: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。
只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x).
Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「24 個雙彎消色散單元」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “24 double-bend achromat cells” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。
knowledge.textEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較。
波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。

Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad.
An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
quiz.explanation: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “24 double-bend achromat cells” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。
knowledge.textEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture.
quiz.explanation: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大」與「超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification" and "SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「240 台四極與 168 台六極」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。TPS 儲存環有 240 台四極與 168 台六極，以墊片調整支腳後機械中心偏差小於 0.01 mm，旋轉線圈量得的磁中心偏差在 0.02 mm 以內，再把磁鐵整組安裝在梗架上對準。2014 年 12 月 31 日在 3 GeV 未開任何修正磁鐵即觀測到首道同步光，顯示對準品質足以讓束流直接繞行。研究也指出被磁化的真空室會擾動磁場並引入多極誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「240 台四極與 168 台六極」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error. The TPS ring has 240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles; after foot shimming the mechanical centres were within 0.01 mm and rotating-coil measurements placed magnetic centres within 0.02 mm before the magnets were aligned as groups on girders. First synchrotron light was observed at 3 GeV on 31 December 2014 with no correctors powered, showing alignment good enough for the beam to circulate directly. Studies also showed that a magnetized vacuum chamber can distort the field and add multipole errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：隨機四極偏移造成的閉合軌道 rms 為 σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Random quadrupole offsets give an rms closed orbit σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「240 台四極與 168 台六極」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大
knowledge.titleEn: Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification
knowledge.text: 四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。TPS 儲存環有 240 台四極與 168 台六極，以墊片調整支腳後機械中心偏差小於 0.01 mm，旋轉線圈量得的磁中心偏差在 0.02 mm 以內，再把磁鐵整組安裝在梗架上對準。
knowledge.textEn: A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error. The TPS ring has 240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles; after foot shimming the mechanical centres were within 0.01 mm and rotating-coil measurements placed magnetic centres within 0.02 mm before the magnets were aligned as groups on girders.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification" is correct?
options: 四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
optionsEn: A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.
quiz.explanation: 四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「240 台四極與 168 台六極」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：隨機四極偏移造成的閉合軌道 rms 為 σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ。假設 β = β_q = 10 m、KL = 0.6 m⁻¹、N = 240、ν ≈ 26.2：√β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90，√(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4，放大係數 ≈ 56；σ_Δ = 20 µm 時未修正軌道 rms 約 1.1 mm，仍在孔徑內但遠大於數 µm 的束流穩定要求，必須靠修正磁鐵與束流基準對準收斂。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Random quadrupole offsets give an rms closed orbit σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ. Assuming β = β_q = 10 m, KL = 0.6 m⁻¹, N = 240 and ν ≈ 26.2, √β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90 and √(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4, an amplification factor of about 56; σ_Δ = 20 µm gives an uncorrected rms orbit of about 1.1 mm, within the aperture but far above the micrometre stability users need, so correctors and beam-based alignment must close the gap. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每台四極以旋轉線圈量測磁中心與多極諧波，記錄相對機械基準的偏差；上梗架後以雷射追蹤儀量測各磁鐵相對梗架基準；有束流時進行束流基準對準（改變單一四極強度並找出軌道不受影響的位置），得到四極與 BPM 的相對偏差並與量測結果比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each quadrupole's magnetic centre and multipole harmonics with a rotating coil and record its offset from the mechanical fiducials; after girder assembly survey every magnet against the girder references with a laser tracker; with beam perform beam-based alignment (vary one quadrupole and find where the orbit is unaffected) to obtain quadrupole-to-BPM offsets and compare with the measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 隨機四極偏移造成的閉合軌道 rms 為 σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ。假設 β = β_q = 10 m、KL = 0.6 m⁻¹、N = 240、ν ≈ 26.2：√β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90，√(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4，放大係數 ≈ 56；σ_Δ = 20 µm 時未修正軌道 rms 約 1.1 mm，仍在孔徑內但遠大於數 µm 的束流穩定要求，必須靠修正磁鐵與束流基準對準收斂。
knowledge.textEn: Random quadrupole offsets give an rms closed orbit σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ. Assuming β = β_q = 10 m, KL = 0.6 m⁻¹, N = 240 and ν ≈ 26.2, √β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90 and √(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4, an amplification factor of about 56; σ_Δ = 20 µm gives an uncorrected rms orbit of about 1.1 mm, within the aperture but far above the micrometre stability users need, so correctors and beam-based alignment must close the gap.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。

quiz.explanation: 隨機四極偏移造成的閉合軌道 rms 為 σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「240 台四極與 168 台六極」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每台四極以旋轉線圈量測磁中心與多極諧波，記錄相對機械基準的偏差；上梗架後以雷射追蹤儀量測各磁鐵相對梗架基準；有束流時進行束流基準對準（改變單一四極強度並找出軌道不受影響的位置），得到四極與 BPM 的相對偏差並與量測結果比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each quadrupole's magnetic centre and multipole harmonics with a rotating coil and record its offset from the mechanical fiducials; after girder assembly survey every magnet against the girder references with a laser tracker; with beam perform beam-based alignment (vary one quadrupole and find where the orbit is unaffected) to obtain quadrupole-to-BPM offsets and compare with the measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：不鏽鋼真空室焊道經加工被磁化，相對導磁率略大於 1，在六極孔徑內產生額外的多極場，動力孔徑縮小、注入效率下降；梗架因地面沉陷而緩慢傾斜時，修正磁鐵電流逐月漂移，最終耗盡修正行程。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Machining can magnetize stainless-steel chamber welds so their relative permeability slightly exceeds 1, adding multipole fields inside sextupole apertures that shrink the dynamic aperture and lower injection efficiency; girders tilting slowly with ground settlement make corrector currents drift month by month until correction range runs out.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「240 台四極與 168 台六極」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 不鏽鋼真空室焊道經加工被磁化，相對導磁率略大於 1，在六極孔徑內產生額外的多極場，動力孔徑縮小、注入效率下降；梗架因地面沉陷而緩慢傾斜時，修正磁鐵電流逐月漂移，最終耗盡修正行程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 儲存環以 499.654 MHz、諧波數 864 的射頻補回每圈輻射損失。三菱重工交付的 KEKB 型模組為單 cell 純鈮超導腔，在 4.5 K 運轉，加速電壓 2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸，搭配額定 300 kW 連續波的功率耦合器。單 cell 加大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外，由束管上的吸收體消耗，避免與 500 mA 的束流產生耦合束團不穩定。超導腔壁損極小，但這少量熱量必須在 4.5 K 移除，每瓦都換算成數百瓦的室溫製冷功率，所以腔電壓、Q 值與低溫系統要一起規劃。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The TPS ring restores its radiation loss with RF at 499.654 MHz and harmonic number 864. The KEKB-type modules delivered by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries are single-cell pure-niobium cavities operating at 4.5 K with 2.4 MV accelerating voltage and Q of 5×10⁸, fed by power couplers rated 300 kW continuous wave. The single cell with large beam pipes lets higher-order modes propagate out to absorbers on the pipes, avoiding coupled-bunch instabilities with the 500 mA beam. Wall loss in a superconducting cavity is tiny, but it must be removed at 4.5 K, where each watt costs hundreds of watts of room-temperature refrigeration, so cavity voltage, Q and cryogenics are planned together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs, f_rev = 578.3 kHz and h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載
knowledge.titleEn: SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load
knowledge.text: TPS 儲存環以 499.654 MHz、諧波數 864 的射頻補回每圈輻射損失。三菱重工交付的 KEKB 型模組為單 cell 純鈮超導腔，在 4.5 K 運轉，加速電壓 2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸，搭配額定 300 kW 連續波的功率耦合器。
knowledge.textEn: The TPS ring restores its radiation loss with RF at 499.654 MHz and harmonic number 864. The KEKB-type modules delivered by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries are single-cell pure-niobium cavities operating at 4.5 K with 2.4 MV accelerating voltage and Q of 5×10⁸, fed by power couplers rated 300 kW continuous wave.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load" is correct?
options: 超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
TPS 儲存環以 499.654 MHz、諧波數 864 的射頻補回每圈輻射損失。
