steps.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs，f_rev = 578.3 kHz，h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864。壁損 P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)，假設 R/Q = 93 Ω：V = 1.2 MV 時 P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W；2.4 MV 時約 124 W。束流功率：U₀ 853 keV 加插件約 300 keV（假設）= 1153 keV，500 mA 時 577 kW，假設 3 組模組分擔，每組約 192 kW，低於 300 kW 耦合器額定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs, f_rev = 578.3 kHz and h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864. Wall loss is P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀); assuming R/Q = 93 Ω, V = 1.2 MV gives P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W and 2.4 MV about 124 W. Beam power: U₀ of 853 keV plus about 300 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 1153 keV, or 577 kW at 500 mA; shared by an assumed three modules, each carries about 192 kW, below the 300 kW coupler rating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現；耦合器以逐步升功率的方式做 RF 調理並記錄真空與電弧偵測；運轉中由液氦蒸發量反推 4.5 K 熱負載，與 V²/((R/Q)Q₀) 的預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand; condition couplers by stepwise power increase while logging vacuum and arc detectors; in operation infer the 4.5 K heat load from helium boil-off and compare with the V²/((R/Q)Q₀) prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs，f_rev = 578.3 kHz，h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864。壁損 P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)，假設 R/Q = 93 Ω：V = 1.2 MV 時 P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W；2.4 MV 時約 124 W。束流功率：U₀ 853 keV 加插件約 300 keV（假設）= 1153 keV，500 mA 時 577 kW，假設 3 組模組分擔，每組約 192 kW，低於 300 kW 耦合器額定。
knowledge.textEn: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs, f_rev = 578.3 kHz and h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864. Wall loss is P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀); assuming R/Q = 93 Ω, V = 1.2 MV gives P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W and 2.4 MV about 124 W. Beam power: U₀ of 853 keV plus about 300 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 1153 keV, or 577 kW at 500 mA; shared by an assumed three modules, each carries about 192 kW, below the 300 kW coupler rating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load", which statement holds?
options: 頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。
optionsEn: Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.
quiz.explanationEn: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs, f_rev = 578.3 kHz and h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現；耦合器以逐步升功率的方式做 RF 調理並記錄真空與電弧偵測；運轉中由液氦蒸發量反推 4.5 K 熱負載，與 V²/((R/Q)Q₀) 的預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand; condition couplers by stepwise power increase while logging vacuum and arc detectors; in operation infer the 4.5 K heat load from helium boil-off and compare with the V²/((R/Q)Q₀) prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失；耦合器窗口電弧觸發連鎖跳脫，每次跳脫都中斷用戶實驗並需重新注入，頻繁跳脫直接拉低可用度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost; a coupler-window arc triggers an interlock trip, each trip interrupts user experiments and requires refilling, and frequent trips directly lower availability.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現；耦合器以逐步升功率的方式做 RF 調理並記錄真空與電弧偵測；運轉中由液氦蒸發量反推 4.5 K 熱負載，與 V²/((R/Q)Q₀) 的預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand; condition couplers by stepwise power increase while logging vacuum and arc detectors; in operation infer the 4.5 K heat load from helium boil-off and compare with the V²/((R/Q)Q₀) prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load"?
options: 腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: 腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現；耦合器以逐步升功率的方式做 RF 調理並記錄真空與電弧偵測；運轉中由液氦蒸發量反推 4.5 K 熱負載，與 V²/((R/Q)Q₀) 的預測比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand; condition couplers by stepwise power increase while logging vacuum and arc detectors; in operation infer the 4.5 K heat load from helium boil-off and compare with the V²/((R/Q)Q₀) prediction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失；耦合器窗口電弧觸發連鎖跳脫，每次跳脫都中斷用戶實驗並需重新注入，頻繁跳脫直接拉低可用度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost; a coupler-window arc triggers an interlock trip, each trip interrupts user experiments and requires refilling, and frequent trips directly lower availability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超導腔壁損極小，但這少量熱量必須在 4.5 K 移除，每瓦都換算成數百瓦的室溫製冷功率，所以腔電壓、Q 值與低溫系統要一起規劃。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wall loss in a superconducting cavity is tiny, but it must be removed at 4.5 K, where each watt costs hundreds of watts of room-temperature refrigeration, so cavity voltage, Q and cryogenics are planned together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失；耦合器窗口電弧觸發連鎖跳脫，每次跳脫都中斷用戶實驗並需重新注入，頻繁跳脫直接拉低可用度。
knowledge.textEn: Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost; a coupler-window arc triggers an interlock trip, each trip interrupts user experiments and requires refilling, and frequent trips directly lower availability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失。
只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost.
Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.
quiz.explanation: 腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失；耦合器窗口電弧觸發連鎖跳脫，每次跳脫都中斷用戶實驗並需重新注入，頻繁跳脫直接拉低可用度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost; a coupler-window arc triggers an interlock trip, each trip interrupts user experiments and requires refilling, and frequent trips directly lower availability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算」與「軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget" and "Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「射頻電壓與能量接受度」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RF voltage and energy acceptance” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。能量接受度取射頻接受度與晶格動量孔徑兩者中較小的一個；射頻接受度由過電壓比 q = eV/U₀ 與動量壓縮因子決定。Touschek 壽命近似與接受度的三次方成正比、與束團密度成反比，因此垂直發射度越小、束團電流越高，壽命越短。殘氣散射與量子壽命則構成其餘項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻電壓與能量接受度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost. The energy acceptance is the smaller of the RF acceptance and the lattice momentum aperture, and the RF acceptance depends on the overvoltage ratio q = eV/U₀ and the momentum compaction. Touschek lifetime scales roughly with the cube of the acceptance and inversely with bunch density, so smaller vertical emittance and higher bunch current both shorten it. Residual-gas scattering and quantum lifetime make up the remaining terms. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF voltage and energy acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「射頻電壓與能量接受度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “RF voltage and energy acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算
knowledge.titleEn: Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget
knowledge.text: 低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。能量接受度取射頻接受度與晶格動量孔徑兩者中較小的一個；射頻接受度由過電壓比 q = eV/U₀ 與動量壓縮因子決定。
knowledge.textEn: The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost. The energy acceptance is the smaller of the RF acceptance and the lattice momentum aperture, and the RF acceptance depends on the overvoltage ratio q = eV/U₀ and the momentum compaction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget" is correct?
options: 只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。
回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。
低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。
optionsEn: Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.

The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost.
quiz.explanation: 低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「射頻電壓與能量接受度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RF voltage and energy acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。假設 V = 3.6 MV、U₀ = 1153 keV（含插件）、α = 2.4×10⁻⁴、h = 864、E = 3 GeV：q = 3.12，sin φs = 1/q，φs ≈ 18.7°，δ_rf ≈ 4.5%。若晶格動量孔徑僅 3%，有效接受度取 3%；再降到 2.5% 時 Touschek 壽命約剩 (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))). Assuming V = 3.6 MV, U₀ = 1153 keV including insertion devices, α = 2.4×10⁻⁴, h = 864 and E = 3 GeV: q = 3.12, sin φs = 1/q, φs ≈ 18.7° and δ_rf ≈ 4.5%. If the lattice momentum aperture is only 3%, the effective acceptance is 3%; dropping to 2.5% leaves the Touschek lifetime at about (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 of its value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命；逐步提高射頻電壓，壽命先增後飽和的轉折點即晶格動量孔徑開始主導之處；改變單束團電流與垂直發射度，分離 Touschek（與束團密度相關）與殘氣（與壓力相關）的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime; raise the RF voltage step by step, and the point where lifetime stops improving marks where the lattice momentum aperture takes over; vary single-bunch current and vertical emittance to separate the Touschek term (bunch density) from the gas term (pressure).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。假設 V = 3.6 MV、U₀ = 1153 keV（含插件）、α = 2.4×10⁻⁴、h = 864、E = 3 GeV：q = 3.12，sin φs = 1/q，φs ≈ 18.7°，δ_rf ≈ 4.5%。若晶格動量孔徑僅 3%，有效接受度取 3%；再降到 2.5% 時 Touschek 壽命約剩 (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 倍。
knowledge.textEn: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))). Assuming V = 3.6 MV, U₀ = 1153 keV including insertion devices, α = 2.4×10⁻⁴, h = 864 and E = 3 GeV: q = 3.12, sin φs = 1/q, φs ≈ 18.7° and δ_rf ≈ 4.5%. If the lattice momentum aperture is only 3%, the effective acceptance is 3%; dropping to 2.5% leaves the Touschek lifetime at about (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 of its value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget", which statement holds?
options: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。
波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))).
An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「射頻電壓與能量接受度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RF voltage and energy acceptance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命；逐步提高射頻電壓，壽命先增後飽和的轉折點即晶格動量孔徑開始主導之處；改變單束團電流與垂直發射度，分離 Touschek（與束團密度相關）與殘氣（與壓力相關）的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime; raise the RF voltage step by step, and the point where lifetime stops improving marks where the lattice momentum aperture takes over; vary single-bunch current and vertical emittance to separate the Touschek term (bunch density) from the gas term (pressure). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命；逐步提高射頻電壓，壽命先增後飽和的轉折點即晶格動量孔徑開始主導之處；改變單束團電流與垂直發射度，分離 Touschek（與束團密度相關）與殘氣（與壓力相關）的貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime; raise the RF voltage step by step, and the point where lifetime stops improving marks where the lattice momentum aperture takes over; vary single-bunch current and vertical emittance to separate the Touschek term (bunch density) from the gas term (pressure).

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命；逐步提高射頻電壓，壽命先增後飽和的轉折點即晶格動量孔徑開始主導之處；改變單束團電流與垂直發射度，分離 Touschek（與束團密度相關）與殘氣（與壓力相關）的貢獻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime; raise the RF voltage step by step, and the point where lifetime stops improving marks where the lattice momentum aperture takes over; vary single-bunch current and vertical emittance to separate the Touschek term (bunch density) from the gas term (pressure). Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「射頻電壓與能量接受度」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “RF voltage and energy acceptance” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘氣散射與量子壽命則構成其餘項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual-gas scattering and quantum lifetime make up the remaining terms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。
knowledge.textEn: A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。
一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.
A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held.
quiz.explanation: 一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。TPS 的垂直發射度只有 16 pm·rad，直線段的垂直束流尺寸只有數 µm，因此軌道必須穩到次微米。擾動來源包括地面振動、冷卻水流動、磁鐵電源漣波、溫度漂移與插件間隙變化。快速軌道回授以全環 BPM 讀值每秒更新數千次，經響應矩陣反解後驅動修正磁鐵，水平約 250 Hz、垂直約 300 Hz 的頻寬內可壓低擾動，頻寬以上則無能為力，甚至可能放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence. With a vertical emittance of only 16 pm·rad, the vertical beam size in a straight is a few micrometres, so the orbit must be stable to below a micrometre. Disturbances come from ground vibration, cooling-water flow, magnet power-supply ripple, temperature drift and insertion-device gap changes. Fast orbit feedback reads all BPMs thousands of times per second, inverts the response matrix and drives correctors, suppressing disturbances within a bandwidth of about 250 Hz horizontally and 300 Hz vertically; above that it cannot help and may even amplify. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授
knowledge.titleEn: Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback
knowledge.text: 光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。TPS 的垂直發射度只有 16 pm·rad，直線段的垂直束流尺寸只有數 µm，因此軌道必須穩到次微米。
knowledge.textEn: Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence. With a vertical emittance of only 16 pm·rad, the vertical beam size in a straight is a few micrometres, so the orbit must be stable to below a micrometre.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback" is correct?
options: 光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。
回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: 光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。積分型回授在 f ≪ f_bw 時抑制比約 f/f_bw：10 Hz、3 µm 的擾動在 250 Hz 頻寬下剩 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm，符合要求；同樣 3 µm 若出現在 400 Hz 則幾乎不受抑制，必須從源頭（如泵浦或電源）處理。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm. An integrating feedback suppresses by about f/f_bw for f ≪ f_bw: a 3 µm disturbance at 10 Hz becomes 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm with 250 Hz bandwidth, meeting the requirement, while the same 3 µm at 400 Hz is barely suppressed and must be removed at its source, such as a pump or power supply. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms；同時在光束線用光子 BPM 量光點位置，確認電子軌道穩定確實轉換為光源穩定；以注入已知頻率的人為擾動量測閉迴路傳遞函數，定出實際頻寬與放大區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off; measure the photon-beam position on beamline photon BPMs to confirm electron-orbit stability translates into source stability; inject a known-frequency disturbance to measure the closed-loop transfer function and locate the real bandwidth and amplification region.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。積分型回授在 f ≪ f_bw 時抑制比約 f/f_bw：10 Hz、3 µm 的擾動在 250 Hz 頻寬下剩 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm，符合要求；同樣 3 µm 若出現在 400 Hz 則幾乎不受抑制，必須從源頭（如泵浦或電源）處理。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm. An integrating feedback suppresses by about f/f_bw for f ≪ f_bw: a 3 µm disturbance at 10 Hz becomes 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm with 250 Hz bandwidth, meeting the requirement, while the same 3 µm at 400 Hz is barely suppressed and must be removed at its source, such as a pump or power supply.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback", which statement holds?
options: 臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。
假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.
Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms；同時在光束線用光子 BPM 量光點位置，確認電子軌道穩定確實轉換為光源穩定；以注入已知頻率的人為擾動量測閉迴路傳遞函數，定出實際頻寬與放大區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off; measure the photon-beam position on beamline photon BPMs to confirm electron-orbit stability translates into source stability; inject a known-frequency disturbance to measure the closed-loop transfer function and locate the real bandwidth and amplification region. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動；修正磁鐵電源達到飽和時回授失效，某些頻段的擾動突然出現在所有光束線。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps; when corrector supplies saturate the feedback fails and disturbances in some bands suddenly appear on every beamline.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms；同時在光束線用光子 BPM 量光點位置，確認電子軌道穩定確實轉換為光源穩定；以注入已知頻率的人為擾動量測閉迴路傳遞函數，定出實際頻寬與放大區。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off; measure the photon-beam position on beamline photon BPMs to confirm electron-orbit stability translates into source stability; inject a known-frequency disturbance to measure the closed-loop transfer function and locate the real bandwidth and amplification region.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.
Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off.
quiz.explanation: 以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms；同時在光束線用光子 BPM 量光點位置，確認電子軌道穩定確實轉換為光源穩定；以注入已知頻率的人為擾動量測閉迴路傳遞函數，定出實際頻寬與放大區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off; measure the photon-beam position on beamline photon BPMs to confirm electron-orbit stability translates into source stability; inject a known-frequency disturbance to measure the closed-loop transfer function and locate the real bandwidth and amplification region. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動；修正磁鐵電源達到飽和時回授失效，某些頻段的擾動突然出現在所有光束線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps; when corrector supplies saturate the feedback fails and disturbances in some bands suddenly appear on every beamline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：快速軌道回授以全環 BPM 讀值每秒更新數千次，經響應矩陣反解後驅動修正磁鐵，水平約 250 Hz、垂直約 300 Hz 的頻寬內可壓低擾動，頻寬以上則無能為力，甚至可能放大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fast orbit feedback reads all BPMs thousands of times per second, inverts the response matrix and drives correctors, suppressing disturbances within a bandwidth of about 250 Hz horizontally and 300 Hz vertically; above that it cannot help and may even amplify.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動；修正磁鐵電源達到飽和時回授失效，某些頻段的擾動突然出現在所有光束線。
knowledge.textEn: When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps; when corrector supplies saturate the feedback fails and disturbances in some bands suddenly appear on every beamline.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動；修正磁鐵電源達到飽和時回授失效，某些頻段的擾動突然出現在所有光束線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps; when corrector supplies saturate the feedback fails and disturbances in some bands suddenly appear on every beamline. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合」與「插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration" and "Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一；大周長讓組合功能 FODO 晶格在 3 GeV 達到約 10 nm·rad 的發射度，提高注入效率，也省下另一座隧道的土建。直線加速器的電子在增能環內由 150 MeV 升到 3 GeV，再注入儲存環。頂注運轉每隔數分鐘補充少量電荷，使儲存電流維持近乎恆定，光束線光學元件的熱負載因此穩定。增能環於 2014 年 12 月 12 日開始束流試運轉，12 月 16 日達到 3 GeV。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source; its large circumference lets a combined-function FODO lattice reach about 10 nm·rad at 3 GeV, improving injection efficiency and saving a second tunnel. Electrons from the linac are ramped in the booster from 150 MeV to 3 GeV and injected into the storage ring. Top-up adds a small charge every few minutes so the stored current stays nearly constant and beamline optics see a steady heat load. Booster beam commissioning began on 12 December 2014 and reached 3 GeV on 16 December. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合
knowledge.text: TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一；大周長讓組合功能 FODO 晶格在 3 GeV 達到約 10 nm·rad 的發射度，提高注入效率，也省下另一座隧道的土建。直線加速器的電子在增能環內由 150 MeV 升到 3 GeV，再注入儲存環。
knowledge.textEn: The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source; its large circumference lets a combined-function FODO lattice reach about 10 nm·rad at 3 GeV, improving injection efficiency and saving a second tunnel. Electrons from the linac are ramped in the booster from 150 MeV to 3 GeV and injected into the storage ring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration" is correct?
options: 頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一。
波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。
optionsEn: Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source.
An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
quiz.explanation: TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一；大周長讓組合功能 FODO 晶格在 3 GeV 達到約 10 nm·rad 的發射度，提高注入效率，也省下另一座隧道的土建。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source; its large circumference lets a combined-function FODO lattice reach about 10 nm·rad at 3 GeV, improving injection efficiency and saving a second tunnel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。假設儲存環壽命 10 h、每 2 min 補注一次：ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%，500 mA 時 ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA；所需電荷 ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC，約 1.8×10¹⁰ 個電子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range. Assuming a 10 h storage-ring lifetime and a top-up every 2 min, ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%, or ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA at 500 mA; the charge needed is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC, about 1.8×10¹⁰ electrons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 量測每次補注時儲存束流的注入擾動振幅與衰減；在儲存環 BPM 頻譜中檢查增能環斜坡重複頻率的成分，確認同隧道的雜散磁場不影響儲存束流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency; record the injection transient amplitude and decay of the stored beam at every top-up with turn-by-turn BPMs; look for the booster ramp repetition frequency in storage-ring BPM spectra to confirm that stray fields in the shared tunnel do not disturb the stored beam.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。假設儲存環壽命 10 h、每 2 min 補注一次：ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%，500 mA 時 ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA；所需電荷 ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC，約 1.8×10¹⁰ 個電子。
knowledge.textEn: The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range. Assuming a 10 h storage-ring lifetime and a top-up every 2 min, ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%, or ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA at 500 mA; the charge needed is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC, about 1.8×10¹⁰ electrons.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration", which statement holds?
options: 發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。
optionsEn: Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.
The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range.
quiz.explanation: 增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 量測每次補注時儲存束流的注入擾動振幅與衰減；在儲存環 BPM 頻譜中檢查增能環斜坡重複頻率的成分，確認同隧道的雜散磁場不影響儲存束流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency; record the injection transient amplitude and decay of the stored beam at every top-up with turn-by-turn BPMs; look for the booster ramp repetition frequency in storage-ring BPM spectra to confirm that stray fields in the shared tunnel do not disturb the stored beam. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染；增能環注入效率下降則補注時間拉長，輻射劑量上升並可能觸發輻射安全連鎖。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mismatched injection-kicker waveforms leave the bump open, so every top-up makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds, beamlines see periodic intensity spikes and time-resolved data are contaminated; a drop in booster injection efficiency lengthens each top-up, raises radiation dose and can trip the radiation-safety interlock.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 量測每次補注時儲存束流的注入擾動振幅與衰減；在儲存環 BPM 頻譜中檢查增能環斜坡重複頻率的成分，確認同隧道的雜散磁場不影響儲存束流。
knowledge.textEn: Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency; record the injection transient amplitude and decay of the stored beam at every top-up with turn-by-turn BPMs; look for the booster ramp repetition frequency in storage-ring BPM spectra to confirm that stray fields in the shared tunnel do not disturb the stored beam.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration"?
options: 以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。
optionsEn: Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.
quiz.explanation: 以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 量測每次補注時儲存束流的注入擾動振幅與衰減；在儲存環 BPM 頻譜中檢查增能環斜坡重複頻率的成分，確認同隧道的雜散磁場不影響儲存束流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency; record the injection transient amplitude and decay of the stored beam at every top-up with turn-by-turn BPMs; look for the booster ramp repetition frequency in storage-ring BPM spectra to confirm that stray fields in the shared tunnel do not disturb the stored beam. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染；增能環注入效率下降則補注時間拉長，輻射劑量上升並可能觸發輻射安全連鎖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mismatched injection-kicker waveforms leave the bump open, so every top-up makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds, beamlines see periodic intensity spikes and time-resolved data are contaminated; a drop in booster injection efficiency lengthens each top-up, raises radiation dose and can trip the radiation-safety interlock. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：增能環於 2014 年 12 月 12 日開始束流試運轉，12 月 16 日達到 3 GeV。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Booster beam commissioning began on 12 December 2014 and reached 3 GeV on 16 December.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染；增能環注入效率下降則補注時間拉長，輻射劑量上升並可能觸發輻射安全連鎖。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染。
波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Mismatched injection-kicker waveforms leave the bump open, so every top-up makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds, beamlines see periodic intensity spikes and time-resolved data are contaminated.
An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
quiz.explanation: 注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染；增能環注入效率下降則補注時間拉長，輻射劑量上升並可能觸發輻射安全連鎖。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mismatched injection-kicker waveforms leave the bump open, so every top-up makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds, beamlines see periodic intensity spikes and time-resolved data are contaminated; a drop in booster injection efficiency lengthens each top-up, raises radiation dose and can trip the radiation-safety interlock. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「IU22 真空內波盪器」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “IU22 in-vacuum undulators” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。真空內設計讓磁鐵陣列直接置於真空中，間隙可縮到數 mm，提高場強與 K 值；但小間隙也讓磁鐵暴露於束流損失與尾場加熱。改變間隙會擾動軌道與工作點，必須以前饋表補償。交接以里程碑與驗收紀錄為準：2014 年底首光、2015 年 12 月儲存電流超過 520 mA、2016 年起開放用戶，規劃容量約 40 條光束線。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「IU22 真空內波盪器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights; the protein-crystallography beamlines TPS 05A and 07A, for example, use 3 m in-vacuum undulators IU22 with a 22 mm period, covering 5.7 to 20 keV. Placing the magnet arrays inside the vacuum lets the gap close to a few millimetres for higher field and K, but small gaps also expose the magnets to beam loss and wakefield heating. Gap changes perturb orbit and tune and must be compensated with feedforward tables. Handoff follows milestones and acceptance records: first light at the end of 2014, more than 520 mA stored in December 2015, user operation from 2016, and a planned capacity of about 40 beamlines. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IU22 in-vacuum undulators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 periods.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「IU22 真空內波盪器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “IU22 in-vacuum undulators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑
knowledge.titleEn: Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones
knowledge.text: TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。真空內設計讓磁鐵陣列直接置於真空中，間隙可縮到數 mm，提高場強與 K 值；但小間隙也讓磁鐵暴露於束流損失與尾場加熱。
knowledge.textEn: TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights; the protein-crystallography beamlines TPS 05A and 07A, for example, use 3 m in-vacuum undulators IU22 with a 22 mm period, covering 5.7 to 20 keV. Placing the magnet arrays inside the vacuum lets the gap close to a few millimetres for higher field and K, but small gaps also expose the magnets to beam loss and wakefield heating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones" is correct?
options: 波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。
臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。
TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。
optionsEn: An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.
TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights.
quiz.explanation: TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights; the protein-crystallography beamlines TPS 05A and 07A, for example, use 3 m in-vacuum undulators IU22 with a 22 mm period, covering 5.7 to 20 keV. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「IU22 真空內波盪器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “IU22 in-vacuum undulators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 週期。假設間隙 7 mm，B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λu)(5.47 − 1.8g/λu)] ≈ 0.70 T，K = 0.934×0.70×2.2 ≈ 1.44，E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.2×(1 + 1.44²/2)) ≈ 1.91 keV。間隙開大到 K = 1 時 E₁ ≈ 2.59 keV，第 5 諧波 ≈ 12.95 keV，可涵蓋 12.66 keV 的硒 K 吸收邊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 periods. Assuming a 7 mm gap, B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λu)(5.47 − 1.8g/λu)] ≈ 0.70 T, K = 0.934×0.70×2.2 ≈ 1.44 and E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.2×(1 + 1.44²/2)) ≈ 1.91 keV. Opening the gap to K = 1 gives E₁ ≈ 2.59 keV and a fifth harmonic near 12.95 keV, covering the 12.66 keV selenium K edge. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測各諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；移動間隙時記錄全環軌道與工作點的變化，確認前饋修正後殘差在數 µm 以內；以熱電偶與磁場量測追蹤小間隙長期運轉下的磁鐵溫度與退磁情形，結果列入光束線交接紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; record ring-wide orbit and tune changes while moving the gap to confirm residuals of a few micrometres after feedforward; track magnet temperature and demagnetization under long-term small-gap operation with thermocouples and field measurements, and enter the results in the beamline handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 periods. Assuming a 7 mm gap, B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λu)(5.47 − 1.8g/λu)] ≈ 0.70 T, K = 0.934×0.70×2.2 ≈ 1.44 and E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.2×(1 + 1.44²/2)) ≈ 1.91 keV. Opening the gap to K = 1 gives E₁ ≈ 2.59 keV and a fifth harmonic near 12.95 keV, covering the 12.66 keV selenium K edge.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「IU22 真空內波盪器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “IU22 in-vacuum undulators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測各諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；移動間隙時記錄全環軌道與工作點的變化，確認前饋修正後殘差在數 µm 以內；以熱電偶與磁場量測追蹤小間隙長期運轉下的磁鐵溫度與退磁情形，結果列入光束線交接紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; record ring-wide orbit and tune changes while moving the gap to confirm residuals of a few micrometres after feedforward; track magnet temperature and demagnetization under long-term small-gap operation with thermocouples and field measurements, and enter the results in the beamline handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If injection or beam losses hit the arrays during small-gap operation, radiation locally demagnetizes the permanent magnets, K drops, harmonic peaks shift and weaken, and users no longer find the expected flux at their energy; at 500 mA wakefield heating can deform the liner so the gap can no longer be closed.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 能量提升練習：TLS 由 1.3 GeV 提升到 1.5 GeV（ρ = 3.495 m 不變）。B 由 1.24 T 升到 1.43 T；E_c = 2.218E³/ρ 由 1.39 keV 升到 2.14 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ 由 72 keV 升到 128 keV，300 mA 時偶極輻射功率由 21.7 kW 升到 38.4 kW。8 keV 光子的偶極通量 dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y)（photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW），y = 8/E_c：1.3 GeV 時 y = 5.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0108，通量 ≈ 1.0×10¹¹；1.5 GeV 時 y = 3.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0670，通量 ≈ 7.4×10¹¹，能量只提高 15%，8 keV 通量卻提高約 7.2 倍。代價是發射度按 E² 由 19.2 增為 25.6 nm·rad，而水平阻尼時間 τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ 由 14.4 ms 縮短為 9.4 ms。數值依公開參數與教學假設計算，不代表實際運轉紀錄。
workedExample.textEn: Energy-upgrade exercise: TLS goes from 1.3 GeV to 1.5 GeV with ρ = 3.495 m unchanged. B rises from 1.24 T to 1.43 T; E_c = 2.218E³/ρ from 1.39 keV to 2.14 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ from 72 keV to 128 keV, so dipole radiation at 300 mA grows from 21.7 kW to 38.4 kW. Bending-magnet flux at 8 keV is dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y) photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW with y = 8/E_c: at 1.3 GeV, y = 5.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0108 and the flux ≈ 1.0×10¹¹; at 1.5 GeV, y = 3.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0670 and the flux ≈ 7.4×10¹¹, so a 15% energy increase raises 8 keV flux about 7.2 times. The price is emittance growing as E² from 19.2 to 25.6 nm·rad, while the horizontal damping time τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ shortens from 14.4 ms to 9.4 ms. Numbers follow public parameters and teaching assumptions, not operating records.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升」與「TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade" and "TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TLS 是周長 120 m 的電子儲存環，由 6 個三彎消色散（TBA）超週期、共 18 台偶極磁鐵組成，彎轉半徑 3.495 m。它原本以 1.3 GeV、1.24 T 設計並於 1993 年啟用，1996 年起把運轉能量提升到 1.5 GeV；由於 ρ 固定，偶極場必須按比例升到約 1.43 T，鐵芯更接近飽和。能量提升使臨界能量按 E³ 上升、每圈輻射損失按 E⁴ 上升，光譜往較硬的 X 光延伸，代價是射頻功率與真空熱負載同步增加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: TLS is an electron storage ring of 120 m circumference built from six triple-bend-achromat (TBA) superperiods with 18 dipoles of 3.495 m bending radius. Designed for 1.3 GeV at 1.24 T and opened in 1993, it moved to 1.5 GeV operation from 1996; with ρ fixed, the dipole field had to rise proportionally to about 1.43 T, closer to iron saturation. The upgrade raises the critical energy as E³ and the energy loss per turn as E⁴, extending the spectrum to harder X-rays at the price of more RF power and vacuum heat load. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：能量提升時磁場、臨界能量與每圈損失的連鎖變化：Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m，B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T（1.3 GeV 時 1.24 T）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Chain of changes with energy: Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m and B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T (1.24 T at 1.3 GeV).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade" is correct?
options: 能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。
TLS 是周長 120 m 的電子儲存環，由 6 個三彎消色散（TBA）超週期、共 18 台偶極磁鐵組成，彎轉半徑 3.495 m。

Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS.
quiz.explanation: TLS 是周長 120 m 的電子儲存環，由 6 個三彎消色散（TBA）超週期、共 18 台偶極磁鐵組成，彎轉半徑 3.495 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: TLS is an electron storage ring of 120 m circumference built from six triple-bend-achromat (TBA) superperiods with 18 dipoles of 3.495 m bending radius. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能量提升時磁場、臨界能量與每圈損失的連鎖變化：Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m，B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T（1.3 GeV 時 1.24 T）。E_c = 2.218E³/ρ ≈ 2.14 keV（1.3 GeV 時 1.39 keV）；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ ≈ 128 keV（1.3 GeV 時 72 keV，增加 77%）；360 mA 時偶極輻射功率 ≈ 128 keV×0.36 A ≈ 46 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Chain of changes with energy: Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m and B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T (1.24 T at 1.3 GeV). E_c = 2.218E³/ρ ≈ 2.14 keV (1.39 keV at 1.3 GeV); U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ ≈ 128 keV (72 keV at 1.3 GeV, 77% more); at 360 mA the dipole radiation power is ≈ 128 keV×0.36 A ≈ 46 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測射頻前向減反射功率並扣除腔損，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜，確認高能尾端斜率符合 2.14 keV 臨界能量的通用曲線，間接核對束流能量；以磁場量測確認 1.43 T 運轉點的積分場與多極成分。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure RF forward minus reflected power less cavity loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); scan a bending-magnet beamline spectrum with its monochromator and check that the high-energy tail matches the universal curve for a 2.14 keV critical energy, an indirect check of beam energy; confirm integrated field and multipoles at the 1.43 T operating point by magnetic measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.
Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary.
Chain of changes with energy: Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m and B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T (1.24 T at 1.3 GeV).

quiz.explanationEn: Chain of changes with energy: Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m and B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T (1.24 T at 1.3 GeV). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測射頻前向減反射功率並扣除腔損，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜，確認高能尾端斜率符合 2.14 keV 臨界能量的通用曲線，間接核對束流能量；以磁場量測確認 1.43 T 運轉點的積分場與多極成分。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure RF forward minus reflected power less cavity loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); scan a bending-magnet beamline spectrum with its monochromator and check that the high-energy tail matches the universal curve for a 2.14 keV critical energy, an indirect check of beam energy; confirm integrated field and multipoles at the 1.43 T operating point by magnetic measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：能量提升後若未重新評估偶極的飽和與多極場，六極成分改變色品與動力孔徑，注入效率與壽命下降；光子吸收器若仍按 1.3 GeV 的熱負載設計，局部過熱造成壓力上升，所有光束線同時受影響。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If dipole saturation and multipoles are not re-evaluated after the upgrade, a changed sextupole component alters chromaticity and dynamic aperture, lowering injection efficiency and lifetime; photon absorbers still designed for 1.3 GeV heat loads overheat locally, pressure rises and every beamline suffers.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測射頻前向減反射功率並扣除腔損，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜，確認高能尾端斜率符合 2.14 keV 臨界能量的通用曲線，間接核對束流能量；以磁場量測確認 1.43 T 運轉點的積分場與多極成分。

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Measure RF forward minus reflected power less cavity loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); scan a bending-magnet beamline spectrum with its monochromator and check that the high-energy tail matches the universal curve for a 2.14 keV critical energy, an indirect check of beam energy; confirm integrated field and multipoles at the 1.43 T operating point by magnetic measurement. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升：失效診斷
