steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 能量提升後若未重新評估偶極的飽和與多極場，六極成分改變色品與動力孔徑，注入效率與壽命下降；光子吸收器若仍按 1.3 GeV 的熱負載設計，局部過熱造成壓力上升，所有光束線同時受影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If dipole saturation and multipoles are not re-evaluated after the upgrade, a changed sextupole component alters chromaticity and dynamic aperture, lowering injection efficiency and lifetime; photon absorbers still designed for 1.3 GeV heat loads overheat locally, pressure rises and every beamline suffers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量提升使臨界能量按 E³ 上升、每圈輻射損失按 E⁴ 上升，光譜往較硬的 X 光延伸，代價是射頻功率與真空熱負載同步增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The upgrade raises the critical energy as E³ and the energy loss per turn as E⁴, extending the spectrum to harder X-rays at the price of more RF power and vacuum heat load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Six-fold TBA lattice” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 第三代光源的關鍵是用消色散晶格壓低發射度，並把插件磁鐵放在零色散的直線段。TLS 每個超週期用三台偶極，6 段約 6 m 長的直線段供插件、射頻與注入使用；設計發射度在 1.3 GeV 為 19.2 nm·rad，按 E² 標度在 1.5 GeV 約 25.6 nm·rad，公開資料依運轉光學列 22 至 25 nm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 與晶格因子 F 標度：TLS 每台偶極彎 20°，TPS 每台只彎 7.5° 且能量加倍，兩者的發射度相差約 16 倍。設計工作點 7.18／4.13、動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key to a third-generation source is an achromatic lattice that lowers emittance and places insertion devices in dispersion-free straights. TLS uses three dipoles per superperiod and six straights of about 6 m for insertion devices, RF and injection; the design emittance of 19.2 nm·rad at 1.3 GeV scales as E² to about 25.6 nm·rad at 1.5 GeV, with public values of 22 to 25 nm·rad depending on the operating optics. Emittance scales with γ²θ³ and a lattice factor F: each TLS dipole bends 20° while each TPS dipole bends only 7.5° at twice the energy, and their emittances differ by about 16 times. Design tunes are 7.18/4.13 and the momentum compaction is 6.78×10⁻³. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Six-fold TBA lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Six-fold TBA lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The key to a third-generation source is an achromatic lattice that lowers emittance and places insertion devices in dispersion-free straights. TLS uses three dipoles per superperiod and six straights of about 6 m for insertion devices, RF and injection; the design emittance of 19.2 nm·rad at 1.3 GeV scales as E² to about 25.6 nm·rad at 1.5 GeV, with public values of 22 to 25 nm·rad depending on the operating optics.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Six-fold TBA lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。γ²θ³ 比（TLS/TPS）= (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74；實際比 25.6/1.6 = 16，表示 TLS 的晶格因子 F ≈ 0.18、TPS ≈ 0.054，相差約 3.4 倍，其餘差距來自晶格世代而非能量與彎角。以 1.3 GeV 設計值換算：19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³. The γ²θ³ ratio (TLS/TPS) is (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74, while the actual ratio is 25.6/1.6 = 16, so TLS has F ≈ 0.18 and TPS F ≈ 0.054, about 3.4 times apart; the remaining gap comes from lattice generation rather than energy and bend angle. Scaling the 1.3 GeV design value: 19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測軌道對能量的響應，以驗證動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³；量測工作點並與 7.18／4.13 的設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad; measure the orbit response to RF-frequency steps to verify the 6.78×10⁻³ momentum compaction; measure the tunes against the 7.18/4.13 design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。γ²θ³ 比（TLS/TPS）= (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74；實際比 25.6/1.6 = 16，表示 TLS 的晶格因子 F ≈ 0.18、TPS ≈ 0.054，相差約 3.4 倍，其餘差距來自晶格世代而非能量與彎角。以 1.3 GeV 設計值換算：19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad。
knowledge.textEn: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³. The γ²θ³ ratio (TLS/TPS) is (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74, while the actual ratio is 25.6/1.6 = 16, so TLS has F ≈ 0.18 and TPS F ≈ 0.054, about 3.4 times apart; the remaining gap comes from lattice generation rather than energy and bend angle. Scaling the 1.3 GeV design value: 19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS", which statement holds?
options: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。
實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。
低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。
optionsEn: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³.
With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.
An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV.
quiz.explanation: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Six-fold TBA lattice” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測軌道對能量的響應，以驗證動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³；量測工作點並與 7.18／4.13 的設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad; measure the orbit response to RF-frequency steps to verify the 6.78×10⁻³ momentum compaction; measure the tunes against the 7.18/4.13 design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降；若只量水平束流尺寸而不扣除色散項，發射度會被高估並誤導晶格調整方向。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls; measuring horizontal beam size without subtracting the dispersion term overestimates emittance and steers lattice tuning the wrong way.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測軌道對能量的響應，以驗證動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³；量測工作點並與 7.18／4.13 的設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad; measure the orbit response to RF-frequency steps to verify the 6.78×10⁻³ momentum compaction; measure the tunes against the 7.18/4.13 design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較。
TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad.
Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.
quiz.explanation: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測軌道對能量的響應，以驗證動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³；量測工作點並與 7.18／4.13 的設計值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad; measure the orbit response to RF-frequency steps to verify the 6.78×10⁻³ momentum compaction; measure the tunes against the 7.18/4.13 design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Six-fold TBA lattice” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降；若只量水平束流尺寸而不扣除色散項，發射度會被高估並誤導晶格調整方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls; measuring horizontal beam size without subtracting the dispersion term overestimates emittance and steers lattice tuning the wrong way. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計工作點 7.18／4.13、動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design tunes are 7.18/4.13 and the momentum compaction is 6.78×10⁻³.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降；若只量水平束流尺寸而不扣除色散項，發射度會被高估並誤導晶格調整方向。
knowledge.textEn: Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls; measuring horizontal beam size without subtracting the dispersion term overestimates emittance and steers lattice tuning the wrong way.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。
插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched.
Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls.
quiz.explanation: 插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降；若只量水平束流尺寸而不扣除色散項，發射度會被高估並誤導晶格調整方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls; measuring horizontal beam size without subtracting the dispersion term overestimates emittance and steers lattice tuning the wrong way. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光」與「超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays" and "SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足；TLS 的解法是局部提高磁場：2002 年起運轉的 6 T 超導波長位移器（SWLS）、3.2 T 的 SW6 超導扭擺器，以及安裝在消色散段內、不佔用直線段的 3.1 T 超導扭擺器 IASW（週期 61 mm、16 極、長 960 mm、極間隙 19 mm）。臨界能量正比於 E²B，6 T 磁場把同一環的臨界能量提高約 4 倍。這些插件浸在 4.5 K 液氦中，啟用時需以四極補償工作點偏移，並評估它們對發射度與能量分散的影響。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux; TLS raised the field locally instead: a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter (SWLS) operating since 2002, the 3.2 T SW6 superconducting wiggler, and the 3.1 T in-achromat superconducting wiggler IASW (61 mm period, 16 poles, 960 mm long, 19 mm pole gap), which sits inside the achromat without using a straight. Critical energy scales as E²B, so 6 T raises it about fourfold on the same ring. These devices are immersed in 4.5 K liquid helium, and switching them on requires quadrupole compensation of the tune shift and assessment of their effect on emittance and energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：插件磁鐵的臨界能量與磁場成正比，E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B：SWLS 6 T → 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV；SW6 3.2 T → 4.79 keV；IASW 3.1 T → 4.64 keV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光
knowledge.titleEn: Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays
knowledge.text: 1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足；TLS 的解法是局部提高磁場：2002 年起運轉的 6 T 超導波長位移器（SWLS）、3.2 T 的 SW6 超導扭擺器，以及安裝在消色散段內、不佔用直線段的 3.1 T 超導扭擺器 IASW（週期 61 mm、16 極、長 960 mm、極間隙 19 mm）。臨界能量正比於 E²B，6 T 磁場把同一環的臨界能量提高約 4 倍。
knowledge.textEn: A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux; TLS raised the field locally instead: a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter (SWLS) operating since 2002, the 3.2 T SW6 superconducting wiggler, and the 3.1 T in-achromat superconducting wiggler IASW (61 mm period, 16 poles, 960 mm long, 19 mm pole gap), which sits inside the achromat without using a straight. Critical energy scales as E²B, so 6 T raises it about fourfold on the same ring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays" is correct?
options: 1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足。
超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。
改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。
optionsEn: A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux.
A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched.
The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.
quiz.explanation: 1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足；TLS 的解法是局部提高磁場：2002 年起運轉的 6 T 超導波長位移器（SWLS）、3.2 T 的 SW6 超導扭擺器，以及安裝在消色散段內、不佔用直線段的 3.1 T 超導扭擺器 IASW（週期 61 mm、16 極、長 960 mm、極間隙 19 mm）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux; TLS raised the field locally instead: a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter (SWLS) operating since 2002, the 3.2 T SW6 superconducting wiggler, and the 3.1 T in-achromat superconducting wiggler IASW (61 mm period, 16 poles, 960 mm long, 19 mm pole gap), which sits inside the achromat without using a straight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：插件磁鐵的臨界能量與磁場成正比，E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B：SWLS 6 T → 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV；SW6 3.2 T → 4.79 keV；IASW 3.1 T → 4.64 keV。IASW 每圈額外損失 ΔU = 0.633E²⟨B²⟩L = 0.633×2.25×(3.1²/2)×0.96 ≈ 6.57 keV，300 mA 時功率 ≈ 1.97 kW；K = 0.934×3.1×6.1 ≈ 17.7，水平扇角 ±K/γ = ±17.7/2935 ≈ ±6.0 mrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV. The IASW adds ΔU = 0.633E²⟨B²⟩L = 0.633×2.25×(3.1²/2)×0.96 ≈ 6.57 keV per turn, about 1.97 kW at 300 mA; K = 0.934×3.1×6.1 ≈ 17.7, and the horizontal fan is ±K/γ = ±17.7/2935 ≈ ±6.0 mrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：IASW 勵磁斜坡時同步記錄工作點與軌道，確認四極補償表把工作點偏移壓回；量測扭擺器光束線在 5 至 23 keV 的通量並與偶極比較（文獻報告 15 keV 約為偶極的 500 倍）；監測液氦消耗（約 2.5 L/h）、真空與失超紀錄，作為低溫負載的驗收依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes; measure wiggler-beamline flux from 5 to 23 keV against a bending magnet (about 500 times at 15 keV was reported); monitor liquid-helium consumption (about 2.5 L/h), vacuum and quench records as the cryogenic-load acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV. The IASW adds ΔU = 0.633E²⟨B²⟩L = 0.633×2.25×(3.1²/2)×0.96 ≈ 6.57 keV per turn, about 1.97 kW at 300 mA; K = 0.934×3.1×6.1 ≈ 17.7, and the horizontal fan is ±K/γ = ±17.7/2935 ≈ ±6.0 mrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays", which statement holds?
options: 軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。
插件磁鐵的臨界能量與磁場成正比，E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B：SWLS 6 T → 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV。
TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
optionsEn: Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary.
An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV.
Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.
quiz.explanation: 插件磁鐵的臨界能量與磁場成正比，E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B：SWLS 6 T → 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV；SW6 3.2 T → 4.79 keV；IASW 3.1 T → 4.64 keV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: IASW 勵磁斜坡時同步記錄工作點與軌道，確認四極補償表把工作點偏移壓回；量測扭擺器光束線在 5 至 23 keV 的通量並與偶極比較（文獻報告 15 keV 約為偶極的 500 倍）；監測液氦消耗（約 2.5 L/h）、真空與失超紀錄，作為低溫負載的驗收依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes; measure wiggler-beamline flux from 5 to 23 keV against a bending magnet (about 500 times at 15 keV was reported); monitor liquid-helium consumption (about 2.5 L/h), vacuum and quench records as the cryogenic-load acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超；SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失改變阻尼與能量分散，若晶格未重新匹配，束流尺寸擴大，所有光束線的亮度一起下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the IASW magnet centre is not offset far enough from the ideal orbit, synchrotron light strikes the cold wall, accelerating helium boil-off or quenching the magnet; the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV per turn changes damping and energy spread, and without lattice rematching the beam grows and brightness falls on every beamline.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: IASW 勵磁斜坡時同步記錄工作點與軌道，確認四極補償表把工作點偏移壓回；量測扭擺器光束線在 5 至 23 keV 的通量並與偶極比較（文獻報告 15 keV 約為偶極的 500 倍）；監測液氦消耗（約 2.5 L/h）、真空與失超紀錄，作為低溫負載的驗收依據。
knowledge.textEn: Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes; measure wiggler-beamline flux from 5 to 23 keV against a bending magnet (about 500 times at 15 keV was reported); monitor liquid-helium consumption (about 2.5 L/h), vacuum and quench records as the cryogenic-load acceptance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays"?

能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。

Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes.

quiz.explanationEn: Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes; measure wiggler-beamline flux from 5 to 23 keV against a bending magnet (about 500 times at 15 keV was reported); monitor liquid-helium consumption (about 2.5 L/h), vacuum and quench records as the cryogenic-load acceptance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超；SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失改變阻尼與能量分散，若晶格未重新匹配，束流尺寸擴大，所有光束線的亮度一起下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the IASW magnet centre is not offset far enough from the ideal orbit, synchrotron light strikes the cold wall, accelerating helium boil-off or quenching the magnet; the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV per turn changes damping and energy spread, and without lattice rematching the beam grows and brightness falls on every beamline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些插件浸在 4.5 K 液氦中，啟用時需以四極補償工作點偏移，並評估它們對發射度與能量分散的影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These devices are immersed in 4.5 K liquid helium, and switching them on requires quadrupole compensation of the tune shift and assessment of their effect on emittance and energy spread.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超；SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失改變阻尼與能量分散，若晶格未重新匹配，束流尺寸擴大，所有光束線的亮度一起下降。
knowledge.textEn: If the IASW magnet centre is not offset far enough from the ideal orbit, synchrotron light strikes the cold wall, accelerating helium boil-off or quenching the magnet; the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV per turn changes damping and energy spread, and without lattice rematching the beam grows and brightness falls on every beamline.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超。

quiz.explanation: IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超；SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失改變阻尼與能量分散，若晶格未重新匹配，束流尺寸擴大，所有光束線的亮度一起下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TLS 原本使用銅製 Doris 腔，其高次模與束流相互作用引起耦合束團不穩定，限制了儲存電流。2004 年底改裝以 Cornell CESR-III 設計為基礎、由 ACCEL 製造的單 cell 鈮超導腔，2005 年 2 月起例行運轉：超導腔可用大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外吸收，並以單一腔提供足夠電壓。配合 100 kW 速調管發射機，電流由 200 mA 提升到 300 mA，再到 360 mA；但高電流下束流負載很重，低階射頻迴路需精細調整才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current. At the end of 2004 it installed a single-cell niobium cavity based on Cornell's CESR-III design and built by ACCEL, in routine use from February 2005: the superconducting cavity can use large beam pipes that let higher-order modes escape to absorbers, and one cavity supplies enough voltage. With a 100 kW klystron transmitter the current rose from 200 mA to 300 mA and later 360 mA, but beam loading at high current is heavy and the low-level RF loops needed careful tuning to stay stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束流負載參數 Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載
knowledge.titleEn: SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading
knowledge.text: TLS 原本使用銅製 Doris 腔，其高次模與束流相互作用引起耦合束團不穩定，限制了儲存電流。2004 年底改裝以 Cornell CESR-III 設計為基礎、由 ACCEL 製造的單 cell 鈮超導腔，2005 年 2 月起例行運轉：超導腔可用大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外吸收，並以單一腔提供足夠電壓。
knowledge.textEn: TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current. At the end of 2004 it installed a single-cell niobium cavity based on Cornell's CESR-III design and built by ACCEL, in routine use from February 2005: the superconducting cavity can use large beam pipes that let higher-order modes escape to absorbers, and one cavity supplies enough voltage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading" is correct?
options: 改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。

實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。
optionsEn: The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.
TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current.
With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.
quiz.explanation: TLS 原本使用銅製 Doris 腔，其高次模與束流相互作用引起耦合束團不穩定，限制了儲存電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束流負載參數 Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c。假設 (R/Q) = 44.5 Ω（電路定義）、Q_L = 2.3×10⁵、V_c = 1.5 MV、I₀ = 0.3 A：Y = 2×0.3×44.5×2.3×10⁵/1.5×10⁶ ≈ 4.1，與文獻報告 300 mA 時的 4.2 一致。功率：U₀ 128 keV 加插件約 40 keV（假設）= 168 keV，360 mA 時束流功率 ≈ 61 kW，100 kW 速調管仍有餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c. Assuming (R/Q) = 44.5 Ω (circuit definition), Q_L = 2.3×10⁵, V_c = 1.5 MV and I₀ = 0.3 A, Y = 2×0.3×44.5×2.3×10⁵/1.5×10⁶ ≈ 4.1, consistent with the reported 4.2 at 300 mA. Power: U₀ of 128 keV plus about 40 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 168 keV, about 61 kW of beam power at 360 mA, leaving margin on the 100 kW klystron. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上；量測腔失諧角對束流電流的關係，與 Y 的預測比較；統計射頻跳脫率（2005 年約每週一次，目標每月少於一次）作為可用度驗收指標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line; measure cavity detuning versus beam current and compare with the Y prediction; track the RF trip rate (about one per week in 2005, target under one per month) as the availability acceptance metric.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c. Assuming (R/Q) = 44.5 Ω (circuit definition), Q_L = 2.3×10⁵, V_c = 1.5 MV and I₀ = 0.3 A, Y = 2×0.3×44.5×2.3×10⁵/1.5×10⁶ ≈ 4.1, consistent with the reported 4.2 at 300 mA. Power: U₀ of 128 keV plus about 40 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 168 keV, about 61 kW of beam power at 360 mA, leaving margin on the 100 kW klystron.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading", which statement holds?
options: 低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。
能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。
束流負載參數 Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c。
optionsEn: An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV.
Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%.
The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c.
quiz.explanation: 束流負載參數 Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上；量測腔失諧角對束流電流的關係，與 Y 的預測比較；統計射頻跳脫率（2005 年約每週一次，目標每月少於一次）作為可用度驗收指標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line; measure cavity detuning versus beam current and compare with the Y prediction; track the RF trip rate (about one per week in 2005, target under one per month) as the availability acceptance metric. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束；低溫系統壓力波動使腔頻率漂移，調諧器追蹤不及也會造成跳脫。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost; cryogenic pressure fluctuations shift the cavity frequency, and a tuner that cannot follow also causes trips.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上；量測腔失諧角對束流電流的關係，與 Y 的預測比較；統計射頻跳脫率（2005 年約每週一次，目標每月少於一次）作為可用度驗收指標。
knowledge.textEn: Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line; measure cavity detuning versus beam current and compare with the Y prediction; track the RF trip rate (about one per week in 2005, target under one per month) as the availability acceptance metric.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading"?
options: 以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。
optionsEn: Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS.
quiz.explanation: 以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上；量測腔失諧角對束流電流的關係，與 Y 的預測比較；統計射頻跳脫率（2005 年約每週一次，目標每月少於一次）作為可用度驗收指標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line; measure cavity detuning versus beam current and compare with the Y prediction; track the RF trip rate (about one per week in 2005, target under one per month) as the availability acceptance metric. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束；低溫系統壓力波動使腔頻率漂移，調諧器追蹤不及也會造成跳脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost; cryogenic pressure fluctuations shift the cavity frequency, and a tuner that cannot follow also causes trips. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：配合 100 kW 速調管發射機，電流由 200 mA 提升到 300 mA，再到 360 mA；但高電流下束流負載很重，低階射頻迴路需精細調整才能穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With a 100 kW klystron transmitter the current rose from 200 mA to 300 mA and later 360 mA, but beam loading at high current is heavy and the low-level RF loops needed careful tuning to stay stable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束；低溫系統壓力波動使腔頻率漂移，調諧器追蹤不及也會造成跳脫。
knowledge.textEn: Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost; cryogenic pressure fluctuations shift the cavity frequency, and a tuner that cannot follow also causes trips.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束。
實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost.
With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.
quiz.explanation: 高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束；低溫系統壓力波動使腔頻率漂移，調諧器追蹤不及也會造成跳脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost; cryogenic pressure fluctuations shift the cavity frequency, and a tuner that cannot follow also causes trips. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算」與「TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Top-up current stability and lifetime inference" and "Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Top-up current stability and lifetime inference: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “DCCT and top-up gating” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TLS 於 2005 年 10 月由衰減模式改為頂注運轉：約每 60 s 由全能量增能環補注一次，使儲存電流維持在 ±0.25% 之內，光束線熱負載近乎恆定，光學元件不再隨電流衰減而漂移。量測核心是直流電流變壓器（DCCT），它的解析度與零點漂移決定能否分辨 0.1% 等級的電流變化，並用來推算壽命與每次補注的電荷。補注瞬間踢擊磁鐵造成的擾動以閘控訊號通知用戶，讓實驗資料可排除注入時段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current. The key measurement is the DC current transformer (DCCT), whose resolution and zero drift determine whether 0.1%-level current changes can be seen and which is used to infer lifetime and the charge per top-up. The kicker disturbance at each injection is announced to users by a gating signal so experiments can exclude those intervals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DCCT and top-up gating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每 60 s 正好用完 ±0.25% 的帶寬（ΔI/I = 0.5%），等效壽命 τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If each 60 s interval uses the full ±0.25% band (ΔI/I = 0.5%), the equivalent lifetime is τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “DCCT and top-up gating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算
knowledge.titleEn: Top-up current stability and lifetime inference
knowledge.text: TLS 於 2005 年 10 月由衰減模式改為頂注運轉：約每 60 s 由全能量增能環補注一次，使儲存電流維持在 ±0.25% 之內，光束線熱負載近乎恆定，光學元件不再隨電流衰減而漂移。量測核心是直流電流變壓器（DCCT），它的解析度與零點漂移決定能否分辨 0.1% 等級的電流變化，並用來推算壽命與每次補注的電荷。
knowledge.textEn: TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current. The key measurement is the DC current transformer (DCCT), whose resolution and zero drift determine whether 0.1%-level current changes can be seen and which is used to infer lifetime and the charge per top-up.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current.
quiz.explanation: TLS 於 2005 年 10 月由衰減模式改為頂注運轉：約每 60 s 由全能量增能環補注一次，使儲存電流維持在 ±0.25% 之內，光束線熱負載近乎恆定，光學元件不再隨電流衰減而漂移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Top-up current stability and lifetime inference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “DCCT and top-up gating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每 60 s 正好用完 ±0.25% 的帶寬（ΔI/I = 0.5%），等效壽命 τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h。300 mA 時每次補注 ΔI = 1.5 mA，迴轉週期 T₀ = 120 m/c ≈ 0.400 µs，電荷 ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ ≈ 0.60 nC，約 3.7×10⁹ 個電子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each 60 s interval uses the full ±0.25% band (ΔI/I = 0.5%), the equivalent lifetime is τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h. At 300 mA each top-up adds ΔI = 1.5 mA; with revolution period T₀ = 120 m/c ≈ 0.400 µs the charge is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ ≈ 0.60 nC, about 3.7×10⁹ electrons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正線圈通入已知電流檢查 DCCT 的刻度與零點漂移，並與注入線積分電流變壓器比對注入效率；在暫停補注的時段擬合電流指數衰減求 τ，於不同束團填充模式與垂直發射度下重複量測，分辨 Touschek 與殘氣的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pass a known current through a calibration winding to check DCCT scale and zero drift, and compare with the injection-line integrating transformer to obtain injection efficiency; fit the exponential current decay during a pause in top-up to obtain τ, repeating under different fill patterns and vertical emittances to separate Touschek and residual-gas contributions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: If each 60 s interval uses the full ±0.25% band (ΔI/I = 0.5%), the equivalent lifetime is τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h. At 300 mA each top-up adds ΔI = 1.5 mA; with revolution period T₀ = 120 m/c ≈ 0.400 µs the charge is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ ≈ 0.60 nC, about 3.7×10⁹ electrons.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Top-up current stability and lifetime inference", which statement holds?
options: TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。

steps.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Top-up current stability and lifetime inference: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “DCCT and top-up gating” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以校正線圈通入已知電流檢查 DCCT 的刻度與零點漂移，並與注入線積分電流變壓器比對注入效率；在暫停補注的時段擬合電流指數衰減求 τ，於不同束團填充模式與垂直發射度下重複量測，分辨 Touschek 與殘氣的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pass a known current through a calibration winding to check DCCT scale and zero drift, and compare with the injection-line integrating transformer to obtain injection efficiency; fit the exponential current decay during a pause in top-up to obtain τ, repeating under different fill patterns and vertical emittances to separate Touschek and residual-gas contributions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An imperfectly closed injection bump makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds at every top-up, and beamlines see periodic intensity spikes; an uncorrected 0.5 mA DCCT zero drift makes top-up regulate to the wrong current, introducing systematic error into user data normalized by current.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。

Pass a known current through a calibration winding to check DCCT scale and zero drift, and compare with the injection-line integrating transformer to obtain injection efficiency.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Top-up current stability and lifetime inference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “DCCT and top-up gating” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An imperfectly closed injection bump makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds at every top-up, and beamlines see periodic intensity spikes; an uncorrected 0.5 mA DCCT zero drift makes top-up regulate to the wrong current, introducing systematic error into user data normalized by current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：補注瞬間踢擊磁鐵造成的擾動以閘控訊號通知用戶，讓實驗資料可排除注入時段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The kicker disturbance at each injection is announced to users by a gating signal so experiments can exclude those intervals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Top-up current stability and lifetime inference" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。
注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary.
An imperfectly closed injection bump makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds at every top-up, and beamlines see periodic intensity spikes.
quiz.explanation: 注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 緊鄰 TLS 興建，開挖與基礎施工會造成地層沉陷與傾斜；若 TLS 的四極磁鐵隨地面移動數十微米，閉合軌道誤差就會被放大到與束流尺寸同量級。NSRRC 在 TLS 儲存環與光束線安裝流體靜力水準系統（HLS）與 Leica Nivel 220 精密傾斜儀，持續記錄垂直沉陷與地板傾斜，作為 TLS 能否維持正常運轉的判據，也讓軌道回授與重新對準有量化依據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: TPS was built right next to TLS, and excavation and foundation work cause ground settlement and tilt; if TLS quadrupoles move tens of micrometres with the floor, closed-orbit errors are amplified to the scale of the beam size. NSRRC installed a hydrostatic levelling system (HLS) and Leica Nivel 220 precision inclinometers in the TLS storage ring and beamlines to record vertical settlement and floor tilt continuously, providing the criterion for keeping TLS in normal operation and a quantitative basis for orbit feedback and realignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
