steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。假設 β_q = 10 m、量測點 β = 5 m、KL = 0.5 m⁻¹、ν_y = 4.13：係數 ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45，Δ = 10 µm 時軌道約 45 µm；以垂直發射度 88 pm·rad、β_y = 5 m 估得 σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm，擾動約為束流尺寸的 2 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ. Assuming β_q = 10 m, β = 5 m at the observation point, KL = 0.5 m⁻¹ and ν_y = 4.13, the factor is ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45, so Δ = 10 µm gives about 45 µm of orbit; with 88 pm·rad vertical emittance and β_y = 5 m, σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm, so the disturbance is about twice the beam size. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應；以施工日誌（開挖、灌漿、重機進出）標記事件；每次停機以雷射追蹤儀複測磁鐵高程，與 HLS 推算值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change; tag events from the construction log (excavation, concrete pours, heavy machinery); at each shutdown re-survey magnet heights with a laser tracker and compare with HLS-derived values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。假設 β_q = 10 m、量測點 β = 5 m、KL = 0.5 m⁻¹、ν_y = 4.13：係數 ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45，Δ = 10 µm 時軌道約 45 µm；以垂直發射度 88 pm·rad、β_y = 5 m 估得 σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm，擾動約為束流尺寸的 2 倍。
knowledge.textEn: A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ. Assuming β_q = 10 m, β = 5 m at the observation point, KL = 0.5 m⁻¹ and ν_y = 4.13, the factor is ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45, so Δ = 10 µm gives about 45 µm of orbit; with 88 pm·rad vertical emittance and β_y = 5 m, σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm, so the disturbance is about twice the beam size.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction", which statement holds?
options: 能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。
單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。
超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。
optionsEn: Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%.
A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ.
A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched.
quiz.explanation: 單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應；以施工日誌（開挖、灌漿、重機進出）標記事件；每次停機以雷射追蹤儀複測磁鐵高程，與 HLS 推算值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change; tag events from the construction log (excavation, concrete pours, heavy machinery); at each shutdown re-survey magnet heights with a laser tracker and compare with HLS-derived values. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控；地面傾斜改變光束線與光源的相對角度時，即使電子軌道被修正，樣品上的光點仍會漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes; floor tilt that changes the beamline-to-source angle makes the spot on the sample drift even when the electron orbit is corrected.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應；以施工日誌（開挖、灌漿、重機進出）標記事件；每次停機以雷射追蹤儀複測磁鐵高程，與 HLS 推算值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change; tag events from the construction log (excavation, concrete pours, heavy machinery); at each shutdown re-survey magnet heights with a laser tracker and compare with HLS-derived values.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。
把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.
Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change.
quiz.explanation: 把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應；以施工日誌（開挖、灌漿、重機進出）標記事件；每次停機以雷射追蹤儀複測磁鐵高程，與 HLS 推算值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change; tag events from the construction log (excavation, concrete pours, heavy machinery); at each shutdown re-survey magnet heights with a laser tracker and compare with HLS-derived values. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控；地面傾斜改變光束線與光源的相對角度時，即使電子軌道被修正，樣品上的光點仍會漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes; floor tilt that changes the beamline-to-source angle makes the spot on the sample drift even when the electron orbit is corrected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NSRRC 在 TLS 儲存環與光束線安裝流體靜力水準系統（HLS）與 Leica Nivel 220 精密傾斜儀，持續記錄垂直沉陷與地板傾斜，作為 TLS 能否維持正常運轉的判據，也讓軌道回授與重新對準有量化依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: NSRRC installed a hydrostatic levelling system (HLS) and Leica Nivel 220 precision inclinometers in the TLS storage ring and beamlines to record vertical settlement and floor tilt continuously, providing the criterion for keeping TLS in normal operation and a quantitative basis for orbit feedback and realignment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控；地面傾斜改變光束線與光源的相對角度時，即使電子軌道被修正，樣品上的光點仍會漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes; floor tilt that changes the beamline-to-source angle makes the spot on the sample drift even when the electron orbit is corrected.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。
optionsEn: Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV.
quiz.explanation: 只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控；地面傾斜改變光束線與光源的相對角度時，即使電子軌道被修正，樣品上的光點仍會漂移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes; floor tilt that changes the beamline-to-source angle makes the spot on the sample drift even when the electron orbit is corrected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋」與「與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage" and "Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。波盪器光子能量隨 E² 標度，同一支波盪器搬到 3 GeV 的 TPS，能量會提高 4 倍。偶極光源的 2.14 keV 臨界能量涵蓋到數 keV，更硬的 X 光則交給超導扭擺器。因此 TLS 的光束線以軟 X 光、紅外與成熟的常規技術為主，與 TPS 的硬 X 光高亮度定位互補。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV. Undulator photon energy scales as E², so the same device moved to 3 GeV TPS would give four times the energy. The 2.14 keV bending-magnet critical energy covers up to a few keV, and harder X-rays come from the superconducting wigglers. TLS beamlines therefore focus on soft X-rays, infrared and mature routine techniques, complementing the hard-X-ray, high-brightness role of TPS. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋
knowledge.text: 1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。波盪器光子能量隨 E² 標度，同一支波盪器搬到 3 GeV 的 TPS，能量會提高 4 倍。
knowledge.textEn: The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV. Undulator photon energy scales as E², so the same device moved to 3 GeV TPS would give four times the energy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage" is correct?
options: 低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。
1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。
TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
optionsEn: An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV.

The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV.
Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.
quiz.explanation: 1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。U9 在 1.5 GeV、K = 1：E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV；K = 3：≈ 43 eV；同一支 U9 在 3 GeV（K = 1）≈ 633 eV。若要以 1.5 GeV 在 K = 1 得到 10 keV 基頻，λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm，即 1.4 mm 週期，遠低於永久磁鐵波盪器的實用範圍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)). U9 at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 gives E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV, and K = 3 gives ≈ 43 eV; the same U9 at 3 GeV (K = 1) gives ≈ 633 eV. A 10 keV fundamental at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 would need λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm, a 1.4 mm period, far below the practical range of permanent-magnet undulators. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；EPU 改變相位時以偏振計量測圓偏振度；記錄間隙或相位改變時的軌道與工作點擾動，建立並定期更新前饋修正表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; measure the degree of circular polarization with a polarimeter as the EPU phase changes; record orbit and tune disturbances as gap or phase changes to build and periodically refresh the feedforward table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。U9 在 1.5 GeV、K = 1：E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV；K = 3：≈ 43 eV；同一支 U9 在 3 GeV（K = 1）≈ 633 eV。若要以 1.5 GeV 在 K = 1 得到 10 keV 基頻，λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm，即 1.4 mm 週期，遠低於永久磁鐵波盪器的實用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)). U9 at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 gives E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV, and K = 3 gives ≈ 43 eV; the same U9 at 3 GeV (K = 1) gives ≈ 633 eV. A 10 keV fundamental at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 would need λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm, a 1.4 mm period, far below the practical range of permanent-magnet undulators.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage", which statement holds?
options: 能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。
改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。
波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。
optionsEn: Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS.
The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.
The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)).
quiz.explanation: 波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；EPU 改變相位時以偏振計量測圓偏振度；記錄間隙或相位改變時的軌道與工作點擾動，建立並定期更新前饋修正表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; measure the degree of circular polarization with a polarimeter as the EPU phase changes; record orbit and tune disturbances as gap or phase changes to build and periodically refresh the feedforward table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy; switching EPU polarization with an outdated feedforward table spreads orbit disturbances to other beamlines and makes intensity jump around the ring.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；EPU 改變相位時以偏振計量測圓偏振度；記錄間隙或相位改變時的軌道與工作點擾動，建立並定期更新前饋修正表。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; measure the degree of circular polarization with a polarimeter as the EPU phase changes; record orbit and tune disturbances as gap or phase changes to build and periodically refresh the feedforward table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage"?
options: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。
optionsEn: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.
quiz.explanation: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；EPU 改變相位時以偏振計量測圓偏振度；記錄間隙或相位改變時的軌道與工作點擾動，建立並定期更新前饋修正表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; measure the degree of circular polarization with a polarimeter as the EPU phase changes; record orbit and tune disturbances as gap or phase changes to build and periodically refresh the feedforward table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy; switching EPU polarization with an outdated feedforward table spreads orbit disturbances to other beamlines and makes intensity jump around the ring. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此 TLS 的光束線以軟 X 光、紅外與成熟的常規技術為主，與 TPS 的硬 X 光高亮度定位互補。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: TLS beamlines therefore focus on soft X-rays, infrared and mature routine techniques, complementing the hard-X-ray, high-brightness role of TPS.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。
knowledge.textEn: Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy; switching EPU polarization with an outdated feedforward table spreads orbit disturbances to other beamlines and makes intensity jump around the ring.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。
TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy.
Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.
quiz.explanation: 波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy; switching EPU polarization with an outdated feedforward table spreads orbit disturbances to other beamlines and makes intensity jump around the ring. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」如何決定台灣同步輻射光源 TLS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。決定實驗留在哪座光源的工程依據之一是相干分率：當電子發射度遠大於光子繞射極限 λ/4π 時，相干光比例很低。交接需記錄每條光束線的光源參數、可用度與老化設備的維護計畫，避免兩座光源共用的人力、低溫與電力資源互相排擠。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired; NSRRC operates both: TLS provides 22 beamlines with about 50 end stations focused on soft X-rays, infrared and mature techniques, while TPS takes experiments needing low emittance and high brightness. One engineering criterion for which source hosts an experiment is the coherent fraction: when electron emittance far exceeds the photon diffraction limit λ/4π, little of the light is coherent. The handoff must record source parameters, availability and maintenance plans for ageing equipment on every beamline so that staff, cryogenics and electrical power shared by the two sources do not crowd each other out. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff
knowledge.text: TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。決定實驗留在哪座光源的工程依據之一是相干分率：當電子發射度遠大於光子繞射極限 λ/4π 時，相干光比例很低。
knowledge.textEn: After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired; NSRRC operates both: TLS provides 22 beamlines with about 50 end stations focused on soft X-rays, infrared and mature techniques, while TPS takes experiments needing low emittance and high brightness. One engineering criterion for which source hosts an experiment is the coherent fraction: when electron emittance far exceeds the photon diffraction limit λ/4π, little of the light is coherent.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff" is correct?
options: TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。
能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。
TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。
optionsEn: Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.
Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%.
After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired.
quiz.explanation: TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired; NSRRC operates both: TLS provides 22 beamlines with about 50 end stations focused on soft X-rays, infrared and mature techniques, while TPS takes experiments needing low emittance and high brightness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。100 eV（λ = 12.4 nm）：ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm；水平相干分率約 ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)，TLS（25.6 nm）≈ 3.7%，TPS（1.6 nm）≈ 38%。10 keV（λ = 0.124 nm）：ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm，TLS ≈ 0.04%、TPS ≈ 0.6%。TLS 垂直發射度 88 pm 在 100 eV 已低於 ε_r，故軟 X 光在垂直方向接近全相干。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π. At 100 eV (λ = 12.4 nm), ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm and the horizontal coherent fraction is about ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r): TLS (25.6 nm) ≈ 3.7% and TPS (1.6 nm) ≈ 38%. At 10 keV (λ = 0.124 nm), ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm, TLS ≈ 0.04% and TPS ≈ 0.6%. The TLS vertical emittance of 88 pm is already below ε_r at 100 eV, so soft X-rays are nearly fully coherent vertically. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表；以光束線的狹縫干涉或空間相干量測驗證相干分率估算；把老化元件（電源、真空泵、低溫系統）的更換紀錄與故障率趨勢納入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime); verify coherent-fraction estimates with slit-interference or spatial-coherence measurements on beamlines; include replacement records and failure-rate trends of ageing components (power supplies, vacuum pumps, cryogenics) in the handoff documents.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。100 eV（λ = 12.4 nm）：ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm；水平相干分率約 ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)，TLS（25.6 nm）≈ 3.7%，TPS（1.6 nm）≈ 38%。10 keV（λ = 0.124 nm）：ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm，TLS ≈ 0.04%、TPS ≈ 0.6%。TLS 垂直發射度 88 pm 在 100 eV 已低於 ε_r，故軟 X 光在垂直方向接近全相干。
knowledge.textEn: The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π. At 100 eV (λ = 12.4 nm), ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm and the horizontal coherent fraction is about ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r): TLS (25.6 nm) ≈ 3.7% and TPS (1.6 nm) ≈ 38%. At 10 keV (λ = 0.124 nm), ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm, TLS ≈ 0.04% and TPS ≈ 0.6%. The TLS vertical emittance of 88 pm is already below ε_r at 100 eV, so soft X-rays are nearly fully coherent vertically.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。
超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。
實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。
optionsEn: The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π.
A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched.
With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.
quiz.explanation: 繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表；以光束線的狹縫干涉或空間相干量測驗證相干分率估算；把老化元件（電源、真空泵、低溫系統）的更換紀錄與故障率趨勢納入交接文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime); verify coherent-fraction estimates with slit-interference or spatial-coherence measurements on beamlines; include replacement records and failure-rate trends of ageing components (power supplies, vacuum pumps, cryogenics) in the handoff documents. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹；若 TLS 的維護因資源轉向 TPS 而延後，老化電源與真空設備的故障率上升，22 條光束線的可用度一起下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time; deferring TLS maintenance as resources shift to TPS raises failure rates of ageing power supplies and vacuum equipment, and availability drops across all 22 beamlines.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表；以光束線的狹縫干涉或空間相干量測驗證相干分率估算；把老化元件（電源、真空泵、低溫系統）的更換紀錄與故障率趨勢納入交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime); verify coherent-fraction estimates with slit-interference or spatial-coherence measurements on beamlines; include replacement records and failure-rate trends of ageing components (power supplies, vacuum pumps, cryogenics) in the handoff documents.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表。
軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime).
Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表；以光束線的狹縫干涉或空間相干量測驗證相干分率估算；把老化元件（電源、真空泵、低溫系統）的更換紀錄與故障率趨勢納入交接文件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime); verify coherent-fraction estimates with slit-interference or spatial-coherence measurements on beamlines; include replacement records and failure-rate trends of ageing components (power supplies, vacuum pumps, cryogenics) in the handoff documents. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹；若 TLS 的維護因資源轉向 TPS 而延後，老化電源與真空設備的故障率上升，22 條光束線的可用度一起下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time; deferring TLS maintenance as resources shift to TPS raises failure rates of ageing power supplies and vacuum equipment, and availability drops across all 22 beamlines. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接需記錄每條光束線的光源參數、可用度與老化設備的維護計畫，避免兩座光源共用的人力、低溫與電力資源互相排擠。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff must record source parameters, availability and maintenance plans for ageing equipment on every beamline so that staff, cryogenics and electrical power shared by the two sources do not crowd each other out.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹；若 TLS 的維護因資源轉向 TPS 而延後，老化電源與真空設備的故障率上升，22 條光束線的可用度一起下降。
knowledge.textEn: Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time; deferring TLS maintenance as resources shift to TPS raises failure rates of ageing power supplies and vacuum equipment, and availability drops across all 22 beamlines.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。
若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%.
Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time.
quiz.explanation: 若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹；若 TLS 的維護因資源轉向 TPS 而延後，老化電源與真空設備的故障率上升，22 條光束線的可用度一起下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time; deferring TLS maintenance as resources shift to TPS raises failure rates of ageing power supplies and vacuum equipment, and availability drops across all 22 beamlines. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
